struct MaybeIndex(Indexed) {
    uint bits;

    static MaybeIndex of(uint value) {
        assert(value != uint.max);
        return MaybeIndex(value + 1);
    }

    bool exists() const {
        return bits != 0;
    }

    uint value() const {
        assert(exists);
        return bits - 1;
    }
}

struct Tagged;

alias KindTag = MaybeIndex!Tagged;
alias KindId = MaybeIndex!RisingKind;

    int level;
    uint node;
    ubyte corner;

    ubyte ySide;

}

enum Extent : ubyte {
    bounded,
    endless,
}

struct ColumnCell {
    int x;
    int y;
    int z;

    ref inout(int) opIndex(size_t axis) inout return {
        if (axis == 0) {
            return x;
        } else if (axis == 1) {
            return y;
        } else {
            assert(axis == 2);
            return z;
        }
    }
}

struct Box {
    ColumnCell low;
    ColumnCell high;
    Extent extent;
}

/// file: plugins/api/flags.d
module plugins.api.flags;

struct Flags(E) {
    static if (E.max < 8) {
        alias Word = ubyte;
    } else static if (E.max < 16) {
        alias Word = ushort;
    } else {
        static assert(E.max < 32);
        alias Word = uint;
    }

    Word bits;

    static Flags of(E flag) {
        return Flags(cast(Word)(1u << flag));
    }

    bool has(E flag) const {
        return (bits & (1u << flag)) != 0;
    }

    void set(E flag) {
        bits |= cast(Word)(1u << flag);
    }

    void clear(E flag) {
        bits &= cast(Word) ~(1u << flag);
    }

    void put(E flag, bool on) {
        if (on) {
            set(flag);
        } else {
            clear(flag);
        }
    }
}

/// file: plugins/arbor/plugin.d
module plugins.arbor.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Color, HorosphereForm, KindId, Look, Material, Registry, Risen, RisingKind, Site, Span, Spot, Tint, entryOf;
import plugins.connector.connector : Tag;
import plugins.horospheres.tree : TRUNK_RADIUS, Trunk, segment;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Offset, Rows, STAIR_HEADROOM, TREAD_THICKNESS, TURN_TREADS, Turtle, boxOf, floorMod, lawn, onWedge, ringRows, treadSpan, wedgeRows;

immutable Look LOOK = Look("arbor", Color(0.72f, 0.84f, 0.74f), Tint.fog);

enum double TREAD_IN = TRUNK_RADIUS - 1;
enum double ROOM_IN = TRUNK_RADIUS + 1.5;
enum double TREAD_OUT = 8.5;
enum double DECK_OUT = 9.5;
enum double RAIL_IN = 8.5;
enum double ROUTE_RADIUS = 6.5;
enum int BURIED_TREADS = 8;
enum int DECK_EVERY = 3;
enum int ROUTE_TURNS = 4;
enum int LANTERN_EVERY = 6;
enum int LANTERN_HEIGHT = 2;
enum uint TREE_EDGES = 2;
enum double ROOT_SHARE = 0.1;
enum Material STEP = Material.spruceWood;
enum Material DECK = Material.woodPlanks;
enum Material POST = Material.spruceWood;
immutable Spot SPAWN = Spot(6, 0, 0);

void climb(Turtle tower, int bottom, int ground) {
    Rows[TURN_TREADS] treads = wedgeRows(tower.column(), TREAD_IN, TREAD_OUT);
    Rows[TURN_TREADS] rooms = wedgeRows(tower.column(), ROOM_IN, TREAD_OUT);
    foreach (tread; -STAIR_HEADROOM .. TURN_TREADS) {
        Rows* wedge = &treads[floorMod(tread, TURN_TREADS)];
        int height = bottom + tread;
        Rows* room = &rooms[floorMod(tread, TURN_TREADS)];
        if (height >= ground - TREAD_THICKNESS) {
            tower.clearOver(*room, tread);
        }
        if (tread >= 0 && height >= ground - BURIED_TREADS) {
            tower.fillRows(STEP, *wedge, treadSpan(tread));
            if (height >= ground) {
                tower.paintRows(STEP, *room, treadSpan(tread));
            }
        }
    }
}

void deck(Turtle tower) {
    Rows floor = ringRows(tower.column(), TREAD_IN, DECK_OUT);
    Rows rail = ringRows(tower.column(), RAIL_IN, DECK_OUT);
    tower.fillRows(DECK, floor, Span(0, 0));
    tower.fillRows(POST, rail, Span(1, 1));
    foreach (tread; 0 .. TURN_TREADS / LANTERN_EVERY) {
        Offset at = onWedge(tread * LANTERN_EVERY, RAIL_IN);
        int x = cast(int) at.x;
        int y = cast(int) at.y;
        tower.fill(Material.lightPanel, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(2, LANTERN_HEIGHT)));
    }
}

void tile(const(Api)* api, Site base, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle tower = Turtle(api, base);
    segment(tower, risen.segment, risen.ground, Trunk.climbed);
    int bottom = risen.segment * tower.edgeCells();
    if (bottom + tower.edgeCells() > risen.ground - BURIED_TREADS) {
        if (floorMod(risen.segment, DECK_EVERY) == 0 && bottom > risen.ground) {
            deck(tower);
        }
        climb(tower, bottom, risen.ground);
    }
}

void plant(const(Api)* api, Site at) {
    KindId kind = api.horosphere(api, 0, HorosphereForm.upright, Tag.tree, &tile, null, 0);
    api.openHorosphere(api, at, kind, TREE_EDGES);
}

void route(Turtle tower) {
    Offset foot = onWedge(0, TREAD_OUT + 2);
    tower.stop(foot.x, foot.y, 0);
    foreach (tread; 0 .. ROUTE_TURNS * TURN_TREADS) {
        Offset at = onWedge(tread, ROUTE_RADIUS);
        tower.stop(at.x, at.y, tread + 1);
    }
}

void landmark(const(Api)* api, Site at, const(void)* data) {
    plant(api, at);
}

void world(const(Api)* api, Site at, const(void)* data) {
    plant(api, at);
    api.tile(api, &lawn, null, 0);
    api.worldLook(api, &LOOK);
    Turtle tower = Turtle(api, at).columnSite();
    route(tower);
    tower.entrance(SPAWN.x, SPAWN.y, SPAWN.z);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "arbor", &world);
    RisingKind rising = RisingKind(ROOT_SHARE, HorosphereForm.upright, Tag.tree, &tile, null, 0, LOOK);
    registry.addKind(registry, "arbor", &rising);
    registry.addLandmark(registry, "arbor", &landmark);
}

/// file: plugins/babel/plugin.d
module plugins.babel.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Color, HorosphereForm, KindId, Look, Material, Registry, Rhythm, Risen, RisingKind, Site, Span, Spot, Tint, entryOf;
import plugins.connector.connector : Tag;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Tread, Turtle, boxOf, floorMod, higherOf, lawn, middle, treadAround;

enum int CORE = 3;
enum int RING = 5;
enum int SIDE_TREADS = 3;
enum int TREADS = 4 * (SIDE_TREADS + 1);
enum int TREAD_DEPTH = 3;
enum int PLAZA = 12;
enum int BAND_EVERY = 64;
enum int ROUTE_TURNS = 2;
enum int FOOTING = 12;
immutable Spot SPAWN = Spot(-PLAZA, 0, 1);
enum Material WALL = Material.sandstone;
enum Material STEP = Material.redSandstone;
enum Material BAND = Material.marble;
enum double COLUMN_SHARE = 0.1;
enum uint COLUMN_EDGES = 2;
immutable Look LOOK = Look("babel", Color(0.82f, 0.74f, 0.58f), Tint.fog);

void core(Turtle tower, Span rising, int lifted) {
    Span wall = Span(-CORE, CORE - 1);
    Span room = Span(-CORE + 1, CORE - 2);
    tower.paint(WALL, boxOf(wall, wall, rising));
    tower.paint(BAND, boxOf(wall, wall, rising), Rhythm(BAND_EVERY, floorMod(BAND_EVERY - 1 - lifted, BAND_EVERY), 1));
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(room, room, rising), Rhythm(TREADS, floorMod(2 - lifted, TREADS), TREADS - 1));
    tower.paint(Material.lightPanel, boxOf(Span(-1, 0), Span(-1, 0), rising), Rhythm(TREADS, floorMod(-lifted, TREADS), 1));
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(0, 1), Span(CORE - 1, CORE - 1), rising), Rhythm(TREADS, floorMod(2 - lifted, TREADS), 3));
}

void stair(Turtle tower, Span rising, int lifted) {
    foreach (index; 0 .. TREADS) {
        Tread tread = treadAround(CORE, RING, SIDE_TREADS, index);
        tower.paint(STEP, boxOf(tread.x, tread.y, rising), Rhythm(TREADS, floorMod(index - TREAD_DEPTH + 1 - lifted, TREADS), TREAD_DEPTH));
    }
}

void route(Turtle tower) {
    tower.stop(CORE + RING + 1.5f, middle(treadAround(CORE, RING, SIDE_TREADS, 0).y), 1);
    foreach (index; 0 .. ROUTE_TURNS * TREADS) {
        Tread tread = treadAround(CORE, RING, SIDE_TREADS, index);
        tower.stop(middle(tread.x), middle(tread.y), index + 1);
    }
}

void column(const(Api)* api, Site base, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle tower = Turtle(api, base);
    int length = tower.edgeCells();
    int lifted = risen.segment * length;
    int plaza = risen.ground - lifted;
    if (plaza >= 0 && plaza < length) {
        tower.fill(WALL, boxOf(Span(-PLAZA, PLAZA - 1), Span(-PLAZA, PLAZA - 1), Span(plaza - FOOTING, plaza - 1)));
        tower.paint(Material.granite, boxOf(Span(-PLAZA, PLAZA - 1), Span(-PLAZA, PLAZA - 1), Span(plaza, plaza)));
    }
    if (plaza < length) {
        Span rising = Span(higherOf(0, plaza), length - 1);
        core(tower, rising, lifted);
        stair(tower, rising, lifted);
    }
}

void landmark(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    KindId kind = api.horosphere(api, 0, HorosphereForm.upright, Tag.column, &column, null, 0);
    api.openHorosphere(api, site, kind, COLUMN_EDGES);
}

void world(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    landmark(api, site, data);
    api.tile(api, &lawn, null, 0);
    api.worldLook(api, &LOOK);
    Turtle tower = Turtle(api, site).columnSite();
    route(tower);
    tower.entrance(SPAWN.x, SPAWN.y, SPAWN.z);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "babel", &world);
    RisingKind rising = RisingKind(COLUMN_SHARE, HorosphereForm.upright, Tag.column, &column, null, 0, LOOK);
    registry.addKind(registry, "babel", &rising);
    registry.addLandmark(registry, "babel", &landmark);
}

/// file: plugins/blocks/blocks.d
module plugins.blocks.blocks;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Material, MaybeIndex, Rhythm, Risen, Site, SitePart, Span;
import plugins.api.flags : Flags;
import plugins.buildings.building : Bound, Join, Lot, Lots, Palette, STORY, Side, Spec;
import plugins.buildings.types : Type, palettes, stories;
import types = plugins.buildings.types;
import plugins.connector.connector : Connection, Tag, connect;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : FACE_CORNERS, Turtle, boxOf, cornersOf, floorDiv, lowerOf, roll, upright;

enum ulong ISLAND_SALT = 0x51ED270B;
enum ulong DROPPED_SALT = 0x2C1B3C6D;
enum ulong TREES_SALT = 0x297A2D39;
enum uint AROUND = 4;
enum double DROPPED_STREET = 0.5;
enum double ISLAND = 0.05;
enum double STREET_TREES = 0.5;
enum uint PARK_PERCENT = 6;
enum uint PLAZA_PERCENT = 5;
enum uint PARKING_PERCENT = 3;
enum uint POND_PERCENT = 50;
enum uint FOUNTAIN_PERCENT = 60;
enum uint ALLEY_PERCENT = 20;
enum uint MAX_INSET = 1;
enum Span ROAD = Span(-2, 1);
enum Span SIDEWALK = Span(2, 3);
enum Span FAR_SIDEWALK = Span(-4, -3);
enum int FRONT = 4;
enum int CROSSING = 1;
enum int TREE_SPACING = 8;
enum int CURB = SIDEWALK.low;
enum int PARKING_SPACING = 3;
enum int CROWN_ROOM = 10;
enum int ROUTE_STORIES = 2;
enum int ROUTE_BUILDING_STORIES = 4;
immutable Bound[4] RUN_BOUNDS = [Side.xLow: Bound.joined, Side.yLow: Bound.joined, Side.xHigh: Bound.lot, Side.yHigh: Bound.lot];
immutable Bound[4] ISLAND_BOUNDS = [Side.xLow: Bound.street, Side.yLow: Bound.street, Side.xHigh: Bound.joined, Side.yHigh: Bound.joined];

enum LotShape : ubyte {
    corner,
    run,
}

enum LotMark : ubyte {
    streetBefore,
    streetAfter,
    first,
}

struct Kind {
    LotShape shape;
    immutable(Type)[] types;
    int most;
}

immutable Type[8] CORNER_TYPES = [Type.tenement, Type.tenement, Type.rowhouse, Type.rowhouse, Type.deco, Type.glass, Type.modern, Type.civic];
immutable Type[8] SLAB_TYPES = [Type.brownstone, Type.brownstone, Type.rowhouse, Type.tenement, Type.warehouse, Type.deco, Type.glass, Type.modern];
immutable Type[7] WIDE_TYPES = [Type.deco, Type.glass, Type.glass, Type.tenement, Type.modern, Type.warehouse, Type.civic];
immutable Type[5] AROUND_TYPES = [Type.deco, Type.glass, Type.tenement, Type.modern, Type.civic];
immutable Type[4] ISLAND_TYPES = [Type.deco, Type.glass, Type.modern, Type.civic];

immutable Kind[4] KINDS = [
    Kind(LotShape.corner, CORNER_TYPES[], 22),
    Kind(LotShape.run, SLAB_TYPES[], 30),
    Kind(LotShape.run, WIDE_TYPES[], 38),
    Kind(LotShape.run, AROUND_TYPES[], 38),
];

struct Root {
    ulong vertex;
    ulong face;
    Risen risen;
    Connection connection;

    bool isRisen() const {
        return risen.hasRisen;
    }
}

struct Area {
    Turtle tower;
    Span x;
    Span y;
}

Turtle[AROUND] quartersOf(Turtle corner) {
    Turtle[AROUND] quarters;
    Turtle turtle = corner;
    foreach (index; 0 .. AROUND) {
        quarters[index] = turtle;
        turtle = turtle.right();
    }
    return quarters;
}

bool probeOwner(ref const Turtle[AROUND] quarters) {
    ulong mine = quarters[0].probeHash(SitePart.face);
    foreach (quarter; quarters[1 .. $]) {
        ulong theirs = quarter.probeHash(SitePart.face);
        if (!(theirs < mine)) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool probeFoot(Turtle corner, ref const Risen risen) {
    ulong own = corner.probeHash(SitePart.vertex);
    ulong foot = Turtle(corner.api, risen.foot).probeHash(SitePart.vertex);
    return own == foot;
}

bool probeOwnsFoot(Turtle face, ref const Risen risen) {
    foreach (corner; cornersOf(face)) {
        Turtle[AROUND] quarters = quartersOf(corner);
        bool foot = probeFoot(corner, risen);
        if (foot) {
            bool owner = probeOwner(quarters);
            if (owner) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

bool probeRootVertex(Turtle site, ref const Root root) {
    ulong own = site.probeHash(SitePart.vertex);
    return own == root.vertex;
}

bool probeIsland(Turtle face, ref const Root root) {
    double rolled = roll(face.probeHash(SitePart.face), ISLAND_SALT);
    if (rolled >= ISLAND) {
        return false;
    } else {
        foreach (corner; cornersOf(face)) {
            bool rooted = probeRootVertex(corner, root);
            if (rooted) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

bool probePlannedStreet(Turtle edge, ref const Root root) {
    bool planned = probeRootVertex(edge, root);
    if (!planned) {
        planned = probeRootVertex(edge.forward(1), root);
    }
    if (!planned) {
        planned = probeIsland(edge, root);
    }
    if (!planned) {
        planned = probeIsland(edge.left(), root);
    }
    if (!planned) {
        double rolled = roll(edge.probeHash(SitePart.edge), DROPPED_SALT);
        planned = rolled >= DROPPED_STREET;
    }
    return planned;
}

bool probeKeptForAccess(Turtle edge, ref const Root root) {
    ulong mine = edge.probeHash(SitePart.edge);
    Turtle turtle = edge.right();
    foreach (index; 1 .. AROUND) {
        bool planned = probePlannedStreet(turtle, root);
        if (planned) {
            return false;
        }
        ulong theirs = turtle.probeHash(SitePart.edge);
        if (!(theirs < mine)) {
            return false;
        }
        turtle = turtle.right();
    }
    return true;
}

bool probeStreet(Turtle edge, ref const Root root) {
    bool paved = probePlannedStreet(edge, root);
    if (!paved) {
        paved = probeKeptForAccess(edge, root);
    }
    if (!paved) {
        paved = probeKeptForAccess(edge.forward(1).right().right(), root);
    }
    return paved;
}

bool probeTrees(Turtle edge) {
    double rolled = roll(edge.probeHash(SitePart.edge), TREES_SALT);
    return rolled < STREET_TREES;
}

int crossingGap(Turtle corner, ref const Root root) {
    bool paved = probeStreet(corner, root);
    if (paved) {
        return CROSSING + 1;
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}

void sidewalk(Turtle edge, Span x, int startGap, int endGap) {
    edge.paint(Material.concrete, boxOf(x, Span(-1, 0), Span(startGap, edge.edgeCells() - 1 - endGap)));
}

void streetTrees(Turtle edge) {
    int last = edge.edgeCells() - 1;
    Span planted = Span(CROSSING + 4, last - CROSSING - 4);
    Rhythm trunk = Rhythm(TREE_SPACING, 6, 1);
    edge.paint(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(CURB - 1, CURB + 1), Span(5, 6), planted), Rhythm(TREE_SPACING, 4, 5));
    edge.paint(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(CURB - 1, CURB + 1), Span(7, 7), planted), Rhythm(TREE_SPACING, 5, 3));
    edge.paint(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(CURB, CURB), Span(8, 8), planted), trunk);
    edge.paint(Material.oakWood, boxOf(Span(CURB, CURB), Span(1, 5), planted), trunk);
}

void street(Turtle edge, ref const Root root) {
    Turtle finish = edge.forward(1);
    int last = edge.edgeCells() - 1;
    edge.paint(Material.basalt, boxOf(ROAD, Span(-1, -1), Span(0, last)));
    sidewalk(edge, SIDEWALK, crossingGap(edge.right(), root), crossingGap(finish.right(), root));
    sidewalk(edge, FAR_SIDEWALK, crossingGap(edge.left(), root), crossingGap(finish.left(), root));
    bool crossedAtStart = probeStreet(edge.right(), root);
    if (!crossedAtStart) {
        crossedAtStart = probeStreet(edge.left(), root);
    }
    if (crossedAtStart) {
        edge.paint(Material.whiteBrick, boxOf(ROAD, Span(-1, -1), Span(CROSSING + 1, CROSSING + 2)));
    }
    bool crossedAtEnd = probeStreet(finish.right(), root);
    if (!crossedAtEnd) {
        crossedAtEnd = probeStreet(finish.left(), root);
    }
    if (crossedAtEnd) {
        edge.paint(Material.whiteBrick, boxOf(ROAD, Span(-1, -1), Span(last - CROSSING - 2, last - CROSSING - 1)));
    }
    bool trees = probeTrees(edge);
    if (trees) {
        streetTrees(edge);
    }
}

void tree(Turtle tower, int x, int y) {
    tower.paint(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(x - 2, x + 2), Span(y - 1, y + 1), Span(5, 7)));
    tower.paint(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(x - 1, x + 1), Span(y - 2, y + 2), Span(5, 7)));
    tower.paint(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(x - 1, x + 1), Span(y - 1, y + 1), Span(8, 9)));
    tower.paint(Material.oakWood, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(1, 7)));
}

Area groundOf(ref const Lot lot) {
    Turtle tower = upright(lot.site);
    int far = tower.column().high;
    int xLow = 0;
    int yLow = 0;
    if (lot.bounds[Side.xLow] == Bound.street) {
        xLow = FRONT;
    }
    if (lot.bounds[Side.yLow] == Bound.street) {
        yLow = FRONT;
    }
    return Area(tower, Span(xLow, far), Span(yLow, far));
}

void pave(ref const Lots lots, Material material) {
    foreach (ref lot; lots.slice()) {
        Area area = groundOf(lot);
        area.tower.paint(material, boxOf(area.x, area.y, Span(-1, 0)));
    }
}

bool isRoomy(Area area) {
    return area.x.high - area.x.low >= 4 && area.y.high - area.y.low >= 4;
}

int centre(Span span) {
    return floorDiv(span.low + span.high + 1, 2);
}

void plant(ref const Lots lots) {
    foreach (ref lot; lots.slice()) {
        Area area = groundOf(lot);
        if (isRoomy(area)) {
            tree(area.tower, centre(area.x), centre(area.y));
        }
    }
}

void fountain(Turtle tower, int x, int y) {
    tower.paint(Material.marble, boxOf(Span(x - 2, x + 2), Span(y - 2, y + 2), Span(1, 1)));
    tower.paint(Material.water, boxOf(Span(x - 1, x + 1), Span(y - 1, y + 1), Span(1, 1)));
    tower.paint(Material.marble, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(1, 2)));
    tower.paint(Material.water, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(3, 3)));
}

void fountains(ref const Lots lots) {
    foreach (ref lot; lots.slice()) {
        Area area = groundOf(lot);
        if (isRoomy(area)) {
            fountain(area.tower, centre(area.x), centre(area.y));
        }
    }
}

void ponds(ref const Lots lots) {
    foreach (ref lot; lots.slice()) {
        Area area = groundOf(lot);
        if (isRoomy(area)) {
            Span x = Span(area.x.low + 1, area.x.high - 1);
            Span y = Span(area.y.low + 1, area.y.high - 1);
            area.tower.paint(Material.water, boxOf(x, y, Span(-1, 0)));
            area.tower.paint(Material.sand, boxOf(x, y, Span(-2, -2)));
        }
    }
}

void parking(ref const Lots lots) {
    foreach (ref lot; lots.slice()) {
        Area area = groundOf(lot);
        area.tower.paint(Material.basalt, boxOf(area.x, area.y, Span(0, 0)));
        for (int x = area.x.low + 1; x <= area.x.high; x += PARKING_SPACING) {
            area.tower.paint(Material.whiteBrick, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(area.y.low + 1, area.y.low + 3), Span(0, 0)));
        }
    }
}

struct Chosen {
    Type type;
    Spec spec;
}

Chosen chosenFor(Turtle site, ref const Kind kind, immutable(Type)[] choices) {
    Type type = choices[site.pick(cast(uint) choices.length)];
    Span range = stories(type);
    int most = lowerOf(range.high, kind.most);
    int count = site.pickBetween(range.low, most);
    int gap = 0;
    if (kind.shape == LotShape.run) {
        bool alley = site.rollChance(ALLEY_PERCENT);
        if (alley) {
            gap = 1;
        }
    }
    int front = FRONT;
    if (kind.shape == LotShape.run) {
        front = FRONT + cast(int) site.pick(MAX_INSET + 1);
    }
    immutable(Palette)[] options = palettes(type);
    Spec spec = {stories: count, palette: options[site.pick(cast(uint) options.length)], front: front, gap: gap};
    return Chosen(type, spec);
}

int fit(Turtle site, int stories) {
    int room = CROWN_ROOM + 1;
    int fitting = floorDiv(site.probeBalance(stories * STORY + room) - room, STORY);
    return lowerOf(stories, fitting);
}

Chosen fitted(Chosen chosen, Turtle site, ref const Root root) {
    Chosen result = chosen;
    if (root.isRisen()) {
        result.spec.stories = fit(site, chosen.spec.stories);
    }
    return result;
}

void build(ref const Lots lots, Chosen chosen) {
    pave(lots, Material.concrete);
    types.build(chosen.type, lots, chosen.spec);
}

bool probePlaza(Turtle corner, ref const Root root) {
    bool plaza = probeRootVertex(corner, root) && root.isRisen();
    if (!plaza) {
        plaza = corner.probeRising().exists;
    }
    return plaza;
}

bool probeRoute(Turtle corner, ref const Lots lots, ref const Root root) {
    bool rooted = probeRootVertex(corner, root);
    if (rooted) {
        foreach (ref lot; lots.slice()) {
            ulong face = lot.site.probeHash(SitePart.face);
            if (face == root.face) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void lotAt(Turtle corner, ref const Lots lots, ref const Root root) {
    Turtle site = lots.items[0].site;
    bool plaza = probePlaza(corner, root);
    if (plaza) {
        pave(lots, Material.granite);
        plant(lots);
    } else {
        bool route = probeRoute(corner, lots, root);
        if (route) {
            Spec spec = {stories: ROUTE_BUILDING_STORIES, palette: palettes(Type.tenement)[0], front: FRONT, routeStories: ROUTE_STORIES};
            build(lots, Chosen(Type.tenement, spec));
        } else {
            rolledLot(site, lots, root);
        }
    }
}

void rolledLot(Turtle site, ref const Lots lots, ref const Root root) {
    bool park = site.rollChance(PARK_PERCENT);
    if (park) {
        pave(lots, Material.grass);
        bool pond = site.rollChance(POND_PERCENT);
        if (pond) {
            ponds(lots);
        } else {
            plant(lots);
        }
    } else {
        bool plaza = site.rollChance(PLAZA_PERCENT);
        if (plaza) {
            pave(lots, Material.granite);
            bool fountain = site.rollChance(FOUNTAIN_PERCENT);
            if (fountain) {
                fountains(lots);
            } else {
                plant(lots);
            }
        } else {
            bool parked = site.rollChance(PARKING_PERCENT);
            if (parked) {
                parking(lots);
            } else {
                Kind kind = KINDS[lots.count - 1];
                Chosen chosen = fitted(chosenFor(site, kind, kind.types), site, root);
                if (chosen.spec.stories >= 1) {
                    build(lots, chosen);
                } else {
                    pave(lots, Material.granite);
                    plant(lots);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

Lot lotOf(Turtle quarter, Flags!LotMark marks) {
    Lot lot;
    lot.site = quarter;
    lot.bounds = RUN_BOUNDS;
    if (marks.has(LotMark.streetAfter)) {
        lot.bounds[Side.xLow] = Bound.street;
    }
    if (marks.has(LotMark.streetBefore)) {
        lot.bounds[Side.yLow] = Bound.street;
    }
    if (marks.has(LotMark.first) && marks.has(LotMark.streetBefore)) {
        lot.front = Side.yLow;
    }
    return lot;
}

void join(ref Lots run) {
    foreach (index; 0 .. run.count) {
        if (run.items[index].bounds[Side.xLow] == Bound.joined) {
            uint next = cast(uint)((index + 1) % run.count);
            run.items[index].joins[Side.xLow] = Join(MaybeIndex!Lot.of(next), Side.yLow);
            run.items[next].joins[Side.yLow] = Join(MaybeIndex!Lot.of(cast(uint) index), Side.xLow);
        }
    }
}

void lotsAt(ref const Turtle[AROUND] quarters, ref const Root root) {
    bool foot = probeRootVertex(quarters[0], root);
    if (foot && root.isRisen()) {
        connect(quarters[0], root.risen, Tag.city, root.connection);
    }
    uint start = 0;
    bool paved = false;
    while (start < AROUND && !paved) {
        paved = probeStreet(quarters[start], root);
        if (!paved) {
            start += 1;
        }
    }
    Lots run;
    foreach (step; 0 .. AROUND) {
        uint index = (start + step) % AROUND;
        uint after = (index + 1) % AROUND;
        bool isolated = probeIsland(quarters[index], root);
        bool streetAfter = probeStreet(quarters[after], root);
        if (!isolated) {
            bool streetBefore = probeStreet(quarters[index], root);
            Flags!LotMark marks;
            marks.put(LotMark.streetBefore, streetBefore);
            marks.put(LotMark.streetAfter, streetAfter);
            marks.put(LotMark.first, run.count == 0);
            run.add(lotOf(quarters[index], marks));
        }
        if (streetAfter || step == AROUND - 1) {
            if (run.count > 0) {
                join(run);
                lotAt(quarters[0], run, root);
            }
            run = Lots.init;
        }
    }
}

void island(ref const Turtle[FACE_CORNERS] corners, ref const Root root) {
    Lots parts;
    foreach (corner; corners) {
        Lot lot;
        lot.site = corner;
        lot.bounds = ISLAND_BOUNDS;
        parts.add(lot);
    }
    parts.items[0].front = Side.yLow;
    Chosen chosen = fitted(chosenFor(corners[0], KINDS[KINDS.length - 1], ISLAND_TYPES[]), corners[0], root);
    if (chosen.spec.stories >= 1) {
        build(parts, chosen);
    } else {
        pave(parts, Material.granite);
        plant(parts);
    }
}

Root rootAt(Turtle site) {
    return Root(site.probeHash(SitePart.vertex), site.probeHash(SitePart.face));
}

Root risenRootAt(Turtle foot, ref const Risen risen, Connection how) {
    return Root(foot.probeHash(SitePart.vertex), foot.probeHash(SitePart.face), risen, how);
}

void tile(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    tileAt(Turtle(api, site), *cast(const(Root)*) data);
}

void tileAt(Turtle face, ref const Root root) {
    Turtle[FACE_CORNERS] corners = cornersOf(face);
    ulong mine = face.probeHash(SitePart.face);
    foreach (edge; corners) {
        bool paved = probeStreet(edge, root);
        if (paved) {
            ulong beside = edge.left().probeHash(SitePart.face);
            if (mine > beside) {
                street(edge, root);
            }
        }
    }
    foreach (corner; corners) {
        Turtle[AROUND] quarters = quartersOf(corner);
        bool owner = probeOwner(quarters);
        if (owner) {
            lotsAt(quarters, root);
        }
    }
    bool isolated = probeIsland(face, root);
    if (isolated) {
        island(corners, root);
    }
}

/// file: plugins/box/box.d
module plugins.box.box;

import plugins.api.api : Material, Rhythm, Span;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Turtle, boxOf;

enum int HALF_WIDTH = 5;
enum int STORY = 4;
enum int DOOR = STORY - 1;
enum int FOUNDATION = 3;
enum int STAIR_START = 2 - HALF_WIDTH;
enum int WINDOW_INSET = 1;
enum int WINDOW_WIDTH = 2;
enum float MIDDLE_LANE = 0;
enum float ROUTE_LANE = 0.5f;
enum Rhythm FLOORS = Rhythm(STORY, 0, 1);
enum Rhythm ROOMS = Rhythm(STORY, 1, STORY - 1);
enum Rhythm WINDOW_ROW = Rhythm(STORY, STORY / 2, 1);
enum int LOW = -HALF_WIDTH;
enum int HIGH = HALF_WIDTH - 1;
enum int HUT_STORIES = 2;
enum int HUT_TOP = HUT_STORIES * STORY;

struct Palette {
    Material wall;
    Material floor;
    Material trim;
}

immutable Palette[4] PALETTES = [
    Palette(Material.concrete, Material.concrete, Material.steel),
    Palette(Material.whiteBrick, Material.greyBrick, Material.steel),
    Palette(Material.sandstone, Material.woodPlanks, Material.steel),
    Palette(Material.greyBrick, Material.concrete, Material.marble),
];

immutable Palette TIMBER = Palette(Material.oakWood, Material.woodPlanks, Material.spruceWood);

immutable int[2] SIDES = [LOW, HIGH];
immutable int[2] WINDOW_STARTS = [LOW + 1 + WINDOW_INSET, HIGH - WINDOW_INSET - WINDOW_WIDTH];

Palette palette(Turtle site) {
    return PALETTES[site.pick(PALETTES.length)];
}

int top(Turtle site, int edges) {
    return edges * site.edgeCells() / STORY * STORY;
}

int lane(int story) {
    if (story % 2 == 0) {
        return 1 - HALF_WIDTH;
    } else {
        return HALF_WIDTH - 3;
    }
}

void shell(Turtle tower, int top, Palette palette) {
    tower.paint(palette.wall, boxOf(Span(LOW, HIGH), Span(LOW, HIGH), Span(-FOUNDATION, top)));
    tower.paint(palette.trim, boxOf(Span(LOW, HIGH), Span(LOW, HIGH), Span(0, top)), FLOORS);
    foreach (x; SIDES) {
        foreach (y; SIDES) {
            tower.paint(palette.trim, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(0, top)));
        }
    }
}

void floors(Turtle tower, int top, Palette palette) {
    tower.paint(palette.floor, boxOf(Span(LOW + 1, HIGH - 1), Span(LOW + 1, HIGH - 1), Span(0, top)), FLOORS);
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(LOW + 1, HIGH - 1), Span(LOW + 1, HIGH - 1), Span(0, top)), ROOMS);
}

void windows(Turtle tower, int top) {
    foreach (start; WINDOW_STARTS) {
        Span window = Span(start, start + WINDOW_WIDTH - 1);
        tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(LOW, LOW), window, Span(0, top - 1)), WINDOW_ROW);
        tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(HIGH, HIGH), window, Span(0, top - 1)), WINDOW_ROW);
        tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(window, Span(LOW, LOW), Span(0, top - 1)), WINDOW_ROW);
        tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(window, Span(HIGH, HIGH), Span(0, top - 1)), WINDOW_ROW);
    }
}

void stairs(Turtle tower, int top, Palette palette) {
    int everyOtherStory = 2 * STORY;
    foreach (parity; 0 .. 2) {
        Span stairLane = Span(lane(parity), lane(parity) + 1);
        int floor = parity * STORY;
        foreach (tread; 0 .. STORY - 1) {
            int step = STAIR_START + tread;
            tower.paint(palette.floor, boxOf(Span(step, step), stairLane, Span(0, top - 1)), Rhythm(everyOtherStory, floor + 1, tread + 1));
        }
        tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(STAIR_START - 1, STAIR_START + STORY - 2), stairLane, Span(STORY, top)), Rhythm(everyOtherStory, floor + STORY, 1));
    }
}

void merlons(Turtle tower, int z, Palette palette) {
    foreach (x; LOW .. HIGH + 1) {
        foreach (y; LOW .. HIGH + 1) {
            if ((x == LOW || x == HIGH || y == LOW || y == HIGH) && (x + y) % 2 == 0) {
                tower.paint(palette.trim, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(z, z)));
            }
        }
    }
}

void tower(Turtle at, int top, Palette palette) {
    shell(at, top, palette);
    floors(at, top, palette);
    windows(at, top);
    stairs(at, top, palette);
    merlons(at, top + 1, palette);
}

void door(Turtle tower) {
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(LOW, LOW), Span(-1, 0), Span(1, DOOR)));
}

void hut(Turtle at) {
    tower(at, HUT_TOP, TIMBER);
    door(at);
}

void stairRoute(Turtle tower, int firstFloor, int top) {
    float approach = STAIR_START - 0.5f;
    float landing = STAIR_START + STORY - 0.5f;
    for (int floor = firstFloor; floor < top; floor += STORY) {
        float stairLane = lane(floor / STORY) + 1;
        tower.stop(approach, MIDDLE_LANE, floor + 1);
        tower.stop(approach, stairLane, floor + 1);
        foreach (tread; 0 .. STORY - 1) {
            tower.stop(STAIR_START + tread + 0.5f, stairLane, floor + tread + 2);
        }
        tower.stop(landing, stairLane, floor + STORY + 1);
        tower.stop(landing, MIDDLE_LANE, floor + STORY + 1);
    }
}

/// file: plugins/buildings/brownstone.d
module plugins.buildings.brownstone;

import plugins.api.api : Material, Span;
import plugins.buildings.building : Lots, Palette, Parts, Spec, chimney, crown, enter, makeParts, masonry, pick, roof, shell, tiers;

enum Span STORIES = Span(4, 5);
enum Material ROOF = Material.slate;

immutable Palette[5] PALETTES = [
    Palette(Material.redSandstone, Material.sandstone, Material.woodPlanks),
    Palette(Material.redSandstone, Material.limestone, Material.woodPlanks),
    Palette(Material.shale, Material.limestone, Material.woodPlanks),
    Palette(Material.clay, Material.sandstone, Material.woodPlanks),
    Palette(Material.spruceWood, Material.diorite, Material.woodPlanks),
];

void build(ref const Lots lots, Spec spec) {
    Parts parts;
    makeParts(parts, lots, spec);
    foreach (ref part; parts.slice()) {
        foreach (tier; tiers(part, spec, 0).slice()) {
            masonry(part, spec.palette, shell(part, spec.palette, tier), tier);
            if (tier.isRoofed()) {
                roof(part, spec.palette, ROOF, tier);
            }
        }
    }
    enter(parts, spec);
    uint choice = pick(parts, 2);
    if (choice == 0) {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &chimney);
    }
}

/// file: plugins/buildings/building.d
module plugins.buildings.building;

import plugins.api.api : Box, Material, MaybeIndex, Rhythm, Span;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Along, Turtle, boxOf, floorDiv, higherOf, lowerOf, upright;

enum int STORY = 4;
enum size_t MOST_PARTS = 5;
enum size_t MOST_TIERS = 8;
enum size_t MOST_BOXES = 32;
enum Rhythm FLOORS = Rhythm(STORY, 0, 1);
enum Rhythm WINDOW_ROWS = Rhythm(STORY, 1, 2);
enum Rhythm ROOMS = Rhythm(STORY, 1, STORY - 1);
enum int DOOR_TOP = STORY - 1;
enum int DOOR_WIDTH = 2;
enum int PIER_SPACING = 3;
enum int ANTENNA = 6;
enum int MAST_SPACING = 3;
enum int CHIMNEY = 3;
enum int LEAST_PAD = 5;
enum int CORE_LENGTH = STORY + 1;
enum int CORE_WIDTH = 5;
enum int CORE_ROOM = CORE_WIDTH + 2;
enum int WALKWAY = 2;
enum int SECOND_LANE = 3;

enum Bound : ubyte {
    street,
    joined,
    lot,
}

enum Side : ubyte {
    xLow,
    yLow,
    xHigh,
    yHigh,
    none,
}

    above,
    below,
}

    open,
    roofed,
}

    covered,

immutable Side[4] SIDES = [Side.xLow, Side.yLow, Side.xHigh, Side.yHigh];

struct Palette {
    Material wall;
    Material trim;
    Material floor;
    Material band;
    Material roof;
}

struct Spec {
    int stories;
    Palette palette;
    int front;
    int gap;
    int routeStories;
}

struct Join {
    MaybeIndex!Lot lot;
    Side side;
}

struct Lot {
    Turtle site;
    Bound[4] bounds;
    Join[4] joins;
    Side front = Side.none;
}

struct Lots {
    Lot[MOST_PARTS] items;
    size_t count;

    void add(Lot lot) {
        items[count] = lot;
        count += 1;
    }

    inout(Lot)[] slice() inout return {
        return items[0 .. count];
    }
}

struct Tier {
    int low;
    int high;
    int shrink;
    Split split;
    Roofing roofing;
    Stacking stacking;
    int aboveShrink;
    Split aboveSplit;

    bool isRoofed() const {
        return roofing == Roofing.roofed;
    }

    bool hasAbove() const {
        return stacking == Stacking.covered;
    }
}

struct PartJoin {
    const(Part)* part;
    Side side;
}

struct Part {
    Turtle tower;
    Turtle site;
    Span x;
    Span y;
    Bound[4] kinds;
    PartJoin[4] joins;
    Side front = Side.none;
    int split;
    Tier top;
    Tier stand;
}

struct Parts {
    Part[MOST_PARTS] items;
    size_t count;

    inout(Part)[] slice() inout return {
        return items[0 .. count];
    }
}

struct Tiers {
    Tier[MOST_TIERS] items;
    size_t count;

    inout(Tier)[] slice() inout return {
        return items[0 .. count];
    }
}

struct Boxes {
    Box[MOST_BOXES] items;
    size_t count;

    void add(Box box) {
        items[count] = box;
        count += 1;
    }

    inout(Box)[] slice() inout return {
        return items[0 .. count];
    }
}

alias Crown = void function(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier);

int boundLow(Bound kind, Spec spec) {
    if (kind == Bound.street) {
        return spec.front;
    } else if (kind == Bound.joined) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        return spec.gap;
    }
}

int boundHigh(Bound kind, Spec spec, int far) {
    if (kind == Bound.joined) {
        return far;
    } else {
        return far - spec.gap;
    }
}

bool isOpen(ref const Part part, Side side, Split split) {
    return part.kinds[side] == Bound.joined && (side == Side.xLow || side == Side.yLow || split == Split.below);
}

int shrinkAt(ref const Part part, Side side, Split split, int shrink) {
    if (isOpen(part, side, split)) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        return shrink;
    }
}

Box footprint(ref const Part part, int shrink, Split split, int low, int high) {
    return boxOf(
        Span(part.x.low + shrinkAt(part, Side.xLow, split, shrink), part.x.high - shrinkAt(part, Side.xHigh, split, shrink)),
        Span(part.y.low + shrinkAt(part, Side.yLow, split, shrink), part.y.high - shrinkAt(part, Side.yHigh, split, shrink)),
        Span(low, high),
    );
}

int middle(Span span) {
    return floorDiv(span.low + span.high, 2);
}

int width(Span span) {
    return span.high - span.low + 1;
}

Span xSpan(Box box) {
    return Span(box.low.x, box.high.x);
}

Span ySpan(Box box) {
    return Span(box.low.y, box.high.y);
}

int area(Box box) {
    return width(xSpan(box)) * width(ySpan(box));
}

bool isEmpty(Box box) {
    return box.low.x > box.high.x || box.low.y > box.high.y;
}

Box faceOf(Box box, Side side) {
    Box face = box;
    if (side == Side.xLow) {
        face.high.x = box.low.x;
    } else if (side == Side.xHigh) {
        face.low.x = box.high.x;
    } else if (side == Side.yLow) {
        face.high.y = box.low.y;
    } else {
        face.low.y = box.high.y;
    }
    return face;
}

bool isAlongY(Side side) {
    return side == Side.xLow || side == Side.xHigh;
}

size_t axisIndex(Along along) {
    if (along == Along.x) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        return 1;
    }
}

size_t alongAxis(Side side) {
    if (isAlongY(side)) {
        return 1;
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}

Span along(Box box, Side side) {
    size_t axis = alongAxis(side);
    return Span(box.low[axis], box.high[axis]);
}

Box withAlong(Box face, Side side, Span span) {
    Box piece = face;
    size_t axis = alongAxis(side);
    piece.low[axis] = span.low;
    piece.high[axis] = span.high;
    return piece;
}

Box movedOut(Box face, Side side, int cells) {
    int sign = cells;
    if (side == Side.xLow || side == Side.yLow) {
        sign = -cells;
    }
    Box moved = face;
    size_t axis = 1 - alongAxis(side);
    moved.low[axis] += sign;
    moved.high[axis] += sign;
    return moved;
}

Boxes uncovered(ref const Part part, Box box, Side side, Tier tier) {
    Boxes pieces;
    PartJoin join = part.joins[side];
    if (join.part !is null) {
        Span theirs = along(footprint(*join.part, tier.shrink, tier.split, tier.low, tier.high), join.side);
        Span mine = along(box, side);
        Box face = faceOf(box, side);
        if (mine.low < theirs.low) {
            pieces.add(withAlong(face, side, Span(mine.low, lowerOf(mine.high, theirs.low - 1))));
        }
        if (mine.high > theirs.high) {
            pieces.add(withAlong(face, side, Span(higherOf(mine.low, theirs.high + 1), mine.high)));
        }
    }
    return pieces;
}

Boxes walls(ref const Part part, Box box, Tier tier) {
    Boxes list;
    foreach (side; SIDES) {
        if (!isOpen(part, side, tier.split)) {
            list.add(faceOf(box, side));
        } else {
            foreach (piece; uncovered(part, box, side, tier).slice()) {
                list.add(piece);
            }
        }
    }
    return list;
}

Boxes strips(Box face, int spacing) {
    size_t axis = 1;
    if (face.low.x != face.high.x) {
        axis = 0;
    }
    int first = face.low[axis];
    int last = face.high[axis];
    Boxes list;
    int cell = first;
    while (cell <= last) {
        Box strip = face;
        strip.low[axis] = cell;
        strip.high[axis] = cell;
        list.add(strip);
        cell += spacing;
    }
    if (list.items[list.count - 1].low[axis] != last) {
        Box strip = face;
        strip.low[axis] = last;
        strip.high[axis] = last;
        list.add(strip);
    }
    return list;
}

int narrowestOf(Box box) {
    return lowerOf(width(ySpan(box)), width(xSpan(box)));
}

int narrowing(Span x, Span y, int wanted, int least) {
    int room = floorDiv(lowerOf(width(y), width(x)) - least, 2);
    return higherOf(lowerOf(wanted, room), 0);
}

Part partOf(ref const Lot lot, Spec spec) {
    Turtle tower = upright(lot.site);
    int far = tower.column().high;
    Part part;
    part.tower = tower;
    part.site = lot.site;
    part.x = Span(boundLow(lot.bounds[Side.xLow], spec), boundHigh(lot.bounds[Side.xHigh], spec, far));
    part.y = Span(boundLow(lot.bounds[Side.yLow], spec), boundHigh(lot.bounds[Side.yHigh], spec, far));
    part.kinds = lot.bounds;
    part.front = lot.front;
    part.split = far + 1;
    return part;
}

void makeParts(ref Parts parts, ref const Lots lots, Spec spec) {
    parts.count = lots.count;
    foreach (index, ref lot; lots.slice()) {
        parts.items[index] = partOf(lot, spec);
    }
    foreach (index, ref lot; lots.slice()) {
        foreach (side; SIDES) {
            if (lot.joins[side].lot.exists) {
                parts.items[index].joins[side] = PartJoin(&parts.items[lot.joins[side].lot.value], lot.joins[side].side);
            }
        }
    }
}

int setbacks(ref const Parts parts, int wanted) {
    int chosen = wanted;
    foreach (ref part; parts.slice()) {
        chosen = lowerOf(narrowing(part.x, part.y, wanted, CORE_ROOM), chosen);
    }
    return chosen;
}

Tiers tiers(ref Part part, Spec spec, int setbacks) {
    int top = spec.stories * STORY;
    Tiers found;
    int belowTop = lowerOf(top, part.split - 1);
    found.items[0] = Tier(0, belowTop, 0, Split.below);
    found.count = 1;
    int low = part.split;
    foreach (tier; 0 .. setbacks + 1) {
        int high = top;
        if (tier < setbacks) {
            high = part.split + floorDiv(floorDiv((top - part.split) * (tier + 1), setbacks + 1), STORY) * STORY;
        }
        if (high >= low) {
            found.items[found.count] = Tier(low, high, tier, Split.above);
            found.count += 1;
            low = high + 1;
        }
    }
    foreach (index; 0 .. found.count) {
        Tier* tier = &found.items[index];
        if (index + 1 < found.count) {
            Tier above = found.items[index + 1];
            tier.stacking = Stacking.covered;
            tier.aboveShrink = above.shrink;
            tier.aboveSplit = above.split;
            if (above.shrink > tier.shrink) {
                tier.roofing = Roofing.roofed;
            }
        } else {
            tier.roofing = Roofing.roofed;
        }
    }
    part.top = found.items[found.count - 1];
    part.stand = part.top;
    return found;
}

Box shell(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box box = footprint(part, tier.shrink, tier.split, tier.low, tier.high);
    Box inside = footprint(part, tier.shrink + 1, tier.split, tier.low, tier.high);
    part.tower.paint(palette.wall, box);
    if (palette.band != Material.none) {
        part.tower.paint(palette.band, box, FLOORS);
    }
    part.tower.paint(palette.floor, inside, FLOORS);
    part.tower.paint(Material.none, inside, ROOMS);
    foreach (side; SIDES) {
        if (isOpen(part, side, tier.split)) {
            foreach (piece; uncovered(part, box, side, tier).slice()) {
                part.tower.paint(palette.wall, piece);
                if (palette.band != Material.none) {
                    part.tower.paint(palette.band, piece, FLOORS);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return box;
}

void ring(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    int z = tier.high + 1;
    Tier level = Tier(z, z, tier.shrink, Split.above);
    Box box = footprint(part, tier.shrink, Split.above, z, z);
    part.tower.paint(palette.trim, box);
    part.tower.paint(Material.none, footprint(part, tier.shrink + 1, Split.above, z, z));
    foreach (side; SIDES) {
        if (isOpen(part, side, Split.above)) {
            foreach (piece; uncovered(part, box, side, level).slice()) {
                part.tower.paint(palette.trim, piece);
            }
        }
    }
}

void roof(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Material material, Tier tier) {
    part.tower.paint(material, footprint(part, tier.shrink, tier.split, tier.high, tier.high));
    if (tier.hasAbove()) {
        part.tower.paint(palette.floor, footprint(part, tier.aboveShrink + 1, tier.aboveSplit, tier.high, tier.high));
    }
    ring(part, palette, tier);
}

void punched(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Box box, Tier tier, int spacing) {
    foreach (face; walls(part, box, tier).slice()) {
        part.tower.paint(Material.glass, face, WINDOW_ROWS);
        foreach (pier; strips(face, spacing).slice()) {
            part.tower.paint(palette.wall, pier);
        }
    }
}

void masonry(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Box box, Tier tier) {
    punched(part, palette, box, tier, PIER_SPACING);
}

void banded(ref const Part part, Box box, Tier tier, Rhythm rows) {
    foreach (face; walls(part, box, tier).slice()) {
        part.tower.paint(Material.glass, face, rows);
    }
}

void storefront(ref const Part part) {
    Box box = footprint(part, 0, Split.below, 1, DOOR_TOP);
    foreach (side; SIDES) {
        if (part.kinds[side] == Bound.street) {
            Box face = faceOf(box, side);
            Span run = along(face, side);
            part.tower.paint(Material.glass, withAlong(face, side, Span(run.low + 1, run.high - 1)));
        }
    }
}

void masts(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box roofBox = footprint(part, tier.shrink + 1, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    if (!isEmpty(roofBox)) {
        int x = middle(xSpan(roofBox));
        int y = middle(ySpan(roofBox));
        size_t axis = 1;
        if (width(xSpan(roofBox)) >= width(ySpan(roofBox))) {
            axis = 0;
        }
        int height = ANTENNA + STORY;
        for (int cell = roofBox.low[axis] + 1; cell <= roofBox.high[axis] - 1; cell += MAST_SPACING) {
            Box mast = boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(cell, cell), Span(tier.high + 1, tier.high + height));
            if (axis == 0) {
                mast = boxOf(Span(cell, cell), Span(y, y), Span(tier.high + 1, tier.high + height));
            }
            part.tower.paint(palette.trim, mast);
            height = higherOf(height - 2, 2);
        }
    }
}

void pyramid(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box roofBox = footprint(part, tier.shrink + 1, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    int reach = floorDiv(narrowestOf(roofBox) - 1, 2);
    int x = middle(xSpan(roofBox));
    int y = middle(ySpan(roofBox));
    foreach (level; 1 .. reach + 2) {
        int spread = reach + 1 - level;
        part.tower.paint(palette.trim, boxOf(Span(x - spread, x + spread), Span(y - spread, y + spread), Span(tier.high + level, tier.high + level)));
    }
}

void helipad(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box roofBox = footprint(part, tier.shrink + 1, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    if (width(xSpan(roofBox)) >= LEAST_PAD && width(ySpan(roofBox)) >= LEAST_PAD) {
        int x = middle(xSpan(roofBox));
        int y = middle(ySpan(roofBox));
        int z = tier.high + 1;
        part.tower.paint(Material.concrete, boxOf(Span(x - 2, x + 2), Span(y - 2, y + 2), Span(z, z)));
        part.tower.paint(Material.whiteBrick, boxOf(Span(x - 1, x - 1), Span(y - 1, y + 1), Span(z, z)));
        part.tower.paint(Material.whiteBrick, boxOf(Span(x + 1, x + 1), Span(y - 1, y + 1), Span(z, z)));
        part.tower.paint(Material.whiteBrick, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(z, z)));
    }
}

void chimney(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box roofBox = footprint(part, tier.shrink + 1, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    if (!isEmpty(roofBox)) {
        int x = roofBox.high.x;
        int y = roofBox.high.y;
        part.tower.paint(palette.trim, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(tier.high + 1, tier.high + CHIMNEY)));
    }
}

void waterTower(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box roofBox = footprint(part, tier.shrink, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    int x = roofBox.high.x - 2;
    int y = roofBox.high.y - 2;
    part.tower.paint(Material.steel, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(tier.high + 1, tier.high + 1)));
    part.tower.paint(Material.steel, boxOf(Span(x + 1, x + 1), Span(y + 1, y + 1), Span(tier.high + 1, tier.high + 1)));
    part.tower.paint(Material.woodPlanks, boxOf(Span(x, x + 1), Span(y, y + 1), Span(tier.high + 2, tier.high + 4)));
}

struct Core {
    Along along;
    int sign;
    int first;
    int across;
    int lengthRoom;
    int widthRoom;

    bool isRoomy() const {
        return lengthRoom >= CORE_LENGTH && widthRoom >= CORE_WIDTH;
    }
}

Core coreOf(ref const Part part, Box interior) {
    Side side = part.front;
    Along direction = Along.y;
    if (side == Side.xLow || side == Side.xHigh) {
        direction = Along.x;
    }
    size_t alongIndex = axisIndex(direction);
    size_t acrossIndex = 1 - alongIndex;
    Span alongSpan = Span(interior.low[alongIndex], interior.high[alongIndex]);
    Span acrossSpan = Span(interior.low[acrossIndex], interior.high[acrossIndex]);
    int sign = 1;
    int first = alongSpan.low;
    if (side == Side.xHigh || side == Side.yHigh) {
        sign = -1;
        first = alongSpan.high;
    }
    int acrossWidth = width(acrossSpan);
    return Core(direction, sign, first, acrossSpan.low + floorDiv(acrossWidth - CORE_WIDTH, 2), width(alongSpan), acrossWidth);
}

Box coreBox(Core core, int alongLow, int alongHigh, int acrossLow, int acrossHigh, Span z) {
    int a = core.first + core.sign * alongLow;
    int b = core.first + core.sign * alongHigh;
    Span alongSpan = Span(lowerOf(a, b), higherOf(a, b));
    Span acrossSpan = Span(core.across + acrossLow, core.across + acrossHigh);
    if (core.along == Along.x) {
        return boxOf(alongSpan, acrossSpan, z);
    } else {
        return boxOf(acrossSpan, alongSpan, z);
    }
}

void coreStairs(ref const Part part, Core core, int top, Material material) {
    int last = top - STORY;
    foreach (parity; 0 .. 2) {
        int lane = SECOND_LANE * parity;
        int floor = parity * STORY;
        foreach (tread; 1 .. STORY) {
            part.tower.paint(material, coreBox(core, tread, tread, lane, lane + 1, Span(1, last - 1)), Rhythm(2 * STORY, floor + 1, tread));
        }
        part.tower.paint(Material.none, coreBox(core, 0, STORY - 1, lane, lane + 1, Span(STORY, last)), Rhythm(2 * STORY, floor + STORY, 1));
    }
}

int wallAlong(Core core, Box ground) {
    size_t axis = axisIndex(core.along);
    if (core.sign > 0) {
        return ground.low[axis];
    } else {
        return ground.high[axis];
    }
}

void coreDoor(ref const Part part, Core core, Box ground) {
    int wall = wallAlong(core, ground);
    Box door = coreBox(core, 0, 0, WALKWAY, WALKWAY + DOOR_WIDTH - 1, Span(1, DOOR_TOP));
    size_t axis = axisIndex(core.along);
    door.low[axis] = lowerOf(wall, wall + core.sign);
    door.high[axis] = higherOf(wall, wall + core.sign);
    part.tower.paint(Material.none, door);
}

void coreStop(ref const Part part, Core core, float alongAt, float across, float z) {
    if (core.along == Along.x) {
        part.tower.stop(alongAt, across, z);
    } else {
        part.tower.stop(across, alongAt, z);
    }
}

void coreRoute(ref const Part part, Core core, Box ground, int stories) {
    int wall = wallAlong(core, ground);
    float walkway = core.across + WALKWAY + 0.5f;
    coreStop(part, core, wall - core.sign * ROAD_STOP + 0.5f, walkway, 0);
    coreStop(part, core, wall - core.sign * SIDEWALK_STOP + 0.5f, walkway, 1);
    foreach (story; 0 .. stories) {
        int floor = story * STORY;
        float lane = core.across + SECOND_LANE * (story % 2) + 1;
        coreStop(part, core, core.first + 0.5f, walkway, floor + 1);
        coreStop(part, core, core.first + 0.5f, lane, floor + 1);
        foreach (tread; 1 .. STORY) {
            coreStop(part, core, core.first + core.sign * tread + 0.5f, lane, floor + tread + 1);
        }
        coreStop(part, core, core.first + core.sign * STORY + 0.5f, lane, floor + STORY + 1);
        coreStop(part, core, core.first + core.sign * STORY + 0.5f, walkway, floor + STORY + 1);
    }
}

void enter(ref const Parts parts, Spec spec) {
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < parts.count && parts.items[index].front == Side.none) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index < parts.count) {
        const(Part)* entry = &parts.items[index];
        Core core = coreOf(*entry, footprint(*entry, entry.top.shrink + 1, entry.top.split, 0, 0));
        if (core.isRoomy()) {
            Box ground = footprint(*entry, 0, Split.below, 0, 0);
            coreDoor(*entry, core, ground);
            if (spec.stories > 1) {
                coreStairs(*entry, core, spec.stories * STORY, spec.palette.floor);
            }
            if (spec.routeStories > 0) {
                coreRoute(*entry, core, ground, spec.routeStories);
            }
        }
    }
}

void crown(ref const Parts parts, Palette palette, Crown chosen) {
    size_t main = 0;
    foreach (index, ref part; parts.slice()) {
        const(Part)* best = &parts.items[main];
        if (area(footprint(part, part.stand.shrink, Split.above, 0, 0)) > area(footprint(*best, best.stand.shrink, Split.above, 0, 0))) {
            main = index;
        }
    }
    chosen(parts.items[main], palette, parts.items[main].stand);
}

uint pick(ref const Parts parts, uint count) {
    return parts.items[0].site.pick(count);
}

/// file: plugins/buildings/civic.d
module plugins.buildings.civic;

import core.stdc.math : floor, sqrt;
import plugins.api.api : Box, Material, Span;
import plugins.buildings.building : Bound, Lots, Palette, Part, Parts, SIDES, STORY, Spec, Split, Tier, along, crown, enter, faceOf, footprint, makeParts, masonry, middle, movedOut, narrowestOf, pick, pyramid, roof, setbacks, shell, strips, tiers, withAlong, xSpan, ySpan;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : boxOf, floorDiv;

enum Span STORIES = Span(3, 6);
enum int SETBACKS = 1;
enum Material ROOF = Material.slate;
enum int COLUMN_SPACING = 3;

immutable Palette[4] PALETTES = [
    Palette(Material.marble, Material.limestone, Material.marble, Material.none, Material.slate),
    Palette(Material.limestone, Material.marble, Material.marble, Material.none, Material.steel),
    Palette(Material.sandstone, Material.limestone, Material.woodPlanks, Material.none, Material.clay),
    Palette(Material.granite, Material.marble, Material.marble, Material.none, Material.slate),
];

void arcade(ref const Part part, Palette palette) {
    Box box = footprint(part, 0, Split.below, 1, STORY - 1);
    foreach (side; SIDES) {
        if (part.kinds[side] == Bound.street) {
            Box face = faceOf(box, side);
            part.tower.paint(Material.none, face);
            foreach (column; strips(face, COLUMN_SPACING).slice()) {
                part.tower.paint(palette.trim, column);
            }
            Box behind = movedOut(face, side, -1);
            Span run = along(behind, side);
            part.tower.paint(Material.glass, withAlong(behind, side, Span(run.low + 1, run.high - 1)));
        }
    }
}

void dome(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box roofBox = footprint(part, tier.shrink + 1, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    int reach = floorDiv(narrowestOf(roofBox) - 1, 2);
    int x = middle(xSpan(roofBox));
    int y = middle(ySpan(roofBox));
    foreach (level; 0 .. reach + 1) {
        int spread = cast(int) floor(sqrt(cast(double)(reach * reach - level * level)) + 0.5);
        int z = tier.high + level + 1;
        part.tower.paint(palette.roof, boxOf(Span(x - spread, x + spread), Span(y - spread, y + spread), Span(z, z)));
    }
}

void build(ref const Lots lots, Spec spec) {
    Parts parts;
    makeParts(parts, lots, spec);
    int chosen = setbacks(parts, SETBACKS);
    foreach (ref part; parts.slice()) {
        foreach (tier; tiers(part, spec, chosen).slice()) {
            masonry(part, spec.palette, shell(part, spec.palette, tier), tier);
            if (tier.isRoofed()) {
                roof(part, spec.palette, ROOF, tier);
            }
        }
        arcade(part, spec.palette);
    }
    enter(parts, spec);
    uint choice = pick(parts, 3);
    if (choice < 2) {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &dome);
    } else {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &pyramid);
    }
}

/// file: plugins/buildings/deco.d
module plugins.buildings.deco;

import plugins.api.api : Box, Material, Span;
import plugins.buildings.building : Lots, Palette, Part, Parts, Spec, Split, Tier, crown, enter, footprint, makeParts, masonry, middle, pick, pyramid, roof, setbacks, shell, storefront, tiers, xSpan, ySpan;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : boxOf;

enum Span STORIES = Span(14, 34);
enum int SETBACKS = 2;
enum Material ROOF = Material.slate;
enum int SPIRE = 10;

immutable Palette[5] PALETTES = [
    Palette(Material.limestone, Material.steel, Material.concrete),
    Palette(Material.sandstone, Material.marble, Material.concrete),
    Palette(Material.whiteBrick, Material.steel, Material.concrete),
    Palette(Material.diorite, Material.granite, Material.concrete),
    Palette(Material.dolomite, Material.slate, Material.concrete),
];

void spire(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box roofBox = footprint(part, tier.shrink, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    int x = middle(xSpan(roofBox));
    int y = middle(ySpan(roofBox));
    part.tower.paint(palette.trim, boxOf(Span(x - 1, x + 1), Span(y - 1, y + 1), Span(tier.high + 1, tier.high + 2)));
    part.tower.paint(palette.trim, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(tier.high + 3, tier.high + SPIRE)));
}

void build(ref const Lots lots, Spec spec) {
    Parts parts;
    makeParts(parts, lots, spec);
    int chosen = setbacks(parts, SETBACKS);
    foreach (ref part; parts.slice()) {
        foreach (tier; tiers(part, spec, chosen).slice()) {
            masonry(part, spec.palette, shell(part, spec.palette, tier), tier);
            if (tier.isRoofed()) {
                roof(part, spec.palette, ROOF, tier);
            }
        }
        storefront(part);
    }
    enter(parts, spec);
    uint choice = pick(parts, 3);
    if (choice < 2) {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &spire);
    } else {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &pyramid);
    }
}

/// file: plugins/buildings/glass.d
module plugins.buildings.glass;

import plugins.api.api : Box, Material, Rhythm, Span;
import plugins.buildings.building : ANTENNA, Bound, Lots, Palette, Part, PartJoin, Parts, STORY, Spec, Split, Tier, crown, enter, footprint, helipad, makeParts, masts, middle, narrowing, pick, roof, setbacks, shell, strips, tiers, walls, xSpan, ySpan;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : boxOf;

enum Span STORIES = Span(12, 38);
enum int SETBACKS = 1;
enum Material ROOF = Material.concrete;
enum Rhythm SPANDRELS = Rhythm(STORY, STORY - 1, 1);
enum int MULLION_SPACING = 3;
enum int PENTHOUSE_SETBACK = 2;
enum int LEAST_WIDTH = 3;

immutable Palette[4] PALETTES = [
    Palette(Material.glass, Material.steel, Material.concrete, Material.concrete),
    Palette(Material.glass, Material.basalt, Material.concrete, Material.slate),
    Palette(Material.glass, Material.steel, Material.marble, Material.steel),
    Palette(Material.glass, Material.gabbro, Material.concrete, Material.gabbro),
];

void curtain(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Box box, Tier tier) {
    foreach (face; walls(part, box, tier).slice()) {
        part.tower.paint(palette.band, face, SPANDRELS);
        foreach (mullion; strips(face, MULLION_SPACING).slice()) {
            part.tower.paint(palette.trim, mullion);
        }
    }
}

Tier penthouse(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box roofBox = footprint(part, tier.shrink, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    int inset = narrowing(xSpan(roofBox), ySpan(roofBox), PENTHOUSE_SETBACK, LEAST_WIDTH);
    Tier cap = Tier(tier.high + 1, tier.high + STORY, tier.shrink + inset, Split.above);
    Part closed = part;
    closed.kinds = [Bound.lot, Bound.lot, Bound.lot, Bound.lot];
    closed.joins = PartJoin.init;
    shell(closed, Palette(palette.band, Material.none, palette.floor), cap);
    return cap;
}

void antenna(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    Box roofBox = footprint(part, tier.shrink, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    int x = middle(xSpan(roofBox));
    int y = middle(ySpan(roofBox));
    part.tower.paint(palette.trim, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(tier.high + 1, tier.high + ANTENNA)));
}

void build(ref const Lots lots, Spec spec) {
    Parts parts;
    makeParts(parts, lots, spec);
    int chosen = setbacks(parts, SETBACKS);
    foreach (ref part; parts.slice()) {
        foreach (tier; tiers(part, spec, chosen).slice()) {
            curtain(part, spec.palette, shell(part, spec.palette, tier), tier);
            if (tier.isRoofed()) {
                roof(part, spec.palette, ROOF, tier);
            }
        }
        part.stand = penthouse(part, spec.palette, part.top);
    }
    enter(parts, spec);
    uint choice = pick(parts, 3);
    if (choice == 0) {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &antenna);
    } else if (choice == 1) {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &masts);
    } else {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &helipad);
    }
}

/// file: plugins/buildings/modern.d
module plugins.buildings.modern;

import plugins.api.api : Box, Material, Rhythm, Span;
import plugins.buildings.building : Bound, FLOORS, Lots, Palette, Part, Parts, SIDES, STORY, Spec, Split, Tier, WINDOW_ROWS, along, banded, crown, enter, faceOf, footprint, helipad, isEmpty, makeParts, masts, middle, movedOut, pick, roof, setbacks, shell, storefront, tiers, width, withAlong, xSpan, ySpan;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : boxOf, higherOf;

enum Span STORIES = Span(6, 20);
enum int SETBACKS = 1;
enum Material ROOF = Material.concrete;
enum Rhythm RAILS = Rhythm(STORY, 1, 1);
enum int LEAST_GARDEN = 5;

immutable Palette[4] PALETTES = [
    Palette(Material.concrete, Material.steel, Material.concrete),
    Palette(Material.whiteBrick, Material.glass, Material.marble),
    Palette(Material.diorite, Material.steel, Material.concrete),
    Palette(Material.gabbro, Material.glass, Material.concrete),
];

void balconied(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Box box, Tier tier) {
    banded(part, box, tier, WINDOW_ROWS);
    int low = higherOf(tier.low, STORY);
    if (low < tier.high) {
        foreach (side; SIDES) {
            if (part.kinds[side] == Bound.street) {
                Box slab = movedOut(faceOf(box, side), side, 1);
                Span run = along(slab, side);
                slab = withAlong(slab, side, Span(run.low + 1, run.high - 1));
                slab.low[2] = low;
                slab.high[2] = tier.high - 1;
                part.tower.paint(palette.floor, slab, FLOORS);
                part.tower.paint(palette.trim, slab, RAILS);
            }
        }
    }
}

void garden(ref const Part part, Tier tier) {
    Box lawn = footprint(part, tier.shrink + 1, Split.above, tier.high, tier.high);
    if (!isEmpty(lawn)) {
        part.tower.paint(Material.grass, lawn);
        if (width(xSpan(lawn)) >= LEAST_GARDEN && width(ySpan(lawn)) >= LEAST_GARDEN) {
            int x = middle(xSpan(lawn));
            int y = middle(ySpan(lawn));
            int z = tier.high;
            part.tower.paint(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(x - 1, x + 1), Span(y - 1, y + 1), Span(z + 3, z + 4)));
            part.tower.paint(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(z + 5, z + 5)));
            part.tower.paint(Material.oakWood, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(z + 1, z + 3)));
        }
    }
}

void build(ref const Lots lots, Spec spec) {
    Parts parts;
    makeParts(parts, lots, spec);
    int chosen = setbacks(parts, SETBACKS);
    foreach (ref part; parts.slice()) {
        foreach (tier; tiers(part, spec, chosen).slice()) {
            balconied(part, spec.palette, shell(part, spec.palette, tier), tier);
            if (tier.isRoofed()) {
                roof(part, spec.palette, ROOF, tier);
            }
        }
        storefront(part);
        garden(part, part.top);
    }
    enter(parts, spec);
    uint choice = pick(parts, 3);
    if (choice == 0) {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &helipad);
    } else if (choice == 1) {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &masts);
    }
}

/// file: plugins/buildings/rowhouse.d
module plugins.buildings.rowhouse;

import plugins.api.api : Box, Material, Span;
import plugins.buildings.building : Lots, Palette, Part, Parts, Spec, Split, Tier, chimney, crown, enter, footprint, isEmpty, makeParts, pick, punched, roof, shell, tiers;

enum Span STORIES = Span(2, 3);
enum Material ROOF = Material.woodPlanks;
enum int PIER_SPACING = 2;

immutable Palette[5] PALETTES = [
    Palette(Material.whiteBrick, Material.spruceWood, Material.woodPlanks, Material.none, Material.slate),
    Palette(Material.woodPlanks, Material.whiteBrick, Material.woodPlanks, Material.none, Material.redSandstone),
    Palette(Material.birchWood, Material.spruceWood, Material.woodPlanks, Material.none, Material.shale),
    Palette(Material.sandstone, Material.clay, Material.woodPlanks, Material.none, Material.clay),
    Palette(Material.limestone, Material.greyBrick, Material.woodPlanks, Material.none, Material.slate),
];

void hipRoof(ref const Part part, Palette palette, Tier tier) {
    int rise = 1;
    Box box = footprint(part, tier.shrink + rise, Split.above, tier.high + rise, tier.high + rise);
    while (!isEmpty(box)) {
        part.tower.paint(palette.roof, box);
        rise += 1;
        box = footprint(part, tier.shrink + rise, Split.above, tier.high + rise, tier.high + rise);
    }
}

void build(ref const Lots lots, Spec spec) {
    Parts parts;
    makeParts(parts, lots, spec);
    foreach (ref part; parts.slice()) {
        foreach (tier; tiers(part, spec, 0).slice()) {
            punched(part, spec.palette, shell(part, spec.palette, tier), tier, PIER_SPACING);
            if (tier.isRoofed()) {
                roof(part, spec.palette, ROOF, tier);
            }
        }
        hipRoof(part, spec.palette, part.top);
    }
    enter(parts, spec);
    uint choice = pick(parts, 3);
    if (choice < 2) {
        crown(parts, spec.palette, &chimney);
    }
}

module plugins.buildings.types;

    brownstone,
    civic,
    deco,
    glass,
    modern,
    rowhouse,
    tenement,
    warehouse,
}

Span stories(Type type) {
    final switch (type) {
        case Type.brownstone:
            return brownstone.STORIES;
        case Type.civic:
            return civic.STORIES;
        case Type.deco:
            return deco.STORIES;
        case Type.glass:
            return glass.STORIES;
        case Type.modern:
            return modern.STORIES;
        case Type.rowhouse:
            return rowhouse.STORIES;
        case Type.tenement:
            return tenement.STORIES;
        case Type.warehouse:
            return warehouse.STORIES;
    }
}

immutable(Palette)[] palettes(Type type) {
    final switch (type) {
        case Type.brownstone:
            return brownstone.PALETTES[];
        case Type.civic:
            return civic.PALETTES[];
        case Type.deco:
            return deco.PALETTES[];
        case Type.glass:
            return glass.PALETTES[];
        case Type.modern:
            return modern.PALETTES[];
        case Type.rowhouse:
            return rowhouse.PALETTES[];
        case Type.tenement:
            return tenement.PALETTES[];
        case Type.warehouse:
            return warehouse.PALETTES[];
    }
}

void build(Type type, ref const Lots lots, Spec spec) {
    final switch (type) {
        case Type.brownstone:
            brownstone.build(lots, spec);
            break;
        case Type.civic:
            civic.build(lots, spec);
            break;
        case Type.deco:

        case Type.glass:

        case Type.rowhouse:
            rowhouse.build(lots, spec);
            break;

            tenement.build(lots, spec);
            break;

            break;
