module plugins.city.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Registry, Site, Spot, entryOf;
import blocks = plugins.blocks.blocks;
import plugins.horospheres.horospheres : CITY_LOOK;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Turtle;

immutable Spot SPAWN = Spot(6, 0, -0.5);

void world(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle at = Turtle(api, site);
    blocks.Root root = blocks.rootAt(at);
    api.tile(api, &blocks.tile, &root, blocks.Root.sizeof);
    api.worldLook(api, &CITY_LOOK);
    at.right().entrance(SPAWN.x, SPAWN.y, SPAWN.z);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "city", &world);
}

/// file: plugins/connector/connector.d
module plugins.connector.connector;

import plugins.api.api : Box, KindTag, Material, Rhythm, Risen, SitePart, Span;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Cell, Turtle, boxOf, floorMod, higherOf, lowerOf, mixed;

enum int STORY = 4;
enum int HALF_WIDTH = 4;
enum int INNER = HALF_WIDTH - 1;
enum int CORE = 2 * INNER;
enum int TURN = 8;
enum int FLIP_SLACK = 2;
enum int DOOR_TOP = 3;
enum int APRON = 2;
enum int OPEN_GROUND = 0;
enum int CITY_GROUND = 1;
enum int BACKROOMS_GROUND = -1;
enum int LIBRARY_GROUND = 1;
enum Span DOOR = Span(-1, 0);
enum Span APRON_WIDTH = Span(-2, 1);
enum Material LANDING = Material.concrete;
immutable Span[2] GLASS = [Span(-3, -2), Span(1, 2)];
enum Span WELL = Span(2, 3);
enum int WELL_CATCH = 7;
enum uint ROLL_PERCENT = 100;
enum ulong STYLE_SALT = 0x3C6EF372;
enum int GALLERY = 12;
enum int DRIFT_EVERY = 11;
enum int STONE_SIDE = 2;
enum int LANTERN_WIDEST = 11;
enum int LANTERN_TIER = 3;
enum int LANTERN_BAND_EVERY = 2;
immutable Cell[8] STONES = [Cell(-10, -1), Cell(-8, 6), Cell(-1, 8), Cell(6, 6), Cell(8, -1), Cell(6, -8), Cell(-1, -10), Cell(-8, -8)];
immutable Cell[TURN] SEGMENTS = [
    Cell(0, 2),
    Cell(0, 4),
    Cell(2, 4),
    Cell(4, 4),
    Cell(4, 2),
    Cell(4, 0),
    Cell(2, 0),
    Cell(0, 0),
];

enum Tag : uint {
    wild,
    city,
    backrooms,
    tree,
    library,
    column,
    stacks,
}

enum Style : ubyte {
    tower,
    spiral,
    drift,
    lantern,
    hidden,
}

enum Routing : ubyte {
    unrouted,
    routed,
    roundTrip,
}

enum StylePick : ubyte {
    rolled,
    forced,
}

struct Connection {
    Routing routing;
    StylePick pick;
    Style style;

    static Connection rolled() {
        return Connection(Routing.unrouted, StylePick.rolled, Style.tower);
    }

    static Connection forced(Style style, Routing routing) {
        return Connection(routing, StylePick.forced, style);
    }
}

struct StyleOdds {
    ubyte tower;
    ubyte spiral;
    ubyte drift;
    ubyte lantern;
    ubyte hidden;

    ubyte percentOf(Style style) const {
        final switch (style) {
            case Style.tower:
                return tower;
            case Style.spiral:
                return spiral;
            case Style.drift:
                return drift;
            case Style.lantern:
                return lantern;
            case Style.hidden:
                return hidden;
        }
    }

    uint total() const {
        return tower + spiral + drift + lantern + hidden;
    }
}

struct Pair {
    Tag lower;
    Tag upper;
    StyleOdds odds;
}

immutable Pair[16] PAIRS = [
    Pair(Tag.wild, Tag.wild, StyleOdds(39, 44, 11, 6)),
    Pair(Tag.wild, Tag.city, StyleOdds(64, 26, 5, 5)),
    Pair(Tag.wild, Tag.backrooms, StyleOdds(25, 12, 25, 38)),
    Pair(Tag.wild, Tag.library, StyleOdds(28, 39, 17, 16)),
    Pair(Tag.city, Tag.wild, StyleOdds(44, 44, 6, 6)),
    Pair(Tag.city, Tag.city, StyleOdds(67, 22, 5, 6)),
    Pair(Tag.city, Tag.backrooms, StyleOdds(53, 0, 20, 27)),
    Pair(Tag.city, Tag.library, StyleOdds(53, 18, 12, 17)),
    Pair(Tag.backrooms, Tag.wild, StyleOdds(17, 17, 33, 33)),
    Pair(Tag.backrooms, Tag.city, StyleOdds(60, 0, 20, 20)),
    Pair(Tag.backrooms, Tag.backrooms, StyleOdds(57, 0, 21, 22)),
    Pair(Tag.backrooms, Tag.library, StyleOdds(50, 10, 20, 20)),
    Pair(Tag.library, Tag.wild, StyleOdds(29, 36, 21, 14)),
    Pair(Tag.library, Tag.city, StyleOdds(55, 20, 10, 15)),
    Pair(Tag.library, Tag.backrooms, StyleOdds(50, 0, 25, 25)),
    Pair(Tag.library, Tag.library, StyleOdds(50, 28, 6, 16)),
];

bool isEveryPairWhole() {
    foreach (ref pair; PAIRS) {
        if (pair.odds.total != ROLL_PERCENT) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

static assert(isEveryPairWhole());

Style styleOf(KindTag lower, uint upper, ulong vertex) {
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < PAIRS.length && !(lower.exists && PAIRS[index].lower == lower.value && PAIRS[index].upper == upper)) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index == PAIRS.length) {
        return Style.tower;
    } else {
        uint roll = cast(uint)(mixed(vertex, STYLE_SALT) % ROLL_PERCENT);
        uint below = 0;
        uint style = 0;
        while (style < Style.max && roll >= below + PAIRS[index].odds.percentOf(cast(Style) style)) {
            below += PAIRS[index].odds.percentOf(cast(Style) style);
            style += 1;
        }
        return cast(Style) style;
    }
}

struct Palette {
    Material wall;
    Material trim;
    Material floor;
}

immutable Palette[4] PALETTES = [
    Palette(Material.whiteBrick, Material.limestone, Material.woodPlanks),
    Palette(Material.redSandstone, Material.whiteBrick, Material.woodPlanks),
    Palette(Material.limestone, Material.steel, Material.concrete),
    Palette(Material.greyBrick, Material.whiteBrick, Material.woodPlanks),
];

immutable Palette DRIFT_PALETTE = Palette(Material.sunlight, Material.limestone, Material.marble);
immutable Palette LANTERN_PALETTE = Palette(Material.glass, Material.steel, Material.marble);
immutable Palette HIDDEN_PALETTE = Palette(Material.mistStone, Material.mistLight, Material.mistStone);

struct Layout {
    int base;
    int top;
    int flip;
}

Box cells(Span along, Span across, Span z) {
    return boxOf(Span(along.low - INNER, along.high - INNER), Span(across.low - INNER, across.high - INNER), z);
}

Box square(int half, Span z) {
    return boxOf(Span(-half, half - 1), Span(-half, half - 1), z);
}

void windows(Turtle tower, Span z, Rhythm rows) {
    foreach (run; GLASS) {
        tower.paint(Material.glass, boxOf(Span(-HALF_WIDTH, -HALF_WIDTH), run, z), rows);
        tower.paint(Material.glass, boxOf(Span(HALF_WIDTH - 1, HALF_WIDTH - 1), run, z), rows);
        tower.paint(Material.glass, boxOf(run, Span(-HALF_WIDTH, -HALF_WIDTH), z), rows);
        tower.paint(Material.glass, boxOf(run, Span(HALF_WIDTH - 1, HALF_WIDTH - 1), z), rows);
    }
}

void shell(Turtle tower, Palette palette, Layout layout) {
    int base = layout.base;
    int top = layout.top;
    int flip = layout.flip;
    tower.paint(palette.wall, square(HALF_WIDTH, Span(base, base + top)));
    tower.paint(palette.trim, square(HALF_WIDTH, Span(base, base + top)), Rhythm(STORY, floorMod(base, STORY), 1));
    windows(tower, Span(base + 1, base + flip), Rhythm(STORY, floorMod(base + 1, STORY), 2));
    windows(tower, Span(base + flip + 1, base + top - 1), Rhythm(STORY, floorMod(base + top - 2, STORY), 2));
    floors(tower, palette, layout, CORE);
}

void floors(Turtle tower, Palette palette, Layout layout, int span) {
    int low = -INNER;
    int high = low + span - 1;
    tower.paint(palette.floor, boxOf(Span(low, high), Span(low, high), Span(layout.base, layout.base)));
    tower.paint(palette.floor, boxOf(Span(low, high), Span(low, high), Span(layout.base + layout.top, layout.base + layout.top)));
}

void openFloors(Turtle tower, Palette palette, Layout layout) {
    tower.paint(palette.floor, square(HALF_WIDTH, Span(layout.base, layout.base)));
    tower.paint(palette.floor, square(HALF_WIDTH, Span(layout.base + layout.top, layout.base + layout.top)));
}

void posts(Turtle tower, Palette palette, Layout layout) {
    immutable int[2] sides = [-HALF_WIDTH, HALF_WIDTH - 1];
    foreach (x; sides) {
        foreach (y; sides) {
            tower.paint(palette.trim, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(layout.base, layout.base + layout.top)));
        }
    }
}

void core(Turtle tower, Material material, Material band, Layout layout) {
    Span rising = Span(layout.base, layout.base + layout.top);
    tower.paint(material, cells(WELL, WELL, rising));
    tower.paint(band, cells(WELL, WELL, rising), Rhythm(TURN, floorMod(layout.base, TURN), 1));
}

void flipGallery(Turtle tower, Material material, Layout layout) {
    ring(tower, material, HALF_WIDTH, Span(layout.base + layout.flip - GALLERY, layout.base + layout.flip + GALLERY));
}

void spiral(Turtle tower, Palette palette, Layout layout) {
    openFloors(tower, palette, layout);
    posts(tower, palette, layout);
    flipGallery(tower, palette.trim, layout);
}

void stones(Turtle tower, Layout layout) {
    Span rising = Span(layout.base + 1, layout.base + layout.top - 1);
    foreach (index, stone; STONES) {
        Span x = Span(stone.x, stone.x + STONE_SIDE - 1);
        Span y = Span(stone.y, stone.y + STONE_SIDE - 1);
        tower.paint(Material.marble, boxOf(x, y, rising), Rhythm(DRIFT_EVERY * cast(int) STONES.length, floorMod(layout.base + cast(int) index * DRIFT_EVERY, DRIFT_EVERY * cast(int) STONES.length), STONE_SIDE));
        tower.paint(Material.sunlight, boxOf(x, y, rising), Rhythm(DRIFT_EVERY * cast(int) STONES.length, floorMod(layout.base + cast(int) index * DRIFT_EVERY + STONE_SIDE, DRIFT_EVERY * cast(int) STONES.length), 1));
    }
}

void drift(Turtle tower, Palette palette, Layout layout) {
    stones(tower, layout);
    openFloors(tower, palette, layout);
    flipGallery(tower, Material.glass, layout);
}

int lanternHalf(Layout layout, int z) {
    int widest = layout.base + layout.flip;
    int reach = lowerOf(layout.flip, layout.top - layout.flip);
    int away = higherOf(z - widest, widest - z);
    return HALF_WIDTH + (LANTERN_WIDEST - HALF_WIDTH) * (reach - lowerOf(reach, away)) / higherOf(reach, 1);
}

void ring(Turtle tower, Material material, int half, Span z) {
    tower.paint(material, boxOf(Span(-half, half - 1), Span(-half, -half), z));
    tower.paint(material, boxOf(Span(-half, half - 1), Span(half - 1, half - 1), z));
    tower.paint(material, boxOf(Span(-half, -half), Span(-half, half - 1), z));
    tower.paint(material, boxOf(Span(half - 1, half - 1), Span(-half, half - 1), z));
}

void lantern(Turtle tower, Palette palette, Layout layout) {
    int end = layout.base + layout.top;
    int tier = 0;
    int low = layout.base;
    while (low < end) {
        int high = lowerOf(low + LANTERN_TIER - 1, end - 1);
        int half = lanternHalf(layout, low);
        tower.paint(palette.trim, square(half, Span(low, low)));
        tower.paint(Material.none, square(half - 1, Span(low, high)));
        if (high > low && tier % LANTERN_BAND_EVERY == 0) {
            ring(tower, palette.wall, half, Span(low + 1, high));
        } else if (high > low) {
            ring(tower, Material.sunlight, half, Span(low + 1, high));
        }
        low = high + 1;
        tier += 1;
    }
    openFloors(tower, palette, layout);
}

int upperShift(Layout layout) {
    return floorMod(layout.top, 2);
}

int upperDoorQuarters(Layout layout) {
    return floorMod(layout.top, TURN) / 2;
}

int firstUpperLayer(Layout layout, int segment) {
    return layout.flip + 1 + floorMod(segment + upperShift(layout) - layout.flip - 1, TURN);
}

Turtle upperDoorFrame(Turtle tower, Layout layout) {
    Turtle frame = tower;
    foreach (_; 0 .. upperDoorQuarters(layout)) {
        frame = frame.rollRight();
    }
    return frame;
}

void helix(Turtle tower, Material material, Layout layout) {
    int base = layout.base;
    int top = layout.top;
    int flip = layout.flip;
    tower.paint(Material.none, cells(Span(0, CORE - 1), Span(0, CORE - 1), Span(base + 1, base + top - 1)));
    tower.paint(material, cells(WELL, WELL, Span(base + flip + WELL_CATCH, base + flip + WELL_CATCH + 1)));
    foreach (index, segment; SEGMENTS) {
        int i = cast(int) index;
        Span along = Span(segment.x, segment.x + 1);
        Span across = Span(segment.y, segment.y + 1);
        int last = flip - floorMod(flip - i, TURN);
        if (last >= 0) {
            tower.paint(material, cells(along, across, Span(base, base + last)), Rhythm(TURN, floorMod(base + i - 1, TURN), 2));
        }
        int first = firstUpperLayer(layout, i);
        if (first <= top) {
            tower.paint(material, cells(along, across, Span(base + first, base + top)), Rhythm(TURN, floorMod(base + i + upperShift(layout), TURN), 2));
        }
    }
}

void doorway(Turtle tower, int floor, Span room) {
    Span apron = Span(-HALF_WIDTH - APRON, -HALF_WIDTH - 1);
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(-HALF_WIDTH, -HALF_WIDTH), DOOR, room));
    tower.paint(LANDING, boxOf(apron, APRON_WIDTH, Span(floor, floor)));
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(apron, APRON_WIDTH, room));
}

void tread(Turtle tower, int segment, int z) {
    Cell at = SEGMENTS[floorMod(segment, TURN)];
    tower.stop(at.x + 1 - INNER, at.y + 1 - INNER, z);
}

void route(Turtle tower, Layout layout) {
    int base = layout.base;
    int top = layout.top;
    tower.stop(-HALF_WIDTH - 1.5f, 0, base + 1);
    tower.stop(0.5f - INNER, 0, base + 1);
    int highest = layout.flip - FLIP_SLACK;
    foreach (layer; 1 .. highest + 1) {
        tread(tower, layer, base + layer + 1);
    }
    foreach (layer; firstUpperLayer(layout, highest + 1) .. top + 1) {
        tread(tower, layer - upperShift(layout), base + layer);
    }
    Turtle door = upperDoorFrame(tower, layout);
    door.stop(0.5f - INNER, 0, base + top);
    door.stop(-HALF_WIDTH - 0.5f, 0, base + top);
}

void routeBack(Turtle tower, Layout layout) {
    int base = layout.base;
    int flip = layout.flip;
    int lowest = flip + FLIP_SLACK + 1;
    upperDoorFrame(tower, layout).stop(0.5f - INNER, 0, base + layout.top);
    foreach_reverse (layer; lowest .. layout.top + 1) {
        tread(tower, layer - upperShift(layout), base + layer);
    }
    int crossing = lowest - 1 - upperShift(layout);
    foreach_reverse (layer; 1 .. flip - floorMod(flip - crossing, TURN) + 1) {
        tread(tower, layer, base + layer + 1);
    }
    tower.stop(0.5f - INNER, 0, base + 1);
    tower.stop(-HALF_WIDTH - 1.5f, 0, base + 1);
}

int groundOf(KindTag tag) {
    if (tag == KindTag.of(Tag.city)) {
        return CITY_GROUND;
    } else if (tag == KindTag.of(Tag.backrooms)) {
        return BACKROOMS_GROUND;
    } else if (tag == KindTag.of(Tag.library)) {
        return LIBRARY_GROUND;
    } else {
        return OPEN_GROUND;
    }
}

Layout layoutOf(Turtle site, ref const Risen risen, int upper, int lower) {
    int length = risen.edges * site.edgeCells();
    int base = lower - 1;
    return Layout(base, length - upper - base, length - risen.balance - base - 1);
}

Style chosenStyle(Turtle site, ref const Risen risen, uint upperTag, Connection how) {
    if (how.pick == StylePick.forced) {
        return how.style;
    } else {
        return styleOf(risen.lower, upperTag, site.probeHash(SitePart.vertex));
    }
}

void connect(Turtle site, ref const Risen risen, uint upperTag, Connection how) {
    Layout layout = layoutOf(site, risen, groundOf(KindTag.of(upperTag)), groundOf(risen.lower));
    Style style = chosenStyle(site, risen, upperTag, how);
    Palette palette = PALETTES[site.pick(PALETTES.length)];
    if (style == Style.drift) {
        palette = DRIFT_PALETTE;
    } else if (style == Style.lantern) {
        palette = LANTERN_PALETTE;
    } else if (style == Style.hidden) {
        palette = HIDDEN_PALETTE;
    }
    Turtle tower = site.pitchUp().rollRight().forward(risen.edges).pitchUp().pitchUp().rollRight();
    int plane = risen.edges * site.edgeCells();
    if (plane < layout.base + layout.top) {
        tower.paint(Material.none, square(HALF_WIDTH, Span(plane, layout.base + layout.top - 1)));
    }
    final switch (style) {
        case Style.tower:
            shell(tower, palette, layout);
            break;
        case Style.spiral:
            spiral(tower, palette, layout);
            break;
        case Style.drift:
            drift(tower, palette, layout);
            break;
        case Style.lantern:
            lantern(tower, palette, layout);
            break;
        case Style.hidden:
            openFloors(tower, palette, layout);
            flipGallery(tower, palette.wall, layout);
            break;
    }
    helix(tower, palette.floor, layout);
    if (style == Style.spiral) {
        core(tower, palette.wall, palette.trim, layout);
    } else if (style == Style.drift) {
        core(tower, Material.sunlight, Material.sunlight, layout);
    } else if (style == Style.hidden) {
        core(tower, palette.trim, palette.trim, layout);
    }
    doorway(tower, layout.base, Span(layout.base + 1, layout.base + DOOR_TOP));
    doorway(upperDoorFrame(tower, layout), layout.base + layout.top, Span(layout.base + layout.top - DOOR_TOP, layout.base + layout.top - 1));
    if (how.routing != Routing.unrouted) {
        route(tower, layout);
    }
    if (how.routing == Routing.roundTrip) {
        routeBack(tower, layout);
    }
}

/// file: plugins/crown/plugin.d
module plugins.crown.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Box, Look, Material, Registry, Rhythm, Site, Span, entryOf;
import box = plugins.box.box;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Along, FACE_CORNERS, Turtle, boxOf, cornersOf, upright;

immutable Look LOOK = Look("crown");
enum int HEIGHT_EDGES = 2;
enum int HALL_ROOF = 2 * box.STORY;
enum int HALL_WINDOW_OFFSET = 2;
enum int FIRST_BALCONY_STORY = 3;
enum int BALCONY_DEPTH = 2;
enum int BALCONY_WIDTH = 4;
enum float ARCH_STOP_CELLS = box.STORY;
enum size_t MOST_ARCH_STOPS = 16;

Box strip(Along along, int from, int to, int low, int high) {
    if (along == Along.x) {
        return boxOf(Span(from, to), Span(0, 0), Span(low, high));
    } else {
        return boxOf(Span(0, 0), Span(from, to), Span(low, high));
    }
}

void hallWall(Turtle tower, box.Palette palette, Along along) {
    int far = tower.column().high;
    int window = box.HALF_WIDTH + HALL_WINDOW_OFFSET;
    tower.paint(palette.wall, strip(along, 0, far, 0, HALL_ROOF));
    tower.paint(palette.trim, strip(along, 0, far, 0, HALL_ROOF), box.FLOORS);
    tower.paint(Material.none, strip(along, window, window + box.WINDOW_WIDTH - 1, 0, HALL_ROOF - 1), box.WINDOW_ROW);
}

void hallDoor(Turtle tower, Along along) {
    int far = tower.column().high;
    tower.paint(Material.none, strip(along, far, far, 1, box.DOOR));
}

void hall(Turtle tower, box.Palette palette) {
    Span inside = Span(0, tower.column().high);
    tower.paint(palette.wall, boxOf(inside, inside, Span(-box.FOUNDATION, -1)));
    tower.paint(palette.floor, boxOf(inside, inside, Span(0, HALL_ROOF)), box.FLOORS);
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(inside, inside, Span(0, HALL_ROOF - 1)), box.ROOMS);
    hallWall(tower, palette, Along.x);
    hallWall(tower, palette, Along.y);
}

void openToHall(Turtle tower, box.Palette palette) {
    Span quarter = Span(0, box.HALF_WIDTH - 1);
    tower.paint(palette.floor, boxOf(quarter, quarter, Span(0, HALL_ROOF)), box.FLOORS);
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(quarter, quarter, Span(0, HALL_ROOF - 1)), box.ROOMS);
}

void doors(Turtle tower) {
    Span face = Span(box.HALF_WIDTH - 1, box.HALF_WIDTH - 1);
    Span terrace = Span(HALL_ROOF + 1, HALL_ROOF + box.DOOR);
    Span bridge = Span(tower.edgeCells() + 1, tower.edgeCells() + box.DOOR);
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(face, Span(1, 2), terrace));
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(1, 2), face, terrace));
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(face, Span(-1, 0), bridge));
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(-1, 0), face, bridge));
}

Box onFace(Along along, Span outward, Span sideways, Span heights) {
    if (along == Along.x) {
        return boxOf(outward, sideways, heights);
    } else {
        return boxOf(sideways, outward, heights);
    }
}

void balcony(Turtle tower, box.Palette palette, Along along, int sideLow, int story, int top) {
    int everyOtherStory = 2 * box.STORY;
    int floor = (story % 2) * box.STORY;
    Span heights = Span(story * box.STORY, top - 1);
    Box slab = onFace(along, Span(-box.HALF_WIDTH - BALCONY_DEPTH, -box.HALF_WIDTH - 1), Span(sideLow, sideLow + BALCONY_WIDTH - 1), heights);
    Box door = onFace(along, Span(-box.HALF_WIDTH, -box.HALF_WIDTH), Span(sideLow + 1, sideLow + BALCONY_WIDTH - 2), heights);
    tower.paint(palette.floor, slab, Rhythm(everyOtherStory, floor, 1));
    tower.paint(Material.none, door, Rhythm(everyOtherStory, floor + 1, box.DOOR));
}

void balconies(Turtle tower, box.Palette palette, int top) {
    balcony(tower, palette, Along.x, -2, FIRST_BALCONY_STORY, top);
    balcony(tower, palette, Along.y, -1, FIRST_BALCONY_STORY + 1, top);
}

Turtle bridgeAhead(Turtle corner) {
    return corner.pitchUp().forward(1).pitchDown();
}

Turtle bridgeBehind(Turtle corner) {
    return bridgeAhead(corner).right();
}

void deck(Turtle bridge, box.Palette palette) {
    bridge.paint(palette.floor, boxOf(Span(-1, 0), Span(0, 0), Span(box.HALF_WIDTH, bridge.edgeCells())));
}

void archRoute(Turtle from, Turtle to) {
    float apex = from.edgeCells() - 0.5f;
    float[MOST_ARCH_STOPS] stops;
    size_t count = 0;
    float along = box.HALF_WIDTH + 0.5f;
    while (along < apex) {
        stops[count] = along;
        count += 1;
        along += ARCH_STOP_CELLS;
    }
    stops[count] = apex;
    count += 1;
    foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
        from.stop(box.ROUTE_LANE, 1, stops[index]);
    }
    foreach_reverse (index; 0 .. count) {
        to.stop(box.ROUTE_LANE, 1, stops[index]);
    }
}

void landmark(const(Api)* api, Site root, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle site = Turtle(api, root);
    box.Palette palette = box.palette(site);
    int top = box.top(site, HEIGHT_EDGES);
    int bridgeFloor = site.edgeCells();
    Turtle[FACE_CORNERS] corners = cornersOf(site);
    foreach (index, corner; corners) {
        Turtle tower = upright(corner);
        hall(tower, palette);
        if (index == 0) {
            hallDoor(tower, Along.x);
        } else if (index == 1) {
            hallDoor(tower, Along.y);
        }
        box.tower(tower, top, palette);
        openToHall(tower, palette);
        doors(tower);
        balconies(tower, palette, top);
        deck(bridgeAhead(corner), palette);
        deck(bridgeBehind(corner), palette);
    }
    Turtle first = upright(corners[0]);
    Turtle second = upright(corners[1]);
    box.stairRoute(first, 0, bridgeFloor);
    first.stop(box.HALF_WIDTH - 1.5f, box.ROUTE_LANE, bridgeFloor + 1);
    first.stop(box.HALF_WIDTH + 0.5f, box.ROUTE_LANE, bridgeFloor + 1);
    archRoute(bridgeAhead(corners[0]), bridgeBehind(corners[1]));
    second.stop(box.ROUTE_LANE, box.HALF_WIDTH - 1.5f, bridgeFloor + 1);
    second.stop(box.ROUTE_LANE, box.ROUTE_LANE, bridgeFloor + 1);
    box.stairRoute(second, bridgeFloor, top);
}

void world(const(Api)* api, Site root, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle site = Turtle(api, root);
    landmark(api, root, data);
    api.worldLook(api, &LOOK);
    site.entrance(0, 1, site.edgeCells() / 2);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "crown", &world);
    registry.addLandmark(registry, "crown", &landmark);
}

module plugins.fixtures.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, HorosphereForm, KindId, Registry, Site, SitePart, Spot, entryOf;
import box = plugins.box.box;
import plugins.buildings.building : Bound, Lot, Lots, Side, Spec;

enum uint RISE_EDGES = 2;
enum int CHAIN_EDGES = 4;
immutable Spot CHAIN_SPAWN = Spot(0, 4, 0);
immutable Connection UNROUTED = Connection.forced(Style.tower, Routing.unrouted);
immutable Connection ROUTED = Connection.forced(Style.tower, Routing.routed);
enum uint HOUSE_FLOOR = 1;
enum uint TOP_FLOOR = 0;
enum int SHOWCASE_FRONT = 4;

Kinds routedKinds(const(Api)* api) {
    return addKinds(api, 0, 0, &ROUTED);
}

void risenCity(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    api.openHorosphere(api, site, routedKinds(api).city, RISE_EDGES);
}

void styled(Style style)(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    immutable Connection how = Connection.forced(style, Routing.routed);
    api.openHorosphere(api, site, addKinds(api, 0, 0, &how).city, RISE_EDGES);

void risenWild(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    api.openHorosphere(api, site, routedKinds(api).wild, RISE_EDGES);

    api.openHorosphere(api, site, routedKinds(api).backrooms, RISE_EDGES);
}

void stacked(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Kinds kinds = routedKinds(api);
    api.rooted(api, kinds.backrooms);
    api.openHorosphere(api, site, kinds.city, RISE_EDGES);
}

void stackedRooms(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Kinds kinds = routedKinds(api);
    api.rooted(api, kinds.backrooms);
    api.openHorosphere(api, site, kinds.backrooms, RISE_EDGES);

enum Ground : ubyte {
    plain,
    wild,
    city,
    backrooms,
}

KindId kindOf(Kinds kinds, Ground ground) {
    final switch (ground) {
        case Ground.plain:
        case Ground.wild:
            return kinds.wild;
        case Ground.city:
            return kinds.city;
        case Ground.backrooms:
            return kinds.backrooms;
    }
}

void trip(Style style, Ground lower, Ground upper)(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    immutable Connection how = Connection.forced(style, Routing.roundTrip);
    Kinds kinds = addKinds(api, 0, 0, &how);
    if (lower != Ground.plain) {
        api.rooted(api, kindOf(kinds, lower));
    }
    api.openHorosphere(api, site, kindOf(kinds, upper), RISE_EDGES);
}

void chain(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Kinds kinds = addKinds(api, 0, 0, &UNROUTED);
    KindId upper = api.horosphere(api, 0, HorosphereForm.solid, Tag.city, &cityTile, &ROUTED, Connection.sizeof);
    api.openHorosphere(api, site, kinds.city, RISE_EDGES);
    Turtle along = Turtle(api, site).pitchUp().forward(RISE_EDGES).pitchUp().forward(CHAIN_EDGES);
    api.openHorosphere(api, along.site, upper, RISE_EDGES);
    along.entrance(CHAIN_SPAWN.x, CHAIN_SPAWN.y, CHAIN_SPAWN.z);
}

void forcedStair(const(Api)* api, Site site, uint upper) {
    Turtle at = Turtle(api, site);
    Turtle stairs = at.forward(1).right();
    layout.ForcedStair forced = layout.ForcedStair(stairs.probeHash(SitePart.vertex), stairs.probeHash(SitePart.face), MaybeLayer.of(upper));
    layout.Root root = layout.Root(at.probeHash(SitePart.vertex), layout.Shaft.none, Routing.routed, forced);
    api.tile(api, &layout.tile, &root, layout.Root.sizeof);
}

void basement(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    forcedStair(api, site, HOUSE_FLOOR);
}

void backroomsStairs(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    forcedStair(api, site, TOP_FLOOR);
}

Turtle show(Turtle quarter, Type type, int stories) {
    Lot lot;
    lot.site = quarter;
    lot.bounds = [Bound.street, Bound.street, Bound.lot, Bound.lot];
    lot.front = Side.yLow;
    Lots lots;
    lots.add(lot);
    Spec spec = {stories: stories, palette: palettes(type)[0], front: SHOWCASE_FRONT};
    build(type, lots, spec);
    return quarter.right();
}

void showcase(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle quarter = Turtle(api, site);
    quarter = show(quarter, Type.brownstone, 5);
    quarter = show(quarter, Type.tenement, 8);
    quarter = show(quarter, Type.deco, 24);
    show(quarter, Type.glass, 30);
}

void hut(Turtle site) {
    Turtle tower = site.pitchUp();
    box.hut(tower);
    box.stairRoute(tower, 0, box.HUT_TOP);
    tower.entrance(-box.HALF_WIDTH, 0, 1);
}

void hamlet(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    foreach (corner; cornersOf(Turtle(api, site))) {
        hut(corner);
    }
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "risencity", &risenCity);
    registry.add(registry, "spiralcity", &styled!(Style.spiral));

    registry.add(registry, "tripstacked", &trip!(Style.tower, Ground.backrooms, Ground.backrooms));

    registry.add(registry, "tripwildwild", &trip!(Style.tower, Ground.wild, Ground.wild));
    registry.add(registry, "tripspiral", &trip!(Style.spiral, Ground.plain, Ground.wild));
    registry.add(registry, "tripdrift", &trip!(Style.drift, Ground.plain, Ground.backrooms));
    registry.add(registry, "triplantern", &trip!(Style.lantern, Ground.city, Ground.city));
    registry.add(registry, "chain", &chain);
