/// file: plugins/horospheres/horospheres.d
module plugins.horospheres.horospheres;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Color, HorosphereForm, KindId, Look, Risen, Site, SitePart, Tint;
import blocks = plugins.blocks.blocks;
import plugins.connector.connector : Connection, Tag, connect;
import layout = plugins.rooms.layout;
import plugins.horospheres.tree : Trunk, segment;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Turtle;

struct Kinds {
    KindId wild;
    KindId city;
    KindId backrooms;
    KindId tree;
}

immutable Look WILD_LOOK = Look("wild");
immutable Look CITY_LOOK = Look("city", Color(0.74f, 0.79f, 0.86f), Tint.fog);
immutable Look BACKROOMS_LOOK = Look("backrooms", Color(0.78f, 0.72f, 0.45f), Tint.fog);

Connection connectionOf(const(void)* data) {
    return *cast(const(Connection)*) data;
}

void wildTile(const(Api)* api, Site face, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    if (risen.hasRisen) {
        bool owner = blocks.probeOwnsFoot(Turtle(api, face), *risen);
        if (owner) {
            connect(Turtle(api, risen.foot), *risen, Tag.wild, connectionOf(data));
        }
    }
}

void cityTile(const(Api)* api, Site face, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    blocks.Root root;
    if (risen.hasRisen) {
        root = blocks.risenRootAt(Turtle(api, risen.foot), *risen, connectionOf(data));
    }
    blocks.tileAt(Turtle(api, face), root);
}

void backroomsTile(const(Api)* api, Site face, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle at = Turtle(api, face);
    layout.Root root;
    if (risen.hasRisen) {
        root = layout.Root(Turtle(api, risen.foot).probeHash(SitePart.vertex), layout.Shaft.open);
    }
    layout.tileAt(at, root);
    if (risen.hasRisen) {
        bool owner = blocks.probeOwnsFoot(at, *risen);
        if (owner) {
            connect(Turtle(api, risen.foot), *risen, Tag.backrooms, connectionOf(data));
        }
    }
}

void treeTile(const(Api)* api, Site base, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    segment(Turtle(api, base), risen.segment, risen.ground, Trunk.bare);
}

Kinds addKinds(const(Api)* api, double odds, double treeOdds, const(Connection)* how) {
    Kinds kinds;
    kinds.wild = api.horosphere(api, odds, HorosphereForm.terrain, Tag.wild, &wildTile, how, Connection.sizeof);
    kinds.city = api.horosphere(api, odds, HorosphereForm.solid, Tag.city, &cityTile, how, Connection.sizeof);
    kinds.backrooms = api.horosphere(api, odds, HorosphereForm.solid, Tag.backrooms, &backroomsTile, how, Connection.sizeof);
    kinds.tree = api.horosphere(api, treeOdds, HorosphereForm.upright, Tag.tree, &treeTile, how, Connection.sizeof);
    api.look(api, kinds.wild, &WILD_LOOK);
    api.look(api, kinds.city, &CITY_LOOK);
    api.look(api, kinds.backrooms, &BACKROOMS_LOOK);
    return kinds;
}

/// file: plugins/horospheres/tree.d
module plugins.horospheres.tree;

import core.stdc.math : ceil, exp;
import plugins.api.api : Material;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Drawing, Turtle, clamped, higherOf;

enum Material BARK = Material.oakWood;
enum Material LEAVES = Material.oakLeaves;
enum double GOLDEN_ANGLE = 137.5;
enum double STEP = 3;
enum double THINNEST = 0.7;

enum double TRUNK_SINK = 12;
enum double TRUNK_RADIUS = 4;
enum double TRUNK_FLARE = 4;
enum double TRUNK_FLARE_HEIGHT = 4;

enum uint ROOT_COUNT = 7;
enum double ROOT_HEIGHT = 3;
enum double ROOT_LENGTH = 22;
enum double ROOT_RADIUS = 3;
enum double ROOT_TIP = 1;
enum double ROOT_DIP = 20;
enum double ROOT_DROOP = 5;
enum double ROOT_WANDER = 10;

enum uint SEGMENT_LIMBS = 4;
enum double BARE_HEIGHT = 10;
enum double LOWEST_LIMB_ANGLE = 85;
enum double HIGHEST_LIMB_ANGLE = 45;
enum double LIMB_SHARE = 0.5;
enum double LIMB_WIDTH = 0.6;

enum double SPREAD = 10;
enum double LATER_SHORTER = 0.5;
enum double LEAF_START = 0.4;
immutable LeafSize TWIG_LEAVES = LeafSize(3, 4);
immutable LeafSize TIP_LEAVES = LeafSize(3.5, 5);
enum uint MOST_CHILDREN = 8;

enum double FULL_TURN = 360;
enum double QUARTER_TURN = 90;
enum double LIMB_DRIFT = 15;

enum Trunk : ubyte {
    bare,
    climbed,
}

struct LeafSize {
    double smallest;
    double largest;
}

struct Order {
    uint children;
    double first;
    double angle;
    double length;
    double width;
    double wander;
    double elevation;
    double steer;
    double tip;
}

immutable Order[4] ORDERS = [
    Order(6, 0.3, 45, 0.55, 0.6, 5, 8, 3, 0.35),
    Order(5, 0.2, 50, 0.6, 0.6, 8, 15, 4, 0.4),
    Order(4, 0.2, 55, 0.65, 0.6, 12, 20, 5, 0.5),
    Order(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 15, 25, 5, 0.6),
];

Drawing wandered(Drawing pen, double degrees) {
    return pen.turn(pen.pickBetween(-degrees, degrees), pen.pickBetween(-degrees, degrees));
}

Drawing steered(Drawing pen, double elevation, double rate) {
    return pen.lift(clamped(elevation - pen.rise(), -rate, rate));
}

void branch(Drawing start, double length, double radius, size_t order) {
    Order shape = ORDERS[order];
    Drawing pen = start;
    uint steps = cast(uint) higherOf(1.0, ceil(length / STEP));
    double step = length / steps;
    double tip = higherOf(THINNEST, radius * shape.tip);
    double roll = pen.pickBetween(0, FULL_TURN);
    double[MOST_CHILDREN] places;
    uint count = 0;
    if (order + 1 < ORDERS.length) {
        foreach (child; 0 .. shape.children) {
            double slot = (child + 1 - pen.pickBetween(0.2, 0.8)) / shape.children;
            places[child] = shape.first + (1 - shape.first) * slot;
        }
        count = shape.children;
    }
    uint child = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. steps) {
        double done = (index + 1.0) / steps;
        double from = radius + (tip - radius) * index / steps;
        double to = radius + (tip - radius) * done;
        pen = pen.limb(BARK, step, from, to);
        while (child < count && places[child] <= done) {
            Drawing fork = pen.roll(roll + (child + 1) * GOLDEN_ANGLE).turn(0, pen.pickBetween(shape.angle - SPREAD, shape.angle + SPREAD));
            double reach = length * shape.length * (1 - LATER_SHORTER * places[child]);
            branch(fork, reach, higherOf(THINNEST, to * shape.width), order + 1);
            child += 1;
        }
        if (order + 1 == ORDERS.length && done >= LEAF_START) {
            pen.leaves(LEAVES, pen.pickBetween(TWIG_LEAVES.smallest, TWIG_LEAVES.largest));
        }
        pen = steered(wandered(pen, shape.wander), shape.elevation, shape.steer);
    }
    if (order + 2 >= ORDERS.length) {
        pen.leaves(LEAVES, pen.pickBetween(TIP_LEAVES.smallest, TIP_LEAVES.largest));
    }
}

double trunkRadius(double aboveGround) {
    return TRUNK_RADIUS + TRUNK_FLARE * exp(-higherOf(0.0, aboveGround) / TRUNK_FLARE_HEIGHT);
}

void roots(Drawing base) {
    double turn = base.pickBetween(0, FULL_TURN);
    uint steps = cast(uint) ceil(ROOT_LENGTH / STEP);
    foreach (root; 0 .. ROOT_COUNT) {
        double around = turn + (root + 1) * FULL_TURN / ROOT_COUNT + base.pickBetween(-ROOT_WANDER, ROOT_WANDER);
        Drawing pen = base.roll(around).turn(0, QUARTER_TURN + ROOT_DIP + base.pickBetween(-ROOT_WANDER, ROOT_WANDER));
        foreach (index; 0 .. steps) {
            double from = ROOT_RADIUS + (ROOT_TIP - ROOT_RADIUS) * index / steps;
            double to = ROOT_RADIUS + (ROOT_TIP - ROOT_RADIUS) * (index + 1.0) / steps;
            pen = wandered(pen.limb(BARK, STEP, from, to), ROOT_WANDER).lift(-ROOT_DROOP);
        }
    }
}

double limbRoll(Trunk trunk, Drawing pen, double firstRoll, uint limb, double along) {
    final switch (trunk) {
        case Trunk.bare:
            return firstRoll + (limb + 1) * GOLDEN_ANGLE;
        case Trunk.climbed:
            return along * FULL_TURN + FULL_TURN / 2 - QUARTER_TURN + pen.pickBetween(-LIMB_DRIFT, LIMB_DRIFT);
    }
}

void segment(Turtle base, int index, int ground, Trunk trunk) {
    double edge = base.edgeCells();
    double bottom = index * edge;
    double start = higherOf(0.0, ground - TRUNK_SINK - bottom);
    if (start < edge) {
        Drawing pen = base.openPen().forward(start);
        uint steps = cast(uint) ceil((edge - start) / STEP);
        double step = (edge - start) / steps;
        double roll = pen.pickBetween(0, FULL_TURN);
        uint limb = 0;
        foreach (stepIndex; 0 .. steps) {
            double height = start + stepIndex * step;
            double above = bottom + height - ground;
            if (above <= ROOT_HEIGHT && above + step > ROOT_HEIGHT) {
                roots(pen);
            }
            pen = pen.limb(BARK, step, trunkRadius(above), trunkRadius(above + step));
            while (limb < SEGMENT_LIMBS && (limb + 1.0) / (SEGMENT_LIMBS + 1) * edge <= height + step) {
                double along = (limb + 1.0) / (SEGMENT_LIMBS + 1);
                if (bottom + along * edge - ground >= BARE_HEIGHT) {
                    double angle = LOWEST_LIMB_ANGLE + (HIGHEST_LIMB_ANGLE - LOWEST_LIMB_ANGLE) * pen.rollUnit();
                    Drawing fork = pen.roll(limbRoll(trunk, pen, roll, limb, along)).turn(0, pen.pickBetween(angle - SPREAD, angle + SPREAD));
                    branch(fork, LIMB_SHARE * edge * (1 - LATER_SHORTER * pen.rollUnit()), trunkRadius(above + step) * LIMB_WIDTH, 0);
                }
                limb += 1;
            }
        }
    }
}

/// file: plugins/lattice/plugin.d
module plugins.lattice.plugin;

import core.stdc.math : fabs;
import plugins.api.api : Api, Color, HorosphereForm, KindId, Look, Material, Registry, Rhythm, Risen, Site, SitePart, Span, Spot, Tint, Turn, entryOf;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Tread, Turtle, boxOf, lowerOf, roll, treadAround, upright;

immutable Look LOOK = Look("lattice", Color(0.05f, 0.06f, 0.1f), Tint.fog);

enum int BEAM = 1;
enum int PLATFORM = 6;
enum int ROOT_PLATFORM = 10;
enum int POLE_RING = 3;
enum int POLE_TREADS = 4 * 2;
enum double FOG = 3.5;
enum double PLATFORM_ODDS = 0.12;
enum double STAIR_ODDS = 0.2;
enum double LANTERN_ODDS = 0.4;
enum double TREE_ODDS = 0.7;
enum double HUT_ODDS = 0.9;
enum ulong PLATFORM_SALT = 0x2F4A7C15;
enum ulong STAIR_SALT = 0x6B43A9B5;
enum ulong DECOR_SALT = 0x5BE0CD19;
enum ulong FLOOR_SALT = 0x1F83D9AB;
enum Material POLE = Material.steel;
enum Material GIRDER = Material.concrete;
enum Material JOINT = Material.basalt;
enum Material STEP = Material.woodPlanks;
immutable Material[3] FLOORS = [Material.woodPlanks, Material.marble, Material.greyBrick];
immutable Spot SPAWN = Spot(21, 2, -3);

enum Axis : ubyte {
    x,
    y,
    z,
}

immutable Axis[2] CROSS = [Axis.x, Axis.y];

struct Root {
    ulong vertex;
}

struct End {
    Turtle frame;
    Axis vertical;
    ulong vertex;
    int sign;
}

Turtle along(Turtle frame, Axis axis, int sign) {
    final switch (axis) {
        case Axis.x:
            if (sign > 0) {
                return frame.right();
            } else {
                return frame.left();
            }
        case Axis.y:
            if (sign > 0) {
                return frame.pitchUp();
            } else {
                return frame.pitchDown();
            }
        case Axis.z:
            if (sign > 0) {
                return frame;
            } else {
                return frame.pitchUp().pitchUp();
            }
    }
}

double riseOf(Turtle frame, Axis axis) {
    final switch (axis) {
        case Axis.x:
            return frame.openPen().turn(90, 0).rise();
        case Axis.y:
            return frame.openPen().turn(0, 90).rise();
        case Axis.z:
            return frame.openPen().rise();
    }
}

Axis verticalOf(Turtle frame) {
    Axis steepest = Axis.z;
    double most = fabs(riseOf(frame, Axis.z));
    foreach (axis; CROSS) {
        double rise = fabs(riseOf(frame, axis));
        if (rise > most) {
            most = rise;
            steepest = axis;
        }
    }
    return steepest;
}

bool isStair(ulong edge) {
    return roll(edge, STAIR_SALT) < STAIR_ODDS;
}

bool probePlatform(ref const End end, ref const Root root) {
    bool raised = end.vertex == root.vertex;
    if (!raised) {
        raised = isStair(along(end.frame, end.vertical, 1).probeHash(SitePart.edge));
    }
    if (!raised) {
        raised = isStair(along(end.frame, end.vertical, -1).probeHash(SitePart.edge));
    }
    return raised || roll(end.vertex, PLATFORM_SALT) < PLATFORM_ODDS;
}

bool probeUpward(ref const End end) {
    double rise = riseOf(end.frame, Axis.z);
    return rise * end.sign > 0;
}

Span near(int sign, int from, int to) {
    if (sign > 0) {
        return Span(from, to);
    } else {
        return Span(-to - 1, -from - 1);
    }
}

Axis acrossOf(Axis vertical) {
    if (vertical == Axis.x) {
        return Axis.y;
    } else {
        return Axis.x;
    }
}

ulong lineHash(Turtle frame, Axis axis) {
    return lowerOf(along(frame, axis, 1).probeHash(SitePart.edge), along(frame, axis, -1).probeHash(SitePart.edge));
}

bool probeDesignated(ref const End end) {
    ulong own = lineHash(end.frame, Axis.z);
    ulong across = lineHash(end.frame, acrossOf(end.vertical));
    return own < across;
}

void platform(ref const End end, ref const Root root) {
    int reach = PLATFORM;
    if (end.vertex == root.vertex) {
        reach = ROOT_PLATFORM;
    }
    Material floor = FLOORS[cast(size_t)(roll(end.vertex, FLOOR_SALT) * FLOORS.length)];
    Span wide = Span(-reach, reach - 1);
    Span thin = Span(-BEAM, BEAM - 1);
    Span z = near(end.sign, BEAM, reach - 1);
    if (end.vertical == Axis.y) {
        end.frame.paint(floor, boxOf(wide, thin, z));
    } else {
        end.frame.paint(floor, boxOf(thin, wide, z));
    }
}

void decorate(ref const End end) {
    double choice = roll(end.vertex, DECOR_SALT);
    Turtle frame = end.frame;
    int sign = end.sign;
    if (choice < LANTERN_ODDS) {
        frame.paint(Material.lightPanel, boxOf(Span(-2, 1), Span(-2, 1), near(sign, 3, 4)));
    } else if (choice < TREE_ODDS) {
        frame.fill(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(-4, 3), Span(-4, 3), near(sign, 3, 6)));
        frame.fill(Material.oakLeaves, boxOf(Span(-2, 1), Span(-2, 1), near(sign, 7, 8)));
    } else if (choice < HUT_ODDS) {
        Span walls = near(sign, 1, 5);
        frame.paint(Material.woodPlanks, boxOf(Span(-5, 4), Span(-5, -5), walls));
        frame.paint(Material.woodPlanks, boxOf(Span(-5, 4), Span(4, 4), walls));
        frame.paint(Material.woodPlanks, boxOf(Span(-5, -5), Span(-4, 3), walls));
        frame.paint(Material.woodPlanks, boxOf(Span(4, 4), Span(-4, 3), walls));
        frame.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(4, 4), Span(-1, 0), near(sign, 1, 3)));
        frame.paint(Material.redSandstone, boxOf(Span(-6, 5), Span(-6, 5), near(sign, 6, 6)));
    }
}

void spiral(Turtle frame, int length) {
    foreach (index; 0 .. POLE_TREADS) {
        Tread tread = treadAround(BEAM, POLE_RING, 1, index);
        frame.paint(STEP, boxOf(tread.x, tread.y, Span(1, length - 2)), Rhythm(POLE_TREADS, index, 1));
    }
}

End endAt(Turtle frame, int sign) {
    return End(frame, verticalOf(frame), frame.probeHash(SitePart.vertex), sign);
}

void edge(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle start = Turtle(api, site);
    Root root = *cast(const(Root)*) data;
    int length = start.edgeCells();
    Span cross = Span(-BEAM, BEAM - 1);
    End[2] ends = [endAt(start, 1), endAt(start.forward(1), -1)];
    foreach (end; ends) {
        bool raised = probePlatform(end, root);
        if (raised && end.vertical == Axis.z) {
            bool upward = probeUpward(end);
            if (upward) {
                decorate(end);
            }
        }
    }
    Material beam = GIRDER;
    if (ends[0].vertical == Axis.z) {
        beam = POLE;
    }
    start.paint(beam, boxOf(cross, cross, Span(1, length - 2)));
    start.paint(JOINT, boxOf(cross, cross, Span(0, 0)));
    start.paint(JOINT, boxOf(cross, cross, Span(length - 1, length - 1)));
    ulong startEdge = start.probeHash(SitePart.edge);
    if (ends[0].vertical == Axis.z && isStair(startEdge)) {
        spiral(start, length);
    }
    foreach (end; ends) {
        bool raised = probePlatform(end, root);
        if (raised && end.vertical != Axis.z) {
            bool designated = probeDesignated(end);
            if (designated) {
                platform(end, root);
            }
        }
    }
}

void world(const(Api)* api, Site at, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle root = Turtle(api, at);
    Root lattice = Root(root.probeHash(SitePart.vertex));
    KindId kind = api.horosphere(api, 0, HorosphereForm.bare, 0, null, null, 0);
    api.rooted(api, kind);
    api.invertGravity(api);
    api.fog(api, FOG);
    api.worldLook(api, &LOOK);
    api.tileEdges(api, &edge, &lattice, Root.sizeof);
    upright(root).entrance(SPAWN.x, SPAWN.y, SPAWN.z);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "lattice", &world);
}

/// file: plugins/library/plugin.d
module plugins.library.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Color, HorosphereForm, KindId, KindTag, Look, Material, Registry, Rhythm, Risen, RisingKind, Site, SitePart, Span, Spot, Tint, entryOf;
import blocks = plugins.blocks.blocks;
import plugins.connector.connector : Connection, Tag, connect;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Along, Cell, EVERY_HEIGHT, Offset, Rows, STAIR_HEADROOM, TURN_TREADS, Turtle, boxOf, cornersOf, floorDiv, floorMod, higherOf, line, lowerOf, onWedge, ringRows, roll, treadSpan, upright, wedgeRows;

immutable Look LOOK = Look("library", Color(0.72f, 0.62f, 0.46f), Tint.fog);

enum int STORY = 6;
enum int CEILING_AT = STORY - 1;
enum int HALL_STORY = 2 * STORY;
enum int BOTTOM = -12;
enum int ROOF = 11;
enum int LOWEST_FLIGHT = -2;
enum int HIGHEST_FLIGHT = 0;
enum int PIER = 3;
enum int DOOR = 2;
enum int CLEAR = 6;
enum Cell LAMP = Cell(10, 4);
enum Span TABLE_X = Span(3, 8);
enum Span TABLE_Y = Span(5, 6);
enum double RISE_ODDS = 0.02;
enum double SHAFT_ODDS = 0.06;
enum double SHAFT_SHARE = 2;
enum double HALL_ODDS = 0.15;
enum double STAIR_ODDS = 0.2;
enum double ARCADE_ODDS = 0.12;
enum double SOLID_ODDS = 0.2;
enum ulong KIND_SALT = 0x3B9ACA07;
enum ulong FLOOR_SALT = 0x7F4A7C15;
enum ulong WALL_SALT = 0x1B873593;
enum Material FRAME = Material.spruceWood;
enum Material CEILING = Material.plaster;
enum double FOG = 6;
immutable Material[4] FLOORS = [Material.woodPlanks, Material.spruceWood, Material.marble, Material.redCarpet];
immutable Material[7] BOOKS = [Material.redCarpet, Material.acaciaWood, Material.jungleWood, Material.birchWood, Material.oakWood, Material.carpet, Material.redSandstone];
immutable Rhythm[2] WALL_BOOKS = [Rhythm(2 * STORY, 2, 2), Rhythm(2 * STORY, STORY + 2, 2)];
immutable Connection ROLLED = Connection.rolled();

enum double WELL = 4.5;
enum double STAIR_OUT = 8.5;
enum double SHELF = 10.5;
enum double RIM = 12;
enum double EVERYWHERE = 100;
enum double ROUTE_RADIUS = 7;
enum int TOP_TREAD = STORY;
enum int ROUTE_TREADS = 20 * TURN_TREADS;
enum int LAMP_SPOT = 6;
immutable Spot SPAWN = Spot(10, 7, 1);

enum Kind : ubyte {
    gallery,
    hall,
    stair,
}

enum Wall : ubyte {
    door,
    arcade,
    solid,
}

enum Clearing : ubyte {
    built,
    clear,
}

struct Quarter {
    Turtle tower;
    Clearing clearing;

    bool isClear() const {
        return clearing == Clearing.clear;
    }
}

Clearing clearingAt(Turtle corner, ref const Risen risen) {
    bool clear = corner.probeRising().exists;
    if (!clear && risen.hasRisen) {
        clear = blocks.probeFoot(corner, risen);
    }
    if (clear) {
        return Clearing.clear;
    } else {
        return Clearing.built;
    }
}

Kind kindOf(ulong face) {
    double chance = roll(face, KIND_SALT);
    if (chance < HALL_ODDS) {
        return Kind.hall;
    } else if (chance < HALL_ODDS + STAIR_ODDS) {
        return Kind.stair;
    } else {
        return Kind.gallery;
    }
}

Wall wallOf(ulong edge) {
    double chance = roll(edge, WALL_SALT);
    if (chance < ARCADE_ODDS) {
        return Wall.arcade;
    } else if (chance < ARCADE_ODDS + SOLID_ODDS) {
        return Wall.solid;
    } else {
        return Wall.door;
    }
}

void spread(ref const Quarter q, Material material, Span z, Rhythm rhythm) {
    int far = q.tower.column().high;
    if (!q.isClear()) {
        q.tower.paint(material, boxOf(Span(0, far), Span(0, far), z), rhythm);
    } else {
        if (z.low <= 0) {
            q.tower.paint(material, boxOf(Span(0, far), Span(0, far), Span(z.low, lowerOf(z.high, 0))), rhythm);
        }
        if (z.high > 0) {
            Span open = Span(higherOf(z.low, 1), z.high);
            q.tower.paint(material, boxOf(Span(CLEAR, far), Span(0, far), open), rhythm);
            q.tower.paint(material, boxOf(Span(0, CLEAR - 1), Span(CLEAR, far), open), rhythm);
        }
    }
}

void shelves(Turtle tower, Along direction, Span span) {
    Span rooms = Span(BOTTOM + 1, ROOF - 1);
    tower.paint(FRAME, line(direction, span, rooms));
    foreach (along; span.low .. span.high + 1) {
        foreach (row; WALL_BOOKS) {
            tower.paint(BOOKS[tower.pick(BOOKS.length)], line(direction, Span(along, along), rooms), row);
        }
    }
}

void wall(Turtle tower, Along direction, ulong edge) {
    int far = tower.column().high;
    final switch (wallOf(edge)) {
        case Wall.door:
            shelves(tower, direction, Span(0, far - DOOR));
            break;
        case Wall.arcade:
            shelves(tower, direction, Span(0, PIER - 1));
            break;
        case Wall.solid:
            shelves(tower, direction, Span(0, far));
            break;
    }
}

void stack(Turtle tower, Span x, Span y) {
    Span rooms = Span(BOTTOM + 1, ROOF - 1);
    tower.paint(FRAME, boxOf(x, y, rooms), Rhythm(STORY, 1, 3));
    tower.paint(BOOKS[tower.pick(BOOKS.length)], boxOf(x, y, rooms), Rhythm(STORY, 2, 1));
}

void floors(ref const Quarter q, Kind kind, Material material) {
    Span whole = Span(BOTTOM, ROOF);
    int story = STORY;
    if (kind == Kind.hall) {
        story = HALL_STORY;
    }
    spread(q, Material.none, Span(BOTTOM + 1, ROOF - 1), EVERY_HEIGHT);
    spread(q, material, whole, Rhythm(story, 0, 1));
    spread(q, CEILING, whole, Rhythm(story, story - 1, 1));
    q.tower.paint(Material.lightPanel, boxOf(Span(LAMP.x, LAMP.x), Span(LAMP.y, LAMP.y), whole), Rhythm(story, story - 1, 1));
    if (kind == Kind.hall) {
        q.tower.paint(Material.oakWood, boxOf(TABLE_X, TABLE_Y, whole), Rhythm(HALL_STORY, 1, 1));
    }
}

void tread(Turtle tower, int x, Span y, int top) {
    tower.paint(Material.marble, boxOf(Span(x, x), y, Span(top - 1, top)));
}

void stairwell(Turtle tower) {
    Span low = Span(1, 3);
    Span high = Span(5, 7);
    foreach (flight; LOWEST_FLIGHT .. HIGHEST_FLIGHT + 1) {
        int level = flight * STORY + 1;
        tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(3, 8), Span(1, 7), Span(level + STORY - 2, level + STORY - 1)));
        foreach (step; 0 .. 2) {
            tread(tower, 3 + step, low, level + step);
        }
        tower.paint(Material.marble, boxOf(Span(5, 8), Span(1, 7), Span(level + 1, level + 2)));
        foreach (step; 0 .. 3) {
            tread(tower, 4 - step, high, level + 3 + step);
        }
    }
}

void quarter(Turtle corner, size_t index, Kind kind, Material material, ref const Risen risen) {
    KindTag rising = corner.probeRising();
    if (rising != KindTag.of(Tag.stacks)) {
        Quarter q = Quarter(upright(corner), clearingAt(corner, risen));
        floors(q, kind, material);
        if (!q.isClear()) {
            wall(q.tower, Along.x, corner.probeHash(SitePart.edge));
            wall(q.tower, Along.y, corner.right().probeHash(SitePart.edge));
        }
        if (kind == Kind.stair && index == 0 && !q.isClear()) {
            stairwell(q.tower);
        } else if (kind == Kind.gallery) {
            stack(q.tower, Span(3, 7), Span(CLEAR, CLEAR + 1));
            uint second = q.tower.pick(2);
            if (second == 0) {
                stack(q.tower, Span(3, 7), Span(CLEAR + 3, CLEAR + 4));
            }
        }
    }
}

void tile(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle face = Turtle(api, site);
    Connection connection = *cast(const(Connection)*) data;
    ulong hash = face.probeHash(SitePart.face);
    Kind kind = kindOf(hash);
    Material material = FLOORS[cast(size_t)(roll(hash, FLOOR_SALT) * FLOORS.length)];
    foreach (index, corner; cornersOf(face)) {
        quarter(corner, index, kind, material, *risen);
    }
    if (risen.hasRisen) {
        bool owner = blocks.probeOwnsFoot(face, *risen);
        if (owner) {
            connect(Turtle(api, risen.foot), *risen, Tag.library, connection);
        }
    }
}

void stories(Turtle tower, double outer, Span z, Material floor) {
    Rows ring = ringRows(tower.column(), WELL, outer);
    Rows well = ringRows(tower.column(), 0, WELL);
    tower.paintRows(Material.none, ring, z);
    tower.paintRows(Material.none, well, z);
    tower.paintRows(floor, ring, z, Rhythm(STORY, 0, 1));
    tower.paintRows(Material.glass, well, z, Rhythm(STORY, 0, 1));
    tower.paintRows(CEILING, ring, z, Rhythm(STORY, CEILING_AT, 1));
    immutable int[2] sides = [-LAMP_SPOT, LAMP_SPOT - 1];
    foreach (x; sides) {
        foreach (y; sides) {
            tower.paint(Material.lightPanel, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), z), Rhythm(STORY, CEILING_AT, 1));
        }
    }
}

void shelving(Turtle tower, Span z) {
    Rows wall = ringRows(tower.column(), SHELF, RIM);
    tower.paintRows(FRAME, wall, z);
    foreach (row; wall.slice()) {
        tower.paint(BOOKS[tower.pick(BOOKS.length)], boxOf(row.x, Span(row.y, row.y), z), Rhythm(STORY, 2, 2));
    }
}

void descent(Turtle tower, int lastTread) {
    Rows[TURN_TREADS] treads = wedgeRows(tower.column(), WELL, STAIR_OUT);
    foreach (at; -STAIR_HEADROOM .. lastTread + 1) {
        Rows* wedge = &treads[floorMod(at, TURN_TREADS)];
        tower.clearOver(*wedge, at);
        if (at >= 0) {
            tower.paintRows(Material.marble, *wedge, treadSpan(at));
        }
    }
}

void shaft(const(Api)* api, Site base, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle tower = Turtle(api, base);
    int length = tower.edgeCells();
    int bottom = risen.segment * length;
    int top = lowerOf(ROOF, bottom + length - 1);
    Material floor = FLOORS[cast(size_t)(roll(Turtle(api, risen.foot).probeHash(SitePart.vertex), FLOOR_SALT) * FLOORS.length)];
    Span deep = Span(bottom, lowerOf(BOTTOM - 1, top));
    Span slab = Span(higherOf(BOTTOM, bottom), top);
    if (deep.low <= deep.high) {
        Span z = Span(deep.low - bottom, deep.high - bottom);
        stories(tower, SHELF, z, floor);
        shelving(tower, z);
    }
    if (slab.low <= slab.high) {
        stories(tower, EVERYWHERE, Span(slab.low - bottom, slab.high - bottom), floor);
    }
    int lastTread = TURN_TREADS - 1;
    if (risen.segment == 0) {
        lastTread = TOP_TREAD;
        Rows cap = ringRows(tower.column(), 0, WELL);
        tower.paintRows(CEILING, cap, Span(ROOF, ROOF));
    }
    descent(tower, lastTread);
}

void route(Turtle tower) {
    foreach (index; 0 .. ROUTE_TREADS + 1) {
        int segment = floorDiv(-index, TURN_TREADS);
        Offset at = onWedge(-index, ROUTE_RADIUS);
        tower.forward(segment).stop(at.x, at.y, 1 - index - segment * TURN_TREADS);
    }
}

void world(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle at = Turtle(api, site);
    Connection connection = Connection.rolled();
    KindId kind = api.horosphere(api, RISE_ODDS, HorosphereForm.solid, Tag.library, &tile, &connection, Connection.sizeof);
    api.rooted(api, kind);
    api.look(api, kind, &LOOK);
    KindId stacks = api.sunken(api, SHAFT_ODDS, Tag.library, Tag.stacks, &shaft, null, 0);
    api.openHorosphere(api, site, stacks, 2);
    api.fog(api, FOG);
    Turtle tower = at.columnSite();
    route(tower);
    tower.entrance(SPAWN.x, SPAWN.y, SPAWN.z);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "library", &world);
    RisingKind rising = RisingKind(1, HorosphereForm.solid, Tag.library, &tile, &ROLLED, Connection.sizeof, LOOK);
    registry.addKind(registry, "library", &rising);
    RisingKind stacks = RisingKind(SHAFT_SHARE, HorosphereForm.sunken, Tag.stacks, &shaft, null, 0, LOOK, Tag.library);
    registry.addKind(registry, "librarystacks", &stacks);
}

/// file: plugins/palace/plugin.d
module plugins.palace.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Look, Material, Registry, Risen, Site, SitePart, Span, Turn, entryOf;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Along, Turtle, boxOf, cornersOf, grass, line, middle, roll, upright;

immutable Look LOOK = Look("palace");

enum size_t MOST_FACES = 16;
enum int FLOOR = -11;
enum int CEILING = 10;
enum int ROOF = 11;
enum int GROUND = 0;
enum int DOOR_TOP = 3;
enum int LANDING = 4;
enum int TREADS = 10;
enum int TREAD_DEPTH = 2;
enum Span STAIR_Y = Span(1, 6);
enum Span DOOR_X = Span(2, 3);
enum Span WINDOW_Z = Span(2, 7);
enum int WINDOW_EVERY = 4;
enum Span LAMP_Z = Span(6, 8);
enum int LAMP = 6;
enum int BASIN = 8;
enum int JET_TOP = -6;
enum double STAIR_ODDS = 0.3;
enum ulong STAIR_SALT = 0x2545F491;
enum Material STONE = Material.limestone;
enum Material FLOOR_STONE = Material.marble;
enum Material TREAD = Material.whiteBrick;

struct FaceHashes {
    ulong[MOST_FACES] items;
    uint count;

    bool contains(ulong hash) const {
        uint index = 0;
        while (index < count && items[index] != hash) {
            index += 1;
        }
        return index < count;
    }
}

struct Footprint {
    FaceHashes hashes;
    Turtle[MOST_FACES] faces;

    void add(Turtle face) {
        ulong hash = face.probeHash(SitePart.face);
        if (!hashes.contains(hash)) {
            hashes.items[hashes.count] = hash;
            faces[hashes.count] = face;
            hashes.count += 1;
        }
    }

    const(Turtle)[] slice() const return {
        return faces[0 .. hashes.count];
    }
}

Footprint footprintOf(Turtle root) {
    Footprint footprint;
    footprint.add(root);
    foreach (corner; cornersOf(root)) {
        footprint.add(corner.right());
        footprint.add(corner.right().right());
        footprint.add(corner.left());
    }
    return footprint;
}

bool probeExterior(ref const Footprint footprint, Turtle across) {
    ulong face = across.probeHash(SitePart.face);
    return !footprint.hashes.contains(face);
}

void outerWall(Turtle tower, Along direction) {
    int far = tower.column().high;
    tower.paint(STONE, line(direction, Span(0, far), Span(FLOOR - 1, ROOF)));
    for (int along = 2; along < far; along += WINDOW_EVERY) {
        tower.paint(Material.glass, line(direction, Span(along, along + 1), WINDOW_Z));
    }
}

void hall(Turtle corner, ref const Footprint footprint) {
    Turtle tower = upright(corner);
    int far = tower.column().high;
    Span whole = Span(0, far);
    tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(whole, whole, Span(FLOOR + 1, CEILING - 1)));
    tower.paint(FLOOR_STONE, boxOf(whole, whole, Span(FLOOR - 1, FLOOR)));
    tower.paint(Material.plaster, boxOf(whole, whole, Span(CEILING, CEILING)));
    tower.paint(STONE, boxOf(whole, whole, Span(ROOF, ROOF)));
    tower.paint(FLOOR_STONE, boxOf(Span(0, 1), Span(0, 1), Span(FLOOR, CEILING)));
    tower.paint(Material.steel, boxOf(Span(LAMP, LAMP), Span(LAMP, LAMP), Span(LAMP_Z.high + 1, CEILING - 1)));
    tower.paint(Material.lightPanel, boxOf(Span(LAMP, LAMP), Span(LAMP, LAMP), LAMP_Z));
    bool outerX = probeExterior(footprint, corner.left());
    if (outerX) {
        outerWall(tower, Along.x);
    }
    bool outerY = probeExterior(footprint, corner.right());
    if (outerY) {
        outerWall(tower, Along.y);
    }
}

void centrePiece(Turtle corner) {
    Turtle tower = upright(corner);
    int far = tower.column().high;
    tower.paint(Material.redCarpet, boxOf(Span(2, BASIN - 1), Span(2, BASIN - 1), Span(FLOOR, FLOOR)));
    tower.paint(FLOOR_STONE, boxOf(Span(BASIN, far), Span(BASIN, far), Span(FLOOR + 1, FLOOR + 1)));
    tower.paint(Material.water, boxOf(Span(BASIN + 1, far), Span(BASIN + 1, far), Span(FLOOR + 1, FLOOR + 1)));
    tower.paint(Material.water, boxOf(Span(far, far), Span(far, far), Span(FLOOR + 2, JET_TOP)));
}

struct Run {
    Turtle near;
    Turtle far;
}

Turtle frameAt(ref const Run run, int cell) {
    if (cell <= run.near.column().high) {
        return run.near;
    } else {
        return run.far;
    }
}

int alongIn(ref const Run run, int cell) {
    int span = run.near.column().high + 1;
    if (cell < span) {
        return cell;
    } else {
        return cell - 2 * span;
    }
}

void grandStair(ref const Run run) {
    run.near.paint(Material.none, boxOf(DOOR_X, Span(0, 0), Span(GROUND, GROUND + DOOR_TOP)));
    run.near.paint(TREAD, boxOf(Span(0, LANDING - 1), STAIR_Y, Span(FLOOR, GROUND - 1)));
    foreach (step; 1 .. TREADS) {
        foreach (offset; 0 .. TREAD_DEPTH) {
            int cell = LANDING + (step - 1) * TREAD_DEPTH + offset;
            int along = alongIn(run, cell);
            frameAt(run, cell).paint(TREAD, boxOf(Span(along, along), STAIR_Y, Span(FLOOR, GROUND - step - 1)));
        }
    }
}

void stairRoute(ref const Run run) {
    float lane = middle(STAIR_Y);
    int floorCell = LANDING + (TREADS - 1) * TREAD_DEPTH;
    run.far.stop(alongIn(run, floorCell) + 0.5f, STAIR_Y.high + 3.5f, FLOOR + 1);
    run.far.stop(alongIn(run, floorCell) + 0.5f, lane, FLOOR + 1);
    foreach_reverse (step; 1 .. TREADS) {
        int cell = LANDING + (step - 1) * TREAD_DEPTH + 1;
        frameAt(run, cell).stop(alongIn(run, cell), lane, GROUND - step);
    }
    float door = middle(DOOR_X);
    run.near.stop(door, lane, GROUND);
    run.near.stop(door, 0.5f, GROUND);
    run.near.stop(door, -2.5f, GROUND);
}

void lawn(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle face = Turtle(api, site);
    const(FaceHashes)* built = cast(const(FaceHashes)*) data;
    ulong hash = face.probeHash(SitePart.face);
    if (!built.contains(hash)) {
        grass(face);
    }
}

struct Halls {
    Run entranceRun;
    Footprint footprint;
}

Halls halls(Turtle root) {
    Footprint footprint = footprintOf(root);
    Run entranceRun;
    uint stairs = 0;
    foreach (face; footprint.slice()) {
        foreach (corner; cornersOf(face)) {
            hall(corner, footprint);
            ulong hash = face.probeHash(SitePart.face);
            if (hash == footprint.hashes.items[0]) {
                centrePiece(corner);
            }
        }
    }
    foreach (face; footprint.slice()) {
        foreach (corner; cornersOf(face)) {
            bool exterior = probeExterior(footprint, corner.left());
            if (exterior) {
                double rolled = roll(corner.probeHash(SitePart.edge), STAIR_SALT);
                if (stairs == 0 || rolled < STAIR_ODDS) {
                    Run run = Run(upright(corner), upright(corner.forward(1)));
                    grandStair(run);
                    if (stairs == 0) {
                        stairRoute(run);
                        entranceRun = run;
                    }
                    stairs += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return Halls(entranceRun, footprint);
}

void landmark(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    halls(Turtle(api, site));
}

void world(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Halls built = halls(Turtle(api, site));
    built.entranceRun.near.turn(Turn.rollLeft).entrance(0, -middle(DOOR_X), GROUND);
    api.tile(api, &lawn, &built.footprint.hashes, FaceHashes.sizeof);
    api.worldLook(api, &LOOK);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "palace", &world);
    registry.addLandmark(registry, "palace", &landmark);
}

/// file: plugins/planet/plugin.d
module plugins.planet.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Registry, Site, Spot, entryOf;
import plugins.connector.connector : Connection;
import plugins.horospheres.horospheres : Kinds, WILD_LOOK, addKinds;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Turtle;

enum double RISE_ODDS = 0.015;
enum double TREE_ODDS = 0.002;
enum int TREE_EDGES = 1;
enum uint TREE_RISE = 2;
enum int LANDMARK_RINGS = 3;
immutable Spot SPAWN = Spot(-14, 12, 0);
immutable Connection CONNECTION = Connection.rolled();

struct LandmarkSites {
    Turtle[4] arms;
    uint next;

    Turtle take() {
        uint arm = next % arms.length;
        Turtle site = arms[arm];
        if (next / arms.length % 2 == 0) {
            arms[arm] = site.forward(2).right();
        } else {
            arms[arm] = site.forward(2).left();
        }
        next += 1;
        return site;
    }
}

void landmarks(const(Api)* api, Turtle at) {
    Turtle ahead = at.forward(2).left();
    Turtle behind = at.left().left().forward(2).right();
    Turtle aside = at.left().forward(2);
    Turtle beyond = at.right().forward(5).right();
    LandmarkSites sites = LandmarkSites([ahead.forward(1), behind.forward(1), aside, beyond]);
    foreach (index; 0 .. LANDMARK_RINGS * cast(uint) sites.arms.length) {
        Turtle site = sites.take();
        bool placed = api.landmark(api, index, site.site);
        if (!placed) {
            return;
        }
        api.flatten(api, site.site);
    }
}

void world(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle at = Turtle(api, site);
    at.build("road");
    Kinds kinds = addKinds(api, RISE_ODDS, TREE_ODDS, &CONNECTION);
    api.rooted(api, kinds.wild);
    api.risingKinds(api, RISE_ODDS);
    api.worldLook(api, &WILD_LOOK);
    Turtle tree = at.right().forward(TREE_EDGES);
    api.openHorosphere(api, tree.site, kinds.tree, TREE_RISE);
    tree.entrance(SPAWN.x, SPAWN.y, SPAWN.z);
    landmarks(api, at);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "planet", &world);
}

/// file: plugins/road/plugin.d
module plugins.road.plugin;

import core.stdc.math : fabs, floor, sqrt;
import plugins.api.api : Api, Look, Material, Registry, Rhythm, Site, Span, entryOf;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Turtle, alongLine, boxOf, higherOf;

immutable Look LOOK = Look("road");

enum int HALF_WIDTH = 6;
enum int DECK = 2;
enum int PARAPET = 1;
enum int INNER_HALF_WIDTH = HALF_WIDTH - 1;
enum int PIER_HALF_WIDTH = 2;
enum int PIER_EDGES = 8;
enum int CROWN = -2;
enum Rhythm DASHES = Rhythm(8, 2, 4);
enum float ROUTE_STOP_CELLS = 12;
enum int ROUTE_STOPS = 5;
enum float ROUTE_LANE = 0;
enum size_t MOST_EDGE_CELLS = 64;
enum Material SURFACE = Material.basalt;
enum Material STRIPE = Material.whiteBrick;
enum Material DECK_MATERIAL = Material.greyBrick;
enum Material PARAPET_MATERIAL = Material.concrete;
enum Material MASONRY = Material.greyBrick;
enum Material RING = Material.limestone;

struct ArchRow {
    int from;
    int span;
    int soffit;
    int ring;
}

struct ArchRows {
    ArchRow[MOST_EDGE_CELLS] rows;
    size_t count;
}

int[MOST_EDGE_CELLS] soffits(int edge, int below) {
    int[MOST_EDGE_CELLS] heights;
    double halfSpan = edge / 2.0 - PIER_HALF_WIDTH;
    double rise = CROWN - below;
    foreach (offset; PIER_HALF_WIDTH .. edge - PIER_HALF_WIDTH) {
        double fromMiddle = fabs(offset + 0.5 - edge / 2.0);
        double ratio = fromMiddle / halfSpan;
        double sag = rise * (1 - sqrt(1 - ratio * ratio));
        heights[offset] = CROWN - cast(int) floor(sag + 0.5);
    }
    return heights;
}

ArchRows archRows(int edge, int below) {
    int[MOST_EDGE_CELLS] heights = soffits(edge, below);
    ArchRows found;
    foreach (offset; PIER_HALF_WIDTH .. edge - PIER_HALF_WIDTH) {
        int inner = offset + 1;
        if (offset + 0.5 > edge / 2.0) {
            inner = offset - 1;
        }
        int soffit = heights[offset];
        int ring = higherOf(soffit, heights[inner]);
        if (found.count > 0 && found.rows[found.count - 1].soffit == soffit && found.rows[found.count - 1].ring == ring) {
            found.rows[found.count - 1].span += 1;
        } else {
            found.rows[found.count] = ArchRow(offset, 1, soffit, ring);
            found.count += 1;
        }
    }
    return found;
}

void arches(Turtle road, int below) {
    int edge = road.edgeCells();
    Span width = Span(-INNER_HALF_WIDTH, INNER_HALF_WIDTH - 1);
    ArchRows found = archRows(edge, below);
    foreach (row; found.rows[0 .. found.count]) {
        Rhythm rhythm = Rhythm(edge, row.from, row.span);
        road.fill(MASONRY, alongLine(width, Span(row.soffit, -1)), rhythm);
        road.fill(RING, alongLine(width, Span(row.soffit, row.ring)), rhythm);
    }
}

void pier(const(Api)* api, Site at, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle site = Turtle(api, at);
    int depth = PIER_EDGES * site.edgeCells();
    site.pitchDown().fill(MASONRY, boxOf(Span(-INNER_HALF_WIDTH, INNER_HALF_WIDTH - 1), Span(-PIER_HALF_WIDTH, PIER_HALF_WIDTH - 1), Span(0, depth - 1)));
    bool placed = site.forward(1).place(&pier, null, 0);
    if (!placed) {
        site.fail("the next pier is behind the road's piers");
    }
}

void world(const(Api)* api, Site at, const(void)* data) {
    Turtle road = Turtle(api, at);
    Span column = road.column();
    Span width = Span(-HALF_WIDTH, HALF_WIDTH - 1);
    Span lanes = Span(-INNER_HALF_WIDTH, INNER_HALF_WIDTH - 1);
    road.paint(Material.none, alongLine(width, Span(DECK, column.high)));
    road.paint(DECK_MATERIAL, alongLine(width, Span(0, DECK - 1)));
    road.paint(SURFACE, alongLine(lanes, Span(DECK - 1, DECK - 1)));
    road.paint(STRIPE, alongLine(Span(-1, 0), Span(DECK - 1, DECK - 1)), DASHES);
    road.paint(PARAPET_MATERIAL, alongLine(Span(-HALF_WIDTH, -HALF_WIDTH), Span(DECK - 1, DECK + PARAPET - 1)));
    road.paint(PARAPET_MATERIAL, alongLine(Span(HALF_WIDTH - 1, HALF_WIDTH - 1), Span(DECK - 1, DECK + PARAPET - 1)));
    arches(road, column.low);
    road.place(&pier, null, 0);
    road.left().left().forward(1).place(&pier, null, 0);
    foreach (stop; 0 .. ROUTE_STOPS) {
        road.stop(ROUTE_LANE, DECK, 0.5f + stop * ROUTE_STOP_CELLS);
    }
}

void lookedWorld(const(Api)* api, Site at, const(void)* data) {
    api.worldLook(api, &LOOK);
    world(api, at, data);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "road", &lookedWorld);
}

/// file: plugins/rooms/layout.d
module plugins.rooms.layout;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Risen, Site, SitePart;
import blocks = plugins.blocks.blocks;
import plugins.buildings.building : SIDES, Side;
import plugins.connector.connector : BACKROOMS_GROUND, Routing;
import plugins.rooms.levels : Biome, HallLayout, LAYERS, Level;
import plugins.rooms.rooms : Axis, Doors, Floor, Frame, Halls, MAZE_CELLS, MaybeLayer, Owns, Plan, Quarter, QuarterKind, SEPARATION, Stair, WallForm, frameOf, origin, paintFloor, stairs;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : FACE_CORNERS, Turtle, cornersOf, higherOf, mixed, roll, upright;

enum int TOP_FLOOR = BACKROOMS_GROUND - 1;
enum int DOOR_LOW = 3;
enum int DOOR_HIGH = 8;
enum ulong SLOT_SALT = 0x2F4A7C15;
enum ulong SECOND_SALT = 0x4F1BBCDD;
enum ulong OFFSET_SALT = 0x6B43A9B5;
enum ulong MISSING_SALT = 0x1F83D9AB;
enum ulong DOOR_SALT = 0x5BE0CD19;
enum ulong STAIR_SALT = 0x6A09E667;
enum ulong STAIR_ODDS_SALT = 0x510E527F;
enum ulong BIOME_SALT = 0x3C6EF372;
enum ulong HALL_SALT = 0x7F4A7C15;
enum ulong SOLID_SALT = 0x1B873593;
enum ulong PLAN_SALT = 0x5BD1E995;
enum double GRID_DROPPED = 0.12;
enum double SECOND_PASSAGE_ODDS = 0.5;
enum size_t FLOOR_COUNT = LAYERS.length;

enum Shaft : ubyte {
    none,
    open,
}

enum Passage : ubyte {
    open,
    closed,
}

struct ForcedStair {
    ulong vertex;
    ulong face;
    MaybeLayer upper;
}

struct Root {
    ulong vertex;
    Shaft shaft;
    Routing routing;
    ForcedStair forced;
}

struct Line {
    ulong hash;
    ulong beyond;
}

Floor[FLOOR_COUNT] floorsOf() {
    Floor[FLOOR_COUNT] floors;
    int base = TOP_FLOOR;
    foreach (index; 0 .. FLOOR_COUNT) {
        if (index > 0) {
            base = base - LAYERS[index].room - SEPARATION - 2;
        }
        floors[index] = Floor(cast(uint) index, base);
    }
    return floors;
}

immutable Floor[FLOOR_COUNT] FLOORS = floorsOf();

bool probeHall(Turtle turtle, ref const Root root, ref const Level level, size_t index) {
    if (level.halls == HallLayout.none) {
        return false;
    } else if (level.halls == HallLayout.streets) {
        blocks.Root streets = blocks.Root(root.vertex);
        return blocks.probeStreet(turtle, streets);
    } else {
        ulong start = turtle.probeHash(SitePart.vertex);
        bool rooted = start == root.vertex;
        if (!rooted) {
            ulong end = turtle.forward(1).probeHash(SitePart.vertex);
            rooted = end == root.vertex;
        }
        if (!rooted) {
            double rolled = roll(turtle.probeHash(SitePart.edge), HALL_SALT + index);
            rooted = rolled >= GRID_DROPPED;
        }
        return rooted;
    }
}

bool isSolid(ulong face, ref const Level level, size_t index) {
    return roll(face, SOLID_SALT + index) < level.solid;
}

Doors lineDoors(ulong hash, size_t index, ref const Level level, Passage passage) {
    if (level.isMaze()) {
        int first = cast(int)(mixed(hash, SLOT_SALT + index) % MAZE_CELLS);
        Doors slots = Doors.one(first);
        if (roll(hash, SECOND_SALT + index) < SECOND_PASSAGE_ODDS) {
            slots.at[1] = cast(int)((first + 1 + mixed(hash, OFFSET_SALT + index) % (MAZE_CELLS - 1)) % MAZE_CELLS);
            slots.count = 2;
        }
        return slots;
    } else if (passage == Passage.closed) {
        return Doors.init;
    } else if (roll(hash, MISSING_SALT + index) < level.missing) {
        return Doors([0, 0], 0, WallForm.missing);
    } else {
        return Doors.one(DOOR_LOW + cast(int)(mixed(hash, DOOR_SALT + index) % (DOOR_HIGH - DOOR_LOW + 1)));
    }
}

Line[4] linesOf(Turtle corner) {
    ulong vertex = corner.probeHash(SitePart.vertex);
    ulong face = corner.probeHash(SitePart.face);
    ulong edgeY = corner.probeHash(SitePart.edge);
    ulong edgeX = corner.right().probeHash(SitePart.edge);
    Line[4] lines;
    lines[Side.yLow] = Line(edgeY ^ vertex, corner.left().probeHash(SitePart.face));
    lines[Side.xLow] = Line(edgeX ^ vertex, corner.right().probeHash(SitePart.face));
    lines[Side.xHigh] = Line(edgeY ^ face, face);
    lines[Side.yHigh] = Line(edgeX ^ face, face);
    return lines;
}

bool probeForcedStair(Turtle corner, ref const Root root) {
    if (root.forced.upper.exists) {
        ulong vertex = corner.probeHash(SitePart.vertex);
        ulong face = corner.probeHash(SitePart.face);
        return vertex == root.forced.vertex && face == root.forced.face;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}

Stair stairOf(Turtle corner, ref const Root root, ref const Halls[FLOOR_COUNT] halls, ref const Quarter q) {
    ulong hash = corner.probeHash(SitePart.vertex) ^ corner.probeHash(SitePart.face);
    uint upper = cast(uint)(mixed(hash, STAIR_SALT) % (FLOOR_COUNT - 1));
    bool forced = probeForcedStair(corner, root);
    if (forced) {
        upper = root.forced.upper.value;
    }
    if (q.isLobby() || (!forced && roll(hash, STAIR_ODDS_SALT) >= FLOORS[upper].level.stairs)) {
        return Stair.init;
    } else {
        uint lower = upper + 1;
        int x = origin(halls[upper], Axis.x, FLOORS[upper].level);
        int otherX = origin(halls[lower], Axis.x, FLOORS[lower].level);
        int y = origin(halls[upper], Axis.y, FLOORS[upper].level);
        int otherY = origin(halls[lower], Axis.y, FLOORS[lower].level);
        return Stair(MaybeLayer.of(upper), lower, higherOf(x, otherX), higherOf(y, otherY));
    }
}

Plan planOf(Turtle corner, ref const Quarter q, ref const Stair stair, ref const Floor floor, size_t index, Halls halls) {
    immutable(Level)* level = &floor.level();
    double chance = roll(corner.probeHash(SitePart.vertex) ^ corner.probeHash(SitePart.face), PLAN_SALT + index);
    ulong face = corner.probeHash(SitePart.face);
    if (level.isMaze()) {
        return Plan.maze;
    } else if (q.isLobby() && (floor.isTop() || q.hasShaft())) {
        return Plan.lobby;
    } else if (stair.isOn(floor.layer)) {
        return Plan.rooms;
    } else if (isSolid(face, *level, index)) {
        return Plan.solid;
    } else if (chance < level.rings) {
        return Plan.rings;
    } else if (!halls.has(Axis.x) && !halls.has(Axis.y) && chance < level.rings + level.chapel) {
        return Plan.chapel;
    } else {
        return Plan.rooms;
    }
}

void quarter(Turtle corner, ref const Root root, ref const(Biome)*[FLOOR_COUNT] biomes) {
    ulong vertex = corner.probeHash(SitePart.vertex);
    ulong face = corner.probeHash(SitePart.face);
    QuarterKind kind = QuarterKind.plain;
    if (vertex == root.vertex && root.shaft == Shaft.open) {
        kind = QuarterKind.lobbyWithShaft;
    } else {
        bool lobby = vertex == root.vertex;
        if (!lobby) {
            lobby = corner.probeRising().exists;
        }
        if (lobby) {
            kind = QuarterKind.lobby;
        }
    }
    Quarter q = Quarter(upright(corner), kind);
    Owns owns;
    owns.put(Side.xHigh, vertex > corner.forward(1).probeHash(SitePart.vertex));
    owns.put(Side.yHigh, vertex > corner.right().forward(1).probeHash(SitePart.vertex));
    Halls[FLOOR_COUNT] halls;
    foreach (index; 0 .. FLOOR_COUNT) {
        bool hallX = probeHall(corner.right(), root, FLOORS[index].level, index + 1);
        bool hallY = probeHall(corner, root, FLOORS[index].level, index + 1);
        halls[index].put(Axis.x, hallX);
        halls[index].put(Axis.y, hallY);
    }
    Line[4] lines = linesOf(corner);
    Stair stair = stairOf(corner, root, halls, q);
    bool forced = probeForcedStair(corner, root);
    if (stair.isPresent() && !forced && (isSolid(face, FLOORS[stair.upper.value].level, stair.upper.value + 1) || isSolid(face, FLOORS[stair.lower].level, stair.lower + 1))) {
        stair = Stair.init;
    }
    Frame[FLOOR_COUNT] frames;
    foreach_reverse (index; 0 .. FLOOR_COUNT) {
        Floor floor = FLOORS[index];
        immutable(Level)* level = &floor.level();
        Doors[4] doors;
        foreach (side; SIDES) {
            Passage passage = Passage.open;
            if (isSolid(face, *level, index + 1) || isSolid(lines[side].beyond, *level, index + 1)) {
                passage = Passage.closed;
            }
            doors[side] = lineDoors(lines[side].hash, index + 1, *level, passage);
        }
        Plan plan = planOf(corner, q, stair, floor, index + 1, halls[index]);
        frames[index] = frameOf(q, halls[index], floor, biomes[index], stair, plan, owns);
        paintFloor(frames[index], doors, plan);
    }
    if (stair.isPresent()) {
        Routing routing = Routing.unrouted;
        if (root.routing == Routing.routed && forced) {
            routing = Routing.routed;
        }
        stairs(frames[stair.lower], frames[stair.upper.value], stair, routing);
    }
}

void tile(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    tileAt(Turtle(api, site), *cast(const(Root)*) data);
}

void tileAt(Turtle face, ref const Root root) {
    Turtle[FACE_CORNERS] corners = cornersOf(face);
    ulong strongest = face.probeHash(SitePart.face);
    foreach (corner; corners) {
        strongest = higherOf(corner.left().probeHash(SitePart.face), strongest);
    }
    const(Biome)*[FLOOR_COUNT] biomes;
    foreach (index; 0 .. FLOOR_COUNT) {
        immutable(Level)* level = &FLOORS[index].level();
        biomes[index] = &level.biomes[mixed(strongest, BIOME_SALT + index + 1) % level.biomes.length];
    }
    foreach (corner; corners) {
        quarter(corner, root, biomes);
    }
}

module plugins.rooms.rooms;

import plugins.api.api : Box, Material, MaybeIndex, Span, Spot;

enum int SEPARATION = 3;
enum uint MAZE_CELLS = 4;
enum int MAZE_PITCH = 3;
enum int MAZE_WIDTH = 2;
enum double MAZE_LOOP_ODDS = 0.1;
enum double MAZE_ROOM_ODDS = 0.25;
enum double MAZE_LIGHT_ODDS = 0.15;
enum int DOOR_WIDTH = 2;
enum int MOST_DOOR_HEIGHT = 3;
enum int MIN_ROOM = 3;
enum int LOBBY = 5;
enum int SHAFT = 3;
enum int LIGHT_FROM = 2;

immutable int[2] RINGS = [1, 3];
enum int LEAST_ATTACHED_WALL = 4;
enum int NOWHERE_STEPS = 2;

alias MaybeLayer = MaybeIndex!Level;

    x,
    y,
}

enum WallForm : ubyte {
    standing,
    missing,
}

enum QuarterKind : ubyte {
    plain,
    lobby,
    lobbyWithShaft,
}

    lobby,
    shaft,
    top,
    skirting,
}

    maze,

struct Region {
    Span x;
    Span y;

    Span span(Axis axis) const {
        if (axis == Axis.x) {
            return x;
        } else {
            return y;
        }
    }

    void setSpan(Axis axis, Span value) {
        if (axis == Axis.x) {
            x = value;
        } else {
            y = value;
        }
    }
}

struct Doors {
    int[2] at;
    uint count;
    WallForm form;

    static Doors one(int door) {
        return Doors([door, 0], 1);
    }

    const(int)[] slice() const return {
        return at[0 .. count];
    }
}

struct Grid {
    uint[GRID_SIZE] rows;

    bool opIndex(int x, int y) const {
        return (rows[x + GRID_OFFSET] & (1u << (y + GRID_OFFSET))) != 0;
    }

    void mark(int x, int y) {
        rows[x + GRID_OFFSET] |= 1u << (y + GRID_OFFSET);
    }
}

struct Forbid {
    uint[2] cells;

    bool has(Axis axis, int at) const {
        return (cells[axis] & (1u << (at + GRID_OFFSET))) != 0;
    }

    void mark(Axis axis, int at) {
        cells[axis] |= 1u << (at + GRID_OFFSET);
    }
}

struct Found {
    Region[MOST_ROOMS] rooms;
    size_t count;

    void add(Region region) {
        rooms[count] = region;
        count += 1;
    }

    const(Region)[] slice() const return {
        return rooms[0 .. count];
    }
}

struct Floor {
    uint layer;
    int base;

    ref immutable(Level) level() const {
        return LAYERS[layer];
    }

    bool isTop() const {
        return layer == 0;
    }
}

struct Quarter {
    Turtle tower;
    QuarterKind kind;

    bool isLobby() const {
        return kind != QuarterKind.plain;
    }

    bool hasShaft() const {
        return kind == QuarterKind.lobbyWithShaft;
    }
}

struct Stair {
    MaybeLayer upper;
    uint lower;
    int x;
    int y;

    bool isPresent() const {
        return upper.exists;
    }

    bool isOn(uint layer) const {
        return isPresent() && (upper.value == layer || lower == layer);
    }
}

struct Frame {
    Turtle tower;
    int base;
    int room;
    int doorHeight;
    int hallWidth;
    int far;
    const(Biome)* biome;
    Hall hall;
    Halls halls;
    Flags!FrameMark marks;
    int x0;
    int y0;
    Region region;
    Grid nearDoors;
    Owns owns;

    bool isLobby() const {
        return marks.has(FrameMark.lobby);
    }

    bool hasShaft() const {
        return marks.has(FrameMark.shaft);
    }

    bool isTop() const {
        return marks.has(FrameMark.top);
    }

    bool hasSkirting() const {
        return marks.has(FrameMark.skirting);
    }
}

bool rollChance(ref const Frame f, double odds) {
    return f.tower.pick(PERCENT) + 1 <= odds * PERCENT;
}

Box line(Axis axis, int at, Span span, Span z) {
    if (axis == Axis.x) {
        return boxOf(Span(at, at), span, z);
    } else {
        return boxOf(span, Span(at, at), z);
    }
}

Axis other(Axis axis) {
    if (axis == Axis.x) {
        return Axis.y;
    } else {
        return Axis.x;
    }
}

Axis axisOf(Side side) {
    if (side == Side.xLow || side == Side.xHigh) {
        return Axis.x;
    } else {
        return Axis.y;
    }
}

bool isLow(Side side) {
    return side == Side.xLow || side == Side.yLow;
}

int edgeOn(Span span, Side side) {
    if (isLow(side)) {
        return span.low;
    } else {
        return span.high;
    }
}

Span roomZ(ref const Frame f) {
    return Span(f.base + 1, f.base + f.room);
}

int ceilingZ(ref const Frame f) {
    return f.base + f.room + 1;
}

int origin(Halls halls, Axis axis, ref const Level level) {
    if (halls.has(axis)) {
        return level.hallWidth + 1;
    } else {
        return 1;
    }
}

struct Pieces {
    Region[2] items;
    size_t count;

    void add(Region region) {
        items[count] = region;
        count += 1;
    }

    const(Region)[] slice() const return {
        return items[0 .. count];
    }
}

Pieces outsideShaft(ref const Frame f, Region area) {
    Pieces pieces;
    if (!f.hasShaft()) {
        pieces.add(area);
    } else {
        if (area.x.high > SHAFT) {
            pieces.add(Region(Span(higherOf(area.x.low, SHAFT + 1), area.x.high), area.y));
        }
        if (area.x.low <= SHAFT && area.y.high > SHAFT) {
            pieces.add(Region(Span(area.x.low, lowerOf(area.x.high, SHAFT)), Span(higherOf(area.y.low, SHAFT + 1), area.y.high)));
        }
    }
    return pieces;
}

struct Spans {
    Span[1] items;
    size_t count;

    const(Span)[] slice() const return {
        return items[0 .. count];
    }
}

Spans outsideLobby(ref const Frame f, int at, Span span) {
    Spans spans;
    if (!f.isLobby() || at > LOBBY) {
        spans.items[0] = span;
        spans.count = 1;
    } else if (span.high > LOBBY) {
        spans.items[0] = Span(higherOf(span.low, LOBBY + 1), span.high);
        spans.count = 1;
    }
    return spans;
}

void doorway(ref Frame f, Axis axis, int at, int door) {
    f.tower.paint(Material.none, line(axis, at, Span(door, door + DOOR_WIDTH - 1), Span(f.base + 1, f.base + f.doorHeight)));
    foreach (along; door .. door + DOOR_WIDTH) {
        foreach (across; at - 1 .. at + 2) {
            if (axis == Axis.x) {
                f.nearDoors.mark(across, along);
            } else {
                f.nearDoors.mark(along, across);
            }
        }
    }
}

void wall(ref Frame f, Axis axis, int at, Span span, const(int)[] doors) {
    foreach (piece; outsideLobby(f, at, span).slice()) {
        f.tower.paint(f.biome.wall, line(axis, at, piece, roomZ(f)));
        if (f.hasSkirting()) {
            f.tower.paint(f.biome.trim, line(axis, at, piece, Span(f.base + 1, f.base + 1)));
        }
        if (f.biome.vents == Vents.some) {
            bool vented = rollChance(f,VENT_ODDS);
            if (vented) {
                int vent = f.tower.pickBetween(piece.low, piece.high);
                f.tower.paint(Material.steel, line(axis, at, Span(vent, vent), Span(f.base + f.room, f.base + f.room)));
            }
        }
    }
    foreach (door; doors) {
        doorway(f, axis, at, door);
    }
}

void slab(ref const Frame f, Material material, Region area, int z) {
    foreach (piece; outsideShaft(f, area).slice()) {
        f.tower.paint(material, boxOf(piece.x, piece.y, Span(z, z)));
    }
}

Pieces bands(ref const Frame f) {
    Pieces list;
    if (f.halls.has(Axis.y)) {
        list.add(Region(Span(0, f.far), Span(0, f.hallWidth - 1)));
    }
    if (f.halls.has(Axis.x)) {
        list.add(Region(Span(0, f.hallWidth - 1), Span(0, f.far)));
    }
    return list;
}

void shell(ref const Frame f) {
    Region whole = Region(Span(0, f.far), Span(0, f.far));
    slab(f, f.biome.floor, whole, f.base);
    foreach (piece; outsideShaft(f, whole).slice()) {
        f.tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(piece.x, piece.y, roomZ(f)));
    }
    slab(f, f.biome.ceiling, whole, ceilingZ(f));
    foreach (band; bands(f).slice()) {
        slab(f, f.hall.floor, band, f.base);
        slab(f, f.hall.ceiling, band, ceilingZ(f));
    }
    if (f.isTop()) {
        slab(f, Material.steel, whole, ceilingZ(f) + ROOF);
    } else if (f.hasShaft()) {
        f.tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(0, SHAFT), Span(0, SHAFT), Span(f.base, ceilingZ(f) + SEPARATION)));
    }
}

int hallEdge(ref const Frame f, Axis axis) {
    if (f.halls.has(axis)) {
        return f.hallWidth;
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}

struct PlannedWall {
    Axis axis;
    int at;
    Span span;
    Doors doors;
}

Doors wallDoors(ref const Frame f, Axis axis, Doors doors) {
    if (f.halls.has(axis)) {
        return Doors.init;
    } else {
        return doors;
    }
}

Forbid walls(ref Frame f, ref const Doors[4] lines) {
    int fromX = hallEdge(f, Axis.x);
    int fromY = hallEdge(f, Axis.y);
    PlannedWall[4] sides;
    sides[Side.yLow] = PlannedWall(Axis.y, fromY, Span(fromX, f.far), wallDoors(f, Axis.y, lines[Side.yLow]));
    sides[Side.xLow] = PlannedWall(Axis.x, fromX, Span(fromY, f.far), wallDoors(f, Axis.x, lines[Side.xLow]));
    sides[Side.xHigh] = PlannedWall(Axis.x, f.far, Span(fromY, f.far), lines[Side.xHigh]);
    sides[Side.yHigh] = PlannedWall(Axis.y, f.far, Span(fromX, f.far), lines[Side.yHigh]);
    Forbid forbid;
    foreach (side; SIDES) {
        PlannedWall planned = sides[side];
        if (planned.doors.form == WallForm.standing) {
            wall(f, planned.axis, planned.at, planned.span, planned.doors.slice());
            foreach (door; planned.doors.slice()) {
                forbid.mark(other(planned.axis), door);
                forbid.mark(other(planned.axis), door + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return forbid;
}

void split(ref Frame f, Region region, Forbid forbid, ref Found found, int depth) {
    Axis[2] axes;
    uint axisCount = 0;
    foreach (axis; AXES) {
        if (width(region.span(axis)) >= 2 * MIN_ROOM + 1) {
            axes[axisCount] = axis;
            axisCount += 1;
        }
    }
    bool big = rollChance(f,f.biome.big * lowerOf(depth, 1));
    if (big || axisCount == 0) {
        found.add(region);
    } else {
        Axis axis = axes[f.tower.pick(axisCount)];
        if (axisCount == 2 && width(region.x) > width(region.y)) {
            axis = Axis.x;
        } else if (axisCount == 2 && width(region.x) < width(region.y)) {
            axis = Axis.y;
        }
        Span span = region.span(axis);
        int[GRID_SIZE] candidates;
        uint candidateCount = 0;
        foreach (at; span.low + MIN_ROOM .. span.high - MIN_ROOM + 1) {
            if (!forbid.has(axis, at)) {
                candidates[candidateCount] = at;
                candidateCount += 1;
            }
        }
        if (candidateCount == 0) {
            found.add(region);
        } else {
            int at = candidates[f.tower.pick(candidateCount)];
            Span along = region.span(other(axis));
            Forbid inner = forbid;
            bool open = rollChance(f,f.biome.open);
            if (!open) {
                int door = f.tower.pickBetween(along.low, along.high - DOOR_WIDTH + 1);
                int[1] doors = [door];
                wall(f, axis, at, along, doors[]);
                inner.mark(other(axis), door);
                inner.mark(other(axis), door + 1);
            }
            Region low = region;
            Region high = region;
            low.setSpan(axis, Span(span.low, at - 1));
            high.setSpan(axis, Span(at + 1, span.high));
            split(f, low, inner, found, depth + 1);
            split(f, high, inner, found, depth + 1);
        }
    }
}

void hallDoors(ref Frame f, ref const Found found) {
    foreach (room; found.slice()) {
        if (f.halls.has(Axis.y) && room.y.low == f.y0) {
            bool door = rollChance(f,f.biome.hallDoors);
            if (door) {
                doorway(f, Axis.y, f.hallWidth, f.tower.pickBetween(room.x.low, room.x.high - DOOR_WIDTH + 1));
            }
        }
        if (f.halls.has(Axis.x) && room.x.low == f.x0) {
            bool door = rollChance(f,f.biome.hallDoors);
            if (door) {
                doorway(f, Axis.x, f.hallWidth, f.tower.pickBetween(room.y.low, room.y.high - DOOR_WIDTH + 1));
            }
        }
    }
}

bool isShaft(ref const Frame f, int x, int y) {
    return f.hasShaft() && x <= SHAFT && y <= SHAFT;
}

void light(ref const Frame f, Material material, int x, int y) {
    if (material != Material.none && !isShaft(f, x, y)) {
        f.tower.paint(material, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(ceilingZ(f), ceilingZ(f))));
    }
}

void skylight(ref const Frame f, int x, int y) {
    if (!isShaft(f, x, y)) {
        f.tower.paint(Material.glass, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(ceilingZ(f), ceilingZ(f) + ROOF)));
        f.tower.paint(Material.sunlight, boxOf(Span(x, x), Span(y, y), Span(f.base, f.base)));
    }
}

void lamp(ref const Frame f, Material material, double odds, int x, int y) {
    bool open = false;
    if (f.isTop()) {
        open = rollChance(f,odds);
    }
    if (open) {
        skylight(f, x, y);
    } else {
        light(f, material, x, y);
    }
}

Span sideSpan(Region room, Side side) {
    if (axisOf(side) == Axis.x) {
        return room.y;
    } else {
        return room.x;
    }
}

void boxes(ref const Frame f, Region room) {
    Side side = SIDES[f.tower.pick(SIDES.length)];
    Span span = sideSpan(room, side);
    if (width(span) >= LEAST_ATTACHED_WALL) {
        int from = f.tower.pickBetween(span.low, span.high - 1);
        Cell[2] cells;
        foreach (step; 0 .. 2) {
            int x = from + step;
            int y = from + step;
            if (axisOf(side) == Axis.x) {
                x = edgeOn(room.x, side);
            } else {
                y = edgeOn(room.y, side);
            }
            cells[step] = Cell(x, y);
        }
        if (!f.nearDoors[cells[0].x, cells[0].y] && !f.nearDoors[cells[1].x, cells[1].y]) {
            int top = f.base + f.tower.pickBetween(2, lowerOf(f.biome.boxHeight, f.room));
            foreach (cell; cells) {
                f.tower.paint(f.biome.boxes, boxOf(Span(cell.x, cell.x), Span(cell.y, cell.y), Span(f.base + 1, top)));
            }
        }
    }
}

void shelves(ref const Frame f, Region room) {
    if (width(room.x) >= 5 && width(room.y) >= 5) {
        for (int y = room.y.low + 1; y <= room.y.high - 1; y += 2) {
            f.tower.paint(f.biome.shelf, boxOf(Span(room.x.low + 1, room.x.high - 1), Span(y, y), Span(f.base + 1, f.base + f.doorHeight)));
        }
    }
}

void furnish(ref Frame f, ref const Found found) {
    hallDoors(f, found);
    foreach (room; found.slice()) {
        if (f.biome.roomFloors.length > 0) {
            f.tower.paint(f.biome.roomFloors[f.tower.pick(cast(uint) f.biome.roomFloors.length)], boxOf(room.x, room.y, Span(f.base, f.base)));
        }
        lamp(f, f.biome.light, f.biome.skylight, middle(room.x), middle(room.y));
        if (f.biome.damp != Material.none) {
            bool damp = rollChance(f,DAMP_ODDS);
            if (damp) {
                int x = f.tower.pickBetween(room.x.low, room.x.high - 1);
                int y = f.tower.pickBetween(room.y.low, room.y.high - 1);
                f.tower.paint(f.biome.damp, boxOf(Span(x, x + 1), Span(y, y + 1), Span(f.base, f.base)));
            }
        }
        if (f.biome.shelf != Material.none) {
            shelves(f, room);
        }
        if (f.biome.boxes != Material.none) {
            bool boxed = rollChance(f,f.biome.boxOdds);
            if (boxed) {
                boxes(f, room);
            }
        }
    }
    foreach (band; bands(f).slice()) {
        for (int at = LIGHT_FROM; at <= f.far; at += LIGHT_EVERY) {
            if (band.x.high == f.far) {
                lamp(f, f.hall.light, f.hall.skylight, at, 0);
            } else {
                lamp(f, f.hall.light, f.hall.skylight, 0, at);
            }
        }
    }
}

Span mazeSpan(ref const Frame f, int index) {
    int low = index * MAZE_PITCH + 1;
    int high = low + MAZE_WIDTH - 1;
    return Span(low, lowerOf(high, f.far));
}

Box mazeGap(ref const Frame f, Axis axis, int i, int j) {
    int at = (i + 1) * MAZE_PITCH;
    if (axis == Axis.x) {
        return boxOf(Span(at, at), mazeSpan(f, j), roomZ(f));
    } else {
        return boxOf(mazeSpan(f, j), Span(at, at), roomZ(f));
    }
}

uint mazeKey(int i, int j) {
    return i * MAZE_CELLS + j;
}

struct Maze {
    uint[MAZE_CELLS * MAZE_CELLS] exits;

    void open(ref const Frame f, Cell a, Cell b) {
        exits[mazeKey(a.x, a.y)] += 1;
        exits[mazeKey(b.x, b.y)] += 1;
        if (a.x != b.x) {
            f.tower.paint(Material.none, mazeGap(f, Axis.x, lowerOf(a.x, b.x), a.y));
        } else {
            f.tower.paint(Material.none, mazeGap(f, Axis.y, lowerOf(a.y, b.y), a.x));
        }
    }
}

void maze(ref Frame f, ref const Doors[4] lines) {
    int cells = MAZE_CELLS;
    f.tower.paint(f.biome.wall, boxOf(Span(0, f.far), Span(0, f.far), roomZ(f)));
    foreach (i; 0 .. cells) {
        foreach (j; 0 .. cells) {
            f.tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(mazeSpan(f, i), mazeSpan(f, j), roomZ(f)));
        }
    }
    Maze carved;
    uint visited = 1u << mazeKey(0, 0);
    Cell[MAZE_CELLS * MAZE_CELLS] trail;
    size_t depth = 1;
    while (depth > 0) {
        Cell at = trail[depth - 1];
        Cell[4] moves;
        uint moveCount = 0;
        foreach (move; MOVES) {
            int i = at.x + move.x;
            int j = at.y + move.y;
            if (i >= 0 && i < cells && j >= 0 && j < cells && (visited & (1u << mazeKey(i, j))) == 0) {
                moves[moveCount] = Cell(i, j);
                moveCount += 1;
            }
        }
        if (moveCount == 0) {
            depth -= 1;
        } else {
            Cell chosen = moves[f.tower.pick(moveCount)];
            visited |= 1u << mazeKey(chosen.x, chosen.y);
            carved.open(f, at, chosen);
            trail[depth] = chosen;
            depth += 1;
        }
    }
    foreach (i; 0 .. cells - 1) {
        foreach (j; 0 .. cells) {
            bool loopAcross = rollChance(f,MAZE_LOOP_ODDS);
            if (loopAcross) {
                carved.open(f, Cell(i, j), Cell(i + 1, j));
            }
            bool loopAlong = rollChance(f,MAZE_LOOP_ODDS);
            if (loopAlong) {
                carved.open(f, Cell(j, i), Cell(j, i + 1));
            }
        }
    }
    bool roomy = rollChance(f,MAZE_ROOM_ODDS);
    if (roomy) {
        int i = f.tower.pickBetween(0, cells - 2);
        int j = f.tower.pickBetween(0, cells - 2);
        f.tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(mazeSpan(f, i).low, mazeSpan(f, i + 1).high), Span(mazeSpan(f, j).low, mazeSpan(f, j + 1).high), roomZ(f)));
    }
    foreach (side; SIDES) {
        Axis axis = axisOf(side);
        if (isLow(side) || f.owns.has(side)) {
            int at = 0;
            if (!isLow(side)) {
                at = f.far;
                f.tower.paint(f.biome.wall, line(axis, at, Span(0, f.far), roomZ(f)));
            }
            foreach (slot; lines[side].slice()) {
                f.tower.paint(Material.none, line(axis, at, mazeSpan(f, slot), roomZ(f)));
            }
        }
    }
    foreach (i; 0 .. cells) {
        foreach (j; 0 .. cells) {
            Span x = mazeSpan(f, i);
            Span y = mazeSpan(f, j);
            bool lit = rollChance(f,MAZE_LIGHT_ODDS);
            if (lit) {
                light(f, f.biome.light, x.low, y.low);
            }
            if (carved.exits[mazeKey(i, j)] == 1) {
                bool nowhere = rollChance(f,f.biome.nowhere);
                if (nowhere) {
                    foreach (step; 1 .. NOWHERE_STEPS + 1) {
                        f.tower.paint(f.biome.stair, boxOf(Span(x.low + step - 1, x.low + step - 1), y, Span(f.base + 1, f.base + step)));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void chapel(ref Frame f) {
    Region region = f.region;
    int depth = SEPARATION;
    int floor = f.base - depth;
    int top = ceilingZ(f) + CHAPEL_RISE;
    Region around = Region(Span(region.x.low - 1, region.x.high + 1), Span(region.y.low - 1, region.y.high + 1));
    f.tower.paint(f.biome.wall, boxOf(around.x, around.y, Span(floor, f.base)));
    f.tower.paint(f.biome.wall, boxOf(around.x, around.y, Span(ceilingZ(f), top)));
    f.tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(region.x, region.y, Span(floor + 1, top - 1)));
    f.tower.paint(f.biome.floor, boxOf(region.x, region.y, Span(floor, floor)));
    f.tower.paint(f.biome.ceiling, boxOf(region.x, region.y, Span(top, top)));
    f.tower.paint(Material.steel, boxOf(around.x, around.y, Span(top + ROOF, top + ROOF)));
    Span steps = Span(region.y.low, region.y.low + 1);
    foreach (step; 1 .. depth) {
        int x = region.x.low + step - 1;
        f.tower.paint(f.biome.stair, boxOf(Span(x, x), steps, Span(floor + 1, f.base - step)));
    }
    foreach (_; 0 .. PODIUMS) {
        int x = f.tower.pickBetween(region.x.low + depth, region.x.high - PODIUM_SIZE + 1);
        int y = f.tower.pickBetween(region.y.low + 2, region.y.high - PODIUM_SIZE + 1);
        f.tower.paint(f.biome.wall, boxOf(Span(x, x + PODIUM_SIZE - 1), Span(y, y + PODIUM_SIZE - 1), Span(floor + 1, floor + f.tower.pickBetween(1, depth + 2))));
    }
    foreach (_; 0 .. HANGING) {
        int x = f.tower.pickBetween(region.x.low + 1, region.x.high - PODIUM_SIZE + 1);
        int y = f.tower.pickBetween(region.y.low + 2, region.y.high - PODIUM_SIZE + 1);
        f.tower.paint(f.biome.wall, boxOf(Span(x, x + PODIUM_SIZE - 1), Span(y, y + PODIUM_SIZE - 1), Span(top - f.tower.pickBetween(1, CHAPEL_RISE), top - 1)));
    }
    int x = middle(region.x);
    int y = middle(region.y);
    f.tower.paint(Material.glass, boxOf(Span(x, x + 1), Span(y, y + 1), Span(top, top + ROOF)));
    f.tower.paint(Material.sunlight, boxOf(Span(x, x + 1), Span(y, y + 1), Span(floor, floor)));
    int farWall = region.y.high + 1;
    Span mural = Span(middle(region.x) - MURAL_HALF_WIDTH, middle(region.x) + MURAL_HALF_WIDTH);
    f.tower.paint(Material.slate, boxOf(mural, Span(farWall, farWall), Span(f.base + 1, f.base + f.room)));
    f.tower.paint(Material.whiteBrick, boxOf(mural, Span(farWall, farWall), Span(f.base + 2, f.base + 2)));
    f.tower.paint(Material.whiteBrick, boxOf(Span(middle(region.x), middle(region.x)), Span(farWall, farWall), Span(f.base + 1, f.base + f.room)));
}

void rings(ref Frame f) {
    foreach (inset; RINGS) {
        Span x = Span(f.region.x.low + inset, f.region.x.high - inset);
        Span y = Span(f.region.y.low + inset, f.region.y.high - inset);
        if (width(x) >= 3 && width(y) >= 3) {
            f.tower.paint(f.biome.wall, boxOf(x, y, roomZ(f)));
            f.tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(x.low + 1, x.high - 1), Span(y.low + 1, y.high - 1), roomZ(f)));
            Side side = SIDES[f.tower.pick(SIDES.length)];
            Axis axis = axisOf(side);
            int at = x.low;
            if (side == Side.xHigh) {
                at = x.high;
            } else if (side == Side.yLow) {
                at = y.low;
            } else if (side == Side.yHigh) {
                at = y.high;
            }
            Span along = x;
            if (axis == Axis.x) {
                along = y;
            }
            if (width(along) >= DOOR_WIDTH + 2) {
                f.tower.paint(Material.none, line(axis, at, Span(along.low + 1, along.low + DOOR_WIDTH), Span(f.base + 1, f.base + f.doorHeight)));
            }
        }
    }
}

void stairs(ref const Frame lower, ref const Frame upper, Stair stair, Routing routing) {
    int rise = upper.base - lower.base;
    int x0 = stair.x;
    int y0 = stair.y;
    int first = floorDiv(rise + 2, 2);
    Span lowRows = Span(y0, y0 + 1);
    Span highRows = Span(y0 + 2, y0 + 3);
    Spot[MOST_STOPS] stops;
    size_t count = 0;
    void stop(float x, float y, float z) {
        stops[count] = Spot(x, y, z);
        count += 1;
    }
    void tread(Span x, Span rows, int height) {
        lower.tower.paint(lower.biome.stair, boxOf(x, rows, Span(lower.base + height, lower.base + height)));
    }
    void enclose(Span x, Span y) {
        upper.tower.paint(upper.biome.wall, boxOf(x, y, Span(upper.base + 1, upper.base + upper.room)));
    }
    lower.tower.paint(Material.none, boxOf(Span(x0, x0 + first + 1), Span(y0, y0 + STAIR_ROWS - 1), Span(lower.base + 1, upper.base)));
    stop(x0 + 0.5f, y0 + 3, lower.base + 1);
    foreach (height; 1 .. first + 1) {
        tread(Span(x0 + height - 1, x0 + height - 1), lowRows, height);
        stop(x0 + height - 0.5f, y0 + 1, lower.base + height + 1);
    }
    tread(Span(x0 + first, x0 + first + 1), Span(y0, y0 + STAIR_ROWS - 1), first);
    stop(x0 + first + 1, y0 + 1, lower.base + first + 1);
    stop(x0 + first + 1, y0 + 3, lower.base + first + 1);
    foreach (height; first + 1 .. rise + 1) {
        int x = x0 + 2 * first - height;
        tread(Span(x, x), highRows, height);
        stop(x + 0.5f, y0 + 3, lower.base + height + 1);
    }
    int arrival = x0 + 2 * first - rise - 1;
    if (arrival >= x0) {
        upper.tower.paint(upper.biome.floor, boxOf(Span(x0, arrival), highRows, Span(upper.base, upper.base)));
    }
    enclose(Span(x0, x0), lowRows);
    enclose(Span(x0 + 1, x0 + first + 1), Span(y0 + STAIR_ROWS, y0 + STAIR_ROWS));
    enclose(Span(x0 + first + 2, x0 + first + 2), Span(y0, y0 + STAIR_ROWS - 1));
    stop(x0 + 0.5f, y0 + 3, upper.base + 1);
    stop(x0 + 0.5f, y0 + STAIR_ROWS + 0.5f, upper.base + 1);
    if (routing == Routing.routed) {
        foreach (spot; stops[0 .. count]) {
            lower.tower.stop(spot.x, spot.y, spot.z);
        }
    }
}

Frame frameOf(ref const Quarter q, Halls halls, Floor floor, const(Biome)* biome, ref const Stair stair, Plan plan, Owns owns) {
    immutable(Level)* level = &floor.level();
    int far = q.tower.column().high;
    int x0 = origin(halls, Axis.x, *level);
    int y0 = origin(halls, Axis.y, *level);
    int regionY = y0;
    if (stair.isOn(floor.layer)) {
        regionY = stair.y + STAIR_DEPTH;
    }
    Frame f;
    f.tower = q.tower;
    f.base = floor.base;
    f.room = level.room;
    f.doorHeight = lowerOf(MOST_DOOR_HEIGHT, level.room);
    f.hallWidth = level.hallWidth;
    f.far = far;
    f.biome = biome;
    f.hall = level.hall;
    f.halls = halls;
    f.marks.put(FrameMark.lobby, plan == Plan.lobby);
    f.marks.put(FrameMark.shaft, q.hasShaft() && !level.isMaze());
    f.marks.put(FrameMark.top, floor.isTop());
    f.x0 = x0;
    f.y0 = y0;
    f.region = Region(Span(x0, far - 1), Span(regionY, far - 1));
    f.owns = owns;
    if (biome.trim != Material.none) {
        bool skirted = rollChance(f,SKIRTING_ODDS);
        f.marks.put(FrameMark.skirting, skirted);
    }
    return f;
}

void paintFloor(ref Frame f, ref const Doors[4] lines, Plan plan) {
    shell(f);
    if (plan == Plan.maze) {
        maze(f, lines);
    } else {
        Forbid forbid = walls(f, lines);
        if (plan == Plan.lobby) {
            light(f, f.biome.light, f.far - 2, f.far - 2);
        } else if (plan == Plan.solid) {
            f.tower.paint(f.biome.wall, boxOf(f.region.x, f.region.y, roomZ(f)));
        } else if (plan == Plan.rings) {
            rings(f);
            Found whole;
            whole.add(f.region);
            furnish(f, whole);
        } else if (plan == Plan.chapel) {
            chapel(f);
        } else {
            Found found;
            split(f, f.region, forbid, found, 0);
            furnish(f, found);
        }
    }
}

module plugins.tower.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Look, Registry, Site, entryOf;

enum int HEIGHT_EDGES = 3;

    int top = box.top(tower, HEIGHT_EDGES);
    box.tower(tower, top, palette);

    box.stairRoute(tower, 0, top);
}

    api.worldLook(api, &LOOK);
