/// file: plugins/trail/plugin.d
module plugins.trail.plugin;

import plugins.api.api : Api, Look, Material, Registry, Site, SitePart, Span, entryOf;
import box = plugins.box.box;
import plugins.turtle.turtle : Turtle, boxOf;

immutable Look LOOK = Look("trail");

enum int HALF_WIDTH = 2;
enum uint HUT_EVERY = 3;
enum float ROUTE_LANE = 0.5f;
enum uint TURNS = 3;
enum int LANDMARK_SEGMENTS = 12;

enum Extent : ubyte {
    endless,
    counted,
}

struct Length {
    int left;
    Extent extent;

    bool isDone() const {
        return extent == Extent.counted && left == 0;
    }

    Length next() const {
        return Length(left - 1, extent);
    }
}

void pave(Turtle segment) {
    int length = segment.edgeCells();
    segment.paint(Material.gravel, boxOf(Span(-HALF_WIDTH, HALF_WIDTH - 1), Span(-1, -1), Span(-HALF_WIDTH, length + HALF_WIDTH - 1)));
    segment.stop(ROUTE_LANE, 0, length / 2.0f);
}

void hut(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    box.hut(Turtle(api, site).pitchUp());
}

void addHut(Turtle tip) {
    Turtle yard = tip.right().forward(1);
    bool claimed = yard.probeClaimed(SitePart.vertex);
    if (!claimed) {
        bool placed = yard.left().place(&hut, null, 0);
        if (placed) {
            yard.claim(SitePart.vertex);
        }
    }
}

Turtle turnedTo(Turtle tip, uint turn) {
    if (turn == 0) {
        return tip;
    } else if (turn == 1) {
        return tip.left();
    } else {
        return tip.right();
    }
}

bool extend(Turtle segment, Length length) {
    Turtle ahead = segment.forward(1);
    bool placed = false;
    bool claimed = ahead.probeClaimed(SitePart.vertex);
    if (!claimed) {
        placed = segment.place(&stretch, &length, Length.sizeof);
    }
    if (placed) {
        ahead.claim(SitePart.vertex);
    }
    return placed;
}

void stretch(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Length length = *cast(const(Length)*) data;
    Turtle segment = Turtle(api, site);
    segment.claim(SitePart.vertex);
    segment.forward(1).claim(SitePart.vertex);
    pave(segment);
    Turtle tip = segment.forward(1);
    ulong edge = segment.probeHash(SitePart.edge);
    if (edge % HUT_EVERY == 0) {
        addHut(tip);
    }
    if (!length.isDone) {
        uint first = segment.pick(TURNS);
        uint tried = 0;
        bool extended = false;
        while (tried < TURNS && !extended) {
            extended = extend(turnedTo(tip, (first + tried) % TURNS), length.next);
            tried += 1;
        }
    }
}

void landmark(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Length length = Length(LANDMARK_SEGMENTS, Extent.counted);
    stretch(api, site, &length);
}

void world(const(Api)* api, Site site, const(void)* data) {
    Length length = Length(0, Extent.endless);
    api.worldLook(api, &LOOK);
    stretch(api, site, &length);
}

pragma(mangle, entryOf!__MODULE__) void plugin(const(Registry)* registry) {
    registry.add(registry, "trail", &world);
    registry.addLandmark(registry, "trail", &landmark);
}

/// file: plugins/turtle/turtle.d
module plugins.turtle.turtle;

import core.stdc.math : atan2, cos, sin;
import plugins.api.api : Api, Box, ColumnCell, Extent, KindTag, Material, Pen, Repeat, Rhythm, Risen, Site, SitePart, Span, Spot, Structure, Turn;

enum double PI = 3.14159265358979323846;
enum int TURN_TREADS = 24;
enum int STAIR_HEADROOM = 4;
enum int TREAD_THICKNESS = 2;
enum uint MOST_ROWS = 48;
enum Rhythm EVERY_HEIGHT = Rhythm(0, 0, 0, Repeat.always);
enum uint PERCENT = 100;
enum uint FACE_CORNERS = 5;
enum ulong MIX = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1D;
enum uint MIX_SHIFT = 24;

ulong mixed(ulong hash, ulong salt) {
    return ((hash ^ salt) * MIX) >> MIX_SHIFT;
}

double roll(ulong hash, ulong salt) {
    return (mixed(hash, salt) % PERCENT) / cast(double) PERCENT;
}

struct Cell {
    int x;
    int y;
}

struct Offset {
    float x;
    float y;
}

Box boxOf(Span x, Span y, Span z) {
    return Box(ColumnCell(x.low, y.low, z.low), ColumnCell(x.high, y.high, z.high));
}

Box alongLine(Span x, Span y) {
    return Box(ColumnCell(x.low, y.low, 0), ColumnCell(x.high, y.high, 0), Extent.endless);
}

int floorDiv(int value, int divisor) {
    int quotient = value / divisor;
    if (value % divisor != 0 && (value < 0) != (divisor < 0)) {
        return quotient - 1;
    } else {
        return quotient;
    }
}

int floorMod(int value, int divisor) {
    int remainder = value % divisor;
    if (remainder < 0) {
        return remainder + divisor;
    } else {
        return remainder;
    }
}

T lowerOf(T)(T a, T b) {
    if (a < b) {
        return a;
    } else {
        return b;
    }
}

T higherOf(T)(T a, T b) {
    if (a > b) {
        return a;
    } else {
        return b;
    }
}

T clamped(T)(T value, T low, T high) {
    if (value < low) {
        return low;
    } else if (value > high) {
        return high;
    } else {
        return value;
    }
}

struct Tread {
    Span x;
    Span y;
}

Span negated(Span span) {
    return Span(-span.high - 1, -span.low - 1);
}

Tread treadAround(int inner, int width, int sides, int index) {
    int at = floorMod(index, 4 * (sides + 1));
    int step = at % (sides + 1);
    int depth = 2 * inner / sides;
    Span ring = Span(inner, inner + width - 1);
    Tread tread = Tread(ring, ring);
    if (step > 0) {
        tread.x = Span(inner - step * depth, inner - (step - 1) * depth - 1);
    }
    foreach (_; 0 .. at / (sides + 1)) {
        tread = Tread(negated(tread.y), tread.x);
    }
    return tread;
}

float middle(Span span) {
    return (span.low + span.high + 1) / 2.0f;
}

struct Row {
    int y;
    Span x;
}

struct Rows {
    Row[MOST_ROWS] items;
    uint count;

    void add(int x, int y) {
        if (count > 0 && items[count - 1].y == y && items[count - 1].x.high == x - 1) {
            items[count - 1].x.high = x;
        } else {
            items[count] = Row(y, Span(x, x));
            count += 1;
        }
    }

    const(Row)[] slice() const return {
        return items[0 .. count];
    }
}

bool isInRing(int x, int y, double inner, double outer) {
    double across = x + 0.5;
    double along = y + 0.5;
    double squared = across * across + along * along;
    return squared >= inner * inner && squared < outer * outer;
}

Rows ringRows(Span column, double inner, double outer) {
    Rows rows;
    foreach (y; column.low .. column.high + 1) {
        foreach (x; column.low .. column.high + 1) {
            if (isInRing(x, y, inner, outer)) {
                rows.add(x, y);
            }
        }
    }
    return rows;
}

Rows[TURN_TREADS] wedgeRows(Span column, double inner, double outer) {
    Rows[TURN_TREADS] wedges;
    foreach (y; column.low .. column.high + 1) {
        foreach (x; column.low .. column.high + 1) {
            if (isInRing(x, y, inner, outer)) {
                wedges[wedgeAt(x, y)].add(x, y);
            }
        }
    }
    return wedges;
}

Span treadSpan(int tread) {
    return Span(higherOf(0, tread - TREAD_THICKNESS + 1), tread);
}

enum Along : ubyte {
    x,
    y,
}

Box line(Along along, Span span, Span z) {
    if (along == Along.x) {
        return boxOf(span, Span(0, 0), z);
    } else {
        return boxOf(Span(0, 0), span, z);
    }
}

void grass(Turtle face) {
    foreach (corner; cornersOf(face)) {
        Span whole = Span(0, corner.column().high);
        upright(corner).paint(Material.grass, boxOf(whole, whole, Span(-1, -1)));
    }
}

void lawn(const(Api)* api, Site face, const(Risen)* risen, const(void)* data) {
    grass(Turtle(api, face));
}

uint wedgeAt(int cellX, int cellY) {
    double turns = atan2(cellY + 0.5, cellX + 0.5) / (2 * PI);
    if (turns < 0) {
        turns += 1;
    }
    return lowerOf(cast(uint)(turns * TURN_TREADS), TURN_TREADS - 1);
}

Offset onWedge(int tread, double radius) {
    double angle = (floorMod(tread, TURN_TREADS) + 0.5) * 2 * PI / TURN_TREADS;
    return Offset(cast(float)(radius * cos(angle)), cast(float)(radius * sin(angle)));
}

Turtle upright(Turtle site) {
    return site.pitchUp().rollRight();
}

Turtle[FACE_CORNERS] cornersOf(Turtle face) {
    Turtle[FACE_CORNERS] corners;
    Turtle corner = face;
    foreach (index; 0 .. FACE_CORNERS) {
        corners[index] = corner;
        corner = corner.forward(1).right();
    }
    return corners;
}

struct Turtle {
    const(Api)* api;
    Site site;

    Turtle forward(int edges) const {
        return Turtle(api, api.forward(api, site, edges));
    }

    Turtle turn(Turn how) const {
        return Turtle(api, api.turn(api, site, how));
    }

    Turtle left() const {
        return turn(Turn.left);
    }

    Turtle right() const {
        return turn(Turn.right);
    }

    Turtle pitchUp() const {
        return turn(Turn.pitchUp);
    }

    Turtle pitchDown() const {
        return turn(Turn.pitchDown);
    }

    Turtle rollLeft() const {
        return turn(Turn.rollLeft);
    }

    Turtle rollRight() const {
        return turn(Turn.rollRight);
    }

    Span column() const {
        return api.column(api);
    }

    void fail(const(char)* message) const {
        api.fail(api, message);
    }

    int edgeCells() const {
        return api.edgeCells(api);
    }

    uint pick(uint count) const {
        return api.pick(api, count);
    }

    int pickBetween(int low, int high) const {
        return low + cast(int) pick(high - low + 1);
    }

    bool rollChance(uint percent) const {
        return api.pick(api, PERCENT) < percent;
    }

    double rollUnit() const {
        return api.random(api);
    }

    ulong probeHash(SitePart part) const {
        return api.probeHash(api, site, part);
    }

    void paint(Material material, Box area, Rhythm rhythm = EVERY_HEIGHT) const {
        api.paint(api, site, material, area, rhythm);
    }

    void fill(Material material, Box area, Rhythm rhythm = EVERY_HEIGHT) const {
        api.fill(api, site, material, area, rhythm);
    }

    void paintRows(Material material, ref const Rows rows, Span z, Rhythm rhythm = EVERY_HEIGHT) const {
        foreach (row; rows.slice()) {
            paint(material, boxOf(row.x, Span(row.y, row.y), z), rhythm);
        }
    }

    void fillRows(Material material, ref const Rows rows, Span z, Rhythm rhythm = EVERY_HEIGHT) const {
        foreach (row; rows.slice()) {
            fill(material, boxOf(row.x, Span(row.y, row.y), z), rhythm);
        }
    }

    void clearOver(ref const Rows room, int tread) const {
        int low = higherOf(0, tread + 1);
        int high = lowerOf(edgeCells() - 1, tread + STAIR_HEADROOM);
        if (low <= high) {
            paintRows(Material.none, room, Span(low, high));
        }
    }

    Turtle columnSite() const {
        return Turtle(api, api.columnSite(api, site));
    }

    void stop(float x, float y, float z) const {
        api.stop(api, site, Spot(x, y, z));
    }

    void entrance(float x, float y, float z) const {
        api.entrance(api, site, Spot(x, y, z));
    }

    bool place(Structure structure, const(void)* data, size_t size) const {
        return api.place(api, site, structure, data, size);
    }

    bool claim(SitePart part) const {
        return api.claim(api, site, part);
    }

    bool probeClaimed(SitePart part) const {
        return api.probeClaimed(api, site, part);
    }

    int probeBalance(int most) const {
        return api.probeBalance(api, site, most);
    }

    KindTag probeRising() const {
        return api.probeRising(api, site);
    }

    bool build(const(char)* world) const {
        return api.build(api, world, site);
    }

    Drawing openPen() const {
        return Drawing(api, api.openPen(api, site));
    }
}

struct Drawing {
    const(Api)* api;
    Pen pen;

    Drawing forward(double cells) const {
        return Drawing(api, api.penForward(api, pen, cells));
    }

    Drawing turn(double yaw, double pitch) const {
        return Drawing(api, api.penTurn(api, pen, yaw, pitch));
    }

    Drawing roll(double degrees) const {
        return Drawing(api, api.penRoll(api, pen, degrees));
    }

    Drawing lift(double degrees) const {
        return Drawing(api, api.penLift(api, pen, degrees));
    }

    double rise() const {
        return api.penRise(api, pen);
    }

    double height() const {
        return api.penHeight(api, pen);
    }

    Drawing limb(Material material, double cells, double fromRadius, double toRadius) const {
        api.limb(api, pen, material, cells, fromRadius, toRadius);
        return forward(cells);
    }

    void leaves(Material material, double radius) const {
        api.leaves(api, pen, material, radius);
    }

    double rollUnit() const {
        return api.random(api);
    }

    double pickBetween(double low, double high) const {
        return low + (high - low) * rollUnit();
    }
}

/// file: source/base/allocator.d
module base.allocator;

import core.bitop : bsr;
import base.array : Array;
import base.hashmap : HashMap;
import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;

enum uint SIZE_CLASSES = 32;

struct FreeRange {
    uint offset;
    uint count;
    MaybeIndex!uint previous;
    MaybeIndex!uint next;
}

struct Offset {
    uint value;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return value;
    }
}

struct RangeAllocator {
    Array!FreeRange ranges;
    Array!uint spare;
    HashMap!(Offset, uint) starts;
    HashMap!(Offset, uint) ends;
    MaybeIndex!uint[SIZE_CLASSES] heads;
    uint capacity;
    uint available;

    Maybe!uint allocate(uint count) {
        uint size = sizeClass(count);
        MaybeIndex!uint found;
        uint larger = size + 1;
        while (larger < SIZE_CLASSES && !heads[larger].exists) {
            larger += 1;
        }
        if (larger < SIZE_CLASSES) {
            found = heads[larger];
        } else {
            found = heads[size];
            while (found.exists && ranges.ptr[found.value].count < count) {
                found = ranges.ptr[found.value].next;
            }
        }
        if (!found.exists) {
            return Maybe!uint.init;
        } else {
            FreeRange range = ranges.ptr[found.value];
            unlink(found.value);
            if (range.count > count) {
                link(range.offset + count, range.count - count);
            }
            available -= count;
            return Maybe!uint.of(range.offset);
        }
    }

    void release(uint offset, uint count) {
        uint start = offset;
        uint end = offset + count;
        const(uint)* before = ends.find(Offset(start));
        if (before !is null) {
            uint index = *before;
            start = ranges.ptr[index].offset;
            unlink(index);
        }
        const(uint)* after = starts.find(Offset(end));
        if (after !is null) {
            uint index = *after;
            end = ranges.ptr[index].offset + ranges.ptr[index].count;
            unlink(index);
        }
        link(start, end - start);
        available += count;
    }

    void link(uint offset, uint count) {
        uint index = void;
        if (spare.length > 0) {
            index = spare.ptr[spare.length - 1];
            spare.length -= 1;
        } else {
            index = cast(uint) ranges.length;
            ranges.append(FreeRange.init);
        }
        uint size = sizeClass(count);
        ranges.ptr[index] = FreeRange(offset, count, MaybeIndex!uint.init, heads[size]);
        if (heads[size].exists) {
            ranges.ptr[heads[size].value].previous = MaybeIndex!uint.of(index);
        }
        heads[size] = MaybeIndex!uint.of(index);
        starts.insert(Offset(offset), index);
        ends.insert(Offset(offset + count), index);
    }

    void unlink(uint index) {
        FreeRange range = ranges.ptr[index];
        if (!range.previous.exists) {
            heads[sizeClass(range.count)] = range.next;
        } else {
            ranges.ptr[range.previous.value].next = range.next;
        }
        if (range.next.exists) {
            ranges.ptr[range.next.value].previous = range.previous;
        }
        starts.remove(Offset(range.offset));
        ends.remove(Offset(range.offset + range.count));
        spare.append(index);
    }

    uint used() const {
        return capacity - available;
    }

    void grow(uint newCapacity) {
        release(capacity, newCapacity - capacity);
        capacity = newCapacity;
    }

    void release() {
        ranges.release();
        spare.release();
        starts.release();
        ends.release();
        heads = MaybeIndex!uint.init;
        capacity = 0;
        available = 0;
    }
}

uint sizeClass(uint count) {
    return bsr(count);
}

/// file: source/base/array.d
module base.array;

import core.stdc.stdlib : free, realloc;
import core.stdc.string : memcpy, memset;

enum size_t LEAST_CAPACITY = 8;

size_t grownCapacity(size_t current, size_t needed) {
    if (current * 2 > needed) {
        return current * 2;
    } else if (needed < LEAST_CAPACITY) {
        return LEAST_CAPACITY;
    } else {
        return needed;
    }
}

struct Array(T) {
    T* ptr;
    size_t length;
    size_t capacity;

    void reserve(size_t wanted) {
        if (wanted > capacity) {
            capacity = grownCapacity(capacity, wanted);
            ptr = cast(T*) realloc(ptr, capacity * T.sizeof);
            assert(ptr !is null);
        }
    }

    void append(T value) {
        reserve(length + 1);
        ptr[length] = value;
        length += 1;
    }

    void appendAll(const(T)[] values) {
        reserve(length + values.length);
        memcpy(ptr + length, values.ptr, values.length * T.sizeof);
        length += values.length;
    }

    void resize(size_t newLength) {
        reserve(newLength);
        if (newLength > length) {
            memset(ptr + length, 0, (newLength - length) * T.sizeof);
        }
        length = newLength;
    }

    void clear() {
        length = 0;
    }

    void shrink() {
        if (length == 0) {
            release();
        } else if (length < capacity) {
            capacity = length;
            ptr = cast(T*) realloc(ptr, capacity * T.sizeof);
        }
    }

    inout(T)[] slice() inout {
        return ptr[0 .. length];
    }

    void release() {
        free(ptr);
        ptr = null;
        length = 0;
        capacity = 0;
    }
}

/// file: source/base/clock.d
module base.clock;

import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;

enum double NANOSECONDS_PER_SECOND = 1e9;
enum double NANOSECONDS_PER_MILLISECOND = 1e6;
enum double MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND = 1e3;
enum uint SMOOTHED_FRAMES = 8;

version (WebAssembly) {
    extern (C) double web_now() nothrow @nogc;

    double nowSeconds() {
        return web_now() / MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND;
    }

    double nowMilliseconds() {
        return web_now();
    }

    double threadCpuMilliseconds() {
        return web_now();
    }
} else {
    version (OSX) {
        import core.sys.posix.time : timespec;

        enum int CLOCK_MONOTONIC = 6;
        enum int CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID = 16;

        extern (C) int clock_gettime(int clock, timespec* time) nothrow @nogc;
    } else {
        import core.sys.posix.time : CLOCK_MONOTONIC, CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, clock_gettime, timespec;
    }

    double nowSeconds() {
        timespec now;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
        return now.tv_sec + now.tv_nsec / NANOSECONDS_PER_SECOND;
    }

    double nowMilliseconds() {
        timespec now;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
        return now.tv_sec * MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND + now.tv_nsec / NANOSECONDS_PER_MILLISECOND;
    }

    double threadCpuMilliseconds() {
        timespec used;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, &used);
        return used.tv_sec * MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND + used.tv_nsec / NANOSECONDS_PER_MILLISECOND;
    }
}

struct Deadline {
    Maybe!double milliseconds;

    static Deadline at(double chosen) {
        return Deadline(Maybe!double.of(chosen));
    }

    bool isBounded() const {
        return milliseconds.exists;
    }

    bool hasPassed(double now) const {
        return isBounded && now >= milliseconds.value;
    }
}

struct PhaseTimes {
    double totalMs = 0;
    double worstMs = 0;
    double lastMs = 0;
    uint count;

    void add(double ms) {
        totalMs += ms;
        lastMs = ms;
        count += 1;
        worstMs = higherOf(ms, worstMs);
    }

    double averageMs() const {
        if (count > 0) {
            return totalMs / count;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }
}

struct FrameClock {
    double[SMOOTHED_FRAMES] intervals = 0;
    double last = 0;
    double worst = 0;
    uint count;

    static FrameClock startingAt(double now) {
        FrameClock clock;
        clock.last = now;
        return clock;
    }

    double tick(double now, double most) {
        double interval = lowerOf(now - last, most);
        intervals[count % SMOOTHED_FRAMES] = interval;
        worst = higherOf(interval, worst);
        last = now;
        count += 1;
        uint used = lowerOf(count, SMOOTHED_FRAMES);
        double total = 0;
        foreach (recent; intervals[0 .. used]) {
            total += recent;
        }
        return total / used;
    }
}

/// file: source/base/crash.d
module base.crash;

import core.stdc.signal : SIGABRT, SIGFPE, SIGILL, SIGSEGV;
import core.stdc.stdlib : _Exit;
version (OSX) {
    import core.sys.darwin.execinfo : backtrace, backtrace_symbols_fd;
} else {
    import core.sys.linux.execinfo : backtrace, backtrace_symbols_fd;
}
import core.sys.posix.signal : SA_RESETHAND, SIGALRM, SIGBUS, SIGTRAP, sigaction, sigaction_t, sigemptyset;
import core.sys.posix.unistd : STDERR_FILENO, alarm, write;

enum uint CRASH_FRAMES = 64;
enum int CRASH_STATUS = 128;
immutable int[6] CRASH_SIGNALS = [SIGSEGV, SIGBUS, SIGILL, SIGTRAP, SIGFPE, SIGABRT];

void reportCrashes() {
    void*[1] warm;
    backtrace(warm.ptr, 1);
    foreach (signal; CRASH_SIGNALS) {
        reportOn(signal);
    }
}

void reportHangAfter(uint seconds) {
    reportOn(SIGALRM);
    alarm(seconds);
}

void reportOn(int signal) {
    sigaction_t action;
    action.sa_handler = &printCrash;
    sigemptyset(&action.sa_mask);
    action.sa_flags = SA_RESETHAND;
    sigaction(signal, &action, null);
}

extern (C) void printCrash(int signal) nothrow @nogc {
    string heading = "crashed, backtrace:\n";
    if (signal == SIGALRM) {
        heading = "hung past its time limit, backtrace:\n";
    }
    write(STDERR_FILENO, heading.ptr, heading.length);
    void*[CRASH_FRAMES] frames;
    int depth = backtrace(frames.ptr, CRASH_FRAMES);
    backtrace_symbols_fd(frames.ptr, depth, STDERR_FILENO);
    _Exit(CRASH_STATUS + signal);
}

/// file: source/base/flags.d
module base.flags;

import base.array : Array;

enum Readiness : ubyte {
    pending,
    ready,
}

enum uint WORD_SHIFT = 6;
enum uint WORD_MASK = (1u << WORD_SHIFT) - 1;

struct Bits {
    Array!ulong words;

    void cover(size_t count) {
        size_t wanted = (count + WORD_MASK) >> WORD_SHIFT;
        if (words.length < wanted) {
            words.resize(wanted);
        }
    }

    void clearAll() {
        words.slice()[] = 0;
    }

    size_t count() const {
        return words.length << WORD_SHIFT;
    }

    bool has(size_t index) const {
        return (words.ptr[index >> WORD_SHIFT] & (1UL << (index & WORD_MASK))) != 0;
    }

    void set(size_t index) {
        words.ptr[index >> WORD_SHIFT] |= 1UL << (index & WORD_MASK);
    }

    void clear(size_t index) {
        words.ptr[index >> WORD_SHIFT] &= ~(1UL << (index & WORD_MASK));
    }

    void release() {
        words.release();
    }
}

/// file: source/base/hashmap.d
module base.hashmap;

import core.bitop : bsr;
import core.stdc.stdlib : calloc, free, malloc;
import core.stdc.string : memset;
import base.numbers : lowerOf;
import base.pages : giveBack;

enum ulong FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15;
enum size_t TABLE_MULTIPLIER = cast(size_t)(FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER >> (ulong.sizeof - size_t.sizeof) * 8);
enum size_t INITIAL_HASH_MAP_CAPACITY = 16;
enum size_t MIGRATED_SLOTS_PER_CHANGE = 8;
enum size_t RELEASED_BYTES = 1 << 20;
enum size_t FULLEST_EIGHTHS = 6;
enum size_t EMPTIEST_EIGHTHS = 1;
enum size_t EIGHTHS = 8;
enum uint TAG_BITS = 7;
enum ubyte EMPTY = 0;
enum ubyte REMOVED = 1;
enum ubyte LIVE = 0x80;

enum OnExisting : ubyte {
    replace,
    keep,
}

struct Present {
}

struct HashSlot(K, V) {
    K key;
    V value;
}

struct HashTable(K, V) {
    ubyte* controls;
    HashSlot!(K, V)* slots;
    size_t capacity;
    size_t used;
    size_t released;
    uint shift;

    void allocate(size_t count) {
        controls = cast(ubyte*) calloc(count, 1);
        slots = cast(HashSlot!(K, V)*) malloc(count * HashSlot!(K, V).sizeof);
        assert(controls !is null && slots !is null);
        capacity = count;
        used = 0;
        released = 0;
        shift = cast(uint)(size_t.sizeof * 8 - bsr(count));
    }

    static size_t hashOf(K key) {
        return key.toHash() * TABLE_MULTIPLIER;
    }

    ubyte tagOf(size_t hash) const {
        return cast(ubyte)(LIVE | ((hash >> (shift - TAG_BITS)) & (LIVE - 1)));
    }

    size_t homeOf(K key) const {
        return hashOf(key) >> shift;
    }

    size_t probe(K key, size_t hash) const {
        size_t mask = capacity - 1;
        ubyte tag = tagOf(hash);
        size_t index = hash >> shift;
        while (controls[index] != EMPTY && !(controls[index] == tag && slots[index].key == key)) {
            index = (index + 1) & mask;
        }
        return index;
    }

    inout(V)* find(K key) inout {
        if (capacity == 0) {
            return null;
        } else {
            size_t index = probe(key, hashOf(key));
            if (controls[index] == EMPTY) {
                return null;
            } else {
                return &slots[index].value;
            }
        }
    }

    void assign(K key, V value, OnExisting existing) {
        size_t hash = hashOf(key);
        size_t index = probe(key, hash);
        if (controls[index] == EMPTY) {
            controls[index] = tagOf(hash);
            slots[index] = HashSlot!(K, V)(key, value);
            used += 1;
        } else if (existing == OnExisting.replace) {
            slots[index].value = value;
        }
    }

    void erase(K key) {
        if (capacity > 0) {
            size_t mask = capacity - 1;
            size_t hole = probe(key, hashOf(key));
            if (controls[hole] != EMPTY) {
                size_t next = (hole + 1) & mask;
                while (controls[next] != EMPTY) {
                    if (((next - homeOf(slots[next].key)) & mask) >= ((next - hole) & mask)) {
                        controls[hole] = controls[next];
                        slots[hole] = slots[next];
                        hole = next;
                    }
                    next = (next + 1) & mask;
                }
                controls[hole] = EMPTY;
                used -= 1;
            }
        }
    }

    void bury(K key) {
        if (capacity > 0) {
            size_t index = probe(key, hashOf(key));
            if (controls[index] != EMPTY) {
                controls[index] = REMOVED;
            }
        }
    }

    void releaseBefore(size_t cursor) {
        if ((cursor - released) * HashSlot!(K, V).sizeof >= RELEASED_BYTES) {
            size_t edge = cursor;
            while (edge > released && controls[edge - 1] != EMPTY) {
                edge -= 1;
            }
            giveBack(slots, released * HashSlot!(K, V).sizeof, edge * HashSlot!(K, V).sizeof);
            giveBack(controls, released, edge);
            released = edge;
        }
    }

    void clear() {
        if (capacity > 0) {
            memset(controls, EMPTY, capacity);
        }
        used = 0;
    }

    void release() {
        free(controls);
        free(slots);
        this = HashTable.init;
    }
}

struct HashMap(K, V) {
    HashTable!(K, V) current;
    HashTable!(K, V) previous;
    size_t migrated;

    inout(V)* find(K key) inout {
        inout(V)* found = current.find(key);
        if (found is null && previous.capacity > 0) {
            size_t index = previous.probe(key, previous.hashOf(key));
            if (index >= migrated && previous.controls[index] != EMPTY) {
                found = &previous.slots[index].value;
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    void insert(K key, V value) {
        if (current.capacity == 0) {
            resize(INITIAL_HASH_MAP_CAPACITY);
        } else if ((current.used + 1) * EIGHTHS > current.capacity * FULLEST_EIGHTHS) {
            resize(current.capacity * 2);
        }
        current.assign(key, value, OnExisting.replace);
        migrate(MIGRATED_SLOTS_PER_CHANGE);
    }

    void remove(K key) {
        current.erase(key);
        previous.bury(key);
        migrate(MIGRATED_SLOTS_PER_CHANGE);
        shrinkIfSparse();
    }

    pragma(inline, false) void shrinkIfSparse() {
        if (previous.capacity == 0 && current.capacity > INITIAL_HASH_MAP_CAPACITY && current.used * EIGHTHS < current.capacity * EMPTIEST_EIGHTHS) {
            resize(current.capacity / 2);
        }
    }

    void clear() {
        current.clear();
        previous.release();
        migrated = 0;
    }

    void resize(size_t capacity) {
        migrate(previous.capacity);
        previous = current;
        current.allocate(capacity);
        migrated = 0;
    }

    void migrate(size_t count) {
        size_t end = lowerOf(migrated + count, previous.capacity);
        foreach (index; migrated .. end) {
            if ((previous.controls[index] & LIVE) != 0) {
                current.assign(previous.slots[index].key, previous.slots[index].value, OnExisting.keep);
            }
        }
        migrated = end;
        if (previous.capacity > 0 && migrated == previous.capacity) {
            previous.release();
            migrated = 0;
        } else {
            previous.releaseBefore(migrated);
        }
    }

    int opApply(scope int delegate(ref const K, ref V) visit) {
        return visitLive(this, visit);
    }

    int opApply(scope int delegate(ref const K, ref const V) visit) const {
        return visitLive(this, visit);
    }

    void release() {
        current.release();
        previous.release();
        migrated = 0;
    }
}

int visitLive(M, D)(ref M map, D visit) {
    int result = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. map.current.capacity) {
        if (result == 0 && (map.current.controls[index] & LIVE) != 0) {
            result = visit(map.current.slots[index].key, map.current.slots[index].value);
        }
    }
    foreach (index; map.migrated .. map.previous.capacity) {
        if (result == 0 && (map.previous.controls[index] & LIVE) != 0 && map.current.find(map.previous.slots[index].key) is null) {
            result = visit(map.previous.slots[index].key, map.previous.slots[index].value);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

module base.maybe;

struct Maybe(T) {
    T stored;
    bool exists;

    static Maybe of(T found) {
        return Maybe(found, true);
    }

    ref inout(T) value() inout return {
        assert(exists);
        return stored;
    }
}

struct MaybeIndex(T) {
    T bits;

    static MaybeIndex of(T index) {
        assert(index != T.max);
        return MaybeIndex(cast(T)(index + 1));
    }

    bool exists() const {
        return bits != 0;
    }

    T value() const {
        assert(exists);
        return cast(T)(bits - 1);
    }
}

/// file: source/base/murmur.d
module base.murmur;

enum ulong MURMUR_C1 = 0x87c37b91114253d5;
enum ulong MURMUR_C2 = 0x4cf5ad432745937f;
enum ulong MURMUR_FINAL_MULTIPLIER_1 = 0xff51afd7ed558ccd;
enum ulong MURMUR_FINAL_MULTIPLIER_2 = 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53;
enum ulong MURMUR_H1_OFFSET = 0x52dce729;
enum ulong MURMUR_H2_OFFSET = 0x38495ab5;
enum size_t MURMUR_BLOCK_BYTES = 16;

struct Hash128 {
    ulong first;
    ulong second;
}

ulong rotateLeft(ulong value, uint amount) {
    return (value << amount) | (value >> (64 - amount));
}

ulong finalMix(ulong value) {
    ulong k = value;
    k ^= k >> 33;
    k *= MURMUR_FINAL_MULTIPLIER_1;
    k ^= k >> 33;
    k *= MURMUR_FINAL_MULTIPLIER_2;
    k ^= k >> 33;
    return k;
}

ulong readLittleEndian(const(ubyte)[] data, size_t offset, size_t count) {
    ulong result = 0;
    foreach (i; 0 .. count) {
        result |= cast(ulong) data[offset + i] << (i * 8);
    }
    return result;
}

ulong mixK1(ulong value) {
    ulong k = value * MURMUR_C1;
    k = rotateLeft(k, 31);
    return k * MURMUR_C2;
}

ulong mixK2(ulong value) {
    ulong k = value * MURMUR_C2;
    k = rotateLeft(k, 33);
    return k * MURMUR_C1;
}

Hash128 murmurHash3(const(ubyte)[] data) {
    ulong h1 = 0;
    ulong h2 = 0;
    size_t blockCount = data.length / MURMUR_BLOCK_BYTES;
    foreach (block; 0 .. blockCount) {
        size_t offset = block * MURMUR_BLOCK_BYTES;
        h1 ^= mixK1(readLittleEndian(data, offset, 8));
        h1 = rotateLeft(h1, 27);
        h1 += h2;
        h1 = h1 * 5 + MURMUR_H1_OFFSET;
        h2 ^= mixK2(readLittleEndian(data, offset + 8, 8));
        h2 = rotateLeft(h2, 31);
        h2 += h1;
        h2 = h2 * 5 + MURMUR_H2_OFFSET;
    }
    size_t tailOffset = blockCount * MURMUR_BLOCK_BYTES;
    size_t tailLength = data.length - tailOffset;
    if (tailLength > 8) {
        h2 ^= mixK2(readLittleEndian(data, tailOffset + 8, tailLength - 8));
    }
    if (tailLength > 8) {
        h1 ^= mixK1(readLittleEndian(data, tailOffset, 8));
    } else if (tailLength > 0) {
        h1 ^= mixK1(readLittleEndian(data, tailOffset, tailLength));
    }
    h1 ^= data.length;
    h2 ^= data.length;
    h1 += h2;
    h2 += h1;
    h1 = finalMix(h1);
    h2 = finalMix(h2);
    h1 += h2;
    h2 += h1;
    return Hash128(h1, h2);
}

/// file: source/base/numbers.d
module base.numbers;

enum float PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;
enum double RADIANS_PER_DEGREE = 0.017453292519943295;
enum double LN_TWO = 0.69314718055994530942;
enum uint LOG_SERIES_TERMS = 40;
enum uint SQRT_STEPS = 60;

bool isNan(float value) {
    return value != value;
}

T lowerOf(T)(T a, T b) {
    if (a < b) {
        return a;
    } else {
        return b;
    }
}

T higherOf(T)(T a, T b) {
    if (a > b) {
        return a;
    } else {
        return b;
    }
}

double logAtCompileTime(double x) {
    assert(x > 0);
    double scaled = x;
    double exponent = 0;
    while (scaled > 2) {
        scaled /= 2;
        exponent += 1;
    }
    while (scaled < 1) {
        scaled *= 2;
        exponent -= 1;
    }
    double z = (scaled - 1) / (scaled + 1);
    double square = z * z;
    double term = z;
    double sum = 0;
    foreach (k; 0 .. LOG_SERIES_TERMS) {
        sum += term / (2 * k + 1);
        term *= square;
    }
    return 2 * sum + exponent * LN_TWO;
}

double acoshAtCompileTime(double x) {
    return logAtCompileTime(x + sqrtAtCompileTime(x * x - 1));
}

double asinhAtCompileTime(double x) {
    return logAtCompileTime(x + sqrtAtCompileTime(x * x + 1));
}

double sqrtAtCompileTime(double x) {
    double estimate = higherOf(x, 1.0);
    foreach (_; 0 .. SQRT_STEPS) {
        estimate = (estimate + x / estimate) / 2;
    }
    return estimate;
}

T clamped(T)(T value, T low, T high) {
    if (value < low) {
        return low;
    } else if (value > high) {
        return high;
    } else {
        return value;
    }
}

/// file: source/base/pages.d
module base.pages;

version (WebAssembly) {
    import core.stdc.stdlib : calloc, free;

    enum size_t WASM_PAGE_BYTES = 65536;

    void* mapPages(size_t size) {
        void* memory = calloc(size, 1);
        assert(memory !is null);
        return memory;
    }

    void unmapPages(void* memory, size_t size) {
        free(memory);
    }

    size_t pageSize() {
        return WASM_PAGE_BYTES;
    }

    void giveBack(void* base, size_t from, size_t to) {
    }
} else {
    import core.sys.posix.sys.mman : MAP_ANON, MAP_PRIVATE, PROT_READ, PROT_WRITE, mmap, munmap;
    import core.sys.posix.unistd : _SC_PAGESIZE, sysconf;

    version (OSX) {
        enum int MADV_DONTNEED = 4;

        extern (C) int madvise(void* address, size_t length, int advice) nothrow @nogc;
    } else {
        import core.sys.linux.sys.mman : MADV_DONTNEED, madvise;
    }

    void* mapPages(size_t size) {
        return mmap(null, size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANON, -1, 0);
    }

    void unmapPages(void* memory, size_t size) {
        munmap(memory, size);
    }

    size_t pageSize() {
        return sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    }

    void giveBack(void* base, size_t from, size_t to) {
        size_t page = pageSize();
        size_t start = (cast(size_t) base + from + page - 1) & ~(page - 1);
        size_t end = (cast(size_t) base + to) & ~(page - 1);
        if (end > start) {
            madvise(cast(void*) start, end - start, MADV_DONTNEED);
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/base/parallel.d
module base.parallel;

import core.atomic : atomicFetchAdd, atomicLoad, atomicOp, atomicStore, cas;
import core.stdc.stdlib : calloc, free;
import base.clock : Deadline, nowMilliseconds;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;

enum uint MAIN_WORKER = 0;
enum size_t CACHE_LINE = 64;
enum size_t GRAINS_PER_PARTICIPANT = 8;

version (WebAssembly) {
    void waitWhile(ref shared uint word, uint expected) {
    }

    void wake(ref shared uint word) {
    }
} else version (OSX) {
    import core.sys.posix.pthread : pthread_create, pthread_join, pthread_t;

    enum uint OS_SYNC_NONE = 0;

    extern (C) int os_sync_wait_on_address(shared(void)* address, ulong value, size_t size, uint flags) nothrow @nogc;
    extern (C) int os_sync_wake_by_address_all(shared(void)* address, size_t size, uint flags) nothrow @nogc;

    void waitWhile(ref shared uint word, uint expected) {
        os_sync_wait_on_address(&word, expected, uint.sizeof, OS_SYNC_NONE);
    }

    void wake(ref shared uint word) {
        os_sync_wake_by_address_all(&word, uint.sizeof, OS_SYNC_NONE);
    }
} else {
    import core.sys.posix.pthread : pthread_create, pthread_join, pthread_t;
    import bindings.kernel : CALL_FUTEX, FUTEX_WAIT_HERE, FUTEX_WAKE_HERE;

    enum int WAKE_ALL = int.max;

    extern (C) long syscall(long number, ...) nothrow @nogc;

    void waitWhile(ref shared uint word, uint expected) {
        syscall(CALL_FUTEX, &word, FUTEX_WAIT_HERE, expected, null, null, 0);
    }

    void wake(ref shared uint word) {
        syscall(CALL_FUTEX, &word, FUTEX_WAKE_HERE, WAKE_ALL, null, null, 0);
    }
}

enum Pace : ubyte {
    onTime,
    late,
}

enum PoolLife : ubyte {
    serving,
    stopping,
}

struct ParallelJob {
    void function(void* context, size_t index, uint worker) run;
    void* context;
    Deadline deadline;
    size_t count;
    size_t grain = 1;
    shared size_t claimed;
    shared Pace pace;

    void work(uint worker) {
        Pace current = atomicLoad(pace);
        while (current == Pace.onTime) {
            size_t first = atomicFetchAdd(claimed, grain);
            if (first >= count) {
                return;
            }
            size_t end = lowerOf(first + grain, count);
            foreach (index; first .. end) {
                run(context, index, worker);
            }
            if (deadline.isBounded) {
                double now = nowMilliseconds();
                if (deadline.hasPassed(now)) {
                    atomicStore(pace, Pace.late);
                }
            }
            current = atomicLoad(pace);
        }
    }

    bool hasOpenWork() const {
        size_t taken = atomicLoad(claimed);
        Pace current = atomicLoad(pace);
        return taken < count && current == Pace.onTime;
    }

    void finish() {
        count = lowerOf(count, atomicLoad(claimed));
    }
}

struct TaskSource {
    bool function(void* context, uint worker) take;
    void* context;
}

struct WorkerStart {
    WorkerPool* pool;
    uint worker;
}

struct WorkerPool {
    TaskSource source;
    version (WebAssembly) {
    } else {
        pthread_t* threads;
        WorkerStart* starts;
    }
    shared size_t job;
    shared uint active;
    shared uint epoch;
    shared uint sleepers;
    shared uint joiners;
    shared PoolLife life;
    uint workerCount;
    uint runs;
    double waitedMs = 0;

    static WorkerPool* make(uint workers, TaskSource source) {
        WorkerPool* pool = cast(WorkerPool*) calloc(1, WorkerPool.sizeof);
        pool.source = source;
        pool.workerCount = workers;
        version (WebAssembly) {
            assert(workers == 0);
        } else {
            pool.threads = cast(pthread_t*) calloc(workers, pthread_t.sizeof);
            pool.starts = cast(WorkerStart*) calloc(workers, WorkerStart.sizeof);
            foreach (index; 0 .. workers) {
                pool.starts[index] = WorkerStart(pool, index + 1);
                pthread_create(&pool.threads[index], null, &workerMain, &pool.starts[index]);
            }
        }
        return pool;
    }

    uint participants() const {
        return workerCount + 1;
    }

    void signal() {
        atomicOp!"+="(epoch, 1);
        uint sleeping = atomicLoad(sleepers);
        if (sleeping > 0) {
            wake(epoch);
        }
    }

    void serve(uint worker) {
        PoolLife current = atomicLoad(life);
        while (current == PoolLife.serving) {
            uint seen = atomicLoad(epoch);
            bool worked = joinJob(worker);
            if (!worked) {
                worked = source.take(source.context, worker);
            }
            if (!worked) {
                atomicOp!"+="(sleepers, 1);
                uint latest = atomicLoad(epoch);
                PoolLife standing = atomicLoad(life);
                if (latest == seen && standing == PoolLife.serving) {
                    waitWhile(epoch, seen);
                }
                atomicOp!"-="(sleepers, 1);
            }
            current = atomicLoad(life);
        }
    }

    bool joinJob(uint worker) {
        atomicOp!"+="(active, 1);
        ParallelJob* open = cast(ParallelJob*) atomicLoad(job);
        if (open !is null) {
            bool hasWork = open.hasOpenWork();
            if (hasWork) {
                open.work(worker);
            } else {
                open = null;
            }
        }
        uint inside = atomicOp!"-="(active, 1);
        uint waiting = atomicLoad(joiners);
        if (inside == 0 && waiting != 0) {
            wake(active);
        }
        return open !is null;
    }

    void helpWithJob(uint worker) {
        size_t open = atomicLoad(job);
        if (open != 0) {
            joinJob(worker);
        }
    }

    void run(ParallelJob* parallel) {
        if (!parallel.deadline.isBounded) {
            parallel.grain = grainFor(parallel.count, participants());
        }
        atomicStore(job, cast(size_t) parallel);
        signal();
        parallel.work(MAIN_WORKER);
        atomicStore(job, 0);
        double start = nowMilliseconds();
        atomicStore(joiners, 1);
        uint inside = atomicLoad(active);
        while (inside != 0) {
            waitWhile(active, inside);
            inside = atomicLoad(active);
        }
        atomicStore(joiners, 0);
        parallel.finish();
        runs += 1;
        waitedMs += nowMilliseconds() - start;
    }

    void release() {
        atomicStore(life, PoolLife.stopping);
        signal();
        wake(epoch);
        version (WebAssembly) {
        } else {
            foreach (index; 0 .. workerCount) {
                pthread_join(threads[index], null);
            }
            free(threads);
            free(starts);
        }
    }
}

size_t grainFor(size_t count, uint participants) {
    return higherOf(count / (cast(size_t) participants * GRAINS_PER_PARTICIPANT), size_t(1));
}

version (WebAssembly) {
} else {
    extern (C) void* workerMain(void* argument) {
        WorkerStart* start = cast(WorkerStart*) argument;
        start.pool.serve(start.worker);
        return null;
    }
}

struct Executor {
    WorkerPool* pool;

    uint workers() const {
        if (pool is null) {
            return 1;
        } else {
            return pool.participants();
        }
    }

    void run(ParallelJob* job) {
        if (pool is null) {
            job.work(MAIN_WORKER);
            job.finish();
        } else {
            pool.run(job);
        }
    }
}

struct QueueCell(T) {
    shared size_t sequence;
    T value;
}

struct ConcurrentQueue(T) {
    QueueCell!T* cells;
    size_t mask;
    ubyte[CACHE_LINE] beforeHead;
    shared size_t head;
    ubyte[CACHE_LINE] beforeTail;
    shared size_t tail;
    ubyte[CACHE_LINE] afterTail;

    static ConcurrentQueue make(size_t capacity) {
        assert((capacity & (capacity - 1)) == 0);
        ConcurrentQueue queue;
        queue.cells = cast(QueueCell!T*) calloc(capacity, QueueCell!T.sizeof);
        queue.mask = capacity - 1;
        foreach (index; 0 .. capacity) {
            atomicStore(queue.cells[index].sequence, index);
        }
        return queue;
    }

    bool push(T value) {
        size_t position = atomicLoad(head);
        while (true) {
            QueueCell!T* cell = &cells[position & mask];
            ptrdiff_t difference = cast(ptrdiff_t)(atomicLoad(cell.sequence) - position);
            if (difference == 0) {
                bool won = cas(&head, position, position + 1);
                if (won) {
                    cell.value = value;
                    atomicStore(cell.sequence, position + 1);
                    return true;
                }
                position = atomicLoad(head);
            } else if (difference < 0) {
                return false;
            } else {
                position = atomicLoad(head);
            }
        }
    }

    bool pop(ref T value) {
        size_t position = atomicLoad(tail);
        while (true) {
            QueueCell!T* cell = &cells[position & mask];
            ptrdiff_t difference = cast(ptrdiff_t)(atomicLoad(cell.sequence) - (position + 1));
            if (difference == 0) {
                bool won = cas(&tail, position, position + 1);
                if (won) {
                    value = cell.value;
                    atomicStore(cell.sequence, position + mask + 1);
                    return true;
                }
                position = atomicLoad(tail);
            } else if (difference < 0) {
                return false;
            } else {
                position = atomicLoad(tail);
            }
        }
    }

    void release() {
        free(cells);
        cells = null;
    }
}

/// file: source/base/slab.d
module base.slab;

import core.bitop : bsf, bsr;
import base.array : Array;
import base.flags : WORD_MASK, WORD_SHIFT;
import base.numbers : lowerOf;
import base.pages : giveBack, mapPages, pageSize, unmapPages;

enum uint SLAB_SHIFT = 12;
enum uint SLAB_SIZE = 2 ^^ SLAB_SHIFT;
enum uint SLAB_MASK = SLAB_SIZE - 1;
enum uint RUN_CLASSES = SLAB_SHIFT + 1;
enum size_t TRIMMED_BLOCKS_PER_CALL = 4;
enum size_t NOTED_PAGES_PER_DISCARD = 512;

enum DiscardPass : ubyte {
    resting,
    sweeping,
}

struct Slab(T) {
    Array!(T*) blocks;
    Array!ulong noted;
    size_t notedCount;
    size_t notedCursor;
    DiscardPass pass;

    inout(T)* at(size_t index) inout {
        return blocks.ptr[index >> SLAB_SHIFT] + (index & SLAB_MASK);
    }

    void ensure(size_t count) {
        while (blocks.length * SLAB_SIZE < count) {
            blocks.append(allocateBlock());
        }
    }

    void trim(size_t count) {
        size_t kept = ((count + SLAB_SIZE - 1) >> SLAB_SHIFT) + 1;
        size_t freed = 0;
        while (blocks.length > kept && freed < TRIMMED_BLOCKS_PER_CALL) {
            unmapBlock(blocks.ptr[blocks.length - 1]);
            blocks.length -= 1;
            freed += 1;
        }
    }

    void discard(size_t from, size_t to) {
        while (from < to) {
            size_t block = from >> SLAB_SHIFT;
            size_t end = lowerOf((block + 1) << SLAB_SHIFT, to);
            if (block < blocks.length && blocks.ptr[block] !is null) {
                giveBack(blocks.ptr[block], (from & SLAB_MASK) * T.sizeof, (end - (block << SLAB_SHIFT)) * T.sizeof);
            }
            from = end;
        }
    }

    void note(size_t index, size_t per) {
        size_t page = pageSize();
        foreach (candidate; index * per * T.sizeof / page .. ((index + 1) * per * T.sizeof - 1) / page + 1) {
            size_t word = candidate >> WORD_SHIFT;
            if (noted.length <= word) {
                noted.resize(word + 1);
            }
            ulong bit = 1UL << (candidate & WORD_MASK);
            if ((noted.ptr[word] & bit) == 0) {
                notedCount += 1;
                noted.ptr[word] |= bit;
            }
        }
    }

    void discardNoted(ref const FreeIndices free, size_t limit, size_t per, ref uint calls) {
        if (notedCount >= NOTED_PAGES_PER_DISCARD) {
            pass = DiscardPass.sweeping;
        }
        size_t page = pageSize();
        size_t runStart = 0;
        size_t runEnd = 0;
        while (pass == DiscardPass.sweeping && calls > 0) {
            ulong* bits = &noted.ptr[notedCursor];
            while (*bits != 0 && calls > 0) {
                size_t candidate = (notedCursor << WORD_SHIFT) + bsf(*bits);
                *bits &= *bits - 1;
                notedCount -= 1;
                if (isPageFree(candidate, page, free, limit, per)) {
                    if (candidate != runEnd) {
                        calls -= discardPages(runStart, runEnd, page);
                        runStart = candidate;
                    }
                    runEnd = candidate + 1;
                }
            }
            if (*bits == 0) {
                notedCursor += 1;
            }
            if (notedCursor == noted.length) {
                notedCursor = 0;
                pass = DiscardPass.resting;
            }
        }
        calls -= lowerOf(calls, discardPages(runStart, runEnd, page));
    }

    bool isPageFree(size_t candidate, size_t page, ref const FreeIndices free, size_t limit, size_t per) const {
        size_t first = candidate * page / T.sizeof / per;
        size_t end = (((candidate + 1) * page + T.sizeof - 1) / T.sizeof + per - 1) / per;
        return first >= limit || free.containsAll(first, lowerOf(end, limit));
    }

    uint discardPages(size_t first, size_t end, size_t page) {
        if (end > first) {
            discard(first * page / T.sizeof, (end * page + T.sizeof - 1) / T.sizeof);
            return 1;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    T* touch(size_t index) {
        size_t block = index >> SLAB_SHIFT;
        while (blocks.length <= block) {
            blocks.append(null);
        }
        if (blocks.ptr[block] is null) {
            blocks.ptr[block] = allocateBlock();
        }
        return at(index);
    }

    T* allocateBlock() {
        T* block = cast(T*) mapPages(SLAB_SIZE * T.sizeof);
        static if (!__traits(isZeroInit, T)) {
            foreach (i; 0 .. SLAB_SIZE) {
                block[i] = T.init;
            }
        }
        return block;
    }

    void unmapBlock(T* block) {
        if (block !is null) {
            unmapPages(block, SLAB_SIZE * T.sizeof);
        }
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (block; blocks.slice()) {
            unmapBlock(block);
        }
        blocks.release();
        noted.release();
        notedCount = 0;
        notedCursor = 0;
        pass = DiscardPass.resting;
    }
}

struct Run {
    uint start;
    uint length;
}

struct RunPool(T) {
    Slab!T items;
    Array!uint[RUN_CLASSES] free;
    uint end;

    inout(T)[] slice(Run run) inout {
        if (run.length == 0) {
            return null;
        } else {
            return items.at(run.start)[0 .. run.length];
        }
    }

    Run reserve(uint length) {
        if (length == 0) {
            return Run(0, 0);
        } else {
            assert(length <= SLAB_SIZE);
            uint size = runClass(length);
            if (free[size].length > 0) {
                free[size].length -= 1;
                return Run(free[size].ptr[free[size].length], length);
            } else {
                uint span = 1u << size;
                uint start = (end + span - 1) & ~(span - 1);
                keepGap(end, start);
                end = start + span;
                items.ensure(end);
                return Run(start, length);
            }
        }
    }

    void release(Run run) {
        if (run.length > 0) {
            free[runClass(run.length)].append(run.start);
        }
    }

    void keepGap(uint from, uint to) {
        while (from < to) {
            uint size = lowerOf(SLAB_SHIFT, cast(uint) bsf(from));
            while ((1u << size) > to - from) {
                size -= 1;
            }
            free[size].append(from);
            from += 1u << size;
        }
    }

    void release() {
        items.release();
        foreach (ref list; free) {
            list.release();
        }
        end = 0;
    }
}

struct FreeIndices {
    Array!ulong words;
    Array!ulong summary;
    size_t lowestWord;
    size_t count;

    bool isEmpty() const {
        return count == 0;
    }

    bool contains(uint index) const {
        size_t word = index >> WORD_SHIFT;
        return word < words.length && (words.ptr[word] & (1UL << (index & WORD_MASK))) != 0;
    }

    bool containsAll(size_t from, size_t to) const {
        while (from < to) {
            size_t word = from >> WORD_SHIFT;
            size_t end = lowerOf((word + 1) << WORD_SHIFT, to);
            size_t span = end - from;
            ulong mask = ulong.max;
            if (span <= WORD_MASK) {
                mask = (1UL << span) - 1;
            }
            mask <<= from & WORD_MASK;
            if (word >= words.length || (words.ptr[word] & mask) != mask) {
                return false;
            }
            from = end;
        }
        return true;
    }

    void add(uint index) {
        size_t word = index >> WORD_SHIFT;
        if (words.length <= word) {
            words.resize(word + 1);
        }
        if (summary.length <= word >> WORD_SHIFT) {
            summary.resize((word >> WORD_SHIFT) + 1);
        }
        words.ptr[word] |= 1UL << (index & WORD_MASK);
        summary.ptr[word >> WORD_SHIFT] |= 1UL << (word & WORD_MASK);
        if (word < lowestWord) {
            lowestWord = word;
        }
        count += 1;
    }

    void drop(uint index) {
        size_t word = index >> WORD_SHIFT;
        words.ptr[word] &= ~(1UL << (index & WORD_MASK));
        if (words.ptr[word] == 0) {
            summary.ptr[word >> WORD_SHIFT] &= ~(1UL << (word & WORD_MASK));
        }
        count -= 1;
    }

    uint takeLowest() {
        assert(count > 0);
        size_t group = lowestWord >> WORD_SHIFT;
        while (summary.ptr[group] == 0) {
            group += 1;
        }
        size_t word = (group << WORD_SHIFT) + bsf(summary.ptr[group]);
        uint index = cast(uint)((word << WORD_SHIFT) + bsf(words.ptr[word]));
        lowestWord = word;
        drop(index);
        return index;
    }

    void release() {
        words.release();
        summary.release();
        lowestWord = 0;
        count = 0;
    }
}

uint runClass(uint length) {
    if (length <= 1) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        return bsr(length - 1) + 1;
    }
}

/// file: source/base/splitmix.d
module base.splitmix;

enum ulong SPLITMIX_INCREMENT = 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15;
enum ulong SPLITMIX_MULTIPLIER_1 = 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9;
enum ulong SPLITMIX_MULTIPLIER_2 = 0x94d049bb133111eb;
enum uint ROLL_DISCARDED_BITS = 40;
enum float ROLL_RANGE = 1 << 24;
enum uint UNIT_DISCARDED_BITS = 11;
enum double UNIT_SCALE = 1.0 / (1UL << 53);

struct SplitMix {
    ulong state;

    ulong next() {
        state += SPLITMIX_INCREMENT;
        ulong z = state;
        z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * SPLITMIX_MULTIPLIER_1;
        z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * SPLITMIX_MULTIPLIER_2;
        return z ^ (z >> 31);
    }

    float roll() {
        return cast(float)(next() >> ROLL_DISCARDED_BITS) / ROLL_RANGE;
    }

    double unit() {
        return unitOf(next());
    }
}

double unitOf(ulong bits) {
    return cast(double)(bits >> UNIT_DISCARDED_BITS) * UNIT_SCALE;
}

/// file: source/base/units.d
module base.units;

struct Quantity(int lengthPower, int timePower, int anglePower) {
    float value = 0;

    Quantity opBinary(string op)(Quantity other) const if (op == "+" || op == "-") {
        return Quantity(mixin("value " ~ op ~ " other.value"));
    }

    Quantity opBinary(string op)(float scale) const if (op == "*" || op == "/") {
        return Quantity(mixin("value " ~ op ~ " scale"));
    }

    Quantity!(lengthPower + otherLength, timePower + otherTime, anglePower + otherAngle) opBinary(string op : "*", int otherLength, int otherTime, int otherAngle)(Quantity!(otherLength, otherTime, otherAngle) other) const {
        return Quantity!(lengthPower + otherLength, timePower + otherTime, anglePower + otherAngle)(value * other.value);
    }

    Quantity!(lengthPower - otherLength, timePower - otherTime, anglePower - otherAngle) opBinary(string op : "/", int otherLength, int otherTime, int otherAngle)(Quantity!(otherLength, otherTime, otherAngle) other) const {
        return Quantity!(lengthPower - otherLength, timePower - otherTime, anglePower - otherAngle)(value / other.value);
    }

    Quantity opUnary(string op)() const if (op == "-") {
        return Quantity(-value);
    }

    int opCmp(Quantity other) const {
        if (value < other.value) {
            return -1;
        } else if (value > other.value) {
            return 1;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }
}

struct Blocks {
    float value = 0;
}

struct LocalBlock {
    Length height;

    Length heightOf(Blocks count) const {
        return height * count.value;
    }
}

alias Rate = Quantity!(0, -1, 0);

/// file: source/base/vector3.d
module base.vector3;

import core.math : sqrt;

struct Vec3(T) {
    T x;
    T y;
    T z;

    ref inout(T) opIndex(size_t axis) inout return {
        if (axis == 0) {
            return x;
        } else if (axis == 1) {
            return y;
        } else {
            assert(axis == 2);
            return z;
        }
    }

    Vec3!U as(U)() const {
        return Vec3!U(cast(U) x, cast(U) y, cast(U) z);
    }
}

immutable Vec3!float ZERO_VECTOR = Vec3!float(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);

float dot(Vec3!float a, Vec3!float b) {
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

float magnitude(Vec3!float v) {
    return sqrt(v.dot(v));
}

Vec3!float scaled(Vec3!float v, float s) {
    return Vec3!float(v.x * s, v.y * s, v.z * s);
}

Vec3!float plus(Vec3!float a, Vec3!float b) {
    return Vec3!float(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
}

Vec3!float minus(Vec3!float a, Vec3!float b) {
    return Vec3!float(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
}

Vec3!float negated(Vec3!float v) {
    return Vec3!float(-v.x, -v.y, -v.z);
}

Vec3!float cross(Vec3!float a, Vec3!float b) {
    return Vec3!float(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);
}

Vec3!float rejectAlong(Vec3!float v, Vec3!float unitAxis) {
    return v.minus(unitAxis.scaled(v.dot(unitAxis)));
}

Vec3!float cappedTo(Vec3!float v, float maxMagnitude) {
    float magnitudeSquared = v.dot(v);
    if (magnitudeSquared > maxMagnitude * maxMagnitude) {
        return v.scaled(maxMagnitude / sqrt(magnitudeSquared));
    } else {
        return v;
    }
}

Vec3!float movedToward(Vec3!float current, Vec3!float target, float maxStep) {
    return current.plus(target.minus(current).cappedTo(maxStep));
}

Vec3!float projectedOntoPlane(Vec3!float subject, Vec3!float normal, Vec3!float direction, float distance) {
    return subject.plus(direction.scaled((distance - subject.dot(normal)) / direction.dot(normal)));
}

module client.arguments;

import core.stdc.stdio : FILE, fclose, fopen, fprintf, stderr, stdout;
