enum string VERSION = "0.0.1";
enum string VERSION_TEXT = "mined " ~ VERSION ~ "\n";
enum string UNKNOWN_OPTION = "unknown option";
enum string NOT_A_NUMBER = "needs a number, got";
enum string REPORT_UNOPENED = "cannot open the report file";

enum OptionSpec WORLDGEN_OPTION = OptionSpec("--worldgen", "terrain | plane <tilt in degrees> | structure <world>", "the world to use");
enum OptionSpec OUTPUT_OPTION = OptionSpec("--out", "<file>", "where a tool writes its report (default stdout)");
enum OptionSpec HELP_OPTION = OptionSpec("--help", "", "show this text");
enum OptionSpec VERSION_OPTION = OptionSpec("--version", "", "show the version");

enum ExitStatus : int {
    ok = 0,
    failed = 1,
    usage = 2,
}

ExitStatus exitStatus(bool succeeded) {
    if (succeeded) {
        return ExitStatus.ok;
    } else {
        return ExitStatus.failed;
    }
}

struct StartupError {
    const(string)[] choices;
    const(char)* message;
    const(char)* argument;
    const(char)[] flag;

    bool isPresent() const {
        return message !is null;
    }

    void report(const(char)* program) const {
        fprintf(stderr, "%s: ", program);
        if (flag.length > 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "%.*s ", cast(int) flag.length, flag.ptr);
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "%s", message);
        if (argument !is null) {
            fprintf(stderr, " '%s'", argument);
        }
        foreach (index, choice; choices) {
            fprintf(stderr, "%s%.*s", choiceSeparator(index), cast(int) choice.length, choice.ptr);
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "\n");
    }
}

immutable(char)* choiceSeparator(size_t index) {
    if (index == 0) {
        return ", expected one of: ";
    } else {
        return ", ";
    }
}

struct OptionSpec {
    string name;
    string value;
    string help;
}

string usageOf()(const(OptionSpec)[] options) {
    string text;
    foreach (option; options) {
        text ~= "  " ~ option.name;
        if (option.value.length > 0) {
            text ~= " " ~ option.value;
        }
        text ~= "  " ~ option.help ~ "\n";
    }
    return text;
}

Maybe!E optionNamed(E)(const(OptionSpec)[] options, const(char)[] name) {
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < options.length && options[index].name != name) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index < options.length) {
        return Maybe!E.of(cast(E) index);
    } else {
        return Maybe!E.init;
    }
}

const(char)[] sliceOf(const(char)* text) {
    return text[0 .. strlen(text)];
}

struct ArgumentCursor {
    char** argv;
    int count;
    int index = 1;

    bool hasMore() const {
        return index < count;
    }

    const(char)* next() {
        const(char)* argument = argv[index];
        index += 1;
        return argument;
    }

    void stop() {
        index = count;
    }
}

void parseOptions(E, A)(ref A arguments, const(OptionSpec)[] options, int argc, char** argv) {
    ArgumentCursor cursor = ArgumentCursor(argv, argc);
    while (cursor.hasMore && !arguments.error.isPresent()) {
        const(char)* argument = cursor.next();
        Maybe!E option = optionNamed!E(options, sliceOf(argument));
        if (!option.exists) {
            arguments.applyPositional(argument);
        } else if (options[option.value].value.length > 0 && !cursor.hasMore) {
            arguments.error = StartupError(null, "needs a value", null, options[option.value].name);
        } else {
            arguments.apply(option.value, cursor);
        }
    }
    if (!arguments.error.isPresent()) {
        arguments.error = arguments.usageError();
    }
}

FILE* openReport(const(char)* path) {
    if (path is null) {
        return stdout;
    } else {
        return fopen(path, "w");
    }
}

void closeReport(FILE* report) {
    if (report !is stdout) {
        fclose(report);
    }
}

Maybe!float numberIn(const(char)* text) {
    const(char)* end;
    float value = strtof(text, &end);
    if (end != text && *end == 0) {
        return Maybe!float.of(value);
    } else {
        return Maybe!float.init;
    }
}

struct WorldgenArgument {
    StartupError error;
    Worldgen worldgen;

    static WorldgenArgument from(ref ArgumentCursor cursor) {
        const(char)* kindText = cursor.next();
        Maybe!WorldgenKind kind = enumNamed!WorldgenKind(sliceOf(kindText));
        if (!kind.exists) {
            return WorldgenArgument(StartupError(ENUM_NAMES!WorldgenKind[], "unknown worldgen", kindText), Worldgen.init);
        } else {
            return WorldgenArgument.ofKind(cursor, kind.value);
        }
    }

    static WorldgenArgument ofKind(ref ArgumentCursor cursor, WorldgenKind kind) {
        WorldgenArgument parsed = void;
        final switch (kind) {
            case WorldgenKind.terrain:
                parsed = WorldgenArgument(StartupError.init, Worldgen.makeTerrain());
                break;
            case WorldgenKind.plane:
                parsed = WorldgenArgument.plane(cursor);
                break;
            case WorldgenKind.structure:
                parsed = WorldgenArgument.structure(cursor);
                break;
        }
        return parsed;
    }

    static WorldgenArgument plane(ref ArgumentCursor cursor) {
        if (!cursor.hasMore) {
            return WorldgenArgument(StartupError(null, "plane needs a tilt in degrees"), Worldgen.init);
        } else {
            const(char)* text = cursor.next();
            Maybe!float tilt = numberIn(text);
            if (!tilt.exists) {
                return WorldgenArgument(StartupError(null, "plane tilt in degrees is not a number", text), Worldgen.init);
            } else {
                return WorldgenArgument(StartupError.init, Worldgen.fromPlane(PlaneWorld(degreesToRadians(tilt.value))));
            }
        }
    }

    static WorldgenArgument structure(ref ArgumentCursor cursor) {
        if (!cursor.hasMore) {
            return WorldgenArgument(StartupError(registry().allNames(), "structure needs a world name"), Worldgen.init);
        } else {
            const(char)* text = cursor.next();
            StructureName name = StructureName.fromText(sliceOf(text));
            if (name.problem !is null) {
                return WorldgenArgument(StartupError(name.choices, name.problem, text), Worldgen.init);
            } else {
                return WorldgenArgument(StartupError.init, Worldgen.fromStructure(name.world));
            }
        }
    }
}

struct StructureName {
    StructureWorld world;
    const(string)[] choices;
    const(char)* problem;

    static StructureName fromText(const(char)[] text) {
        if (text.length > STRUCTURE_NAME_CAPACITY) {
            return StructureName(StructureWorld.init, null, "structure name is too long");
        } else if (registry().find(text) is null) {
            return StructureName(StructureWorld.init, registry().allNames(), "unknown structure");
        } else {
            return StructureName(StructureWorld.fromName(text), null, null);
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/client/arrivals.d
module client.arrivals;

import core.stdc.stdlib : calloc, free;
import base.array : Array;
import base.clock : Deadline;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.parallel : Executor, ParallelJob;
import client.tasks : GenKind, GenResult;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.neighbors : chunkNeighborSlot, isBorderingVoid, isPredictionContradicted, needsMesh, touchChunksAround;
import common.edits : ChunkEdits, applyEdits;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkId, ChunkSlot, ChunkState, Materials;
import common.worldgen.generation : ChunkParams, GeneratedVoxels, MaterialPass;
import geometry.cube : DIRECTIONS;

struct IntegrationOutput {
    Array!ChunkSlot restored;
    Array!ChunkSlot holders;
    Array!ChunkSlot changed;
    Array!ChunkSlot exposed;
    Array!ChunkSlot editedDeferred;

    void clear() {
        restored.clear();
        holders.clear();
        changed.clear();
        exposed.clear();
        editedDeferred.clear();
    }

    void release() {
        restored.release();
        holders.release();
        changed.release();
        exposed.release();
        editedDeferred.release();
    }
}

struct IntegrationJob {
    Graph* graph;
    GenResult* arrivals;
    IntegrationOutput* outputs;
}

struct Integrator {
    Array!GenResult arrivals;
    IntegrationOutput* outputs;
    uint participants;

    static Integrator make(uint participants) {
        Integrator integrator;
        integrator.participants = participants;
        integrator.outputs = cast(IntegrationOutput*) calloc(participants, IntegrationOutput.sizeof);
        return integrator;
    }

    void run(ref Graph graph, Executor executor) {
        if (arrivals.length > 0) {
            join(graph, executor);
        }
    }

    void join(ref Graph graph, Executor executor) {
        IntegrationJob context = IntegrationJob(&graph, arrivals.ptr, outputs);
        runPass(executor, &storeArrival, &context, arrivals.length);
        runPass(executor, &settleArrival, &context, arrivals.length);
        foreach (worker; 0 .. participants) {
            graph.chunks.restores.appendAll(outputs[worker].restored.slice());
            graph.chunks.changed.appendAll(outputs[worker].changed.slice());
        }
        foreach (worker; 0 .. participants) {
            foreach (holder; outputs[worker].holders.slice()) {
                graph.markChanged(holder);
            }
            foreach (exposed; outputs[worker].exposed.slice()) {
                graph.resolveIfExposed(exposed);
            }
            foreach (edited; outputs[worker].editedDeferred.slice()) {
                if (graph.chunks.at(edited).hasDeferredMaterials) {
                    graph.resolveMaterials(edited);
                }
            }
            outputs[worker].clear();
        }
        arrivals.clear();
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (arrival; arrivals.slice()) {
            arrival.generated.voxels.release();
        }
        foreach (worker; 0 .. participants) {
            outputs[worker].release();
        }
        free(outputs);
        outputs = null;
        arrivals.release();
    }
}

void runPass(Executor executor, void function(void* context, size_t item, uint worker) pass, IntegrationJob* context, size_t count) {
    ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(pass, context, Deadline.init, count);
    executor.run(&job);
}

void storeArrival(void* context, size_t item, uint worker) {
    IntegrationJob* job = cast(IntegrationJob*) context;
    GenResult arrival = job.arrivals[item];
    Chunk* chunk = job.graph.chunks.existing(arrival.chunk);
    chunk.voxels = arrival.generated.voxels;
    chunk.materials = arrival.generated.materials;
    const(ChunkEdits)* edits = (*job.graph).editsAt(arrival.chunk);
    if (edits !is null) {
        applyEdits(*edits, chunk, job.graph.layout.dimension);
        if (chunk.hasDeferredMaterials) {
            job.outputs[worker].editedDeferred.append(arrival.chunk);
        }
    }
    chunk.state = ChunkState.populated;
}

const(ChunkEdits)* editsAt(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk) {
    return graph.edits.editsOf(ChunkId(graph.idAt(chunk.slot), chunk.corner));
}

void settleArrival(void* context, size_t item, uint worker) {
    IntegrationJob* job = cast(IntegrationJob*) context;
    settle(*job.graph, job.arrivals[item], job.outputs[worker]);
}

void settle(ref Graph graph, GenResult arrival, ref IntegrationOutput output) {
    const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(arrival.chunk);
    if (arrival.kind == GenKind.fresh) {
        queueMesh(graph, arrival.chunk, output);
        if ((*chunk).isPredictionContradicted()) {
            graph.touchChunksAround(arrival.chunk, output.holders);
        }
    }
    if (chunk.hasDeferredMaterials && graph.isBorderingVoid(arrival.chunk)) {
        output.exposed.append(arrival.chunk);
    }
    foreach (direction; DIRECTIONS) {
        Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(arrival.chunk, direction);
        if (neighbor.exists && graph.chunks.has(neighbor.value.slot)) {
            Chunk* other = graph.chunks.existing(neighbor.value);
            bool restored = false;
            if (arrival.kind == GenKind.fresh) {
                restored = other.casState(ChunkState.dropped, ChunkState.generating);
            }
            if (restored) {
                output.restored.append(neighbor.value);
            } else {
                ChunkState state = other.loadState();
                if (state == ChunkState.populated) {
                    if (arrival.kind == GenKind.fresh) {
                        queueMesh(graph, neighbor.value, output);
                    }
                    if (other.hasDeferredMaterials && graph.isBorderingVoid(neighbor.value)) {
                        output.exposed.append(neighbor.value);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void queueMesh(ref Graph graph, ChunkSlot target, ref IntegrationOutput output) {
    if (graph.needsMesh(target)) {
        bool claimed = graph.chunks.existing(target).claimQueued();
        if (claimed) {
            output.changed.append(target);
        }
    }
}

void generateNow(ref Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk) {
    if (graph.chunks.at(chunk).state == ChunkState.fresh) {
        ChunkParams params = ChunkParams.make(graph.view, chunk.slot, chunk.corner);
        graph.chunks.writable(chunk).predicted = params.predictOccupancy();
        graph.populateChunk(chunk, params.generateVoxels());
    }
}

void populateChunk(ref Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, GeneratedVoxels generated) {
    Integrator integrator = Integrator.make(1);
    integrator.arrivals.append(GenResult(generated, chunk, GenKind.fresh));
    integrator.run(graph, Executor(null));
    integrator.release();
}

void resolveIfExposed(ref Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk) {
    if (graph.chunks.at(chunk).hasDeferredMaterials && graph.isBorderingVoid(chunk)) {
        graph.resolveMaterials(chunk);
    }
}

void resolveMaterials(ref Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk) {
    ChunkParams params = ChunkParams.make(graph.view, chunk.slot, chunk.corner);
    params.materials = MaterialPass.resolving;
    GeneratedVoxels generated = params.generateVoxels();
    Chunk* target = graph.chunks.existing(chunk);
    target.releaseVoxels();
    target.voxels = generated.voxels;
    target.materials = Materials.resolved;
    const(ChunkEdits)* edits = graph.editsAt(chunk);
    if (edits !is null) {
        applyEdits(*edits, target, graph.layout.dimension);
    }
    graph.markChanged(chunk);
    foreach (direction; DIRECTIONS) {
        Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(chunk, direction);
        if (neighbor.exists && graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).state == ChunkState.populated) {
            graph.markChanged(neighbor.value);
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/client/camera.d
module client.camera;

import core.math : cos, sin, sqrt;
import core.stdc.math : asinf, fabsf;
import base.numbers : PI, clamped;
import base.units : Angle, Length;
import base.vector3 : Vec3, cross, dot;
import common.position : Position;
import geometry.lorentz : Mat4, Motion;

enum Angle PITCH_LIMIT = Angle(PI / 2.0f - 1e-3f);
enum float OPPOSITE_DOT_LIMIT = -0.999999f;
enum float PERPENDICULAR_AXIS_LIMIT = 0.9f;
enum float MIN_QUATERNION_LENGTH = 1e-10f;

immutable Vec3!float CAMERA_FORWARD = Vec3!float(0, 0, -1);

struct Quaternion {
    float w = 1;
    float x = 0;
    float y = 0;
    float z = 0;

    static Quaternion identity() {
        return Quaternion(1, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    static Quaternion fromAxisAngle(Vec3!float axis, float angle) {
        float length = sqrt(axis.dot(axis));
        if (length < MIN_QUATERNION_LENGTH) {
            return identity();
        } else {
            float halfAngle = angle * 0.5f;
            float scale = sin(halfAngle) / length;
            return Quaternion(cos(halfAngle), axis.x * scale, axis.y * scale, axis.z * scale);
        }
    }

    static Quaternion fromVectors(Vec3!float from, Vec3!float to) {
        float along = from.dot(to);
        if (along < OPPOSITE_DOT_LIMIT) {
            Vec3!float axis = unitOrZero(from.cross(perpendicularAxis(from)));
            return Quaternion(0, axis.x, axis.y, axis.z);
        } else {
            Vec3!float across = from.cross(to);
            float w = 1.0f + along;
            float inverseNorm = 1.0f / sqrt(w * w + across.dot(across));
            return Quaternion(w * inverseNorm, across.x * inverseNorm, across.y * inverseNorm, across.z * inverseNorm);
        }
    }

    Quaternion opBinary(string op)(Quaternion rhs) const if (op == "*") {
        return Quaternion(w * rhs.w - x * rhs.x - y * rhs.y - z * rhs.z, w * rhs.x + x * rhs.w + y * rhs.z - z * rhs.y, w * rhs.y - x * rhs.z + y * rhs.w + z * rhs.x, w * rhs.z + x * rhs.y - y * rhs.x + z * rhs.w);
    }

    Vec3!float rotate(Vec3!float v) const {
        Quaternion rotated = this * Quaternion(0, v.x, v.y, v.z) * Quaternion(w, -x, -y, -z);
        return Vec3!float(rotated.x, rotated.y, rotated.z);
    }

    Quaternion normalized() const {
        float length = sqrt(w * w + x * x + y * y + z * z);
        if (length < MIN_QUATERNION_LENGTH) {
            return identity();
        } else {
            float inverseLength = 1.0f / length;
            return Quaternion(w * inverseLength, x * inverseLength, y * inverseLength, z * inverseLength);
        }
    }

    Quaternion inverted() const {
        return Quaternion(w, -x, -y, -z);
    }

    Motion!float toMotion() const {
        Mat4!float m;
        m.c[0][0] = 1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z);
        m.c[0][1] = 2 * (x * y + w * z);
        m.c[0][2] = 2 * (x * z - w * y);
        m.c[1][0] = 2 * (x * y - w * z);
        m.c[1][1] = 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z);
        m.c[1][2] = 2 * (y * z + w * x);
        m.c[2][0] = 2 * (x * z + w * y);
        m.c[2][1] = 2 * (y * z - w * x);
        m.c[2][2] = 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y);
        m.c[3][3] = 1;
        return Motion!float(m);
    }
}

Vec3!float perpendicularAxis(Vec3!float from) {
    if (fabsf(from.x) < PERPENDICULAR_AXIS_LIMIT) {
        return Vec3!float(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    } else {
        return Vec3!float(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
    }
}

Vec3!float unitOrZero(Vec3!float axis) {
    float length = sqrt(axis.dot(axis));
    if (length > 0) {
        return Vec3!float(axis.x / length, axis.y / length, axis.z / length);
    } else {
        return axis;
    }
}

struct Camera {
    Position position;
    Motion!float eye;
    Quaternion heading;
    Vec3!float viewUp = Vec3!float(0, 1, 0);
    Length eyeOffset;
    Angle pitch;

    static Camera make(Length eyeOffset) {
        return Camera(Position.origin(), Motion!float.identity(), Quaternion.identity(), Vec3!float(0, 1, 0), eyeOffset, Angle(0));
    }

    Quaternion orientation() const {
        return heading * Quaternion.fromAxisAngle(Vec3!float(1, 0, 0), pitch.value);
    }

    Position orientedPosition() const {
        return Position(position.node, position.local * eye * orientation.toMotion());
    }

    Vec3!float forward() const {
        return orientation.rotate(CAMERA_FORWARD);
    }

    Angle elevation() const {
        return Angle(asinf(clamped(forward().dot(viewUp), -1.0f, 1.0f)));
    }

    void follow(Position bodyPosition, Motion!float eyeFromBody, Vec3!float visibleUp) {
        position = bodyPosition;
        eye = eyeFromBody;
        heading = (Quaternion.fromVectors(heading.rotate(Vec3!float(0, 1, 0)), visibleUp) * heading).normalized();
        viewUp = visibleUp;
    }

    void turn(Angle deltaYaw, Angle deltaPitch) {
        heading = (Quaternion.fromAxisAngle(viewUp, deltaYaw.value) * heading).normalized();
        pitch = Angle(clamped((pitch + deltaPitch).value, -PITCH_LIMIT.value, PITCH_LIMIT.value));
    }
}

immutable KeyCode[27] KEY_CODES = [
    KeyCode(0x0E, XK_e),
    KeyCode(0x03, XK_f),
    KeyCode(0x1F, XK_o),
    KeyCode(0x21, XK_bracketleft),
    KeyCode(0x1E, XK_bracketright),
    KeyCode(0x0D, XK_w),
    KeyCode(0x00, XK_a),
    KeyCode(0x01, XK_s),
    KeyCode(0x02, XK_d),
    KeyCode(0x09, XK_v),
    KeyCode(0x2D, XK_n),
    KeyCode(0x23, XK_p),
    KeyCode(0x12, XK_1),
    KeyCode(0x13, XK_1 + 1),
    KeyCode(0x14, XK_1 + 2),
    KeyCode(0x15, XK_1 + 3),
    KeyCode(0x17, XK_1 + 4),
    KeyCode(0x16, XK_1 + 5),
    KeyCode(0x1A, XK_1 + 6),
    KeyCode(0x1C, XK_1 + 7),
    KeyCode(0x19, XK_9),
    KeyCode(0x31, XK_space),
    KeyCode(0x35, XK_Escape),
    KeyCode(0x7B, XK_Left),
    KeyCode(0x7C, XK_Right),
    KeyCode(0x7E, XK_Up),
    KeyCode(0x7D, XK_Down),
];

extern (C) nothrow @nogc {
    id objc_getClass(const(char)* name);
    SEL sel_registerName(const(char)* name);
    void objc_msgSend();
    void* objc_autoreleasePoolPush();
    void objc_autoreleasePoolPop(void* pool);
    int CGAssociateMouseAndMouseCursorPosition(int isConnected);
    extern __gshared id NSDefaultRunLoopMode;
}

R send(R = id, Args...)(id receiver, const(char)* selector, Args args) {
    alias Method = extern (C) R function(id, SEL, Args) nothrow @nogc;
    return (cast(Method) &objc_msgSend)(receiver, sel_registerName(selector), args);
}

Maybe!KeySym keySymOf(ushort code) {
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < KEY_CODES.length && KEY_CODES[index].code != code) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index < KEY_CODES.length) {
        return Maybe!KeySym.of(KEY_CODES[index].symbol);
    } else {
        return Maybe!KeySym.init;
    }
}

enum KeyAction : ubyte {
    released,
    pressed,
    repeated,
}

struct KeyEvent {
    KeySym symbol;
    KeyAction action;
}

struct WindowEvents {
    void delegate(KeyEvent key) onKey;
    void delegate(uint button) onButton;
    void delegate(double dx, double dy) onMotion;
}

struct CocoaWindow {
    id application;
    id window;
    id view;
    id layer;

    bool open(uint width, uint height) {
        void* pool = objc_autoreleasePoolPush();
        application = send(objc_getClass("NSApplication"), "sharedApplication");
        send!void(application, "setActivationPolicy:", NS_ACTIVATION_POLICY_REGULAR);
        send!void(application, "finishLaunching");
        CGRect frame = CGRect(CGPoint(0, 0), CGSize(width, height));
        ulong style = NS_WINDOW_TITLED | NS_WINDOW_CLOSABLE | NS_WINDOW_MINIATURIZABLE | NS_WINDOW_RESIZABLE;
        window = send(send(objc_getClass("NSWindow"), "alloc"), "initWithContentRect:styleMask:backing:defer:", frame, style, NS_BACKING_STORE_BUFFERED, false);
        if (window !is null) {
            send!void(window, "setReleasedWhenClosed:", false);
            send!void(window, "setAcceptsMouseMovedEvents:", true);
            send!void(window, "center");
            view = send(window, "contentView");
            layer = send(send(objc_getClass("CAMetalLayer"), "layer"), "retain");
            send!void(view, "setLayer:", layer);
            send!void(view, "setWantsLayer:", true);
            send!void(window, "makeKeyAndOrderFront:", null);
            send!void(application, "activateIgnoringOtherApps:", true);
        }
        objc_autoreleasePoolPop(pool);
        return window !is null;
    }

    const(CAMetalLayer)* metalLayer() const {
        return cast(const(CAMetalLayer)*) layer;
    }

    bool isOpen() {
        return send!bool(window, "isVisible");
    }

    bool isFocused() {
        return send!bool(window, "isKeyWindow");
    }

    void setTitle(const(char)* title) {
        void* pool = objc_autoreleasePoolPush();
        send!void(window, "setTitle:", send(objc_getClass("NSString"), "stringWithUTF8String:", title));
        objc_autoreleasePoolPop(pool);
    }

    void capturePointer() {
        CGAssociateMouseAndMouseCursorPosition(0);
        send!void(objc_getClass("NSCursor"), "hide");
    }

    void releasePointer() {
        CGAssociateMouseAndMouseCursorPosition(1);
        send!void(objc_getClass("NSCursor"), "unhide");
    }

    void poll(WindowEvents events) {
        void* pool = objc_autoreleasePoolPush();
        id past = send(objc_getClass("NSDate"), "distantPast");
        id event = send(application, "nextEventMatchingMask:untilDate:inMode:dequeue:", NS_EVENT_MASK_ANY, past, NSDefaultRunLoopMode, true);
        while (event !is null) {
            bool handled = handle(event, events);
            if (!handled) {
                send!void(application, "sendEvent:", event);
            }
            event = send(application, "nextEventMatchingMask:untilDate:inMode:dequeue:", NS_EVENT_MASK_ANY, past, NSDefaultRunLoopMode, true);
        }
        send!void(application, "updateWindows");
        objc_autoreleasePoolPop(pool);
    }

    bool handle(id event, WindowEvents events) {
        ulong type = send!ulong(event, "type");
        bool isKey = type == NS_EVENT_KEY_DOWN || type == NS_EVENT_KEY_UP;
        if (isKey) {
            passKey(event, type, events);
        } else {
            observe(event, type, events);
        }
        return isKey;
    }

    void passKey(id event, ulong type, WindowEvents events) {
        Maybe!KeySym symbol = keySymOf(send!ushort(event, "keyCode"));
        if (symbol.exists) {
            KeyAction action = KeyAction.released;
            if (type == NS_EVENT_KEY_DOWN) {
                bool repeat = send!bool(event, "isARepeat");
                if (repeat) {
                    action = KeyAction.repeated;
                } else {
                    action = KeyAction.pressed;
                }
            }
            events.onKey(KeyEvent(symbol.value, action));
        }
    }

    void observe(id event, ulong type, WindowEvents events) {
        if (type == NS_EVENT_FLAGS_CHANGED) {
            ushort code = send!ushort(event, "keyCode");
            if (code == LEFT_SHIFT_KEYCODE) {
                ulong modifiers = send!ulong(event, "modifierFlags");
                KeyAction action = KeyAction.released;
                if ((modifiers & LEFT_SHIFT_DEVICE_MASK) != 0) {
                    action = KeyAction.pressed;
                }
                events.onKey(KeyEvent(XK_Shift_L, action));
            }
        } else if (type == NS_EVENT_LEFT_MOUSE_DOWN) {
            passButton(event, Button1, events);
        } else if (type == NS_EVENT_RIGHT_MOUSE_DOWN) {
            passButton(event, Button3, events);
        } else if (type == NS_EVENT_MOUSE_MOVED || type == NS_EVENT_LEFT_MOUSE_DRAGGED || type == NS_EVENT_RIGHT_MOUSE_DRAGGED || type == NS_EVENT_OTHER_MOUSE_DRAGGED) {
            events.onMotion(send!double(event, "deltaX"), send!double(event, "deltaY"));
        }
    }

    void passButton(id event, uint button, WindowEvents events) {
        bool inContent = isInContent(event);
        if (inContent) {
            events.onButton(button);
        }
    }

    bool isInContent(id event) {
        id owner = send(event, "window");
        id hit = send(view, "hitTest:", send!CGPoint(event, "locationInWindow"));
        return owner is window && hit is view;
    }

    void close() {
        send!void(window, "close");
        send!void(layer, "release");
        send!void(window, "release");
    }
}

/// file: source/client/config.d
module client.config;

import core.stdc.stdlib : strtof;
import core.stdc.string : strlen;
import base.numbers : clamped;
import base.stdio : FILE, fclose, fgets, fopen;
import base.units : Angle, AngularSpeed, Length, Ratio;

enum size_t CONFIG_LINE_CAPACITY = 256;

enum PitchAxis : ubyte {
    normal,
    inverted,
}

float pitchSign(PitchAxis axis) {
    if (axis == PitchAxis.inverted) {
        return -1.0f;
    } else {
        return 1.0f;
    }
}

struct ClientConfig {
    Angle mouseTurnPerCount = Angle(0.001f);
    AngularSpeed keyTurnRate = AngularSpeed(1.5f);
    Length reach = Length(0.5f);
    Ratio comfort = Ratio(1);
    PitchAxis pitchAxis;

    static ClientConfig fromFile(const(char)* path) {
        ClientConfig config;
        FILE* file = fopen(path, "r");
        if (file is null) {
            return config;
        } else {
            char[CONFIG_LINE_CAPACITY] line;
            const(char)* read = fgets(line.ptr, cast(int) line.length, file);
            while (read !is null) {
                config.apply(ConfigEntry.fromLine(line[0 .. strlen(line.ptr)]));
                read = fgets(line.ptr, cast(int) line.length, file);
            }
            fclose(file);
            return config;
        }
    }

    void apply(ConfigEntry entry) {
        if (entry.key == "mouse_sensitivity") {
            mouseTurnPerCount = Angle(strtof(entry.value.ptr, null));
        } else if (entry.key == "turn_speed") {
            keyTurnRate = AngularSpeed(strtof(entry.value.ptr, null));
        } else if (entry.key == "reach") {
            reach = Length(strtof(entry.value.ptr, null));
        } else if (entry.key == "comfort") {
            comfort = Ratio(clamped(strtof(entry.value.ptr, null), 0.0f, 1.0f));
        } else if (entry.key == "invert_y") {
            pitchAxis = PitchAxis.normal;
            if (entry.value == "1" || entry.value == "true" || entry.value == "yes" || entry.value == "on") {
                pitchAxis = PitchAxis.inverted;
            }
        }
    }
}

struct ConfigEntry {
    const(char)[] key;
    const(char)[] value;

    static ConfigEntry fromLine(const(char)[] line) {
        const(char)[] trimmed = trim(line);
        size_t equals = 0;
        while (equals < trimmed.length && trimmed[equals] != '=') {
            equals += 1;
        }
        if (equals < trimmed.length && trimmed[0] != '#') {
            return ConfigEntry(trim(trimmed[0 .. equals]), trim(trimmed[equals + 1 .. $]));
        } else {
            return ConfigEntry.init;
        }
    }
}

bool isSpace(char c) {
    return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n';
}

const(char)[] trim(const(char)[] text) {
    size_t start = 0;
    size_t end = text.length;
    while (start < end && isSpace(text[start])) {
        start += 1;
    }
    while (end > start && isSpace(text[end - 1])) {
        end -= 1;
    }
    return text[start .. end];
}

/// file: source/client/drive.d
module client.drive;

import core.stdc.stdio : FILE, fflush, fprintf;
import core.sys.posix.sys.stat : mkdir;
import base.array : Array;
import base.clock : MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND;
import base.flags : Readiness;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.names : textFor;
import client.frames : FrameRecord, FrameSummary, MouseCounts, MouseMotion, RenderTimes, cameraStep;
import client.images : ImageDifference, PixelOrder, RGBA_BYTES, copyAsRgba, differenceOf;
import client.png : writePng;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.position : Position;
import plugins.api.flags : Flags;

enum uint LEFT_BUTTON = 1;
enum uint RIGHT_BUTTON = 3;
enum uint DIRECTORY_MODE = 0x1ED;
enum string CAPTURE_DIRECTORY = "screenshots";

enum DriveKey : ubyte {
    w,
    a,
    s,
    d,
    space,
    shift,
    v,
    n,
    left,
    right,
    up,
    down,
    bracketLeft,
    bracketRight,
    escape,
    digit1,
    digit2,
    digit3,
    digit4,
    digit5,
    digit6,
    digit7,
    digit8,
    digit9,
}

enum DriveEventKind : ubyte {
    press,
    release,
    click,
}

struct DriveEvent {
    DriveEventKind kind;
    DriveKey key;
    uint button;
}

struct DriveInput {
    const(DriveEvent)[] events;
    double dx = 0;
    double dy = 0;
}

enum Toggle : ubyte {
    off,
    on,
}

enum DriveMark : ubyte {
    watching,
    logging,
    captureAsked,
    summaryAsked,
    settling,
    drawn,
    drawnImaged,
    waitingImage,
    finished,
    failed,
}

enum DriveActionKind : ubyte {
    frames,
    move,
    hold,
    release,
    tap,
    click,
    settle,
    capture,
    watch,
    log,
    summary,
}

struct DriveAction {
    DriveActionKind kind;
    uint frames;
    double dx = 0;
    double dy = 0;
    DriveKey key;
    uint button;
    string text;
    Toggle toggle;
}

struct NamedDrive {
    string name;
    immutable(DriveAction)[] actions;
}

DriveAction framesOf(uint count) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.frames, frames: count};
    return action;
}

DriveAction moveBy(double dx, double dy, uint count) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.move, frames: count, dx: dx, dy: dy};
    return action;
}

DriveAction holdKey(DriveKey key) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.hold, key: key};
    return action;
}

DriveAction releaseKey(DriveKey key) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.release, key: key};
    return action;
}

DriveAction tapKey(DriveKey key) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.tap, key: key};
    return action;
}

DriveAction clickButton(uint button) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.click, button: button};
    return action;
}

DriveAction settleWithin(uint limit) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.settle, frames: limit};
    return action;
}

DriveAction captureTo(string path) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.capture, text: path};
    return action;
}

DriveAction watching(Toggle toggle) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.watch, toggle: toggle};
    return action;
}

DriveAction logging(Toggle toggle) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.log, toggle: toggle};
    return action;
}

DriveAction summaryOf(string title) {
    DriveAction action = {kind: DriveActionKind.summary, text: title};
    return action;
}

struct DriveHost {
    const(DriveAction)[] actions;
    size_t nextAction;
    FILE* report;
    Array!DriveEvent events;
    Array!DriveEvent later;
    Array!char capturePath;
    Array!char summaryTitle;
    Array!char drawnPath;
    Array!char waitingPath;
    Array!ubyte previous;
    Array!ubyte current;
    MouseMotion motion;
    Position lastCamera;
    FrameRecord drawn;
    FrameRecord waiting;
    FrameSummary summary;
    Maybe!double lastNow;
    uint pendingFrames;
    uint frame;
    uint summaryFrame;
    Flags!DriveMark marks;

    bool isFailed() const {
        return marks.has(DriveMark.failed);
    }

    void start(const(char)* name, const(DriveAction)[] chosen, FILE* output, float sensitivity) {
        report = output;
        fprintf(report, "drive: %s, the mouse turns %g radians per count\n", name, cast(double) sensitivity);
        actions = chosen;
        mkdir(CAPTURE_DIRECTORY.ptr, DIRECTORY_MODE);
    }

    void fail(const(char)* message) {
        fprintf(report, "drive error: %s\n", message);
        marks.set(DriveMark.failed);
        marks.set(DriveMark.finished);
    }

    DriveInput next(Readiness world) {
        events.clear();
        events.appendAll(later.slice());
        later.clear();
        if (marks.has(DriveMark.settling) && world == Readiness.ready) {
            finishSettling("settled");
        }
        while (pendingFrames == 0 && !marks.has(DriveMark.finished)) {
            if (nextAction == actions.length) {
                marks.set(DriveMark.finished);
            } else {
                apply(actions[nextAction]);
                nextAction += 1;
            }
        }
        DriveInput input;
        if (pendingFrames > 0) {
            pendingFrames -= 1;
            if (motion.isActive()) {
                MouseCounts share = motion.next();
                input.dx = share.dx;
                input.dy = share.dy;
            }
            if (pendingFrames == 0 && marks.has(DriveMark.settling)) {
                finishSettling("not settled");
            }
        }
        input.events = events.slice();
        return input;
    }

    void apply(ref const DriveAction action) {
        final switch (action.kind) {
            case DriveActionKind.frames:
                pendingFrames = action.frames;
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.move:
                if (action.frames == 0) {
                    fail("mouse motion needs at least one frame");
                } else {
                    motion = MouseMotion.init;
                    motion.total = MouseCounts(action.dx, action.dy);
                    motion.steps = action.frames;
                    pendingFrames = action.frames;
                }
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.hold:
                events.append(DriveEvent(DriveEventKind.press, action.key));
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.release:
                events.append(DriveEvent(DriveEventKind.release, action.key));
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.tap:
                events.append(DriveEvent(DriveEventKind.press, action.key));
                later.append(DriveEvent(DriveEventKind.release, action.key));
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.click:
                if (action.button != LEFT_BUTTON && action.button != RIGHT_BUTTON) {
                    fail("the button is 1 (left) or 3 (right)");
                } else {
                    DriveEvent click = {kind: DriveEventKind.click, button: action.button};
                    events.append(click);
                }
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.settle:
                if (action.frames == 0) {
                    fail("settling needs at least one frame");
                } else {
                    marks.set(DriveMark.settling);
                    pendingFrames = action.frames;
                }
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.capture:
                capturePath.clear();
                capturePath.appendAll(action.text);
                marks.set(DriveMark.captureAsked);
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.watch:
                marks.put(DriveMark.watching, action.toggle == Toggle.on);
                if (action.toggle == Toggle.off) {
                    previous.clear();
                }
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.log:
                marks.put(DriveMark.logging, action.toggle == Toggle.on);
                break;
            case DriveActionKind.summary:
                askSummary(action.text);
                break;
        }
    }

    void finishSettling(immutable(char)* outcome) {
        pendingFrames = 0;
        marks.clear(DriveMark.settling);
        fprintf(report, "settle: %s at frame %u\n", outcome, frame);
    }

    void record(double now, double dt, double stepMs, DriveInput input, Position camera, ref const Graph graph) {
        if (!marks.has(DriveMark.finished)) {
            FrameRecord made;
            made.frame = frame;
            made.dtMs = dt * MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND;
            made.stepMs = stepMs;
            made.dx = input.dx;
            made.dy = input.dy;
            if (lastNow.exists) {
                made.intervalMs = Maybe!double.of((now - lastNow.value) * MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND);
                made.step = graph.cameraStep(lastCamera, camera);
            }
            lastNow = Maybe!double.of(now);
            lastCamera = camera;
            frame += 1;
            drawnPath.clear();
            if (marks.has(DriveMark.captureAsked)) {
                drawnPath.appendAll(capturePath.slice());
                marks.clear(DriveMark.captureAsked);
            }
            drawn = made;
            marks.set(DriveMark.drawn);
            marks.put(DriveMark.drawnImaged, marks.has(DriveMark.watching) || drawnPath.length > 0);
        }
    }

    bool wantsImage() const {
        return marks.has(DriveMark.drawn) && marks.has(DriveMark.drawnImaged);
    }

    bool isDone() const {
        return marks.has(DriveMark.finished) && !marks.has(DriveMark.drawn) && !marks.has(DriveMark.waitingImage);
    }

    void finishFrame(RenderTimes render, const(ubyte)[] image, uint width, uint height, PixelOrder order) {
        if (marks.has(DriveMark.waitingImage)) {
            takeImage(image, width, height, order);
            print(waiting);
            marks.clear(DriveMark.waitingImage);
        }
        if (marks.has(DriveMark.drawn)) {
            drawn.render = render;
            if (marks.has(DriveMark.drawnImaged)) {
                waiting = drawn;
                Array!char swapped = waitingPath;
                waitingPath = drawnPath;
                drawnPath = swapped;
                marks.set(DriveMark.waitingImage);
            } else {
                print(drawn);
            }
            marks.clear(DriveMark.drawn);
        }
    }

    void takeImage(const(ubyte)[] image, uint width, uint height, PixelOrder order) {
        if (image is null) {
            if (waitingPath.length > 0) {
                fprintf(report, "frame %u: not captured, the frame was not drawn or cannot be read back\n", waiting.frame);
            }
        } else {
            size_t pixels = cast(size_t) width * height;
            current.resize(pixels * RGBA_BYTES);
            copyAsRgba(current.slice(), image, order);
            if (marks.has(DriveMark.watching) && previous.length == current.length) {
                waiting.image = Maybe!ImageDifference.of(differenceOf(previous.slice(), current.slice(), RGBA_BYTES, pixels));
            }
            if (waitingPath.length > 0) {
                waitingPath.append('\0');
                bool written = writePng(waitingPath.ptr, width, height, current.slice());
                fprintf(report, "frame %u: %s %s\n", waiting.frame, textFor(written, "captured", "could not write"), waitingPath.ptr);
            }
            Array!ubyte swapped = previous;
            previous = current;
            current = swapped;
        }
    }

    void print(ref const FrameRecord made) {
        if (marks.has(DriveMark.summaryAsked) && made.frame >= summaryFrame) {
            printSummary();
        }
        if (marks.has(DriveMark.logging)) {
            made.print(report);
        }
        summary.add(made);
    }

    void askSummary(const(char)[] title) {
        if (marks.has(DriveMark.summaryAsked)) {
            printSummary();
        }
        summaryTitle.clear();
        summaryTitle.appendAll(title);
        summaryFrame = frame;
        marks.set(DriveMark.summaryAsked);
    }

    void printSummary() {
        fprintf(report, "== %.*s\n", cast(int) summaryTitle.length, summaryTitle.ptr);
        summary.print(report);
        summary = FrameSummary.init;
        marks.clear(DriveMark.summaryAsked);
    }

    void finish() {
        if (marks.has(DriveMark.summaryAsked)) {
            printSummary();
        }
        fprintf(report, "== after the last summary\n");
        summary.print(report);
        summaryTitle.release();
        fflush(report);
        events.release();
        later.release();
        capturePath.release();
        drawnPath.release();
        waitingPath.release();
        previous.release();
        current.release();
    }
}

/// file: source/client/font.d
module client.font;

import core.stdc.math : ceilf, fabsf, floorf, sqrtf;
import base.array : Array;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;

immutable ubyte[] PLEX_MONO = cast(immutable(ubyte)[]) import("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf");

enum uint TRUETYPE_VERSION = 0x00010000;
enum size_t DIRECTORY_TABLE_COUNT = 4;
enum size_t DIRECTORY_RECORDS = 12;
enum size_t TABLE_RECORD_SIZE = 16;
enum size_t TABLE_RECORD_OFFSET = 8;
enum size_t TAG_SIZE = 4;
enum size_t HEAD_UNITS_PER_EM = 18;
enum size_t HEAD_INDEX_TO_LOC_FORMAT = 50;
enum size_t MAXP_GLYPH_COUNT = 4;
enum size_t HHEA_ASCENDER = 4;
enum size_t HHEA_DESCENDER = 6;
enum size_t HHEA_LINE_GAP = 8;
enum size_t HHEA_HORIZONTAL_METRICS = 34;
enum size_t HORIZONTAL_METRIC_SIZE = 4;
enum size_t CMAP_TABLE_COUNT = 2;
enum size_t CMAP_RECORDS = 4;
enum size_t ENCODING_RECORD_SIZE = 8;
enum size_t ENCODING_SUBTABLE_OFFSET = 4;
enum ushort SEGMENT_FORMAT = 4;
enum size_t SEGMENT_COUNT_DOUBLED = 6;
enum size_t SEGMENT_END_CODES = 14;
enum size_t SEGMENT_RESERVED_PAD = 2;
enum size_t GLYPH_HEADER_SIZE = 10;
enum size_t GLYPH_X_MIN = 2;
enum size_t GLYPH_Y_MIN = 4;
enum size_t GLYPH_X_MAX = 6;
enum size_t GLYPH_Y_MAX = 8;
enum ubyte ON_CURVE_POINT = 0x01;
enum ubyte X_SHORT_VECTOR = 0x02;
enum ubyte Y_SHORT_VECTOR = 0x04;
enum ubyte REPEAT_FLAG = 0x08;
enum ubyte X_IS_SAME_OR_POSITIVE = 0x10;
enum ubyte Y_IS_SAME_OR_POSITIVE = 0x20;
enum ushort ARG_1_AND_2_ARE_WORDS = 0x0001;
enum ushort ARGS_ARE_XY_VALUES = 0x0002;
enum ushort WE_HAVE_A_SCALE = 0x0008;
enum ushort MORE_COMPONENTS = 0x0020;
enum ushort WE_HAVE_AN_X_AND_Y_SCALE = 0x0040;
enum ushort WE_HAVE_A_TWO_BY_TWO = 0x0080;
enum float F2DOT14_ONE = 1 << 14;
enum float FLATTEN_TOLERANCE = 0.05f;
enum uint SUMMED_COLUMNS = 2;
enum float FULL_COVERAGE = 255;

enum LocaFormat : ubyte {
    halved,
    full,
}

ushort readU16(const(ubyte)[] bytes, size_t at) {
    return cast(ushort)((bytes[at] << 8) | bytes[at + 1]);
}

short readI16(const(ubyte)[] bytes, size_t at) {
    return cast(short) readU16(bytes, at);
}

uint readU32(const(ubyte)[] bytes, size_t at) {
    return (cast(uint) bytes[at] << 24) | (cast(uint) bytes[at + 1] << 16) | (cast(uint) bytes[at + 2] << 8) | bytes[at + 3];
}

float readF2Dot14(const(ubyte)[] bytes, size_t at) {
    return readI16(bytes, at) / F2DOT14_ONE;
}

size_t tableAt(const(ubyte)[] bytes, string tag) {
    size_t count = readU16(bytes, DIRECTORY_TABLE_COUNT);
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < count && bytes[recordAt(index) .. recordAt(index) + TAG_SIZE] != cast(const(ubyte)[]) tag) {
        index += 1;
    }
    assert(index < count);
    return readU32(bytes, recordAt(index) + TABLE_RECORD_OFFSET);
}

size_t recordAt(size_t index) {
    return DIRECTORY_RECORDS + index * TABLE_RECORD_SIZE;
}

size_t subtableAt(const(ubyte)[] bytes, size_t cmap, size_t index) {
    return cmap + readU32(bytes, cmap + CMAP_RECORDS + index * ENCODING_RECORD_SIZE + ENCODING_SUBTABLE_OFFSET);
}

size_t segmentSubtable(const(ubyte)[] bytes, size_t cmap) {
    size_t count = readU16(bytes, cmap + CMAP_TABLE_COUNT);
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < count && readU16(bytes, subtableAt(bytes, cmap, index)) != SEGMENT_FORMAT) {
        index += 1;
    }
    assert(index < count);
    return subtableAt(bytes, cmap, index);
}

LocaFormat locaFormatOf(short stored) {
    if (stored == 0) {
        return LocaFormat.halved;
    } else {
        assert(stored == 1);
        return LocaFormat.full;
    }
}

struct GlyphBounds {
    short xMin;
    short yMin;
    short xMax;
    short yMax;
}

struct Font {
    const(ubyte)[] bytes;
    size_t glyf;
    size_t loca;
    size_t hmtx;
    size_t segments;
    ushort unitsPerEm;
    ushort glyphCount;
    ushort horizontalMetrics;
    short ascender;
    short descender;
    short lineGap;
    LocaFormat locaFormat;

    static Font make(const(ubyte)[] bytes) {
        assert(readU32(bytes, 0) == TRUETYPE_VERSION);
        size_t head = bytes.tableAt("head");
        size_t hhea = bytes.tableAt("hhea");
        size_t maxp = bytes.tableAt("maxp");
        return Font(
            bytes,
            bytes.tableAt("glyf"),
            bytes.tableAt("loca"),
            bytes.tableAt("hmtx"),
            bytes.segmentSubtable(bytes.tableAt("cmap")),
            readU16(bytes, head + HEAD_UNITS_PER_EM),
            readU16(bytes, maxp + MAXP_GLYPH_COUNT),
            readU16(bytes, hhea + HHEA_HORIZONTAL_METRICS),
            readI16(bytes, hhea + HHEA_ASCENDER),
            readI16(bytes, hhea + HHEA_DESCENDER),
            readI16(bytes, hhea + HHEA_LINE_GAP),
            locaFormatOf(readI16(bytes, head + HEAD_INDEX_TO_LOC_FORMAT)),
        );
    }
}

ushort glyphOf(ref const Font font, uint code) {
    const(ubyte)[] bytes = font.bytes;
    size_t segmentCount = readU16(bytes, font.segments + SEGMENT_COUNT_DOUBLED) / 2;
    size_t ends = font.segments + SEGMENT_END_CODES;
    size_t starts = ends + 2 * segmentCount + SEGMENT_RESERVED_PAD;
    size_t deltas = starts + 2 * segmentCount;
    size_t rangeOffsets = deltas + 2 * segmentCount;
    size_t segment = 0;
    while (segment < segmentCount && readU16(bytes, ends + 2 * segment) < code) {
        segment += 1;
    }
    assert(segment < segmentCount);
    uint start = readU16(bytes, starts + 2 * segment);
    ushort delta = readU16(bytes, deltas + 2 * segment);
    size_t rangeOffsetAt = rangeOffsets + 2 * segment;
    uint rangeOffset = readU16(bytes, rangeOffsetAt);
    if (start > code) {
        return 0;
    } else if (rangeOffset == 0) {
        return cast(ushort)(code + delta);
    } else {
        ushort found = readU16(bytes, rangeOffsetAt + rangeOffset + 2 * (code - start));
        if (found == 0) {
            return 0;
        } else {
            return cast(ushort)(found + delta);
        }
    }
}

size_t glyphStart(ref const Font font, uint glyph) {
    final switch (font.locaFormat) {
        case LocaFormat.halved:
            return 2 * cast(size_t) readU16(font.bytes, font.loca + 2 * glyph);
        case LocaFormat.full:
            return readU32(font.bytes, font.loca + 4 * glyph);
    }
}

bool hasOutline(ref const Font font, ushort glyph) {
    return font.glyphStart(glyph + 1) > font.glyphStart(glyph);
}

Maybe!GlyphBounds boundsOf(ref const Font font, ushort glyph) {
    if (font.hasOutline(glyph)) {
        size_t at = font.glyf + font.glyphStart(glyph);
        return Maybe!GlyphBounds.of(GlyphBounds(readI16(font.bytes, at + GLYPH_X_MIN), readI16(font.bytes, at + GLYPH_Y_MIN), readI16(font.bytes, at + GLYPH_X_MAX), readI16(font.bytes, at + GLYPH_Y_MAX)));
    } else {
        return Maybe!GlyphBounds.init;
    }
}

ushort advanceOf(ref const Font font, ushort glyph) {
    size_t index = lowerOf(cast(size_t) glyph, cast(size_t) font.horizontalMetrics - 1);
    return readU16(font.bytes, font.hmtx + index * HORIZONTAL_METRIC_SIZE);
}

struct Transform {
    float xFromX = 1;
    float xFromY = 0;
    float yFromX = 0;
    float yFromY = 1;
    float dx = 0;
    float dy = 0;
}

Transform after(Transform outer, Transform inner) {
    return Transform(
        outer.xFromX * inner.xFromX + outer.xFromY * inner.yFromX,
        outer.xFromX * inner.xFromY + outer.xFromY * inner.yFromY,
        outer.yFromX * inner.xFromX + outer.yFromY * inner.yFromX,
        outer.yFromX * inner.xFromY + outer.yFromY * inner.yFromY,
        outer.xFromX * inner.dx + outer.xFromY * inner.dy + outer.dx,
        outer.yFromX * inner.dx + outer.yFromY * inner.dy + outer.dy,
    );
}

struct OutlinePoint {
    float x;
    float y;
    ubyte flags;
}

bool isOnCurve(OutlinePoint point) {
    return (point.flags & ON_CURVE_POINT) != 0;
}

struct Outline {
    Array!OutlinePoint points;
    Array!uint ends;

    void clear() {
        points.clear();
        ends.clear();
    }

    void release() {
        points.release();
        ends.release();
    }
}

void addGlyph(ref const Font font, ushort glyph, Transform transform, ref Outline outline) {
    if (font.hasOutline(glyph)) {
        size_t at = font.glyf + font.glyphStart(glyph);
        short contours = readI16(font.bytes, at);
        if (contours >= 0) {
            addSimpleGlyph(font.bytes, at, contours, transform, outline);
        } else {
            font.addCompositeGlyph(at, transform, outline);
        }
    }
}

int coordinateDelta(const(ubyte)[] bytes, ref size_t cursor, ubyte flags, ubyte shortVector, ubyte sameOrPositive) {
    if ((flags & shortVector) != 0) {
        int magnitude = bytes[cursor];
        cursor += 1;
        if ((flags & sameOrPositive) != 0) {
            return magnitude;
        } else {
            return -magnitude;
        }
    } else if ((flags & sameOrPositive) != 0) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        int delta = readI16(bytes, cursor);
        cursor += 2;
        return delta;
    }
}

void addSimpleGlyph(const(ubyte)[] bytes, size_t at, short contours, Transform transform, ref Outline outline) {
    size_t endPoints = at + GLYPH_HEADER_SIZE;
    size_t pointCount = 0;
    if (contours > 0) {
        pointCount = readU16(bytes, endPoints + 2 * (contours - 1)) + 1;
    }
    size_t instructions = endPoints + 2 * contours;
    size_t cursor = instructions + 2 + readU16(bytes, instructions);
    size_t first = outline.points.length;
    outline.points.resize(first + pointCount);
    OutlinePoint[] points = outline.points.slice()[first .. $];
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < pointCount) {
        ubyte flags = bytes[cursor];
        cursor += 1;
        size_t repeats = 0;
        if ((flags & REPEAT_FLAG) != 0) {
            repeats = bytes[cursor];
            cursor += 1;
        }
        foreach (_; 0 .. repeats + 1) {
            points[index].flags = flags;
            index += 1;
        }
    }
    int x = 0;
    foreach (ref point; points) {
        x += coordinateDelta(bytes, cursor, point.flags, X_SHORT_VECTOR, X_IS_SAME_OR_POSITIVE);
        point.x = x;
    }
    int y = 0;
    foreach (ref point; points) {
        y += coordinateDelta(bytes, cursor, point.flags, Y_SHORT_VECTOR, Y_IS_SAME_OR_POSITIVE);
        point.y = y;
    }
    foreach (ref point; points) {
        float fontX = point.x;
        float fontY = point.y;
        point.x = transform.xFromX * fontX + transform.xFromY * fontY + transform.dx;
        point.y = transform.yFromX * fontX + transform.yFromY * fontY + transform.dy;
    }
    foreach (contour; 0 .. contours) {
        outline.ends.append(cast(uint)(first + readU16(bytes, endPoints + 2 * contour) + 1));
    }
}

void addCompositeGlyph(ref const Font font, size_t at, Transform transform, ref Outline outline) {
    const(ubyte)[] bytes = font.bytes;
    size_t cursor = at + GLYPH_HEADER_SIZE;
    ushort flags;
    do {
        flags = readU16(bytes, cursor);
        ushort component = readU16(bytes, cursor + 2);
        cursor += 4;
        assert((flags & ARGS_ARE_XY_VALUES) != 0);
        Transform part;
        if ((flags & ARG_1_AND_2_ARE_WORDS) != 0) {
            part.dx = readI16(bytes, cursor);
            part.dy = readI16(bytes, cursor + 2);
            cursor += 4;
        } else {
            part.dx = cast(byte) bytes[cursor];
            part.dy = cast(byte) bytes[cursor + 1];
            cursor += 2;
        }
        if ((flags & WE_HAVE_A_SCALE) != 0) {
            part.xFromX = readF2Dot14(bytes, cursor);
            part.yFromY = part.xFromX;
            cursor += 2;
        } else if ((flags & WE_HAVE_AN_X_AND_Y_SCALE) != 0) {
            part.xFromX = readF2Dot14(bytes, cursor);
            part.yFromY = readF2Dot14(bytes, cursor + 2);
            cursor += 4;
        } else if ((flags & WE_HAVE_A_TWO_BY_TWO) != 0) {
            part.xFromX = readF2Dot14(bytes, cursor);
            part.yFromX = readF2Dot14(bytes, cursor + 2);
            part.xFromY = readF2Dot14(bytes, cursor + 4);
            part.yFromY = readF2Dot14(bytes, cursor + 6);
            cursor += 8;
        }
        font.addGlyph(component, transform.after(part), outline);
    } while ((flags & MORE_COMPONENTS) != 0);
}

struct PixelPoint {
    float x;
    float y;
}

struct Segment {
    PixelPoint from;
    PixelPoint to;
}

struct PixelBox {
    int left;
    int top;
    uint width;
    uint height;
}

PixelBox pixelBoxOf(GlyphBounds bounds, float scale) {
    int left = cast(int) floorf(bounds.xMin * scale);
    int top = cast(int) floorf(-bounds.yMax * scale);
    int right = cast(int) ceilf(bounds.xMax * scale);
    int bottom = cast(int) ceilf(-bounds.yMin * scale);
    return PixelBox(left, top, right - left, bottom - top);
}

struct PixelFrame {
    float scale;
    float left;
    float top;

    PixelPoint place(OutlinePoint point) const {
        return PixelPoint(point.x * scale - left, -point.y * scale - top);
    }
}

PixelPoint midpoint(PixelPoint a, PixelPoint b) {
    return PixelPoint((a.x + b.x) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2);
}

void flatten(ref const Outline outline, PixelFrame frame, ref Array!Segment segments) {
    uint first = 0;
    foreach (end; outline.ends.slice()) {
        flattenContour(outline.points.slice()[first .. end], frame, segments);
        first = end;
    }
}

void flattenContour(const(OutlinePoint)[] points, PixelFrame frame, ref Array!Segment segments) {
    size_t count = points.length;
    if (count > 1) {
        size_t startIndex = 0;
        while (startIndex < count && !points[startIndex].isOnCurve) {
            startIndex += 1;
        }
        PixelPoint start;
        size_t steps = count - 1;
        if (startIndex < count) {
            start = frame.place(points[startIndex]);
        } else {
            start = midpoint(frame.place(points[0]), frame.place(points[1]));
            startIndex = 0;
            steps = count;
        }
        PixelPoint current = start;
        Maybe!PixelPoint control;
        foreach (step; 1 .. steps + 1) {
            OutlinePoint point = points[(startIndex + step) % count];
            PixelPoint placed = frame.place(point);
            if (point.isOnCurve) {
                addCurve(segments, current, control, placed);
                current = placed;
                control = Maybe!PixelPoint.init;
            } else if (control.exists) {
                PixelPoint between = midpoint(control.value, placed);
                addCurve(segments, current, control, between);
                current = between;
                control = Maybe!PixelPoint.of(placed);
            } else {
                control = Maybe!PixelPoint.of(placed);
            }
        }
        addCurve(segments, current, control, start);
    }
}

void addCurve(ref Array!Segment segments, PixelPoint from, Maybe!PixelPoint control, PixelPoint to) {
    if (control.exists) {
        addQuadratic(segments, from, control.value, to);
    } else {
        segments.append(Segment(from, to));
    }
}

void addQuadratic(ref Array!Segment segments, PixelPoint from, PixelPoint control, PixelPoint to) {
    float bendX = from.x - 2 * control.x + to.x;
    float bendY = from.y - 2 * control.y + to.y;
    float bend = sqrtf(bendX * bendX + bendY * bendY);
    uint pieces = higherOf(1u, cast(uint) ceilf(sqrtf(bend / (4 * FLATTEN_TOLERANCE))));
    PixelPoint previous = from;
    foreach (piece; 1 .. pieces + 1) {
        float t = cast(float) piece / pieces;
        float u = 1 - t;
        PixelPoint next = PixelPoint(u * u * from.x + 2 * t * u * control.x + t * t * to.x, u * u * from.y + 2 * t * u * control.y + t * t * to.y);
        segments.append(Segment(previous, next));
        previous = next;
    }
}

struct Raster {
    Array!float accumulation;
    uint stride;
    uint height;

    void begin(uint width, uint rows) {
        stride = width + SUMMED_COLUMNS;
        height = rows;
        accumulation.resize(cast(size_t) stride * height);
        accumulation.slice()[] = 0;
    }

    void fill(const(Segment)[] segments) {
        foreach (segment; segments) {
            addSegment(segment);
        }
    }

    void addSegment(Segment segment) {
        if (segment.from.y != segment.to.y) {
            float direction = 1;
            PixelPoint upper = segment.from;
            PixelPoint lower = segment.to;
            if (segment.from.y > segment.to.y) {
                direction = -1;
                upper = segment.to;
                lower = segment.from;
            }
            float slope = (lower.x - upper.x) / (lower.y - upper.y);
            int firstRow = higherOf(cast(int) floorf(upper.y), 0);
            int endRow = lowerOf(cast(int) ceilf(lower.y), cast(int) height);
            foreach (row; firstRow .. endRow) {
                float rowTop = higherOf(cast(float) row, upper.y);
                float rowBottom = lowerOf(cast(float) row + 1, lower.y);
                if (rowBottom > rowTop) {
                    addRowPiece(row, upper.x + (rowTop - upper.y) * slope, upper.x + (rowBottom - upper.y) * slope, (rowBottom - rowTop) * direction);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void addRowPiece(int row, float fromX, float toX, float rise) {
        float low = lowerOf(fromX, toX);
        float high = higherOf(fromX, toX);
        float span = high - low;
        int firstColumn = cast(int) floorf(low);
        int lastColumn = cast(int) floorf(high);
        if (span == 0 || firstColumn == lastColumn) {
            addCell(row, firstColumn, (low + high) / 2, rise);
        } else {
            foreach (column; firstColumn .. lastColumn + 1) {
                float left = higherOf(low, cast(float) column);
                float right = lowerOf(high, cast(float) column + 1);
                if (right > left) {
                    addCell(row, column, (left + right) / 2, rise * (right - left) / span);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void addCell(int row, int column, float middle, float rise) {
        int cell = lowerOf(higherOf(column, 0), cast(int) stride - SUMMED_COLUMNS);
        float inside = middle - cell;
        size_t at = cast(size_t) row * stride + cell;
        accumulation.ptr[at] += rise * (1 - inside);
        accumulation.ptr[at + 1] += rise * inside;
    }

    void writeCoverage(uint width, ubyte[] target, size_t targetStride, size_t targetStart) const {
        foreach (row; 0 .. height) {
            float sum = 0;
            foreach (column; 0 .. width) {
                sum += accumulation.ptr[cast(size_t) row * stride + column];
                target[targetStart + row * targetStride + column] = cast(ubyte)(lowerOf(fabsf(sum), 1.0f) * FULL_COVERAGE + 0.5f);
            }
        }
    }

    void release() {
        accumulation.release();
    }
}

module client.frames;

import core.math : sqrt;
import core.stdc.math : atan2, fabs, round;
import core.stdc.stdio : FILE, fprintf;
import base.clock : MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND, PhaseTimes;
import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import client.images : ImageDifference;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.position : Position;
import geometry.honeycomb : FACE_COUNT, Face, mirror;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Point;

immutable double[2] LATE_INTERVALS_MS = [20, 34];
enum double MOVING_DISTANCE = 1e-6;

struct CameraStep {
    double turned = 0;
    double moved = 0;
}

struct RenderTimes {
    double totalMs = 0;
    double fenceMs = 0;
    double updateMs = 0;
    double acquireMs = 0;
    double presentMs = 0;
    double gpuMs = 0;
}

struct FrameRecord {
    uint frame;
    Maybe!double intervalMs;
    double dtMs = 0;
    double stepMs = 0;
    RenderTimes render;
    double dx = 0;
    double dy = 0;
    Maybe!CameraStep step;
    Maybe!ImageDifference image;

    void print(FILE* report) const {
        fprintf(report, "frame %u:", frame);
        if (intervalMs.exists) {
            fprintf(report, " interval %.2fms", intervalMs.value);
        } else {
            fprintf(report, " first frame");
        }
        fprintf(report, " dt %.2fms step %.2fms render %.2fms (fence %.2f update %.2f present %.2f, gpu %.2f) input %+.0f %+.0f", dtMs, stepMs, render.totalMs, render.fenceMs, render.updateMs, render.presentMs, render.gpuMs, dx, dy);
        if (step.exists) {
            fprintf(report, " turned %.5f moved %.5f", step.value.turned, step.value.moved);
        } else {
            fprintf(report, " camera step unknown");
        }
        if (image.exists) {
            fprintf(report, " image changed %.4f mean %.2f largest %d", image.value.changed, image.value.meanDelta, image.value.largestDelta);
        }
        fprintf(report, "\n");
    }
}

struct MouseCounts {
    double dx = 0;
    double dy = 0;
}

struct MouseMotion {
    MouseCounts total;
    MouseCounts sent;
    uint steps;
    uint done;

    bool isActive() const {
        return done < steps;
    }

    MouseCounts next() {
        done += 1;
        MouseCounts target = MouseCounts(round(total.dx * done / steps), round(total.dy * done / steps));
        MouseCounts share = MouseCounts(target.dx - sent.dx, target.dy - sent.dy);
        sent = target;
        return share;
    }
}

struct FrameSummary {
    PhaseTimes step;
    PhaseTimes render;
    PhaseTimes fence;
    PhaseTimes update;
    PhaseTimes acquire;
    PhaseTimes present;
    PhaseTimes gpu;
    double turnedTotal = 0;
    double countsTotal = 0;
    uint frames;
    uint[LATE_INTERVALS_MS.length] late;
    uint moving;
    uint imaged;
    uint stillImages;
    double intervalTotalMs = 0;
    double worstIntervalMs = 0;
    double stepErrorTotalMs = 0;
    double worstStepErrorMs = 0;
    double slowestSpeed = 0;
    double fastestSpeed = 0;
    double speedTotal = 0;

    void add(ref const FrameRecord record) {
        step.add(record.stepMs);
        render.add(record.render.totalMs);
        fence.add(record.render.fenceMs);
        update.add(record.render.updateMs);
        acquire.add(record.render.acquireMs);
        present.add(record.render.presentMs);
        gpu.add(record.render.gpuMs);
        if (record.step.exists) {
            turnedTotal += record.step.value.turned;
        }
        countsTotal += sqrt(record.dx * record.dx + record.dy * record.dy);
        if (record.intervalMs.exists) {
            double interval = record.intervalMs.value;
            frames += 1;
            intervalTotalMs += interval;
            worstIntervalMs = higherOf(interval, worstIntervalMs);
            foreach (index, limit; LATE_INTERVALS_MS) {
                if (interval > limit) {
                    late[index] += 1;
                }
            }
            double error = fabs(record.dtMs - interval);
            stepErrorTotalMs += error;
            worstStepErrorMs = higherOf(error, worstStepErrorMs);
            if (record.step.exists && record.step.value.moved > MOVING_DISTANCE && interval > 0) {
                double speed = record.step.value.moved / (interval / MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND);
                if (moving == 0) {
                    slowestSpeed = speed;
                }
                moving += 1;
                speedTotal += speed;
                slowestSpeed = lowerOf(speed, slowestSpeed);
                fastestSpeed = higherOf(speed, fastestSpeed);
            }
        }
        if (record.image.exists) {
            imaged += 1;
            if (record.image.value.changed == 0) {
                stillImages += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    void print(FILE* report) const {
        if (frames == 0) {
            fprintf(report, "frames: none timed\n");
        } else {
            fprintf(report, "frames: %u, interval avg %.2fms worst %.2fms, %u over %.0fms, %u over %.0fms\n", frames, intervalTotalMs / frames, worstIntervalMs, late[0], LATE_INTERVALS_MS[0], late[1], LATE_INTERVALS_MS[1]);
            fprintf(report, "frames: stepped dt against the wall interval, avg off %.2fms, worst off %.2fms\n", stepErrorTotalMs / frames, worstStepErrorMs);
        }
        fprintf(report, "frames: avg/worst ms step %.2f/%.2f render %.2f/%.2f (fence %.2f/%.2f update %.2f/%.2f present %.2f/%.2f of which acquire %.2f/%.2f, gpu %.2f/%.2f)\n", step.averageMs(), step.worstMs, render.averageMs(), render.worstMs, fence.averageMs(), fence.worstMs, update.averageMs(), update.worstMs, present.averageMs(), present.worstMs, acquire.averageMs(), acquire.worstMs, gpu.averageMs(), gpu.worstMs);
        fprintf(report, "frames: turned %.5f radians in all for %.0f mouse counts\n", turnedTotal, countsTotal);
        if (moving > 0) {
            fprintf(report, "frames: camera speed over wall time in %u moving frames, avg %.4f slowest %.4f fastest %.4f units/s\n", moving, speedTotal / moving, slowestSpeed, fastestSpeed);
        }
        if (imaged > 0) {
            fprintf(report, "frames: %u compared with the frame before, %u unchanged\n", imaged, stillImages);
        }
    }
}

Maybe!CameraStep cameraStep(ref const Graph graph, Position before, Position after) {
    MaybeIndex!uint from = graph.slotOf(before.node);
    MaybeIndex!uint to = graph.slotOf(after.node);
    if (!from.exists || !to.exists) {
        return Maybe!CameraStep.init;
    } else if (from == to) {
        return Maybe!CameraStep.of(stepBetween(before.local.as!double(), after.local.as!double()));
    } else {
        foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            if (graph.neighborSlot(to.value, cast(Face) face) == from) {
                return Maybe!CameraStep.of(stepBetween((cast(Face) face).mirror.as!double() * before.local.as!double(), after.local.as!double()));
            }
        }
        return Maybe!CameraStep.init;
    }
}

CameraStep stepBetween(Motion!double before, Motion!double after) {
    Motion!double step = before.inverse() * after;
    Point!double reached = step * Point!double.origin();
    Motion!double turn = Motion!double.shiftTo(reached).inverse() * step;
    double cosine = (turn.m.c[0][0] + turn.m.c[1][1] + turn.m.c[2][2] - 1) / 2;
    Vec3!double axis = Vec3!double(turn.m.c[1][2] - turn.m.c[2][1], turn.m.c[2][0] - turn.m.c[0][2], turn.m.c[0][1] - turn.m.c[1][0]);
    double sine = sqrt(axis.x * axis.x + axis.y * axis.y + axis.z * axis.z) / 2;
    return CameraStep(atan2(sine, cosine), reached.distance(Point!double.origin()));
}
