    Preset.light: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.gravity, Ratio(-0.9f)).leveled(Channel.jumpHeight, Ratio(0.9f)),
    Preset.wide: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.fieldOfView, Ratio(0.9f)),
    Preset.narrow: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.fieldOfView, Ratio(-0.6f)).leveled(Channel.fog, Ratio(1.2f)),
    Preset.behind: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.eyeOffset, Ratio(0.4f)),
    Preset.swaying: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.warp, Ratio(0.1f)),
    Preset.turned: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.colorTurn0, Ratio(1.2f)).leveled(Channel.colorTurn3, Ratio(0.8f)),
    Preset.mist: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.revealMist, Ratio(1)),
    Preset.afterimage: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.afterimage, Ratio(1)),
    Preset.sharp: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.fineDetail, Ratio(0.9f)),
    Preset.soft: Perception.init.leveled(Channel.fineDetail, Ratio(-2.5f)).leveled(Channel.coarseDetail, Ratio(-1)),
];

enum Key : ubyte {
    fwd,
    back,
    left,
    right,
    up,
    down,
    yawLeft,
    yawRight,
    pitchUp,
    pitchDown,
}

enum uint KEY_COUNT = Key.max + 1;

enum KeyStroke : ubyte {
    first,
    repeated,
}

enum Command : ubyte {
    walkMode,
    noclipMode,
    previousWorld,
    nextWorld,
    throwBlock,
    nextPreset,
    dose,
    use,
    eat,
}

struct KeyBinding(Symbol) {
    Symbol symbol;
    Key key;
}

struct CommandBinding(Symbol) {
    Symbol symbol;
    Command command;
}

Maybe!Command commandOf(Symbol)(const(CommandBinding!Symbol)[] bindings, Symbol symbol, KeyStroke press) {
    Maybe!Command found;
    if (press == KeyStroke.first) {
        foreach (binding; bindings) {
            if (binding.symbol == symbol) {
                found = Maybe!Command.of(binding.command);
            }
        }
    }
    return found;
}

void holdBound(Symbol)(ref Flags!Key held, const(KeyBinding!Symbol)[] bindings, Symbol symbol) {
    foreach (binding; bindings) {
        if (binding.symbol == symbol) {
            held.set(binding.key);
        }
    }
}

void letGoBound(Symbol)(ref Flags!Key held, const(KeyBinding!Symbol)[] bindings, Symbol symbol) {
    foreach (binding; bindings) {
        if (binding.symbol == symbol) {
            held.clear(binding.key);
        }
    }
}

enum ChunkSupply : ubyte {
    streamed,
    onDemand,
}

struct FrameInput {
    Angle yaw;
    Angle pitch;
    Flags!Key held;
}

float axisValue(Flags!Key held, Key key) {
    if (held.has(key)) {
        return 1.0f;
    } else {
        return 0.0f;
    }
}

FrameInput frameInputOf(ref const ClientConfig config, Flags!Key held, double mouseDx, double mouseDy, Time dt) {
    AngularSpeed yawRate = config.keyTurnRate * (axisValue(held, Key.yawRight) - axisValue(held, Key.yawLeft));
    AngularSpeed pitchRate = config.keyTurnRate * (axisValue(held, Key.pitchDown) - axisValue(held, Key.pitchUp));
    Angle yaw = yawRate * dt + config.mouseTurnPerCount * cast(float) mouseDx;
    Angle pitch = pitchRate * dt + config.mouseTurnPerCount * cast(float) mouseDy * pitchSign(config.pitchAxis);
    return FrameInput(yaw, pitch, held);
}

struct UnloadedCount {
    uint fresh;
    uint generating;
    uint dropped;
    uint missingNodes;
    uint awaitingBuilding;

    void visitMissingNode(uint, Face) {
        missingNodes += 1;
    }

    void visitChunk(ref const Graph graph, LocalFrame, ChunkSlot slot, CellRange) {
        final switch (graph.chunks.at(slot).state) {
            case ChunkState.fresh:
                if (graph.structures.at(slot.slot).isBuildingQueued) {
                    awaitingBuilding += 1;
                } else {
                    fresh += 1;
                }
                break;
            case ChunkState.generating:
                generating += 1;
                break;
            case ChunkState.dropped:
                dropped += 1;
                break;
            case ChunkState.populated:
                break;
        }
    }
}

struct SolidProbe {
    MaterialSet solid;
    uint solidCells;

    void visitMissingNode(uint, Face) {
    }

    void visitChunk(ref const Graph graph, LocalFrame frame, ChunkSlot slot, CellRange) {
        Vec3!float grid = gridPoint(graph.layout, slot.corner.nodeToCorner * frame.toBody.inverse());
        if (isInsideGrid(grid, graph.layout.dimension) && graph.chunks.at(slot).state == ChunkState.populated) {
            size_t cell = cellIndex(graph.layout.dimension, cast(int) floorf(grid.x), cast(int) floorf(grid.y), cast(int) floorf(grid.z));
            if (solid.has(graph.chunks.at(slot).voxels.at(cell))) {
                solidCells += 1;
            }
        }
    }
}

enum ThrownMotion : ubyte {
    flying,
    resting,
    gone,
}

struct Thrown {
    Position position;
    Vec3!float velocity;
    MaterialSet solid;
    Position[TRAIL_POINTS] trail;
    uint trailCount;
    float untilTrail = 0;
    float age = 0;
    ThrownMotion motion;

    void remember() {
        trail[trailCount % TRAIL_POINTS] = position;
        trailCount += 1;
        untilTrail = TRAIL_EVERY_SECONDS;
    }

    void advance(ref const Graph graph, float gravity, Time dt) {
        age += dt.value;
        if (age > THROWN_SECONDS || !graph.slotOf(position.node).exists) {
            motion = ThrownMotion.gone;
        } else if (motion == ThrownMotion.flying) {
            untilTrail -= dt.value;
            if (untilTrail <= 0) {
                remember();
            }
            fly(graph, gravity, dt);
        }
    }

    void fly(ref const Graph graph, float gravity, Time dt) {
        uint substeps = higherOf(cast(uint) ceilf(velocity.magnitude * dt.value / THROWN_STEP), 1u);
        float each = dt.value / substeps;
        foreach (_; 0 .. substeps) {
            MaybeIndex!uint slot = graph.slotOf(position.node);
            if (!slot.exists) {
                motion = ThrownMotion.gone;
                return;
            } else if (graph.isGravityKnown(slot.value)) {
                Gravity pull = graph.gravityAt(position);
                velocity = velocity.minus(pull.up.scaled(pull.strength * gravity * each));
            }
            Position next = graph.movedBy(position, velocity.scaled(each));
            SolidProbe probe = SolidProbe(solid);
            visitCells(graph, next, Length(0), probe);
            if (probe.solidCells > 0) {
                motion = ThrownMotion.resting;
                return;
            }
            position = next;
        }
    }
}

struct Beacon {
    ChunkId chunk;
    uint cell;
}

struct Seed {
    WildGenes genes;
    Material plant;
}

struct PlantGenes {
    WildGenes genes;
    Material plant;
    Readiness growth;
}

struct Scan {
    Molecule product;
    Ratio[MOST_SCANNED_RECEPTORS] affinity;
    Ratio[MOST_SCANNED_RECEPTORS] efficacy;
    Time seenAt;
    uint receptors;
    Material plant;
}

struct BeaconSighting {
    Vec3!float direction;
    Length distance;
}

struct RouteWaypoint {
    Angle yaw;
    Length horizontal;
    Length rise;
}

struct Game {
    LocalWorld world;
    Camera camera;
    CharacterState characterState;
    CharacterConfig character;
    Perception perception;
    Reveal reveal;
    Organism organism;
    Time time;
    Length traveled;
    Length altitude;
    Ratio comfort = Ratio(1);
    Acceleration cameraVerticalAcceleration;
    Length cameraAltitude;
    Speed cameraVerticalVelocity;
    Array!Thrown thrown;
    Array!Beacon beacons;
    Array!Seed seeds;
    Maybe!Scan scan;
    Vec3!float compass = Vec3!float(0, 0, -1);
    Inventory inventory = Inventory.starter();
    uint doses;
    MovementMode mode = MovementMode.walk;
    Preset preset;
    ChunkSupply supply;
    Readiness cameraVelocity;
    Flags!Key lastHeld;

    static Game make(Worldgen worldgen, Length reach) {
        Game game;
        game.world = LocalWorld.make(CHUNK_DIMENSION, worldgen, tanhf(reach.value));
        game.world.graph.bindView();
        game.camera = Camera.make(game.character.eyeOffset);
        game.organism = Organism.make(starterGenome());
        return game;
    }

    Length bodyExtent() const {
        return character.halfHeight + character.skin;
    }

    Length bodyReach() const {
        return bodyExtent() + character.radius;
    }

    Capsule bodyCapsule() const {
        return Capsule(characterState.up, character.radius.value, character.halfHeight.value, character.skin.value);
    }

    void generateAround(Position position, Length reach) {
        Array!ChunkSlot picked = world.graph.collectChunksNear(position, atanhf(world.tanhReach));
        foreach (chunk; picked.slice()) {
            world.graph.generateNow(chunk);
        }
        picked.release();
        RequiredChunks required;
        do {
            required.clear();
            visitCells(world.graph, position, reach, required);
            foreach (missing; required.missing.slice()) {
                world.graph.ensureNeighborSlot(missing.slot, missing.side);
            }
            foreach (chunk; required.chunks.slice()) {
                world.graph.generateNow(chunk);
            }
        } while (required.missing.length > 0);
        required.release();
    }

    void placeAtSpawn() {
        Maybe!RouteStop entrance = world.graph.structures.blueprint.entrance;
        if (entrance.exists) {
            placeAt(ensureSitePosition(entrance.value.site, spawnBefore(world.graph.layout, entrance.value.spot)), bodyExtent() + character.skin);
        } else {
            Position spawn = world.graph.findSpawnPosition(bodyReach().value);
            Vec3!float up = world.graph.ensureGravityAt(spawn).up;
            characterState = CharacterState(spawn, ZERO_VECTOR, Vec3!float(0, 1, 0), up, up);
        }
        settleToGround();
        resetView();
        if (world.graph.structures.blueprint.entrance.exists) {
            camera.turn(yawToward(directionToDoor()), Angle(0));
        } else if (world.graph.worldgen.groundTiltRadians() != 0) {
            camera.turn(yawToward(uphillDirection()), Angle(0));
        }
        updateView();
        resetCompass();
        world.settleFogColor();
    }

    void resetCompass() {
        Vec3!float level = camera.heading.rotate(CAMERA_FORWARD).rejectAlong(characterState.up);
        compass = level.scaled(1.0f / level.magnitude);
    }

    void levelCompass() {
        Vec3!float level = compass.rejectAlong(characterState.up);
        float length = level.magnitude;
        if (length > LEAST_COMPASS_LENGTH) {
            compass = level.scaled(1.0f / length);
        }
    }

    Angle compassOff() const {
        return yawToward(compass);
    }

    void throwBlock() {
        if (thrown.length == MOST_THROWN) {
            foreach (index; 1 .. thrown.length) {
                thrown.ptr[index - 1] = thrown.ptr[index];
            }
            thrown.length -= 1;
        }
        Thrown made;
        made.solid = bodySolid();
        made.position = world.cameraPosition;
        made.velocity = CAMERA_FORWARD.scaled(THROW_SPEED).plus(Vec3!float(0, THROW_LIFT, 0));
        made.remember();
        thrown.append(made);
    }

    void stepThrown(Time dt) {
        size_t index = 0;
        while (index < thrown.length) {
            thrown.ptr[index].advance(world.graph, character.gravity.value, dt);
            if (thrown.ptr[index].motion == ThrownMotion.gone) {
                foreach (later; index + 1 .. thrown.length) {
                    thrown.ptr[later - 1] = thrown.ptr[later];
                }
                thrown.length -= 1;
            } else {
                index += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    void settleToGround() {
        Length reach = regionReach(character) + bodyReach();
        Features features;
        Slide drop;
        while (!drop.hasLanded) {
            generateAround(characterState.position, reach);
            characterState.up = world.graph.ensureGravityAt(characterState.position).up;
            characterState.pull = characterState.up;
            features.collect(world.graph, characterState.position, reach, bodySolid());
            drop = Mover.make(character, features, characterState.up, Length(0)).settle(ZERO_VECTOR, bodyReach());
            characterState.position = world.graph.movedBy(characterState.position, drop.position);
        }
        features.release();
        characterState.groundNormal = drop.groundNormal;
        characterState.footing = Footing.grounded;
    }

    void resetView() {
        camera = Camera.make(character.eyeOffset);
        altitude = ensureAltitude();
        followBody();
        updateView();
        cameraAltitude = altitude + camera.eyeOffset;
        cameraVelocity = Readiness.pending;
    }

    Length ensureAltitude() {
        Position position = characterState.position;
        return Length(world.graph.horospheres.gravitySign() * world.graph.ensureState(world.graph.slotOf(position.node).value).surface.distanceTo(position.local * Point!float.origin()));
    }

    Vec3!float directionToDoor() const {
        RouteStop entrance = world.graph.structures.blueprint.entrance.value;
        Motion!float siteToBody = characterState.position.local.inverse() * world.graph.ownView.siteToNode(entrance.site, world.graph.slotOf(characterState.position.node).value);
        return (siteToBody * columnPoint(world.graph.layout, entrance.spot)).v.spatial();
    }

    Vec3!float uphillDirection() const {
        return world.graph.stateAt(world.graph.slotOf(characterState.position.node).value).reference.upAt(characterState.position.local).negated;
    }

    Angle yawToward(Vec3!float direction) const {
        Vec3!float forward = camera.heading.rotate(CAMERA_FORWARD);
        Vec3!float level = direction.rejectAlong(camera.viewUp);
        return Angle(atan2f(camera.viewUp.dot(forward.cross(level)), forward.dot(level)));
    }

    void enterStructure(Length height) {
        float edge = edgeLength(world.graph.layout).value;
        float edges = floorf(height.value / edge);
        float rest = height.value - edges * edge;
        SiteFrame tower = world.graph.view.turnSite(rootSite(world.graph.anchorSlot), Turn.pitchUp);
        SiteFrame at = world.graph.view.moveToLevel(forwarded(tower, cast(int) edges), 0);
        placeAt(ensureSitePosition(at, Point!float(Vec4!float([0, 0, sinhf(rest), coshf(rest)]))), Length(0));
    }

    Position ensureSitePosition(SiteFrame site, Point!float inSite) {
        Point!float point = sitePlacement(site, world.graph.layout) * inSite;
        return world.graph.ensureNormalized(Position(world.graph.idAt(site.node), Motion!float.shiftTo(point)));
    }

    void enterRoute(size_t index) {
        RouteStop stop = world.graph.structures.blueprint.route.ptr[index];
        placeAt(ensureSitePosition(stop.site, columnPoint(world.graph.layout, stop.spot)), bodyExtent() + character.skin);
    }

    Maybe!RouteWaypoint routeWaypoint(size_t index) const {
        if (index >= world.graph.structures.blueprint.route.length) {
            return Maybe!RouteWaypoint.init;
        } else {
            RouteStop stop = world.graph.structures.blueprint.route.ptr[index];
            Motion!float siteToBody = world.graph.ownView.siteToNode(stop.site, world.graph.slotOf(characterState.position.node).value);
            return Maybe!RouteWaypoint.of(waypointAt(siteToBody * columnPoint(world.graph.layout, stop.spot)));
        }
    }

    RouteWaypoint waypointAt(Point!float floor) const {
        Vec4!float local = (characterState.position.local.inverse() * floor).v;
        Vec3!float direction = local.spatial();
        float length = direction.magnitude;
        Vec3!float toFloor = direction.scaled(acoshf(local.c[3]) / length);
        Vec3!float fromFeet = toFloor.plus(characterState.up.scaled(bodyExtent().value));
        return RouteWaypoint(yawToward(toFloor), Length(fromFeet.rejectAlong(characterState.up).magnitude), Length(fromFeet.dot(characterState.up)));
    }

    void placeAt(Position target, Length lift) {
        Vec3!float up = world.graph.ensureGravityAt(target).up;
        Position lifted = world.graph.ensureNormalized(Position(target.node, (target.local * Motion!float.shift(up.scaled(lift.value))).orthonormalized()));
        Vec3!float liftedUp = world.graph.ensureGravityAt(lifted).up;
        characterState = CharacterState(lifted, ZERO_VECTOR, characterState.groundNormal, liftedUp, liftedUp);
        resetView();
        resetCompass();
    }

    void rebuildWorld(Worldgen worldgen) {
        ubyte dimension = world.graph.layout.dimension;
        float tanhReach = world.tanhReach;
        float renderRadius = world.renderRadius;
        uint epoch = world.epoch;
        thrown.clear();
        beacons.clear();
        reveal.touchable = MaterialSet.init;
        world.release();
        world = LocalWorld.make(dimension, worldgen, tanhReach);
        world.graph.bindView();
        world.renderRadius = renderRadius;
        world.epoch = epoch + 1;
    }

    void release() {
        thrown.release();
        beacons.release();
        seeds.release();
        organism.release();
        world.release();
    }

    bool breakBlock() {
        Maybe!GraphCastHit hit = world.castCenterRay();
        Maybe!Material broken = world.targetMaterial();
        Maybe!PlantGenes genes = plantGenesAt(hit);
        if (genes.exists) {
            keepSeed(Seed(genes.value.genes, genes.value.plant));
        }
        bool done = world.breakBlock();
        if (done) {
            inventory.gain(broken.value);
            Cell coords = hit.value.voxelCoords;
            uint cell = cast(uint) cellIndex(world.graph.layout.dimension, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z);
            if (broken.value == Material.beacon) {
                removeBeacon(hit.value.chunk, cell);
            } else if (broken.value == Material.collector || isPlant(broken.value)) {
                world.graph.edits.dropRecord(hit.value.chunk, cell);
            }
        }
        return done;
    }

    Maybe!PlantGenes plantGenesAt(Maybe!GraphCastHit hit) {
        if (!hit.exists) {
            return Maybe!PlantGenes.init;
        } else {
            Cell coords = hit.value.voxelCoords;
            uint cell = cast(uint) cellIndex(world.graph.layout.dimension, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z);
            ChunkSlot slot = ChunkSlot(world.graph.slotOf(hit.value.chunk.node).value, hit.value.chunk.corner);
            Material plant = world.graph.chunks.at(slot).voxels.at(cell);
            BlockRecord* record = world.graph.edits.recordAt(hit.value.chunk, cell);
            if (!isPlant(plant) || !world.graph.nodeAt(slot.slot).hasState) {
                return Maybe!PlantGenes.init;
            } else if (record !is null && record.kind == RecordKind.planted) {
                Readiness growth = Readiness.pending;
                if (time - record.placed >= GROWN_SECONDS) {
                    growth = Readiness.ready;
                }
                return Maybe!PlantGenes.of(PlantGenes(record.genes, plant, growth));
            } else {
                ulong cellHash = hit.value.chunk.node.spice() ^ (cast(ulong) slot.corner << CELL_HASH_SHIFT) ^ cell;
                return Maybe!PlantGenes.of(PlantGenes(cellGenes(world.graph.stateAt(slot.slot).wild, cellHash), plant, Readiness.ready));
            }
        }
    }

    Maybe!Molecule plantProductAt(Maybe!GraphCastHit hit) {
        Maybe!PlantGenes genes = plantGenesAt(hit);
        if (genes.exists && genes.value.growth == Readiness.ready) {
            return Maybe!Molecule.of(productOfGenes(genes.value.genes));
        } else {
            return Maybe!Molecule.init;
        }
    }

    void keepSeed(Seed seed) {
        if (seeds.length == MOST_SEEDS) {
            foreach (index; 1 .. seeds.length) {
                seeds.ptr[index - 1] = seeds.ptr[index];
            }
            seeds.length -= 1;
        }
        seeds.append(seed);
    }

    Maybe!Seed takeSeedFor(Material plant) {
        size_t index = seeds.length;
        while (index > 0 && seeds.ptr[index - 1].plant != plant) {
            index -= 1;
        }
        if (index == 0) {
            return Maybe!Seed.init;
        } else {
            Seed taken = seeds.ptr[index - 1];
            foreach (later; index .. seeds.length) {
                seeds.ptr[later - 1] = seeds.ptr[later];
            }
            seeds.length -= 1;
            return Maybe!Seed.of(taken);
        }
    }

    bool breedAt(uint slot) {
        if (seeds.length < 2) {
            return false;
        } else {
            float odds = BASE_BREEDING_MUTATION;
            if (world.graph.nodeAt(slot).hasState) {
                odds += ASH_BREEDING_MUTATION * airOf(world.graph.stateAt(slot).climate.climate()).fractions[ASH_GAS].value;
            }
            if (inventory.spend(Material.sulfur)) {
                odds += SULFUR_BREEDING_MUTATION;
            }
            Seed first = seeds.ptr[seeds.length - 1];
            Seed second = seeds.ptr[seeds.length - 2];
            ulong salt = BREEDING_SALT ^ (cast(ulong)(time.value * MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND) << 8) ^ seeds.length;
            keepSeed(Seed(crossed(first.genes, second.genes, salt, odds), first.plant));
            return true;
        }
    }

    bool splice() {
        if (seeds.length == 0 || organism.genome.count == MOST_GENES) {
            return false;
        } else {
            Seed source = seeds.ptr[seeds.length - 1];
            seeds.length -= 1;
            Genome genome = organism.genome;
            genome.add(enzymeGene(enzymeFromSeed(source.genes.seeds[FIRST_ENZYME_GENE]), Ratio(1)));
            Body body = organism.body;
            Signaling signaling = organism.signaling;
            organism.release();
            organism = Organism.make(genome);
            organism.body = body;
            organism.signaling = signaling;
            return true;
        }
    }

    void use() {
        Maybe!GraphCastHit hit = world.castCenterRay();
        Maybe!Material target = world.targetMaterial();
        if (target.exists && target.value == Material.collector) {
            collectAt(hit.value);
        } else if (target.exists && target.value == Material.bench) {
            breedAt(world.graph.slotOf(hit.value.chunk.node).value);
        } else {
            scanAt(hit);
        }
    }

    void collectAt(GraphCastHit hit) {
        Cell coords = hit.voxelCoords;
        BlockRecord* record = world.graph.edits.recordAt(hit.chunk, cast(uint) cellIndex(world.graph.layout.dimension, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z));
        uint slot = world.graph.slotOf(hit.chunk.node).value;
        if (record !is null && world.graph.nodeAt(slot).hasState) {
            float elapsed = lowerOf((time - record.placed).value, MOST_COLLECTED_SECONDS.value);
            AirMix air = airOf(world.graph.stateAt(slot).climate.climate());
            foreach (gas; 0 .. GAS_COUNT) {
                organism.dose(Dose(GAS_MOLECULES[gas], Ratio(air.fractions[gas].value * COLLECTION_RATE.value * elapsed), Route.inhaled));
            }
            record.placed = time;
        }
    }

    void scanAt(Maybe!GraphCastHit hit) {
        Maybe!Molecule product = plantProductAt(hit);
        if (product.exists) {
            Scan made;
            made.product = product.value;
            made.seenAt = time;
            made.plant = world.targetMaterial().value;
            made.receptors = cast(uint) lowerOf(organism.receptors.length, cast(size_t) MOST_SCANNED_RECEPTORS);
            foreach (index; 0 .. made.receptors) {
                Binding binding = organism.cache.bindingOf(organism.receptors.ptr[index].pocket, product.value);
                made.affinity[index] = binding.affinity;
                float efficacy = 0;
                foreach (transducer; binding.efficacy) {
                    efficacy += transducer.value;
                }
                made.efficacy[index] = Ratio(efficacy);
            }
            scan = Maybe!Scan.of(made);
        }
    }

    bool eat() {
        Maybe!GraphCastHit hit = world.castCenterRay();
        Maybe!Material target = world.targetMaterial();
        if (target.exists && target.value == Material.bench) {
            return splice();
        } else {
            Maybe!PlantGenes genes = plantGenesAt(hit);
            if (genes.exists && genes.value.growth == Readiness.ready && world.setVoxel(hit.value.chunk, hit.value.voxelCoords, Material.none)) {
                uint slot = world.graph.slotOf(hit.value.chunk.node).value;
                float expression = expressionIn(genes.value.plant, world.graph.stateAt(slot).climate.climate());
                Cell coords = hit.value.voxelCoords;
                world.graph.edits.dropRecord(hit.value.chunk, cast(uint) cellIndex(world.graph.layout.dimension, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z));
                organism.dose(Dose(productOfGenes(genes.value.genes), PLANT_DOSE * expression, Route.ingested));
                return true;
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    bool isScanShown() const {
        return scan.exists && time - scan.value.seenAt < SCAN_SECONDS;
    }

    void addBeacon(ChunkId chunk, uint cell) {
        world.graph.reference(world.graph.slotOf(chunk.node).value);
        beacons.append(Beacon(chunk, cell));
        world.graph.edits.keepRecord(chunk, BlockRecord(WildGenes.init, time, cell, RecordKind.beacon));
    }

    void removeBeacon(ChunkId chunk, uint cell) {
        size_t index = 0;
        while (index < beacons.length && !(beacons.ptr[index].chunk == chunk && beacons.ptr[index].cell == cell)) {
            index += 1;
        }
        if (index < beacons.length) {
            world.graph.unreference(world.graph.slotOf(chunk.node).value);
            beacons.ptr[index] = beacons.ptr[beacons.length - 1];
            beacons.length -= 1;
            world.graph.edits.dropRecord(chunk, cell);
        }
    }

    BeaconSighting sightingOf(Beacon beacon) const {
        ubyte dimension = world.graph.layout.dimension;
        uint slot = world.graph.slotOf(beacon.chunk.node).value;
        uint bodySlot = world.graph.slotOf(characterState.position.node).value;
        Vec3!float cube = world.graph.layout.cellCenter(Vec3!int(beacon.cell % dimension, beacon.cell / dimension % dimension, beacon.cell / (dimension * dimension)));
        Point!float inNode = (beacon.chunk.corner.cubeToNode * Vec4!float([cube.x, cube.y, cube.z, 1])).toPoint();
        Vec4!float inBody = (characterState.position.local.inverse() * world.graph.ownView.nodeToNode(slot, bodySlot) * inNode).v;
        return BeaconSighting(inBody.spatial(), Length(acoshf(inBody.c[3])));
    }

    bool placeBlock() {
        Maybe!Placement placement = world.placementTarget();
        Material held = inventory.held();
        if (placement.exists && inventory.counts[held] > 0 && world.isEmptyAt(placement.value) && !isBodyOverlapping(ChunkSlot(world.graph.slotOf(placement.value.chunk.node).value, placement.value.chunk.corner), placement.value)) {
            bool done = world.setVoxel(placement.value.chunk, placement.value.coords, held);
            if (done) {
                inventory.spend(held);
                Cell coords = placement.value.coords;
                uint cell = cast(uint) cellIndex(world.graph.layout.dimension, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z);
                if (held == Material.beacon) {
                    addBeacon(placement.value.chunk, cell);
                } else if (held == Material.collector) {
                    world.graph.edits.keepRecord(placement.value.chunk, BlockRecord(WildGenes.init, time, cell, RecordKind.collector));
                } else if (isPlant(held)) {
                    Maybe!Seed seed = takeSeedFor(held);
                    if (seed.exists) {
                        world.graph.edits.keepRecord(placement.value.chunk, BlockRecord(seed.value.genes, time, cell, RecordKind.planted));
                    }
                }
            }
            return done;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }

    bool isBodyOverlapping(ChunkSlot slot, Placement placement) const {
        Vec3!float[MAX_BODY_SECTIONS] storage;
        CellOverlap overlap = CellOverlap(sectionCenters(bodyCapsule(), ZERO_VECTOR, storage[]), slot, placement.coords, character.radius.value);
        visitCells(world.graph, characterState.position, regionReach(character), overlap);
        return overlap.overlaps > 0;
    }

    void look(Angle yaw, Angle pitch) {
        camera.turn(-yaw, -pitch);
        updateView();
    }

    void followBody() {
        Motion!float eye = Motion!float.shift(characterState.up.scaled(camera.eyeOffset.value));
        camera.follow(characterState.position, eye, characterState.up);
    }

    void updateView() {
        world.cameraPosition = camera.orientedPosition();
        world.sunward = camera.orientation.inverted().rotate(sunInBody());
        world.view = viewOf(perception, time, reveal.revealed, comfort);
    }

    MaterialSet bodySolid() const {
        return character.solid.joined(reveal.touchable);
    }

    void settleReveal() {
        reveal.update(perception);
        foreach (family; FAMILY_SETS) {
            if (!family.within(reveal.revealed).isEmpty && family.within(reveal.touchable).isEmpty && !isBodyInside(family)) {
                reveal.touchable = reveal.touchable.joined(family);
            }
        }
    }

    bool isBodyInside(MaterialSet materials) const {
        Vec3!float[MAX_BODY_SECTIONS] storage;
        MaterialOverlap overlap = MaterialOverlap(sectionCenters(bodyCapsule(), ZERO_VECTOR, storage[]), materials, character.radius.value);
        visitCells(world.graph, characterState.position, regionReach(character), overlap);
        return overlap.overlaps > 0;
    }

    void perceive(Preset chosen) {
        preset = chosen;
        perception = felt(PRESETS[chosen], organism.signaling.signals[]);
        settleReveal();
        updateView();
    }

    void doseNext() {
        organism.dose(STARTER_DOSES[doses % STARTER_DOSES.length]);
        doses += 1;
    }

    void nextPreset() {
        perceive(cast(Preset)((preset + 1) % PRESET_COUNT));
    }

    Vec3!float sunInBody() const {
        Vec3!float up = characterState.up;
        Vec3!float side = perpendicularTo(up).rejectAlong(up);
        return up.scaled(SUN_ELEVATION_COSINE).plus(side.scaled(SUN_ELEVATION_SINE / side.magnitude));
    }

    void step(FrameInput input, Time dt) {
        look(input.yaw, input.pitch);
        float moveX = axisValue(input.held, Key.right) - axisValue(input.held, Key.left);
        float moveY = axisValue(input.held, Key.up) - axisValue(input.held, Key.down);
        float moveZ = axisValue(input.held, Key.back) - axisValue(input.held, Key.fwd);
        organism.advance(dt);
        perception = felt(PRESETS[preset], organism.signaling.signals[]);
        settleReveal();
        CharacterConfig effective = character.effectiveFor(perception);
        effective.solid = bodySolid();
        Stepped stepped = runCharacter(effective, characterInput(moveX, moveY, moveZ, jumpFrom(input.held)), dt);
        lastHeld = input.held;
        traveled = traveled + stepped.traveled;
        altitude = ensureAltitude();
        followBody();
        levelCompass();
        updateView();
        stepThrown(dt);
        world.approachFogColor(dt.value);
        trackCameraAcceleration(altitude + camera.eyeOffset, dt);
        if (supply == ChunkSupply.streamed) {
            world.update(Pacing.budgeted);
        }
        time = time + dt;
    }

    Length probeFrameDrift(Length radius) {
        NearbyScratch scratch;
        NearbyNode[] fresh = scratch.collectAll(world.graph, world.cameraPosition, radius.value);
        const(NearbyScratch)* drawn = &world.nearby[world.published];
        Motion!float fromFrame = world.cameraInNearbyFrame().inverse();
        Motion!float fromNode = world.cameraPosition.local.inverse();
        double most = 0;
        foreach (node; fresh) {
            MaybeIndex!uint index = drawn.indexOf(node.slot);
            if (index.exists) {
                Motion!float drawnToCamera = fromFrame * drawn.nodes.ptr[index.value].transform;
                Motion!float freshToCamera = fromNode * node.transform;
                foreach (corner; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
                    Motion!float toNode = (cast(Corner) corner).cornerToNode;
                    Vec4!double apart = (drawnToCamera * toNode * Point!float.origin()).v.as!double() - (freshToCamera * toNode * Point!float.origin()).v.as!double();
                    most = higherOf(sqrt(fabs(apart.minkowski(apart))), most);
                }
            }
        }
        scratch.release();
        return Length(cast(float) most);
    }

    UnloadedCount unloadedWithin(Length radius) const {
        UnloadedCount counted;
        visitCells(world.graph, characterState.position, radius, counted);
        return counted;
    }

    bool isLoadedAround() const {
        Features features;
        features.collect(world.graph, characterState.position, regionReach(character), bodySolid());
        uint unloaded = features.unloaded;
        features.release();
        return unloaded == 0;
    }

    Stepped runCharacter(ref const CharacterConfig config, CharacterInput input, Time dt) {
        if (supply == ChunkSupply.onDemand) {
            return runGenerating(config, input, dt);
        } else {
            return characterState.runStep(config, world.graph, input, dt);
        }
    }

    Stepped runGenerating(ref const CharacterConfig config, CharacterInput input, Time dt) {
        generateAround(characterState.position, regionReach(config));
        CharacterState trial = characterState;
        Stepped stepped = trial.runStep(config, world.graph, input, dt);
        while (stepped.isStalled) {
            generateAround(trial.position, regionReach(config));
            trial = characterState;
            stepped = trial.runStep(config, world.graph, input, dt);
        }
        characterState = trial;
        return stepped;
    }

    Jump jumpFrom(Flags!Key held) const {
        if (held.has(Key.up) && !lastHeld.has(Key.up)) {
            return Jump.pressed;
        } else {
            return Jump.none;
        }
    }

    CharacterInput characterInput(float moveX, float moveY, float moveZ, Jump jump) const {
        if (mode == MovementMode.noclip) {
            return CharacterInput(camera.orientation.rotate(Vec3!float(moveX, moveY, moveZ)), mode);
        } else if (mode == MovementMode.fly) {
            return CharacterInput(levelMove(moveX, moveZ).plus(characterState.up.scaled(moveY)), mode);
        } else {
            return CharacterInput(levelMove(moveX, moveZ), mode, jump);
        }
    }

    Vec3!float levelMove(float moveX, float moveZ) const {
        return camera.heading.rotate(Vec3!float(1, 0, 0)).scaled(moveX).plus(camera.heading.rotate(Vec3!float(0, 0, 1)).scaled(moveZ));
    }

    void trackCameraAcceleration(Length newCameraAltitude, Time dt) {
        Speed verticalVelocity = (newCameraAltitude - cameraAltitude) / dt;
        if (cameraVelocity == Readiness.ready) {
            cameraVerticalAcceleration = Acceleration(fabsf(((verticalVelocity - cameraVerticalVelocity) / dt).value));
        } else {
            cameraVerticalAcceleration = Acceleration(0);
        }
        cameraAltitude = newCameraAltitude;
        cameraVerticalVelocity = verticalVelocity;
        cameraVelocity = Readiness.ready;
    }

    void toggleMode(MovementMode toggled) {
        if (mode == toggled) {
            mode = MovementMode.fly;
        } else {
            mode = toggled;
        }
    }
}

module client.graphics.base;

import bindings.platform : VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR, VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE, VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE, VK_COLOR_SPACE_SRGB_NONLINEAR_KHR, VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY, VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT, VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR, VK_DEPENDENCY_BY_REGION_BIT, VK_FENCE_CREATE_SIGNALED_BIT, VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB, VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_BIT, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT, VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR, VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_CREATE_INFO_KHR, VkAttachmentDescription, VkAttachmentReference, VkCommandBuffer, VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo, VkCommandPool, VkCommandPoolCreateInfo, VkDevice, VkDeviceMemory, VkExtent2D, VkExtent3D, VkFence, VkFenceCreateInfo, VkFormat, VkFramebuffer, VkFramebufferCreateInfo, VkImage, VkImageAspectFlags, VkImageCreateInfo, VkImageLayout, VkImageUsageFlags, VkImageView, VkImageViewCreateInfo, VkPhysicalDevice, VkPresentModeKHR, VkRenderPass, VkRenderPassCreateInfo, VkSemaphore, VkSemaphoreCreateInfo, VkSubpassDependency, VkSubpassDescription, VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR, VkSurfaceFormatKHR, VkSurfaceKHR, VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR, VkSwapchainKHR, vkAllocateCommandBuffers, vkCreateCommandPool, vkCreateFence, vkCreateFramebuffer, vkCreateImage, vkCreateImageView, vkCreateRenderPass, vkCreateSemaphore, vkCreateSwapchainKHR, vkDestroyCommandPool, vkDestroyFence, vkDestroyFramebuffer, vkDestroyImage, import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : clamped;
import client.graphics.pipeline : SUBPASS_EXTERNAL, VULKAN_TRUE, bindDeviceLocalImage, expectSuccess;
import plugins.api.flags : Flags;

enum uint MAX_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGES = 8;
enum uint MAX_SURFACE_FORMATS = 64;
enum uint MAX_PRESENT_MODES = 16;
enum uint UNDEFINED_EXTENT = uint.max;
enum uint SCENE_DEPENDENCIES = 3;
enum VkFormat SCENE_FORMAT = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;

enum SwapchainMark : ubyte {
    offscreen,
    readable,
}

struct SwapchainState {
    VkImage[MAX_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGES] images;
    VkImageView[MAX_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGES] imageViews;
    VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice;
    VkSurfaceKHR surface;
    VkSwapchainKHR swapchain;
    VkImage offscreenImage;
    VkDeviceMemory offscreenMemory;
    VkImage sceneImage;
    VkDeviceMemory sceneMemory;
    VkImageView sceneView;
    VkImage depthImage;
    VkDeviceMemory depthMemory;
    VkImageView depthView;
    VkImage glowImage;
    VkDeviceMemory glowMemory;
    VkImageView glowView;
    VkFramebuffer sceneFramebuffer;
    VkRenderPass renderPass;
    VkCommandPool commandPool;
    VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer;
    VkSemaphore imageAvailableSemaphore;
    VkSemaphore renderFinishedSemaphore;
    VkFence inFlightFence;
    VkExtent2D extent;
    VkFormat format;
    uint imageCount;
    Flags!SwapchainMark marks;

    bool isOffscreen() const {
        return marks.has(SwapchainMark.offscreen);
    }

    bool isReadable() const {
        return marks.has(SwapchainMark.readable);
    }

    void setup(VkPhysicalDevice physical, VkDevice device, VkSurfaceKHR targetSurface, uint queueFamily) {
        physicalDevice = physical;
        surface = targetSurface;
        createSwapchainResources(device);
        createCommandObjects(device, queueFamily);
    }

    void setupOffscreen(VkPhysicalDevice physical, VkDevice device, uint queueFamily, VkExtent2D size) {
        physicalDevice = physical;
        marks.set(SwapchainMark.offscreen);
        extent = size;
        format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;
        offscreenImage = createImage(device, format, extent, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT);
        offscreenMemory = bindDeviceLocalImage(physicalDevice, device, offscreenImage);
        images[0] = offscreenImage;
        imageViews[0] = createImageView(device, offscreenImage, format, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
        imageCount = 1;
        createSceneResources(device);
        createRenderPass(device);
        createFramebuffer(device);
        createCommandObjects(device, queueFamily);
    }

    bool isMinimized() const {
        return extent.width == 0 || extent.height == 0;
    }

    void createCommandObjects(VkDevice device, uint queueFamily) {
        VkCommandPoolCreateInfo poolInfo;
        poolInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
        poolInfo.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
        poolInfo.queueFamilyIndex = queueFamily;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateCommandPool(device, &poolInfo, null, &commandPool));
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo allocateInfo;
        allocateInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        allocateInfo.commandPool = commandPool;
        allocateInfo.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
        allocateInfo.commandBufferCount = 1;
        expectSuccess(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device, &allocateInfo, &commandBuffer));
        createSemaphores(device);
        VkFenceCreateInfo fenceInfo;
        fenceInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO;
        fenceInfo.flags = VK_FENCE_CREATE_SIGNALED_BIT;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateFence(device, &fenceInfo, null, &inFlightFence));
    }

    void createSemaphores(VkDevice device) {
        VkSemaphoreCreateInfo semaphoreInfo;
        semaphoreInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateSemaphore(device, &semaphoreInfo, null, &imageAvailableSemaphore));
        expectSuccess(vkCreateSemaphore(device, &semaphoreInfo, null, &renderFinishedSemaphore));
    }

    void recreate(VkDevice device) {
        vkDeviceWaitIdle(device);
        destroySwapchainResources(device);
        vkDestroySemaphore(device, imageAvailableSemaphore, null);
        vkDestroySemaphore(device, renderFinishedSemaphore, null);
        createSemaphores(device);
        createSwapchainResources(device);
    }

    void createSwapchainResources(VkDevice device) {
        VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR capabilities;
        expectSuccess(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR(physicalDevice, surface, &capabilities));
        extent = surfaceExtent(capabilities, extent);
        if (!isMinimized()) {
            createSwapchain(device, capabilities);
            createSceneResources(device);
            if (renderPass is null) {
                createRenderPass(device);
            }
            createFramebuffer(device);
        }
    }

    void createSceneResources(VkDevice device) {
        sceneImage = createImage(device, SCENE_FORMAT, extent, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT);
        sceneMemory = bindDeviceLocalImage(physicalDevice, device, sceneImage);
        sceneView = createImageView(device, sceneImage, SCENE_FORMAT, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
        depthImage = createImage(device, VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT, extent, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_BIT);
        depthMemory = bindDeviceLocalImage(physicalDevice, device, depthImage);
        depthView = createImageView(device, depthImage, VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT);
        glowImage = createImage(device, VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, extent, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_BIT);
        glowMemory = bindDeviceLocalImage(physicalDevice, device, glowImage);
        glowView = createImageView(device, glowImage, VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
    }

    void createFramebuffer(VkDevice device) {
        VkImageView[3] attachments = [
            sceneView,
            depthView,
            glowView,
        ];
        VkFramebufferCreateInfo framebufferInfo;
        framebufferInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
        framebufferInfo.renderPass = renderPass;
        framebufferInfo.attachmentCount = attachments.length;
        framebufferInfo.pAttachments = attachments.ptr;
        framebufferInfo.width = extent.width;
        framebufferInfo.height = extent.height;
        framebufferInfo.layers = 1;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateFramebuffer(device, &framebufferInfo, null, &sceneFramebuffer));
    }

    void createSwapchain(VkDevice device, VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR capabilities) {
        Maybe!VkSurfaceFormatKHR chosen = srgbSurfaceFormat(physicalDevice, surface);
        assert(chosen.exists);
        VkSurfaceFormatKHR surfaceFormat = chosen.value;
        format = surfaceFormat.format;
        VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR info;
        info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_CREATE_INFO_KHR;
        info.surface = surface;
        info.minImageCount = wantedImageCount(capabilities);
        info.imageFormat = format;
        info.imageColorSpace = surfaceFormat.colorSpace;
        info.imageExtent = extent;
        info.imageArrayLayers = 1;
        marks.put(SwapchainMark.readable, (capabilities.supportedUsageFlags & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT) != 0);
        info.imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
        if (isReadable) {
            info.imageUsage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
        }
        info.imageSharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        info.preTransform = capabilities.currentTransform;
        info.compositeAlpha = VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR;
        info.presentMode = selectPresentMode(physicalDevice, surface);
        info.clipped = VULKAN_TRUE;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateSwapchainKHR(device, &info, null, &swapchain));
        imageCount = MAX_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGES;
        expectSuccess(vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(device, swapchain, &imageCount, images.ptr));
        foreach (i; 0 .. imageCount) {
            imageViews[i] = createImageView(device, images[i], format, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
        }
    }

    VkImageLayout colorFinalLayout() const {
        if (isOffscreen) {
            return VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
        } else {
            return VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;
        }
    }

    void createRenderPass(VkDevice device) {
        VkAttachmentDescription[3] attachments;
        attachments[0].format = SCENE_FORMAT;
        attachments[0].samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        attachments[0].loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR;
        attachments[0].storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
        attachments[0].initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        attachments[0].finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
        attachments[1].format = VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT;
        attachments[1].samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        attachments[1].loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR;
        attachments[1].storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
        attachments[1].initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        attachments[1].finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
        attachments[2].format = VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
        attachments[2].samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        attachments[2].loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR;
        attachments[2].storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
        attachments[2].initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        attachments[2].finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
        VkAttachmentReference colorReference = VkAttachmentReference(0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
        VkAttachmentReference depthReference = VkAttachmentReference(1, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
        VkAttachmentReference[2] geometryColors = [
            colorReference,
            VkAttachmentReference(2, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL),
        ];
        VkAttachmentReference[2] overlayInputs = [
            VkAttachmentReference(1, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL),
            VkAttachmentReference(2, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL),
        ];
        VkSubpassDescription[2] subpasses;
        subpasses[0].pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
        subpasses[0].colorAttachmentCount = geometryColors.length;
        subpasses[0].pColorAttachments = geometryColors.ptr;
        subpasses[0].pDepthStencilAttachment = &depthReference;
        subpasses[1].pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
        subpasses[1].colorAttachmentCount = 1;
        subpasses[1].pColorAttachments = &colorReference;
        subpasses[1].inputAttachmentCount = overlayInputs.length;
        subpasses[1].pInputAttachments = overlayInputs.ptr;
        VkSubpassDependency[SCENE_DEPENDENCIES] dependencies;
        dependencies[0].srcSubpass = SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;
        dependencies[0].dstSubpass = 0;
        dependencies[0].srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT;
        dependencies[0].dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT;
        dependencies[0].dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
        dependencies[1].srcSubpass = 0;
        dependencies[1].dstSubpass = 1;
        dependencies[1].srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
        dependencies[1].dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT;
        dependencies[1].srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
        dependencies[1].dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT;
        dependencies[1].dependencyFlags = VK_DEPENDENCY_BY_REGION_BIT;
        dependencies[2].srcSubpass = 1;
        dependencies[2].dstSubpass = SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;
        dependencies[2].srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
        dependencies[2].dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT;
        dependencies[2].srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
        dependencies[2].dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
        VkRenderPassCreateInfo info;
        info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO;
        info.attachmentCount = attachments.length;
        info.pAttachments = attachments.ptr;
        info.subpassCount = 2;
        info.pSubpasses = subpasses.ptr;
        info.dependencyCount = dependencies.length;
        info.pDependencies = dependencies.ptr;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateRenderPass(device, &info, null, &renderPass));
    }

    void destroySwapchainResources(VkDevice device) {
        foreach (i; 0 .. imageCount) {
            vkDestroyImageView(device, imageViews[i], null);
            imageViews[i] = null;
        }
        imageCount = 0;
        vkDestroyFramebuffer(device, sceneFramebuffer, null);
        vkDestroyImageView(device, sceneView, null);
        vkDestroyImage(device, sceneImage, null);
        vkFreeMemory(device, sceneMemory, null);
        vkDestroyImageView(device, depthView, null);
        vkDestroyImage(device, depthImage, null);
        vkFreeMemory(device, depthMemory, null);
        vkDestroyImageView(device, glowView, null);
        vkDestroyImage(device, glowImage, null);
        vkFreeMemory(device, glowMemory, null);
        if (!isOffscreen) {
            vkDestroySwapchainKHR(device, swapchain, null);
        }
        vkDestroyImage(device, offscreenImage, null);
        vkFreeMemory(device, offscreenMemory, null);
        sceneFramebuffer = null;
        sceneView = null;
        sceneImage = null;
        sceneMemory = null;
        depthView = null;
        depthImage = null;
        depthMemory = null;
        glowView = null;
        glowImage = null;
        glowMemory = null;
        swapchain = null;
        offscreenImage = null;
        offscreenMemory = null;
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyFence(device, inFlightFence, null);
        vkDestroySemaphore(device, renderFinishedSemaphore, null);
        vkDestroySemaphore(device, imageAvailableSemaphore, null);
        vkDestroyCommandPool(device, commandPool, null);
        destroySwapchainResources(device);
        vkDestroyRenderPass(device, renderPass, null);
    }
}

VkImage createImage(VkDevice device, VkFormat format, VkExtent2D extent, VkImageUsageFlags usage) {
    VkImageCreateInfo imageInfo;
    imageInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
    imageInfo.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    imageInfo.format = format;
    imageInfo.extent = VkExtent3D(extent.width, extent.height, 1);
    imageInfo.mipLevels = 1;
    imageInfo.arrayLayers = 1;
    imageInfo.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    imageInfo.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    imageInfo.usage = usage;
    imageInfo.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    imageInfo.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    VkImage image;
    expectSuccess(vkCreateImage(device, &imageInfo, null, &image));
    return image;
}

VkExtent2D surfaceExtent(VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR capabilities, VkExtent2D previous) {
    if (capabilities.currentExtent.width == UNDEFINED_EXTENT) {
        return VkExtent2D(clamped(previous.width, capabilities.minImageExtent.width, capabilities.maxImageExtent.width), clamped(previous.height, capabilities.minImageExtent.height, capabilities.maxImageExtent.height));
    } else {
        return capabilities.currentExtent;
    }
}

uint wantedImageCount(VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR capabilities) {
    if (capabilities.maxImageCount > 0 && capabilities.minImageCount + 1 > capabilities.maxImageCount) {
        return capabilities.maxImageCount;
    } else {
        return capabilities.minImageCount + 1;
    }
}

VkImageView createImageView(VkDevice device, VkImage image, VkFormat format, VkImageAspectFlags aspect) {
    VkImageViewCreateInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO;
    info.image = image;
    info.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    info.format = format;
    info.subresourceRange.aspectMask = aspect;
    info.subresourceRange.levelCount = 1;
    info.subresourceRange.layerCount = 1;
    VkImageView result;
    expectSuccess(vkCreateImageView(device, &info, null, &result));
    return result;
}

bool isSrgbSurfaceFormat(VkSurfaceFormatKHR candidate) {
    return candidate.colorSpace == VK_COLOR_SPACE_SRGB_NONLINEAR_KHR && (candidate.format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB || candidate.format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB);
}

Maybe!VkSurfaceFormatKHR srgbSurfaceFormat(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkSurfaceKHR surface) {
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR[MAX_SURFACE_FORMATS] formats;
    uint count = MAX_SURFACE_FORMATS;
    expectSuccess(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(physicalDevice, surface, &count, formats.ptr));
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < count && !isSrgbSurfaceFormat(formats[index])) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index < count) {
        return Maybe!VkSurfaceFormatKHR.of(formats[index]);
    } else {
        return Maybe!VkSurfaceFormatKHR.init;
    }
}

VkPresentModeKHR selectPresentMode(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkSurfaceKHR surface) {
    VkPresentModeKHR[MAX_PRESENT_MODES] modes;
    uint count = MAX_PRESENT_MODES;
    expectSuccess(vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(physicalDevice, surface, &count, modes.ptr));
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < count && modes[index] != VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index < count) {
        return VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR;
    } else {
        return VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;
    }
}

module client.graphics.core;

import bindings.platform : PFN_vkWaitForPresentKHR, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_ID_FEATURES_KHR, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_WAIT_FEATURES_KHR, VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2, VkPhysicalDevicePresentIdFeaturesKHR, VkPhysicalDevicePresentWaitFeaturesKHR, vkGetDeviceProcAddr, vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2, VULKAN_API_1_1, VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_DISCRETE_GPU, VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_INTEGRATED_GPU, VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_VIRTUAL_GPU, VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, VK_SUCCESS, VkApplicationInfo, VkBool32, VkDevice, VkDeviceCreateInfo, VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo, VkInstance, VkInstanceCreateFlags, VkInstanceCreateInfo, VkPhysicalDevice, VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures, VkPhysicalDeviceProperties, VkQueue, VkQueueFamilyProperties, VkResult, VkSurfaceKHR, vkCreateDevice, vkCreateInstance, vkDestroyDevice, vkDestroyInstance, vkDestroySurfaceKHR, vkDeviceWaitIdle, vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices, vkGetDeviceQueue, vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures, vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties, vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties, vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceSupportKHR;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import client.graphics.base : srgbSurfaceFormat;
import client.graphics.pipeline : VULKAN_TRUE, expectSuccess;

enum string NO_INSTANCE = "cannot create a Vulkan 1.1 instance with the extensions this needs";
enum string NO_DEVICE = "no usable Vulkan device: needs multiDrawIndirect, drawIndirectFirstInstance and, for a window, an 8-bit sRGB surface format";
enum uint MAX_PHYSICAL_DEVICES = 16;
enum uint MAX_QUEUE_FAMILIES = 32;
enum uint MAX_EXTENSIONS = 5;
enum uint APPLICATION_VERSION = 1;
immutable string[1] SWAPCHAIN_EXTENSIONS = ["VK_KHR_swapchain"];
immutable string[2] PRESENT_WAIT_EXTENSIONS = ["VK_KHR_present_id", "VK_KHR_present_wait"];

version (OSX) {
    import bindings.platform : CAMetalLayer, VK_INSTANCE_CREATE_ENUMERATE_PORTABILITY_BIT_KHR, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_METAL_SURFACE_CREATE_INFO_EXT, VkMetalSurfaceCreateInfoEXT, vkCreateMetalSurfaceEXT;

    struct SurfaceSource {
        const(CAMetalLayer)* layer;
    }

    immutable string[1] INSTANCE_EXTENSIONS = ["VK_KHR_portability_enumeration"];
    immutable string[2] SURFACE_EXTENSIONS = ["VK_KHR_surface", "VK_EXT_metal_surface"];
    immutable string[1] DEVICE_EXTENSIONS = ["VK_KHR_portability_subset"];
    enum VkInstanceCreateFlags INSTANCE_FLAGS = VK_INSTANCE_CREATE_ENUMERATE_PORTABILITY_BIT_KHR;

    VkSurfaceKHR createSurface(VkInstance instance, SurfaceSource source) {
        VkMetalSurfaceCreateInfoEXT info;
        info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_METAL_SURFACE_CREATE_INFO_EXT;
        info.pLayer = source.layer;
        VkSurfaceKHR surface;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateMetalSurfaceEXT(instance, &info, null, &surface));
        return surface;
    }
} else {
    import bindings.platform : Display, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_XLIB_SURFACE_CREATE_INFO_KHR, VkXlibSurfaceCreateInfoKHR, Window, vkCreateXlibSurfaceKHR;

    struct SurfaceSource {
        Display* display;
        Window window;
    }

    immutable string[0] INSTANCE_EXTENSIONS = [];
    immutable string[2] SURFACE_EXTENSIONS = ["VK_KHR_surface", "VK_KHR_xlib_surface"];
    immutable string[0] DEVICE_EXTENSIONS = [];

    VkSurfaceKHR createSurface(VkInstance instance, SurfaceSource source) {

        info.window = source.window;

        return surface;

struct ExtensionList {
    const(char)*[MAX_EXTENSIONS] names;
    uint count;

    void add(const(string)[] added) {
        foreach (name; added) {
            assert(count < MAX_EXTENSIONS);
            names[count] = name.ptr;
            count += 1;
        }
    }
}

enum DeviceRank : ubyte {
    unusable,
    other,
    simulated,
    integrated,
    discrete,
}

DeviceRank deviceTypeRank(VkPhysicalDevice device) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties properties;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(device, &properties);
    if (properties.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_DISCRETE_GPU) {
        return DeviceRank.discrete;
    } else if (properties.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_INTEGRATED_GPU) {
        return DeviceRank.integrated;
    } else if (properties.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_VIRTUAL_GPU) {
        return DeviceRank.simulated;
    } else {
        return DeviceRank.other;
    }
}

bool isIndirectDrawingSupported(VkPhysicalDevice device) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures features;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures(device, &features);
    return features.multiDrawIndirect != 0 && features.drawIndirectFirstInstance != 0;
}

enum CoreTarget : ubyte {
    offscreen,
    window,
}

struct VulkanCore {
    VkInstance instance;
    VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice;
    VkDevice device;
    VkQueue graphicsQueue;
    VkSurfaceKHR surface;
    PFN_vkWaitForPresentKHR waitForPresent;
    uint graphicsQueueFamily;
    uint maxDrawIndirectCount;
    CoreTarget target;

    bool isPresenting() const {
        return target == CoreTarget.window;
    }

    bool isPresentWaitable() const {
        return waitForPresent !is null;
    }

    bool wantsPresentWait() const {
        if (isPresenting()) {
            return supportsPresentWait();
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }

    bool supportsPresentWait() const {
        VkPhysicalDevicePresentWaitFeaturesKHR wait;
        wait.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_WAIT_FEATURES_KHR;
        VkPhysicalDevicePresentIdFeaturesKHR id;
        id.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_ID_FEATURES_KHR;
        id.pNext = &wait;
        VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 features;
        features.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2;
        features.pNext = &id;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(cast(VkPhysicalDevice) physicalDevice, &features);
        return id.presentId != 0 && wait.presentWait != 0;
    }

    const(char)* setup(SurfaceSource source) {
        target = CoreTarget.window;
        bool created = createInstance();
        if (!created) {
            return NO_INSTANCE;
        } else {
            surface = createSurface(instance, source);
            return startDevice();
        }
    }

    const(char)* setupOffscreen() {
        target = CoreTarget.offscreen;
        bool created = createInstance();
        if (!created) {
            return NO_INSTANCE;
        } else {
            return startDevice();
        }
    }

    const(char)* startDevice() {
        bool picked = pickPhysicalDevice();
        if (!picked) {
            if (isPresenting) {
                vkDestroySurfaceKHR(instance, surface, null);
            }
            vkDestroyInstance(instance, null);
            return NO_DEVICE;
        } else {
            createDevice();
            return null;
        }
    }

    bool createInstance() {
        ExtensionList extensions;
        extensions.add(INSTANCE_EXTENSIONS);
        if (isPresenting) {
            extensions.add(SURFACE_EXTENSIONS);
        }
        VkApplicationInfo applicationInfo;
        applicationInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO;
        applicationInfo.pApplicationName = "mined";
        applicationInfo.applicationVersion = APPLICATION_VERSION;
        applicationInfo.pEngineName = "mined";
        applicationInfo.engineVersion = APPLICATION_VERSION;
        applicationInfo.apiVersion = VULKAN_API_1_1;
        VkInstanceCreateInfo info;
        info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO;
        info.flags = INSTANCE_FLAGS;
        info.pApplicationInfo = &applicationInfo;
        info.enabledExtensionCount = extensions.count;
        info.ppEnabledExtensionNames = extensions.names.ptr;
        VkResult created = vkCreateInstance(&info, null, &instance);
        return created == VK_SUCCESS;
    }

    bool hasSurfaceFormat(VkPhysicalDevice candidate) {
        if (isPresenting) {
            return srgbSurfaceFormat(candidate, surface).exists;
        } else {
            return true;
        }
    }

    DeviceRank usableRank(VkPhysicalDevice candidate) {
        Maybe!uint family = usableGraphicsFamily(candidate);
        bool indirect = isIndirectDrawingSupported(candidate);
        bool formatted = hasSurfaceFormat(candidate);
        if (family.exists && indirect && formatted) {
            return deviceTypeRank(candidate);
        } else {
            return DeviceRank.unusable;
        }
    }

    bool pickPhysicalDevice() {
        VkPhysicalDevice[MAX_PHYSICAL_DEVICES] devices;
        uint deviceCount = MAX_PHYSICAL_DEVICES;
        expectSuccess(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &deviceCount, devices.ptr));
        DeviceRank bestRank = DeviceRank.unusable;
        foreach (candidate; devices[0 .. deviceCount]) {
            DeviceRank rank = usableRank(candidate);
            if (rank > bestRank) {
                physicalDevice = candidate;
                bestRank = rank;
            }
        }
        if (bestRank == DeviceRank.unusable) {
            return false;
        } else {
            graphicsQueueFamily = usableGraphicsFamily(physicalDevice).value;
            VkPhysicalDeviceProperties properties;
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(physicalDevice, &properties);
            maxDrawIndirectCount = properties.limits.maxDrawIndirectCount;
            return true;
        }
    }

    bool isPresentable(VkPhysicalDevice candidate, uint family) {
        if (isPresenting) {
            VkBool32 presentSupport = 0;
            VkResult queried = vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceSupportKHR(candidate, family, surface, &presentSupport);
            return queried == VK_SUCCESS && presentSupport != 0;
        } else {
            return true;
        }
    }

    Maybe!uint usableGraphicsFamily(VkPhysicalDevice candidate) {
        VkQueueFamilyProperties[MAX_QUEUE_FAMILIES] families;
        uint familyCount = MAX_QUEUE_FAMILIES;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(candidate, &familyCount, families.ptr);
        foreach (family; 0 .. familyCount) {
            if ((families[family].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT) != 0) {
                bool presentable = isPresentable(candidate, family);
                if (presentable) {
                    return Maybe!uint.of(family);
                }
            }
        }
        return Maybe!uint.init;
    }

    void createDevice() {
        float queuePriority = 1.0f;
        VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo queueInfo;
        queueInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO;
        queueInfo.queueFamilyIndex = graphicsQueueFamily;
        queueInfo.queueCount = 1;
        queueInfo.pQueuePriorities = &queuePriority;
        ExtensionList extensions;
        extensions.add(DEVICE_EXTENSIONS);
        if (isPresenting) {
            extensions.add(SWAPCHAIN_EXTENSIONS);
        }
        bool presentWait = wantsPresentWait();
        if (presentWait) {
            extensions.add(PRESENT_WAIT_EXTENSIONS);
        }
        VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures features;
        features.multiDrawIndirect = VULKAN_TRUE;
        features.drawIndirectFirstInstance = VULKAN_TRUE;
        VkPhysicalDevicePresentWaitFeaturesKHR wait;
        wait.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_WAIT_FEATURES_KHR;
        wait.presentWait = VULKAN_TRUE;
        VkPhysicalDevicePresentIdFeaturesKHR id;
        id.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PRESENT_ID_FEATURES_KHR;
        id.pNext = &wait;
        id.presentId = VULKAN_TRUE;
        VkDeviceCreateInfo info;
        info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO;
        if (presentWait) {
            info.pNext = &id;
        }
        info.queueCreateInfoCount = 1;
        info.pQueueCreateInfos = &queueInfo;
        info.pEnabledFeatures = &features;
        info.enabledExtensionCount = extensions.count;
        info.ppEnabledExtensionNames = extensions.names.ptr;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateDevice(physicalDevice, &info, null, &device));
        vkGetDeviceQueue(device, graphicsQueueFamily, 0, &graphicsQueue);
        if (presentWait) {
            waitForPresent = cast(PFN_vkWaitForPresentKHR) vkGetDeviceProcAddr(device, "vkWaitForPresentKHR");
        }
    }

    void cleanup() {
        vkDeviceWaitIdle(device);
        vkDestroyDevice(device, null);
        if (isPresenting) {
            vkDestroySurfaceKHR(instance, surface, null);
        }
        vkDestroyInstance(instance, null);
    }
}

module client.graphics.crosshair;

import bindings.platform : VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, VkCommandBuffer, VkDevice, VkPipeline, VkPipelineLayout, VkPushConstantRange, VkRenderPass, VkShaderModule, vkCmdBindPipeline, vkCmdDraw, vkCmdPushConstants, vkDestroyPipeline, vkDestroyPipelineLayout, vkDestroyShaderModule;
import client.graphics.pipeline : Blend, Culling, Depth, Outputs, PipelineSettings, createGraphicsPipeline, createPipelineLayout, createShader;

enum string CROSSHAIR_VERT_SPV = import("crosshair.vert.spv");
enum string CROSSHAIR_FRAG_SPV = import("crosshair.frag.spv");
enum uint CROSSHAIR_VERTICES = 18;
enum uint CROSSHAIR_SUBPASS = 1;

struct CrosshairPipeline {
    VkPipelineLayout pipelineLayout;
    VkPipeline pipeline;

    void setup(VkDevice device, VkRenderPass renderPass) {
        VkShaderModule vertexShader = createShader(device, CROSSHAIR_VERT_SPV);
        VkShaderModule fragmentShader = createShader(device, CROSSHAIR_FRAG_SPV);
        VkPushConstantRange[1] pushConstants = [
            VkPushConstantRange(VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, float.sizeof),
        ];
        pipelineLayout = createPipelineLayout(device, null, pushConstants[]);
        PipelineSettings settings = PipelineSettings(
            pipelineLayout,
            renderPass,
            vertexShader,
            fragmentShader,
            VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST,
            CROSSHAIR_SUBPASS,
            Blend.alpha,
            Depth.ignored,
            Culling.none,
            Outputs.color,
        );
        pipeline = createGraphicsPipeline(device, settings);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, vertexShader, null);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, fragmentShader, null);
    }

    void draw(VkCommandBuffer commands, float widthOverHeight) {
        vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline);
        vkCmdPushConstants(commands, pipelineLayout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, float.sizeof, &widthOverHeight);
        vkCmdDraw(commands, CROSSHAIR_VERTICES, 1, 0, 0);
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyPipeline(device, pipeline, null);
        vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, pipelineLayout, null);
    }
}

module client.graphics.fog;

import bindings.platform : VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST, VkCommandBuffer, VkDescriptorSet, VkDescriptorSetLayout, VkDevice, VkPipeline, VkPipelineLayout, VkRenderPass, VkShaderModule, vkCmdBindDescriptorSets, vkCmdBindPipeline, vkCmdDraw, vkDestroyPipeline, vkDestroyPipelineLayout, vkDestroyShaderModule;
import client.graphics.pipeline : Blend, Culling, Depth, Outputs, PipelineSettings, createGraphicsPipeline, createPipelineLayout, createShader;

enum string FULLSCREEN_VERT_SPV = import("fullscreen.vert.spv");
enum string FOG_FRAG_SPV = import("fog.frag.spv");
enum uint FULLSCREEN_TRIANGLE_VERTICES = 3;
enum uint FOG_SUBPASS = 1;

struct FogPipeline {
    VkPipelineLayout pipelineLayout;
    VkPipeline pipeline;

    void setup(VkDevice device, VkRenderPass renderPass, VkDescriptorSetLayout commonLayout) {
        VkShaderModule vertexShader = createShader(device, FULLSCREEN_VERT_SPV);
        VkShaderModule fragmentShader = createShader(device, FOG_FRAG_SPV);
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[1] setLayouts = [
            commonLayout,
        ];
        pipelineLayout = createPipelineLayout(device, setLayouts[], null);
        PipelineSettings settings = PipelineSettings(
            pipelineLayout,
            renderPass,
            vertexShader,
            fragmentShader,
            VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST,
            FOG_SUBPASS,
            Blend.transmittance,
            Depth.ignored,
            Culling.none,
            Outputs.color,
        );
        pipeline = createGraphicsPipeline(device, settings);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, vertexShader, null);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, fragmentShader, null);
    }

    void draw(VkCommandBuffer commands, VkDescriptorSet commonSet) {
        vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline);
        vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipelineLayout, 0, 1, &commonSet, 0, null);
        vkCmdDraw(commands, FULLSCREEN_TRIANGLE_VERTICES, 1, 0, 0);
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyPipeline(device, pipeline, null);
        vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, pipelineLayout, null);
    }
}

/// file: source/client/graphics/frustum.d
module client.graphics.frustum;

import core.math : sqrt;
import geometry.lorentz : Normal, Vec4;

enum uint FRUSTUM_PLANE_COUNT = 5;

struct Frustum {
    float tanHalfWidth;
    float tanHalfHeight;

    static Frustum fromVerticalTangent(float tanHalfHeight, float aspectRatio) {
        return Frustum(aspectRatio * tanHalfHeight, tanHalfHeight);
    }

    Normal!float[FRUSTUM_PLANE_COUNT] planes() const {
        Normal!float[FRUSTUM_PLANE_COUNT] found = [
            sidePlane(1, 0, tanHalfWidth),
            sidePlane(-1, 0, tanHalfWidth),
            sidePlane(0, 1, tanHalfHeight),
            sidePlane(0, -1, tanHalfHeight),
            Normal!float(Vec4!float([0, 0, -1, 0])),
        ];
        return found;
    }

    float[16] projection(float near) const {
        float scale = kleinDepthScale(near);
        float[16] columns = 0;
        columns[0] = 1 / tanHalfWidth;
        columns[5] = -1 / tanHalfHeight;
        columns[10] = scale;
        columns[11] = -1;
        columns[14] = scale;
        return columns;
    }
}

float kleinDepthScale(float near) {
    return near / (1 - near);
}

Normal!float sidePlane(float x, float y, float tangent) {
    float length = sqrt(1 + tangent * tangent);
    return Normal!float(Vec4!float([x / length, y / length, -tangent / length, 0]));
}

module client.graphics.highlight;

import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import bindings.platform : VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_LINE_LIST, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, VkCommandBuffer, VkDescriptorSet, VkDescriptorSetLayout, VkDevice, VkPipeline, VkPipelineLayout, VkPushConstantRange, VkRenderPass, VkShaderModule, vkCmdBindDescriptorSets, vkCmdBindPipeline, vkCmdDraw, vkCmdPushConstants, vkDestroyPipeline, vkDestroyPipelineLayout, vkDestroyShaderModule;
import client.graphics.pipeline : Blend, Culling, Depth, Outputs, PipelineSettings, createGraphicsPipeline, createPipelineLayout, createShader;

enum string HIGHLIGHT_VERT_SPV = import("highlight.vert.spv");
enum string HIGHLIGHT_FRAG_SPV = import("highlight.frag.spv");
enum uint MODEL_FLOATS = 16;
enum uint HIGHLIGHT_PUSH_BYTES = HighlightPush.sizeof;
enum uint CUBE_EDGE_VERTICES = 24;

struct HighlightPush {
    float[MODEL_FLOATS] model;
    Vec3!float low;
    float lowPadding;
    Vec3!float high;
    float highPadding;
}

struct HighlightPipeline {
    VkPipelineLayout pipelineLayout;
    VkPipeline pipeline;

    void setup(VkDevice device, VkRenderPass renderPass, VkDescriptorSetLayout commonLayout) {
        VkShaderModule vertexShader = createShader(device, HIGHLIGHT_VERT_SPV);
        VkShaderModule fragmentShader = createShader(device, HIGHLIGHT_FRAG_SPV);
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[1] setLayouts = [
            commonLayout,
        ];
        VkPushConstantRange[1] pushConstants = [
            VkPushConstantRange(VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, HIGHLIGHT_PUSH_BYTES),
        ];
        pipelineLayout = createPipelineLayout(device, setLayouts[], pushConstants[]);
        PipelineSettings settings = PipelineSettings(
            pipelineLayout,
            renderPass,
            vertexShader,
            fragmentShader,
            VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_LINE_LIST,
            0,
            Blend.opaque,
            Depth.tested,
            Culling.none,
            Outputs.colorAndGlow,
        );
        pipeline = createGraphicsPipeline(device, settings);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, vertexShader, null);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, fragmentShader, null);
    }

    void draw(VkCommandBuffer commands, VkDescriptorSet commonSet, float[MODEL_FLOATS] model, Vec3!float low, Vec3!float high) {
        HighlightPush constants = HighlightPush(model, low, 0, high, 0);
        vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline);
        vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipelineLayout, 0, 1, &commonSet, 0, null);
        vkCmdPushConstants(commands, pipelineLayout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, HIGHLIGHT_PUSH_BYTES, &constants);
        vkCmdDraw(commands, CUBE_EDGE_VERTICES, 1, 0, 0);
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyPipeline(device, pipeline, null);
        vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, pipelineLayout, null);
    }
}

/// file: source/client/graphics/matrices.d
module client.graphics.matrices;

import geometry.lorentz : Mat4;

enum uint MATRIX_FLOATS = 16;
enum uint COFACTOR_COUNT = 12;

float[MATRIX_FLOATS] flatten(Mat4!float matrix) {
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] result;
    foreach (column; 0 .. 4) {
        foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
            result[column * 4 + row] = matrix.c[column][row];
        }
    }
    return result;
}

float[MATRIX_FLOATS] matrixMultiply(float[MATRIX_FLOATS] a, float[MATRIX_FLOATS] b) {
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] result = 0;
    foreach (column; 0 .. 4) {
        foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
            float sum = 0;
            foreach (k; 0 .. 4) {
                sum += a[k * 4 + row] * b[column * 4 + k];
            }
            result[column * 4 + row] = sum;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

float[COFACTOR_COUNT] cofactors(float[MATRIX_FLOATS] m) {
    float[COFACTOR_COUNT] b = [
        m[0] * m[5] - m[1] * m[4],
        m[0] * m[6] - m[2] * m[4],
        m[0] * m[7] - m[3] * m[4],
        m[1] * m[6] - m[2] * m[5],
        m[1] * m[7] - m[3] * m[5],
        m[2] * m[7] - m[3] * m[6],
        m[8] * m[13] - m[9] * m[12],
        m[8] * m[14] - m[10] * m[12],
        m[8] * m[15] - m[11] * m[12],
        m[9] * m[14] - m[10] * m[13],
        m[9] * m[15] - m[11] * m[13],
        m[10] * m[15] - m[11] * m[14],
    ];
    return b;
}

float determinantOf(float[COFACTOR_COUNT] b) {
    return b[0] * b[11] - b[1] * b[10] + b[2] * b[9] + b[3] * b[8] - b[4] * b[7] + b[5] * b[6];
}

float determinant(float[MATRIX_FLOATS] m) {
    return determinantOf(cofactors(m));
}
