module client.graphics.overlay;

import core.stdc.string : memcpy;
import bindings.platform : VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, VK_FILTER_NEAREST, VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST, VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE, VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, VkSamplerCreateInfo, VkShaderModule, VkWriteDescriptorSet, vkAllocateDescriptorSets, vkCmdBindDescriptorSets, vkCmdBindPipeline, vkCmdCopyBufferToImage, vkCmdDraw, vkCmdPipelineBarrier, vkCmdPushConstants, vkCreateDescriptorPool, vkCreateImage, vkCreateImageView, vkCreateSampler, vkDestroyDescriptorPool, vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout, vkDestroyImage, vkDestroyImageView, import base.maybe : Maybe;
import client.graphics.matrices : MATRIX_FLOATS, flatten;

import client.hud : HudVertex, MOST_VERTICES, Marker;

enum string HUD_VERT_SPV = import("hud.vert.spv");
enum string HUD_FRAG_SPV = import("hud.frag.spv");
enum string MARKER_VERT_SPV = import("marker.vert.spv");
enum string MARKER_FRAG_SPV = import("marker.frag.spv");
enum uint HUD_SUBPASS = 1;
enum uint MARKER_SUBPASS = 0;
enum uint CUBE_VERTICES = 36;
enum uint HUD_VERTICES_BINDING = 0;
enum uint HUD_ATLAS_BINDING = 1;

struct HudPipeline {
    GpuBuffer vertexBuffer;
    GpuBuffer atlasStaging;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout setLayout;
    VkDescriptorPool pool;
    VkDescriptorSet set;
    VkPipelineLayout pipelineLayout;
    VkPipeline pipeline;
    VkImage atlasImage;
    VkDeviceMemory atlasMemory;
    VkImageView atlasView;
    VkSampler atlasSampler;
    Maybe!uint uploadedRevision;
    uint vertexCount;

    void setup(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkRenderPass renderPass) {
        vertexBuffer = GpuBuffer.makeMapped(physicalDevice, device, MOST_VERTICES * HudVertex.sizeof, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT);
        atlasStaging = GpuBuffer.makeMapped(physicalDevice, device, cast(size_t) ATLAS_WIDTH * ATLAS_HEIGHT, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT);
        createAtlas(physicalDevice, device);
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding[2] bindings = [
            layoutBinding(HUD_VERTICES_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT),
            layoutBinding(HUD_ATLAS_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT),
        ];
        setLayout = createSetLayout(device, bindings[]);
        VkDescriptorPoolSize[2] sizes = [
            VkDescriptorPoolSize(VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1),
            VkDescriptorPoolSize(VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1),
        ];
        VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo poolInfo;
        poolInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
        poolInfo.maxSets = 1;
        poolInfo.poolSizeCount = sizes.length;
        poolInfo.pPoolSizes = sizes.ptr;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateDescriptorPool(device, &poolInfo, null, &pool));
        VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo allocateInfo;
        allocateInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        allocateInfo.descriptorPool = pool;
        allocateInfo.descriptorSetCount = 1;
        allocateInfo.pSetLayouts = &setLayout;
        expectSuccess(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(device, &allocateInfo, &set));
        VkDescriptorBufferInfo info = VkDescriptorBufferInfo(vertexBuffer.buffer, 0, WHOLE_SIZE);
        VkDescriptorImageInfo atlasInfo = VkDescriptorImageInfo(atlasSampler, atlasView, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
        VkWriteDescriptorSet[2] writes = [
            bufferWrite(set, HUD_VERTICES_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, &info),
            imageWrite(set, HUD_ATLAS_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, &atlasInfo),
        ];
        vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, writes.length, writes.ptr, 0, null);
        VkShaderModule vertexShader = createShader(device, HUD_VERT_SPV);
        VkShaderModule fragmentShader = createShader(device, HUD_FRAG_SPV);
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[1] setLayouts = [
            setLayout,
        ];
        pipelineLayout = createPipelineLayout(device, setLayouts[], null);
        PipelineSettings settings = PipelineSettings(
            pipelineLayout,
            renderPass,
            vertexShader,
            fragmentShader,
            VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST,
            HUD_SUBPASS,
            Blend.alpha,
            Depth.ignored,
            Culling.none,
            Outputs.color,
        );
        pipeline = createGraphicsPipeline(device, settings);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, vertexShader, null);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, fragmentShader, null);
    }

    void createAtlas(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device) {
        VkImageCreateInfo imageInfo;
        imageInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
        imageInfo.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
        imageInfo.format = VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
        imageInfo.extent = VkExtent3D(ATLAS_WIDTH, ATLAS_HEIGHT, 1);
        imageInfo.mipLevels = 1;
        imageInfo.arrayLayers = 1;
        imageInfo.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        imageInfo.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
        imageInfo.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
        imageInfo.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        imageInfo.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateImage(device, &imageInfo, null, &atlasImage));
        atlasMemory = bindDeviceLocalImage(physicalDevice, device, atlasImage);
        VkImageViewCreateInfo viewInfo;
        viewInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO;
        viewInfo.image = atlasImage;
        viewInfo.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
        viewInfo.format = VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;
        viewInfo.subresourceRange = atlasRange();
        expectSuccess(vkCreateImageView(device, &viewInfo, null, &atlasView));
        VkSamplerCreateInfo samplerInfo;
        samplerInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO;
        samplerInfo.magFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
        samplerInfo.minFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
        samplerInfo.mipmapMode = VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST;
        samplerInfo.addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
        samplerInfo.addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
        samplerInfo.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateSampler(device, &samplerInfo, null, &atlasSampler));
    }

    void upload(const(HudVertex)[] vertices) {
        vertexCount = cast(uint) vertices.length;
        memcpy(vertexBuffer.mapped, vertices.ptr, vertices.length * HudVertex.sizeof);
    }

    void recordAtlasUpload(VkCommandBuffer commands, ref const GlyphAtlas atlas) {
        if (uploadedRevision != Maybe!uint.of(atlas.revision)) {
            memcpy(atlasStaging.mapped, atlas.pixels.ptr, atlas.pixels.length);
            VkImageMemoryBarrier barrier;
            barrier.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
            barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
            barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
            barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
            barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
            barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex = QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
            barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex = QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
            barrier.image = atlasImage;
            barrier.subresourceRange = atlasRange();
            vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, null, 0, null, 1, &barrier);
            VkBufferImageCopy region;
            region.imageSubresource = VkImageSubresourceLayers(VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1);
            region.imageExtent = VkExtent3D(ATLAS_WIDTH, ATLAS_HEIGHT, 1);
            vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(commands, atlasStaging.buffer, atlasImage, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &region);
            barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
            barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
            barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
            barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
            vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, 0, 0, null, 0, null, 1, &barrier);
            uploadedRevision = Maybe!uint.of(atlas.revision);
        }
    }

    void draw(VkCommandBuffer commands) {
        if (vertexCount > 0) {
            vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline);
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipelineLayout, 0, 1, &set, 0, null);
            vkCmdDraw(commands, vertexCount, 1, 0, 0);
        }
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyPipeline(device, pipeline, null);
        vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, pipelineLayout, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorPool(device, pool, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(device, setLayout, null);
        vkDestroySampler(device, atlasSampler, null);
        vkDestroyImageView(device, atlasView, null);
        vkDestroyImage(device, atlasImage, null);
        vkFreeMemory(device, atlasMemory, null);
        atlasStaging.destroy(device);
        vertexBuffer.destroy(device);
    }
}

VkImageSubresourceRange atlasRange() {
    return VkImageSubresourceRange(VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1);
}

struct MarkerPush {
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] model;
    float half;
    uint color;
}

struct MarkerPipeline {
    VkPipelineLayout pipelineLayout;
    VkPipeline pipeline;

    void setup(VkDevice device, VkRenderPass renderPass, VkDescriptorSetLayout commonLayout) {
        VkShaderModule vertexShader = createShader(device, MARKER_VERT_SPV);
        VkShaderModule fragmentShader = createShader(device, MARKER_FRAG_SPV);
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[1] setLayouts = [
            commonLayout,
        ];
        VkPushConstantRange[1] pushConstants = [
            VkPushConstantRange(VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, MarkerPush.sizeof),
        ];
        pipelineLayout = createPipelineLayout(device, setLayouts[], pushConstants[]);
        PipelineSettings settings = PipelineSettings(
            pipelineLayout,
            renderPass,
            vertexShader,
            fragmentShader,
            VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST,
            MARKER_SUBPASS,
            Blend.opaque,
            Depth.written,
            Culling.none,
            Outputs.colorAndGlow,
        );
        pipeline = createGraphicsPipeline(device, settings);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, vertexShader, null);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, fragmentShader, null);
    }

    void draw(VkCommandBuffer commands, VkDescriptorSet commonSet, const(Marker)[] markers) {
        if (markers.length > 0) {
            vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipeline);
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipelineLayout, 0, 1, &commonSet, 0, null);
            foreach (ref marker; markers) {
                MarkerPush push = MarkerPush(flatten(marker.frame.m), marker.half, marker.color);
                vkCmdPushConstants(commands, pipelineLayout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, MarkerPush.sizeof, &push);
                vkCmdDraw(commands, CUBE_VERTICES, 1, 0, 0);
            }
        }
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyPipeline(device, pipeline, null);
        vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, pipelineLayout, null);
    }
}

struct GpuBuffer {
    VkBuffer buffer;
    VkDeviceMemory memory;
    VkDeviceSize size;
    void* mapped;

    static GpuBuffer make(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkDeviceSize size, VkBufferUsageFlags usage, VkMemoryPropertyFlags properties) {
        GpuBuffer result;
        result.size = size;
        VkBufferCreateInfo bufferInfo;
        bufferInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
        bufferInfo.size = size;
        bufferInfo.usage = usage;
        bufferInfo.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateBuffer(device, &bufferInfo, null, &result.buffer));
        VkMemoryRequirements requirements;
        vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(device, result.buffer, &requirements);
        result.memory = allocateMemory(physicalDevice, device, requirements, properties);
        expectSuccess(vkBindBufferMemory(device, result.buffer, result.memory, 0));
        return result;
    }

    static GpuBuffer makeDeviceLocal(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkDeviceSize size, VkBufferUsageFlags usage) {
        return make(physicalDevice, device, size, usage, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
    }

    static GpuBuffer makeMapped(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkDeviceSize size, VkBufferUsageFlags usage) {
        GpuBuffer result = make(physicalDevice, device, size, usage, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
        expectSuccess(vkMapMemory(device, result.memory, 0, size, 0, &result.mapped));
        memset(result.mapped, 0, size);
        return result;
    }

    static GpuBuffer makeReadable(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkDeviceSize size, VkBufferUsageFlags usage) {
        GpuBuffer result = make(physicalDevice, device, size, usage, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_CACHED_BIT);
        expectSuccess(vkMapMemory(device, result.memory, 0, size, 0, &result.mapped));
        return result;
    }

    static GpuBuffer makeFilled(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, const(void)[] data, VkBufferUsageFlags usage) {
        GpuBuffer result = makeMapped(physicalDevice, device, data.length, usage);
        memcpy(result.mapped, data.ptr, data.length);
        return result;
    }

    void destroy(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyBuffer(device, buffer, null);
        vkFreeMemory(device, memory, null);
        this = GpuBuffer.init;
    }
}

bool isMemoryTypeUsable(ref const VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties properties, uint index, uint typeBits, VkMemoryPropertyFlags wanted) {
    return (typeBits & (1u << index)) != 0 && (properties.memoryTypes[index].propertyFlags & wanted) == wanted;
}

uint memoryTypeIndex(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, uint typeBits, VkMemoryPropertyFlags wanted) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties properties;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(physicalDevice, &properties);
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < properties.memoryTypeCount && !isMemoryTypeUsable(properties, index, typeBits, wanted)) {
        index += 1;
    }
    assert(index < properties.memoryTypeCount);
    return index;
}

VkDeviceMemory allocateMemory(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkMemoryRequirements requirements, VkMemoryPropertyFlags properties) {
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo allocateInfo;
    allocateInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO;
    allocateInfo.allocationSize = requirements.size;
    allocateInfo.memoryTypeIndex = memoryTypeIndex(physicalDevice, requirements.memoryTypeBits, properties);
    VkDeviceMemory memory;
    expectSuccess(vkAllocateMemory(device, &allocateInfo, null, &memory));
    return memory;
}

VkDeviceMemory bindDeviceLocalImage(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkImage image) {
    VkMemoryRequirements requirements;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(device, image, &requirements);
    VkDeviceMemory memory = allocateMemory(physicalDevice, device, requirements, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
    expectSuccess(vkBindImageMemory(device, image, memory, 0));
    return memory;
}

enum Blend : ubyte {
    opaque,
    transmittance,
    alpha,
}

enum Depth : ubyte {
    ignored,
    tested,
    written,
}

enum Culling : ubyte {
    none,
    backFaces,
}

enum Outputs : ubyte {
    color,
    colorAndGlow,
    colorAndHistory,
}

struct PipelineSettings {
    VkPipelineLayout layout;
    VkRenderPass renderPass;
    VkShaderModule vertexShader;
    VkShaderModule fragmentShader;
    VkPrimitiveTopology topology;
    uint subpass;
    Blend blend;
    Depth depth;
    Culling culling;
    Outputs outputs;

    VkCullModeFlags cullMode() const {
        if (culling == Culling.backFaces) {
            return VK_CULL_MODE_BACK_BIT;
        } else {
            return VK_CULL_MODE_NONE;
        }
    }

    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState blendAttachment() const {
        if (blend == Blend.opaque) {
            return opaqueAttachment();
        } else if (blend == Blend.transmittance) {
            return blendedAttachment(VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA, VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA);
        } else {
            return blendedAttachment(VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA, VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
        }
    }

    uint colorAttachmentCount() const {
        if (outputs == Outputs.color) {
            return 1;
        } else {
            return MOST_COLOR_ATTACHMENTS;
        }
    }

    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState secondAttachment() const {
        if (outputs == Outputs.colorAndHistory) {
            return opaqueAttachment();
        } else {
            return glowAttachment();
        }
    }
}

VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState opaqueAttachment() {
    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState attachment;
    attachment.colorWriteMask = COLOR_WRITE_RGBA;
    return attachment;
}

VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState glowAttachment() {
    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState attachment;
    attachment.colorWriteMask = COLOR_WRITE_RED;
    return attachment;
}

VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState blendedAttachment(VkBlendFactor sourceFactor, VkBlendFactor destinationFactor) {
    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState attachment;
    attachment.blendEnable = VULKAN_TRUE;
    attachment.srcColorBlendFactor = sourceFactor;
    attachment.dstColorBlendFactor = destinationFactor;
    attachment.colorBlendOp = VK_BLEND_OP_ADD;
    attachment.alphaBlendOp = VK_BLEND_OP_ADD;
    attachment.colorWriteMask = COLOR_WRITE_RGB;
    return attachment;
}

VkShaderModule createShader(VkDevice device, const(char)[] spirv) {
    uint* code = cast(uint*) malloc(spirv.length);
    memcpy(code, spirv.ptr, spirv.length);
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO;
    info.codeSize = spirv.length;
    info.pCode = code;
    VkShaderModule result;
    VkResult created = vkCreateShaderModule(device, &info, null, &result);
    free(code);
    expectSuccess(created);
    return result;
}

VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo shaderStage(VkShaderStageFlagBits stage, VkShaderModule shaderModule) {
    return VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo(VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, null, 0, stage, shaderModule, "main", null);
}

VkPipeline createGraphicsPipeline(VkDevice device, PipelineSettings settings) {
    VkPipelineShaderStageCreateInfo[2] stages = [
        shaderStage(VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, settings.vertexShader),
        shaderStage(VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, settings.fragmentShader),
    ];
    VkPipelineVertexInputStateCreateInfo vertexInput;
    vertexInput.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VERTEX_INPUT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    VkPipelineInputAssemblyStateCreateInfo inputAssembly;
    inputAssembly.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_INPUT_ASSEMBLY_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    inputAssembly.topology = settings.topology;
    VkPipelineViewportStateCreateInfo viewport;
    viewport.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_VIEWPORT_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    viewport.viewportCount = 1;
    viewport.scissorCount = 1;
    VkPipelineRasterizationStateCreateInfo rasterization;
    rasterization.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_RASTERIZATION_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    rasterization.polygonMode = VK_POLYGON_MODE_FILL;
    rasterization.cullMode = settings.cullMode();
    rasterization.frontFace = VK_FRONT_FACE_CLOCKWISE;
    rasterization.lineWidth = 1.0f;
    VkPipelineMultisampleStateCreateInfo multisample;
    multisample.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_MULTISAMPLE_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    multisample.rasterizationSamples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    VkPipelineDepthStencilStateCreateInfo depthStencil;
    depthStencil.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DEPTH_STENCIL_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    if (settings.depth != Depth.ignored) {
        depthStencil.depthTestEnable = VULKAN_TRUE;
    }
    if (settings.depth == Depth.written) {
        depthStencil.depthWriteEnable = VULKAN_TRUE;
    }
    depthStencil.depthCompareOp = VK_COMPARE_OP_GREATER;
    VkPipelineColorBlendAttachmentState[MOST_COLOR_ATTACHMENTS] blendAttachments = [
        settings.blendAttachment(),
        settings.secondAttachment(),
    ];
    VkPipelineColorBlendStateCreateInfo colorBlend;
    colorBlend.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_COLOR_BLEND_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    colorBlend.attachmentCount = settings.colorAttachmentCount();
    colorBlend.pAttachments = blendAttachments.ptr;
    VkDynamicState[2] dynamicStates = [
        VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VIEWPORT,
        VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_SCISSOR,
    ];
    VkPipelineDynamicStateCreateInfo dynamicState;
    dynamicState.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_DYNAMIC_STATE_CREATE_INFO;
    dynamicState.dynamicStateCount = 2;
    dynamicState.pDynamicStates = dynamicStates.ptr;
    VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
    info.stageCount = 2;
    info.pStages = stages.ptr;
    info.pVertexInputState = &vertexInput;
    info.pInputAssemblyState = &inputAssembly;
    info.pViewportState = &viewport;
    info.pRasterizationState = &rasterization;
    info.pMultisampleState = &multisample;
    info.pDepthStencilState = &depthStencil;
    info.pColorBlendState = &colorBlend;
    info.pDynamicState = &dynamicState;
    info.layout = settings.layout;
    info.renderPass = settings.renderPass;
    info.subpass = settings.subpass;
    VkPipeline result;
    expectSuccess(vkCreateGraphicsPipelines(device, null, 1, &info, null, &result));
    return result;
}

VkPipeline createComputePipeline(VkDevice device, VkShaderModule shader, VkPipelineLayout layout) {
    VkComputePipelineCreateInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO;
    info.stage = shaderStage(VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, shader);
    info.layout = layout;
    VkPipeline result;
    expectSuccess(vkCreateComputePipelines(device, null, 1, &info, null, &result));
    return result;
}

VkWriteDescriptorSet bufferWrite(VkDescriptorSet set, uint binding, VkDescriptorType type, VkDescriptorBufferInfo* info) {
    VkWriteDescriptorSet write;
    write.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
    write.dstSet = set;
    write.dstBinding = binding;
    write.descriptorCount = 1;
    write.descriptorType = type;
    write.pBufferInfo = info;
    return write;
}

VkWriteDescriptorSet imageWrite(VkDescriptorSet set, uint binding, VkDescriptorType type, VkDescriptorImageInfo* info) {
    VkWriteDescriptorSet write;
    write.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
    write.dstSet = set;
    write.dstBinding = binding;
    write.descriptorCount = 1;
    write.descriptorType = type;
    write.pImageInfo = info;
    return write;
}

VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding layoutBinding(uint binding, VkDescriptorType type, VkShaderStageFlags stages) {
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding result;
    result.binding = binding;
    result.descriptorType = type;
    result.descriptorCount = 1;
    result.stageFlags = stages;
    return result;
}

VkDescriptorSetLayout createSetLayout(VkDevice device, VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding[] bindings) {
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
    info.bindingCount = cast(uint) bindings.length;
    info.pBindings = bindings.ptr;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout result;
    expectSuccess(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(device, &info, null, &result));
    return result;
}

VkPipelineLayout createPipelineLayout(VkDevice device, VkDescriptorSetLayout[] setLayouts, VkPushConstantRange[] pushConstants) {
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO;
    info.setLayoutCount = cast(uint) setLayouts.length;
    info.pSetLayouts = setLayouts.ptr;
    info.pushConstantRangeCount = cast(uint) pushConstants.length;
    info.pPushConstantRanges = pushConstants.ptr;
    VkPipelineLayout result;
    expectSuccess(vkCreatePipelineLayout(device, &info, null, &result));
    return result;
}

import bindings.platform : VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT, VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE, VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE, VK_DEPENDENCY_BY_REGION_BIT, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, VK_FILTER_LINEAR, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST, VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE, VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO, import client.graphics.base : MAX_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGES, SCENE_FORMAT, SwapchainState, createImage, createImageView;

enum string REDUCE_FRAG_SPV = import("reduce.frag.spv");
enum string POST_FRAG_SPV = import("post.frag.spv");
enum uint PYRAMID_LEVELS = BAND_COUNT;
enum uint HISTORY_COUNT = 2;
enum uint FINER_BINDING = 0;
enum uint SCENE_BINDING = 0;
enum uint PREVIOUS_BINDING = 1;
enum uint FIRST_LEVEL_BINDING = 2;
enum uint POST_SAMPLERS = FIRST_LEVEL_BINDING + PYRAMID_LEVELS;
enum uint SAMPLER_DESCRIPTORS = PYRAMID_LEVELS + HISTORY_COUNT * POST_SAMPLERS;
enum uint POST_SETS = PYRAMID_LEVELS + HISTORY_COUNT;
enum uint REDUCE_DEPENDENCIES = 2;
enum uint PRESENTING_COMPOSITE_DEPENDENCIES = 3;
enum uint OFFSCREEN_COMPOSITE_DEPENDENCIES = 4;

enum History : ubyte {
    fresh,
    kept,
}

struct Target {
    VkImage image;
    VkDeviceMemory memory;
    VkImageView view;
    VkExtent2D extent;

    static Target make(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkExtent2D extent) {
        Target made;
        made.extent = extent;
        made.image = createImage(device, SCENE_FORMAT, extent, VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT);
        made.memory = bindDeviceLocalImage(physicalDevice, device, made.image);
        made.view = createImageView(device, made.image, SCENE_FORMAT, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
        return made;
    }

    void destroy(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyImageView(device, view, null);
        vkDestroyImage(device, image, null);
        vkFreeMemory(device, memory, null);
        this = Target.init;
    }
}

struct PostChain {
    Target[PYRAMID_LEVELS] levels;
    Target[HISTORY_COUNT] histories;
    VkFramebuffer[PYRAMID_LEVELS] levelFramebuffers;
    VkFramebuffer[MAX_SWAPCHAIN_IMAGES * HISTORY_COUNT] compositeFramebuffers;
    VkDescriptorSet[PYRAMID_LEVELS] reduceSets;
    VkDescriptorSet[HISTORY_COUNT] postSets;
    VkRenderPass reducePass;
    VkRenderPass compositePass;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout reduceLayout;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout postLayout;
    VkDescriptorPool pool;
    VkPipelineLayout reducePipelineLayout;
    VkPipelineLayout postPipelineLayout;
    VkPipeline reducePipeline;
    VkPipeline postPipeline;
    VkSampler sampler;
    uint current;
    History history;

    void setup(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, ref SwapchainState swapchain) {
        createSampler(device);
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding[1] reduceBindings = [
            layoutBinding(FINER_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT),
        ];
        reduceLayout = createSetLayout(device, reduceBindings[]);
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding[POST_SAMPLERS] postBindings;
        foreach (binding; 0 .. POST_SAMPLERS) {
            postBindings[binding] = layoutBinding(binding, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT);
        }
        postLayout = createSetLayout(device, postBindings[]);
        allocateSets(device);
        reducePass = createReducePass(device);
        compositePass = createCompositePass(device, swapchain);
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[1] reduceLayouts = [
            reduceLayout,
        ];
        reducePipelineLayout = createPipelineLayout(device, reduceLayouts[], null);
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[1] postLayouts = [
            postLayout,
        ];
        VkPushConstantRange[1] pushConstants = [
            VkPushConstantRange(VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 0, PostSettings.sizeof),
        ];
        postPipelineLayout = createPipelineLayout(device, postLayouts[], pushConstants[]);
        reducePipeline = fullscreenPipeline(device, reducePipelineLayout, reducePass, REDUCE_FRAG_SPV, Outputs.color);
        postPipeline = fullscreenPipeline(device, postPipelineLayout, compositePass, POST_FRAG_SPV, Outputs.colorAndHistory);
        rebuild(physicalDevice, device, swapchain);
    }

    void createSampler(VkDevice device) {
        VkSamplerCreateInfo info;
        info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO;
        info.magFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR;
        info.minFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR;
        info.mipmapMode = VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST;
        info.addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
        info.addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
        info.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateSampler(device, &info, null, &sampler));
    }

    void allocateSets(VkDevice device) {
        VkDescriptorPoolSize[1] sizes = [
            VkDescriptorPoolSize(VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, SAMPLER_DESCRIPTORS),
        ];
        VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo poolInfo;
        poolInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
        poolInfo.maxSets = POST_SETS;
        poolInfo.poolSizeCount = sizes.length;
        poolInfo.pPoolSizes = sizes.ptr;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateDescriptorPool(device, &poolInfo, null, &pool));
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[POST_SETS] setLayouts;
        foreach (level; 0 .. PYRAMID_LEVELS) {
            setLayouts[level] = reduceLayout;
        }
        foreach (index; 0 .. HISTORY_COUNT) {
            setLayouts[PYRAMID_LEVELS + index] = postLayout;
        }
        VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo allocateInfo;
        allocateInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        allocateInfo.descriptorPool = pool;
        allocateInfo.descriptorSetCount = setLayouts.length;
        allocateInfo.pSetLayouts = setLayouts.ptr;
        VkDescriptorSet[POST_SETS] allocated;
        expectSuccess(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(device, &allocateInfo, allocated.ptr));
        reduceSets = allocated[0 .. PYRAMID_LEVELS];
        postSets = allocated[PYRAMID_LEVELS .. POST_SETS];
    }

    void rebuild(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, ref SwapchainState swapchain) {
        destroySized(device);
        if (!swapchain.isMinimized()) {
            createSized(physicalDevice, device, swapchain);
        }
    }

    void createSized(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, ref SwapchainState swapchain) {
        VkExtent2D extent = swapchain.extent;
        foreach (level; 0 .. PYRAMID_LEVELS) {
            extent = VkExtent2D(higherOf(extent.width / 2, 1u), higherOf(extent.height / 2, 1u));
            levels[level] = Target.make(physicalDevice, device, extent);
            VkImageView[1] attachments = [
                levels[level].view,
            ];
            levelFramebuffers[level] = framebufferOf(device, reducePass, attachments[], extent);
        }
        foreach (index; 0 .. HISTORY_COUNT) {
            histories[index] = Target.make(physicalDevice, device, swapchain.extent);
        }
        foreach (image; 0 .. swapchain.imageCount) {
            foreach (index; 0 .. HISTORY_COUNT) {
                VkImageView[2] attachments = [
                    swapchain.imageViews[image],
                    histories[index].view,
                ];
                compositeFramebuffers[image * HISTORY_COUNT + index] = framebufferOf(device, compositePass, attachments[], swapchain.extent);
            }
        }
        writeSets(device, swapchain.sceneView);
        current = 0;
        history = History.fresh;
    }

    VkDescriptorImageInfo sampled(VkImageView view) {
        return VkDescriptorImageInfo(sampler, view, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    }

    void writeSets(VkDevice device, VkImageView sceneView) {
        VkDescriptorImageInfo[SAMPLER_DESCRIPTORS] infos;
        VkWriteDescriptorSet[SAMPLER_DESCRIPTORS] writes;
        uint count = 0;
        foreach (level; 0 .. PYRAMID_LEVELS) {
            infos[count] = sampled(sceneView);
            if (level > 0) {
                infos[count] = sampled(levels[level - 1].view);
            }
            writes[count] = imageWrite(reduceSets[level], FINER_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, &infos[count]);
            count += 1;
        }
        foreach (index; 0 .. HISTORY_COUNT) {
            foreach (binding; 0 .. POST_SAMPLERS) {
                infos[count] = sampled(postInput(binding, index, sceneView));
                writes[count] = imageWrite(postSets[index], binding, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, &infos[count]);
                count += 1;
            }
        }
        vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, count, writes.ptr, 0, null);
    }

    VkImageView postInput(uint binding, uint index, VkImageView sceneView) {
        if (binding == SCENE_BINDING) {
            return sceneView;
        } else if (binding == PREVIOUS_BINDING) {
            return histories[(index + 1) % HISTORY_COUNT].view;
        } else {
            return levels[binding - FIRST_LEVEL_BINDING].view;
        }
    }

    void recordReduce(VkCommandBuffer commands) {
        foreach (level; 0 .. PYRAMID_LEVELS) {
            beginPass(commands, reducePass, levelFramebuffers[level], levels[level].extent);
            vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, reducePipeline);
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, reducePipelineLayout, 0, 1, &reduceSets[level], 0, null);
            vkCmdDraw(commands, FULLSCREEN_TRIANGLE_VERTICES, 1, 0, 0);
            vkCmdEndRenderPass(commands);
        }
    }

    void beginComposite(VkCommandBuffer commands, uint imageIndex, VkExtent2D extent, PostSettings settings) {
        PostSettings pushed = settings;
        if (history == History.fresh) {
            imageBarrier(commands, histories[(current + 1) % HISTORY_COUNT].image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, 0, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT);
            pushed.afterimage = 0;
        }
        beginPass(commands, compositePass, compositeFramebuffers[imageIndex * HISTORY_COUNT + current], extent);
        vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, postPipeline);
        vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, postPipelineLayout, 0, 1, &postSets[current], 0, null);
        vkCmdPushConstants(commands, postPipelineLayout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, 0, PostSettings.sizeof, &pushed);
        vkCmdDraw(commands, FULLSCREEN_TRIANGLE_VERTICES, 1, 0, 0);
    }

    void advance() {
        current = (current + 1) % HISTORY_COUNT;
        history = History.kept;
    }

    void destroySized(VkDevice device) {
        foreach (ref framebuffer; levelFramebuffers) {
            vkDestroyFramebuffer(device, framebuffer, null);
            framebuffer = null;
        }
        foreach (ref framebuffer; compositeFramebuffers) {
            vkDestroyFramebuffer(device, framebuffer, null);
            framebuffer = null;
        }
        foreach (ref level; levels) {
            level.destroy(device);
        }
        foreach (ref kept; histories) {
            kept.destroy(device);
        }
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        destroySized(device);
        vkDestroyPipeline(device, postPipeline, null);
        vkDestroyPipeline(device, reducePipeline, null);
        vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, postPipelineLayout, null);
        vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, reducePipelineLayout, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorPool(device, pool, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(device, postLayout, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(device, reduceLayout, null);
        vkDestroyRenderPass(device, compositePass, null);
        vkDestroyRenderPass(device, reducePass, null);
        vkDestroySampler(device, sampler, null);
    }
}

void beginPass(VkCommandBuffer commands, VkRenderPass pass, VkFramebuffer framebuffer, VkExtent2D extent) {
    VkRenderPassBeginInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO;
    info.renderPass = pass;
    info.framebuffer = framebuffer;
    info.renderArea.extent = extent;
    vkCmdBeginRenderPass(commands, &info, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
    VkViewport viewport = VkViewport(0, 0, cast(float) extent.width, cast(float) extent.height, 0, 1);
    vkCmdSetViewport(commands, 0, 1, &viewport);
    VkRect2D scissor;
    scissor.extent = extent;
    vkCmdSetScissor(commands, 0, 1, &scissor);
}

VkFramebuffer framebufferOf(VkDevice device, VkRenderPass pass, VkImageView[] attachments, VkExtent2D extent) {
    VkFramebufferCreateInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO;
    info.renderPass = pass;
    info.attachmentCount = cast(uint) attachments.length;
    info.pAttachments = attachments.ptr;
    info.width = extent.width;
    info.height = extent.height;
    info.layers = 1;
    VkFramebuffer made;
    expectSuccess(vkCreateFramebuffer(device, &info, null, &made));
    return made;
}

VkPipeline fullscreenPipeline(VkDevice device, VkPipelineLayout layout, VkRenderPass pass, const(char)[] fragment, Outputs outputs) {
    VkShaderModule vertexShader = createShader(device, FULLSCREEN_VERT_SPV);
    VkShaderModule fragmentShader = createShader(device, fragment);
    PipelineSettings settings = PipelineSettings(
        layout,
        pass,
        vertexShader,
        fragmentShader,
        VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST,
        0,
        Blend.opaque,
        Depth.ignored,
        Culling.none,
        outputs,
    );
    VkPipeline made = createGraphicsPipeline(device, settings);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device, vertexShader, null);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(device, fragmentShader, null);
    return made;
}

VkAttachmentDescription sampledTarget(VkAttachmentDescription described) {
    VkAttachmentDescription made = described;
    made.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    made.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
    made.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
    made.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    return made;
}

VkSubpassDependency writtenForSampling(uint subpass) {
    VkSubpassDependency dependency;
    dependency.srcSubpass = subpass;
    dependency.dstSubpass = SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;
    dependency.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dependency.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT;
    dependency.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    dependency.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
    return dependency;
}

VkSubpassDependency afterSampling() {
    VkSubpassDependency dependency;
    dependency.srcSubpass = SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;
    dependency.dstSubpass = 0;
    dependency.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT;
    dependency.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dependency.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    return dependency;
}

VkRenderPass createReducePass(VkDevice device) {
    VkAttachmentDescription described;
    described.format = SCENE_FORMAT;
    described.finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    VkAttachmentDescription[1] attachments = [
        sampledTarget(described),
    ];
    VkAttachmentReference color = VkAttachmentReference(0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);
    VkSubpassDescription subpass;
    subpass.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    subpass.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
    subpass.pColorAttachments = &color;
    VkSubpassDependency[REDUCE_DEPENDENCIES] dependencies = [
        afterSampling(),
        writtenForSampling(0),
    ];
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO;
    info.attachmentCount = attachments.length;
    info.pAttachments = attachments.ptr;
    info.subpassCount = 1;
    info.pSubpasses = &subpass;
    info.dependencyCount = dependencies.length;
    info.pDependencies = dependencies.ptr;
    VkRenderPass made;
    expectSuccess(vkCreateRenderPass(device, &info, null, &made));
    return made;
}

uint compositeDependencyCount(ref const SwapchainState swapchain) {
    if (swapchain.isOffscreen) {
        return OFFSCREEN_COMPOSITE_DEPENDENCIES;
    } else {
        return PRESENTING_COMPOSITE_DEPENDENCIES;
    }
}

VkRenderPass createCompositePass(VkDevice device, ref const SwapchainState swapchain) {
    VkAttachmentDescription display;
    display.format = swapchain.format;
    display.finalLayout = swapchain.colorFinalLayout();
    VkAttachmentDescription kept;
    kept.format = SCENE_FORMAT;
    kept.finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    VkAttachmentDescription[2] attachments = [
        sampledTarget(display),
        sampledTarget(kept),
    ];
    VkAttachmentReference[2] postColors = [
        VkAttachmentReference(0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL),
        VkAttachmentReference(1, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL),
    ];
    VkSubpassDescription[2] subpasses;
    subpasses[0].pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    subpasses[0].colorAttachmentCount = postColors.length;
    subpasses[0].pColorAttachments = postColors.ptr;
    subpasses[1].pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    subpasses[1].colorAttachmentCount = 1;
    subpasses[1].pColorAttachments = postColors.ptr;
    VkSubpassDependency overlay;
    overlay.srcSubpass = 0;
    overlay.dstSubpass = 1;
    overlay.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    overlay.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    overlay.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    overlay.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    overlay.dependencyFlags = VK_DEPENDENCY_BY_REGION_BIT;
    VkSubpassDependency readback;
    readback.srcSubpass = 1;
    readback.dstSubpass = SUBPASS_EXTERNAL;
    readback.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    readback.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT;
    readback.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    readback.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
    VkSubpassDependency[OFFSCREEN_COMPOSITE_DEPENDENCIES] dependencies = [
        afterSampling(),
        overlay,
        writtenForSampling(0),
        readback,
    ];
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo info;
    info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO;
    info.attachmentCount = attachments.length;
    info.pAttachments = attachments.ptr;
    info.subpassCount = subpasses.length;
    info.pSubpasses = subpasses.ptr;
    info.dependencyCount = compositeDependencyCount(swapchain);
    info.pDependencies = dependencies.ptr;
    VkRenderPass made;
    expectSuccess(vkCreateRenderPass(device, &info, null, &made));
    return made;
}

VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR, VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PRESENT_ID_KHR, VkPresentIdKHR, VkImage, VkImageLayout, VkImageMemoryBarrier, VkImageSubresourceRange, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT,
