enum float CLEAR_DEPTH = 0.0f;
enum ulong NO_TIMEOUT = ulong.max;
enum double MESH_BUDGET_MILLISECONDS = 2.0;
enum uint PIXEL_BYTES = 4;
enum uint OFFSCREEN_IMAGE = 0;
enum uint TIMESTAMP_COUNT = 3;
enum uint FRAME_START_STAMP = 0;
enum uint CULL_END_STAMP = 1;
enum uint FRAME_END_STAMP = 2;
enum ulong PRESENTS_AHEAD = 1;
enum ulong PRESENT_WAIT_NANOSECONDS = 100_000_000;

enum CaptureMark : ubyte {
    wanted,
    copying,
    ready,
}

enum SubmitKind : ubyte {
    offscreen,
    presenting,
}

struct GpuTimes {
    double frameMs = 0;
    double cullMs = 0;
}

struct FrameTimes {
    GpuTimes gpu;
    double fenceWaitMs = 0;
    double chunkUpdateMs = 0;
    double acquireMs = 0;
    double presentMs = 0;
}

struct GpuTimer {
    VkQueryPool pool;
    double millisecondsPerTick = 0;

    void setup(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties properties;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(physicalDevice, &properties);
        millisecondsPerTick = properties.limits.timestampPeriod / NANOSECONDS_PER_MILLISECOND;
        VkQueryPoolCreateInfo info;
        info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
        info.queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP;
        info.queryCount = TIMESTAMP_COUNT;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateQueryPool(device, &info, null, &pool));
    }

    void begin(VkCommandBuffer commands) {
        vkCmdResetQueryPool(commands, pool, 0, TIMESTAMP_COUNT);
        vkCmdWriteTimestamp(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, pool, FRAME_START_STAMP);
    }

    void markCullEnd(VkCommandBuffer commands) {
        vkCmdWriteTimestamp(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, pool, CULL_END_STAMP);
    }

    void end(VkCommandBuffer commands) {
        vkCmdWriteTimestamp(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, pool, FRAME_END_STAMP);
    }

    GpuTimes read(VkDevice device, GpuTimes previous) {
        ulong[TIMESTAMP_COUNT] stamps;
        VkResult result = vkGetQueryPoolResults(device, pool, 0, TIMESTAMP_COUNT, stamps.sizeof, stamps.ptr, ulong.sizeof, VK_QUERY_RESULT_64_BIT);
        if (result == VK_SUCCESS) {
            return GpuTimes((stamps[FRAME_END_STAMP] - stamps[FRAME_START_STAMP]) * millisecondsPerTick, (stamps[CULL_END_STAMP] - stamps[FRAME_START_STAMP]) * millisecondsPerTick);
        } else {
            return previous;
        }
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyQueryPool(device, pool, null);
    }
}

struct Renderer {
    VulkanCore core;
    SwapchainState swapchain;
    SurfacePipeline voxels;
    ChunkMeshes meshes;
    CullPipeline cull;
    FogPipeline fog;
    HighlightPipeline highlight;
    CrosshairPipeline crosshair;
    HudPipeline hud;
    MarkerPipeline marker;
    const(HudVertex)[] hudVertices;
    const(Marker)[] markers;
    const(GlyphAtlas)* atlas;
    GpuTimer timer;
    FrameTimes frameTimes;
    GpuBuffer readback;
    Array!ubyte captured;
    VkExtent2D capturedExtent;
    VkExtent2D copiedExtent;
    LinearColor fogLinear = LinearColor(0, 0, 0, 1);
    ChunkLayout layout;
    MaterialSet unseen;
    PostChain post;
    Maybe!double previousFrame;
    Maybe!uint worldEpoch;
    ubyte dimension;
    uint backlog;
    ulong presentCount;
    Flags!CaptureMark captureMarks;

    const(char)* setup(SurfaceSource source, ubyte chunkDimension) {
        prepare(chunkDimension);
        const(char)* problem = core.setup(source);
        if (problem is null) {
            swapchain.setup(core.physicalDevice, core.device, core.surface, core.graphicsQueueFamily);
            ensureReadback();
            setupPipelines();
        }
        return problem;
    }

    void ensureReadback() {
        VkDeviceSize size = cast(VkDeviceSize) swapchain.extent.width * swapchain.extent.height * PIXEL_BYTES;
        if (swapchain.isReadable && readback.size != size) {
            readback.destroy(core.device);
            readback = GpuBuffer.makeReadable(core.physicalDevice, core.device, size, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT);
        }
    }

    const(ubyte)[] capturedImage() const {
        if (captureMarks.has(CaptureMark.ready)) {
            return captured.slice();
        } else {
            return null;
        }
    }

    PixelOrder capturedOrder() const {
        if (swapchain.format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB) {
            return PixelOrder.bgra;
        } else {
            return PixelOrder.rgba;
        }
    }

    const(char)* setupOffscreen(VkExtent2D extent, ubyte chunkDimension) {
        prepare(chunkDimension);
        const(char)* problem = core.setupOffscreen();
        if (problem is null) {
            swapchain.setupOffscreen(core.physicalDevice, core.device, core.graphicsQueueFamily, extent);
            readback = GpuBuffer.makeMapped(core.physicalDevice, core.device, cast(VkDeviceSize) extent.width * extent.height * PIXEL_BYTES, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT);
            setupPipelines();
        }
        return problem;
    }

    void prepare(ubyte chunkDimension) {
        dimension = chunkDimension;
    }

    void setupPipelines() {
        meshes.setup(core.physicalDevice, core.device, dimension);
        voxels.setup(core.physicalDevice, core.device, swapchain.renderPass, core.graphicsQueue, swapchain.commandPool, swapchain.depthView, swapchain.glowView);
        cull.setup(core.device, voxels.commonUbo.buffer);
        bindMeshBuffers();
        fog.setup(core.device, swapchain.renderPass, voxels.commonLayout);
        highlight.setup(core.device, swapchain.renderPass, voxels.commonLayout);
        post.setup(core.physicalDevice, core.device, swapchain);
        crosshair.setup(core.device, post.compositePass);
        hud.setup(core.physicalDevice, core.device, post.compositePass);
        marker.setup(core.device, swapchain.renderPass, voxels.commonLayout);
        timer.setup(core.physicalDevice, core.device);
    }

    void bindMeshBuffers() {
        voxels.bindStorage(core.device, FACES_BINDING, meshes.faces.buffer);
        voxels.bindStorage(core.device, TRANSFORMS_BINDING, meshes.transforms.buffer);
        cull.bindBuffers(core.device, meshes);
    }

    void render(ref LocalWorld world) {
        captureMarks.clear(CaptureMark.ready);
        if (swapchain.isMinimized()) {
            recreateSwapchain();
        }
        if (!swapchain.isMinimized()) {
            renderFrame(world);
        }
    }

    uint meshBacklog() const {
        return backlog;
    }

    void renderFrame(ref LocalWorld world) {
        layout = world.graph.layout;
        unseen = unseenMaterials(world);
        fogLinear = perceivedFog(world);
        double waitStart = nowMilliseconds();
        expectSuccess(vkWaitForFences(core.device, 1, &swapchain.inFlightFence, VULKAN_TRUE, NO_TIMEOUT));
        double updateStart = nowMilliseconds();
        frameTimes.fenceWaitMs = updateStart - waitStart;
        frameTimes.gpu = timer.read(core.device, frameTimes.gpu);
        if (captureMarks.has(CaptureMark.copying)) {
            takeCopy();
        }
        CommonUniforms uniforms = commonUniforms(world, fogLinear, cast(float) swapchain.extent.width / cast(float) swapchain.extent.height);
        voxels.updateCommonUbo(uniforms);
        hud.upload(hudVertices);
        updateChunks(world);
        frameTimes.chunkUpdateMs = nowMilliseconds() - updateStart;
        Maybe!HighlightTarget target = findHighlightTarget(world);
        PostSettings settings = postSettings(world, frameTime(updateStart));
        if (swapchain.isOffscreen) {
            expectSuccess(vkResetFences(core.device, 1, &swapchain.inFlightFence));
            recordCommands(OFFSCREEN_IMAGE, target, settings);
            submit(SubmitKind.offscreen);
        } else {
            double presentStart = nowMilliseconds();
            uint imageIndex;
            VkResult acquired = vkAcquireNextImageKHR(core.device, swapchain.swapchain, NO_TIMEOUT, swapchain.imageAvailableSemaphore, null, &imageIndex);
            if (acquired == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR) {
                recreateSwapchain();
            } else {
                expectAcquired(acquired);
                expectSuccess(vkResetFences(core.device, 1, &swapchain.inFlightFence));
                frameTimes.acquireMs = nowMilliseconds() - presentStart;
                recordCommands(imageIndex, target, settings);
                submit(SubmitKind.presenting);
                present(imageIndex);
            }
            frameTimes.presentMs = nowMilliseconds() - presentStart;
        }
    }

    Time frameTime(double now) {
        Time elapsed = Time(0);
        if (previousFrame.exists) {
            elapsed = Time(cast(float)((now - previousFrame.value) / MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND));
        }
        previousFrame = Maybe!double.of(now);
        return elapsed;
    }

    void updateChunks(ref LocalWorld world) {
        if (!worldEpoch.exists || world.epoch != worldEpoch.value) {
            meshes.forgetWorld();
            worldEpoch = Maybe!uint.of(world.epoch);
        }
        meshes.beginFrame();
        meshes.forget(world.unloaded.slice());
        world.unloaded.clear();
        meshes.list(world.nearby[world.published], world.listVersion);
        meshChanged(world);
        if (meshes.replaced.has(Replaced.faces) || meshes.replaced.has(Replaced.drawBuffers)) {
            bindMeshBuffers();
        }
    }

    void meshChanged(ref LocalWorld world) {
        if (world.graph.chunks.hasChanges()) {
            meshes.batch.prepare(world.graph, world.streamer.workerCount + 1, meshes.dimension);
            ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(&meshJob, &meshes.batch, Deadline.at(nowMilliseconds() + MESH_BUDGET_MILLISECONDS), world.graph.chunks.pending().length);
            world.streamer.runParallel(&job);
            foreach (_; 0 .. job.count) {
                world.graph.chunks.takeChanged();
            }
            meshes.applyBatch(world.nearby[world.published]);
            meshes.batch.requeueWaiting(world.graph);
        }
        backlog = cast(uint) world.graph.chunks.pending().length;
    }

    void recordCommands(uint imageIndex, Maybe!HighlightTarget target, PostSettings settings) {
        VkCommandBuffer commands = swapchain.commandBuffer;
        vkResetCommandBuffer(commands, 0);
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo beginInfo;
        beginInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO;
        vkBeginCommandBuffer(commands, &beginInfo);
        timer.begin(commands);
        meshes.recordUploads(commands);
        cull.record(commands, meshes.drawableCount);
        timer.markCullEnd(commands);
        if (atlas !is null) {
            hud.recordAtlasUpload(commands, *atlas);
        }
        VkClearValue[3] clears;
        clears[0].color.float32 = [fogLinear.red, fogLinear.green, fogLinear.blue, fogLinear.alpha];
        clears[1].depthStencil.depth = CLEAR_DEPTH;
        VkRenderPassBeginInfo passInfo;
        passInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO;
        passInfo.renderPass = swapchain.renderPass;
        passInfo.framebuffer = swapchain.sceneFramebuffer;
        passInfo.renderArea.extent = swapchain.extent;
        passInfo.clearValueCount = clears.length;
        passInfo.pClearValues = clears.ptr;
        vkCmdBeginRenderPass(commands, &passInfo, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
        VkViewport viewport = VkViewport(0, 0, cast(float) swapchain.extent.width, cast(float) swapchain.extent.height, 0, 1);
        vkCmdSetViewport(commands, 0, 1, &viewport);
        VkRect2D scissor;
        scissor.extent = swapchain.extent;
        vkCmdSetScissor(commands, 0, 1, &scissor);
        vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, voxels.pipeline);
        VkDescriptorSet[2] sets = [
            voxels.commonSet,
            voxels.staticSet,
        ];
        vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, voxels.pipelineLayout, 0, sets.length, sets.ptr, 0, null);
        LayoutPush layoutPush = LayoutPush(layout.dimension, layout.cellRatio, GLOWING.words, unseen.words, Material.glass);
        vkCmdPushConstants(commands, voxels.pipelineLayout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, LayoutPush.sizeof, &layoutPush);
        uint drawn = 0;
        while (drawn < meshes.drawableCount) {
            uint batch = lowerOf(meshes.drawableCount - drawn, core.maxDrawIndirectCount);
            vkCmdDrawIndirect(commands, meshes.commands.buffer, cast(VkDeviceSize) drawn * VkDrawIndirectCommand.sizeof, batch, VkDrawIndirectCommand.sizeof);
            drawn += batch;
        }
        if (target.exists) {
            highlight.draw(commands, voxels.commonSet, target.value.model, target.value.low, target.value.high);
        }
        marker.draw(commands, voxels.commonSet, markers);
        vkCmdNextSubpass(commands, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
        fog.draw(commands, voxels.commonSet);
        vkCmdEndRenderPass(commands);
        post.recordReduce(commands);
        post.beginComposite(commands, imageIndex, swapchain.extent, settings);
        vkCmdNextSubpass(commands, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
        crosshair.draw(commands, cast(float) swapchain.extent.width / cast(float) swapchain.extent.height);
        hud.draw(commands);
        vkCmdEndRenderPass(commands);
        post.advance();
        if (swapchain.isOffscreen) {
            recordReadback(commands, swapchain.offscreenImage);
        } else if (captureMarks.has(CaptureMark.wanted) && swapchain.isReadable) {
            recordPresentedReadback(commands, swapchain.images[imageIndex]);
            captureMarks.set(CaptureMark.copying);
            copiedExtent = swapchain.extent;
        }
        timer.end(commands);
        vkEndCommandBuffer(commands);
    }

    void takeCopy() {
        size_t bytes = cast(size_t) copiedExtent.width * copiedExtent.height * PIXEL_BYTES;
        captured.resize(bytes);
        memcpy(captured.ptr, readback.mapped, bytes);
        capturedExtent = copiedExtent;
        captureMarks.set(CaptureMark.ready);
        captureMarks.clear(CaptureMark.copying);
    }

    void recordPresentedReadback(VkCommandBuffer commands, VkImage image) {
        imageBarrier(commands, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT);
        recordReadback(commands, image);
        imageBarrier(commands, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT, 0, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT);
    }

    void recordReadback(VkCommandBuffer commands, VkImage image) {
        VkBufferImageCopy region;
        region.imageSubresource = VkImageSubresourceLayers(VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1);
        region.imageExtent = VkExtent3D(swapchain.extent.width, swapchain.extent.height, 1);
        vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(commands, image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, readback.buffer, 1, &region);
        VkMemoryBarrier barrier;
        barrier.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
        barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT, 0, 1, &barrier, 0, null, 0, null);
    }

    void submit(SubmitKind kind) {
        VkPipelineStageFlags waitStage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
        VkSubmitInfo submitInfo;
        submitInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO;
        submitInfo.commandBufferCount = 1;
        submitInfo.pCommandBuffers = &swapchain.commandBuffer;
        if (kind == SubmitKind.presenting) {
            submitInfo.waitSemaphoreCount = 1;
            submitInfo.pWaitSemaphores = &swapchain.imageAvailableSemaphore;
            submitInfo.pWaitDstStageMask = &waitStage;
            submitInfo.signalSemaphoreCount = 1;
            submitInfo.pSignalSemaphores = &swapchain.renderFinishedSemaphore;
        }
        expectSuccess(vkQueueSubmit(core.graphicsQueue, 1, &submitInfo, swapchain.inFlightFence));
    }

    void present(uint imageIndex) {
        VkPresentInfoKHR presentInfo;
        presentInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PRESENT_INFO_KHR;
        presentInfo.waitSemaphoreCount = 1;
        presentInfo.pWaitSemaphores = &swapchain.renderFinishedSemaphore;
        presentInfo.swapchainCount = 1;
        presentInfo.pSwapchains = &swapchain.swapchain;
        presentInfo.pImageIndices = &imageIndex;
        ulong presentId = presentCount + 1;
        VkPresentIdKHR ids;
        ids.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PRESENT_ID_KHR;
        ids.swapchainCount = 1;
        ids.pPresentIds = &presentId;
        if (core.isPresentWaitable()) {
            presentInfo.pNext = &ids;
        }
        VkResult presented = vkQueuePresentKHR(core.graphicsQueue, &presentInfo);
        presentCount = presentId;
        if (presented == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR || presented == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) {
            recreateSwapchain();
        } else {
            expectSuccess(presented);
        }
    }

    const(ubyte)[] capture() {
        expectSuccess(vkWaitForFences(core.device, 1, &swapchain.inFlightFence, VULKAN_TRUE, NO_TIMEOUT));
        return (cast(const(ubyte)*) readback.mapped)[0 .. readback.size];
    }

    void waitForDisplay() {
        if (core.isPresentWaitable() && presentCount > PRESENTS_AHEAD) {
            core.waitForPresent(core.device, swapchain.swapchain, presentCount - PRESENTS_AHEAD, PRESENT_WAIT_NANOSECONDS);
        }
    }

    void recreateSwapchain() {
        swapchain.recreate(core.device);
        post.rebuild(core.physicalDevice, core.device, swapchain);
        presentCount = 0;
        captureMarks.clear(CaptureMark.copying);
        if (!swapchain.isMinimized()) {
            ensureReadback();
            voxels.updateInputDescriptors(core.device, swapchain.depthView, swapchain.glowView);
        }
    }

    void cleanup() {
        vkDeviceWaitIdle(core.device);
        timer.cleanup(core.device);
        marker.cleanup(core.device);
        hud.cleanup(core.device);
        crosshair.cleanup(core.device);
        post.cleanup(core.device);
        highlight.cleanup(core.device);
        fog.cleanup(core.device);
        cull.cleanup(core.device);
        voxels.cleanup(core.device);
        meshes.cleanup();
        readback.destroy(core.device);
        captured.release();
        swapchain.cleanup(core.device);
        core.cleanup();
    }
}

void imageBarrier(VkCommandBuffer commands, VkImage image, VkImageLayout from, VkImageLayout to, uint sourceAccess, uint destinationAccess, uint sourceStage, uint destinationStage) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier barrier;
    barrier.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
    barrier.srcAccessMask = sourceAccess;
    barrier.dstAccessMask = destinationAccess;
    barrier.oldLayout = from;
    barrier.newLayout = to;
    barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex = QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex = QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    barrier.image = image;
    barrier.subresourceRange = VkImageSubresourceRange(VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1);
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commands, sourceStage, destinationStage, 0, 0, null, 0, null, 1, &barrier);
}

void expectAcquired(VkResult acquired) {
    if (acquired != VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) {
        expectSuccess(acquired);
    }
}

/// file: source/client/graphics/uniforms.d
module client.graphics.uniforms;

import core.stdc.math : expf, powf, sinhf, tanf;
import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;
import base.numbers : RADIANS_PER_DEGREE, lowerOf;
import base.units : Angle, Time;
import base.vector3 : Vec3, scaled;
import client.camera : CAMERA_FORWARD;
import client.graphics.frustum : FRUSTUM_PLANE_COUNT, Frustum, kleinDepthScale;
import client.graphics.matrices : MATRIX_FLOATS, determinant, flatten, matrixMultiply;
import client.world : FOG_SHARPNESS, LocalWorld, fogReach;
import common.color : ColorTurn, Seen, seenOf, spectrumOf, turned;
import common.material : BITS_PER_WORD, ByteColor, HIDDEN, MATERIAL_COLORS, MATERIAL_COUNT, MATERIAL_WORDS, MaterialSet, without;
import common.node : ChunkLayout;
import common.perception : BAND_COUNT;
import common.raycast.graph : GraphCastHit;
import geometry.cube : Cell;
import geometry.honeycomb : CUBE_RADIUS, cubeToNode;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Normal, Point, Vec4;
import plugins.api.api : Color;

enum Angle HALF_VERTICAL_FOV = Angle(cast(float)(45 * RADIANS_PER_DEGREE));
enum float NEAR_PLANE = 1.0e-4f;
enum uint TINT_SLOTS = MATERIAL_WORDS * BITS_PER_WORD;
enum float MOST_TINT = 16;
enum float CHANNEL_MOST = 255;

enum float SRGB_LINEAR_LIMIT = 0.04045f;
enum float SRGB_LINEAR_SLOPE = 12.92f;
enum float SRGB_OFFSET = 0.055f;
enum float SRGB_GAMMA = 2.4f;

struct LinearColor {
    float red;
    float green;
    float blue;
    float alpha;
}

struct CommonUniforms {
    LinearColor[TINT_SLOTS] materialTints;
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] projection;
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] cameraInverse;
    Normal!float[FRUSTUM_PLANE_COUNT] frustumPlanes;
    LinearColor fogColor;
    Vec4!float sun;
    Point!float eye;
    Frustum frustum;
    float depthScale;
    float fogReach;
    float fogSharpness;
    float viewParity;
    float cullSinhRadius;
    float warpStrength;
    float warpSeconds;
}

struct PostSettings {
    float[BAND_COUNT] bandGains;
    float afterimage;
}

struct HighlightTarget {
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] model;
    Vec3!float low;
    Vec3!float high;
}

CommonUniforms commonUniforms(ref const LocalWorld world, LinearColor fogLinear, float widthOverHeight) {
    Frustum frustum = Frustum.fromVerticalTangent(tanf(HALF_VERTICAL_FOV.value) * world.view.fieldTangentScale.value, widthOverHeight);
    Motion!float camera = world.cameraInNearbyFrame() * Motion!float.shift(CAMERA_FORWARD.scaled(-world.view.eyeBack.value));
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] cameraInverse = flatten(camera.inverse().m);
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] projection = frustum.projection(NEAR_PLANE);
    Vec3!float sunward = world.sunward;
    return CommonUniforms(
        materialTints(world.view.colorTurn),
        projection,
        cameraInverse,
        frustum.planes(),
        fogLinear,
        camera * Vec4!float([sunward.x, sunward.y, sunward.z, 1]),
        camera * Point!float.origin(),
        frustum,
        kleinDepthScale(NEAR_PLANE),
        fogReach(world.viewRadius()) * world.view.fogShare.value,
        FOG_SHARPNESS,
        parityOf(determinant(matrixMultiply(projection, cameraInverse))),
        sinhf(CUBE_RADIUS),
        world.view.warpStrength.value,
        world.view.warpSeconds.value,
    );
}

PostSettings postSettings(ref const LocalWorld world, Time frame) {
    PostSettings settings;
    foreach (band; 0 .. BAND_COUNT) {
        settings.bandGains[band] = world.view.bandGains[band].value;
    }
    if (world.view.afterimageTime.value > 0) {
        settings.afterimage = expf(-frame.value / world.view.afterimageTime.value);
    }
    return settings;
}

Maybe!HighlightTarget findHighlightTarget(ref const LocalWorld world) {
    Maybe!GraphCastHit hit = world.castCenterRay();
    if (!hit.exists) {
        return Maybe!HighlightTarget.init;
    } else {
        MaybeIndex!uint index = world.nearby[world.published].indexOf(world.graph.slotOf(hit.value.chunk.node).value);
        if (!index.exists) {
            return Maybe!HighlightTarget.init;
        } else {
            ChunkLayout layout = world.graph.layout;
            float[MATRIX_FLOATS] chunkToWorld = matrixMultiply(flatten(world.cachedNodes[index.value].transform.m), flatten(hit.value.chunk.corner.cubeToNode));
            Cell cell = hit.value.voxelCoords;
            Vec3!float low = Vec3!float(layout.gridToCube(cell.x), layout.gridToCube(cell.y), layout.gridToCube(cell.z));
            Vec3!float high = Vec3!float(layout.gridToCube(cell.x + 1), layout.gridToCube(cell.y + 1), layout.gridToCube(cell.z + 1));
            return Maybe!HighlightTarget.of(HighlightTarget(chunkToWorld, low, high));
        }
    }
}

float parityOf(float value) {
    if (value < 0) {
        return -1.0f;
    } else {
        return 1.0f;
    }
}

LinearColor linearOf(Color color) {
    return LinearColor(srgbToLinear(color.red), srgbToLinear(color.green), srgbToLinear(color.blue), 1);
}

MaterialSet unseenMaterials(ref const LocalWorld world) {
    return HIDDEN.without(world.view.visible);
}

LinearColor perceivedFog(ref const LocalWorld world) {
    LinearColor plain = linearOf(world.fogColor);
    Seen seen = seenOf(turned(spectrumOf([plain.red, plain.green, plain.blue]), world.view.colorTurn));
    return LinearColor(seen[0], seen[1], seen[2], 1);
}

LinearColor[TINT_SLOTS] materialTints(ColorTurn turn) {
    LinearColor[TINT_SLOTS] tints = LinearColor(1, 1, 1, 1);
    foreach (index; 1 .. MATERIAL_COUNT) {
        ByteColor written = MATERIAL_COLORS[index];
        Seen plain = [srgbToLinear(written.red / CHANNEL_MOST), srgbToLinear(written.green / CHANNEL_MOST), srgbToLinear(written.blue / CHANNEL_MOST)];
        Seen seen = seenOf(turned(spectrumOf(plain), turn));
        tints[index] = LinearColor(tintOf(seen[0], plain[0]), tintOf(seen[1], plain[1]), tintOf(seen[2], plain[2]), 1);
    }
    return tints;
}

float tintOf(float seen, float plain) {
    if (plain > 0) {
        return lowerOf(seen / plain, MOST_TINT);
    } else {
        return 1;
    }
}

float srgbToLinear(float encoded) {
    if (encoded > SRGB_LINEAR_LIMIT) {
        return powf((encoded + SRGB_OFFSET) / (1.0f + SRGB_OFFSET), SRGB_GAMMA);
    } else {
        return encoded / SRGB_LINEAR_SLOPE;
    }
}

/// file: source/client/graphics/voxels/cull.d
module client.graphics.voxels.cull;

import bindings.platform : VK_ACCESS_INDIRECT_COMMAND_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_DRAW_INDIRECT_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_SHADER_BIT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, VkBuffer, VkCommandBuffer, VkDescriptorBufferInfo, VkDescriptorPool, VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo, VkDescriptorPoolSize, VkDescriptorSet, VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo, VkDescriptorSetLayout, VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding, VkDevice, VkMemoryBarrier, VkPipeline, VkPipelineLayout, VkPushConstantRange, VkShaderModule, VkWriteDescriptorSet, vkAllocateDescriptorSets, vkCmdBindDescriptorSets, vkCmdBindPipeline, vkCmdDispatch, vkCmdPipelineBarrier, vkCmdPushConstants, vkCreateDescriptorPool, vkDestroyDescriptorPool, vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout, vkDestroyPipeline, vkDestroyPipelineLayout, vkDestroyShaderModule, vkUpdateDescriptorSets;
import client.graphics.pipeline : WHOLE_SIZE, bufferWrite, createComputePipeline, createPipelineLayout, createSetLayout, createShader, expectSuccess, layoutBinding;
import client.graphics.voxels.meshes : ChunkMeshes;

enum string CULL_COMP_SPV = import("cull.comp.spv");
enum uint CULL_WORKGROUP = 64;
enum uint CULL_STORAGE_BINDINGS = 5;
enum uint COMMON_BINDING = 0;

struct CullPipeline {
    VkDescriptorSetLayout setLayout;
    VkDescriptorPool pool;
    VkDescriptorSet set;
    VkPipelineLayout pipelineLayout;
    VkPipeline pipeline;

    void setup(VkDevice device, VkBuffer commonUbo) {
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding[CULL_STORAGE_BINDINGS + 1] bindings;
        bindings[COMMON_BINDING] = layoutBinding(COMMON_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT);
        foreach (i; 1 .. CULL_STORAGE_BINDINGS + 1) {
            bindings[i] = layoutBinding(cast(uint) i, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT);
        }
        setLayout = createSetLayout(device, bindings[]);
        VkDescriptorPoolSize[2] sizes = [
            VkDescriptorPoolSize(VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, 1),
            VkDescriptorPoolSize(VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, CULL_STORAGE_BINDINGS),
        ];
        VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo poolInfo;
        poolInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
        poolInfo.maxSets = 1;
        poolInfo.poolSizeCount = sizes.length;
        poolInfo.pPoolSizes = sizes.ptr;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateDescriptorPool(device, &poolInfo, null, &pool));
        VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo allocateInfo;
        allocateInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        allocateInfo.descriptorPool = pool;
        allocateInfo.descriptorSetCount = 1;
        allocateInfo.pSetLayouts = &setLayout;
        expectSuccess(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(device, &allocateInfo, &set));
        VkDescriptorBufferInfo commonInfo = VkDescriptorBufferInfo(commonUbo, 0, WHOLE_SIZE);
        VkWriteDescriptorSet write = bufferWrite(set, COMMON_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, &commonInfo);
        vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, 1, &write, 0, null);
        VkShaderModule shader = createShader(device, CULL_COMP_SPV);
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[1] setLayouts = [
            setLayout,
        ];
        VkPushConstantRange[1] pushConstants = [
            VkPushConstantRange(VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, uint.sizeof),
        ];
        pipelineLayout = createPipelineLayout(device, setLayouts[], pushConstants[]);
        pipeline = createComputePipeline(device, shader, pipelineLayout);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, shader, null);
    }

    void bindBuffers(VkDevice device, ref ChunkMeshes meshes) {
        VkDescriptorBufferInfo[CULL_STORAGE_BINDINGS] infos = [
            VkDescriptorBufferInfo(meshes.cubeFrames.buffer, 0, WHOLE_SIZE),
            VkDescriptorBufferInfo(meshes.nodes.buffer, 0, WHOLE_SIZE),
            VkDescriptorBufferInfo(meshes.drawables.buffer, 0, WHOLE_SIZE),
            VkDescriptorBufferInfo(meshes.transforms.buffer, 0, WHOLE_SIZE),
            VkDescriptorBufferInfo(meshes.commands.buffer, 0, WHOLE_SIZE),
        ];
        VkWriteDescriptorSet[CULL_STORAGE_BINDINGS] writes;
        foreach (i; 0 .. CULL_STORAGE_BINDINGS) {
            writes[i] = bufferWrite(set, cast(uint) i + 1, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, &infos[i]);
        }
        vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, writes.length, writes.ptr, 0, null);
    }

    void record(VkCommandBuffer commands, uint drawableCount) {
        vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pipeline);
        vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pipelineLayout, 0, 1, &set, 0, null);
        vkCmdPushConstants(commands, pipelineLayout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, uint.sizeof, &drawableCount);
        vkCmdDispatch(commands, (drawableCount + CULL_WORKGROUP - 1) / CULL_WORKGROUP, 1, 1);
        VkMemoryBarrier barrier;
        barrier.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
        barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT;
        barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_INDIRECT_COMMAND_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_DRAW_INDIRECT_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_SHADER_BIT, 0, 1, &barrier, 0, null, 0, null);
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyPipeline(device, pipeline, null);
        vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, pipelineLayout, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorPool(device, pool, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(device, setLayout, null);
    }
}

/// file: source/client/graphics/voxels/drawlist.d
module client.graphics.voxels.drawlist;

import base.maybe : MaybeIndex;
import client.graphics.matrices : MATRIX_FLOATS, flatten;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, Corner, cubeCenter, cubeToNode;
import geometry.lorentz : Point;
import plugins.api.flags : Flags;

enum uint NOT_LISTED = uint.max;

struct CubeFrame {
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] cubeToNode;
    Point!float center;
}

struct ListedNode {
    uint bits = NOT_LISTED;

    bool isListed() const {
        return bits != NOT_LISTED;
    }

    uint index() const {
        assert(isListed);
        return bits;
    }
}

struct DrawableRecord {
    ListedNode node;
    uint corner;
    uint faceOffset;
    uint faceCount;
}

enum ChunkMark : ubyte {
    drawable,
    nodeMissing,
    unlisted,
}

struct RenderChunk {
    uint faceOffset;
    uint faceCount;
    uint drawable;
    uint slot;
    Flags!ChunkMark marks;
}

CubeFrame[CORNER_COUNT] cubeFrameTable() {
    CubeFrame[CORNER_COUNT] table;
    foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
        Corner corner = cast(Corner) index;
        table[index] = CubeFrame(flatten(corner.cubeToNode), corner.cubeCenter);
    }
    return table;
}

ListedNode recordedNode(MaybeIndex!uint node) {
    if (node.exists) {
        return ListedNode(node.value);
    } else {
        return ListedNode.init;
    }
}

mixin template DrawList() {
    import base.allocator : RangeAllocator;
    import base.array : Array;
    import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;
    import base.slab : Slab;
    import client.graphics.matrices : flatten;
    import client.graphics.voxels.drawlist : ChunkMark, DrawableRecord, ListedNode, RenderChunk, recordedNode;
    import client.meshing : MeshBatch, MeshRecord, Quad;
    import common.eviction : Unloaded;
    import common.node : ChunkSlot;
    import common.traversal : NearbyScratch;
    import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, Corner;
    import plugins.api.flags : Flags;

    Slab!RenderChunk chunks;
    Array!(MaybeIndex!uint) renderBlocks;
    Array!uint freeRenderBlocks;
    Array!uint drawableChunks;
    Array!DrawableRecord drawableRecords;
    Array!(Maybe!uint) placedVersions;
    Array!uint unlisted;
    MeshBatch batch;
    RangeAllocator allocator;
    Maybe!uint listedVersion;
    uint listedNodes;
    uint renderBlockCount;
    uint meshedChunks;

    uint drawableCount() const {
        return cast(uint) drawableChunks.length;
    }

    void replaceNodes(uint capacity) {
        growNodes(capacity);
        placedVersions.resize(capacity);
        placedVersions.slice()[] = Maybe!uint.init;
    }

    void forgetWorld() {
        chunks.release();
        renderBlocks.clear();
        freeRenderBlocks.clear();
        renderBlockCount = 0;
        drawableChunks.clear();
        drawableRecords.clear();
        placedVersions.slice()[] = Maybe!uint.init;
        unlisted.clear();
        uint capacity = allocator.capacity;
        allocator.release();
        allocator.grow(capacity);
        listedVersion = Maybe!uint.init;
        listedNodes = 0;
        meshedChunks = 0;
    }

    void list(ref const NearbyScratch nearby, uint listVersion) {
        Maybe!uint current = Maybe!uint.of(listVersion);
        if (current != listedVersion) {
            listedVersion = current;
            refreshDrawableNodes(nearby);
        } else if (nearby.nodes.length > listedNodes) {
            refreshUnlisted(nearby);
        }
        listedNodes = cast(uint) nearby.nodes.length;
    }

    MaybeIndex!uint placeNode(ref const NearbyScratch nearby, uint chunkIndex) {
        uint render = chunkIndex / CORNER_COUNT;
        MaybeIndex!uint node = nearby.indexOf(chunks.at(chunkIndex).slot);
        if (node.exists) {
            if (placedVersions.ptr[render] != listedVersion) {
                storeNode(render, flatten(nearby.nodes.ptr[node.value].transform.m));
                placedVersions.ptr[render] = listedVersion;
            }
            return MaybeIndex!uint.of(render);
        } else {
            return MaybeIndex!uint.init;
        }
    }

    void refreshDrawableNodes(ref const NearbyScratch nearby) {
        foreach (chunkIndex; unlisted.slice()) {
            chunks.at(chunkIndex).marks.clear(ChunkMark.unlisted);
        }
        unlisted.clear();
        foreach (drawable, chunkIndex; drawableChunks.slice()) {
            MaybeIndex!uint node = placeNode(nearby, chunkIndex);
            setDrawableNode(cast(uint) drawable, recordedNode(node));
            noteNode(chunkIndex, node);
        }
    }

    void setDrawableNode(uint drawable, ListedNode node) {
        drawableRecords.ptr[drawable].node = node;
        storeDrawableNode(drawable, node);
    }

    void setDrawable(uint drawable, DrawableRecord record) {
        drawableRecords.ptr[drawable] = record;
        storeDrawable(drawable, record);
    }

    void noteNode(uint chunkIndex, MaybeIndex!uint node) {
        RenderChunk* entry = chunks.at(chunkIndex);
        entry.marks.put(ChunkMark.nodeMissing, !node.exists);
        if (!node.exists && !entry.marks.has(ChunkMark.unlisted)) {
            entry.marks.set(ChunkMark.unlisted);
            unlisted.append(chunkIndex);
        }
    }

    void refreshUnlisted(ref const NearbyScratch nearby) {
        size_t kept = 0;
        foreach (chunkIndex; unlisted.slice()) {
            RenderChunk* entry = chunks.at(chunkIndex);
            if (entry.marks.has(ChunkMark.drawable) && entry.marks.has(ChunkMark.nodeMissing)) {
                MaybeIndex!uint node = placeNode(nearby, chunkIndex);
                if (node.exists) {
                    setDrawableNode(entry.drawable, ListedNode(node.value));
                    entry.marks.clear(ChunkMark.nodeMissing);
                }
            }
            if (entry.marks.has(ChunkMark.drawable) && entry.marks.has(ChunkMark.nodeMissing)) {
                unlisted.ptr[kept] = chunkIndex;
                kept += 1;
            } else {
                entry.marks.clear(ChunkMark.unlisted);
            }
        }
        unlisted.length = kept;
    }

    void applyRecords(ref const NearbyScratch nearby) {
        foreach (worker; batch.workers.slice()) {
            foreach (record; worker.records.slice()) {
                apply(nearby, record, worker.faces.ptr[record.offset .. record.offset + record.count]);
            }
        }
    }

    uint renderIndexFor(uint block, Corner corner) {
        if (renderBlocks.length <= block) {
            renderBlocks.resize(block + 1);
        }
        if (!renderBlocks.ptr[block].exists) {
            uint render = renderBlockCount;
            if (freeRenderBlocks.length > 0) {
                render = freeRenderBlocks.ptr[freeRenderBlocks.length - 1];
                freeRenderBlocks.length -= 1;
            } else {
                renderBlockCount += 1;
                chunks.ensure(cast(size_t) renderBlockCount * CORNER_COUNT);
            }
            renderBlocks.ptr[block] = MaybeIndex!uint.of(render);
        }
        return renderBlocks.ptr[block].value * CORNER_COUNT + corner;
    }

    void apply(ref const NearbyScratch nearby, MeshRecord record, const(Quad)[] meshed) {
        uint chunkIndex = renderIndexFor(record.block.value, record.slot.corner);
        if (renderBlockCount > nodeCapacity) {
            replaceNodes(cast(uint) grownCapacity(nodeCapacity, renderBlockCount));
            refreshDrawableNodes(nearby);
        }
        RenderChunk* entry = chunks.at(chunkIndex);
        if (entry.faceCount > 0) {
            allocator.release(entry.faceOffset, entry.faceCount);
        }
        entry.faceCount = cast(uint) meshed.length;
        entry.slot = record.slot.slot;
        meshedChunks += 1;
        if (meshed.length == 0) {
            removeDrawable(chunkIndex);
        } else {
            entry.faceOffset = allocateFaces(entry.faceCount);
            uploadFaces(meshed, entry.faceOffset);
            writeDrawable(chunkIndex, record.slot, placeNode(nearby, chunkIndex));
        }
    }

    void forget(const(Unloaded)[] unloaded) {
        foreach (released; unloaded) {
            if (released.block.exists && released.block.value < renderBlocks.length && renderBlocks.ptr[released.block.value].exists) {
                uint render = renderBlocks.ptr[released.block.value].value;
                foreach (corner; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
                    uint chunkIndex = render * CORNER_COUNT + corner;
                    RenderChunk* entry = chunks.at(chunkIndex);
                    if (entry.faceCount > 0) {
                        allocator.release(entry.faceOffset, entry.faceCount);
                    }
                    removeDrawable(chunkIndex);
                    Flags!ChunkMark kept;
                    kept.put(ChunkMark.unlisted, entry.marks.has(ChunkMark.unlisted));
                    *entry = RenderChunk.init;
                    entry.marks = kept;
                }
                freeRenderBlocks.append(render);
                placedVersions.ptr[render] = Maybe!uint.init;
                renderBlocks.ptr[released.block.value] = MaybeIndex!uint.init;
            }
        }
    }

    uint allocateFaces(uint count) {
        Maybe!uint offset = allocator.allocate(count);
        if (!offset.exists) {
            growFaces(count);
            offset = allocator.allocate(count);
            assert(offset.exists);
        }
        return offset.value;
    }

    void writeDrawable(uint chunkIndex, ChunkSlot slot, MaybeIndex!uint node) {
        RenderChunk* entry = chunks.at(chunkIndex);
        if (!entry.marks.has(ChunkMark.drawable)) {
            makeDrawableRoom();
            entry.drawable = drawableCount;
            entry.marks.set(ChunkMark.drawable);
            drawableChunks.append(chunkIndex);
            drawableRecords.append(DrawableRecord.init);
        }
        setDrawable(entry.drawable, DrawableRecord(recordedNode(node), slot.corner, entry.faceOffset, entry.faceCount));
        noteNode(chunkIndex, node);
    }

    void removeDrawable(uint chunkIndex) {
        RenderChunk* entry = chunks.at(chunkIndex);
        if (entry.marks.has(ChunkMark.drawable)) {
            uint last = drawableCount - 1;
            uint movedChunk = drawableChunks.ptr[last];
            setDrawable(entry.drawable, drawableRecords.ptr[last]);
            drawableChunks.ptr[entry.drawable] = movedChunk;
            chunks.at(movedChunk).drawable = entry.drawable;
            drawableChunks.length = last;
            drawableRecords.length = last;
            entry.marks.clear(ChunkMark.drawable);
        }
    }

    void releaseDrawList() {
        batch.release();
        drawableChunks.release();
        drawableRecords.release();
        placedVersions.release();
        unlisted.release();
        allocator.release();
        chunks.release();
        renderBlocks.release();
        freeRenderBlocks.release();
    }
}

/// file: source/client/graphics/voxels/meshes.d
module client.graphics.voxels.meshes;

import core.stdc.string : memcpy;
import bindings.platform : VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BIT, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_SHADER_BIT, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, VkBuffer, VkBufferCopy, VkBufferUsageFlags, VkCommandBuffer, VkDevice, VkDeviceSize, VkDrawIndirectCommand, VkMemoryBarrier, VkPhysicalDevice, vkCmdCopyBuffer, vkCmdPipelineBarrier;
import base.array : Array, grownCapacity;
import base.maybe : MaybeIndex;
import client.graphics.matrices : MATRIX_FLOATS;
import client.graphics.pipeline : GpuBuffer;
import client.graphics.voxels.drawlist : CubeFrame, DrawList, DrawableRecord, ListedNode, cubeFrameTable;
import client.meshing : Quad;
import common.traversal : NearbyScratch;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, Corner;
import geometry.lorentz : Vec4;
import plugins.api.flags : Flags;

enum uint INITIAL_FACE_CAPACITY = 2 ^^ 20;
enum uint INITIAL_STAGING_FACES = 2 ^^ 16;
enum uint INITIAL_DRAWABLE_CAPACITY = 2 ^^ 14;
enum uint INITIAL_NODE_CAPACITY = 2 ^^ 16;

struct DrawTransform {
    float[MATRIX_FLOATS] transform;
    Vec4!float reversed;
}

enum Replaced : ubyte {
    faces,
    drawBuffers,
}

struct BufferCopy {
    VkBuffer source;
    VkBuffer destination;
    VkDeviceSize size;
}

struct ChunkMeshes {
    mixin DrawList;

    GpuBuffer faces;
    GpuBuffer staging;
    GpuBuffer cubeFrames;
    GpuBuffer nodes;
    GpuBuffer drawables;
    GpuBuffer transforms;
    GpuBuffer commands;
    Array!VkBufferCopy uploads;
    Array!BufferCopy growthCopies;
    Array!GpuBuffer retired;
    VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice;
    VkDevice device;
    uint drawableCapacity;
    uint nodeCapacity;
    uint stagedFaces;
    uint stagingCapacity;
    ubyte dimension;
    Flags!Replaced replaced;

    void setup(VkPhysicalDevice physical, VkDevice logical, ubyte chunkDimension) {
        physicalDevice = physical;
        device = logical;
        dimension = chunkDimension;
        CubeFrame[CORNER_COUNT] table = cubeFrameTable();
        cubeFrames = GpuBuffer.makeFilled(physicalDevice, device, table[], VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT);
        faces = GpuBuffer.makeDeviceLocal(physicalDevice, device, cast(VkDeviceSize) INITIAL_FACE_CAPACITY * Quad.sizeof, faceUsage());
        allocator.grow(INITIAL_FACE_CAPACITY);
        staging = GpuBuffer.makeMapped(physicalDevice, device, cast(VkDeviceSize) INITIAL_STAGING_FACES * Quad.sizeof, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT);
        stagingCapacity = INITIAL_STAGING_FACES;
        growDrawBuffers(INITIAL_DRAWABLE_CAPACITY);
        replaceNodes(INITIAL_NODE_CAPACITY);
    }

    void growNodes(uint capacity) {
        nodes = replacedMapped(nodes, cast(VkDeviceSize) capacity * MATRIX_FLOATS * float.sizeof);
        nodeCapacity = capacity;
    }

    void storeNode(uint render, float[MATRIX_FLOATS] matrix) {
        (cast(float[MATRIX_FLOATS]*) nodes.mapped)[render] = matrix;
    }

    void storeDrawableNode(uint drawable, ListedNode node) {
        (cast(DrawableRecord*) drawables.mapped)[drawable].node = node;
    }

    void storeDrawable(uint drawable, DrawableRecord record) {
        (cast(DrawableRecord*) drawables.mapped)[drawable] = record;
    }

    void makeDrawableRoom() {
        if (drawableCount == drawableCapacity) {
            growDrawBuffers(drawableCapacity * 2);
        }
    }

    GpuBuffer replacedMapped(GpuBuffer old, VkDeviceSize size) {
        retired.append(old);
        replaced.set(Replaced.drawBuffers);
        return GpuBuffer.makeMapped(physicalDevice, device, size, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT);
    }

    void growDrawBuffers(uint capacity) {
        drawables = replacedMapped(drawables, cast(VkDeviceSize) capacity * DrawableRecord.sizeof);
        memcpy(drawables.mapped, drawableRecords.ptr, drawableRecords.length * DrawableRecord.sizeof);
        retired.append(transforms);
        retired.append(commands);
        transforms = GpuBuffer.makeDeviceLocal(physicalDevice, device, cast(VkDeviceSize) capacity * DrawTransform.sizeof, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT);
        commands = GpuBuffer.makeDeviceLocal(physicalDevice, device, cast(VkDeviceSize) capacity * VkDrawIndirectCommand.sizeof, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BIT);
        drawableCapacity = capacity;
    }

    void beginFrame() {
        foreach (i; 0 .. retired.length) {
            retired.ptr[i].destroy(device);
        }
        retired.clear();
        uploads.clear();
        growthCopies.clear();
        stagedFaces = 0;
        replaced = Flags!Replaced.init;
    }

    void applyBatch(ref const NearbyScratch nearby) {
        size_t batchFaces = 0;
        foreach (worker; batch.workers.slice()) {
            batchFaces += worker.faces.length;
        }
        if (batchFaces > stagingCapacity) {
            retired.append(staging);
            stagingCapacity = cast(uint) grownCapacity(stagingCapacity, batchFaces);
            staging = GpuBuffer.makeMapped(physicalDevice, device, cast(VkDeviceSize) stagingCapacity * Quad.sizeof, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT);
        }
        applyRecords(nearby);
    }

    uint faceCountOf(MaybeIndex!uint block, Corner corner) const {
        if (block.exists && block.value < renderBlocks.length && renderBlocks.ptr[block.value].exists) {
            return chunks.at(renderBlocks.ptr[block.value].value * CORNER_COUNT + corner).faceCount;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    void uploadFaces(const(Quad)[] meshed, uint deviceOffset) {
        memcpy(cast(Quad*) staging.mapped + stagedFaces, meshed.ptr, meshed.length * Quad.sizeof);
        uploads.append(VkBufferCopy(cast(VkDeviceSize) stagedFaces * Quad.sizeof, cast(VkDeviceSize) deviceOffset * Quad.sizeof, meshed.length * Quad.sizeof));
        stagedFaces += cast(uint) meshed.length;
    }

    void growFaces(uint needed) {
        uint capacity = cast(uint) grownCapacity(allocator.capacity, allocator.capacity + needed);
        GpuBuffer larger = GpuBuffer.makeDeviceLocal(physicalDevice, device, cast(VkDeviceSize) capacity * Quad.sizeof, faceUsage());
        growthCopies.append(BufferCopy(faces.buffer, larger.buffer, cast(VkDeviceSize) allocator.capacity * Quad.sizeof));
        retired.append(faces);
        faces = larger;
        allocator.grow(capacity);
        replaced.set(Replaced.faces);
    }

    void recordUploads(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer) {
        foreach (copy; growthCopies.slice()) {
            VkBufferCopy region = VkBufferCopy(0, 0, copy.size);
            vkCmdCopyBuffer(commandBuffer, copy.source, copy.destination, 1, &region);
            transferBarrier(commandBuffer, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT);
        }
        if (uploads.length > 0) {
            vkCmdCopyBuffer(commandBuffer, staging.buffer, faces.buffer, cast(uint) uploads.length, uploads.ptr);
        }
        if (uploads.length > 0 || growthCopies.length > 0) {
            transferBarrier(commandBuffer, VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_SHADER_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT);
        }
    }

    void cleanup() {
        foreach (i; 0 .. retired.length) {
            retired.ptr[i].destroy(device);
        }
        faces.destroy(device);
        staging.destroy(device);
        cubeFrames.destroy(device);
        nodes.destroy(device);
        drawables.destroy(device);
        transforms.destroy(device);
        commands.destroy(device);
        retired.release();
        uploads.release();
        growthCopies.release();
        releaseDrawList();
    }
}

VkBufferUsageFlags faceUsage() {
    return VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
}

void transferBarrier(VkCommandBuffer commandBuffer, uint destinationAccess, uint destinationStage) {
    VkMemoryBarrier barrier;
    barrier.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
    barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    barrier.dstAccessMask = destinationAccess;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commandBuffer, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, destinationStage, 0, 1, &barrier, 0, null, 0, null);
}

module client.graphics.voxels.surface;

import core.stdc.stdlib : free;
import bindings.platform : VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT, VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY, struct LayoutPush {
    uint dimension;
    float cellRatio;
    uint[MATERIAL_WORDS] glowing;
    uint[MATERIAL_WORDS] unseen;
    uint framedMaterial;
}

struct SurfacePipeline {
    GpuBuffer commonUbo;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout commonLayout;
    VkDescriptorSetLayout staticLayout;
    VkDescriptorPool descriptorPool;
    VkDescriptorSet commonSet;
    VkDescriptorSet staticSet;
    VkPipelineLayout pipelineLayout;
    VkPipeline pipeline;
    VkImage textureImage;
    VkDeviceMemory textureMemory;
    VkImageView textureView;
    VkSampler textureSampler;

    void setup(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkRenderPass renderPass, VkQueue queue, VkCommandPool commandPool, VkImageView depthView, VkImageView glowView) {
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding[3] commonBindings = [
            layoutBinding(COMMON_UBO_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT),
            layoutBinding(DEPTH_INPUT_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT),
            layoutBinding(GLOW_INPUT_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT),
        ];
        commonLayout = createSetLayout(device, commonBindings[]);
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding[3] staticBindings = [
            layoutBinding(FACES_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT),
            layoutBinding(TEXTURE_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT),
            layoutBinding(TRANSFORMS_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT),
        ];
        staticLayout = createSetLayout(device, staticBindings[]);
        allocateSets(device);
        commonUbo = GpuBuffer.makeMapped(physicalDevice, device, CommonUniforms.sizeof, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT);
        createTextureArray(physicalDevice, device, queue, commandPool);
        writeDescriptors(device, depthView, glowView);
        createPipeline(device, renderPass);
    }

    void allocateSets(VkDevice device) {
        VkDescriptorPoolSize[4] sizes = [
            VkDescriptorPoolSize(VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, 1),
            VkDescriptorPoolSize(VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 2),
            VkDescriptorPoolSize(VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 1),
            VkDescriptorPoolSize(VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT, 2),
        ];
        VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo poolInfo;
        poolInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO;
        poolInfo.maxSets = 2;
        poolInfo.poolSizeCount = sizes.length;
        poolInfo.pPoolSizes = sizes.ptr;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateDescriptorPool(device, &poolInfo, null, &descriptorPool));
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[2] setLayouts = [
            commonLayout,
            staticLayout,
        ];
        VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo allocateInfo;
        allocateInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        allocateInfo.descriptorPool = descriptorPool;
        allocateInfo.descriptorSetCount = setLayouts.length;
        allocateInfo.pSetLayouts = setLayouts.ptr;
        VkDescriptorSet[2] allocated;
        expectSuccess(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(device, &allocateInfo, allocated.ptr));
        commonSet = allocated[0];
        staticSet = allocated[1];
    }

    void writeDescriptors(VkDevice device, VkImageView depthView, VkImageView glowView) {
        VkDescriptorBufferInfo commonInfo = VkDescriptorBufferInfo(commonUbo.buffer, 0, WHOLE_SIZE);
        VkDescriptorImageInfo textureInfo = VkDescriptorImageInfo(textureSampler, textureView, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
        VkDescriptorImageInfo depthInfo = VkDescriptorImageInfo(null, depthView, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
        VkDescriptorImageInfo glowInfo = VkDescriptorImageInfo(null, glowView, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
        VkWriteDescriptorSet[4] writes = [
            bufferWrite(commonSet, COMMON_UBO_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, &commonInfo),
            imageWrite(commonSet, DEPTH_INPUT_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT, &depthInfo),
            imageWrite(commonSet, GLOW_INPUT_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT, &glowInfo),
            imageWrite(staticSet, TEXTURE_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, &textureInfo),
        ];
        vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, writes.length, writes.ptr, 0, null);
    }

    void bindStorage(VkDevice device, uint binding, VkBuffer buffer) {
        VkDescriptorBufferInfo info = VkDescriptorBufferInfo(buffer, 0, WHOLE_SIZE);
        VkWriteDescriptorSet write = bufferWrite(staticSet, binding, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, &info);
        vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, 1, &write, 0, null);
    }

    void createPipeline(VkDevice device, VkRenderPass renderPass) {
        VkShaderModule vertexShader = createShader(device, VOXELS_VERT_SPV);
        VkShaderModule fragmentShader = createShader(device, VOXELS_FRAG_SPV);
        VkDescriptorSetLayout[2] setLayouts = [
            commonLayout,
            staticLayout,
        ];
        VkPushConstantRange[1] pushConstants = [
            VkPushConstantRange(VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, 0, LayoutPush.sizeof),
        ];
        pipelineLayout = createPipelineLayout(device, setLayouts[], pushConstants[]);
        PipelineSettings settings = PipelineSettings(
            pipelineLayout,
            renderPass,
            vertexShader,
            fragmentShader,
            VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST,
            0,
            Blend.opaque,
            Depth.written,
            Culling.backFaces,
            Outputs.colorAndGlow,
        );
        pipeline = createGraphicsPipeline(device, settings);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, vertexShader, null);
        vkDestroyShaderModule(device, fragmentShader, null);
    }

    void createTextureArray(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device, VkQueue queue, VkCommandPool commandPool) {
        ubyte[] pixels = makeTexturePixels();
        GpuBuffer staging = GpuBuffer.makeFilled(physicalDevice, device, pixels, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT);
        free(pixels.ptr);
        VkImageSubresourceRange range = VkImageSubresourceRange(VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, TEXTURE_MIPS, 0, TEXTURE_LAYERS);
        createTextureImage(physicalDevice, device);
        uploadTexture(device, queue, commandPool, staging.buffer, range);
        staging.destroy(device);
        VkImageViewCreateInfo viewInfo;
        viewInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO;
        viewInfo.image = textureImage;
        viewInfo.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY;
        viewInfo.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;
        viewInfo.subresourceRange = range;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateImageView(device, &viewInfo, null, &textureView));
        VkSamplerCreateInfo samplerInfo;
        samplerInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO;
        samplerInfo.magFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR;
        samplerInfo.minFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR;
        samplerInfo.mipmapMode = VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_LINEAR;
        samplerInfo.addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
        samplerInfo.addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
        samplerInfo.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
        samplerInfo.maxLod = TEXTURE_MIPS;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateSampler(device, &samplerInfo, null, &textureSampler));
    }

    void createTextureImage(VkPhysicalDevice physicalDevice, VkDevice device) {
        VkImageCreateInfo imageInfo;
        imageInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO;
        imageInfo.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
        imageInfo.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;
        imageInfo.extent = VkExtent3D(TEXTURE_SIZE, TEXTURE_SIZE, 1);
        imageInfo.mipLevels = TEXTURE_MIPS;
        imageInfo.arrayLayers = TEXTURE_LAYERS;
        imageInfo.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        imageInfo.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
        imageInfo.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
        imageInfo.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        imageInfo.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        expectSuccess(vkCreateImage(device, &imageInfo, null, &textureImage));
        textureMemory = bindDeviceLocalImage(physicalDevice, device, textureImage);
    }

    void uploadTexture(VkDevice device, VkQueue queue, VkCommandPool commandPool, VkBuffer staging, VkImageSubresourceRange range) {
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo commandInfo;
        commandInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO;
        commandInfo.commandPool = commandPool;
        commandInfo.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
        commandInfo.commandBufferCount = 1;
        VkCommandBuffer commands;
        expectSuccess(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device, &commandInfo, &commands));
        recordTextureUpload(commands, staging, range);
        VkSubmitInfo submitInfo;
        submitInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO;
        submitInfo.commandBufferCount = 1;
        submitInfo.pCommandBuffers = &commands;
        expectSuccess(vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &submitInfo, null));
        expectSuccess(vkQueueWaitIdle(queue));
        vkFreeCommandBuffers(device, commandPool, 1, &commands);
    }

    void recordTextureUpload(VkCommandBuffer commands, VkBuffer staging, VkImageSubresourceRange range) {
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo beginInfo;
        beginInfo.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO;
        vkBeginCommandBuffer(commands, &beginInfo);
        VkImageMemoryBarrier barrier;
        barrier.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER;
        barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex = QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex = QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        barrier.image = textureImage;
        barrier.subresourceRange = range;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, null, 0, null, 1, &barrier);
        VkBufferImageCopy[TEXTURE_MIPS] regions;
        foreach (mip; 0 .. TEXTURE_MIPS) {
            regions[mip].bufferOffset = mipOffset(mip);
            regions[mip].imageSubresource = VkImageSubresourceLayers(VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, mip, 0, TEXTURE_LAYERS);
            regions[mip].imageExtent = VkExtent3D(TEXTURE_SIZE >> mip, TEXTURE_SIZE >> mip, 1);
        }
        vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(commands, staging, textureImage, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, TEXTURE_MIPS, regions.ptr);
        barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
        barrier.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, 0, 0, null, 0, null, 1, &barrier);
        vkEndCommandBuffer(commands);
    }

    void updateInputDescriptors(VkDevice device, VkImageView depthView, VkImageView glowView) {
        VkDescriptorImageInfo depthInfo = VkDescriptorImageInfo(null, depthView, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
        VkDescriptorImageInfo glowInfo = VkDescriptorImageInfo(null, glowView, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
        VkWriteDescriptorSet[2] writes = [
            imageWrite(commonSet, DEPTH_INPUT_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT, &depthInfo),
            imageWrite(commonSet, GLOW_INPUT_BINDING, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT, &glowInfo),
        ];
        vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, writes.length, writes.ptr, 0, null);
    }

    void updateCommonUbo(CommonUniforms uniforms) {
        *cast(CommonUniforms*) commonUbo.mapped = uniforms;
    }

    void cleanup(VkDevice device) {
        vkDestroyPipeline(device, pipeline, null);
        vkDestroyPipelineLayout(device, pipelineLayout, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorPool(device, descriptorPool, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(device, commonLayout, null);
        vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(device, staticLayout, null);
        vkDestroySampler(device, textureSampler, null);
        vkDestroyImageView(device, textureView, null);
        vkDestroyImage(device, textureImage, null);
        vkFreeMemory(device, textureMemory, null);
        commonUbo.destroy(device);
    }
}

module client.graphics.voxels.textures;

import core.stdc.math : floorf;
import core.stdc.stdlib : free, malloc;
import base.numbers : clamped, higherOf;
import base.splitmix : SplitMix;
import client.meshing : WINDOWS_PER_SIDE;

import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum uint TEXELS_PER_WINDOW = 16;
enum uint TEXTURE_SIZE = WINDOWS_PER_SIDE * TEXELS_PER_WINDOW;
enum uint TEXTURE_MIPS = 9;
enum uint TEXTURE_LAYERS = Material.max;
enum uint TEXEL_BYTES = 4;
enum uint COLOR_CHANNELS = 3;
enum ubyte TEXTURE_OPAQUE = 255;
enum ubyte TEXTURE_CLEAR = 0;
enum float CHANNEL_MOST = 255;
enum uint CORNERS_PER_TEXEL = 4;
enum ulong OCTAVE_SALT = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15;
enum uint LAYER_SHIFT = 37;

struct Octave {
    uint cell;
    float weight;
}

immutable Octave[4] OCTAVES = [
    Octave(1, 0.2f),
    Octave(2, 0.25f),
    Octave(8, 0.3f),
    Octave(32, 0.25f),
];

immutable float[Material.max + 1] GRAIN = [

float latticeAt(ulong salt, uint u, uint v) {
    return 2 * SplitMix(salt ^ (cast(ulong) u << 20) ^ v).roll() - 1;
}

float smoothed(float share) {
    return share * share * (3 - 2 * share);
}

float octaveAt(ulong salt, uint cell, uint u, uint v) {
    uint side = TEXTURE_SIZE / cell;
    uint lowU = u / cell;
    uint lowV = v / cell;
    uint highU = (lowU + 1) % side;
    uint highV = (lowV + 1) % side;
    float acrossU = smoothed((u % cell) / cast(float) cell);
    float acrossV = smoothed((v % cell) / cast(float) cell);
    float near = latticeAt(salt, lowU, lowV) * (1 - acrossU) + latticeAt(salt, highU, lowV) * acrossU;
    float far = latticeAt(salt, lowU, highV) * (1 - acrossU) + latticeAt(salt, highU, highV) * acrossU;
    return near * (1 - acrossV) + far * acrossV;
}

float[] makeNoise() {
    float[] noise = (cast(float*) malloc(TEXTURE_SIZE * TEXTURE_SIZE * float.sizeof))[0 .. TEXTURE_SIZE * TEXTURE_SIZE];
    foreach (v; 0 .. TEXTURE_SIZE) {
        foreach (u; 0 .. TEXTURE_SIZE) {
            float sum = 0;
            foreach (index, octave; OCTAVES) {
                sum += octave.weight * octaveAt(OCTAVE_SALT * (index + 1), octave.cell, u, v);
            }
            noise[v * TEXTURE_SIZE + u] = sum;
        }
    }
    return noise;
}

bool insideFrame(uint u, uint v) {
    return u >= TEXELS_PER_WINDOW && v >= TEXELS_PER_WINDOW && u < TEXTURE_SIZE - TEXELS_PER_WINDOW && v < TEXTURE_SIZE - TEXELS_PER_WINDOW;
}

size_t mipBytes(uint mip) {
    size_t side = TEXTURE_SIZE >> mip;
    return side * side * TEXEL_BYTES * TEXTURE_LAYERS;
}

size_t mipOffset(uint mip) {
    size_t offset = 0;
    foreach (level; 0 .. mip) {
        offset += mipBytes(level);
    }
    return offset;
}

size_t textureBytes() {
    return mipOffset(TEXTURE_MIPS);
}

ubyte shaded(ubyte channel, float shade) {
    return cast(ubyte) clamped(floorf(channel * shade + 0.5f), 0.0f, CHANNEL_MOST);
}

void fillFirstMip(ubyte[] pixels) {
    float[] noise = makeNoise();
    size_t at = 0;
    foreach (layer; 0 .. TEXTURE_LAYERS) {
        Material material = cast(Material)(layer + 1);
        float grain = GRAIN[material];
        uint shift = layer * LAYER_SHIFT;
        foreach (v; 0 .. TEXTURE_SIZE) {
            foreach (u; 0 .. TEXTURE_SIZE) {
                float shade = 1 + grain * noise[((v + shift) % TEXTURE_SIZE) * TEXTURE_SIZE + (u + shift) % TEXTURE_SIZE];
                pixels[at] = shaded(MATERIAL_COLORS[material].red, shade);
                pixels[at + 1] = shaded(MATERIAL_COLORS[material].green, shade);
                pixels[at + 2] = shaded(MATERIAL_COLORS[material].blue, shade);
                pixels[at + COLOR_CHANNELS] = TEXTURE_OPAQUE;
                if (material == Material.glass && insideFrame(u, v)) {
                    pixels[at + COLOR_CHANNELS] = TEXTURE_CLEAR;
                }
                at += TEXEL_BYTES;
            }
        }
    }
    free(noise.ptr);
}

void downsample(const(ubyte)[] from, ubyte[] to, uint side) {
    foreach (layer; 0 .. TEXTURE_LAYERS) {
        foreach (y; 0 .. side / 2) {
            foreach (x; 0 .. side / 2) {
                uint[COLOR_CHANNELS] sum = 0;
                uint opaque = 0;
                ubyte alpha = TEXTURE_CLEAR;
                foreach (corner; 0 .. CORNERS_PER_TEXEL) {
                    size_t source = (layer * side * side + (y * 2 + corner / 2) * side + x * 2 + corner % 2) * TEXEL_BYTES;
                    if (from[source + COLOR_CHANNELS] != TEXTURE_CLEAR) {
                        foreach (channel; 0 .. COLOR_CHANNELS) {
                            sum[channel] += from[source + channel];
                        }
                        opaque += 1;
                    }
                    alpha = higherOf(alpha, from[source + COLOR_CHANNELS]);
                }
                size_t target = (layer * (side / 2) * (side / 2) + y * (side / 2) + x) * TEXEL_BYTES;
                foreach (channel; 0 .. COLOR_CHANNELS) {
                    to[target + channel] = cast(ubyte)(sum[channel] / higherOf(opaque, 1u));
                }
                to[target + COLOR_CHANNELS] = alpha;
            }
        }
    }
}

ubyte[] makeTexturePixels() {
    ubyte[] pixels = (cast(ubyte*) malloc(textureBytes()))[0 .. textureBytes()];
    fillFirstMip(pixels);
    foreach (mip; 1 .. TEXTURE_MIPS) {
        downsample(pixels[mipOffset(mip - 1) .. mipOffset(mip)], pixels[mipOffset(mip) .. mipOffset(mip) + mipBytes(mip)], TEXTURE_SIZE >> (mip - 1));
    }
    return pixels;
}
