const(char)[] worldNameOf(ref const Worldgen worldgen) {
    final switch (worldgen.kind) {
        case WorldgenKind.terrain:
            return "terrain";
        case WorldgenKind.plane:
            return "plane";
        case WorldgenKind.structure:
            return worldgen.structureName();
    }
}

enum MouseCapture : ubyte {
    released,
    captured,
}

struct FrameMeter {
    double last = 0;
    float fps = 0;
    float worstFrameMs = 0;
    uint frames;

    static FrameMeter startingAt(double now) {
        FrameMeter meter;
        meter.last = now;
        return meter;
    }

    bool tick(double now, ref FrameClock clock) {
        frames += 1;
        bool refreshed = now - last >= STATUS_INTERVAL_SECONDS;
        if (refreshed) {
            fps = cast(float)(frames / (now - last));
            worstFrameMs = cast(float)(clock.worst * MILLISECONDS_PER_SECOND);
            clock.worst = 0;
            frames = 0;
            last = now;
        }
        return refreshed;
    }
}

char[STATUS_CAPACITY] statusLine(ref const Game game, MouseCapture mouse, ref const FrameMeter meter) {
    char[STATUS_CAPACITY] text;
    string mode = ENUM_NAMES!MovementMode[game.mode];
    string preset = ENUM_NAMES!Preset[game.preset];
    const(char)[] world = worldNameOf(game.world.graph.worldgen);
    final switch (mouse) {
        case MouseCapture.captured:
            snprintf(text.ptr, text.length, "mined - %.*s ([ ]) - %.*s (V) - %.*s (P) - [%u] - Esc to release mouse - FPS %.0f, worst frame %.0fms", cast(int) world.length, world.ptr, cast(int) mode.length, mode.ptr, cast(int) preset.length, preset.ptr, game.inventory.selected + 1, cast(double) meter.fps, cast(double) meter.worstFrameMs);
            break;
        case MouseCapture.released:
            snprintf(text.ptr, text.length, "mined - %.*s ([ ]) - %.*s (V) - %.*s (P) - click to capture mouse - FPS %.0f, worst frame %.0fms", cast(int) world.length, world.ptr, cast(int) mode.length, mode.ptr, cast(int) preset.length, preset.ptr, cast(double) meter.fps, cast(double) meter.worstFrameMs);
            break;
    }
    return text;
}

const(char)[] stateLine(ref const Game game, char[] buffer) {
    string mode = ENUM_NAMES!MovementMode[game.mode];
    string preset = ENUM_NAMES!Preset[game.preset];
    const(char)[] world = worldNameOf(game.world.graph.worldgen);
    int written = snprintf(buffer.ptr, buffer.length, "%.*s   %.*s   %.*s", cast(int) world.length, world.ptr, cast(int) mode.length, mode.ptr, cast(int) preset.length, preset.ptr);
    return buffer[0 .. lowerOf(cast(size_t) higherOf(written, 0), buffer.length - 1)];
}

struct Growth {
    Array!uint seen;
    Array!uint placeOf;
    Array!uint queue;
    uint[GROWTH_STEPS + 1] within;
    uint generation;
    MaybeIndex!uint countedSlot;
    uint countedVersion;
    uint countedEpoch;
    size_t countedNodes;

    void update(ref const LocalWorld world) {
        MaybeIndex!uint start = world.graph.slotOf(world.cameraPosition.node);
        size_t nodes = world.nearby[world.published].nodes.length;
        if (start != countedSlot || world.nearbyVersion != countedVersion || world.epoch != countedEpoch || nodes > 2 * countedNodes) {
            count(world, start.value);
            countedSlot = start;
            countedVersion = world.nearbyVersion;
            countedEpoch = world.epoch;
            countedNodes = nodes;
        }
    }

    void count(ref const LocalWorld world, uint start) {
        const(Graph)* graph = &world.graph;
        const(NearbyScratch)* nearby = &world.nearby[world.published];
        generation += 1;
        seen.resize(graph.slotCount);
        placeOf.resize(graph.slotCount);
        queue.clear();
        visit(start);
        size_t first = 0;
        foreach (step; 0 .. GROWTH_STEPS + 1) {
            within[step] = cast(uint) queue.length;
            size_t end = queue.length;
            if (step < GROWTH_STEPS) {
                foreach (index; first .. end) {
                    uint slot = queue.ptr[index];
                    foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                        MaybeIndex!uint next = graph.neighborSlot(slot, cast(Face) face);
                        if (next.exists && seen.ptr[next.value] != generation && nearby.indexOf(next.value).exists) {
                            visit(next.value);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            first = end;
        }
    }

    void visit(uint slot) {
        seen.ptr[slot] = generation;
        placeOf.ptr[slot] = cast(uint) queue.length;
        queue.append(slot);
    }

    bool isCounted(uint slot) const {
        return slot < seen.length && seen.ptr[slot] == generation;
    }

    void release() {
        seen.release();
        placeOf.release();
        queue.release();
    }
}

struct DiskPoint {
    ScreenPoint at;
    float share;
}

struct Hud {
    Array!HudVertex vertices;
    Array!Marker markers;
    Array!DiskPoint disk;
    Growth growth;
    GlyphAtlas atlas;
    Ratio[MESSENGER_COUNT][TRACE_POINTS] trace;
    uint traced;
    float width = 0;
    float height = 0;
    float scale = 1;

    void rect(float x, float y, float w, float h, uint color) {
        quad(ScreenPoint(x, y), ScreenPoint(x + w, y), ScreenPoint(x + w, y + h), ScreenPoint(x, y + h), color);
    }

    void quad(ScreenPoint a, ScreenPoint b, ScreenPoint c, ScreenPoint d, uint color) {
        texturedQuad(a, b, c, d, color, [WHITE_TEXEL, WHITE_TEXEL, WHITE_TEXEL, WHITE_TEXEL]);
    }

    void texturedQuad(ScreenPoint a, ScreenPoint b, ScreenPoint c, ScreenPoint d, uint color, uint[4] texels) {
        if (vertices.length + QUAD_VERTICES <= MOST_VERTICES) {
            vertex(a, color, texels[0]);
            vertex(b, color, texels[1]);
            vertex(c, color, texels[2]);
            vertex(c, color, texels[2]);
            vertex(d, color, texels[3]);
            vertex(a, color, texels[0]);
        }
    }

    void vertex(ScreenPoint at, uint color, uint texel) {
        vertices.append(HudVertex(ScreenPoint(2 * at.x / width - 1, 2 * at.y / height - 1), color, texel));
    }

    void text(float x, float top, const(char)[] line, uint color) {
        float pen = floorf(x);
        float baseline = floorf(top) + atlas.ascent;
        foreach (character; line) {
            if (character >= FIRST_CHARACTER && character <= LAST_CHARACTER) {
                AtlasGlyph glyph = atlas.glyphs[character - FIRST_CHARACTER];
                if (glyph.box.width > 0 && glyph.box.height > 0) {
                    float left = pen + glyph.box.left;
                    float upper = baseline + glyph.box.top;
                    float right = left + glyph.box.width;
                    float lower = upper + glyph.box.height;
                    uint atlasRight = glyph.atlasX + glyph.box.width;
                    uint atlasLower = glyph.atlasY + glyph.box.height;
                    texturedQuad(ScreenPoint(left, upper), ScreenPoint(right, upper), ScreenPoint(right, lower), ScreenPoint(left, lower), color, [texelOf(glyph.atlasX, glyph.atlasY), texelOf(atlasRight, glyph.atlasY), texelOf(atlasRight, atlasLower), texelOf(glyph.atlasX, atlasLower)]);
                }
            }
            pen += atlas.advance;
        }
    }

    float textWidth(const(char)[] line) const {
        return cast(float) line.length * atlas.advance;
    }

    void line(ScreenPoint from, ScreenPoint to, float thickness, uint color) {
        float dx = to.x - from.x;
        float dy = to.y - from.y;
        float length = sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (length > 0) {
            float nx = -dy / length * thickness * 0.5f;
            float ny = dx / length * thickness * 0.5f;
            quad(ScreenPoint(from.x + nx, from.y + ny), ScreenPoint(to.x + nx, to.y + ny), ScreenPoint(to.x - nx, to.y - ny), ScreenPoint(from.x - nx, from.y - ny), color);
        }
    }

    void circle(ScreenPoint center, float radius, uint fill, uint rim) {
        foreach (segment; 0 .. CIRCLE_SEGMENTS) {
            ScreenPoint a = onCircle(center, radius, segment);
            ScreenPoint b = onCircle(center, radius, segment + 1);
            if (vertices.length + 3 <= MOST_VERTICES) {
                vertex(center, fill, WHITE_TEXEL);
                vertex(a, fill, WHITE_TEXEL);
                vertex(b, fill, WHITE_TEXEL);
            }
            line(a, b, scale, rim);
        }
    }

    void buildMarkers(ref const Game game) {
        markers.clear();
        const(NearbyScratch)* nearby = &game.world.nearby[game.world.published];
        foreach (ref thrown; game.thrown.slice()) {
            addMarker(game, nearby, thrown.position, BLOCK_HALF, THROWN_COLOR);
            foreach (ref point; thrown.trail[0 .. lowerOf(thrown.trailCount, TRAIL_POINTS)]) {
                addMarker(game, nearby, point, TRAIL_HALF, TRAIL_COLOR);
            }
        }
    }

    void addMarker(ref const Game game, const(NearbyScratch)* nearby, Position position, float half, uint color) {
        MaybeIndex!uint slot = game.world.graph.slotOf(position.node);
        if (slot.exists) {
            MaybeIndex!uint index = nearby.indexOf(slot.value);
            if (index.exists) {
                markers.append(Marker(nearby.nodes.ptr[index.value].transform * position.local, half, color));
            }
        }
    }

    void build(ref const Game game, uint pixelsWide, uint pixelsHigh) {
        vertices.clear();
        width = pixelsWide;
        height = pixelsHigh;
        scale = higherOf(1u, pixelsHigh / BASE_HEIGHT);
        atlas.ensure(emPixelsFor(pixelsHigh));
        if (game.world.cameraNearbyIndex().exists) {
            growth.update(game.world);
            buildPoincareDisk(game);
        }
        buildCompass(game);
        buildState(game);
        buildBody(game);
        buildHotbar(game);
        Maybe!Material aimed = game.world.targetMaterial();
        if (aimed.exists && aimed.value == Material.bench) {
            buildBench(game);
        } else if (game.isScanShown) {
            buildScan(game.scan.value);
        }
    }

    void buildBench(ref const Game game) {
        float margin = MARGIN * scale;
        float padding = TEXT_PADDING * scale;
        float row = atlas.lineHeight + padding;
        float cell = atlas.lineHeight / 2;
        float label = textWidth(BENCH_LONGEST_LABEL);
        size_t genes = game.organism.genome.count;
        size_t seeds = lowerOf(game.seeds.length, cast(size_t) SEEDS_SHOWN);
        float panelWidth = higherOf(label + STRIP_CELLS * cell + 3 * padding, textWidth(BENCH_TITLE) + 2 * padding);
        float left = width - margin - panelWidth;
        float top = 2 * margin + 2 * DISK_SHARE * height;
        rect(left, top, panelWidth, (genes + seeds + 1) * row + 2 * padding, PANEL);
        float x = left + padding;
        float y = top + padding;
        text(x, y, BENCH_TITLE, WHITE);
        y += row;
        foreach (index, ref gene; game.organism.genome.slice()) {
            char[RECEPTOR_LABEL_CAPACITY] buffer;
            int written = snprintf(buffer.ptr, buffer.length, "gene %zu", index + 1);
            text(x, y, buffer[0 .. lowerOf(cast(size_t) higherOf(written, 0), buffer.length - 1)], WHITE);
            foreach (letter; 0 .. lowerOf(cast(uint) gene.length, STRIP_CELLS)) {
                rect(x + label + letter * cell, y, cell - scale, atlas.lineHeight, letterColor(gene.letters[letter]));
            }
            y += row;
        }
        foreach (shown; 0 .. seeds) {
            const(Seed)* seed = &game.seeds.ptr[game.seeds.length - 1 - shown];
            char[RECEPTOR_LABEL_CAPACITY] buffer;
            int written = snprintf(buffer.ptr, buffer.length, "seed %zu", shown + 1);
            text(x, y, buffer[0 .. lowerOf(cast(size_t) higherOf(written, 0), buffer.length - 1)], CYAN);
            foreach (nibble; 0 .. STRIP_CELLS) {
                ulong value = seed.genes.seeds[nibble / NIBBLES_PER_SEED_SHOWN] >> (4 * (nibble % NIBBLES_PER_SEED_SHOWN));
                rect(x + label + nibble * cell, y, cell - scale, atlas.lineHeight, letterColor(cast(ushort)(value & 0xF)));
            }
            y += row;
        }
    }

    void buildScan(ref const Scan scan) {
        float margin = MARGIN * scale;
        float padding = TEXT_PADDING * scale;
        float row = atlas.lineHeight + padding;
        float label = textWidth(SCAN_LONGEST_LABEL);
        float bar = BAR_SHARE * height;
        float plot = SCAN_PLOT_SHARE * height;
        float panelWidth = label + bar + 3 * padding;
        float left = width - margin - panelWidth;
        float top = 2 * margin + 2 * DISK_SHARE * height;
        rect(left, top, panelWidth, 5 * row + plot + 3 * padding, PANEL);
        float x = left + padding;
        float y = top + padding;
        string name = ENUM_NAMES!Material[scan.plant];
        text(x, y, name, WHITE);
        y += row;
        uint[4] counts;
        foreach (cell; 0 .. GRID_CELLS) {
            Fragment fragment = scan.product.fragmentAt(cell);
            if (fragment.isPresent) {
                counts[0] += 1;
                foreach (property; 0 .. PROPERTY_COUNT) {
                    if (fragment.has(cast(Property) property)) {
                        counts[1 + property] += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        foreach (index, count; counts) {
            text(x, y, SCAN_LABELS[index], WHITE);
            rect(x + label, y, bar, atlas.lineHeight, faded(WHITE, BAR_BACK_SHARE));
            rect(x + label, y, bar * lowerOf(cast(float) count / SCAN_MOST_FRAGMENTS, 1.0f), atlas.lineHeight, GOLD);
            y += row;
        }
        float plotLeft = x;
        float plotTop = y + padding;
        float plotWidth = label + bar;
        rect(plotLeft, plotTop, plotWidth, plot, faded(WHITE, BAR_BACK_SHARE / 2));
        foreach (index; 0 .. scan.receptors) {
            uint color = faded(WHITE, BAR_BACK_SHARE * 2);
            if (scan.efficacy[index].value > 0) {
                color = GOLD;
            } else if (scan.efficacy[index].value < 0) {
                color = CYAN;
            }
            foreach (point; 1 .. ASSAY_POINTS) {
                line(assayPoint(plotLeft, plotTop, plotWidth, plot, point - 1, scan.affinity[index].value), assayPoint(plotLeft, plotTop, plotWidth, plot, point, scan.affinity[index].value), scale, color);
            }
        }
    }

    void buildHotbar(ref const Game game) {
        const(Inventory)* inventory = &game.inventory;
        float side = HOTBAR_SHARE * height;
        float gap = TEXT_PADDING * scale;
        float total = HOTBAR_SLOTS * side + (HOTBAR_SLOTS - 1) * gap;
        float left = floorf((width - total) / 2);
        float top = height - MARGIN * scale - side;
        foreach (slot; 0 .. HOTBAR_SLOTS) {
            float x = left + slot * (side + gap);
            Material material = inventory.hotbar[slot];
            uint count = inventory.counts[material];
            rect(x, top, side, side, PANEL);
            if (material != Material.none && count > 0) {
                ByteColor color = MATERIAL_COLORS[material];
                float inset = side * SWATCH_INSET_SHARE;
                rect(x + inset, top + inset, side - 2 * inset, side - 2 * inset, rgba(color.red, color.green, color.blue, 255));
                char[COUNT_LABEL_CAPACITY] buffer;
                int written = snprintf(buffer.ptr, buffer.length, "%u", count);
                const(char)[] label = buffer[0 .. lowerOf(cast(size_t) higherOf(written, 0), buffer.length - 1)];
                rect(x + side - textWidth(label) - gap, top + side - atlas.lineHeight, textWidth(label), atlas.lineHeight, PANEL);
                text(x + side - textWidth(label) - gap, top + side - atlas.lineHeight, label, WHITE);
            }
            if (slot == inventory.selected) {
                ScreenPoint[4] corners = [ScreenPoint(x, top), ScreenPoint(x + side, top), ScreenPoint(x + side, top + side), ScreenPoint(x, top + side)];
                foreach (index; 0 .. 4) {
                    line(corners[index], corners[(index + 1) % 4], NEEDLE_THICKNESS * scale, GOLD);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void buildBody(ref const Game game) {
        const(Organism)* organism = &game.organism;
        recordTrace(organism.signaling);
        if (organism.body.count > 0) {
            float margin = MARGIN * scale;
            float padding = TEXT_PADDING * scale;
            float row = atlas.lineHeight + padding;
            float label = textWidth(LONGEST_LABEL);
            float bar = BAR_SHARE * height;
            float traceHeight = TRACE_SHARE * height;
            size_t rows = SIGNAL_COUNT + organism.receptors.length;
            float top = 2 * margin + atlas.lineHeight + 2 * padding;
            float left = margin + padding;
            rect(margin, top, label + bar + 3 * padding, rows * row + traceHeight + 3 * padding, PANEL);
            float y = top + padding;
            Ratio[SIGNAL_COUNT] signals = organism.signaling.signals();
            foreach (signal; 0 .. SIGNAL_COUNT) {
                text(left, y, SIGNAL_NAMES[signal], WHITE);
                centeredBar(left + label, y, bar, atlas.lineHeight, signals[signal].value / SIGNAL_RANGE);
                y += row;
            }
            foreach (index, occupied; organism.occupancy.slice()) {
                const(Receptor)* receptor = &organism.receptors.ptr[index];
                char[RECEPTOR_LABEL_CAPACITY] buffer;
                int written = snprintf(buffer.ptr, buffer.length, "%c%c bound", cast(char)(FIRST_HALF_NAME + receptor.firstHalf), cast(char)(FIRST_HALF_NAME + receptor.secondHalf));
                text(left, y, buffer[0 .. lowerOf(cast(size_t) higherOf(written, 0), buffer.length - 1)], WHITE);
                rect(left + label, y, bar, atlas.lineHeight, faded(WHITE, BAR_BACK_SHARE));
                rect(left + label, y, bar * lowerOf(occupied.value, 1.0f), atlas.lineHeight, CYAN);
                y += row;
            }
            drawTrace(left, y + padding, label + bar, traceHeight);
        }
    }

    void centeredBar(float x, float y, float w, float h, float share) {
        float middle = x + w / 2;
        float reach = w / 2 * lowerOf(higherOf(share, -1.0f), 1.0f);
        rect(x, y, w, h, faded(WHITE, BAR_BACK_SHARE));
        if (reach >= 0) {
            rect(middle, y, reach, h, GOLD);
        } else {
            rect(middle + reach, y, -reach, h, CYAN);
        }
        rect(middle, y, scale, h, WHITE);
    }

    void recordTrace(ref const Signaling signaling) {
        trace[traced % TRACE_POINTS] = signaling.messengers;
        traced += 1;
    }

    void drawTrace(float x, float y, float w, float h) {
        uint shown = lowerOf(traced, TRACE_POINTS);
        foreach (messenger; 0 .. MESSENGER_COUNT) {
            foreach (point; 1 .. shown) {
                ScreenPoint from = tracePoint(x, y, w, h, point - 1, shown, messenger);
                ScreenPoint to = tracePoint(x, y, w, h, point, shown, messenger);
                line(from, to, scale, TRACE_COLORS[messenger]);
            }
        }
    }

    ScreenPoint tracePoint(float x, float y, float w, float h, uint point, uint shown, uint messenger) const {
        uint index = (traced - shown + point) % TRACE_POINTS;
        float level = lowerOf(higherOf(trace[index][messenger].value / TRACE_RANGE, 0.0f), 1.0f);
        return ScreenPoint(x + w * point / (TRACE_POINTS - 1), y + h * (1 - level));
    }

    void buildState(ref const Game game) {
        char[STATUS_CAPACITY] buffer;
        const(char)[] shown = stateLine(game, buffer[]);
        float margin = MARGIN * scale;
        float padding = TEXT_PADDING * scale;
        rect(margin, margin, textWidth(shown) + 2 * padding, atlas.lineHeight + 2 * padding, PANEL);
        text(margin + padding, margin + padding, shown, WHITE);
    }

    void buildCompass(ref const Game game) {
        float radius = COMPASS_SHARE * height;
        ScreenPoint center = ScreenPoint(width - MARGIN * scale - radius, height - MARGIN * scale - radius);
        circle(center, radius, PANEL, RIM);
        float off = game.compassOff().value;
        ScreenPoint ahead = ScreenPoint(center.x, center.y - radius * 0.8f);
        line(center, ahead, scale, faded(WHITE, 0.45f));
        ScreenPoint tip = ScreenPoint(center.x - sinf(off) * radius * 0.92f, center.y - cosf(off) * radius * 0.92f);
        line(center, tip, NEEDLE_THICKNESS * scale, GOLD);
        Maybe!float nearest;
        foreach (beacon; game.beacons.slice()) {
            BeaconSighting sighting = game.sightingOf(beacon);
            float toward = game.yawToward(sighting.direction).value;
            ScreenPoint end = ScreenPoint(center.x - sinf(toward) * radius * BEACON_NEEDLE_SHARE, center.y - cosf(toward) * radius * BEACON_NEEDLE_SHARE);
            line(center, end, NEEDLE_THICKNESS * scale, CYAN);
            if (!nearest.exists || sighting.distance.value < nearest.value) {
                nearest = Maybe!float.of(sighting.distance.value);
            }
        }
        if (nearest.exists) {
            char[COUNT_LABEL_CAPACITY] buffer;
            int written = snprintf(buffer.ptr, buffer.length, "%.1f", cast(double) nearest.value);
            const(char)[] label = buffer[0 .. lowerOf(cast(size_t) higherOf(written, 0), buffer.length - 1)];
            text(center.x - textWidth(label) / 2, center.y - radius - atlas.lineHeight - TEXT_PADDING * scale, label, CYAN);
        }
    }

    void buildPoincareDisk(ref const Game game) {
        float radius = DISK_SHARE * height;
        ScreenPoint center = ScreenPoint(width - MARGIN * scale - radius, MARGIN * scale + radius);
        circle(center, radius, PANEL, RIM);
        const(LocalWorld)* world = &game.world;
        const(Graph)* graph = &world.graph;
        const(NearbyScratch)* nearby = &world.nearby[world.published];
        Motion!float level = Quaternion.fromAxisAngle(Vec3!float(1, 0, 0), game.camera.pitch.value).toMotion() * world.cameraInNearbyFrame().inverse();
        const(uint)[] nearest = growth.queue.slice()[0 .. lowerOf(growth.queue.length, MOST_DISK_NODES)];
        disk.resize(nearest.length);
        foreach (index, slot; nearest) {
            disk.ptr[index] = onDisk(level * nearby.nodes.ptr[nearby.indexOf(slot).value].transform.m.column(3));
        }
        foreach (index, slot; nearest) {
            DiskPoint from = disk.ptr[index];
            if (from.share > 0) {
                foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                    MaybeIndex!uint next = graph.neighborSlot(slot, cast(Face) face);
                    if (next.exists && next.value > slot && growth.isCounted(next.value) && growth.placeOf.ptr[next.value] < nearest.length && disk.ptr[growth.placeOf.ptr[next.value]].share > 0) {
                        DiskPoint to = disk.ptr[growth.placeOf.ptr[next.value]];
                        line(placed(center, radius, from.at), placed(center, radius, to.at), LINK_THICKNESS * scale, faded(CYAN, lowerOf(from.share, to.share)));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        line(center, ScreenPoint(center.x, center.y - 4 * scale), NEEDLE_THICKNESS * scale, GOLD);
        rect(center.x - scale, center.y - scale, 2 * scale, 2 * scale, WHITE);
    }

    void release() {
        vertices.release();
        markers.release();
        disk.release();
        growth.release();
        atlas.release();
    }
}

uint letterColor(ushort letter) {
    uint mixed = cast(uint)(letter * LETTER_COLOR_MULTIPLIER);
    return rgba(LETTER_COLOR_FLOOR + (mixed & LETTER_COLOR_MASK), LETTER_COLOR_FLOOR + ((mixed >> 8) & LETTER_COLOR_MASK), LETTER_COLOR_FLOOR + ((mixed >> 16) & LETTER_COLOR_MASK), 255);
}

ScreenPoint assayPoint(float x, float y, float w, float h, uint point, float affinity) {
    float share = cast(float) point / (ASSAY_POINTS - 1);
    float concentration = powf(10, LEAST_ASSAY_DECADE + share * ASSAY_DECADES);
    float occupied = concentration / (concentration + affinity);
    return ScreenPoint(x + w * share, y + h * (1 - occupied));
}

ScreenPoint onCircle(ScreenPoint center, float radius, uint segment) {
    float angle = segment * 2 * PI / CIRCLE_SEGMENTS;
    return ScreenPoint(center.x + cosf(angle) * radius, center.y + sinf(angle) * radius);
}

ScreenPoint placed(ScreenPoint center, float radius, ScreenPoint at) {
    return ScreenPoint(center.x + at.x * radius, center.y + at.y * radius);
}

DiskPoint onDisk(Vec4!float point) {
    float height = asinhf(point.c[1]);
    float share = 1 - height * height / (DISK_BAND * DISK_BAND);
    if (!(point.c[3] < DISK_FARTHEST_W) || !(share > 0)) {
        return DiskPoint(ScreenPoint(0, 0), 0);
    } else {
        float foot = sqrtf(1 + point.c[1] * point.c[1]);
        float over = 1 / (foot + point.c[3]);
        return DiskPoint(ScreenPoint(point.c[0] * over, point.c[2] * over), share);
    }
}

/// file: source/client/images.d
module client.images;

import core.stdc.string : memcpy;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;

enum int CHANGE_THRESHOLD = 8;
enum int DIFFERENCE_GAIN = 4;
enum uint COMPARED_CHANNELS = 3;
enum uint RGBA_BYTES = 4;
enum ubyte OPAQUE = 255;

struct ImageDifference {
    double changed = 0;
    double meanDelta = 0;
    int largestDelta;
}

int channelDelta(ubyte a, ubyte b) {
    if (a > b) {
        return a - b;
    } else {
        return b - a;
    }
}

ImageDifference differenceOf(const(ubyte)[] first, const(ubyte)[] second, uint stride, size_t pixels) {
    ImageDifference difference;
    size_t changed = 0;
    ulong total = 0;
    foreach (pixel; 0 .. pixels) {
        int largest = 0;
        foreach (channel; 0 .. COMPARED_CHANNELS) {
            int delta = channelDelta(first[pixel * stride + channel], second[pixel * stride + channel]);
            total += delta;
            largest = higherOf(delta, largest);
        }
        if (largest > CHANGE_THRESHOLD) {
            changed += 1;
        }
        difference.largestDelta = higherOf(largest, difference.largestDelta);
    }
    if (pixels > 0) {
        difference.changed = cast(double) changed / pixels;
        difference.meanDelta = cast(double) total / (pixels * COMPARED_CHANNELS);
    }
    return difference;
}

void writeDifference(ubyte[] rgba, const(ubyte)[] first, const(ubyte)[] second, uint stride, size_t pixels) {
    foreach (pixel; 0 .. pixels) {
        foreach (channel; 0 .. COMPARED_CHANNELS) {
            int delta = channelDelta(first[pixel * stride + channel], second[pixel * stride + channel]);
            rgba[pixel * RGBA_BYTES + channel] = cast(ubyte) lowerOf(delta * DIFFERENCE_GAIN, int(OPAQUE));
        }
        rgba[pixel * RGBA_BYTES + COMPARED_CHANNELS] = OPAQUE;
    }
}

enum PixelOrder : ubyte {
    rgba,
    bgra,
}

void copyAsRgba(ubyte[] rgba, const(ubyte)[] source, PixelOrder order) {
    memcpy(rgba.ptr, source.ptr, rgba.length);
    if (order == PixelOrder.bgra) {
        foreach (pixel; 0 .. rgba.length / RGBA_BYTES) {
            rgba[pixel * RGBA_BYTES] = source[pixel * RGBA_BYTES + 2];
            rgba[pixel * RGBA_BYTES + 2] = source[pixel * RGBA_BYTES];
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/client/meshing.d
module client.meshing;

import core.stdc.stdlib : free, malloc;
import core.stdc.string : memcpy;
import base.array : Array;
import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;
import base.splitmix : SplitMix;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.material : isOccluding, isShownAgainst;
import common.neighbors : acrossBorder, chunkNeighborSlot, indexIn, isCellOccupied, isOutside;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkSlot, ChunkState, cellIndex;
import geometry.cube : AXIS_COUNT, DIRECTIONS, beyondBoundary, boundaryOf;
import plugins.api.api : Material;
import plugins.api.flags : Flags;

enum uint CORNERS_PER_FACE = 4;
enum uint OCCLUSION_LEVELS = 3;
enum uint COORD_BITS = 8;
enum uint AXIS_SHIFT = 3 * COORD_BITS;
enum uint OCCLUSION_SHIFT = 24;
enum uint OCCLUSION_BITS = 2;
enum uint REVERSED_BIT = 1 << 2;
enum uint FLIPPED_BIT = 1 << 3;
enum uint WINDOW_SHIFT = 16;
enum uint WINDOW_BITS = 8;
enum uint WINDOWS_PER_SIDE = 1 << (WINDOW_BITS / 2);
enum uint CHUNK_SEED_SHIFT = 40;
enum uint CELL_SEED_SHIFT = 2;

enum Facing : ubyte {
    outward,
    inward,
}

enum CornerCell : ubyte {
    edgeB,
    edgeC,
    diagonal,
}

struct Quad {
    uint posAxis;
    uint occlusionMaterial;

    static Quad fromVoxel(Vec3!int voxel, size_t axis, Facing facing, Material material, uint[CORNERS_PER_FACE] occlusion, uint window) {
        uint axisCode = cast(uint) axis;
        if (facing == Facing.inward) {
            axisCode |= REVERSED_BIT;
        }
        if (isDiagonalFlipped(occlusion)) {
            axisCode |= FLIPPED_BIT;
        }
        uint packed = material | window << WINDOW_SHIFT;
        foreach (corner; 0 .. CORNERS_PER_FACE) {
            packed |= occlusion[corner] << (OCCLUSION_SHIFT + OCCLUSION_BITS * corner);
        }
        return Quad(cast(uint) voxel.x | cast(uint) voxel.y << COORD_BITS | cast(uint) voxel.z << (2 * COORD_BITS) | axisCode << AXIS_SHIFT, packed);
    }
}

struct ChunkCells {
    const(Material)* padded;
    const(Graph)* graph;
    ChunkSlot chunk;
    ubyte dimension;
    uint stride;
    ulong seed;

    uint windowOf(size_t index, size_t axis) const {
        return cast(uint)(SplitMix(seed ^ (index << CELL_SEED_SHIFT | axis)).next() >> (ulong.sizeof * 8 - WINDOW_BITS));
    }

    bool isOccupied(Vec3!int voxel) const {
        uint outside = 0;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
            if (isOutside(dimension, voxel[axis])) {
                outside += 1;
            }
        }
        if (outside > 1) {
            return (*graph).isCellOccupied(chunk, voxel);
        } else {
            return isOccluding(padded[paddedIndex(dimension, voxel)]);
        }
    }

    uint[CORNERS_PER_FACE] faceOcclusion(Vec3!int base, size_t axis) const {
        size_t bAxis = (axis + 1) % AXIS_COUNT;
        size_t cAxis = (axis + 2) % AXIS_COUNT;
        uint[CORNERS_PER_FACE] result;
        foreach (corner; 0 .. CORNERS_PER_FACE) {
            int stepB = cast(int)(corner & 1) * 2 - 1;
            int stepC = cast(int)(corner >> 1) * 2 - 1;
            Vec3!int edgeB = base;
            edgeB[bAxis] += stepB;
            Vec3!int edgeC = base;
            edgeC[cAxis] += stepC;
            Vec3!int diagonal = edgeB;
            diagonal[cAxis] += stepC;
            Flags!CornerCell occupied;
            occupied.put(CornerCell.edgeB, isOccupied(edgeB));
            occupied.put(CornerCell.edgeC, isOccupied(edgeC));
            occupied.put(CornerCell.diagonal, isOccupied(diagonal));
            result[corner] = cornerOcclusion(occupied);
        }
        return result;
    }

    uint extractQuads(Quad* quads) const {
        size_t side = dimension + 2;
        size_t[AXIS_COUNT] strides = [1, side, side * side];
        uint count = 0;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
            size_t bAxis = (axis + 1) % AXIS_COUNT;
            size_t cAxis = (axis + 2) % AXIS_COUNT;
            size_t step = strides[axis];
            foreach (c; 0 .. dimension) {
                foreach (b; 0 .. dimension) {
                    size_t rowStart = (b + 1) * strides[bAxis] + (c + 1) * strides[cAxis] + step;
                    for (uint a = 0; a <= dimension; a += stride) {
                        size_t index = rowStart + a * step;
                        Maybe!Facing facing = facingAt(padded[index], padded[index - step], a);
                        if (facing.exists) {
                            Vec3!int voxel;
                            voxel[axis] = cast(int) a;
                            voxel[bAxis] = cast(int) b;
                            voxel[cAxis] = cast(int) c;
                            Vec3!int base = voxel;
                            base[axis] -= solidSideStep(facing.value);
                            quads[count] = Quad.fromVoxel(voxel, axis, facing.value, solidMaterial(index, step, facing.value), faceOcclusion(base, axis), windowOf(index, axis));
                            count += 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    Maybe!Facing facingAt(Material self, Material other, uint a) const {
        bool otherShows = isShownAgainst(other, self);
        bool selfShows = isShownAgainst(self, other);
        if (otherShows && (a < dimension || selfShows)) {
            return Maybe!Facing.of(Facing.inward);
        } else if (!otherShows && a > 0 && selfShows) {
            return Maybe!Facing.of(Facing.outward);
        } else {
            return Maybe!Facing.init;
        }
    }

    Material solidMaterial(size_t index, size_t step, Facing facing) const {
        if (facing == Facing.inward) {
            return padded[index - step];
        } else {
            return padded[index];
        }
    }
}

struct Mesher {
    Quad* quads;
    Material* padded;

    void setup(ubyte dimension) {
        quads = cast(Quad*) malloc(maxQuads(dimension) * Quad.sizeof);
        padded = cast(Material*) malloc(paddedCellCount(dimension));
    }

    void release() {
        free(quads);
        free(padded);
        quads = null;
        padded = null;
    }

    const(Quad)[] mesh(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk) {
        pad(graph, chunk);
        ulong seed = graph.idAt(chunk.slot).spice() ^ (cast(ulong) chunk.corner << CHUNK_SEED_SHIFT);
        uint stride = 1;
        if (graph.chunks.at(chunk).voxels.isUniform()) {
            stride = graph.layout.dimension;
        }
        ChunkCells cells = ChunkCells(padded, &graph, chunk, graph.layout.dimension, stride, seed);
        return quads[0 .. cells.extractQuads(quads)];
    }

    void pad(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk) {
        ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
        const(Chunk)* own = graph.chunks.at(chunk);
        foreach (z; 0 .. dimension) {
            foreach (y; 0 .. dimension) {
                Material* row = padded + paddedIndex(dimension, Vec3!int(0, y, z));
                if (own.voxels.isUniform()) {
                    row[0 .. dimension] = own.voxels.fill;
                } else {
                    memcpy(row, own.voxels.cells(dimension).ptr + cellIndex(dimension, 0, y, z), dimension);
                }
            }
        }
        foreach (direction; DIRECTIONS) {
            Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(chunk, direction);
            const(Chunk)* other = null;
            if (neighbor.exists && graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).state == ChunkState.populated) {
                other = graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value);
            }
            size_t u = (direction.axis + 1) % AXIS_COUNT;
            size_t v = (direction.axis + 2) % AXIS_COUNT;
            Vec3!int past;
            past[direction.axis] = beyondBoundary(dimension, direction.sign);
            Vec3!int inside;
            inside[direction.axis] = boundaryOf(dimension, direction.sign);
            foreach (j; 0 .. dimension) {
                foreach (i; 0 .. dimension) {
                    past[u] = i;
                    past[v] = j;
                    inside[u] = i;
                    inside[v] = j;
                    if (other is null) {
                        padded[paddedIndex(dimension, past)] = own.voxels.at(indexIn(dimension, inside));
                    } else {
                        padded[paddedIndex(dimension, past)] = other.voxels.at(indexIn(dimension, acrossBorder(dimension, chunk.corner, past, direction)));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

struct MeshRecord {
    ChunkSlot slot;
    MaybeIndex!uint block;
    uint offset;
    uint count;
}

struct WorkerMeshes {
    Mesher mesher;
    Array!Quad faces;
    Array!MeshRecord records;
    Array!ChunkSlot waiting;
    Array!ChunkSlot dropped;
}

struct MeshBatch {
    Array!WorkerMeshes workers;
    const(Graph)* graph;

    void prepare(ref const Graph source, uint workerCount, ubyte dimension) {
        graph = &source;
        while (workers.length < workerCount) {
            workers.append(WorkerMeshes.init);
            workers.ptr[workers.length - 1].mesher.setup(dimension);
        }
        foreach (i; 0 .. workers.length) {
            workers.ptr[i].faces.clear();
            workers.ptr[i].records.clear();
            workers.ptr[i].waiting.clear();
            workers.ptr[i].dropped.clear();
        }
    }

    void requeueWaiting(ref Graph target) {
        foreach (worker; workers.slice()) {
            foreach (slot; worker.waiting.slice()) {
                target.markChanged(slot);
            }
            foreach (slot; worker.dropped.slice()) {
                Chunk* chunk = target.chunks.existing(slot);
                if (chunk.state == ChunkState.dropped) {
                    chunk.state = ChunkState.generating;
                    target.chunks.restores.append(slot);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (i; 0 .. workers.length) {
            workers.ptr[i].mesher.release();
            workers.ptr[i].faces.release();
            workers.ptr[i].records.release();
            workers.ptr[i].waiting.release();
            workers.ptr[i].dropped.release();
        }
        workers.release();
    }
}

bool isBesideUnsettled(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot slot) {
    foreach (direction; DIRECTIONS) {
        Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(slot, direction);
        if (neighbor.exists && (graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).state == ChunkState.generating || graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).state == ChunkState.dropped)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void meshJob(void* context, size_t index, uint worker) {
    MeshBatch* batch = cast(MeshBatch*) context;
    const(Graph)* graph = batch.graph;
    ChunkSlot slot = graph.chunks.pending()[index];
    const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(slot);
    WorkerMeshes* output = &batch.workers.ptr[worker];
    if (chunk.state == ChunkState.populated && !chunk.voxels.isOpaqueFill()) {
        foreach (direction; DIRECTIONS) {
            Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = (*graph).chunkNeighborSlot(slot, direction);
            if (neighbor.exists && graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).state == ChunkState.dropped) {
                output.dropped.append(neighbor.value);
            }
        }
        if ((*graph).isBesideUnsettled(slot)) {
            output.waiting.append(slot);
        } else {
            const(Quad)[] meshed = output.mesher.mesh(*graph, slot);
            output.records.append(MeshRecord(slot, graph.chunks.blockOf(slot.slot), cast(uint) output.faces.length, cast(uint) meshed.length));
            output.faces.appendAll(meshed);
        }
    }
}

size_t paddedIndex(ubyte dimension, Vec3!int cell) {
    size_t side = dimension + 2;
    return (cell.x + 1) + (cell.y + 1) * side + (cell.z + 1) * side * side;
}

size_t paddedCellCount(ubyte dimension) {
    size_t side = dimension + 2;
    return side * side * side;
}

uint maxQuads(ubyte dimension) {
    return AXIS_COUNT * (dimension * dimension * dimension + dimension * dimension);
}

uint cornerOcclusion(Flags!CornerCell occupied) {
    if (occupied.has(CornerCell.edgeB) && occupied.has(CornerCell.edgeC)) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        uint level = OCCLUSION_LEVELS;
        foreach (cell; [CornerCell.edgeB, CornerCell.edgeC, CornerCell.diagonal]) {
            if (occupied.has(cell)) {
                level -= 1;
            }
        }
        return level;
    }
}

bool isDiagonalFlipped(uint[CORNERS_PER_FACE] occlusion) {
    return occlusion[1] + occlusion[2] > occlusion[0] + occlusion[3];
}

int solidSideStep(Facing facing) {
    if (facing == Facing.inward) {
        return 0;
    } else {
        return 1;
    }
}

/// file: source/client/plugins.d
module client.plugins;

import core.stdc.string : strlen;
import base.flags : Readiness;
import base.stdio : fprintf, snprintf, stderr;
import plugins.api.api : ENTRY, Entry, Registry, RisingKind, Structure;

enum size_t MAX_STRUCTURES = 64;
enum size_t MAX_KINDS = 32;
enum size_t MAX_LANDMARKS = 32;
enum size_t PATH_CAPACITY = 4096;
enum string PLUGIN_DIRECTORY = "lib";
version (WebAssembly) {
    import arbor = plugins.arbor.plugin;
    import babel = plugins.babel.plugin;
    import backrooms = plugins.backrooms.plugin;
    import city = plugins.city.plugin;
    import crown = plugins.crown.plugin;
    import fixtures = plugins.fixtures.plugin;
    import lattice = plugins.lattice.plugin;
    import library = plugins.library.plugin;
    import palace = plugins.palace.plugin;
    import planet = plugins.planet.plugin;
    import road = plugins.road.plugin;
    import tower = plugins.tower.plugin;
    import trail = plugins.trail.plugin;
} else version (OSX) {
    import core.sys.posix.dirent : DIR, closedir, dirent, opendir, readdir;
    import core.sys.posix.dlfcn : RTLD_NOW, dlerror, dlopen, dlsym;
    import core.sys.posix.stdlib : realpath;

    enum string LIBRARY_SUFFIX = ".dylib";

    extern (C) int _NSGetExecutablePath(char* buffer, uint* size) nothrow @nogc;

    size_t executablePath(ref char[PATH_CAPACITY] resolved) {
        char[PATH_CAPACITY] path = 0;
        uint size = cast(uint) path.length;
        int status = _NSGetExecutablePath(path.ptr, &size);
        if (status != 0) {
            return 0;
        } else {
            const(char)* found = realpath(path.ptr, resolved.ptr);
            if (found is null) {
                return 0;
            } else {
                return strlen(resolved.ptr);
            }
        }
    }
} else {
    import core.sys.posix.dirent : DIR, closedir, dirent, opendir, readdir;
    import core.sys.posix.dlfcn : RTLD_NOW, dlerror, dlopen, dlsym;
    import core.sys.posix.unistd : readlink;

    enum string LIBRARY_SUFFIX = ".so";

    size_t executablePath(ref char[PATH_CAPACITY] path) {
        ptrdiff_t length = readlink("/proc/self/exe", path.ptr, path.length);
        if (length <= 0 || length == path.length) {
            return 0;
        } else {
            return cast(size_t) length;
        }
    }
}

void sortByName(T)(string[] names, T[] items) {
    foreach (index; 1 .. names.length) {
        string name = names[index];
        T item = items[index];
        size_t at = index;
        while (at > 0 && isOrderedAfter(names[at - 1], name)) {
            names[at] = names[at - 1];
            items[at] = items[at - 1];
            at -= 1;
        }
        names[at] = name;
        items[at] = item;
    }
}

bool isOrderedAfter(const(char)[] a, const(char)[] b) {
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < a.length && index < b.length && a[index] == b[index]) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index == a.length || index == b.length) {
        return a.length > b.length;
    } else {
        return a[index] > b[index];
    }
}

struct Worlds {
    string[MAX_STRUCTURES] names;
    Structure[MAX_STRUCTURES] structures;
    size_t count;
    string[MAX_KINDS] kindNames;
    RisingKind[MAX_KINDS] risingKinds;
    size_t kindCount;
    string[MAX_LANDMARKS] landmarkNames;
    Structure[MAX_LANDMARKS] landmarks;
    size_t landmarkCount;

    void sort() {
        sortByName(names[0 .. count], structures[0 .. count]);
        sortByName(kindNames[0 .. kindCount], risingKinds[0 .. kindCount]);
        sortByName(landmarkNames[0 .. landmarkCount], landmarks[0 .. landmarkCount]);
    }

    version (WebAssembly) {
        void gather() {
            Registry registry = Registry(&this, &add, &addKind, &addLandmark);
            Entry[13] entries = [&arbor.plugin, &babel.plugin, &backrooms.plugin, &city.plugin, &crown.plugin, &fixtures.plugin, &lattice.plugin, &library.plugin, &palace.plugin, &planet.plugin, &road.plugin, &tower.plugin, &trail.plugin];
            foreach (entry; entries) {
                entry(&registry);
            }
            sort();
        }
    } else {
        void gather() {
            char[PATH_CAPACITY] directory = 0;
            size_t length = executablePath(directory);
            while (length > 0 && directory[length - 1] != '/') {
                length -= 1;
            }
            if (length == 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "cannot find the executable's own path, so no plugins are loaded\n");
            } else {
                snprintf(directory.ptr + length, directory.length - length, "%s", PLUGIN_DIRECTORY.ptr);
                gatherFrom(directory.ptr);
                sort();
            }
        }

        void gatherFrom(const(char)* path) {
            DIR* directory = opendir(path);
            if (directory is null) {
                fprintf(stderr, "cannot open the plugin directory '%s'\n", path);
            } else {
                dirent* entry = readdir(directory);
                while (entry !is null) {
                    const(char)[] name = entry.d_name.ptr[0 .. strlen(entry.d_name.ptr)];
                    if (name.length > LIBRARY_SUFFIX.length && name[$ - LIBRARY_SUFFIX.length .. $] == LIBRARY_SUFFIX) {
                        load(path, name);
                    }
                    entry = readdir(directory);
                }
                closedir(directory);
            }
        }

        void load(const(char)* directory, const(char)[] file) {
            char[PATH_CAPACITY] path = 0;
            snprintf(path.ptr, path.length, "%s/%.*s", directory, cast(int) file.length, file.ptr);
            void* library = dlopen(path.ptr, RTLD_NOW);
            if (library is null) {
                fprintf(stderr, "cannot load the plugin '%s': %s\n", path.ptr, dlerror());
            } else {
                Entry plugin = cast(Entry) dlsym(library, ENTRY.ptr);
                if (plugin is null) {
                    fprintf(stderr, "the plugin '%s' has no '%s'; it may have been built against another version of the API\n", path.ptr, ENTRY.ptr);
                } else {
                    Registry registry = Registry(&this, &add, &addKind, &addLandmark);
                    plugin(&registry);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    const(string)[] allNames() const return {
        return names[0 .. count];
    }

    Structure find(const(char)[] name) const {
        size_t index = 0;
        while (index < count && names[index] != name) {
            index += 1;
        }
        if (index < count) {
            return structures[index];
        } else {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

void add(const(Registry)* registry, const(char)* name, Structure world) {
    Worlds* worlds = cast(Worlds*) registry.host;
    if (worlds.count == MAX_STRUCTURES) {
        fprintf(stderr, "too many worlds, '%s' is left out (at most %zu)\n", name, MAX_STRUCTURES);
    } else {
        worlds.names[worlds.count] = cast(string) name[0 .. strlen(name)];
        worlds.structures[worlds.count] = world;
        worlds.count += 1;
    }
}

void addKind(const(Registry)* registry, const(char)* name, const(RisingKind)* kind) {
    Worlds* worlds = cast(Worlds*) registry.host;
    if (worlds.kindCount == MAX_KINDS) {
        fprintf(stderr, "too many rising kinds, '%s' is left out (at most %zu)\n", name, MAX_KINDS);
    } else {
        worlds.kindNames[worlds.kindCount] = cast(string) name[0 .. strlen(name)];
        worlds.risingKinds[worlds.kindCount] = *kind;
        worlds.kindCount += 1;
    }
}

void addLandmark(const(Registry)* registry, const(char)* name, Structure landmark) {
    Worlds* worlds = cast(Worlds*) registry.host;
    if (worlds.landmarkCount == MAX_LANDMARKS) {
        fprintf(stderr, "too many landmarks, '%s' is left out (at most %zu)\n", name, MAX_LANDMARKS);
    } else {
        worlds.landmarkNames[worlds.landmarkCount] = cast(string) name[0 .. strlen(name)];
        worlds.landmarks[worlds.landmarkCount] = landmark;
        worlds.landmarkCount += 1;
    }
}

__gshared Worlds gathered;
__gshared Readiness gatheredState;

void gatherWorlds() {
    gathered.gather();
    gatheredState = Readiness.ready;
}

ref const(Worlds) registry() {
    assert(gatheredState == Readiness.ready);
    return gathered;
}

/// file: source/client/png.d
module client.png;

import core.stdc.stdio : FILE, SEEK_END, SEEK_SET, fclose, fopen, fread, fseek, ftell, fwrite;
import core.stdc.stdlib : free, malloc;
import core.stdc.string : memcpy;
import base.maybe : Maybe;

enum uint CRC_POLYNOMIAL = 0xEDB88320;
enum uint CRC_TABLE_SIZE = 256;
enum uint ADLER_MODULUS = 65521;
enum uint STORED_BLOCK_LIMIT = 65535;
enum ubyte ZLIB_METHOD = 0x78;
enum ubyte ZLIB_FLAGS = 0x01;
enum ubyte FINAL_BLOCK = 1;
enum ubyte MORE_BLOCKS = 0;
enum ubyte FILTER_NONE = 0;
enum ubyte BIT_DEPTH = 8;
enum ubyte COLOR_TYPE_RGB = 2;
enum uint RGB_BYTES = 3;
enum uint RGBA_BYTES = 4;
enum uint HEADER_BYTES = 13;
enum uint STORED_BLOCK_HEADER_BYTES = 5;
enum uint ZLIB_HEADER_BYTES = 2;
enum uint CHUNK_LENGTH_BYTES = 4;
enum uint CHUNK_KIND_BYTES = 4;
enum uint CHUNK_CRC_BYTES = 4;
enum uint ADLER_BYTES = 4;
enum uint CRC_INITIAL = 0xFFFFFFFF;
enum uint BYTE_MASK = 0xFF;

immutable ubyte[8] PNG_SIGNATURE = [
    0x89,
    'P',
    'N',
    'G',
    '\r',
    '\n',
    0x1A,
    '\n',
];

uint[CRC_TABLE_SIZE] buildCrcTable() {
    uint[CRC_TABLE_SIZE] table;
    foreach (n; 0 .. CRC_TABLE_SIZE) {
        uint c = n;
        foreach (_; 0 .. 8) {
            if ((c & 1) != 0) {
                c = CRC_POLYNOMIAL ^ (c >> 1);
            } else {
                c = c >> 1;
            }
        }
        table[n] = c;
    }
    return table;
}

immutable uint[CRC_TABLE_SIZE] CRC_TABLE = buildCrcTable();

uint crcUpdate(uint crc, const(ubyte)[] data) {
    uint c = crc;
    foreach (value; data) {
        c = CRC_TABLE[(c ^ value) & BYTE_MASK] ^ (c >> 8);
    }
    return c;
}

uint crc32(const(ubyte)[] data) {
    return crcUpdate(CRC_INITIAL, data) ^ CRC_INITIAL;
}

uint adler32(const(ubyte)[] data) {
    uint a = 1;
    uint b = 0;
    foreach (value; data) {
        a = (a + value) % ADLER_MODULUS;
        b = (b + a) % ADLER_MODULUS;
    }
    return (b << 16) | a;
}

void putBigEndian(ubyte* target, uint value) {
    target[0] = cast(ubyte)(value >> 24);
    target[1] = cast(ubyte)(value >> 16);
    target[2] = cast(ubyte)(value >> 8);
    target[3] = cast(ubyte) value;
}

size_t chunkSize(size_t dataBytes) {
    return CHUNK_LENGTH_BYTES + CHUNK_KIND_BYTES + dataBytes + CHUNK_CRC_BYTES;
}

size_t putChunk(ubyte* target, const(char)[4] kind, const(ubyte)[] data) {
    putBigEndian(target, cast(uint) data.length);
    memcpy(target + CHUNK_LENGTH_BYTES, kind.ptr, CHUNK_KIND_BYTES);
    memcpy(target + CHUNK_LENGTH_BYTES + CHUNK_KIND_BYTES, data.ptr, data.length);
    putBigEndian(target + CHUNK_LENGTH_BYTES + CHUNK_KIND_BYTES + data.length, crcUpdate(crcUpdate(CRC_INITIAL, cast(const(ubyte)[]) kind[]), data) ^ CRC_INITIAL);
    return chunkSize(data.length);
}

size_t storedSize(size_t raw) {
    size_t blocks = (raw + STORED_BLOCK_LIMIT - 1) / STORED_BLOCK_LIMIT;
    return ZLIB_HEADER_BYTES + raw + blocks * STORED_BLOCK_HEADER_BYTES + ADLER_BYTES;
}

size_t deflateStored(const(ubyte)[] raw, ubyte* output) {
    size_t at = 0;
    output[at] = ZLIB_METHOD;
    output[at + 1] = ZLIB_FLAGS;
    at += ZLIB_HEADER_BYTES;
    size_t consumed = 0;
    while (consumed < raw.length) {
        size_t length = raw.length - consumed;
        ubyte kind = FINAL_BLOCK;
        if (length > STORED_BLOCK_LIMIT) {
            length = STORED_BLOCK_LIMIT;
            kind = MORE_BLOCKS;
        }
        output[at] = kind;
        output[at + 1] = cast(ubyte) length;
        output[at + 2] = cast(ubyte)(length >> 8);
        output[at + 3] = cast(ubyte) ~length;
        output[at + 4] = cast(ubyte)(~length >> 8);
        at += STORED_BLOCK_HEADER_BYTES;
        memcpy(output + at, raw.ptr + consumed, length);
        at += length;
        consumed += length;
    }
    putBigEndian(output + at, adler32(raw));
    return at + ADLER_BYTES;
}

struct PngImage {
    ubyte* rgb;
    uint width;
    uint height;

    bool isRead() const {
        return rgb !is null;
    }

    const(ubyte)[] pixels() const {
        return rgb[0 .. cast(size_t) width * height * RGB_BYTES];
    }

    void release() {
        free(rgb);
        rgb = null;
    }
}

bool writePng(const(char)* path, uint width, uint height, const(ubyte)[] rgba) {
    ubyte[] bytes = encodePng(width, height, rgba);
    FILE* file = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (file is null) {
        free(bytes.ptr);
        return false;
    } else {
        size_t written = fwrite(bytes.ptr, 1, bytes.length, file);
        int closeStatus = fclose(file);
        free(bytes.ptr);
        return written == bytes.length && closeStatus == 0;
    }
}

PngImage readPng(const(char)* path) {
    FILE* file = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (file is null) {
        return PngImage.init;
    } else {
        fseek(file, 0, SEEK_END);
        long length = ftell(file);
        fseek(file, 0, SEEK_SET);
        ubyte* bytes = cast(ubyte*) malloc(cast(size_t) length + 1);
        size_t read = fread(bytes, 1, cast(size_t) length, file);
        fclose(file);
        PngImage image;
        if (length > 0 && read == cast(size_t) length) {
            image = decodePng(bytes[0 .. read]);
        }
        free(bytes);
        return image;
    }
}

uint getBigEndian(const(ubyte)* source) {
    return (cast(uint) source[0] << 24) | (cast(uint) source[1] << 16) | (cast(uint) source[2] << 8) | source[3];
}

Maybe!size_t gatherDeflated(const(ubyte)[] bytes, ref PngImage image, ubyte* deflated) {
    if (bytes.length < PNG_SIGNATURE.length || bytes[0 .. PNG_SIGNATURE.length] != PNG_SIGNATURE[]) {
        return Maybe!size_t.init;
    }
    size_t at = PNG_SIGNATURE.length;
    size_t deflatedBytes = 0;
    while (at + chunkSize(0) <= bytes.length) {
        size_t length = getBigEndian(bytes.ptr + at);
        const(char)[] kind = cast(const(char)[]) bytes[at + CHUNK_LENGTH_BYTES .. at + CHUNK_LENGTH_BYTES + CHUNK_KIND_BYTES];
        size_t data = at + CHUNK_LENGTH_BYTES + CHUNK_KIND_BYTES;
        if (data + length + CHUNK_CRC_BYTES > bytes.length) {
            return Maybe!size_t.init;
        } else if (kind == "IHDR") {
            image.width = getBigEndian(bytes.ptr + data);
            image.height = getBigEndian(bytes.ptr + data + 4);
            if (length != HEADER_BYTES || bytes[data + 8] != BIT_DEPTH || bytes[data + 9] != COLOR_TYPE_RGB) {
                return Maybe!size_t.init;
            }
        } else if (kind == "IDAT") {
            memcpy(deflated + deflatedBytes, bytes.ptr + data, length);
            deflatedBytes += length;
        } else if (kind == "IEND") {
            return Maybe!size_t.of(deflatedBytes);
        }
        at = data + length + CHUNK_CRC_BYTES;
    }
    return Maybe!size_t.init;
}

ubyte* unfiltered(const(ubyte)* raw, size_t rowBytes, size_t height) {
    ubyte* rgb = cast(ubyte*) malloc((rowBytes - 1) * height);
    foreach (row; 0 .. height) {
        if (raw[row * rowBytes] != FILTER_NONE) {
            free(rgb);
            return null;
        }
        memcpy(rgb + row * (rowBytes - 1), raw + row * rowBytes + 1, rowBytes - 1);
    }
    return rgb;
}

PngImage decodePng(const(ubyte)[] bytes) {
    PngImage image;
    ubyte* deflated = cast(ubyte*) malloc(bytes.length);
    Maybe!size_t deflatedBytes = gatherDeflated(bytes, image, deflated);
    if (deflatedBytes.exists && image.width > 0 && image.height > 0) {
        size_t rowBytes = 1 + cast(size_t) image.width * RGB_BYTES;
        size_t rawBytes = rowBytes * image.height;
        ubyte* raw = cast(ubyte*) malloc(rawBytes + 1);
        bool inflated = inflateStored(deflated[0 .. deflatedBytes.value], raw[0 .. rawBytes]);
        if (inflated) {
            image.rgb = unfiltered(raw, rowBytes, image.height);
        }
        free(raw);
    }
    free(deflated);
    return image;
}

bool inflateStored(const(ubyte)[] deflated, ubyte[] raw) {
    if (deflated.length < ZLIB_HEADER_BYTES + ADLER_BYTES || deflated[0] != ZLIB_METHOD) {
        return false;
    }
    size_t at = ZLIB_HEADER_BYTES;
    size_t produced = 0;
    ubyte kind = MORE_BLOCKS;
    while (kind != FINAL_BLOCK) {
        if (at + STORED_BLOCK_HEADER_BYTES > deflated.length || (deflated[at] & ~FINAL_BLOCK) != 0) {
            return false;
        }
        kind = deflated[at];
        size_t length = deflated[at + 1] | (cast(size_t) deflated[at + 2] << 8);
        at += STORED_BLOCK_HEADER_BYTES;
        if (at + length > deflated.length || produced + length > raw.length) {
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(raw.ptr + produced, deflated.ptr + at, length);
        produced += length;
        at += length;
    }
    return produced == raw.length && at + ADLER_BYTES <= deflated.length && getBigEndian(deflated.ptr + at) == adler32(raw);
}

ubyte[] encodePng(uint width, uint height, const(ubyte)[] rgba) {
    size_t rowBytes = 1 + cast(size_t) width * RGB_BYTES;
    size_t rawBytes = rowBytes * height;
    ubyte* raw = cast(ubyte*) malloc(rawBytes);
    foreach (y; 0 .. height) {
        raw[y * rowBytes] = FILTER_NONE;
        foreach (x; 0 .. width) {
            size_t source = (cast(size_t) y * width + x) * RGBA_BYTES;
            size_t target = y * rowBytes + 1 + x * RGB_BYTES;
            memcpy(raw + target, rgba.ptr + source, RGB_BYTES);
        }
    }
    ubyte* compressed = cast(ubyte*) malloc(storedSize(rawBytes));
    size_t compressedBytes = deflateStored(raw[0 .. rawBytes], compressed);
    ubyte[HEADER_BYTES] header = 0;
    putBigEndian(header.ptr, width);
    putBigEndian(header.ptr + 4, height);
    header[8] = BIT_DEPTH;
    header[9] = COLOR_TYPE_RGB;
    size_t fileBytes = PNG_SIGNATURE.length + chunkSize(header.length) + chunkSize(compressedBytes) + chunkSize(0);
    ubyte* bytes = cast(ubyte*) malloc(fileBytes);
    memcpy(bytes, PNG_SIGNATURE.ptr, PNG_SIGNATURE.length);
    size_t at = PNG_SIGNATURE.length;
    at += putChunk(bytes + at, "IHDR", header[]);
    at += putChunk(bytes + at, "IDAT", compressed[0 .. compressedBytes]);
    putChunk(bytes + at, "IEND", null);
    free(raw);
    free(compressed);
    return bytes[0 .. fileBytes];
}

/// file: source/client/sampler.d
module client.sampler;

import core.atomic : atomicLoad, atomicOp, atomicStore;
import core.stdc.stdio : FILE, fprintf, snprintf;
import core.stdc.stdlib : calloc, free;
import core.sys.posix.pthread : pthread_equal, pthread_self, pthread_t;
import core.sys.posix.signal : SA_RESTART, SIGPROF, sigaction, sigaction_t, sigemptyset;
import core.sys.posix.sys.time : itimerval, setitimer, timeval;
import base.array : Array;
import base.flags : Bits;
import base.hashmap : FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER, HashMap;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : lowerOf;

enum uint SAMPLE_FRAMES = 48;
enum uint SAMPLE_CAPACITY = 1 << 18;
enum uint SIGNAL_FRAMES = 2;
enum int SAMPLE_MICROSECONDS = 4000;
enum uint LISTED_FUNCTIONS = 60;
enum uint LISTED_CALLEES = 30;
enum uint LISTED_CALLERS = 4;
enum double SHARED_FRAME_PERCENT = 90.0;
enum size_t NAME_CAPACITY = 160;
enum long NANOSECONDS_PER_MICROSECOND = 1000;

version (OSX) {
    import core.sys.darwin.dlfcn : Dl_info, dladdr;
    import core.sys.darwin.execinfo : backtrace;

    enum int ITIMER_PROF = 2;
    enum long MAIN_SAMPLE_NANOSECONDS = SAMPLE_MICROSECONDS * NANOSECONDS_PER_MICROSECOND;

    extern (C) int* __error() nothrow @nogc;

    alias errnoLocation = __error;
} else {
    import core.sys.linux.dlfcn : Dl_info, dladdr;
    import core.sys.linux.execinfo : backtrace;
    import core.sys.posix.signal : sigevent;
    import core.sys.posix.sys.time : ITIMER_PROF;
    import core.sys.posix.time : CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, itimerspec, timer_create, timer_delete, timer_settime, timer_t, timespec;
    import base.parallel : syscall;
    import bindings.kernel : CALL_GETTID, SIGNAL_ONE_THREAD;

    enum long MAIN_SAMPLE_NANOSECONDS = 500_000;

    extern (C) int* __errno_location() nothrow @nogc;
    extern (C) int __libc_current_sigrtmin() nothrow @nogc;

    alias errnoLocation = __errno_location;
}

enum SampledThread : ubyte {
    worker,
    main,
}

enum SamplerState : ubyte {
    stopped,
    running,
}

struct Sample {
    void*[SAMPLE_FRAMES] frames;
    int depth;
    SampledThread thread;
}

__gshared Sample* samples;
__gshared pthread_t mainThread;
shared uint sampleCount;

extern (C) void recordWorkerSample(int signal) {
    int onMain = pthread_equal(pthread_self(), mainThread);
    if (onMain == 0) {
        record(SampledThread.worker);
    }
}

extern (C) void recordMainSample(int signal) {
    record(SampledThread.main);
}

extern (C) void recordAnySample(int signal) {
    int onMain = pthread_equal(pthread_self(), mainThread);
    if (onMain != 0) {
        record(SampledThread.main);
    } else {
        record(SampledThread.worker);
    }
}

void record(SampledThread thread) {
    int saved = *errnoLocation();
    uint index = atomicOp!"+="(sampleCount, 1) - 1;
    if (index < SAMPLE_CAPACITY) {
        Sample* sample = &samples[index];
        sample.depth = backtrace(sample.frames.ptr, SAMPLE_FRAMES);
        sample.thread = thread;
    }
    *errnoLocation() = saved;
}

struct AddressKey {
    size_t address;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return address * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER;
    }
}

struct FunctionCounts {
    char[NAME_CAPACITY] name;
    uint selfMain;
    uint totalMain;
    uint selfWorker;
    uint totalWorker;
    uint lastSample;
}

struct CallKey {
    uint callee;
    uint caller;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return (cast(size_t) callee << 32 | caller) * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER;
    }
}

struct CallCounts {
    CallKey key;
    uint main;
    uint lastSample;
}

struct Sampler {
    version (OSX) {
    } else {
        timer_t mainTimer;
    }
    SamplerState state;

    void start() {
        if (samples is null) {
            samples = cast(Sample*) calloc(SAMPLE_CAPACITY, Sample.sizeof);
            void*[1] warm;
            backtrace(warm.ptr, 1);
        }
        mainThread = pthread_self();
        atomicStore(sampleCount, 0);
        version (OSX) {
            handle(SIGPROF, &recordAnySample);
        } else {
            handle(SIGPROF, &recordWorkerSample);
            handle(__libc_current_sigrtmin(), &recordMainSample);
            sigevent event;
            event.sigev_notify = SIGNAL_ONE_THREAD;
            event.sigev_signo = __libc_current_sigrtmin();
            event._tid = cast(int) syscall(CALL_GETTID);
            timer_create(CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, &event, &mainTimer);
            itimerspec mainPeriod = itimerspec(timespec(0, MAIN_SAMPLE_NANOSECONDS), timespec(0, MAIN_SAMPLE_NANOSECONDS));
            timer_settime(mainTimer, 0, &mainPeriod, null);
        }
        itimerval timer = itimerval(timeval(0, SAMPLE_MICROSECONDS), timeval(0, SAMPLE_MICROSECONDS));
        setitimer(ITIMER_PROF, &timer, null);
        state = SamplerState.running;
    }

    void handle(int signal, typeof(sigaction_t.sa_handler) handler) {
        sigaction_t action;
        action.sa_handler = handler;
        sigemptyset(&action.sa_mask);
        action.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
        sigaction(signal, &action, null);
    }

    void stop() {
        itimerval timer;
        setitimer(ITIMER_PROF, &timer, null);
        version (OSX) {
        } else {
            timer_delete(mainTimer);
        }
        state = SamplerState.stopped;
    }

    void report(FILE* output, const(char)* title) {
        stop();
        uint taken = atomicLoad(sampleCount);
        uint count = lowerOf(taken, SAMPLE_CAPACITY);
        HashMap!(AddressKey, uint) byAddress;
        HashMap!(AddressKey, uint) byStart;
        HashMap!(CallKey, uint) callIndex;
        Array!FunctionCounts functions;
        Array!CallCounts calls;
        uint mainSamples = 0;
        uint workerSamples = 0;
        foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
            Sample* sample = &samples[index];
            if (sample.thread == SampledThread.main) {
                mainSamples += 1;
            } else {
                workerSamples += 1;
            }
            Maybe!uint callee;
            foreach (depth; SIGNAL_FRAMES .. sample.depth) {
                uint current = functionOf(sample.frames[depth], byAddress, byStart, functions);
                FunctionCounts* counts = &functions.ptr[current];
                uint lastSeen = counts.lastSample;
                counts.lastSample = index + 1;
                if (sample.thread == SampledThread.main) {
                    if (depth == SIGNAL_FRAMES) {
                        counts.selfMain += 1;
                    }
                    if (lastSeen != index + 1) {
                        counts.totalMain += 1;
                    }
                    if (callee.exists && callee.value != current) {
                        countCall(CallKey(callee.value, current), index, callIndex, calls);
                    }
                } else {
                    if (depth == SIGNAL_FRAMES) {
                        counts.selfWorker += 1;
                    }
                    if (lastSeen != index + 1) {
                        counts.totalWorker += 1;
                    }
                }
                callee = Maybe!uint.of(current);
            }
        }
        fprintf(output, "profile %s: main %u samples of %ldus of its cpu, workers %u samples of %dus of process cpu (%u dropped)\n", title, mainSamples, MAIN_SAMPLE_NANOSECONDS / NANOSECONDS_PER_MICROSECOND, workerSamples, SAMPLE_MICROSECONDS, taken - count);
        listTop(output, "main by total", functions, mainSamples, Column.totalMain, Column.selfMain, Column.totalMain);
        listTop(output, "main by self", functions, mainSamples, Column.selfMain, Column.selfMain, Column.totalMain);
        listTop(output, "workers by total", functions, workerSamples, Column.totalWorker, Column.selfWorker, Column.totalWorker);
        listTop(output, "workers by self", functions, workerSamples, Column.selfWorker, Column.selfWorker, Column.totalWorker);
        listCallers(output, functions, calls, mainSamples);
        byAddress.release();
        byStart.release();
        callIndex.release();
        functions.release();
        calls.release();
    }

    void release() {
        if (state == SamplerState.running) {
            stop();
        }
        free(samples);
        samples = null;
    }
}

uint functionOf(void* frame, ref HashMap!(AddressKey, uint) byAddress, ref HashMap!(AddressKey, uint) byStart, ref Array!FunctionCounts functions) {
    AddressKey address = AddressKey(cast(size_t) frame);
    const(uint)* known = byAddress.find(address);
    if (known !is null) {
        return *known;
    } else {
        Dl_info info;
        AddressKey start = address;
        const(char)* symbol = null;
        int found = dladdr(frame, &info);
        if (found != 0 && info.dli_saddr !is null) {
            start = AddressKey(cast(size_t) info.dli_saddr);
            symbol = info.dli_sname;
        }
        const(uint)* existing = byStart.find(start);
        uint index = void;
        if (existing !is null) {
            index = *existing;
        } else {
            index = cast(uint) functions.length;
            functions.append(FunctionCounts.init);
            readableName(symbol, start.address, functions.ptr[index].name);
            byStart.insert(start, index);
        }
        byAddress.insert(address, index);
        return index;
    }
}

void readableName(const(char)* symbol, size_t start, ref char[NAME_CAPACITY] name) {
    if (symbol is null) {
        snprintf(name.ptr, NAME_CAPACITY, "?%zx", start);
    } else if (symbol[0] == '_' && symbol[1] == 'D' && symbol[2] >= '0' && symbol[2] <= '9') {
        size_t written = 0;
        const(char)* cursor = symbol + 2;
        while (written + 1 < NAME_CAPACITY && (isDigit(*cursor) || isTemplateMark(cursor))) {
            char joiner = '.';
            if (isTemplateMark(cursor)) {
                joiner = '!';
                cursor += 3;
            }
            size_t length = 0;
            while (isDigit(*cursor)) {
                length = length * 10 + (*cursor - '0');
                cursor += 1;
            }
            if (written > 0) {
                name[written] = joiner;
                written += 1;
            }
            foreach (_; 0 .. length) {
                if (*cursor != 0 && written + 1 < NAME_CAPACITY) {
                    name[written] = *cursor;
                    written += 1;
                }
                if (*cursor != 0) {
                    cursor += 1;
                }
            }
            if (joiner == '!') {
                break;
            }
        }
        name[written] = 0;
    } else {
        snprintf(name.ptr, NAME_CAPACITY, "%s", symbol);
    }
}

void countCall(CallKey key, uint sample, ref HashMap!(CallKey, uint) callIndex, ref Array!CallCounts calls) {
    const(uint)* known = callIndex.find(key);
    uint index = void;
    if (known !is null) {
        index = *known;
    } else {
        index = cast(uint) calls.length;
        calls.append(CallCounts(key, 0, 0));
        callIndex.insert(key, index);
    }
    CallCounts* counts = &calls.ptr[index];
    if (counts.lastSample != sample + 1) {
        counts.lastSample = sample + 1;
        counts.main += 1;
    }
}

Maybe!size_t heaviest(alias countOf, T)(const(T)[] items, ref const Bits listed) {
    Maybe!size_t best;
    foreach (index, ref item; items) {
        uint count = countOf(item);
        if (!listed.has(index) && count > 0 && (!best.exists || count > countOf(items[best.value]))) {
            best = Maybe!size_t.of(index);
        }
    }
    return best;
}

void listCallers(FILE* output, ref Array!FunctionCounts functions, ref Array!CallCounts calls, uint samples) {
    fprintf(output, "  main callers of the heaviest functions (total%%):\n");
    uint unsharedTotal(ref const FunctionCounts counts) {
        if (100.0 * counts.totalMain / samples < SHARED_FRAME_PERCENT) {
            return counts.totalMain;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    Bits listed;
    listed.cover(functions.length);
    uint count = 0;
    Maybe!size_t best = heaviest!unsharedTotal(functions.slice(), listed);
    while (count < LISTED_CALLEES && best.exists) {
        listed.set(best.value);
        fprintf(output, "    %5.1f  %s\n", 100.0 * functions.ptr[best.value].totalMain / samples, functions.ptr[best.value].name.ptr);
        listCallersOf(output, functions, calls, cast(uint) best.value, samples);
        count += 1;
        best = heaviest!unsharedTotal(functions.slice(), listed);
    }
    listed.release();
}

void listCallersOf(FILE* output, ref Array!FunctionCounts functions, ref Array!CallCounts calls, uint callee, uint samples) {
    uint callsFromHere(ref const CallCounts counts) {
        if (counts.key.callee == callee) {
            return counts.main;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }
    Bits listed;
    listed.cover(calls.length);
    uint count = 0;
    Maybe!size_t best = heaviest!callsFromHere(calls.slice(), listed);
    while (count < LISTED_CALLERS && best.exists) {
        listed.set(best.value);
        fprintf(output, "           %5.1f  from %s\n", 100.0 * calls.ptr[best.value].main / samples, functions.ptr[calls.ptr[best.value].key.caller].name.ptr);
        count += 1;
        best = heaviest!callsFromHere(calls.slice(), listed);
    }
    listed.release();
}

bool isDigit(char text) {
    return text >= '0' && text <= '9';
}

bool isTemplateMark(const(char)* text) {
    return text[0] == '_' && text[1] == '_' && text[2] == 'T';
}

enum Column : ubyte {
    selfMain,
    totalMain,
    selfWorker,
    totalWorker,
}

uint countIn(ref const FunctionCounts counts, Column column) {
    final switch (column) {
        case Column.selfMain:
            return counts.selfMain;
        case Column.totalMain:
            return counts.totalMain;
        case Column.selfWorker:
            return counts.selfWorker;
        case Column.totalWorker:
            return counts.totalWorker;
    }
}

void listTop(FILE* output, const(char)* heading, ref Array!FunctionCounts functions, uint samples, Column rank, Column self, Column total) {
    fprintf(output, "  %s (total%% self%%):\n", heading);
    uint rankOf(ref const FunctionCounts counts) {
        return countIn(counts, rank);
    }
    Bits listed;
    listed.cover(functions.length);
    uint count = 0;
    Maybe!size_t best = heaviest!rankOf(functions.slice(), listed);
    while (count < LISTED_FUNCTIONS && best.exists) {
        listed.set(best.value);
        FunctionCounts* counts = &functions.ptr[best.value];
        fprintf(output, "    %5.1f %5.1f  %s\n", 100.0 * countIn(*counts, total) / samples, 100.0 * countIn(*counts, self) / samples, counts.name.ptr);
        count += 1;
        best = heaviest!rankOf(functions.slice(), listed);
    }
    listed.release();
}
