module client.save;

import core.stdc.stdio : FILE, fclose, fopen, fread, fseek, ftell, fwrite, SEEK_END, SEEK_SET;
import core.stdc.string : memcpy, strncpy;
import base.array : Array;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.units : Length;
import client.game : Beacon, Game, Seed;
import client.hud : worldNameOf;
import common.biology.genome : Genome;
import common.biology.kinetics : Body;
import common.biology.organism : Organism;
import common.biology.signaling : Signaling;
import common.edits : BlockRecord, CellEdit, ChunkEdits;
import common.graph : Graph, NodeId, ParentList, ROOT_NODE;
import common.inventory : Inventory;
import common.node : ChunkId;
import common.position : Position;
import geometry.honeycomb : Corner, Face;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion;
import plugins.api.api : ENTRY;

enum uint SAVE_MAGIC = 0x6D696E65;
enum uint SAVE_FORMAT = 3;
enum uint MOST_SAVED_SEEDS = 1 << 10;
enum uint WORLDGEN_VERSION = 3;
enum size_t ENTRY_CAPACITY = 32;
enum size_t WORLD_NAME_CAPACITY = 64;
enum uint MOST_PATH_FACES = 1 << 16;

struct SaveHeader {
    uint magic;
    uint format;
    uint worldgen;
    char[ENTRY_CAPACITY] entry;
    char[WORLD_NAME_CAPACITY] world;
}

struct SavedEdits {
    NodeId node;
    uint cells;
    uint records;
    Corner corner;
}

struct SavedBeacon {
    uint faces;
    uint cell;
    Corner corner;
}

struct Writer {
    Array!ubyte bytes;

    void put(T)(ref const T value) {
        bytes.appendAll((cast(const(ubyte)*) &value)[0 .. T.sizeof]);
    }

    void putAll(T)(const(T)[] values) {
        bytes.appendAll((cast(const(ubyte)*) values.ptr)[0 .. T.sizeof * values.length]);
    }
}

struct Reader {
    const(ubyte)[] bytes;
    size_t at;

    bool take(T)(ref T value) {
        if (at + T.sizeof > bytes.length) {
            return false;
        } else {
            memcpy(&value, bytes.ptr + at, T.sizeof);
            at += T.sizeof;
            return true;
        }
    }
}

struct SaveData {
    SaveHeader header;
    Array!Face path;
    Motion!float local;
    Inventory inventory;
    Genome genome;
    Body body;
    Signaling signaling;
    Array!SavedEdits chunks;
    Array!CellEdit cells;
    Array!BlockRecord records;
    Array!SavedBeacon beacons;
    Array!Face beaconPaths;
    Array!Seed seeds;

    void release() {
        seeds.release();
        path.release();
        chunks.release();
        cells.release();
        records.release();
        beacons.release();
        beaconPaths.release();
    }
}

SaveHeader headerFor(ref const Game game) {
    SaveHeader header = SaveHeader(SAVE_MAGIC, SAVE_FORMAT, WORLDGEN_VERSION);
    strncpy(header.entry.ptr, ENTRY.ptr, ENTRY_CAPACITY - 1);
    const(char)[] world = worldNameOf(game.world.graph.worldgen);
    size_t length = world.length;
    if (length > WORLD_NAME_CAPACITY - 1) {
        length = WORLD_NAME_CAPACITY - 1;
    }
    memcpy(header.world.ptr, world.ptr, length);
    return header;
}

void pathFromRoot(ref const Graph graph, uint slot, ref Array!Face path) {
    path.clear();
    uint at = slot;
    while (graph.idAt(at) != ROOT_NODE) {
        ParentList list = graph.parents(at);
        path.append(list.links[0].side);
        at = list.links[0].slot;
    }
    foreach (index; 0 .. path.length / 2) {
        Face swapped = path.ptr[index];
        path.ptr[index] = path.ptr[path.length - 1 - index];
        path.ptr[path.length - 1 - index] = swapped;
    }
}

void writeGame(ref const Game game, ref Writer writer) {
    SaveHeader header = headerFor(game);
    writer.put(header);
    Array!Face path;
    Position body = game.characterState.position;
    pathFromRoot(game.world.graph, game.world.graph.slotOf(body.node).value, path);
    uint faces = cast(uint) path.length;
    writer.put(faces);
    writer.putAll(path.slice());
    writer.put(body.local);
    path.release();
    writer.put(game.inventory);
    writer.put(game.organism.genome);
    writer.put(game.organism.body);
    writer.put(game.organism.signaling);
    uint counted = 0;
    foreach (ref const chunk, ref const edits; game.world.graph.edits.chunks) {
        counted += 1;
    }
    writer.put(counted);
    foreach (ref const chunk, ref const edits; game.world.graph.edits.chunks) {
        SavedEdits saved = SavedEdits(chunk.node, cast(uint) edits.cells.length, cast(uint) edits.records.length, chunk.corner);
        writer.put(saved);
        writer.putAll(edits.cells.slice());
        writer.putAll(edits.records.slice());
    }
    uint beaconCount = cast(uint) game.beacons.length;
    writer.put(beaconCount);
    Array!Face beaconPath;
    foreach (beacon; game.beacons.slice()) {
        pathFromRoot(game.world.graph, game.world.graph.slotOf(beacon.chunk.node).value, beaconPath);
        SavedBeacon saved = SavedBeacon(cast(uint) beaconPath.length, beacon.cell, beacon.chunk.corner);
        writer.put(saved);
        writer.putAll(beaconPath.slice());
    }
    beaconPath.release();
    uint seedCount = cast(uint) game.seeds.length;
    writer.put(seedCount);
    writer.putAll(game.seeds.slice());
}

const(char)* readGame(const(ubyte)[] bytes, ref const Game game, ref SaveData data) {
    Reader reader = Reader(bytes);
    if (!reader.take(data.header) || data.header.magic != SAVE_MAGIC) {
        return "is not a mined save";
    } else if (data.header.format != SAVE_FORMAT) {
        return "was written by another save format";
    } else if (data.header.worldgen != WORLDGEN_VERSION) {
        return "was written for another version of world generation, so its edits would not line up";
    } else if (data.header.entry != headerFor(game).entry) {
        return "was written for another plugin interface version";
    } else if (data.header.world != headerFor(game).world) {
        return "belongs to another world";
    } else {
        return readBody(reader, data);
    }
}

const(char)* readBody(ref Reader reader, ref SaveData data) {
    if (!readPath(reader, data)) {
        return "is cut short in the body's place";
    } else if (!reader.take(data.local) || !reader.take(data.inventory) || !reader.take(data.genome) || !reader.take(data.body) || !reader.take(data.signaling)) {
        return "is cut short before the edits";
    } else if (!readEdits(reader, data)) {
        return "is cut short in the edits";
    } else if (!readBeacons(reader, data)) {
        return "is cut short in the beacons";
    } else if (!readSeeds(reader, data)) {
        return "is cut short in the seeds";
    } else {
        return null;
    }
}

bool readSeeds(ref Reader reader, ref SaveData data) {
    uint count;
    bool counted = reader.take(count) && count <= MOST_SAVED_SEEDS;
    if (counted) {
        foreach (_; 0 .. count) {
            Seed seed;
            if (!reader.take(seed)) {
                return false;
            }
            data.seeds.append(seed);
        }
    }
    return counted;
}

bool readBeacons(ref Reader reader, ref SaveData data) {
    uint count;
    bool counted = reader.take(count);
    if (counted) {
        foreach (_; 0 .. count) {
            SavedBeacon saved;
            if (!reader.take(saved) || saved.faces > MOST_PATH_FACES) {
                return false;
            }
            data.beacons.append(saved);
            foreach (face; 0 .. saved.faces) {
                Face along;
                if (!reader.take(along)) {
                    return false;
                }
                data.beaconPaths.append(along);
            }
        }
    }
    return counted;
}

bool readPath(ref Reader reader, ref SaveData data) {
    uint faces;
    bool counted = reader.take(faces) && faces <= MOST_PATH_FACES;
    if (counted) {
        data.path.resize(faces);
        foreach (index; 0 .. faces) {
            if (!reader.take(data.path.ptr[index])) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return counted;
}

bool readEdits(ref Reader reader, ref SaveData data) {
    uint chunkCount;
    bool counted = reader.take(chunkCount);
    if (counted) {
        foreach (_; 0 .. chunkCount) {
            SavedEdits saved;
            if (!reader.take(saved)) {
                return false;
            }
            data.chunks.append(saved);
            foreach (cell; 0 .. saved.cells) {
                CellEdit edit;
                if (!reader.take(edit)) {
                    return false;
                }
                data.cells.append(edit);
            }
            foreach (record; 0 .. saved.records) {
                BlockRecord kept;
                if (!reader.take(kept)) {
                    return false;
                }
                data.records.append(kept);
            }
        }
    }
    return counted;
}

void applyEdits(ref Game game, ref const SaveData data) {
    size_t cell = 0;
    size_t record = 0;
    foreach (saved; data.chunks.slice()) {
        ChunkId chunk = ChunkId(saved.node, saved.corner);
        foreach (_; 0 .. saved.cells) {
            CellEdit edit = data.cells.ptr[cell];
            game.world.graph.edits.record(chunk, edit.cell, edit.material);
            cell += 1;
        }
        foreach (_; 0 .. saved.records) {
            game.world.graph.edits.keepRecord(chunk, data.records.ptr[record]);
            record += 1;
        }
    }
}

uint replayed(ref Graph graph, const(Face)[] path) {
    uint slot = graph.slotOf(ROOT_NODE).value;
    foreach (face; path) {
        slot = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(slot, face);
    }
    return slot;
}

void applyState(ref Game game, ref const SaveData data) {
    game.inventory = data.inventory;
    game.organism.release();
    game.organism = Organism.make(data.genome);
    game.organism.body = data.body;
    game.organism.signaling = data.signaling;
    game.seeds.clear();
    game.seeds.appendAll(data.seeds.slice());
    size_t first = 0;
    foreach (saved; data.beacons.slice()) {
        uint beaconSlot = replayed(game.world.graph, data.beaconPaths.slice()[first .. first + saved.faces]);
        first += saved.faces;
        game.world.graph.reference(beaconSlot);
        game.beacons.append(Beacon(ChunkId(game.world.graph.idAt(beaconSlot), saved.corner), saved.cell));
    }
    uint slot = replayed(game.world.graph, data.path.slice());
    game.placeAt(Position(game.world.graph.idAt(slot), data.local), Length(0));
}

bool writeFile(const(char)* path, const(ubyte)[] bytes) {
    FILE* file = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (file is null) {
        return false;
    } else {
        size_t written = fwrite(bytes.ptr, 1, bytes.length, file);
        fclose(file);
        return written == bytes.length;
    }
}

Maybe!(Array!ubyte) readFile(const(char)* path) {
    FILE* file = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (file is null) {
        return Maybe!(Array!ubyte).init;
    } else {
        fseek(file, 0, SEEK_END);
        long size = ftell(file);
        fseek(file, 0, SEEK_SET);
        Array!ubyte bytes;
        bytes.resize(cast(size_t) size);
        size_t read = fread(bytes.ptr, 1, bytes.length, file);
        fclose(file);
        if (read != bytes.length) {
            bytes.release();
            return Maybe!(Array!ubyte).init;
        } else {
            return Maybe!(Array!ubyte).of(bytes);
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/client/script.d
module client.script;

import core.stdc.math : acosf, floor, fabsf;
import core.stdc.stdio : FILE, fclose, fopen, fprintf, snprintf;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.names : ENUM_NAMES;
import base.numbers : RADIANS_PER_DEGREE, clamped;
import base.units : Angle, AngularSpeed, Length, Speed, Time;
import base.vector3 : dot, magnitude, rejectAlong;
import client.arguments : ExitStatus, StructureName, exitStatus;
import client.game : ChunkSupply, FrameInput, Game, KEY_COUNT, Key, Preset, RouteWaypoint, ThrownMotion, UnloadedCount;
import common.inventory : HOTBAR_SLOTS;
import client.structures : StructureProblem, growthProblem, restartGame;
import common.character.controller : Footing, MovementMode;
import common.worldgen.generation : PlaneWorld, Worldgen, WorldgenKind;
import plugins.api.api : Material;
import plugins.api.flags : Flags;

enum Time DEFAULT_TIMESTEP = Time(0.016f);
enum Time ONE_SECOND = Time(1.0f);
enum size_t FAILURE_CAPACITY = 1024;

alias ScriptBody = void function(ref Script script);

enum HookState : ubyte {
    idle,
    running,
}

struct NamedScript {
    string name;
    ScriptBody run;
}

struct StepHook {
    void function(ref Script script, void* context) call;
    void* context;
}

Angle degrees(double value) {
    return Angle(cast(float)(value * RADIANS_PER_DEGREE));
}

double degreesOf(Angle angle) {
    return angle.value / RADIANS_PER_DEGREE;
}

float smoothStep(float share) {
    return share * share * (3 - 2 * share);
}

struct Script {
    Game* game;
    FILE* report;
    Time timestep = DEFAULT_TIMESTEP;
    AngularSpeed yawRate;
    AngularSpeed pitchRate;
    StepHook hook;
    StepHook camera;
    uint steps;
    char[FAILURE_CAPACITY] failure = 0;
    Flags!Key held;
    HookState hookState;

    static Script make(Game* game, FILE* report) {
        return Script(game, report);
    }

    bool isFailed() const {
        return failure[0] != 0;
    }

    ExitStatus run(ScriptBody body) {
        body(this);
        if (isFailed) {
            fprintf(report, "script error: %s\n", failure.ptr);
        }
        return exitStatus(!isFailed);
    }

    void fail(Args...)(const(char)* format, Args args) {
        if (!isFailed) {
            snprintf(failure.ptr, failure.length, format, args);
        }
    }

    bool takeFailure() {
        if (isFailed) {
            failure[0] = 0;
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }

    void check(Args...)(bool condition, const(char)* format, Args args) {
        if (!condition) {
            fail(format, args);
        }
    }

    void step() {
        step(timestep);
    }

    void step(Time dt) {
        if (!(dt.value > 0)) {
            fail("the timestep must be positive");
        } else if (hookState == HookState.running) {
            fail("a step hook cannot advance time");
        } else if (!isFailed) {
            game.step(FrameInput(yawRate * dt, pitchRate * dt, held), dt);
            steps += 1;
            StructureProblem grown = growthProblem(game.world.graph);
            if (grown.isPresent) {
                fail("%s", grown.text.ptr);
            } else if (hook.call !is null) {
                hookState = HookState.running;
                hook.call(this, hook.context);
                hookState = HookState.idle;
            }
        }
    }

    void wait(double seconds) {
        wait(seconds, timestep);
    }

    void wait(double seconds, Time dt) {
        if (!(seconds >= 0)) {
            fail("cannot wait a negative time");
        } else if (!(dt.value > 0)) {
            fail("the timestep must be positive");
        } else {
            ulong count = cast(ulong) floor(seconds / dt.value + 0.5);
            ulong done = 0;
            while (done < count && !isFailed) {
                step(dt);
                done += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    void setTimestep(Time chosen) {
        if (!(chosen.value > 0)) {
            fail("the timestep must be positive");
        } else {
            timestep = chosen;
        }
    }

    Time time() const {
        return game.time;
    }

    void worldgen(Worldgen chosen) {
        if (steps > 0) {
            fail("worldgen must be chosen before the first step");
        } else {
            StructureProblem problem = restartGame(*game, chosen);
            if (problem.isPresent) {
                fail("%s", problem.text.ptr);
            }
        }
    }

    void terrain() {
        worldgen(Worldgen.makeTerrain());
    }

    void plane(Angle tilt) {
        worldgen(Worldgen.fromPlane(PlaneWorld(tilt.value)));
    }

    void structure(const(char)[] name) {
        StructureName found = StructureName.fromText(name);
        if (found.problem !is null) {
            fail("%s '%.*s'", found.problem, cast(int) name.length, name.ptr);
        } else {
            worldgen(Worldgen.fromStructure(found.world));
        }
    }

    void onStep(StepHook chosen) {
        hook = chosen;
    }

    void hold(Key[] keys...) {
        foreach (key; keys) {
            held.set(key);
        }
    }

    void release(Key[] keys...) {
        foreach (key; keys) {
            held.clear(key);
        }
    }

    void releaseAll() {
        held = Flags!Key.init;
    }

    void press(double seconds, Key[] keys...) {
        hold(keys);
        wait(seconds);
        release(keys);
    }

    void look(Angle yaw, Angle pitch) {
        game.look(yaw, pitch);
    }

    void turnRate(AngularSpeed yaw, AngularSpeed pitch) {
        yawRate = yaw;
        pitchRate = pitch;
    }

    void turn(Angle yaw, Angle pitch, double seconds) {
        Time duration = Time(cast(float) seconds);
        AngularSpeed restingYaw = yawRate;
        AngularSpeed restingPitch = pitchRate;
        yawRate = yaw / duration;
        pitchRate = pitch / duration;
        wait(seconds);
        yawRate = restingYaw;
        pitchRate = restingPitch;
    }

    void roll() {
        hook = camera;
    }

    void glide(Key key, float distance, Angle yaw, Angle pitch, double seconds) {
        ulong count = cast(ulong) floor(seconds / timestep.value + 0.5);
        Speed resting = game.character.noclipSpeed;
        float before = 0;
        hold(key);
        foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
            if (!isFailed) {
                float after = smoothStep((index + 1.0f) / count);
                float share = after - before;
                before = after;
                game.character.noclipSpeed = Speed(fabsf(distance) * share / timestep.value);
                look(yaw * share, pitch * share);
                step();
            }
        }
        release(key);
        game.character.noclipSpeed = resting;
    }

    void ease(Angle yaw, Angle pitch, double seconds) {
        ulong count = cast(ulong) floor(seconds / timestep.value + 0.5);
        float before = 0;
        foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
            if (!isFailed) {
                float after = smoothStep((index + 1.0f) / count);
                look(yaw * (after - before), pitch * (after - before));
                before = after;
                step();
            }
        }
    }

    void throwBlock() {
        game.throwBlock();
    }

    size_t thrownCount() const {
        return game.thrown.length;
    }

    bool isThrownResting(size_t index) const {
        return game.thrown.ptr[index].motion == ThrownMotion.resting;
    }

    void resetCompass() {
        game.resetCompass();
    }

    Angle compassOff() const {
        return game.compassOff();
    }

    MovementMode mode() const {
        return game.mode;
    }

    void mode(MovementMode chosen) {
        game.mode = chosen;
    }

    Preset preset() const {
        return game.preset;
    }

    void perceive(Preset chosen) {
        game.perceive(chosen);
    }

    void dose() {
        game.doseNext();
    }

    void use() {
        game.use();
    }

    bool eat() {
        return game.eat();
    }

    uint material() const {
        return game.inventory.selected + 1;
    }

    void material(uint slot) {
        if (slot < 1 || slot > HOTBAR_SLOTS) {
            fail("material slot must be 1..%d", cast(int) HOTBAR_SLOTS);
        } else {
            game.inventory.selected = slot - 1;
        }
    }

    bool breakBlock() {
        return game.breakBlock();
    }

    bool placeBlock() {
        return game.placeBlock();
    }

    Maybe!Material targetMaterial() const {
        return game.world.targetMaterial();
    }

    void enterStructure(Length height) {
        if (game.world.graph.worldgen.kind != WorldgenKind.structure) {
            fail("enterStructure needs the structure worldgen");
        } else {
            game.enterStructure(height);
        }
    }

    void enterRoute(size_t number = 1) {
        if (number == 0 || game.world.graph.structures.blueprint.route.length < number) {
            fail("enterRoute needs a structure with a route that has stop %zu", number);
        } else {
            game.enterRoute(number - 1);
        }
    }

    Maybe!RouteWaypoint routeWaypoint(size_t number) const {
        Maybe!RouteWaypoint waypoint;
        if (number >= 1) {
            waypoint = game.routeWaypoint(number - 1);
            if (waypoint.exists) {
                waypoint.value.yaw = -waypoint.value.yaw;
            }
        }
        return waypoint;
    }

    RouteWaypoint needWaypoint(size_t number) {
        Maybe!RouteWaypoint waypoint = routeWaypoint(number);
        if (waypoint.exists) {
            return waypoint.value;
        } else {
            fail("the route has no stop %zu", number);
            return RouteWaypoint.init;
        }
    }

    Length traveled() const {
        return game.traveled;
    }

    bool isOnGround() const {
        return game.characterState.isOnGround;
    }

    Footing footing() const {
        return game.characterState.footing;
    }

    void live() {
        game.supply = ChunkSupply.streamed;
    }

    bool isLoaded() const {
        return game.isLoadedAround();
    }

    UnloadedCount unloadedWithin(Length radius) const {
        return game.unloadedWithin(radius);
    }

    Length probeFrameDrift(Length radius) {
        return game.probeFrameDrift(radius);
    }

    Length altitude() const {
        return game.altitude;
    }

    Speed speed() const {
        return Speed(game.characterState.velocity.magnitude);
    }

    Speed horizontalSpeed() const {
        return Speed(game.characterState.velocity.rejectAlong(game.characterState.up).magnitude);
    }

    Angle floorTilt() const {
        return Angle(acosf(clamped(game.characterState.groundNormal.dot(game.characterState.up), -1.0f, 1.0f)));
    }

    Speed verticalSpeed() const {
        return Speed(game.characterState.velocity.dot(game.characterState.up));
    }

    float cameraVerticalAcceleration() const {
        return game.cameraVerticalAcceleration.value;
    }
}

const(T)* named(T)(const(T)[] items, const(char)[] name) {
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < items.length && items[index].name != name) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index < items.length) {
        return &items[index];
    } else {
        return null;
    }
}

struct ScriptRecorder {
    FILE* file;
    Time pendingDt;
    uint pendingSteps;
    Flags!Key held;

    bool open(const(char)* path) {
        file = fopen(path, "w");
        if (file is null) {
            return false;
        } else {
            fprintf(file, "void recorded(ref Script world) {\n");
            return true;
        }
    }

    void recordFrame(FrameInput input, Time dt) {
        foreach (i; 0 .. KEY_COUNT) {
            Key key = cast(Key) i;
            if (input.held.has(key) != held.has(key)) {
                flush();
                string name = ENUM_NAMES!Key[i];
                fprintf(file, "    world.%s(Key.%.*s);\n", keyCall(input.held, key), cast(int) name.length, name.ptr);
            }
        }
        held = input.held;
        if (input.yaw.value != 0 || input.pitch.value != 0) {
            flush();
            fprintf(file, "    world.look(degrees(%.9g), degrees(%.9g));\n", degreesOf(input.yaw), degreesOf(input.pitch));
        }
        if (dt.value != pendingDt.value) {
            flush();
            pendingDt = dt;
        }
        pendingSteps += 1;
    }

    void recordCall(const(char)* call) {
        flush();
        fprintf(file, "    world.%s();\n", call);
    }

    void recordMode(MovementMode mode) {
        flush();
        string name = ENUM_NAMES!MovementMode[mode];
        fprintf(file, "    world.mode(MovementMode.%.*s);\n", cast(int) name.length, name.ptr);
    }

    void recordPreset(Preset preset) {
        flush();
        string name = ENUM_NAMES!Preset[preset];
        fprintf(file, "    world.perceive(Preset.%.*s);\n", cast(int) name.length, name.ptr);
    }

    void recordMaterial(uint slot) {
        flush();
        fprintf(file, "    world.material(%u);\n", slot);
    }

    void flush() {
        if (pendingSteps > 0) {
            fprintf(file, "    world.wait(%.9g, Time(%.9gf));\n", pendingSteps * cast(double) pendingDt.value, cast(double) pendingDt.value);
        }
        pendingSteps = 0;
    }

    void close() {
        flush();
        fprintf(file, "}\n");
        fclose(file);
        file = null;
    }
}

immutable(char)* keyCall(Flags!Key held, Key key) {
    if (held.has(key)) {
        return "hold";
    } else {
        return "release";
    }
}

/// file: source/client/streaming.d
module client.streaming;

import core.atomic : atomicLoad;
import core.stdc.math : acoshf, coshf;
import core.stdc.stdlib : calloc, free;
import base.array : Array;
import base.clock : Deadline, nowMilliseconds;
import base.flags : Readiness;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : lowerOf;
import base.parallel : ConcurrentQueue, Executor, MAIN_WORKER, ParallelJob, TaskSource, WorkerPool;
import base.units : Length;
import client.arrivals : Integrator;
import client.tasks : BuildingRequest, BuildingResult, GenKind, GenRequest, GenResult, QUEUE_CAPACITY, TaskQueues, pushedPrefix, takeTask, workerThreadCount;
import common.character.features : RequiredChunks, visitCells;
import common.eviction : KEEP_RADIUS, Unloaded;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.node : ChunkSlot, ChunkState, Occupancy;
import common.position : Position;
import common.traversal : NearbyNode;
import common.view : GraphView;
import common.worldgen.generation : ChunkParams, ChunkStructure, GeneratedVoxels;
import common.worldgen.store : NodeMark, NodeStructure;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, CUBE_RADIUS, Corner, cubeCenter;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Point;

enum size_t LOOKAHEAD_PER_CANDIDATE = 8;
version (WebAssembly) {
    enum Maybe!uint MOST_SCANNED_PER_FRAME = Maybe!uint.init;
    enum size_t SCAN_WINDOW = 256;
} else {
    enum Maybe!uint MOST_SCANNED_PER_FRAME = Maybe!uint.of(4096);
    enum size_t SCAN_WINDOW = 4096;
}
enum uint IN_FLIGHT_PER_WORKER = 256;
enum uint FAR_BUILDINGS_PER_WORKER = 4;
enum size_t INTEGRATION_BATCH = 4096;
enum Length FOCUS_REACH = Length(0.75f);
enum double NEAR_REFRESH_TRAVEL = 0.25;
enum uint NEAR_BANDS = 3;
enum uint URGENT_BANDS = 2;
immutable float[NEAR_BANDS] NEAR_BAND_RADII = [1.5f, 3.0f, 4.5f];

enum ScanEnd : ubyte {
    finished,
    waitingOnBuilding,
    interrupted,
}

enum ScanProgress : ubyte {
    through,
    stopped,
}

enum Urgency : ubyte {
    normal,
    urgent,
}

enum Pacing : ubyte {
    budgeted,
    unbudgeted,
}

enum Rescan : ubyte {
    onceTraveled,
    never,
}

struct NextScan {
    double travel = 0;
    Rescan rescan;
}

enum NextScan RESCAN_NOW = NextScan.init;

struct ScanOutcome {
    Maybe!float nearestOutOfRange;
    Maybe!float nearestDropped;
    ScanEnd end;
}

Maybe!float marginPast(Maybe!float coshNearest, float reach) {
    if (coshNearest.exists) {
        return Maybe!float.of(acoshf(coshNearest.value) - reach);
    } else {
        return Maybe!float.init;
    }
}

Maybe!float nearerOf(Maybe!float a, Maybe!float b) {
    if (!a.exists) {
        return b;
    } else if (!b.exists) {
        return a;
    } else {
        return Maybe!float.of(lowerOf(a.value, b.value));
    }
}

struct ScanRange {
    Point!float camera;
    float range;
    float threshold;
    float keepRange;
    float keepThreshold;

    static ScanRange make(Point!float camera, float range, float keepRange) {
        return ScanRange(camera, range, coshf(range), keepRange, coshf(keepRange));
    }

    NextScan nextAfter(double travel, ScanOutcome outcome) const {
        Maybe!float margin = nearerOf(marginPast(outcome.nearestOutOfRange, range), marginPast(outcome.nearestDropped, keepRange));
        if (margin.exists) {
            return NextScan(travel + margin.value, Rescan.onceTraveled);
        } else {
            return NextScan(0, Rescan.never);
        }
    }
}

struct PlannedChunk {
    ChunkSlot chunk;
    GenKind kind;
    Urgency urgency;
}

struct PlannedParams {
    ChunkParams params;
    GeneratedVoxels generated;
    Occupancy predicted;
    Readiness state;
}

struct ParamsJob {
    Graph* graph;
    const(PlannedChunk)* chunks;
    PlannedParams* made;
}

void computeParams(void* context, size_t index, uint worker) {
    ParamsJob* job = cast(ParamsJob*) context;
    GraphView* view = &job.graph.threadViews[worker];
    ChunkSlot chunk = job.chunks[index].chunk;
    PlannedParams* made = &job.made[index];
    made.state = Readiness.pending;
    ChunkStructure structure = view.ensureChunkStructure(chunk.slot);
    if (structure.isKnown) {
        made.params = ChunkParams.make(*view, chunk.slot, chunk.corner);
        if (view.isBlocked) {
            view.forget();
        } else {
            made.state = Readiness.ready;
            made.predicted = made.params.predictOccupancy();
            if (job.chunks[index].kind == GenKind.fresh) {
                job.graph.chunks.existing(chunk).predicted = made.predicted;
                if (made.params.isUniformlyFilled(made.predicted)) {
                    made.generated = made.params.generateVoxels();
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

struct ScanFacts {
    uint freshInRange;
    uint droppedInRange;
    Maybe!float nearestOutOfRange;
    Maybe!float nearestDropped;
}

ScanFacts scanFacts(ref const Graph graph, NearbyNode nearbyNode, ScanRange range) {
    ScanFacts found;
    foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
        Corner corner = cast(Corner) index;
        ChunkState state = graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot(nearbyNode.slot, corner)).state;
        if (state == ChunkState.fresh) {
            float product = range.camera.coshDistance(nearbyNode.transform * corner.cubeCenter);
            if (!(product > range.threshold)) {
                found.freshInRange |= 1u << index;
            } else {
                found.nearestOutOfRange = nearerOf(found.nearestOutOfRange, Maybe!float.of(product));
            }
        } else if (state == ChunkState.dropped) {
            float product = range.camera.coshDistance(nearbyNode.transform * corner.cubeCenter);
            if (!(product > range.keepThreshold)) {
                found.droppedInRange |= 1u << index;
            } else {
                found.nearestDropped = nearerOf(found.nearestDropped, Maybe!float.of(product));
            }
        }
    }
    return found;
}

struct ScanJob {
    const(Graph)* graph;
    const(Streamer)* streamer;
    const(NearbyNode)* nodes;
    ScanFacts* facts;
    ScanRange range;
}

void gatherScanFacts(void* context, size_t item, uint worker) {
    ScanJob* job = cast(ScanJob*) context;
    NearbyNode nearbyNode = job.nodes[item];
    if (job.streamer.isScanPending(nearbyNode.slot)) {
        job.facts[item] = scanFacts(*job.graph, nearbyNode, job.range);
    }
}

struct NearBands {
    Array!uint[NEAR_BANDS] bands;

    void release() {
        foreach (ref band; bands) {
            band.release();
        }
    }
}

struct NearJob {
    const(NearbyNode)* nodes;
    NearBands* outputs;
    Point!float camera;
    float[NEAR_BANDS] thresholds;
}

void sortIntoBand(void* context, size_t item, uint worker) {
    NearJob* job = cast(NearJob*) context;
    float product = job.camera.coshDistance(job.nodes[item].transform * Point!float.origin());
    uint band = 0;
    while (band < NEAR_BANDS && product > job.thresholds[band]) {
        band += 1;
    }
    if (band < NEAR_BANDS) {
        job.outputs[worker].bands[band].append(cast(uint) item);
    }
}

struct Streamer {
    Array!GenRequest requests;
    Array!GenRequest urgentRequests;
    Array!uint buildingSlots;
    Array!uint urgentBuildingSlots;
    Array!PlannedChunk planned;
    Array!PlannedParams made;
    Array!ScanFacts facts;
    Array!NextScan rescanAt;
    Array!uint waiting;
    Array!uint nearCamera;
    RequiredChunks around;
    Integrator integrator;
    TaskQueues* queues;
    WorkerPool* pool;
    NearBands* bands;
    double travel = 0;
    double nearTravel = 0;
    size_t nearHead;
    size_t nearUrgent;
    uint workerCount;
    uint inFlight;
    uint buildingsInFlight;
    uint scanCursor;
    uint scanVersion;

    static Streamer make() {
        Streamer streamer;
        streamer.queues = TaskQueues.make();
        version (WebAssembly) {
            streamer.workerCount = 1;
            streamer.pool = WorkerPool.make(0, TaskSource(&takeTask, streamer.queues));
        } else {
            import core.sys.posix.unistd : _SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN, sysconf;

            streamer.workerCount = workerThreadCount(sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN));
            streamer.pool = WorkerPool.make(streamer.workerCount, TaskSource(&takeTask, streamer.queues));
        }
        streamer.queues.pool = streamer.pool;
        streamer.integrator = Integrator.make(streamer.pool.participants());
        streamer.bands = cast(NearBands*) calloc(streamer.pool.participants(), NearBands.sizeof);
        return streamer;
    }

    void planParams(ref Graph graph) {
        if (planned.length > 0) {
            made.resize(planned.length);
            graph.threadViews.begin(graph, pool.participants());
            ParamsJob context = ParamsJob(&graph, planned.ptr, made.ptr);
            ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(&computeParams, &context, Deadline.init,planned.length);
            pool.run(&job);
            graph.threadViews.finish(graph);
            foreach (index, plan; planned.slice()) {
                PlannedParams* result = &made.ptr[index];
                if (result.state == Readiness.pending) {
                    result.params = ChunkParams.make(graph.view, plan.chunk.slot, plan.chunk.corner);
                    result.predicted = result.params.predictOccupancy();
                    if (plan.kind == GenKind.fresh) {
                        graph.chunks.existing(plan.chunk).predicted = result.predicted;
                        if (result.params.isUniformlyFilled(result.predicted)) {
                            result.generated = result.params.generateVoxels();
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (plan.kind == GenKind.restoring || !result.params.isUniformlyFilled(result.predicted)) {
                    GenRequest request = GenRequest(result.params, plan.chunk, plan.kind);
                    if (plan.urgency == Urgency.urgent) {
                        urgentRequests.append(request);
                    } else {
                        requests.append(request);
                    }
                } else {
                    integrator.arrivals.append(GenResult(result.generated, plan.chunk, GenKind.fresh));
                }
            }
            planned.clear();
            integrator.run(graph, executor());
        }
    }

    void runParallel(ParallelJob* job) {
        pool.run(job);
    }

    void runTasksUntil(double deadline) {
        bool took = true;
        double now = nowMilliseconds();
        while (took && now < deadline) {
            took = takeTask(queues, MAIN_WORKER);
            now = nowMilliseconds();
        }
    }

    Executor executor() {
        return Executor(pool);
    }

    void requestAround(ref Graph graph, Position focus) {
        around.clear();
        visitCells(graph, focus, FOCUS_REACH, around);
        foreach (missing; around.missing.slice()) {
            graph.ensureNeighborSlot(missing.slot, missing.side);
        }
        foreach (chunk; around.chunks.slice()) {
            ChunkState state = graph.chunks.at(chunk).state;
            if (state == ChunkState.dropped) {
                plan(graph, chunk, GenKind.restoring, Urgency.urgent);
            } else if (state == ChunkState.fresh) {
                bool ready = probeBuildingReady(graph, chunk.slot);
                if (ready) {
                    plan(graph, chunk, GenKind.fresh, Urgency.urgent);
                } else {
                    scheduleBuilding(graph, chunk.slot, Urgency.urgent);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void drive(ref Graph graph, const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, Position focus, Motion!float cameraLocal, float distance, uint nearbyVersion, Pacing pacing, Deadline deadline) {
        if (rescanAt.length < graph.slotCount) {
            rescanAt.resize(graph.slotCount);
        }
        integrate(graph, deadline);
        foreach (chunk; graph.chunks.restores.slice()) {
            planned.append(PlannedChunk(chunk, GenKind.restoring, Urgency.normal));
        }
        graph.chunks.restores.clear();
        ScanRange range = ScanRange.make(cameraLocal * Point!float.origin(), distance + CUBE_RADIUS, KEEP_RADIUS + CUBE_RADIUS);
        if (scanVersion != nearbyVersion) {
            scanVersion = nearbyVersion;
            scanCursor = 0;
            waiting.clear();
            findNearCamera(nearby, range.camera);
        } else if (travel - nearTravel >= NEAR_REFRESH_TRAVEL) {
            findNearCamera(nearby, range.camera);
        }
        requestAround(graph, focus);
        version (WebAssembly) {
            size_t plans = scanAndPlan(graph, nearby, range, pacing, deadline);
            double now = nowMilliseconds();
            while (plans > 0 && !deadline.hasPassed(now)) {
                plans = scanAndPlan(graph, nearby, range, pacing, deadline);
                now = nowMilliseconds();
            }
        } else {
            scanAndPlan(graph, nearby, range, pacing, deadline);
        }
    }

    size_t scanAndPlan(ref Graph graph, const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, ScanRange range, Pacing pacing, Deadline deadline) {
        Maybe!uint budget = requestBudget(pacing);
        rescanBuilt(graph, nearby, range, budget);
        ScanProgress progress = scanNearCamera(graph, nearby, range, budget, deadline);
        if (progress == ScanProgress.through) {
            scanCursor = cast(uint) scan(graph, nearby, range, budget, deadline);
        }
        size_t plans = planned.length;
        planParams(graph);
        submitRequests(graph);
        return plans;
    }

    void rescanBuilt(ref Graph graph, const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, ScanRange range, Maybe!uint budget) {
        size_t kept = 0;
        foreach (index; waiting.slice()) {
            bool finished = finishWaiting(graph, nearby[index], range, budget);
            if (!finished) {
                waiting.ptr[kept] = index;
                kept += 1;
            }
        }
        waiting.length = kept;
    }

    bool finishWaiting(ref Graph graph, NearbyNode nearbyNode, ScanRange range, Maybe!uint budget) {
        if (graph.structures.at(nearbyNode.slot).isBuildingQueued) {
            return false;
        } else {
            ScanOutcome outcome = scanNode(graph, nearbyNode.slot, scanFacts(graph, nearbyNode, range), budget, Urgency.normal);
            if (outcome.end == ScanEnd.finished) {
                rescanAt.ptr[nearbyNode.slot] = range.nextAfter(travel, outcome);
                return true;
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    Maybe!uint requestBudget(Pacing pacing) const {
        if (pacing == Pacing.unbudgeted) {
            return Maybe!uint.init;
        } else if (inFlight < workerCount * IN_FLIGHT_PER_WORKER) {
            return Maybe!uint.of(workerCount * IN_FLIGHT_PER_WORKER - inFlight);
        } else {
            return Maybe!uint.of(0);
        }
    }

    bool isScanPending(uint slot) const {
        return slot < rescanAt.length && rescanAt.ptr[slot].rescan == Rescan.onceTraveled && rescanAt.ptr[slot].travel <= travel;
    }

    void collectUnstructured(ref const Graph graph, const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, ref Array!uint into, size_t limit) const {
        size_t looked = 0;
        size_t near = nearHead;
        while (near < nearCamera.length && looked < limit * LOOKAHEAD_PER_CANDIDATE && into.length < limit) {
            collectIfUnstructured(graph, nearby[nearCamera.ptr[near]].slot, into);
            near += 1;
            looked += 1;
        }
        size_t index = scanCursor;
        while (index < nearby.length && looked < limit * LOOKAHEAD_PER_CANDIDATE && into.length < limit) {
            collectIfUnstructured(graph, nearby[index].slot, into);
            index += 1;
            looked += 1;
        }
    }

    void collectIfUnstructured(ref const Graph graph, uint slot, ref Array!uint into) const {
        if (isScanPending(slot) && !graph.isFinished(slot) && !graph.structures.at(slot).isCovered) {
            into.append(slot);
        }
    }

    size_t scan(ref Graph graph, const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, ScanRange range, Maybe!uint budget, Deadline deadline) {
        uint scanned = 0;
        size_t index = scanCursor;
        double start = nowMilliseconds();
        if (deadline.hasPassed(start)) {
            return index;
        }
        while (index < nearby.length) {
            size_t first = index;
            size_t end = lowerOf(first + SCAN_WINDOW, nearby.length);
            facts.resize(end - first);
            ScanJob context = ScanJob(&graph, &this, nearby.ptr + first, facts.ptr, range);
            ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(&gatherScanFacts, &context, Deadline.init,end - first);
            pool.run(&job);
            while (index < end) {
                if (isScanPending(nearby[index].slot)) {
                    scanned += 1;
                    ScanEnd stopped = scanAt(graph, nearby, index, facts.ptr[index - first], range, budget, Urgency.normal);
                    if (stopped == ScanEnd.interrupted) {
                        return index;
                    }
                    index += 1;
                    double now = nowMilliseconds();
                    if ((MOST_SCANNED_PER_FRAME.exists && scanned >= MOST_SCANNED_PER_FRAME.value) || deadline.hasPassed(now)) {
                        return index;
                    }
                } else {
                    index += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return index;
    }

    ScanEnd scanAt(ref Graph graph, const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, size_t index, ScanFacts found, ScanRange range, Maybe!uint budget, Urgency urgency) {
        uint slot = nearby[index].slot;
        ScanOutcome outcome = scanNode(graph, slot, found, budget, urgency);
        if (outcome.end == ScanEnd.waitingOnBuilding) {
            rescanAt.ptr[slot] = RESCAN_NOW;
            waiting.append(cast(uint) index);
        } else if (outcome.end == ScanEnd.finished) {
            rescanAt.ptr[slot] = range.nextAfter(travel, outcome);
        }
        return outcome.end;
    }

    void findNearCamera(const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, Point!float camera) {
        NearJob context = NearJob(nearby.ptr, bands, camera);
        foreach (band; 0 .. NEAR_BANDS) {
            context.thresholds[band] = coshf(NEAR_BAND_RADII[band]);
        }
        ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(&sortIntoBand, &context, Deadline.init,nearby.length);
        pool.run(&job);
        nearCamera.clear();
        foreach (band; 0 .. NEAR_BANDS) {
            foreach (worker; 0 .. pool.participants()) {
                nearCamera.appendAll(bands[worker].bands[band].slice());
                bands[worker].bands[band].clear();
            }
            if (band + 1 == URGENT_BANDS) {
                nearUrgent = nearCamera.length;
            }
        }
        nearHead = 0;
        nearTravel = travel;
    }

    ScanProgress scanNearCamera(ref Graph graph, const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, ScanRange range, Maybe!uint budget, Deadline deadline) {
        double start = nowMilliseconds();
        if (deadline.hasPassed(start)) {
            return ScanProgress.stopped;
        }
        while (nearHead < nearCamera.length) {
            uint index = nearCamera.ptr[nearHead];
            if (isScanPending(nearby[index].slot)) {
                Urgency urgency = Urgency.normal;
                Maybe!uint allowed = budget;
                if (nearHead < nearUrgent) {
                    urgency = Urgency.urgent;
                    allowed = Maybe!uint.init;
                }
                ScanEnd scanned = scanAt(graph, nearby, index, scanFacts(graph, nearby[index], range), range, allowed, urgency);
                if (scanned == ScanEnd.interrupted) {
                    return ScanProgress.stopped;
                }
                nearHead += 1;
                double now = nowMilliseconds();
                if (deadline.hasPassed(now)) {
                    return ScanProgress.stopped;
                }
            } else {
                nearHead += 1;
            }
        }
        return ScanProgress.through;
    }

    ScanOutcome scanNode(ref Graph graph, uint slot, ScanFacts found, Maybe!uint budget, Urgency urgency) {
        ScanOutcome outcome = ScanOutcome(found.nearestOutOfRange, found.nearestDropped, ScanEnd.finished);
        uint wanted = found.freshInRange | found.droppedInRange;
        foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
            uint bit = 1u << index;
            if ((wanted & bit) != 0) {
                ChunkSlot chunk = ChunkSlot(slot, cast(Corner) index);
                if (budget.exists && requests.length + planned.length >= budget.value) {
                    outcome.end = ScanEnd.interrupted;
                    return outcome;
                } else if ((found.droppedInRange & bit) != 0) {
                    plan(graph, chunk, GenKind.restoring, urgency);
                } else {
                    bool ready = probeBuildingReady(graph, slot);
                    if (ready) {
                        plan(graph, chunk, GenKind.fresh, urgency);
                    } else {
                        scheduleBuilding(graph, slot, urgency);
                        outcome.end = ScanEnd.waitingOnBuilding;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return outcome;
    }

    void plan(ref Graph graph, ChunkSlot slot, GenKind kind, Urgency urgency) {
        graph.chunks.writable(slot).state = ChunkState.generating;
        planned.append(PlannedChunk(slot, kind, urgency));
    }

    void scheduleBuilding(ref Graph graph, uint slot, Urgency urgency) {
        NodeStructure* node = &graph.structures.at(slot);
        if (graph.structures.buildingAt(slot) is null && !node.isBuildingQueued) {
            node.marks.set(NodeMark.buildingQueued);
            if (urgency == Urgency.urgent) {
                node.marks.set(NodeMark.buildingUrgent);
                urgentBuildingSlots.append(slot);
            } else {
                node.marks.clear(NodeMark.buildingUrgent);
                buildingSlots.append(slot);
            }
        } else if (urgency == Urgency.urgent && node.isBuildingQueued && !node.isBuildingUrgent) {
            node.marks.set(NodeMark.buildingUrgent);
            size_t index = 0;
            while (index < buildingSlots.length && buildingSlots.ptr[index] != slot) {
                index += 1;
            }
            if (index < buildingSlots.length) {
                foreach (moved; index + 1 .. buildingSlots.length) {
                    buildingSlots.ptr[moved - 1] = buildingSlots.ptr[moved];
                }
                buildingSlots.length -= 1;
                urgentBuildingSlots.append(slot);
            }
        }
    }

    void submitRequests(ref Graph graph) {
        size_t generations = pushedPrefix(queues.urgent, urgentRequests, QUEUE_CAPACITY - inFlight);
        generations += pushedPrefix(queues.generations, requests, QUEUE_CAPACITY - inFlight - generations);
        size_t buildings = submitBuildings(graph, urgentBuildingSlots, queues.urgentBuildings, QUEUE_CAPACITY - buildingsInFlight);
        size_t farLimit = workerCount * FAR_BUILDINGS_PER_WORKER;
        if (buildingsInFlight + buildings < farLimit) {
            buildings += submitBuildings(graph, buildingSlots, queues.buildings, farLimit - buildingsInFlight - buildings);
        }
        inFlight += cast(uint) generations;
        buildingsInFlight += cast(uint) buildings;
        if (generations > 0 || buildings > 0) {
            pool.signal();
        }
    }

    size_t submitBuildings(ref Graph graph, ref Array!uint slots, ref ConcurrentQueue!BuildingRequest queue, size_t room) {
        size_t pushed = 0;
        while (pushed < slots.length && pushed < room) {
            uint slot = slots.ptr[pushed];
            bool accepted = queue.push(BuildingRequest(graph.planBuilding(slot), slot));
            assert(accepted);
            pushed += 1;
        }
        foreach (index; pushed .. slots.length) {
            slots.ptr[index - pushed] = slots.ptr[index];
        }
        slots.length -= pushed;
        return pushed;
    }

    void forget(const(Unloaded)[] unloaded) {
        foreach (entry; unloaded) {
            if (entry.slot < rescanAt.length) {
                rescanAt.ptr[entry.slot] = RESCAN_NOW;
            }
        }
    }

    bool isIdle() const {
        return inFlight == 0 && buildingsInFlight == 0 && requests.length == 0 && urgentRequests.length == 0 && buildingSlots.length == 0 && urgentBuildingSlots.length == 0;
    }

    void settle(ref Graph graph) {
        while (!isIdle()) {
            submitRequests(graph);
            uint seen = atomicLoad(queues.completed);
            uint integrated = integrate(graph, Deadline.init);
            if (integrated == 0) {
                queues.await(seen);
            }
        }
    }

    uint integrate(ref Graph graph, Deadline deadline) {
        uint integrated = 0;
        BuildingResult built;
        bool popped = queues.built.pop(built);
        while (popped) {
            integrateBuilding(graph, built);
            integrated += 1;
            popped = queues.built.pop(built);
        }
        GenResult result;
        popped = true;
        double now = nowMilliseconds();
        while (popped && !deadline.hasPassed(now) && integrator.arrivals.length < INTEGRATION_BATCH) {
            popped = queues.generated.pop(result);
            if (popped) {
                inFlight -= 1;
                integrated += 1;
                integrator.arrivals.append(result);
            }
            now = nowMilliseconds();
        }
        integrator.run(graph, executor());
        return integrated;
    }

    void integrateBuilding(ref Graph graph, BuildingResult built) {
        buildingsInFlight -= 1;
        graph.structures.at(built.slot).marks.clear(NodeMark.buildingQueued);
        graph.structures.at(built.slot).marks.clear(NodeMark.buildingUrgent);
        if (graph.structures.buildingAt(built.slot) !is null) {
            built.building.release();
        } else {
            graph.structures.storeBuilding(built.slot, built.building);
        }
        if (built.slot < rescanAt.length) {
            rescanAt.ptr[built.slot] = RESCAN_NOW;
        }
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (index; 0 .. pool.participants()) {
            bands[index].release();
        }
        free(bands);
        bands = null;
        integrator.release();
        pool.release();
        free(pool);
        pool = null;
        workerCount = 0;
        queues.release();
        free(queues);
        queues = null;
        buildingSlots.release();
        urgentBuildingSlots.release();
        requests.release();
        urgentRequests.release();
        planned.release();
        made.release();
        facts.release();
        nearCamera.release();
        around.release();
        rescanAt.release();
        waiting.release();
    }
}

bool probeBuildingReady(ref Graph graph, uint slot) {
    bool needsBuilding = graph.ensureStructureAt(slot);
    return !needsBuilding || graph.structures.buildingAt(slot) !is null;
}

enum size_t MESSAGE_CAPACITY = 1024;
enum string UNBOUNDED_PAINT = "paints bounded heights: give the box a z range";
enum string BAD_PEN_DRAW = "a pen draws a length of at least zero with radii above zero";
enum string ONLY_WORLD_TILES_GROUND = "only the world's own structure tiles the ground, and only once";
enum string ONLY_WORLD_TILES_EDGES = "only the world's own structure tiles the edges, and only once";
enum string ONLY_WORLD_FLATTENS = "only the world's own structure flattens the ground";
enum string ONLY_WORLD_TURNS_GRAVITY = "only the world's own structure turns gravity around";
enum string ONLY_WORLD_SETS_FOG = "only the world's own structure sets the fog";
enum string ONLY_WORLD_GIVES_KINDS = "only the world's own structure gives horospheres their kinds";
enum string ONLY_WORLD_SETS_LOOK = "only the world's own structure sets how it looks";
enum string ONLY_WORLD_OPENS = "only the world's own structure opens horospheres";
enum string ONLY_WORLD_ROOTS = "only the world's own structure gives the root its kind, and only once";
enum string NOT_AN_EDGE_CLAIM = "a site claims its vertex or face, not its edge";
enum string UNKNOWN_KIND = "unknown kind of horosphere";
enum double HALF_TURN = 3.141592653589793;
enum double VERTICAL_TOLERANCE = 1e-9;
enum Vec3!double ACROSS = Vec3!double(1, 0, 0);
enum Vec3!double UP = Vec3!double(0, 1, 0);
enum Vec3!double AHEAD = Vec3!double(0, 0, 1);

struct StructureProblem {
    char[MESSAGE_CAPACITY] text = 0;

    bool isPresent() const {
        return text[0] != 0;
    }

    static StructureProblem fromMessage(const(char)[] name, const(char)* message) {
        StructureProblem problem;
        snprintf(problem.text.ptr, problem.text.length, "structure %.*s: %s", cast(int) name.length, name.ptr, message);
        return problem;
    }
}

struct QueuedStructure {
    SiteFrame site;
    Array!uint held;
    Array!ubyte data;
    Structure structure;
    uint key;
}

struct PenFrame {
    Motion!double frame;
    Vec4!double ground;
    uint node;

    static PenFrame fromPen(Pen pen) {
        PenFrame made;
        foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
            foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
                made.frame.m.c[col][row] = pen.frame[col * 4 + row];
            }
        }
        made.ground = Vec4!double(pen.ground);
        made.node = pen.node;
        return made;
    }

    Pen toPen() const {
        Pen pen;
        foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
            foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
                pen.frame[col * 4 + row] = frame.m.c[col][row];
            }
        }
        pen.ground = ground.c;
        pen.node = node;
        return pen;
    }

    Vec3!double up() const {
        Vec4!double local = frame.inverse() * ground;
        double length = sqrt(local.c[0] * local.c[0] + local.c[1] * local.c[1] + local.c[2] * local.c[2]);
        return Vec3!double(local.c[0] / length, local.c[1] / length, local.c[2] / length);
    }

    PenFrame moved(double distance) const {
        return PenFrame((frame * Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(0, 0, distance))).orthonormalized(), ground, node);
    }

    PenFrame turned(Vec3!double from, Vec3!double toward, double degrees) const {
        return PenFrame(frame * planeRotation(from, toward, degrees * RADIANS_PER_DEGREE), ground, node);
    }

    PenFrame lifted(double degrees) const {
        Vec3!double rising = up();
        double side = sqrt(rising.x * rising.x + rising.y * rising.y);
        if (side < VERTICAL_TOLERANCE) {
            return this;
        } else {
            double toUp = atan2(side, rising.z);
            double angle = clamped(degrees * RADIANS_PER_DEGREE, toUp - HALF_TURN, toUp);
            return PenFrame(frame * planeRotation(AHEAD, Vec3!double(rising.x / side, rising.y / side, 0), angle), ground, node);
        }
    }
}

Motion!double planeRotation(Vec3!double from, Vec3!double toward, double angle) {
    Motion!double rotation = Motion!double.identity();
    double turn = sin(angle);
    double shrink = cos(angle) - 1;
    foreach (col; 0 .. 3) {
        foreach (row; 0 .. 3) {
            rotation.m.c[col][row] += turn * (toward[row] * from[col] - from[row] * toward[col]) + shrink * (from[row] * from[col] + toward[row] * toward[col]);
        }
    }
    return rotation;
}

Vec4!double unitNormal(Plane plane) {
    double stretch = cosh(plane.height);
    return Vec4!double([plane.up.x * stretch, plane.up.y * stretch, plane.up.z * stretch, -sinh(plane.height)]);
}

Span columnOf(ubyte dimension) {
    return Span(-cast(int) dimension, dimension - 1);
}

double cellLengthOf(ref const ChunkLayout layout) {
    return edgeLength(layout).value / edgeCells(layout.dimension);
}

mixin template Refusing() {
    const(char)* refusal;

    void refuse(const(char)* message) {
        if (refusal is null) {
            refusal = message;
        }
    }

    void takeRefusal() {
        if (refusal !is null) {
            fail(refusal);
            refusal = null;
        }
    }
}

bool isWithin(Box area, Span column) {
    return area.low.x >= column.low && area.high.x <= column.high && area.low.y >= column.low && area.high.y <= column.high;
}

bool isOrdered(Box area) {
    return area.low.x <= area.high.x && area.low.y <= area.high.y && area.low.z <= area.high.z;
}

Vec3!int cellOf(ColumnCell cell) {
    return Vec3!int(cell.x, cell.y, cell.z);
}

CellBox cellBoxOf(Box area) {
    return CellBox(cellOf(area.low), cellOf(area.high), area.extent);
}

const(char)* boxRefusal(Box area, ApiRhythm rhythm, Span column) {
    if (!isOrdered(area)) {
        return "a box runs from high to low";
    } else if (!area.isWithin(column)) {
        return "a box leaves the site's column";
    } else if (rhythm.repeat == Repeat.rhythmic && (rhythm.every <= 0 || rhythm.span <= 0)) {
        return "a rhythm needs a positive every and span";
    } else {
        return null;
    }
}

Rhythm engineRhythm(ApiRhythm rhythm) {
    return Rhythm(rhythm.every, rhythm.from, rhythm.span, rhythm.repeat);
}

Array!ubyte copied(const(void)* data, size_t size) {
    Array!ubyte bytes;
    bytes.resize(size);
    if (size > 0) {
        memcpy(bytes.ptr, data, size);
    }
    return bytes;
}

Structure worldNamed(const(char)* name) {
    return registry().find(name[0 .. strlen(name)]);
}

enum WorldStep : ubyte {
    previous,
    next,
}

uint steppedWorld(uint index, WorldStep direction) {
    uint count = cast(uint) registry().allNames().length + 1;
    uint step = count - 1;
    if (direction == WorldStep.next) {
        step = 1;
    }
    return (index + step) % count;
}

Worldgen worldgenAt(uint index) {
    if (index == 0) {
        return Worldgen.makeTerrain();
    } else {
        return Worldgen.fromStructure(StructureWorld.fromName(registry().allNames()[index - 1]));
    }
}

KindTag ensureRisingTag(ref GraphView view, Site site, HorosphereId over) {
    SiteFrame at = view.moveToLevel(frameOf(site), 0);
    Rise rise = view.ensureRise(at.node, at.corner, over);
    if (rise.kind.exists) {
        return KindTag.of(view.horospheres.kinds.ptr[rise.kind.value].tag);
    } else {
        return KindTag.init;
    }
}

struct StructureHost {
    BlueprintBuilder builder;
    Array!(Array!QueuedStructure) queue;
    TileCalls calls;
    TileWork tiles;
    Executor executor;
    SplitMix random;
    Api api;
    StructureWorld name;
    uint key;
    uint nextKey;
    StructureProblem problem;

    mixin Refusing;

    static StructureHost make(ref Graph graph) {
        StructureHost host;
        host.builder = BlueprintBuilder.make(graph);
        host.random = SplitMix(graph.anchorBits(graph.anchorSlot));
        host.name = StructureWorld.fromName(graph.worldgen.structureName());
        return host;
    }

    bool hasCover() const {
        foreach (call; calls.kinds.slice()) {
            if (call.tile !is null) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return calls.root.tile !is null || calls.edge.tile !is null;
    }

    void build(SiteFrame root) {
        api = mainApi(&this);
        tiles.calls = &calls;
        Structure world = registry().find(name.name());
        if (world is null) {
            fail("no plugin has a world by this name");
        } else {
            world(&api, siteOf(root), null);
            takeRefusal();
        }
    }

    void fail(const(char)* message) {
        if (!problem.isPresent) {
            problem = StructureProblem.fromMessage(name.name(), message);
        }
    }

    void grow(ref Graph graph, int through) {
        builder.graph = &graph;
        while (!problem.isPresent && nextKey < queue.length && cast(int) nextKey <= through) {
            size_t index = 0;
            while (!problem.isPresent && index < queue.ptr[nextKey].length) {
                run(queue.ptr[nextKey].ptr[index]);
                index += 1;
            }
            if (!problem.isPresent) {
                queue.ptr[nextKey].release();
                nextKey += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    void run(ref QueuedStructure queued) {
        key = queued.key;
        builder.growFrom(queued.key);
        foreach (slot; queued.held.slice()) {
            builder.graph.unreference(slot);
        }
        queued.held.release();
        queued.structure(&api, siteOf(queued.site), queued.data.ptr);
        queued.data.release();
        takeRefusal();
    }

    void cover(ref Graph graph, uint slot) {
        builder.graph = &graph;
        if (!problem.isPresent && hasCover()) {
            void onTile(TileKey key, SiteFrame site, HorosphereId over, int segment, TileSpan span) {
                coverTile(graph, key, site, over, segment, span);
            }
            visitTilesAt!onTile(graph.view, calls, slot);
            runTiles(graph);
        }
    }

    void coverTile(ref Graph graph, TileKey key, SiteFrame site, HorosphereId over, int segment, TileSpan span) {
        const(uint)* known = graph.structures.tiledFaces.find(key);
        if (known !is null && !graph.structures.blueprint.tiles.ptr[*known].isDropped) {
            graph.structures.blueprint.useTile(*known);
        } else {
            tiles.addTask(graph, key, site.node, null, over, site, segment, span);
        }
    }

    void runTiles(ref Graph graph) {
        tiles.fallbackTiles += cast(uint) tiles.tasks.length;
        tiles.runTasks(graph, executor);
        if (tiles.hasFailed) {
            fail(tiles.failure.ptr);
        }
    }

    void paintAhead(ref Graph graph, const(uint)[] candidates, Executor chosen) {
        executor = chosen;
        builder.graph = &graph;
        if (!problem.isPresent && hasCover()) {
            tiles.paintAhead(graph, candidates, executor);
            if (tiles.hasFailed) {
                fail(tiles.failure.ptr);
            }
        }
    }

    void enqueue(QueuedStructure queued) {
        while (queue.length <= queued.key) {
            queue.append(Array!QueuedStructure.init);
        }
        builder.graph.reference(queued.site.node);
        queued.held.append(queued.site.node);
        queue.ptr[queued.key].append(queued);
    }

    ref GraphView hostView() {
        return builder.graph.view;
    }

    ubyte dimension() const {
        return builder.graph.layout.dimension;
    }

    Span column() const {
        return columnOf(dimension());
    }

    double cellLength() const {
        return cellLengthOf(builder.graph.layout);
    }

    void paint(Site site, Material material, Box area, ApiRhythm rhythm, Cover cover) {
        const(char)* wrong = boxRefusal(area, rhythm, column());
        if (wrong !is null) {
            refuse(wrong);
        } else {
            PaintResult result = builder.paint(frameOf(site), cellBoxOf(area), engineRhythm(rhythm), material, cover);
            if (result == PaintResult.endless) {
                refuse(UNBOUNDED_PAINT);
            } else if (result == PaintResult.behind) {
                refuse("paints too far behind its site: a placed structure stays near where it was placed");
            }
        }
    }

    bool place(Site site, Structure structure, const(void)* data, size_t size) {
        SiteFrame frame = frameOf(site);
        RootedCorner origin = builder.graph.view.ensureSiteOrigin(frame);
        if (cast(int) origin.depth + PLACE_SLACK >= cast(int) key) {
            enqueue(QueuedStructure(frame, Array!uint.init, copied(data, size), structure, higherOf(origin.depth, key)));
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }

    ClaimKey ensureClaimKeyAt(Site site, SitePart part) {
        return builder.graph.view.ensureClaimKey(frameOf(site), part);
    }

    bool claim(Site site, SitePart part) {
        if (part == SitePart.edge) {
            refuse(NOT_AN_EDGE_CLAIM);
            return false;
        } else {
            return builder.claim(ensureClaimKeyAt(site, part));
        }
    }

    bool probeClaimed(Site site, SitePart part) {
        if (part == SitePart.edge) {
            refuse(NOT_AN_EDGE_CLAIM);
            return false;
        } else {
            ClaimKey key = ensureClaimKeyAt(site, part);
            return builder.blueprint.isClaimed(key);
        }
    }

    void tile(Tile tile, const(void)* data, size_t size) {
        if (builder.isGrowing || calls.hasRoot) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_TILES_GROUND);
        } else {
            calls.root = TileCall(tile, copied(data, size));
        }
    }

    void tileEdges(Tile tile, const(void)* data, size_t size) {
        if (builder.isGrowing || calls.hasEdge) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_TILES_EDGES);
        } else {
            calls.edge = TileCall(tile, copied(data, size));
        }
    }

    void flatten(Site site) {
        if (builder.isGrowing) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_FLATTENS);
        } else {
            SiteFrame at = builder.graph.view.moveToLevel(frameOf(site), 0);
            builder.graph.structures.blueprint.flats.append(at);
            builder.graph.reference(at.node);
            foreach (slot; 0 .. builder.graph.slotCount) {
                if (builder.graph.nodeAt(slot).hasState) {
                    builder.graph.states.at(slot).climate.calm = builder.graph.view.calmAt(slot);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void invertGravity() {
        if (builder.isGrowing) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_TURNS_GRAVITY);
        } else {
            builder.graph.horospheres.pull = GravityPull.up;
        }
    }

    void fog(double units) {
        if (builder.isGrowing) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_SETS_FOG);
        } else if (!(units > 0)) {
            refuse("the fog closes in past a distance above zero");
        } else {
            builder.graph.structures.blueprint.fog = Maybe!float.of(cast(float) units);
        }
    }

    KindId horosphere(double odds, HorosphereForm form, uint tag, Tile tile, const(void)* data, size_t size) {
        Horospheres* horospheres = &builder.graph.horospheres;
        if (builder.isGrowing) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_GIVES_KINDS);
            return KindId.init;
        } else if (!(odds >= 0) || horospheres.totalOdds() + odds > 1) {
            refuse("horosphere odds are chances per vertex, and all kinds together add up to at most 1");
            return KindId.init;
        } else if (horospheres.kinds.length == ubyte.max) {
            refuse("too many kinds of horosphere");
            return KindId.init;
        } else {
            horospheres.kinds.append(HorosphereKind(odds, form, tag));
            calls.kinds.append(TileCall(tile, copied(data, size)));
            return KindId.of(cast(uint) horospheres.kinds.length - 1);
        }
    }

    KindId sunken(double odds, uint under, uint tag, Tile tile, const(void)* data, size_t size) {
        KindId made = horosphere(odds, HorosphereForm.sunken, tag, tile, data, size);
        if (refusal is null) {
            builder.graph.horospheres.kinds.ptr[made.value].under = under;
        }
        return made;
    }

    void look(KindId kind, ref const Look chosen) {
        if (builder.isGrowing) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_SETS_LOOK);
        } else if (!isKnownKind(kind)) {
            refuse(UNKNOWN_KIND);
        } else {
            builder.graph.horospheres.kinds.ptr[kind.value].look = chosen;
        }
    }

    void worldLook(ref const Look chosen) {
        if (builder.isGrowing) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_SETS_LOOK);
        } else {
            builder.graph.structures.blueprint.look = chosen;
        }
    }

    void addRisingKinds(double odds) {
        foreach (ref kind; registry().risingKinds[0 .. registry().kindCount]) {
            KindId made = horosphere(odds * kind.share, kind.form, kind.tag, kind.tile, kind.data, kind.size);
            if (refusal is null) {
                builder.graph.horospheres.kinds.ptr[made.value].under = kind.under;
                look(made, kind.look);
            }
        }
    }

    bool isKnownKind(KindId kind) const {
        return kind.exists && kind.value < builder.graph.horospheres.kinds.length;
    }

    void openHorosphereAt(Site site, KindId kind, uint edges) {
        if (builder.isGrowing) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_OPENS);
        } else if (!isKnownKind(kind)) {
            refuse(UNKNOWN_KIND);
        } else if (edges < LOWEST_RISE_EDGES || edges > ubyte.max) {
            refuse("a horosphere rises at least two edges");
        } else {
            bool opened = (*builder.graph).openHorosphere(frameOf(site), Rise(MaybeIndex!ubyte.of(cast(ubyte) kind.value), cast(ubyte) edges));
            if (!opened) {
                refuse("a horosphere beside another one would cross it");
            }
        }
    }

    void rooted(KindId kind) {
        Horospheres* horospheres = &builder.graph.horospheres;
        if (builder.isGrowing || horospheres.rootKind.exists) {
            refuse(ONLY_WORLD_ROOTS);
        } else if (!isKnownKind(kind)) {
            refuse(UNKNOWN_KIND);
        } else if (horospheres.isUprightKind(cast(ubyte) kind.value)) {
            refuse("the root is a plane, so it cannot be an upright kind");
        } else {
            horospheres.rootKind = MaybeIndex!ubyte.of(cast(ubyte) kind.value);
        }
    }

    KindTag ensureRisingTagAt(Site site) {
        return builder.graph.view.ensureRisingTag(site, ROOT);
    }

    PenFrame ensurePen(Site site) {
        Graph* graph = builder.graph;
        SiteFrame frame = frameOf(site);
        return PenFrame(sitePlacement(frame, graph.layout).as!double(), unitNormal(graph.ensureState(frame.node).surface), frame.node);
    }

    void draw(Pen pen, double cells, double fromRadius, double toRadius, Material material, StrokeForm form) {
        if (builder.isGrowing) {
            refuse("only the world's own structure draws with a pen");
        } else if (!(cells >= 0) || !(fromRadius > 0) || !(toRadius > 0)) {
            refuse(BAD_PEN_DRAW);
        } else {
            Graph* graph = builder.graph;
            double cell = cellLength();
            PenFrame frame = PenFrame.fromPen(pen);
            graph.structures.addStroke(graph.view, PaintOwner.init, frame.node, Stroke.make(frame.frame, cells * cell, cast(float)(fromRadius * cell), cast(float)(toRadius * cell), material, form));
        }
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (ref bucket; queue.slice()) {
            foreach (ref queued; bucket.slice()) {
                queued.held.release();
                queued.data.release();
            }
            bucket.release();
        }
        queue.release();
        calls.release();
        tiles.release();
        builder.release();
    }
}

StructureHost* mainHost(const(Api)* api) {
    return cast(StructureHost*) api.host;
}

Api mainApi(StructureHost* host) {
    Api api;
    api.host = host;
    api.failure = &apiFailure!mainHost;
    api.fail = &apiFail!mainHost;
    api.forward = &apiForward;
    api.turn = &apiTurned!mainHost;
    api.column = &apiColumn!mainHost;
    api.edgeCells = &apiEdgeCells!mainHost;
    api.pick = &apiPick!mainHost;
    api.random = &apiRandom!mainHost;
    api.probeHash = &apiHash!mainHost;
    api.paint = &apiPaint!mainHost;
    api.fill = &apiFill!mainHost;
    api.stop = &mainStop;
    api.entrance = &mainEntrance;
    api.place = &mainPlace;
    api.claim = &mainClaim;
    api.probeClaimed = &mainProbeClaimed;
    api.tile = &mainTile;
    api.tileEdges = &mainTileEdges;
    api.horosphere = &mainHorosphere;
    api.sunken = &mainSunken;
    api.openHorosphere = &mainOpenHorosphere;
    api.columnSite = &mainColumnSite;
    api.flatten = &mainFlatten;
    api.rooted = &mainRooted;
    api.invertGravity = &mainInvertGravity;
    api.fog = &mainFog;
    api.probeRising = &apiRising!mainHost;
    api.probeBalance = &mainBalance;
    api.openPen = &apiPen!mainHost;
    api.penForward = &apiPenForward!mainHost;
    api.penTurn = &apiPenTurn;
    api.penRoll = &apiPenRoll;
    api.penLift = &apiPenLift;
    api.penRise = &apiPenRise;
    api.penHeight = &apiPenHeight!mainHost;
    api.limb = &apiLimb!mainHost;
    api.leaves = &apiLeaves!mainHost;
    api.build = &apiBuild!mainHost;
    api.look = &mainLook;
    api.worldLook = &mainWorldLook;
    api.risingKinds = &mainRisingKinds;
    api.landmark = &mainLandmark;
    return api;
}

const(char)* apiFailure(alias hostOf)(const(Api)* api) {
    const(char)* refusal = hostOf(api).refusal;
    hostOf(api).refusal = null;
    return refusal;
}

void apiFail(alias hostOf)(const(Api)* api, const(char)* message) {
    hostOf(api).refuse(message);
}

Site apiForward(const(Api)* api, Site site, int edges) {
    return siteOf(forwarded(frameOf(site), edges));
}

Site apiTurned(alias hostOf)(const(Api)* api, Site site, Turn turn) {
    return siteOf(hostOf(api).hostView.turnSite(frameOf(site), turn));
}

ulong apiHash(alias hostOf)(const(Api)* api, Site site, SitePart part) {
