StructureProblem placeWorldStructure(ref Graph graph) {
    if (!graph.worldgen.hasStructure()) {
        return StructureProblem.init;
    } else {
        StructureHost* host = cast(StructureHost*) malloc(StructureHost.sizeof);
        *host = StructureHost.make(graph);
        host.build(rootSite(graph.anchorSlot));
        StructureProblem problem = host.problem;
        if (problem.isPresent || !(host.nextKey < host.queue.length || host.hasCover())) {
            releaseStructureHost(host);
        } else {
            graph.structures.grower = Grower(&growStructures, &coverStructures, &paintStructuresAhead, &releaseStructureHost, host);
        }
        return problem;
    }
}

void growStructures(void* context, ref Graph graph, int through) {
    (cast(StructureHost*) context).grow(graph, through);
}

void coverStructures(void* context, ref Graph graph, uint slot) {
    (cast(StructureHost*) context).cover(graph, slot);
}

void paintStructuresAhead(void* context, ref Graph graph, const(uint)[] candidates, Executor executor) {
    (cast(StructureHost*) context).paintAhead(graph, candidates, executor);
}

void releaseStructureHost(void* context) {
    StructureHost* host = cast(StructureHost*) context;
    host.release();
    free(host);
}

struct TileCounts {
    uint prepared;
    uint fallback;
}

TileCounts tileCounts(ref const Graph graph) {
    if (graph.structures.grower.context is null) {
        return TileCounts.init;
    } else {
        const(TileWork)* tiles = &(cast(const(StructureHost)*) graph.structures.grower.context).tiles;
        return TileCounts(tiles.preparedTiles, tiles.fallbackTiles);
    }
}

StructureProblem growthProblem(ref const Graph graph) {
    if (graph.structures.grower.context is null) {
        return StructureProblem.init;
    } else {
        return (cast(const(StructureHost)*) graph.structures.grower.context).problem;
    }
}

StructureProblem placeStructure(ref Game game) {
    StructureProblem problem = placeWorldStructure(game.world.graph);
    if (problem.isPresent) {
        return problem;
    } else {
        game.placeAtSpawn();
        return growthProblem(game.world.graph);
    }
}

StructureProblem restartGame(ref Game game, Worldgen worldgen) {
    game.rebuildWorld(worldgen);
    return placeStructure(game);
}

/// file: source/client/tasks.d
module client.tasks;

import core.atomic : atomicLoad, atomicOp, atomicStore;
import core.stdc.stdlib : calloc;
import base.array : Array;
import base.numbers : higherOf;
import base.parallel : ConcurrentQueue, MAIN_WORKER, WorkerPool, waitWhile, wake;
import common.node : ChunkSlot;
import common.worldgen.building : Building, BuildingPlan;
import common.worldgen.generation : ChunkParams, GeneratedVoxels, Yield;

enum uint RESERVED_CORES = 2;
enum size_t QUEUE_CAPACITY = 1 << 14;

enum GenKind : ubyte {
    fresh,
    restoring,
}

struct GenRequest {
    ChunkParams params;
    ChunkSlot chunk;
    GenKind kind;
}

struct GenResult {
    GeneratedVoxels generated;
    ChunkSlot chunk;
    GenKind kind;
}

struct BuildingRequest {
    BuildingPlan plan;
    uint slot;
}

struct BuildingResult {
    Building building;
    uint slot;
}

struct TaskQueues {
    ConcurrentQueue!GenRequest generations;
    ConcurrentQueue!GenRequest urgent;
    ConcurrentQueue!BuildingRequest buildings;
    ConcurrentQueue!BuildingRequest urgentBuildings;
    ConcurrentQueue!GenResult generated;
    ConcurrentQueue!BuildingResult built;
    WorkerPool* pool;
    shared uint completed;
    shared uint awaiting;

    static TaskQueues* make() {
        TaskQueues* queues = cast(TaskQueues*) calloc(1, TaskQueues.sizeof);
        queues.generations = ConcurrentQueue!GenRequest.make(QUEUE_CAPACITY);
        queues.urgent = ConcurrentQueue!GenRequest.make(QUEUE_CAPACITY);
        queues.buildings = ConcurrentQueue!BuildingRequest.make(QUEUE_CAPACITY);
        queues.urgentBuildings = ConcurrentQueue!BuildingRequest.make(QUEUE_CAPACITY);
        queues.generated = ConcurrentQueue!GenResult.make(QUEUE_CAPACITY);
        queues.built = ConcurrentQueue!BuildingResult.make(QUEUE_CAPACITY);
        return queues;
    }

    void announce() {
        atomicOp!"+="(completed, 1);
        uint waiting = atomicLoad(awaiting);
        if (waiting != 0) {
            wake(completed);
        }
    }

    void await(uint seen) {
        version (WebAssembly) {
            takeTask(&this, MAIN_WORKER);
        }
        atomicStore(awaiting, 1);
        uint latest = atomicLoad(completed);
        if (latest == seen) {
            waitWhile(completed, seen);
        }
        atomicStore(awaiting, 0);
    }

    void release() {
        void dropRequest(ref GenRequest request) {
        }
        void dropPlan(ref BuildingRequest request) {
            request.plan.release();
        }
        void dropVoxels(ref GenResult result) {
            result.generated.voxels.release();
        }
        void dropBuilding(ref BuildingResult result) {
            result.building.release();
        }
        drained!dropRequest(generations);
        drained!dropRequest(urgent);
        drained!dropPlan(buildings);
        drained!dropPlan(urgentBuildings);
        drained!dropVoxels(generated);
        drained!dropBuilding(built);
        generations.release();
        urgent.release();
        buildings.release();
        urgentBuildings.release();
        generated.release();
        built.release();
    }
}

void drained(alias drop, T)(ref ConcurrentQueue!T queue) {
    T item;
    bool popped = queue.pop(item);
    while (popped) {
        drop(item);
        popped = queue.pop(item);
    }
}

struct JobHelp {
    WorkerPool* pool;
    uint worker;
}

void yieldToJob(void* context) {
    JobHelp* help = cast(JobHelp*) context;
    help.pool.helpWithJob(help.worker);
}

bool takeTask(void* context, uint worker) {
    TaskQueues* queues = cast(TaskQueues*) context;
    BuildingRequest building;
    GenRequest request;
    bool took = queues.urgentBuildings.pop(building);
    if (took) {
        makeBuilding(queues, building);
    }
    if (!took) {
        took = queues.urgent.pop(request);
        if (took) {
            generate(queues, request, worker);
        }
    }
    if (!took) {
        took = queues.buildings.pop(building);
        if (took) {
            makeBuilding(queues, building);
        }
    }
    if (!took) {
        took = queues.generations.pop(request);
        if (took) {
            generate(queues, request, worker);
        }
    }
    if (took) {
        queues.announce();
    }
    return took;
}

void makeBuilding(TaskQueues* queues, BuildingRequest building) {
    BuildingResult made = BuildingResult(Building.make(building.plan), building.slot);
    building.plan.release();
    bool accepted = queues.built.push(made);
    assert(accepted);
}

void generate(TaskQueues* queues, GenRequest request, uint worker) {
    JobHelp help = JobHelp(queues.pool, worker);
    bool accepted = queues.generated.push(GenResult(request.params.generateVoxels(Yield(&yieldToJob, &help)), request.chunk, request.kind));
    assert(accepted);
}

size_t pushedPrefix(T)(ref ConcurrentQueue!T queue, ref Array!T pending, size_t room) {
    size_t pushed = 0;
    bool accepted = true;
    while (accepted && pushed < pending.length && pushed < room) {
        accepted = queue.push(pending.ptr[pushed]);
        if (accepted) {
            pushed += 1;
        }
    }
    foreach (index; pushed .. pending.length) {
        pending.ptr[index - pushed] = pending.ptr[index];
    }
    pending.length -= pushed;
    return pushed;
}

uint workerThreadCount(long cores) {
    return cast(uint) higherOf(cores - RESERVED_CORES, 1L);
}

/// file: source/client/text.d
module client.text;

import core.stdc.math : roundf;
import base.array : Array;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : clamped, higherOf;
import client.font : Font, GlyphBounds, Outline, PLEX_MONO, PixelBox, PixelFrame, Raster, Segment, Transform, addGlyph, advanceOf, boundsOf, flatten, glyphOf, pixelBoxOf;

enum uint ATLAS_WIDTH = 1024;
enum uint ATLAS_HEIGHT = 512;
enum uint ATLAS_COLUMNS = 16;
enum char FIRST_CHARACTER = ' ';
enum char LAST_CHARACTER = '~';
enum uint GLYPH_COUNT = LAST_CHARACTER - FIRST_CHARACTER + 1;
enum uint ATLAS_ROWS = (GLYPH_COUNT + ATLAS_COLUMNS - 1) / ATLAS_COLUMNS;
enum uint GLYPH_PADDING = 1;
enum uint WHITE_BLOCK_SIDE = 2;
enum uint WHITE_BLOCK_X = ATLAS_WIDTH - WHITE_BLOCK_SIDE;
enum uint WHITE_BLOCK_Y = ATLAS_HEIGHT - WHITE_BLOCK_SIDE;
enum uint WHITE_TEXEL_X = WHITE_BLOCK_X + WHITE_BLOCK_SIDE / 2;
enum uint WHITE_TEXEL_Y = WHITE_BLOCK_Y + WHITE_BLOCK_SIDE / 2;
enum ubyte FULL_TEXEL = 255;
enum uint LEAST_EM_PIXELS = 12;
enum uint MOST_EM_PIXELS = 48;
enum float EM_SHARE_OF_HEIGHT = 0.025f;
enum char ADVANCE_CHARACTER = 'M';
enum uint TEXEL_Y_SHIFT = 16;

uint texelOf(uint x, uint y) {
    return x | (y << TEXEL_Y_SHIFT);
}

enum uint WHITE_TEXEL = texelOf(WHITE_TEXEL_X, WHITE_TEXEL_Y);

uint emPixelsFor(uint screenHeight) {
    return clamped(cast(uint) roundf(screenHeight * EM_SHARE_OF_HEIGHT), LEAST_EM_PIXELS, MOST_EM_PIXELS);
}

struct AtlasGlyph {
    PixelBox box;
    uint atlasX;
    uint atlasY;
}

struct GlyphAtlas {
    Array!ubyte pixels;
    Array!Segment segments;
    Outline outline;
    Raster raster;
    AtlasGlyph[GLYPH_COUNT] glyphs;
    uint emPixels;
    uint advance;
    uint ascent;
    uint lineHeight;
    uint revision;

    void ensure(uint wanted) {
        if (wanted != emPixels) {
            build(wanted);
        }
    }

    void build(uint chosen) {
        Font font = Font.make(PLEX_MONO);
        float scale = cast(float) chosen / font.unitsPerEm;
        ushort[GLYPH_COUNT] ids;
        uint cellWidth = 0;
        uint cellHeight = 0;
        foreach (index, ref glyph; glyphs) {
            ids[index] = font.glyphOf(FIRST_CHARACTER + cast(uint) index);
            Maybe!GlyphBounds bounds = font.boundsOf(ids[index]);
            glyph.box = PixelBox.init;
            if (bounds.exists) {
                glyph.box = pixelBoxOf(bounds.value, scale);
            }
            cellWidth = higherOf(cellWidth, glyph.box.width + 2 * GLYPH_PADDING);
            cellHeight = higherOf(cellHeight, glyph.box.height + 2 * GLYPH_PADDING);
        }
        assert(ATLAS_COLUMNS * cellWidth <= WHITE_BLOCK_X && ATLAS_ROWS * cellHeight <= WHITE_BLOCK_Y);
        pixels.resize(cast(size_t) ATLAS_WIDTH * ATLAS_HEIGHT);
        pixels.slice()[] = 0;
        foreach (index, ref glyph; glyphs) {
            glyph.atlasX = cast(uint)(index % ATLAS_COLUMNS) * cellWidth + GLYPH_PADDING;
            glyph.atlasY = cast(uint)(index / ATLAS_COLUMNS) * cellHeight + GLYPH_PADDING;
            if (glyph.box.width > 0 && glyph.box.height > 0) {
                outline.clear();
                font.addGlyph(ids[index], Transform.init, outline);
                segments.clear();
                flatten(outline, PixelFrame(scale, glyph.box.left, glyph.box.top), segments);
                raster.begin(glyph.box.width, glyph.box.height);
                raster.fill(segments.slice());
                raster.writeCoverage(glyph.box.width, pixels.slice(), ATLAS_WIDTH, cast(size_t) glyph.atlasY * ATLAS_WIDTH + glyph.atlasX);
            }
        }
        foreach (y; WHITE_BLOCK_Y .. WHITE_BLOCK_Y + WHITE_BLOCK_SIDE) {
            pixels.slice()[cast(size_t) y * ATLAS_WIDTH + WHITE_BLOCK_X .. cast(size_t) y * ATLAS_WIDTH + WHITE_BLOCK_X + WHITE_BLOCK_SIDE] = FULL_TEXEL;
        }
        advance = cast(uint) roundf(font.advanceOf(font.glyphOf(ADVANCE_CHARACTER)) * scale);
        ascent = cast(uint) roundf(font.ascender * scale);
        lineHeight = cast(uint) roundf((font.ascender - font.descender + font.lineGap) * scale);
        emPixels = chosen;
        revision += 1;
    }

    void release() {
        pixels.release();
        segments.release();
        outline.release();
        raster.release();
    }
}

enum double PAINT_AHEAD_MILLISECONDS = 2.0;

struct TileOutput {

    uint lineStart;
    uint lineCount;
    uint brushStart;
    uint brushCount;
    uint touchStart;
    uint touchCount;
    uint stopStart;
    uint stopCount;
    uint strokeStart;
    uint strokeCount;
    TaskEnd end;
}

struct TilePainter {
    Array!SiteLine known;
    Array!LineOutput lines;
    Array!BrushOutput brushes;
    Array!TouchOutput touches;
    Array!StopOutput stops;
    Array!StrokeOutput strokes;
    Array!Face paths;
    Array!TileOutput outputs;
    TileOutput current;
    TilePass pass;

    void clear() {
        lines.clear();
        brushes.clear();
        touches.clear();
        stops.clear();
        strokes.clear();
        paths.clear();
        outputs.clear();
    }

    void begin(uint task, TilePass chosen) {
        known.clear();
        pass = chosen;
        current = TileOutput.init;
        current.task = task;
        current.lineStart = cast(uint) lines.length;
        current.brushStart = cast(uint) brushes.length;
        current.touchStart = cast(uint) touches.length;
        current.stopStart = cast(uint) stops.length;
        current.strokeStart = cast(uint) strokes.length;
    }

    void finish(TaskEnd end) {
        current.lineCount = cast(uint) lines.length - current.lineStart;
        current.brushCount = cast(uint) brushes.length - current.brushStart;
        current.touchCount = cast(uint) touches.length - current.touchStart;
        current.stopCount = cast(uint) stops.length - current.stopStart;
        current.strokeCount = cast(uint) strokes.length - current.strokeStart;
        current.end = end;
        outputs.append(current);
    }

    SiteLine* ensureLine(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site) {
        uint index = 0;
        while (index < known.length && known.ptr[index].site != site) {
            index += 1;
        }
        if (index == known.length) {
            CanonicalSite canonical = view.canonicalOf(site);
            LineKey key = LineKey(view.idAt(canonical.line.node.value), canonical.line.lower, canonical.line.xSide, canonical.line.ySide);
            uint line = current.lineStart;
            while (line < lines.length && lines.ptr[line].key != key) {
                line += 1;
            }
            if (line == lines.length) {
                lines.append(LineOutput(key, canonical.line));
            }
            known.append(SiteLine(site, canonical.transform, line));
        }
        return &known.ptr[index];
    }

    PaintResult paint(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site, CellBox box, Rhythm rhythm, Material material, Cover cover) {
        SiteLine* found = ensureLine(view, site);
        ubyte dimension = view.layout.dimension;
        CellBox canonical = canonicalBox(box, found.transform, dimension);
        int lowEdge = edgeOf(canonical.low.z, dimension);
        int highEdge = edgeOf(canonical.high.z, dimension);
        if (canonical.isEndless) {
            return PaintResult.endless;
        } else {
            bool ahead = true;
            if (pass == TilePass.first) {
                bool isClosed(uint slot) {
                    return view.hasStructureAt(slot);
                }
                ahead = probeLineAhead!isClosed(view, *found, lines.ptr[found.line].spec, lowEdge, highEdge);
            }
            if (!ahead) {
                return PaintResult.behind;
            } else {
                if (pass == TilePass.first) {
                    record(view, *found, lowEdge, highEdge);
                }
                brushes.append(BrushOutput(found.line, Brush(canonical, canonicalRhythm(rhythm, found.transform, dimension), 0, Paint(MaybeIndex!ubyte.init, cover)), material));
                return PaintResult.painted;
            }
        }
    }

    void record(ref GraphView view, ref SiteLine found, int lowEdge, int highEdge) {
        LineOutput* line = &lines.ptr[found.line];
        if (!found.touched.contains(lowEdge, highEdge)) {
            const(uint)* existing = view.blueprint.lineIndex.find(line.key);
            SlotTouch edge = seedTouch(line.spec, found.line);
            foreach (level; lowEdge .. highEdge + 1) {
                if (existing is null || !view.blueprint.isEdgeTouched(LineEdge(*existing, level))) {
                    edge = view.walkTouch(edge, line.spec, level);
                    TouchOutput touched = TouchOutput(found.line, level);
                    foreach (index, around; view.ensureAroundEdge(edge, line.spec)) {
                        touched.nodes[index] = view.idAt(around.slot);
                        touched.touches[index] = around.touch;
                    }
                    touches.append(touched);
                }
            }
            found.touched.include(lowEdge, highEdge);
        }
        line.edges.widen(lowEdge, highEdge);
    }

    void stop(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site, ColumnSpot spot, StopKind kind) {
        if (pass == TilePass.first) {
            uint pathStart = cast(uint) paths.length;
            uint start = view.pathTo(site.node, paths);
            stops.append(StopOutput(site, spot, start, pathStart, cast(uint) paths.length - pathStart, kind));
        }
    }

    void stroke(ref GraphView view, PenFrame pen, double length, float startRadius, float endRadius, Material material, StrokeForm form) {
        uint pathStart = cast(uint) paths.length;
        uint start = view.pathTo(pen.node, paths);
        strokes.append(StrokeOutput(pen.frame, length, startRadius, endRadius, material, form, start, pathStart, cast(uint) paths.length - pathStart));
    }

    void release() {
        known.release();
        lines.release();
        brushes.release();
        touches.release();
        stops.release();
        strokes.release();
        paths.release();
        outputs.release();
    }
}

struct TileTask {
    TileKey key;
    uint start;
    uint pathStart;
    uint pathLength;
    uint record;
    HorosphereId horosphere;
    SiteFrame site;
    int segment;
    TileSpan span;
    TilePass pass;
}

struct PlannedTile {
    TileKey key;
    uint start;
    uint pathStart;
    uint pathLength;
    HorosphereId horosphere;
    SiteFrame site;
    int segment;
    TileSpan span;
}

struct PlanResult {
    uint candidate;
    uint tileStart;
    uint tileCount;
    PlanEnd end;
}

struct MeasuredRise {
    HorosphereId horosphere;
    RiseMeasure measure;
}

struct PlanOutputs {
    Array!PlannedTile tiles;
    Array!Face paths;
    Array!PlanResult results;
    Array!uint usedRecords;
    Array!MeasuredRise measures;

    void clear() {
        tiles.clear();
        paths.clear();
        results.clear();
        usedRecords.clear();
        measures.clear();
    }

    bool hasMeasure(HorosphereId horosphere) const {
        uint index = 0;
        while (index < measures.length && measures.ptr[index].horosphere != horosphere) {
            index += 1;
        }
        return index < measures.length;
    }

    void release() {
        tiles.release();
        paths.release();
        results.release();
        usedRecords.release();
        measures.release();
    }
}

bool isTiledBy(ref const Graph graph, ref const TileCalls calls, HorosphereId horosphere) {
    return callFor(graph, calls, horosphere).tile !is null;
}

const(TileCall)* callFor(ref const Graph graph, ref const TileCalls calls, HorosphereId horosphere) {
    MaybeIndex!ubyte kind = graph.horospheres.kindOf(horosphere);
    if (kind.exists) {
        return &calls.kinds.ptr[kind.value];
    } else {
        return &calls.root;
    }
}

void visitTilesAt(alias onTile)(ref GraphView view, ref const TileCalls calls, uint slot) {
    if (isTiledBy(*view.graph, calls, ROOT)) {
        foreach (face; view.ensureGroundRing(view.ensureGroundNode(slot, ROOT), Face.first)) {
            onTile(view.faceKey(face, Face.first), faceSite(face, Face.first), ROOT, 0, TileSpan.ground);
        }
    }
    size_t count = view.ensureHorospheresAt(slot).length;
    foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
        HorosphereRef near = view.horospheresAt(slot)[index];
        if (!view.isBlocked && isTiledBy(*view.graph, calls, near.horosphere)) {
            if (view.horospheres.isUpright(near.horosphere)) {
                Span segments = view.ensureSegmentsNear(near);
                foreach (segment; segments.low .. segments.high + 1) {
                    SiteFrame site = view.ensureSegmentSite(near.horosphere, segment);
                    onTile(view.segmentKey(site), site, near.horosphere, segment, TileSpan.ground);
                }
            } else {
                bool painted = view.probePaintedBy(slot, near);
                if (painted) {
                    Face label = view.horospheres.horosphere(near.horosphere).label;
                    foreach (face; view.ensureGroundRing(view.ensureGroundNode(slot, near.horosphere), label)) {
                        onTile(view.faceKey(face, label), faceSite(face, label), near.horosphere, 0, TileSpan.ground);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (calls.hasEdge) {
        foreach (site; view.edgeSitesOf(slot)) {
            onTile(view.edgeKey(site), site, ROOT, 0, TileSpan.edge);
        }
    }
}

Risen risenOf(ref const Graph graph, HorosphereId horosphere, int segment) {
    Risen risen;
    risen.segment = segment;
    if (horosphere != ROOT) {
        const(Horosphere)* found = &graph.horospheres.horosphere(horosphere);
        risen.rising = Rising.risen;
        risen.foot = siteOf(found.foot);
        risen.edges = found.edges;
        risen.ground = found.ground;
        risen.balance = found.balance;
        risen.lower = graph.horospheres.tagOf(found.parent);
    }
    return risen;
}

TileKey faceKey(ref const GraphView view, uint face, Face label) {
    return TileKey(view.idAt(face), label);
}

TileKey segmentKey(ref const GraphView view, SiteFrame site) {
    return TileKey(view.idAt(site.node), cast(ubyte)(FACE_COUNT + site.corner));
}

TileKey edgeKey(ref const GraphView view, SiteFrame site) {
    return TileKey(view.idAt(site.node), cast(ubyte)(FACE_COUNT + CORNER_COUNT + site.corner * 3 + sideAxis(site.corner, site.zSide())));
}

struct TileHost {
    TilePainter painter;
    PlanOutputs plan;
    GraphView* view;
    const(TileCalls)* calls;
    Api api;
    SplitMix random;
    HorosphereId horosphere;
    int segment;
    TaskEnd taskEnd;
    char[MESSAGE_CAPACITY] failure = 0;

    mixin Refusing;

    void fail(const(char)* message) {
        taskEnd = TaskEnd.failed;
        if (failure[0] == 0) {
            snprintf(failure.ptr, failure.length, "%s (tile over horosphere %u, segment %d)", message, horosphere.bits, segment);
        }
    }

    ref GraphView hostView() {
        return *view;
    }

    ubyte dimension() const {
        return view.layout.dimension;
    }

    Span column() const {
        return columnOf(dimension());
    }

    double cellLength() const {
        return cellLengthOf(view.layout);
    }

    void run(ref const Graph graph, GraphView* threadView, ref const TileTask task, const(Face)[] path, uint index) {
        view = threadView;
        uint node = task.start;
        foreach (side; path) {
            node = view.ensureNeighborSlot(node, side);
        }
        painter.begin(index, task.pass);
        random = SplitMix(task.key.node.spice() ^ task.key.feature);
        horosphere = task.horosphere;
        segment = task.segment;
        taskEnd = TaskEnd.painted;
        const(TileCall)* call = &calls.edge;
        if (task.span == TileSpan.ground) {
            call = callFor(graph, *calls, task.horosphere);
        }
        Risen risen = risenOf(graph, task.horosphere, task.segment);
        SiteFrame site = task.site;
        site.node = node;
        call.tile(&api, siteOf(site), &risen, call.data.ptr);
        takeRefusal();
        painter.finish(taskEnd);
    }

    void paint(Site site, Material material, Box area, ApiRhythm rhythm, Cover cover) {
        const(char)* wrong = boxRefusal(area, rhythm, column());
        if (wrong !is null) {
            refuse(wrong);
        } else {
            PaintResult result = painter.paint(*view, frameOf(site), cellBoxOf(area), engineRhythm(rhythm), material, cover);
            if (result == PaintResult.endless) {
                refuse(UNBOUNDED_PAINT);
            } else if (result == PaintResult.behind) {
                refuse("paints ground that is already built: a tile paints only near its face");
            }
        }
    }

    void stop(Site site, Spot spot, StopKind kind) {
        painter.stop(*view, frameOf(site), ColumnSpot(spot.x, spot.y, spot.z), kind);
    }

    PenFrame ensurePen(Site site) {
        SiteFrame frame = frameOf(site);
        return PenFrame(sitePlacement(frame, view.layout).as!double(), unitNormal((*view).ensurePlaneIn(horosphere, frame.node)), frame.node);
    }

    void draw(Pen pen, double cells, double fromRadius, double toRadius, Material material, StrokeForm form) {
        if (!(cells >= 0) || !(fromRadius > 0) || !(toRadius > 0)) {
            refuse(BAD_PEN_DRAW);
        } else {
            double cell = cellLength();
            painter.stroke(*view, PenFrame.fromPen(pen), cells * cell, cast(float)(fromRadius * cell), cast(float)(toRadius * cell), material, form);
        }
    }

    KindTag ensureRisingTagAt(Site site) {
        return (*view).ensureRisingTag(site, horosphere);
    }

    void planCandidate(ref const Graph graph, GraphView* threadView, uint candidate, uint index) {
        view = threadView;
        uint tileStart = cast(uint) plan.tiles.length;
        if (!graph.isFinished(candidate)) {
            void onTile(TileKey key, SiteFrame site, HorosphereId over, int segment, TileSpan span) {
                planTile(graph, key, site, over, segment, span);
            }
            visitTilesAt!onTile(*view, *calls, candidate);
        }
        if (view.isBlocked) {
            plan.tiles.length = tileStart;
            plan.results.append(PlanResult(index, tileStart, 0, PlanEnd.blocked));
            view.forget();
        } else {
            plan.results.append(PlanResult(index, tileStart, cast(uint) plan.tiles.length - tileStart, PlanEnd.planned));
            measureRises(graph, tileStart);
        }
    }

    void measureRises(ref const Graph graph, uint tileStart) {
        foreach (index; tileStart .. plan.tiles.length) {
            HorosphereId over = plan.tiles.ptr[index].horosphere;
            if (over != ROOT && !graph.horospheres.horosphere(over).isMeasured && !plan.hasMeasure(over)) {
                RiseMeasure measure = (*view).ensureMeasure(over);
                if (view.isBlocked) {
                    view.forget();
                } else {
                    plan.measures.append(MeasuredRise(over, measure));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void planTile(ref const Graph graph, TileKey key, SiteFrame site, HorosphereId over, int segment, TileSpan span) {
        const(uint)* known = graph.structures.tiledFaces.find(key);
        if (known !is null) {
            plan.usedRecords.append(*known);
        }
        if (known is null || graph.structures.blueprint.tiles.ptr[*known].isDropped) {
            uint pathStart = cast(uint) plan.paths.length;
            uint start = view.pathTo(site.node, plan.paths);
            plan.tiles.append(PlannedTile(key, start, pathStart, cast(uint) plan.paths.length - pathStart, over, site, segment, span));
        }
    }

    void release() {
        painter.release();
        plan.release();
    }
}

TileHost* tileHost(const(Api)* api) {
    return cast(TileHost*) api.host;
}

    api.stop = &tileStop;
    api.entrance = &tileEntrance;
    api.place = &tilePlace;

    tileHost(api).refuse(ONLY_WORLD_FLATTENS);

void tileInvertGravity(const(Api)* api) {
    tileHost(api).refuse(ONLY_WORLD_TURNS_GRAVITY);
}

void tileFog(const(Api)* api, double units) {
    tileHost(api).refuse(ONLY_WORLD_SETS_FOG);
}

int tileBalance(const(Api)* api, Site site, int most) {
    TileHost* host = tileHost(api);
    if (host.horosphere == ROOT || host.view.horospheres.isUpright(host.horosphere)) {
        host.refuse("only a horosphere that rose as a plane from another has one to balance against");
        return 0;
    } else if (most < 1) {
        host.refuse("balance looks at least one cell up");
        return 0;
    } else {
        return (*host.view).ensureBalanceAlong((*host.view).turnSite(frameOf(site), Turn.pitchUp), host.horosphere, most);
    }
}

    tileHost(api).refuse(ONLY_WORLD_SETS_LOOK);

    tileHost(api).refuse(ONLY_WORLD_GIVES_KINDS);
}

bool tileLandmark(const(Api)* api, uint index, Site site) {
    tileHost(api).refuse(TILE_CANNOT_PLACE);
    return false;
}

struct TileJob {
    Graph* graph;
    TileHost** hosts;
    const(TileTask)* tasks;
    const(Face)* paths;
    const(uint)* candidates;
}

void runTileTask(void* context, size_t index, uint worker) {
    TileJob* job = cast(TileJob*) context;
    const(TileTask)* task = &job.tasks[index];
    job.hosts[worker].run(*job.graph, &job.graph.threadViews[worker], *task, job.paths[task.pathStart .. task.pathStart + task.pathLength], cast(uint) index);
}

void planCandidateTask(void* context, size_t index, uint worker) {
    TileJob* job = cast(TileJob*) context;
    job.hosts[worker].planCandidate(*job.graph, &job.graph.threadViews[worker], job.candidates[index], cast(uint) index);
}

struct TaskOutput {
    uint host;
    uint output;
}

struct TileWork {
    Array!(TileHost*) hosts;
    Array!TileTask tasks;
    Array!Face paths;
    Array!TaskOutput outputOf;
    Array!uint lineIndices;
    Array!uint lineFills;
    Array!uint brushOrder;
    Array!uint covered;
    Array!uint planning;
    Array!uint blocked;
    HashMap!(TileKey, uint) taskOf;
    const(TileCalls)* calls;
    double msPerTask = INITIAL_MS_PER_TASK;
    uint preparedTiles;
    uint fallbackTiles;
    char[MESSAGE_CAPACITY] failure = 0;

    bool hasFailed() const {
        return failure[0] != 0;
    }

    void ensureHosts(uint workers) {
        while (hosts.length < workers) {
            TileHost* host = cast(TileHost*) calloc(1, TileHost.sizeof);
            *host = TileHost.init;
            host.api = tileApi(host);
            host.calls = calls;
            hosts.append(host);
        }
    }

    size_t taskBudget() const {
        return cast(size_t) clamped(PAINT_AHEAD_MILLISECONDS / msPerTask, TILE_TASK_LEAST, TILE_TASK_MOST);
    }

    void paintAhead(ref Graph target, const(uint)[] candidates, Executor executor) {
        double start = nowMilliseconds();
        size_t budget = taskBudget();
        ensureHosts(executor.workers);
        covered.clear();
        planning.clear();
        planning.appendAll(candidates);
        uint round = 0;
        while (!hasFailed && planning.length > 0 && round < PLAN_ROUNDS && tasks.length < budget) {
            size_t made = planCandidates(target, executor);
            blocked.clear();
            size_t index = 0;
            while (index < planning.length && tasks.length < budget) {
                const(TileHost)* host = hosts.ptr[outputOf.ptr[index].host];
                PlanResult result = host.plan.results.ptr[outputOf.ptr[index].output];
                if (result.end == PlanEnd.blocked) {
                    blocked.append(planning.ptr[index]);
                } else {
                    foreach (tile; host.plan.tiles.ptr[result.tileStart .. result.tileStart + result.tileCount]) {
                        addTask(target, tile.key, tile.start, host.plan.paths.ptr[tile.pathStart .. tile.pathStart + tile.pathLength], tile.horosphere, tile.site, tile.segment, tile.span);
                    }
                    covered.append(planning.ptr[index]);
                }
                index += 1;
            }
            planning.clear();
            planning.appendAll(blocked.slice());
            round += 1;
            if (made == 0) {
                break;
            }
        }
        size_t painted = tasks.length;
        preparedTiles += cast(uint) painted;
        runTasks(target, executor);
        if (!hasFailed) {
            foreach (slot; covered.slice()) {
                target.structures.at(slot).marks.set(NodeMark.covered);
            }
        }
        if (painted >= TILE_TASK_LEAST) {
            msPerTask = (nowMilliseconds() - start) / painted;
        }
    }

    size_t planCandidates(ref Graph target, Executor executor) {
        foreach (host; hosts.slice()) {
            host.plan.clear();
        }
        target.threadViews.begin(target, executor.workers);
        TileJob context = TileJob(&target, hosts.ptr, null, null, planning.ptr);
        ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(&planCandidateTask, &context, Deadline.init,planning.length);
        executor.run(&job);
        size_t made = target.threadViews.finish(target);
        outputOf.resize(planning.length);
        foreach (hostIndex, host; hosts.slice()) {
            foreach (record; host.plan.usedRecords.slice()) {
                target.structures.blueprint.useTile(record);
            }
            foreach (measured; host.plan.measures.slice()) {
                if (!target.horospheres.horosphere(measured.horosphere).isMeasured) {
                    target.storeMeasure(measured.horosphere, measured.measure);
                }
            }
            foreach (resultIndex, result; host.plan.results.slice()) {
                outputOf.ptr[result.candidate] = TaskOutput(cast(uint) hostIndex, cast(uint) resultIndex);
            }
        }
        return made;
    }

    void takeFailure(const(TileHost)* host) {
        failure = host.failure;
    }

    void clearTasks() {
        tasks.clear();
        paths.clear();
        taskOf.clear();
    }

    void addTask(ref Graph target, TileKey key, uint start, const(Face)[] path, HorosphereId horosphere, SiteFrame site, int segment, TileSpan span) {
        if (taskOf.find(key) is null) {
            const(uint)* known = target.structures.tiledFaces.find(key);
            Maybe!uint record;
            TilePass pass = TilePass.first;
            if (known is null) {
                record = Maybe!uint.of(target.structures.blueprint.addTile(key.node, key.feature, horosphere));
                target.structures.tiledFaces.insert(key, record.value);
            } else if (target.structures.blueprint.tiles.ptr[*known].isDropped) {
                record = Maybe!uint.of(*known);
                target.structures.blueprint.tiles.ptr[record.value].horosphere = horosphere;
                pass = TilePass.restoring;
            }
            if (record.exists) {
                if (horosphere != ROOT) {
                    target.horospheres.horospheres.ptr[horosphere.index].tiles += 1;
                    target.ensureMeasured(horosphere);
                }
                taskOf.insert(key, cast(uint) tasks.length);
                tasks.append(TileTask(key, start, cast(uint) paths.length, cast(uint) path.length, record.value, horosphere, site, segment, span, pass));
                paths.appendAll(path);
            }
        }
    }

    void runTasks(ref Graph target, Executor executor) {
        ensureHosts(executor.workers);
        if (tasks.length > 0 && !hasFailed) {
            foreach (host; hosts.slice()) {
                host.painter.clear();
            }
            target.threadViews.begin(target, executor.workers);
            TileJob context = TileJob(&target, hosts.ptr, tasks.ptr, paths.ptr, null);
            ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(&runTileTask, &context, Deadline.init,tasks.length);
            executor.run(&job);
            target.threadViews.finish(target);
            outputOf.resize(tasks.length);
            foreach (hostIndex, host; hosts.slice()) {
                foreach (outputIndex, output; host.painter.outputs.slice()) {
                    outputOf.ptr[output.task] = TaskOutput(cast(uint) hostIndex, cast(uint) outputIndex);
                }
            }
            size_t index = 0;
            while (index < tasks.length && !hasFailed) {
                TileHost* host = hosts.ptr[outputOf.ptr[index].host];
                TileOutput output = host.painter.outputs.ptr[outputOf.ptr[index].output];
                if (output.end == TaskEnd.failed) {
                    takeFailure(host);
                } else {
                    apply(target, tasks.ptr[index], host.painter, output);
                }
                index += 1;
            }
        }
        clearTasks();
    }

    uint slotAlong(ref Graph target, ref const TilePainter painter, uint start, uint pathStart, uint pathLength) {
        uint slot = start;
        foreach (side; painter.paths.ptr[pathStart .. pathStart + pathLength]) {
            slot = target.ensureNeighborSlot(slot, side);
        }
        return slot;
    }

    void apply(ref Graph target, ref const TileTask task, ref const TilePainter painter, TileOutput output) {
        Blueprint* blueprint = &target.structures.blueprint;
        lineIndices.resize(output.lineCount);
        uint[] lines = lineIndices.slice();
        foreach (local; 0 .. output.lineCount) {
            const(LineOutput)* line = &painter.lines.ptr[output.lineStart + local];
            LineSpec spec = line.spec;
            spec.node = MaybeIndex!uint.init;
            uint index = blueprint.ensureLine(spec, line.key.node);
            blueprint.lines.ptr[index].edges.widen(line.edges);
            lines[local] = index;
        }
        const(BrushOutput)[] painted = painter.brushes.ptr[output.brushStart .. output.brushStart + output.brushCount];
        blueprint.tiles.ptr[task.record].painted.brushes.reserve(output.brushCount);
        lineFills.resize(output.lineCount + 1);
        lineFills.slice()[] = 0;
        foreach (made; painted) {
            lineFills.ptr[made.line - output.lineStart + 1] += 1;
        }
        foreach (local; 0 .. output.lineCount) {
            lineFills.ptr[local + 1] += lineFills.ptr[local];
        }
        brushOrder.resize(output.brushCount);
        foreach (index, made; painted) {
            uint local = made.line - output.lineStart;
            brushOrder.ptr[lineFills.ptr[local]] = cast(uint) index;
            lineFills.ptr[local] += 1;
        }
        foreach (index; brushOrder.slice()) {
            const(BrushOutput)* made = &painted[index];
            Brush brush = made.brush;
            brush.order = index;
            brush.paint.material = blueprint.ensurePaint(made.material);
            blueprint.addBrush(PaintOwner.ofTile(task.record), lines[made.line - output.lineStart], brush);
        }
        foreach (touched; painter.touches.ptr[output.touchStart .. output.touchStart + output.touchCount]) {
            uint line = lines[touched.line - output.lineStart];
            if (!blueprint.isEdgeTouched(LineEdge(line, touched.level))) {
                blueprint.touchEdge(LineEdge(line, touched.level), touched.nodes);
                foreach (corner; 0 .. EDGE_NODES) {
                    LineTouch touch = touched.touches[corner];
                    touch.line = line;
                    target.addPendingTouch(touched.nodes[corner], touch);
                }
            }
        }
        if (task.pass == TilePass.first) {
            useEdges(blueprint, task.record, painted, lines, output.lineStart);
        }
        foreach (stop; painter.stops.ptr[output.stopStart .. output.stopStart + output.stopCount]) {
            uint slot = slotAlong(target, painter, stop.start, stop.pathStart, stop.pathLength);
            SiteFrame site = stop.site;
            site.node = slot;
            if (stop.kind == StopKind.route) {
                blueprint.route.append(RouteStop(site, stop.spot));
                target.reference(slot);
            } else if (!blueprint.entrance.exists) {
                blueprint.entrance = Maybe!RouteStop.of(RouteStop(site, stop.spot));
                target.reference(slot);
            }
        }
        foreach (drawn; painter.strokes.ptr[output.strokeStart .. output.strokeStart + output.strokeCount]) {
            uint slot = slotAlong(target, painter, drawn.start, drawn.pathStart, drawn.pathLength);
            target.structures.addStroke(target.view, PaintOwner.ofTile(task.record), slot, Stroke.make(drawn.frame, drawn.length, drawn.startRadius, drawn.endRadius, drawn.material, drawn.form));
        }
        blueprint.reviveTile(task.record);
        blueprint.useTile(task.record);
        if (task.pass == TilePass.restoring) {
            blueprint.restoredTiles += 1;
        }
    }

    void useEdges(Blueprint* blueprint, uint tile, const(BrushOutput)[] painted, const(uint)[] lines, uint lineStart) {
        Array!TileEdge* edges = &blueprint.tiles.ptr[tile].edges;
        foreach (ref made; painted) {
            uint line = lines[made.line - lineStart];
            foreach (level; edgeOf(made.brush.box.low.z, blueprint.dimension) .. edgeOf(made.brush.box.high.z, blueprint.dimension) + 1) {
                LineEdge edge = LineEdge(line, level);
                size_t index = 0;
                while (index < edges.length && edges.ptr[index].edge != edge) {
                    index += 1;
                }
                if (index == edges.length) {
                    edges.append(TileEdge(edge, blueprint.useEdge(edge)));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (host; hosts.slice()) {
            host.release();
            free(host);
        }
        hosts.release();
        tasks.release();
        paths.release();
        outputOf.release();
        lineIndices.release();
        lineFills.release();
        brushOrder.release();
        covered.release();
        planning.release();
        blocked.release();
        taskOf.release();
    }
}

/// file: source/client/world.d
module client.world;

import core.stdc.math : coshf, expf, logf, powf;
import base.array : Array;
import base.clock : Deadline, PhaseTimes, nowMilliseconds, threadCpuMilliseconds;
import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import client.arrivals : resolveIfExposed, resolveMaterials;
import client.camera : CAMERA_FORWARD;
import client.streaming : Pacing, Streamer;
import common.eviction : Evictor, Unloaded;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.neighbors : chunkNeighborId, neighborAxisMap, touchChunksReading;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkId, ChunkSlot, ChunkState, cellIndex;
import common.perception : ViewEffects;
import common.position : Position;
import common.raycast.graph : GraphCastHit, rayCast;
import common.traversal : NearbyNode, NearbyScratch;
import common.worldgen.generation : Worldgen;
import common.worldgen.horospheres : lookAt;
import geometry.cube : Cell, Direction, boundaryOf;
import geometry.honeycomb : NODE_RADIUS;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Point, Vec4;
import geometry.ray : Ray;
import plugins.api.api : Color, Look, Material, Tint;

enum float NEARBY_PADDING = 0.05f;
enum float NEARBY_REBUILD_DISTANCE = 0.25f;
enum double REBUILD_NARROW_TRAVEL = 4 * NEARBY_REBUILD_DISTANCE;
enum double REBUILD_ABANDON_TRAVEL = FULL_RADIUS - CAMERA_REACH;
enum float REBUILD_GROWTH = 0.25f;
enum float REBASE_DISTANCE = NODE_RADIUS + 1.0f;
enum float REDERIVE_RADIUS = 6.0f;
enum double TELEPORT_TRAVEL = 1.0e3;
enum float RENDER_RADIUS = 8.0f;
enum float FOG_VISIBILITY_THRESHOLD = 1e-3f;
enum float FOG_LOAD_THRESHOLD = 1.0f / 256;
enum float FOG_SHARPNESS = 4.0f;
enum float FULL_RADIUS = 4.5f;
enum float CAMERA_REACH = 2.0f;
enum double STEP_BUDGET_MILLISECONDS = 8.0;
enum double NEARBY_LEAST_MILLISECONDS = 1.0;
enum double STREAMER_LEAST_MILLISECONDS = 1.0;
version (WebAssembly) {
    enum size_t STRUCTURE_CANDIDATES = 16;
} else {
    enum size_t STRUCTURE_CANDIDATES = 256;
}
enum double RECOVERY_BUDGET_MILLISECONDS = 8.0;
enum float FOG_COLOR_RATE = 1.5f;
enum Color SKY_SRGB = Color(0.55f, 0.7f, 0.94f);

struct Placement {
    ChunkId chunk;
    Cell coords;
}

enum NearbyStage : ubyte {
    initial,
    published,
    rebuilding,
}

struct NearbyStats {
    double slicedMilliseconds = 0;
    double recoveryMilliseconds = 0;
    double pendingTravel = 0;
    uint pendingFrames;
    uint publishes;
    uint recoveries;
    uint grown;
    uint narrowings;
    uint abandons;
    uint rebases;
}

struct StepPhases {
    PhaseTimes paint;
    PhaseTimes nearby;
    PhaseTimes streamer;
    PhaseTimes evict;
    PhaseTimes nearbyCpu;
    PhaseTimes streamerCpu;
}

struct LocalWorld {
    Graph graph;
    Streamer streamer;
    NearbyScratch[2] nearby;
    Position cameraPosition;
    Point!float publishedPoint;
    Point!float pendingPoint;
    Point!float trackedCamera;
    Vec3!float sunward = Vec3!float(0, 1, 0);
    Color fogColor = SKY_SRGB;
    ViewEffects view;
    uint trackedVersion;
    NearbyNode[] cachedNodes;
    Array!Unloaded unloaded;
    Array!uint candidates;
    double rebuildTravel = 0;
    double startTravel = 0;
    float renderRadius;
    float radiusCut = 0;
    float publishedCut = 0;
    float pendingCut = 0;
    float tanhReach;
    uint published;
    uint nearbyVersion;
    uint listVersion;
    uint epoch;
    Evictor evictor;
    StepPhases phases;
    NearbyStats nearbyStats;
    NearbyStage nearbyStage;

    static LocalWorld make(ubyte dimension, Worldgen worldgen, float tanhReach) {
        LocalWorld world;
        world.graph = Graph.make(dimension, worldgen);
        world.graph.bindView();
        world.streamer = Streamer.make();
        world.cameraPosition = Position.origin();
        world.renderRadius = RENDER_RADIUS;
        world.tanhReach = tanhReach;
        return world;
    }

    void release() {
        streamer.release();
        nearby[0].release();
        nearby[1].release();
        evictor.release();
        unloaded.release();
        candidates.release();
        graph.release();
    }

    MaybeIndex!uint cameraNearbyIndex() const {
        return nearby[published].indexOf(graph.slotOf(cameraPosition.node).value);
    }

    Motion!float cameraInNearbyFrame() const {
        return nearby[published].nodes.ptr[cameraNearbyIndex().value].transform * cameraPosition.local;
    }

    const(Look)* lookAtCamera() const {
        return graph.lookAt(cameraPosition);
    }

    Color wantedFogColor() const {
        const(Look)* look = lookAtCamera();
        const(Look)* world = &graph.structures.blueprint.look;
        if (look.tint == Tint.fog) {
            return look.fog;
        } else if (world.tint == Tint.fog) {
            return world.fog;
        } else {
            return SKY_SRGB;
        }
    }

    void settleFogColor() {
        fogColor = wantedFogColor();
    }

    void approachFogColor(float seconds) {
        Color wanted = wantedFogColor();
        float kept = expf(-FOG_COLOR_RATE * seconds);
        fogColor.red = wanted.red + (fogColor.red - wanted.red) * kept;
        fogColor.green = wanted.green + (fogColor.green - wanted.green) * kept;
        fogColor.blue = wanted.blue + (fogColor.blue - wanted.blue) * kept;
    }

    float viewRadius() const {
        Maybe!float fog = graph.structures.blueprint.fog;
        if (fog.exists) {
            return lowerOf(renderRadius, fog.value);
        } else {
            return renderRadius;
        }
    }

    float loadRadius() const {
        return fogReach(viewRadius()) * powf(logf(1.0f / FOG_LOAD_THRESHOLD), 1.0f / FOG_SHARPNESS);
    }

    void update(Pacing pacing) {
        double start = nowMilliseconds();
        double end = start + STEP_BUDGET_MILLISECONDS - phases.evict.lastMs;
        paintAhead();
        double painted = nowMilliseconds();
        double paintedCpu = threadCpuMilliseconds();
        Deadline deadline = phaseDeadline(pacing, end - phases.streamer.lastMs, NEARBY_LEAST_MILLISECONDS);
        if (nearbyStage == NearbyStage.initial) {
            buildInitialNearby(deadline);
        } else if (!cameraNearbyIndex().exists) {
            recoverNearby();
        } else {
            refreshNearby(deadline);
        }
        followCamera();
        keepCameraCollected();
        trackTravel();
        double found = nowMilliseconds();
        double foundCpu = threadCpuMilliseconds();
        streamer.drive(graph, cachedNodes, cameraPosition, cameraInNearbyFrame(), loadRadius(), nearbyVersion, pacing, phaseDeadline(pacing, end, STREAMER_LEAST_MILLISECONDS));
        double streamed = nowMilliseconds();
        double streamedCpu = threadCpuMilliseconds();
        evict();
        phases.paint.add(painted - start);
        phases.nearby.add(found - painted);
        phases.streamer.add(streamed - found);
        phases.evict.add(nowMilliseconds() - streamed);
        phases.nearbyCpu.add(foundCpu - paintedCpu);
        phases.streamerCpu.add(streamedCpu - foundCpu);
    }

    void paintAhead() {
        if (graph.structures.grower.paintAhead !is null) {
            candidates.clear();
            streamer.collectUnstructured(graph, cachedNodes, candidates, STRUCTURE_CANDIDATES);
            graph.paintAhead(candidates.slice(), streamer.executor());
        }
    }

    void evict() {
        size_t first = unloaded.length;
        NearbyScratch* next = &nearby[1 - published];
        const(NearbyScratch)* building = null;
        if (next.isBuilding()) {
            building = next;
        }
        evictor.sweep(graph, nearby[published], building, cameraInNearbyFrame() * Point!float.origin(), unloaded, nowMilliseconds());
        streamer.forget(unloaded.slice()[first .. $]);
    }

    void keepCameraCollected() {
        uint cameraSlot = graph.slotOf(cameraPosition.node).value;
        nearby[published].collectAround(graph, cameraSlot, cameraInNearbyFrame() * Point!float.origin(), CAMERA_REACH);
        NearbyScratch* next = &nearby[1 - published];
        MaybeIndex!uint index = next.indexOf(cameraSlot);
        if (next.isBuilding() && !next.isKeeping() && index.exists) {
            next.collectAround(graph, cameraSlot, next.nodes.ptr[index.value].transform * cameraPosition.local * Point!float.origin(), CAMERA_REACH);
        }
        cachedNodes = nearby[published].nodes.slice();
    }

    void trackTravel() {
        Point!float camera = cameraInNearbyFrame() * Point!float.origin();
        if (trackedVersion == nearbyVersion) {
            streamer.travel += trackedCamera.distance(camera);
        } else {
            streamer.travel += NEARBY_PADDING;
        }
        trackedCamera = camera;
        trackedVersion = nearbyVersion;
    }

    void buildInitialNearby(Deadline deadline) {
        NearbyScratch* current = &nearby[published];
        if (!current.isBuilding() || !cameraNearbyIndex().exists) {
            current.begin(graph, cameraPosition, rebuildDistance(), FULL_RADIUS);
            publishedPoint = cameraPosition.local * Point!float.origin();
            publishedCut = radiusCut;
            nearbyVersion += 1;
            listVersion += 1;
            streamer.travel += TELEPORT_TRAVEL;
            startTravel = streamer.travel;
        }
        current.advance(graph, deadline, streamer.executor());
        if (!current.isBuilding()) {
            nearbyStage = NearbyStage.published;
        }
        cachedNodes = current.nodes.slice();
    }

    void recoverNearby() {
        double start = nowMilliseconds();
        NearbyScratch* next = &nearby[1 - published];
        if (!next.isBuilding() || next.isKeeping() || !next.indexOf(graph.slotOf(cameraPosition.node).value).exists) {
            next.begin(graph, cameraPosition, rebuildDistance(), FULL_RADIUS);
            pendingPoint = cameraPosition.local * Point!float.origin();
            pendingCut = radiusCut;
            next.advance(graph, Deadline.at(start + RECOVERY_BUDGET_MILLISECONDS), streamer.executor());
        }
        nearbyStats.recoveries += 1;
        nearbyStats.recoveryMilliseconds += nowMilliseconds() - start;
        streamer.travel += TELEPORT_TRAVEL;
        startTravel = streamer.travel;
        publish(pendingPoint);
    }

    void refreshNearby(Deadline deadline) {
        double start = nowMilliseconds();
        NearbyScratch* current = &nearby[published];
        NearbyScratch* next = &nearby[1 - published];
        Point!float camera = cameraInNearbyFrame() * Point!float.origin();
        if ((current.isBuilding() || nearbyStage == NearbyStage.rebuilding) && streamer.travel - startTravel > REBUILD_ABANDON_TRAVEL) {
            abandonRebuild(deadline);
        } else if (current.isBuilding()) {
            current.advance(graph, deadline, streamer.executor());
            cachedNodes = current.nodes.slice();
        } else {
            double traveled = streamer.travel - rebuildTravel;
            if (next.isBuilding() && !next.isKeeping() && traveled > REBUILD_NARROW_TRAVEL) {
                cutRadius(traveled);
                next.narrow(rebuildDistance());
                pendingCut = radiusCut;
                rebuildTravel = streamer.travel;
                nearbyStats.narrowings += 1;
            } else if (nearbyStage == NearbyStage.published && (publishedPoint.coshDistance(camera) > coshf(NEARBY_REBUILD_DISTANCE) || publishedCut > 0)) {
                startNext(camera);
            }
            if (nearbyStage == NearbyStage.rebuilding) {
                nearbyStats.pendingFrames += 1;
                next.continueKeeping(*current, deadline, streamer.executor());
                next.advance(graph, deadline, streamer.executor());
                if (!next.isBuilding()) {
                    publishOrRestart();
                }
            }
        }
        nearbyStats.slicedMilliseconds += nowMilliseconds() - start;
    }

    void abandonRebuild(Deadline deadline) {
        NearbyScratch* next = &nearby[1 - published];
        cutRadius(streamer.travel - rebuildTravel);
        next.begin(graph, cameraPosition, rebuildDistance(), FULL_RADIUS);
        pendingPoint = cameraPosition.local * Point!float.origin();
        pendingCut = radiusCut;
        rebuildTravel = streamer.travel;
        startTravel = streamer.travel;
        next.advance(graph, deadline, streamer.executor());
        nearbyStats.abandons += 1;
        publish(pendingPoint);
    }

    float rebuildDistance() const {
        return loadRadius() - radiusCut + NEARBY_PADDING;
    }

    void cutRadius(double traveled) {
        if (traveled > NEARBY_REBUILD_DISTANCE) {
            radiusCut += 0.5f * logf(cast(float)(traveled / NEARBY_REBUILD_DISTANCE));
        } else if (traveled < NEARBY_REBUILD_DISTANCE / 2) {
            radiusCut -= REBUILD_GROWTH;
        }
        radiusCut = higherOf(lowerOf(radiusCut, loadRadius() - FULL_RADIUS), 0.0f);
    }

    void startNext(Point!float camera) {
        NearbyScratch* current = &nearby[published];
        NearbyScratch* next = &nearby[1 - published];
        current.rederive(graph, graph.slotOf(cameraPosition.node).value, camera, FULL_RADIUS + NODE_RADIUS, streamer.executor());
        next.beginFrom(*current, graph, camera, rebuildDistance(), FULL_RADIUS);
        pendingPoint = camera;
        pendingCut = radiusCut;
        rebuildTravel = streamer.travel;
        startTravel = streamer.travel;
        nearbyStage = NearbyStage.rebuilding;
        nearbyStats.grown += 1;
    }

    void publishOrRestart() {
        NearbyScratch* next = &nearby[1 - published];
        if (next.indexOf(graph.slotOf(cameraPosition.node).value).exists) {
            cutRadius(streamer.travel - rebuildTravel);
            nearbyStats.pendingTravel += streamer.travel - startTravel;
            publish(pendingPoint);
        } else {
            next.begin(graph, cameraPosition, rebuildDistance(), FULL_RADIUS);
            pendingPoint = cameraPosition.local * Point!float.origin();
            pendingCut = radiusCut;
            startTravel = streamer.travel;
        }
    }

    void publish(Point!float point) {
        published = 1 - published;
        nearbyStage = NearbyStage.published;
        publishedCut = pendingCut;
        cachedNodes = nearby[published].nodes.slice();
        publishedPoint = point;
        nearbyVersion += 1;
        listVersion += 1;
        nearbyStats.publishes += 1;
    }

    void followCamera() {
        uint cameraSlot = graph.slotOf(cameraPosition.node).value;
        NearbyScratch* current = &nearby[published];
        NearbyScratch* next = &nearby[1 - published];
        Motion!float toCamera = current.nodes.ptr[current.indexOf(cameraSlot).value].transform;
        if (!next.isKeeping() && isFarFromOrigin(toCamera * cameraPosition.local)) {
            Motion!float toFrame = toCamera.inverse();
            current.rebase(graph, cameraSlot, toFrame, REDERIVE_RADIUS, streamer.executor());
            publishedPoint = toFrame * publishedPoint;
            trackedCamera = toFrame * trackedCamera;
            listVersion += 1;
            nearbyStats.rebases += 1;
        }
        MaybeIndex!uint index = next.indexOf(cameraSlot);
        if (next.isBuilding() && !next.isKeeping() && index.exists && isFarFromOrigin(next.nodes.ptr[index.value].transform * cameraPosition.local)) {
            Motion!float toFrame = next.nodes.ptr[index.value].transform.inverse();
            next.rebase(graph, cameraSlot, toFrame, REDERIVE_RADIUS, streamer.executor());
            pendingPoint = toFrame * pendingPoint;
        }
    }

    bool isWorldgenSettled() const {
        return nearbyStage != NearbyStage.initial && !nearby[published].isBuilding() && radiusCut == 0 && publishedCut == 0 && streamer.isIdle() && streamer.waiting.length == 0 && streamer.scanCursor >= cachedNodes.length;
    }

    Maybe!GraphCastHit castCenterRay() const {
        Ray ray = Ray(Point!float.origin(), Vec4!float([CAMERA_FORWARD.x, CAMERA_FORWARD.y, CAMERA_FORWARD.z, 0]).toNormal());
        return graph.rayCast(cameraPosition, ray, tanhReach, view.visible);
    }

    bool isEmptyAt(Placement placement) const {
        const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot(graph.slotOf(placement.chunk.node).value, placement.chunk.corner));
        return chunk.state == ChunkState.populated && chunk.voxels.at(cellIndex(graph.layout.dimension, placement.coords.x, placement.coords.y, placement.coords.z)) == Material.none;
    }

    Maybe!Material targetMaterial() const {
        Maybe!GraphCastHit hit = castCenterRay();
        if (hit.exists) {
            const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot(graph.slotOf(hit.value.chunk.node).value, hit.value.chunk.corner));
            Cell cell = hit.value.voxelCoords;
            return Maybe!Material.of(chunk.voxels.at(cellIndex(graph.layout.dimension, cell.x, cell.y, cell.z)));
        } else {
            return Maybe!Material.init;
        }
    }

    bool breakBlock() {
        Maybe!GraphCastHit hit = castCenterRay();
        if (hit.exists) {
            return setVoxel(hit.value.chunk, hit.value.voxelCoords, Material.none);
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }

    Maybe!Placement placementTarget() const {
        Maybe!GraphCastHit hit = castCenterRay();
        if (hit.exists) {
            return placementBeside(hit.value);
        } else {
            return Maybe!Placement.init;
        }
    }

    Maybe!Placement placementBeside(GraphCastHit hit) const {
        ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
        Cell coords = hit.voxelCoords;
        int stepped = coords[hit.faceAxis] + hit.faceSign;
        Direction direction = Direction(hit.faceAxis, hit.faceSign);
        Maybe!ChunkId neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborId(hit.chunk, direction);
        if (stepped >= 0 && stepped < dimension) {
            coords[hit.faceAxis] = cast(ubyte) stepped;
            return Maybe!Placement.of(Placement(hit.chunk, coords));
        } else if (neighbor.exists) {
            coords[hit.faceAxis] = boundaryOf(dimension, direction.sign);
            return Maybe!Placement.of(Placement(neighbor.value, neighborAxisMap(hit.chunk.corner, direction).apply(coords)));
        } else {
            return Maybe!Placement.init;
        }
    }

    bool setVoxel(ChunkId chunkId, Cell coords, Material material) {
        ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
        ChunkSlot slot = ChunkSlot(graph.slotOf(chunkId.node).value, chunkId.corner);
        if (graph.chunks.at(slot).state != ChunkState.populated) {
            return false;
        } else {
            Chunk* chunk = graph.chunks.existing(slot);
            graph.edits.record(chunkId, cast(uint) cellIndex(dimension, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z), material);
            if (chunk.hasDeferredMaterials) {
                graph.resolveMaterials(slot);
            }
            chunk.denseVoxels(dimension)[cellIndex(dimension, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)] = material;
            chunk.markEdited();
            graph.markChanged(slot);
            Array!ChunkSlot holders;
            graph.touchChunksReading(slot, coords.as!int(), holders);
            foreach (holder; holders.slice()) {
                graph.markChanged(holder);
                graph.resolveIfExposed(holder);
            }
            holders.release();
            return true;
        }
    }
}

float fogReach(float renderRadius) {
    return renderRadius / powf(logf(1.0f / FOG_VISIBILITY_THRESHOLD), 1.0f / FOG_SHARPNESS);
}

float fogVisibility(float distance, float renderRadius) {
    return expf(-powf(distance / fogReach(renderRadius), FOG_SHARPNESS));
}

bool isFarFromOrigin(Motion!float camera) {
    return (camera * Point!float.origin()).v.c[3] > coshf(REBASE_DISTANCE);
}

Deadline phaseDeadline(Pacing pacing, double planned, double leastMilliseconds) {
    if (pacing == Pacing.unbudgeted) {
        return Deadline.init;
    } else {
        return Deadline.at(higherOf(planned, nowMilliseconds() + leastMilliseconds));
    }
}

/// file: source/common/biology/air.d
module common.biology.air;

import core.stdc.math : expf;
import base.units : Ratio;
import common.biology.molecule : CENTER_CELL, Fragment, GridPoint, Molecule, Property, cellOf, propertyBit, withFragment;
import common.worldgen.climate : Climate;

enum uint GAS_COUNT = 3;
enum uint ASH_GAS = 2;
enum float AIR_STEEPNESS = 3;
enum float ASH_RELIEF = 1;

immutable string[GAS_COUNT] GAS_NAMES = ["mire", "frost", "ash"];

Molecule[GAS_COUNT] gasMolecules() {
    Molecule mire = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(propertyBit(Property.polar))).withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(1, 0, 0)), Fragment.of(propertyBit(Property.charged)));
    Molecule frost = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(propertyBit(Property.bulky))).withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(0, 1, 0)), Fragment.of(0));
    Molecule ash = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(cast(ubyte)(propertyBit(Property.bulky) | propertyBit(Property.charged)))).withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(0, 0, 1)), Fragment.of(propertyBit(Property.polar))).withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(-1, 0, 0)), Fragment.of(0));
    return [mire, frost, ash];
}

immutable Molecule[GAS_COUNT] GAS_MOLECULES = gasMolecules();

struct AirMix {
    Ratio[GAS_COUNT] fractions;
}

float rising(float value) {
    return 1 / (1 + expf(-AIR_STEEPNESS * value));
}

AirMix airOf(Climate climate) {
    return AirMix([Ratio(rising(climate.wetness + climate.heat)), Ratio(rising(-climate.warmth())), Ratio(rising(climate.relief - ASH_RELIEF + climate.strata))]);
}

/// file: source/common/biology/breeding.d
module common.biology.breeding;

import core.stdc.math : expf;
import base.splitmix : SplitMix;
import common.biology.wild : WILD_GENES, WildGenes, mutated;
import common.worldgen.climate : Climate, SNOW_WARMTH, isDesert;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum ulong CROSS_SALT = 0xC2055_ED;
enum float SUITABILITY_STEEPNESS = 4;
enum float WET_FOR_FERN = 0.45f;

WildGenes crossed(WildGenes first, WildGenes second, ulong salt, float mutationOdds) {
    WildGenes child;
    foreach (index; 0 .. WILD_GENES) {
        bool fromFirst = (SplitMix(salt ^ CROSS_SALT ^ index).next() & 1) == 0;
        ulong seed = second.seeds[index];
        if (fromFirst) {
            seed = first.seeds[index];
        }
        child.seeds[index] = mutated(seed, salt ^ index, mutationOdds);
    }
    return child;
}

float suitabilityOf(Material plant, Climate climate) {
    float warmth = climate.warmth();
    if (plant == Material.thornbush) {
        return warmth - climate.wetness;
    } else if (plant == Material.moss) {
        return SNOW_WARMTH - warmth + 0.5f;
    } else if (plant == Material.fern) {
        return climate.wetness - WET_FOR_FERN + 0.5f;
    } else {
        return 0.5f - (climate.wetness * climate.wetness + warmth * warmth);
    }
}

float expressionIn(Material plant, Climate climate) {
    return 1 / (1 + expf(-SUITABILITY_STEEPNESS * suitabilityOf(plant, climate)));
}

/// file: source/common/biology/genome.d
module common.biology.genome;

import base.array : Array;
import base.units : Ratio;
import common.biology.metabolism : Enzyme, MOTIF_CELLS, MotifCell, Operation, Presence;
import common.biology.molecule : Fragment, PROPERTY_MASK;
import common.biology.pocket : HALF_CELLS, HalfPocket, Pocket, PocketCell, PocketKind, joined;

enum uint MOST_GENES = 16;
enum uint MOST_LETTERS = 16;
enum uint PROPERTY_FIELD_BITS = 3;
enum uint KIND_FIELD_BITS = 2;
enum ushort KIND_FIELD_MASK = (1 << KIND_FIELD_BITS) - 1;
enum uint RECEPTOR_WANTED_SHIFT = KIND_FIELD_BITS;
enum uint RECEPTOR_CARES_SHIFT = RECEPTOR_WANTED_SHIFT + PROPERTY_FIELD_BITS;
enum uint RECEPTOR_TRANSDUCER_SHIFT = RECEPTOR_CARES_SHIFT + PROPERTY_FIELD_BITS;
enum uint MOTIF_CARES_SHIFT = PROPERTY_FIELD_BITS;
enum uint MOTIF_PRESENCE_SHIFT = 2 * PROPERTY_FIELD_BITS;
enum uint ENZYME_ATTACHED_SHIFT = KIND_FIELD_BITS;
enum uint ENZYME_HEADER_LETTERS = 1;

alias Letter = ushort;

enum GeneKind : ubyte {
    receptorHalf,
    enzyme,
}

struct Gene {
    Letter[MOST_LETTERS] letters;
    Ratio expression;
    ubyte length;
    GeneKind kind;
}

struct Genome {
    Gene[MOST_GENES] genes;
    uint count;

    void add(Gene gene) {
        assert(count < MOST_GENES);
        genes[count] = gene;
        count += 1;
    }

    const(Gene)[] slice() const {
        return genes[0 .. count];
    }
}

Letter letterOf(PocketCell cell) {
    return cast(Letter)(cell.kind | (cell.wanted & PROPERTY_MASK) << RECEPTOR_WANTED_SHIFT | (cell.cares & PROPERTY_MASK) << RECEPTOR_CARES_SHIFT | (cell.transducer & 1) << RECEPTOR_TRANSDUCER_SHIFT);
}

PocketCell pocketCellOf(Letter letter) {
    return PocketCell(cast(PocketKind)(letter & KIND_FIELD_MASK), cast(ubyte)((letter >> RECEPTOR_WANTED_SHIFT) & PROPERTY_MASK), cast(ubyte)((letter >> RECEPTOR_CARES_SHIFT) & PROPERTY_MASK), cast(ubyte)((letter >> RECEPTOR_TRANSDUCER_SHIFT) & 1));
}

Gene receptorGene(HalfPocket half, Ratio expression) {
    Gene gene = Gene(Letter[MOST_LETTERS].init, expression, HALF_CELLS, GeneKind.receptorHalf);
    foreach (index, cell; half.cells) {
        gene.letters[index] = letterOf(cell);
    }
    return gene;
}

HalfPocket halfOf(ref const Gene gene) {
    assert(gene.kind == GeneKind.receptorHalf && gene.length == HALF_CELLS);
    HalfPocket half;
    foreach (index; 0 .. HALF_CELLS) {
        half.cells[index] = pocketCellOf(gene.letters[index]);
    }
    return half;
}

Letter motifLetterOf(MotifCell cell) {
    return cast(Letter)((cell.wanted & PROPERTY_MASK) | (cell.cares & PROPERTY_MASK) << MOTIF_CARES_SHIFT | cell.presence << MOTIF_PRESENCE_SHIFT);
}

MotifCell motifCellOf(Letter letter) {
    return MotifCell(cast(ubyte)(letter & PROPERTY_MASK), cast(ubyte)((letter >> MOTIF_CARES_SHIFT) & PROPERTY_MASK), cast(Presence)((letter >> MOTIF_PRESENCE_SHIFT) & KIND_FIELD_MASK));
}

Gene enzymeGene(Enzyme enzyme, Ratio expression) {
    Gene gene = Gene(Letter[MOST_LETTERS].init, expression, ENZYME_HEADER_LETTERS + MOTIF_CELLS, GeneKind.enzyme);
    gene.letters[0] = cast(Letter)(enzyme.operation | enzyme.attached.properties << ENZYME_ATTACHED_SHIFT);
    foreach (index, cell; enzyme.motif) {
        gene.letters[ENZYME_HEADER_LETTERS + index] = motifLetterOf(cell);
    }
    return gene;
}

Enzyme enzymeOf(ref const Gene gene) {
    assert(gene.kind == GeneKind.enzyme && gene.length == ENZYME_HEADER_LETTERS + MOTIF_CELLS);
    Enzyme enzyme;
    enzyme.operation = cast(Operation)(gene.letters[0] & KIND_FIELD_MASK);
    enzyme.attached = Fragment.of(cast(ubyte)((gene.letters[0] >> ENZYME_ATTACHED_SHIFT) & PROPERTY_MASK));
    foreach (index; 0 .. MOTIF_CELLS) {
        enzyme.motif[index] = motifCellOf(gene.letters[ENZYME_HEADER_LETTERS + index]);
    }
    return enzyme;
}

struct Receptor {
    Pocket pocket;
    Ratio amount;
    ubyte firstHalf;
    ubyte secondHalf;
}

void assembleReceptors(ref const Genome genome, ref Array!Receptor receptors) {
    receptors.clear();
    float total = 0;
    foreach (ref gene; genome.slice()) {
        if (gene.kind == GeneKind.receptorHalf) {
            total += gene.expression.value;
        }
    }
    ubyte firstHalf = 0;
    foreach (first, ref one; genome.slice()) {
        if (one.kind == GeneKind.receptorHalf) {
            ubyte secondHalf = firstHalf;
            foreach (second, ref other; genome.slice()[first .. $]) {
                if (other.kind == GeneKind.receptorHalf) {
                    float pairs = one.expression.value * other.expression.value / total;
                    if (secondHalf != firstHalf) {
                        pairs *= 2;
                    }
                    receptors.append(Receptor(joined(halfOf(one), halfOf(other)), Ratio(pairs), firstHalf, secondHalf));
                    secondHalf += 1;
                }
            }
            firstHalf += 1;
        }
    }
}

void enzymesOf(ref const Genome genome, ref Array!Enzyme enzymes) {
    enzymes.clear();
    foreach (ref gene; genome.slice()) {
        if (gene.kind == GeneKind.enzyme) {
            enzymes.append(enzymeOf(gene));
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/common/biology/kinetics.d
module common.biology.kinetics;

import core.stdc.math : expf;
import base.units : Rate, Ratio, Time;
import common.biology.molecule : GRID_CELLS, Molecule, Property, fragmentAt, isConjugated;

enum uint MOST_SPECIES = 16;
enum Rate GUT_ABSORPTION = Rate(0.2f);
enum Rate LUNG_ABSORPTION = Rate(2.0f);
enum Rate BASE_CLEARANCE = Rate(0.02f);
enum Rate POLAR_CLEARANCE = Rate(0.01f);
enum Rate CONJUGATED_CLEARANCE = Rate(0.1f);

enum Route : ubyte {
    injected,
    inhaled,
    ingested,
}

struct Species {
    Molecule molecule;
    Ratio gut;
    Ratio lung;
    Ratio blood;
}

Rate clearanceOf(Molecule molecule) {
    uint polar = 0;
    foreach (cell; 0 .. GRID_CELLS) {
        if (molecule.fragmentAt(cell).isPresent && molecule.fragmentAt(cell).has(Property.polar)) {
            polar += 1;
        }
    }
    Rate clearance = BASE_CLEARANCE + POLAR_CLEARANCE * polar;
    if (molecule.isConjugated) {
        clearance = clearance + CONJUGATED_CLEARANCE;
    }
    return clearance;
}

float absorbedInto(float held, Rate absorption, Rate clearance, Time step) {
    float a = absorption.value;
    float k = clearance.value;
    float t = step.value;
    if (a == k) {
        return a * held * t * expf(-k * t);
    } else {
        return a * held * (expf(-a * t) - expf(-k * t)) / (k - a);
    }
}

struct Body {
    Species[MOST_SPECIES] species;
    uint count;

    uint indexOf(Molecule molecule) const {
        uint index = 0;
        while (index < count && species[index].molecule != molecule) {
            index += 1;
        }
        return index;
    }

    bool hasRoomFor(Molecule molecule) const {
        return indexOf(molecule) < count || count < MOST_SPECIES;
    }

    Species* speciesFor(Molecule molecule) {
        uint index = indexOf(molecule);
        if (index == count) {
            assert(count < MOST_SPECIES);
            species[index] = Species(molecule);
            count += 1;
        }
        return &species[index];
    }

    void dose(Molecule molecule, Ratio amount, Route route) {
        Species* held = speciesFor(molecule);
        final switch (route) {
            case Route.injected:
                held.blood = held.blood + amount;
                break;
            case Route.inhaled:
                held.lung = held.lung + amount;
                break;
            case Route.ingested:
                held.gut = held.gut + amount;
                break;
        }
    }

    void advance(Time step) {
        foreach (ref held; species[0 .. count]) {
            Rate clearance = clearanceOf(held.molecule);
            float blood = held.blood.value * expf(-(clearance * step).value) + absorbedInto(held.gut.value, GUT_ABSORPTION, clearance, step) + absorbedInto(held.lung.value, LUNG_ABSORPTION, clearance, step);
            held.gut = held.gut * expf(-(GUT_ABSORPTION * step).value);
            held.lung = held.lung * expf(-(LUNG_ABSORPTION * step).value);
            held.blood = Ratio(blood);
        }
    }

    Ratio bloodOf(Molecule molecule) const {
        uint index = indexOf(molecule);
        if (index < count) {
            return species[index].blood;
        } else {
            return Ratio(0);
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/common/biology/metabolism.d
module common.biology.metabolism;

import core.stdc.math : expf;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.units : Rate, Ratio, Time;
import common.biology.kinetics : Body, MOST_SPECIES, Species;
import common.biology.molecule : Fragment, GRID_SIDE, GridPoint, Molecule, Property, ROTATION_COUNT, cellOf, conjugated, fragmentAt, propertyBit, rotated, withFragment;

enum uint MOTIF_SIDE = 2;
enum uint MOTIF_CELLS = MOTIF_SIDE * MOTIF_SIDE * MOTIF_SIDE;
enum uint MOTIF_PLACES = GRID_SIDE - MOTIF_SIDE + 1;
enum uint SITE_CELL = 0;
enum Rate ENZYME_RATE = Rate(0.1f);

enum Operation : ubyte {
    cleave,
    attach,
    oxidize,
    conjugate,
}

enum Presence : ubyte {
    any,
    filled,
    empty,
}

struct MotifCell {
    ubyte wanted;
    ubyte cares;
    Presence presence;
}

struct Enzyme {
    MotifCell[MOTIF_CELLS] motif;
    Fragment attached;
    Operation operation;
}

GridPoint motifPoint(uint index, GridPoint corner) {
    return GridPoint(corner.x + cast(int)(index % MOTIF_SIDE), corner.y + cast(int)(index / MOTIF_SIDE % MOTIF_SIDE), corner.z + cast(int)(index / (MOTIF_SIDE * MOTIF_SIDE)));
}

bool isMotifCellMatched(MotifCell wanted, Fragment fragment) {
    final switch (wanted.presence) {
        case Presence.empty:
            return !fragment.isPresent;
        case Presence.filled:
            return fragment.isPresent && ((fragment.properties ^ wanted.wanted) & wanted.cares) == 0;
        case Presence.any:
            return !fragment.isPresent || ((fragment.properties ^ wanted.wanted) & wanted.cares) == 0;
    }
}

bool isMotifAt(Enzyme enzyme, Molecule molecule, GridPoint corner) {
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < MOTIF_CELLS && isMotifCellMatched(enzyme.motif[index], molecule.fragmentAt(cellOf(motifPoint(index, corner))))) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return index == MOTIF_CELLS;
}

Maybe!Molecule productOf(Enzyme enzyme, Molecule molecule) {
    foreach (rotation; 0 .. ROTATION_COUNT) {
        Molecule turned = molecule.rotated(rotation);
        foreach (z; 0 .. MOTIF_PLACES) {
            foreach (y; 0 .. MOTIF_PLACES) {
                foreach (x; 0 .. MOTIF_PLACES) {
                    GridPoint corner = GridPoint(x - 1, y - 1, z - 1);
                    if (enzyme.isMotifAt(turned, corner)) {
                        Molecule changed = enzyme.applied(turned, cellOf(motifPoint(SITE_CELL, corner)));
                        if (changed != turned) {
                            return Maybe!Molecule.of(changed);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return Maybe!Molecule.init;
}

Molecule applied(Enzyme enzyme, Molecule molecule, uint site) {
    Fragment at = molecule.fragmentAt(site);
    final switch (enzyme.operation) {
        case Operation.cleave:
            return molecule.withFragment(site, Fragment.init);
        case Operation.attach:
            if (at.isPresent) {
                return molecule;
            } else {
                return molecule.withFragment(site, enzyme.attached);
            }
        case Operation.oxidize:
            if (at.isPresent) {
                return molecule.withFragment(site, Fragment.of(cast(ubyte)(at.properties ^ propertyBit(Property.polar))));
            } else {
                return molecule;
            }
        case Operation.conjugate:
            return molecule.conjugated();
    }
}

void metabolize(ref Body body, const(Enzyme)[] enzymes, Time step) {
    float converted = 1 - expf(-(ENZYME_RATE * step).value);
    uint existing = body.count;
    foreach (enzyme; enzymes) {
        foreach (index; 0 .. existing) {
            Maybe!Molecule product = enzyme.productOf(body.species[index].molecule);
            if (product.exists && body.hasRoomFor(product.value)) {
                Ratio gut = body.species[index].gut * converted;
                Ratio blood = body.species[index].blood * converted;
                body.species[index].gut = body.species[index].gut - gut;
                body.species[index].blood = body.species[index].blood - blood;
                Species* made = body.speciesFor(product.value);
                made.gut = made.gut + gut;
                made.blood = made.blood + blood;
            }
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/common/biology/molecule.d
module common.biology.molecule;

import base.murmur : Hash128, murmurHash3;

enum uint GRID_SIDE = 3;
enum uint GRID_CELLS = GRID_SIDE * GRID_SIDE * GRID_SIDE;
enum uint CENTER_CELL = GRID_CELLS / 2;
enum uint FRAGMENT_BITS = 4;
enum uint CELLS_PER_WORD = 64 / FRAGMENT_BITS;
enum ubyte FRAGMENT_MASK = (1 << FRAGMENT_BITS) - 1;
enum ubyte PRESENT = 1 << 3;
enum ubyte PROPERTY_MASK = PRESENT - 1;
enum uint PROPERTY_COUNT = 3;
enum uint ROTATION_COUNT = 24;
enum uint AXES = 3;
enum ulong CONJUGATED_BIT = 1UL << (GRID_CELLS * FRAGMENT_BITS - 64);

enum Property : ubyte {
    bulky,
    charged,
    polar,
}

struct Fragment {
    ubyte bits;

    static Fragment of(ubyte properties) {
        return Fragment(cast(ubyte)(PRESENT | (properties & PROPERTY_MASK)));
    }

    bool isPresent() const {
        return (bits & PRESENT) != 0;
    }

    ubyte properties() const {
        return bits & PROPERTY_MASK;
    }

    bool has(Property property) const {
        return (bits & (1 << property)) != 0;
    }
}

ubyte propertyBit(Property property) {
    return cast(ubyte)(1 << property);
}

struct Molecule {
    ulong[2] packed;

    size_t toHash() const {
        Hash128 hash = murmurHash3((cast(const(ubyte)*) packed.ptr)[0 .. packed.sizeof]);
        return cast(size_t) hash.first;
    }
}

Fragment fragmentAt(Molecule molecule, uint cell) {
    return Fragment(cast(ubyte)((molecule.packed[cell / CELLS_PER_WORD] >> (FRAGMENT_BITS * (cell % CELLS_PER_WORD))) & FRAGMENT_MASK));
}

Molecule withFragment(Molecule molecule, uint cell, Fragment fragment) {
    Molecule made = molecule;
    uint shift = FRAGMENT_BITS * (cell % CELLS_PER_WORD);
    made.packed[cell / CELLS_PER_WORD] = (made.packed[cell / CELLS_PER_WORD] & ~(cast(ulong) FRAGMENT_MASK << shift)) | (cast(ulong) fragment.bits << shift);
    return made;
}

bool isConjugated(Molecule molecule) {
    return (molecule.packed[1] & CONJUGATED_BIT) != 0;
}

Molecule conjugated(Molecule molecule) {
    Molecule made = molecule;
    made.packed[1] |= CONJUGATED_BIT;
    return made;
}

uint fragmentCount(Molecule molecule) {
    uint count = 0;
    foreach (cell; 0 .. GRID_CELLS) {
