module common.character.features;

import core.math : sqrt;
import core.stdc.math : coshf, fabsf, floorf;
import base.array : Array;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : clamped, higherOf, isNan, lowerOf;
import base.units : Length, LocalBlock;
import base.vector3 : Vec3, cross, dot, magnitude, minus, plus, scaled;
import common.character.chart : Matrix3, chunkPointInNode, gridJacobian, inverted;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.material : MaterialSet, has;
import common.neighbors : chunkNeighborSlot, indexIn, isInside, materialNear;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkLayout, ChunkSlot, ChunkState;
import common.position : Position;
import common.traversal : NodeVisit, VisitQueue;
import geometry.cube : Cell, DIRECTIONS, Direction, Sign;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, CUBE_RADIUS, Corner, FACE_COUNT, Face, NODE_RADIUS, cubeCenter, faces, mirror, nodeToCorner;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Point, Vec4;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum uint FEATURE_MAX_NODES = 64;
enum int RANGE_MARGIN_CELLS = 1;
enum uint CELL_CORNERS = 8;
enum uint CELL_FACES = 6;
enum uint QUAD_CORNERS = 4;

struct Quad {
    Vec3!float[QUAD_CORNERS] corners;
    Vec3!float normal;

    float separation(Vec3!float point) const {
        return normal.dot(point.minus(corners[0]));
    }

    bool isAbove(Vec3!float point) const {
        uint index = 0;
        while (index < QUAD_CORNERS && normal.dot(corners[(index + 1) % QUAD_CORNERS].minus(corners[index]).cross(point.minus(corners[index]))) >= 0) {
            index += 1;
        }
        return index == QUAD_CORNERS;
    }

    float distanceTo(Vec3!float point) const {
        Vec3!float projected = point.minus(normal.scaled(separation(point)));
        if (isAbove(projected)) {
            return fabsf(separation(point));
        } else {
            float nearest = segmentDistance(corners[0], corners[1], point);
            foreach (index; 1 .. QUAD_CORNERS) {
                nearest = lowerOf(segmentDistance(corners[index], corners[(index + 1) % QUAD_CORNERS], point), nearest);
            }
            return nearest;
        }
    }
}

struct Edge {
    Vec3!float start;
    Vec3!float end;
}

struct Hexahedron {
    Vec3!float[CELL_CORNERS] corners;

    Vec3!float center() const {
        Vec3!float sum = Vec3!float(0, 0, 0);
        foreach (corner; corners) {
            sum = sum.plus(corner);
        }
        return sum.scaled(1.0f / CELL_CORNERS);
    }

    Quad face(size_t axis, int sign) const {
        size_t uAxis = (axis + 1) % 3;
        size_t vAxis = (axis + 2) % 3;
        uint base = sideBit(axis, sign);
        Quad result;
        result.corners[0] = corners[base];
        result.corners[1] = corners[base | (1u << uAxis)];
        result.corners[2] = corners[base | (1u << uAxis) | (1u << vAxis)];
        result.corners[3] = corners[base | (1u << vAxis)];
        Vec3!float normal = unit(result.corners[1].minus(result.corners[0]).cross(result.corners[3].minus(result.corners[0])));
        Vec3!float faceCenter = result.corners[0].plus(result.corners[2]).scaled(0.5f);
        if (normal.dot(faceCenter.minus(center())) < 0) {
            Vec3!float second = result.corners[1];
            result.corners[1] = result.corners[3];
            result.corners[3] = second;
            normal = normal.scaled(-1);
        }
        result.normal = normal;
        return result;
    }

    float distanceTo(Vec3!float point) const {
        float nearest = 0;
        uint outside = 0;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
            foreach (side; 0 .. 2) {
                Quad candidate = face(axis, sideSign(side));
                if (candidate.separation(point) > 0) {
                    float distance = candidate.distanceTo(point);
                    if (outside == 0) {
                        nearest = distance;
                    }
                    outside += 1;
                    nearest = lowerOf(distance, nearest);
                }
            }
        }
        return nearest;
    }
}

struct LocalFrame {
    Motion!float toBody;

    Vec3!float klein(Point!float point) const {
        Vec4!float local = toBody * point.v;
        return Vec3!float(local.c[0] / local.c[3], local.c[1] / local.c[3], local.c[2] / local.c[3]);
    }

    Hexahedron cell(ref const ChunkLayout layout, Corner corner, Vec3!int cell) const {
        Hexahedron result;
        foreach (cellCorner; 0 .. CELL_CORNERS) {
            Vec3!float chunk;
            foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
                chunk[axis] = layout.gridToCube(cell[axis] + ((cellCorner >> axis) & 1));
            }
            result.corners[cellCorner] = klein(chunkPointInNode(corner, chunk));
        }
        return result;
    }
}

struct CellRange {
    Vec3!int low;
    Vec3!int high;

    bool isEmpty() const {
        return low.x > high.x || low.y > high.y || low.z > high.z;
    }

    bool contains(Vec3!int cell) const {
        return cell.x >= low.x && cell.x <= high.x && cell.y >= low.y && cell.y <= high.y && cell.z >= low.z && cell.z <= high.z;
    }

    bool isTouching(Direction direction, ubyte dimension) const {
        if (direction.sign == Sign.plus) {
            return high[direction.axis] == dimension - 1;
        } else {
            return low[direction.axis] == 0;
        }
    }
}

struct Features {
    Array!Quad quads;
    Array!Edge edges;
    Array!(Vec3!float) corners;
    MaterialSet solid;
    uint unloaded;

    bool isLoaded() const {
        return unloaded == 0;
    }

    void release() {
        quads.release();
        edges.release();
        corners.release();
    }

    void collect(ref const Graph graph, Position body, Length reach, MaterialSet chosen) {
        quads.clear();
        edges.clear();
        corners.clear();
        unloaded = 0;
        solid = chosen;
        visitCells(graph, body, reach, this);
    }

    void visitChunk(ref const Graph graph, LocalFrame frame, ChunkSlot slot, CellRange range) {
        ChunkCellsNear cells = ChunkCellsNear(&graph, slot, graph.chunks.at(slot), solid);
        if (cells.chunk.state != ChunkState.populated || !graph.areNeighborsPopulated(slot, range)) {
            unloaded += 1;
        } else {
            foreach (x; range.low.x .. range.high.x + 1) {
                foreach (y; range.low.y .. range.high.y + 1) {
                    foreach (z; range.low.z .. range.high.z + 1) {
                        Vec3!int cell = Vec3!int(x, y, z);
                        if (cells.isSolid(cell, Vec3!int(0, 0, 0)) && cells.hasExposedFace(cell)) {
                            addCell(cells, frame.cell(graph.layout, slot.corner, cell), cell);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void visitMissingNode(uint, Face) {
        unloaded += 1;
    }

    void addCell(ref const ChunkCellsNear cells, Hexahedron hexahedron, Vec3!int cell) {
        foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
            foreach (side; 0 .. 2) {
                int sign = sideSign(side);
                if (!cells.isSolid(cell, offsetAlong(axis, sign))) {
                    Quad quad = hexahedron.face(axis, sign);
                    quads.append(quad);
                    addBoundary(quad);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void addBoundary(Quad quad) {
        foreach (index; 0 .. QUAD_CORNERS) {
            edges.append(Edge(quad.corners[index], quad.corners[(index + 1) % QUAD_CORNERS]));
            corners.append(quad.corners[index]);
        }
    }
}

struct CellOverlap {
    Vec3!float[] centers;
    ChunkSlot target;
    Cell coords;
    float radius;
    uint overlaps;

    void visitMissingNode(uint, Face) {
    }

    void visitChunk(ref const Graph graph, LocalFrame frame, ChunkSlot slot, CellRange range) {
        Vec3!int cell = coords.as!int();
        if (slot == target && range.contains(cell) && overlaps == 0 && isTouchingAny(frame.cell(graph.layout, slot.corner, cell), centers, radius)) {
            overlaps += 1;
        }
    }
}

struct MaterialOverlap {
    Vec3!float[] centers;
    MaterialSet materials;
    float radius;
    uint overlaps;

    void visitMissingNode(uint, Face) {
    }

    void visitChunk(ref const Graph graph, LocalFrame frame, ChunkSlot slot, CellRange range) {
        const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(slot);
        if (overlaps == 0 && chunk.state == ChunkState.populated && !(chunk.voxels.isUniform() && !materials.has(chunk.voxels.fill))) {
            foreach (x; range.low.x .. range.high.x + 1) {
                foreach (y; range.low.y .. range.high.y + 1) {
                    foreach (z; range.low.z .. range.high.z + 1) {
                        Vec3!int cell = Vec3!int(x, y, z);
                        if (materials.has(chunk.voxels.at(indexIn(graph.layout.dimension, cell))) && isTouchingAny(frame.cell(graph.layout, slot.corner, cell), centers, radius)) {
                            overlaps += 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

struct BlockProbe {
    Vec3!float up;
    Maybe!LocalBlock block;

    void visitMissingNode(uint, Face) {
    }

    void visitChunk(ref const Graph graph, LocalFrame frame, ChunkSlot slot, CellRange) {
        Motion!float toCorner = slot.corner.nodeToCorner * frame.toBody.inverse();
        Vec3!float grid = gridPoint(graph.layout, toCorner);
        if (!block.exists && isInsideGrid(grid, graph.layout.dimension)) {
            Matrix3 absolutePerGrid = inverted(gridJacobian(graph.layout, toCorner));
            float height = 0;
            foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
                height += fabsf(absolutePerGrid.x[axis] * up.x + absolutePerGrid.y[axis] * up.y + absolutePerGrid.z[axis] * up.z);
            }
            block = Maybe!LocalBlock.of(LocalBlock(Length(height)));
        }
    }
}

Vec3!float gridPoint(ref const ChunkLayout layout, Motion!float toCorner) {
    Vec4!float at = (toCorner * Point!float.origin()).v;
    return Vec3!float(layout.kleinToGrid(at.c[0] / at.c[3]), layout.kleinToGrid(at.c[1] / at.c[3]), layout.kleinToGrid(at.c[2] / at.c[3]));
}

bool isInsideGrid(Vec3!float grid, ubyte dimension) {
    return grid.x >= 0 && grid.x < dimension && grid.y >= 0 && grid.y < dimension && grid.z >= 0 && grid.z < dimension;
}

struct NodeSide {
    uint slot;
    Face side;
}

struct RequiredChunks {
    Array!ChunkSlot chunks;
    Array!NodeSide missing;

    void clear() {
        chunks.clear();
        missing.clear();
    }

    void release() {
        chunks.release();
        missing.release();
    }

    void visitMissingNode(uint slot, Face side) {
        missing.append(NodeSide(slot, side));
    }

    void visitChunk(ref const Graph graph, LocalFrame, ChunkSlot slot, CellRange range) {
        chunks.append(slot);
        foreach (direction; DIRECTIONS) {
            if (range.isTouching(direction, graph.layout.dimension)) {
                Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(slot, direction);
                if (neighbor.exists) {
                    chunks.append(neighbor.value);
                } else {
                    missing.append(NodeSide(slot.slot, slot.corner.faces[direction.axis]));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void visitCells(V)(ref const Graph graph, Position body, Length reach, ref V visitor) {
    Vec4!float point = (body.local * Point!float.origin()).v;
    Motion!float bodyInverse = body.local.inverse();
    float nodeThreshold = coshf(reach.value + NODE_RADIUS + CUBE_RADIUS);
    float chunkThreshold = coshf(reach.value + CUBE_RADIUS);
    VisitQueue!FEATURE_MAX_NODES queue = VisitQueue!FEATURE_MAX_NODES.fromSlot(graph.slotOf(body.node).value);
    while (queue.hasNext()) {
        NodeVisit visit = queue.current();
        Vec4!float local = visit.inverse * point;
        LocalFrame frame = LocalFrame(bodyInverse * visit.inverse.inverse());
        foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
            Corner corner = cast(Corner) index;
            if (!(-local.minkowski(corner.cubeCenter.v) > chunkThreshold)) {
                CellRange range = cellRange(graph.layout, corner, local, reach);
                if (!range.isEmpty()) {
                    visitor.visitChunk(graph, frame, ChunkSlot(visit.slot, corner), range);
                }
            }
        }
        foreach (index; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            Face side = cast(Face) index;
            if (!graph.neighborSlot(visit.slot, side).exists && !((side.mirror * visit.inverse * point).c[3] > nodeThreshold)) {
                visitor.visitMissingNode(visit.slot, side);
            }
        }
        queue.expand(graph, visit, point, nodeThreshold);
    }
}

CellRange cellRange(ref const ChunkLayout layout, Corner corner, Vec4!float local, Length reach) {
    Motion!float toCorner = corner.nodeToCorner * Motion!float.shiftTo(Point!float(local));
    Vec3!float grid = gridPoint(layout, toCorner);
    Matrix3 jacobian = gridJacobian(layout, toCorner);
    CellRange range;
    foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
        float extent = jacobian[axis].dot(jacobian[axis]);
        float span = sqrt(extent) * reach.value;
        if (isNan(grid[axis]) || isNan(span)) {
            range.low[axis] = 0;
            range.high[axis] = -1;
        } else {
            range.low[axis] = higherOf(clampedCell(grid[axis] - span, layout.dimension) - RANGE_MARGIN_CELLS, 0);
            range.high[axis] = lowerOf(clampedCell(grid[axis] + span, layout.dimension) + RANGE_MARGIN_CELLS, layout.dimension - 1);
        }
    }
    return range;
}

int clampedCell(float grid, ubyte dimension) {
    return cast(int) floorf(clamped!float(grid, -RANGE_MARGIN_CELLS - 1, dimension + RANGE_MARGIN_CELLS));
}

bool areNeighborsPopulated(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot slot, CellRange range) {
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < DIRECTIONS.length && !(range.isTouching(DIRECTIONS[index], graph.layout.dimension) && !graph.isNeighborPopulated(slot, DIRECTIONS[index]))) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return index == DIRECTIONS.length;
}

bool isNeighborPopulated(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot slot, Direction direction) {
    Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(slot, direction);
    return neighbor.exists && graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).state == ChunkState.populated;
}

struct ChunkCellsNear {
    const(Graph)* graph;
    ChunkSlot slot;
    const(Chunk)* chunk;
    MaterialSet solid;

    bool isSolid(Vec3!int cell, Vec3!int offset) const {
        Vec3!int at = Vec3!int(cell.x + offset.x, cell.y + offset.y, cell.z + offset.z);
        ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
        if (isInside(dimension, at)) {
            return solid.has(chunk.voxels.at(indexIn(dimension, at)));
        } else {
            return solid.has((*graph).materialNear(slot, at));
        }
    }

    bool hasExposedFace(Vec3!int cell) const {
        uint face = 0;
        while (face < CELL_FACES && isSolid(cell, offsetAlong(face / 2, sideSign(face % 2)))) {
            face += 1;
        }
        return face < CELL_FACES;
    }
}

bool isTouchingAny(Hexahedron hexahedron, const(Vec3!float)[] centers, float radius) {
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < centers.length && !(hexahedron.distanceTo(centers[index]) < radius)) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return index < centers.length;
}

Vec3!int offsetAlong(size_t axis, int sign) {
    Vec3!int offset = Vec3!int(0, 0, 0);
    offset[axis] = sign;
    return offset;
}

uint sideBit(size_t axis, int sign) {
    if (sign > 0) {
        return 1u << axis;
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}

int sideSign(int side) {
    if (side == 1) {
        return 1;
    } else {
        return -1;
    }
}

Vec3!float unit(Vec3!float v) {
    return v.scaled(1.0f / v.magnitude);
}

float segmentDistance(Vec3!float start, Vec3!float end, Vec3!float point) {
    Vec3!float along = end.minus(start);
    float t = clamped(point.minus(start).dot(along) / along.dot(along), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    return point.minus(start.plus(along.scaled(t))).magnitude;
}

/// file: source/common/character/sweep.d
module common.character.sweep;

import core.math : sqrt;
import core.stdc.math : ceilf;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : higherOf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3, ZERO_VECTOR, cross, dot, magnitude, minus, plus, scaled;
import common.character.features : Edge, Features, Quad, unit;

enum double MIN_DISPLACEMENT_SQUARED = 1e-16;
enum float MIN_CREASE_SINE = 1e-3f;

struct Capsule {
    Vec3!float axis;
    float radius;
    float halfHeight;
    float skin;

    float capOffset() const {
        return higherOf(halfHeight - radius, 0.0f);
    }

    float sectionSpacing() const {
        return 2.0f * sqrt(skin * (2.0f * radius - skin));
    }

    uint sectionCount() const {
        float length = 2.0f * capOffset();
        if (length > 0) {
            return cast(uint) ceilf(length / sectionSpacing()) + 1;
        } else {
            return 1;
        }
    }

    float sectionOffset(uint sectionIndex, uint count) const {
        if (count > 1) {
            return capOffset() * (2.0f * cast(float) sectionIndex / cast(float)(count - 1) - 1.0f);
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    Vec3!float sectionCenter(Vec3!float center, uint sectionIndex, uint count) const {
        return center.plus(axis.scaled(sectionOffset(sectionIndex, count)));
    }
}

enum SectionRank : ubyte {
    upper,
    lowest,
}

struct Contact {
    Vec3!float normal = Vec3!float(0, 0, 0);
    float stop = 0;
    float gap = 0;
    SectionRank rank;
}

bool isImprovedBy(Maybe!Contact best, float candidate) {
    return !best.exists || candidate < best.value.stop;
}

struct ContactPlane {
    Vec3!float normal;
    float separation;
}

bool isSameDirection(Vec3!float a, Vec3!float b) {
    return a.dot(b) > 0 && a.cross(b).magnitude < MIN_CREASE_SINE;
}

struct Section {
    const(ContactPlane)[] clipped;
    Vec3!float center;
    float radius;
    float stopRadius;
    SectionRank rank;

    float gapAt(float separation, float stop) const {
        if (stop == 0) {
            return separation - radius;
        } else {
            return stopRadius - radius;
        }
    }

    Maybe!Contact accepted(Maybe!Contact best, Contact candidate) const {
        size_t index = 0;
        while (index < clipped.length && !isSameDirection(clipped[index].normal, candidate.normal)) {
            index += 1;
        }
        if (index < clipped.length) {
            return best;
        } else {
            return Maybe!Contact.of(candidate);
        }
    }

    Maybe!Contact quadContact(ref const Quad quad, Vec3!float direction, float distance, Maybe!Contact best) const {
        float separation = quad.separation(center);
        float rate = quad.normal.dot(direction);
        Maybe!float stop = contactTime(separation * separation, separation * rate, rate * rate, stopRadius);
        if (rate >= 0 || !isTouchWithin(stop, distance) || !best.isImprovedBy(stop.value)) {
            return best;
        } else {
            Vec3!float at = center.plus(direction.scaled(stop.value));
            if (quad.isAbove(at.minus(quad.normal.scaled(quad.separation(at))))) {
                return accepted(best, Contact(quad.normal, stop.value, gapAt(separation, stop.value), rank));
            } else {
                return best;
            }
        }
    }

    Maybe!Contact edgeContact(ref const Edge edge, Vec3!float direction, float distance, Maybe!Contact best) const {
        Vec3!float along = edge.end.minus(edge.start);
        float length = along.magnitude;
        Vec3!float line = along.scaled(1.0f / length);
        Vec3!float offset = center.minus(edge.start);
        Vec3!float offsetAcross = offset.minus(line.scaled(offset.dot(line)));
        Vec3!float rateAcross = direction.minus(line.scaled(direction.dot(line)));
        Maybe!float stop = contactTime(offsetAcross.dot(offsetAcross), offsetAcross.dot(rateAcross), rateAcross.dot(rateAcross), stopRadius);
        if (!isTouchWithin(stop, distance) || !best.isImprovedBy(stop.value)) {
            return best;
        } else {
            Vec3!float reached = center.plus(direction.scaled(stop.value)).minus(edge.start);
            float position = reached.dot(line);
            if (position >= 0 && position <= length) {
                return accepted(best, Contact(unit(reached.minus(line.scaled(position))), stop.value, gapAt(offsetAcross.magnitude, stop.value), rank));
            } else {
                return best;
            }
        }
    }

    Maybe!Contact cornerContact(Vec3!float corner, Vec3!float direction, float distance, Maybe!Contact best) const {
        Vec3!float offset = center.minus(corner);
        Maybe!float stop = contactTime(offset.dot(offset), offset.dot(direction), direction.dot(direction), stopRadius);
        if (!isTouchWithin(stop, distance) || !best.isImprovedBy(stop.value)) {
            return best;
        } else {
            return accepted(best, Contact(unit(center.plus(direction.scaled(stop.value)).minus(corner)), stop.value, gapAt(offset.magnitude, stop.value), rank));
        }
    }
}

struct Sweep {
    Vec3!float displacement;
    Maybe!Contact contact;

    static Sweep fromCapsule(ref const Features features, Capsule capsule, Vec3!float start, Vec3!float displacement, const(ContactPlane)[] clipped) {
        float displacementSquared = displacement.dot(displacement);
        if (displacementSquared < MIN_DISPLACEMENT_SQUARED) {
            return Sweep(ZERO_VECTOR);
        } else {
            float distance = sqrt(displacementSquared);
            Maybe!Contact contact = features.capsuleContact(capsule, start, displacement.scaled(1.0f / distance), distance, clipped);
            if (contact.exists) {
                return Sweep(displacement.scaled(contact.value.stop / distance), contact);
            } else {
                return Sweep(displacement);
            }
        }
    }
}

bool isTouchWithin(Maybe!float stop, float distance) {
    return stop.exists && !(stop.value > distance);
}

Maybe!float contactTime(float separationSquared, float approach, float directionSquared, float stopRadius) {
    float constantTerm = separationSquared - stopRadius * stopRadius;
    float discriminant = approach * approach - directionSquared * constantTerm;
    if (approach >= 0.0f) {
        return Maybe!float.init;
    } else if (constantTerm <= 0.0f && separationSquared - approach * approach / directionSquared < separationSquared) {
        return Maybe!float.of(0.0f);
    } else if (constantTerm <= 0.0f) {
        return Maybe!float.init;
    } else if (discriminant > 0.0f) {
        return Maybe!float.of(constantTerm / (-approach + sqrt(discriminant)));
    } else {
        return Maybe!float.init;
    }
}

Maybe!Contact capsuleContact(ref const Features features, Capsule capsule, Vec3!float start, Vec3!float direction, float distance, const(ContactPlane)[] clipped) {
    uint count = capsule.sectionCount();
    Maybe!Contact best;
    foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
        SectionRank rank = SectionRank.upper;
        if (index == 0) {
            rank = SectionRank.lowest;
        }
        Section section = Section(clipped, capsule.sectionCenter(start, index, count), capsule.radius, capsule.radius + capsule.skin, rank);
        foreach (ref quad; features.quads.slice()) {
            best = section.quadContact(quad, direction, distance, best);
        }
        foreach (ref edge; features.edges.slice()) {
            best = section.edgeContact(edge, direction, distance, best);
        }
        foreach (corner; features.corners.slice()) {
            best = section.cornerContact(corner, direction, distance, best);
        }
    }
    return best;
}

Vec3!float[] sectionCenters(Capsule capsule, Vec3!float center, Vec3!float[] storage) {
    uint count = capsule.sectionCount();
    foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
        storage[index] = capsule.sectionCenter(center, index, count);
    }
    return storage[0 .. count];
}

/// file: source/common/chunks.d
module common.chunks;

import base.array : Array;
import base.maybe : MaybeIndex;
import base.slab : FreeIndices, Slab;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkSlot;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT;

immutable Chunk FRESH_CHUNK = Chunk.init;

struct ChunkStore {
    Slab!Chunk records;
    Slab!(MaybeIndex!uint) blocks;
    FreeIndices freeBlocks;
    Array!ChunkSlot changed;
    Array!ChunkSlot restores;
    size_t changedHead;
    uint blockCount;

    void ensureSlots(uint count) {
        blocks.ensure(count);
    }

    MaybeIndex!uint blockOf(uint slot) const {
        return *blocks.at(slot);
    }

    bool has(uint slot) const {
        return blockOf(slot).exists;
    }

    const(Chunk)* at(ChunkSlot chunk) const {
        MaybeIndex!uint block = blockOf(chunk.slot);
        if (block.exists) {
            return records.at(indexOf(block.value, chunk));
        } else {
            return &FRESH_CHUNK;
        }
    }

    Chunk* existing(ChunkSlot chunk) {
        return records.at(indexOf(blockOf(chunk.slot).value, chunk));
    }

    Chunk* writable(ChunkSlot chunk) {
        MaybeIndex!uint* block = blocks.at(chunk.slot);
        if (!block.exists) {
            if (!freeBlocks.isEmpty()) {
                *block = MaybeIndex!uint.of(freeBlocks.takeLowest());
            } else {
                *block = MaybeIndex!uint.of(blockCount);
                blockCount += 1;
                records.ensure(cast(size_t) blockCount * CORNER_COUNT);
            }
        }
        return records.at(indexOf(block.value, chunk));
    }

    void releaseBlock(uint slot) {
        MaybeIndex!uint* block = blocks.at(slot);
        uint index = block.value;
        foreach (corner; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
            Chunk* chunk = records.at(cast(size_t) index * CORNER_COUNT + corner);
            chunk.releaseVoxels();
            *chunk = Chunk.init;
        }
        freeBlocks.add(index);
        *block = MaybeIndex!uint.init;
        while (blockCount > 0 && freeBlocks.contains(blockCount - 1)) {
            freeBlocks.drop(blockCount - 1);
            blockCount -= 1;
        }
        records.trim(cast(size_t) blockCount * CORNER_COUNT);
        records.note(index, CORNER_COUNT);
    }

    void discardFreed(ref uint calls) {
        records.discardNoted(freeBlocks, blockCount, CORNER_COUNT, calls);
    }

    void queue(ChunkSlot chunk) {
        writable(chunk).markQueued();
        changed.append(chunk);
    }

    const(ChunkSlot)[] pending() const {
        return changed.slice()[changedHead .. $];
    }

    bool hasChanges() const {
        return changedHead < changed.length;
    }

    ChunkSlot takeChanged() {
        ChunkSlot taken = changed.ptr[changedHead];
        changedHead += 1;
        if (has(taken.slot)) {
            existing(taken).unmarkQueued();
        }
        if (changedHead == changed.length) {
            changed.clear();
            changedHead = 0;
        }
        return taken;
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (index; 0 .. cast(size_t) blockCount * CORNER_COUNT) {
            records.at(index).releaseVoxels();
        }
        records.release();
        blocks.release();
        freeBlocks.release();
        changed.release();
        restores.release();
        changedHead = 0;
        blockCount = 0;
    }
}

size_t indexOf(uint block, ChunkSlot chunk) {
    return cast(size_t) block * CORNER_COUNT + chunk.corner;
}

/// file: source/common/color.d
module common.color;

import core.stdc.math : cosf, sinf;
import base.numbers : lowerOf, sqrtAtCompileTime;
import base.units : Angle;

enum uint COLOR_CHANNELS = 5;
enum uint SEEN_CHANNELS = 3;
enum uint CHROMA_AXES = COLOR_CHANNELS - 1;
enum uint TURN_PLANES = CHROMA_AXES * (CHROMA_AXES - 1) / 2;

alias Spectrum = float[COLOR_CHANNELS];
alias Seen = float[SEEN_CHANNELS];

struct ColorTurn {
    Angle[TURN_PLANES] angles;
}

struct TurnPlane {
    uint first;
    uint second;
}

immutable Spectrum[CHROMA_AXES] CHROMA_BASIS = chromaBasis();
immutable TurnPlane[TURN_PLANES] TURN_PLANES_OF = turnPlanes();

Spectrum[CHROMA_AXES] chromaBasis() {
    Spectrum[CHROMA_AXES] basis;
    foreach (axis; 0 .. CHROMA_AXES) {
        Spectrum vector = -1.0f / COLOR_CHANNELS;
        vector[axis] += 1;
        foreach (previous; 0 .. axis) {
            float along = dotOf(vector, basis[previous]);
            foreach (channel; 0 .. COLOR_CHANNELS) {
                vector[channel] -= along * basis[previous][channel];
            }
        }
        float length = cast(float) sqrtAtCompileTime(dotOf(vector, vector));
        foreach (channel; 0 .. COLOR_CHANNELS) {
            basis[axis][channel] = vector[channel] / length;
        }
    }
    return basis;
}

TurnPlane[TURN_PLANES] turnPlanes() {
    TurnPlane[TURN_PLANES] planes;
    uint index = 0;
    foreach (first; 0 .. CHROMA_AXES) {
        foreach (second; first + 1 .. CHROMA_AXES) {
            planes[index] = TurnPlane(first, second);
            index += 1;
        }
    }
    return planes;
}

float dotOf(Spectrum a, Spectrum b) {
    float sum = 0;
    foreach (channel; 0 .. COLOR_CHANNELS) {
        sum += a[channel] * b[channel];
    }
    return sum;
}

float grayOf(Spectrum color) {
    float sum = 0;
    foreach (channel; color) {
        sum += channel;
    }
    return sum / COLOR_CHANNELS;
}

Spectrum spectrumOf(Seen linear) {
    float gray = (linear[0] + linear[1] + linear[2]) / SEEN_CHANNELS;
    return [linear[0], linear[1], linear[2], gray, gray];
}

Spectrum turned(Spectrum color, ColorTurn turn) {
    float gray = grayOf(color);
    float[CHROMA_AXES] chroma;
    foreach (axis; 0 .. CHROMA_AXES) {
        chroma[axis] = dotOf(color, CHROMA_BASIS[axis]);
    }
    foreach (index, plane; TURN_PLANES_OF) {
        float cosine = cosf(turn.angles[index].value);
        float sine = sinf(turn.angles[index].value);
        float first = chroma[plane.first];
        float second = chroma[plane.second];
        chroma[plane.first] = cosine * first - sine * second;
        chroma[plane.second] = sine * first + cosine * second;
    }
    Spectrum result = gray;
    foreach (axis; 0 .. CHROMA_AXES) {
        foreach (channel; 0 .. COLOR_CHANNELS) {
            result[channel] += chroma[axis] * CHROMA_BASIS[axis][channel];
        }
    }
    return result;
}

Seen seenOf(Spectrum color) {
    float gray = grayOf(color);
    Seen seen = [color[0], color[1], color[2]];
    float least = lowerOf(seen[0], lowerOf(seen[1], seen[2]));
    if (least < 0) {
        float kept = gray / (gray - least);
        foreach (ref channel; seen) {
            channel = gray + (channel - gray) * kept;
        }
    }
    return seen;
}

/// file: source/common/edits.d
module common.edits;

import base.array : Array;
import base.hashmap : HashMap;
import base.units : Time;
import common.biology.wild : WildGenes;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkId;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

struct CellEdit {
    uint cell;
    Material material;
}

enum RecordKind : ubyte {
    beacon,
    collector,
    planted,
}

struct BlockRecord {
    WildGenes genes;
    Time placed;
    uint cell;
    RecordKind kind;
}

struct ChunkEdits {
    Array!CellEdit cells;
    Array!BlockRecord records;

    void keep(BlockRecord record) {
        drop(record.cell);
        records.append(record);
    }

    void drop(uint cell) {
        size_t index = 0;
        while (index < records.length && records.ptr[index].cell != cell) {
            index += 1;
        }
        if (index < records.length) {
            records.ptr[index] = records.ptr[records.length - 1];
            records.length -= 1;
        }
    }

    void set(uint cell, Material material) {
        size_t index = 0;
        while (index < cells.length && cells.ptr[index].cell != cell) {
            index += 1;
        }
        if (index < cells.length) {
            cells.ptr[index].material = material;
        } else {
            cells.append(CellEdit(cell, material));
        }
    }
}

struct EditStore {
    HashMap!(ChunkId, ChunkEdits) chunks;
    size_t cellCount;

    ChunkEdits* ensure(ChunkId chunk) {
        ChunkEdits* found = chunks.find(chunk);
        if (found is null) {
            chunks.insert(chunk, ChunkEdits.init);
            found = chunks.find(chunk);
        }
        return found;
    }

    void record(ChunkId chunk, uint cell, Material material) {
        ChunkEdits* found = ensure(chunk);
        size_t before = found.cells.length;
        found.set(cell, material);
        cellCount += found.cells.length - before;
    }

    void keepRecord(ChunkId chunk, BlockRecord record) {
        ensure(chunk).keep(record);
    }

    void dropRecord(ChunkId chunk, uint cell) {
        ChunkEdits* found = chunks.find(chunk);
        if (found !is null) {
            found.drop(cell);
        }
    }

    const(ChunkEdits)* editsOf(ChunkId chunk) const {
        return chunks.find(chunk);
    }

    BlockRecord* recordAt(ChunkId chunk, uint cell) {
        ChunkEdits* found = chunks.find(chunk);
        if (found is null) {
            return null;
        } else {
            size_t index = 0;
            while (index < found.records.length && found.records.ptr[index].cell != cell) {
                index += 1;
            }
            if (index < found.records.length) {
                return &found.records.ptr[index];
            } else {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (ref const chunk, ref edits; chunks) {
            edits.cells.release();
            edits.records.release();
        }
        chunks.release();
        cellCount = 0;
    }
}

void applyEdits(ref const ChunkEdits edits, Chunk* chunk, ubyte dimension) {
    Material[] cells = chunk.denseVoxels(dimension);
    foreach (edit; edits.cells.slice()) {
        cells[edit.cell] = edit.material;
    }
    chunk.markEdited();
}

/// file: source/common/eviction.d
module common.eviction;

import core.stdc.math : coshf;
import base.array : Array;
import base.clock : nowMilliseconds;
import base.flags : Bits;
import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;
import base.numbers : higherOf;
import common.graph : Graph, ParentList;
import common.neighbors : chunkNeighborSlot;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkSlot, ChunkState;
import common.traversal : NearbyNode, NearbyScratch;
import common.worldgen.blueprint : Blueprint;
import common.worldgen.horospheres : releaseIdleHorospheres;
import common.worldgen.store : dropTile, forgetTile, isTileGone, isTilePinned, unpin;
import geometry.cube : DIRECTIONS;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, CUBE_RADIUS, Corner, cubeCenter;
import geometry.lorentz : Point;

enum uint SLOTS_PER_CLOCK_CHECK = 256;
enum uint SWEEP_CYCLE_FRAMES = 120;
enum uint SWEEP_LEAST_SLOTS = 1024;
enum double SWEEP_MOST_MILLISECONDS = 3.0;
enum float KEEP_RADIUS = 3.0f;
enum float DROP_RADIUS = 3.5f;
enum uint TILE_IDLE_SWEEPS = 60;
enum uint TILE_CYCLE_FRAMES = 30;
enum uint TILES_PER_CLOCK_CHECK = 64;

struct Evictor {
    Array!uint stack;
    Bits recent;
    uint cursor;
    uint tileCursor;
    uint forgetCursor;
    uint seenLive;
    uint seenNodes;
    uint evicted;
    uint dropped;
    uint droppedTiles;
    uint forgottenTiles;

    void sweep(ref Graph graph, ref const NearbyScratch published, const(NearbyScratch)* building, Point!float camera, ref Array!Unloaded unloaded, double start) {
        Near near = Near(&published, building);
        recent.cover(graph.slotCount);
        double deadline = start + SWEEP_MOST_MILLISECONDS;
        dropIdleTiles(graph, near, deadline);
        forgetGoneTiles(graph);
        float dropThreshold = coshf(DROP_RADIUS + CUBE_RADIUS);
        uint wanted = higherOf(graph.slotCount / SWEEP_CYCLE_FRAMES, SWEEP_LEAST_SLOTS);
        uint owed = graph.madeNodes - seenNodes;
        seenNodes = graph.madeNodes;
        uint before = evicted;
        uint examined = 0;
        uint limit = wanted;
        while (examined < limit) {
            if (cursor >= graph.slotCount) {
                cursor = 0;
                graph.releaseIdleHorospheres();
            }
            uint slot = cursor;
            cursor += 1;
            examined += 1;
            if (examined % SLOTS_PER_CLOCK_CHECK == 0 && evicted - before >= owed) {
                double now = nowMilliseconds();
                if (now >= deadline) {
                    limit = examined;
                }
            }
            if (graph.isLive(slot)) {
                if (recent.has(slot)) {
                    recent.clear(slot);
                } else if (near.contains(slot)) {
                    recent.set(slot);
                    MaybeIndex!uint index = published.indexOf(slot);
                    if (index.exists && graph.chunks.has(slot)) {
                        dropped += graph.dropFarChunks(published.nodes.ptr[index.value], camera, dropThreshold);
                    }
                } else if (graph.isEvictable(slot)) {
                    evictFrom(graph, slot, near, unloaded);
                } else {
                    graph.unloadNode(slot, unloaded);
                }
            }
        }
        graph.discardFreed();
    }

    void evictFrom(ref Graph graph, uint slot, Near near, ref Array!Unloaded unloaded) {
        stack.append(slot);
        while (stack.length > 0) {
            uint current = stack.ptr[stack.length - 1];
            stack.length -= 1;
            ParentList parents = graph.parents(current);
            graph.evictNode(current, unloaded);
            evicted += 1;
            foreach (link; parents.links[0 .. parents.count]) {
                if (!recent.has(link.slot) && !near.contains(link.slot) && graph.isEvictable(link.slot)) {
                    stack.append(link.slot);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void dropIdleTiles(ref Graph graph, Near near, double deadline) {
        Blueprint* blueprint = &graph.structures.blueprint;
        blueprint.sweep += 1;
        uint owed = blueprint.madeLive - seenLive;
        seenLive = blueprint.madeLive;
        size_t count = blueprint.liveTiles.length / TILE_CYCLE_FRAMES + 1;
        size_t examined = 0;
        while (examined < count) {
            if (tileCursor >= blueprint.liveTiles.length) {
                tileCursor = 0;
            }
            if (tileCursor < blueprint.liveTiles.length) {
                uint tile = blueprint.liveTiles.ptr[tileCursor];
                if (graph.isTileIdle(tile, tileCursor, near)) {
                    graph.dropTile(tile);
                    droppedTiles += 1;
                    if (owed > 0) {
                        owed -= 1;
                    }
                    if (graph.isTileGone(tile)) {
                        graph.forgetTile(tile);
                        forgottenTiles += 1;
                    }
                } else {
                    tileCursor += 1;
                }
            }
            examined += 1;
            if (examined % TILES_PER_CLOCK_CHECK == 0 && owed == 0) {
                double now = nowMilliseconds();
                if (now >= deadline) {
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void forgetGoneTiles(ref Graph graph) {
        Blueprint* blueprint = &graph.structures.blueprint;
        size_t count = blueprint.droppedTiles.length / SWEEP_CYCLE_FRAMES + 1;
        foreach (examined; 0 .. count) {
            if (forgetCursor >= blueprint.droppedTiles.length) {
                forgetCursor = 0;
            }
            if (forgetCursor < blueprint.droppedTiles.length) {
                uint tile = blueprint.droppedTiles.ptr[forgetCursor];
                if (graph.isTileGone(tile)) {
                    graph.forgetTile(tile);
                    forgottenTiles += 1;
                } else {
                    forgetCursor += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void release() {
        stack.release();
        recent.release();
    }
}

bool isTileIdle(ref const Graph graph, uint tile, uint listed, Near near) {
    const(Blueprint)* blueprint = &graph.structures.blueprint;
    if (blueprint.sweep - blueprint.liveUses.ptr[listed] > TILE_IDLE_SWEEPS && !graph.isTilePinned(tile)) {
        MaybeIndex!uint face = graph.slotOf(blueprint.tiles.ptr[tile].face);
        return !face.exists || !near.contains(face.value);
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}

struct Near {
    const(NearbyScratch)* published;
    const(NearbyScratch)* building;

    bool contains(uint slot) const {
        return published.indexOf(slot).exists || (building !is null && building.indexOf(slot).exists);
    }
}

uint dropFarChunks(ref Graph graph, NearbyNode node, Point!float camera, float threshold) {
    uint count = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
        Corner corner = cast(Corner) index;
        ChunkSlot chunk = ChunkSlot(node.slot, corner);
        const(Chunk)* current = graph.chunks.at(chunk);
        if (current.state == ChunkState.populated && !current.voxels.isUniform() && !current.isQueued && camera.coshDistance(node.transform * corner.cubeCenter) > threshold && graph.areFaceNeighborsSettled(chunk)) {
            Chunk* target = graph.chunks.existing(chunk);
            target.releaseVoxels();
            target.state = ChunkState.dropped;
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

bool areFaceNeighborsSettled(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk) {
    uint direction = 0;
    while (direction < DIRECTIONS.length && graph.isSettled(graph.chunkNeighborSlot(chunk, DIRECTIONS[direction]))) {
        direction += 1;
    }
    return direction == DIRECTIONS.length;
}

bool isSettled(ref const Graph graph, Maybe!ChunkSlot chunk) {
    if (chunk.exists) {
        ChunkState state = graph.chunks.at(chunk.value).state;
        return state == ChunkState.populated || state == ChunkState.dropped;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}

bool isEvictable(ref const Graph graph, uint slot) {
    return graph.nodeAt(slot).liveChildren == 0 && graph.nodeAt(slot).references == 0 && !graph.isPinned(slot);
}

bool isPinned(ref const Graph graph, uint slot) {
    return graph.structures.at(slot).isBuildingQueued || (graph.chunks.has(slot) && graph.hasPinnedChunk(slot));
}

bool hasPinnedChunk(ref const Graph graph, uint slot) {
    uint corner = 0;
    while (corner < CORNER_COUNT && !isPinnedChunk(graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot(slot, cast(Corner) corner)))) {
        corner += 1;
    }
    return corner < CORNER_COUNT;
}

bool isPinnedChunk(const(Chunk)* chunk) {
    return chunk.state == ChunkState.generating;
}

struct Unloaded {
    uint slot;
    MaybeIndex!uint block;
}

void unloadNode(ref Graph graph, uint slot, ref Array!Unloaded unloaded) {
    uint held = 0;
    if (graph.chunks.has(slot)) {
        uint released = 0;
        foreach (corner; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
            Chunk* chunk = graph.chunks.existing(ChunkSlot(slot, cast(Corner) corner));
            if (chunk.state == ChunkState.populated || chunk.state == ChunkState.dropped) {
                chunk.releaseVoxels();
                *chunk = Chunk.init;
                released += 1;
            }
            if (chunk.state != ChunkState.fresh) {
                held += 1;
            }
        }
        if (released > 0) {
            unloaded.append(Unloaded(slot, graph.chunks.blockOf(slot)));
        }
        if (held == 0) {
            graph.chunks.releaseBlock(slot);
        } else if (released > 0) {
            foreach (corner; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
                if (graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot(slot, cast(Corner) corner)).state == ChunkState.populated) {
                    graph.markChanged(ChunkSlot(slot, cast(Corner) corner));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (held == 0) {
        graph.structures.releaseBuilding(slot);
        graph.horospheres.forget(slot);
    }
    graph.unpin(slot);
}

void evictNode(ref Graph graph, uint slot, ref Array!Unloaded unloaded) {
    unloaded.append(Unloaded(slot, graph.chunks.blockOf(slot)));
    if (graph.chunks.has(slot)) {
        graph.chunks.releaseBlock(slot);
    }
    graph.unpin(slot);
    graph.structures.forget(slot);
    graph.horospheres.forget(slot);
    graph.removeNode(slot);
}

/// file: source/common/graph.d
module common.graph;

import core.bitop : bsf;
import base.array : Array;
import base.flags : Readiness;
import base.hashmap : FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER, HashMap;
import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;
import base.murmur : Hash128, murmurHash3;
import base.parallel : Executor;
import base.slab : FreeIndices, Slab;
import common.chunks : ChunkStore;
import common.edits : EditStore;
import common.neighbors : needsMesh;
import common.node : ChunkLayout, ChunkSlot;
import common.position : Position;
import common.view : GraphView, ThreadViews;
import common.worldgen.blueprint : Blueprint;
import common.worldgen.building : Building, BuildingPlan;
import common.worldgen.generation : NodeState, Worldgen;
import common.worldgen.horospheres : Fill, Horospheres;
import common.worldgen.store : NodeMark, StructureStore, unpin;
import common.worldgen.structure : PAINT_REACH, ensureAnchorSlot, finalizeStructure;
import geometry.honeycomb : BEYOND_TOLERANCE, FACE_COUNT, Face, adjacentFaces, faceBit, mirror, normal;
import geometry.lorentz : Point;

enum size_t NODE_ID_BYTES = 16;

struct NodeId {
    Hash128 value;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return cast(size_t)(value.first + value.second * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER);
    }

    ulong spice() const {
        return value.first ^ value.second;
    }
}

enum NodeId ROOT_NODE = NodeId(Hash128(1, 1));
enum uint MAX_PARENTS = 3;
enum ushort ALL_FACES = (1u << FACE_COUNT) - 1;
enum uint DISCARDS_PER_FRAME = 256;

enum NodeContent : ubyte {
    unknown,
    empty,
    holding,
}

enum SlotUse : ubyte {
    free,
    live,
}

struct Node {
    NodeId id;
    MaybeIndex!uint[FACE_COUNT] neighbors;
    uint depth;
    ushort parentFaces;
    ushort liveChildren;
    ushort references;
    NodeContent content;
    Readiness state;
    SlotUse use;

    bool hasState() const {
        return state == Readiness.ready;
    }
}

struct ParentEntry {
    uint slot;
    Face side;
}

struct ParentList {
    ParentEntry[MAX_PARENTS] links;
    uint count;
}

struct Finishing {
    uint slot;
    uint parent;
}

ushort childParentFaces(ushort parentFaces, Face face) {
    return cast(ushort)((parentFaces & adjacentFaces(face)) | faceBit(face));
}

NodeId childId(NodeId firstParent, Face face) {
    ubyte[NODE_ID_BYTES + 1] hashInput;
    hashInput[0 .. NODE_ID_BYTES] = (cast(const(ubyte)*) &firstParent.value)[0 .. NODE_ID_BYTES];
    hashInput[NODE_ID_BYTES] = face;
    return NodeId(murmurHash3(hashInput[]));
}

Maybe!Face farthestFaceBeyond(Point!float point, ushort allowed) {
    Maybe!Face farthest;
    float most = BEYOND_TOLERANCE * point.v.c[3];
    foreach (index; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        float beyond = normal(cast(Face) index).minkowski(point.v);
        if ((allowed & (1u << index)) != 0 && beyond > most) {
            most = beyond;
            farthest = Maybe!Face.of(cast(Face) index);
        }
    }
    return farthest;
}

struct Graph {
    Slab!Node nodes;
    Slab!NodeState states;
    HashMap!(NodeId, uint) slots;
    FreeIndices freeSlots;
    ChunkStore chunks;
    EditStore edits;
    StructureStore structures;
    Horospheres horospheres;
    GraphView ownView;
    ThreadViews threadViews;
    Worldgen worldgen;
    ChunkLayout layout;
    uint slotCount;
    uint liveCount;
    uint madeNodes;
    uint anchorSlot;

    static Graph make(ubyte dimension, Worldgen chosen) {
        Graph graph;
        graph.bindView();
        graph.layout = ChunkLayout.make(dimension);
        graph.worldgen = chosen;
        graph.horospheres.rootFill = Fill.terrain;
        if (chosen.hasPlaneGround()) {
            graph.horospheres.rootFill = Fill.flat;
        }
        graph.structures.blueprint = Blueprint.make(dimension);
        uint root = graph.addNode(ROOT_NODE, 0, 0);
        graph.anchorSlot = root;
        if (chosen.hasStructure()) {
            graph.anchorSlot = graph.ensureAnchorSlot();
        }
        graph.reference(root);
        graph.reference(graph.anchorSlot);
        return graph;
    }

    void bindView() {
        ownView.graph = &this;
        ownView.owner = &this;
    }

    ref GraphView view() return {
        assert(ownView.owner is &this);
        return ownView;
    }

    inout(Node)* nodeAt(uint slot) inout {
        return nodes.at(slot);
    }

    bool isLive(uint slot) const {
        return nodeAt(slot).use == SlotUse.live;
    }

    MaybeIndex!uint slotOf(NodeId id) const {
        const(uint)* found = slots.find(id);
        if (found is null) {
            return MaybeIndex!uint.init;
        } else {
            return MaybeIndex!uint.of(*found);
        }
    }

    NodeId idAt(uint slot) const {
        return nodeAt(slot).id;
    }

    uint depthOf(uint slot) const {
        return nodeAt(slot).depth;
    }

    MaybeIndex!uint neighborSlot(uint slot, Face face) const {
        return nodeAt(slot).neighbors[face];
    }

    Maybe!NodeId neighbor(NodeId node, Face face) const {
        MaybeIndex!uint found = neighborSlot(slotOf(node).value, face);
        if (found.exists) {
            return Maybe!NodeId.of(idAt(found.value));
        } else {
            return Maybe!NodeId.init;
        }
    }

    bool isParentFace(uint slot, Face face) const {
        return (nodeAt(slot).parentFaces & faceBit(face)) != 0;
    }

    ParentList parents(uint slot) const {
        ParentList list;
        const(Node)* node = nodeAt(slot);
        uint remaining = node.parentFaces;
        while (remaining != 0) {
            uint face = bsf(remaining);
            remaining &= remaining - 1;
            list.links[list.count] = ParentEntry(node.neighbors[face].value, cast(Face) face);
            list.count += 1;
        }
        return list;
    }

    uint addNode(NodeId id, uint depth, ushort parentFaces) {
        uint slot = slotCount;
        if (!freeSlots.isEmpty()) {
            slot = freeSlots.takeLowest();
        } else {
            slotCount += 1;
            nodes.ensure(slotCount);
            states.ensure(slotCount);
            chunks.ensureSlots(slotCount);
            structures.ensureSlots(slotCount);
            horospheres.ensureSlots(slotCount);
        }
        Node* added = nodeAt(slot);
        *added = Node.init;
        added.id = id;
        added.depth = depth;
        added.parentFaces = parentFaces;
        added.use = SlotUse.live;
        liveCount += 1;
        madeNodes += 1;
        slots.insert(id, slot);
        return slot;
    }

    void removeNode(uint slot) {
        ParentList list = parents(slot);
        foreach (link; list.links[0 .. list.count]) {
            Node* parent = nodeAt(link.slot);
            parent.neighbors[link.side] = MaybeIndex!uint.init;
            parent.liveChildren -= 1;
        }
        slots.remove(idAt(slot));
        *nodeAt(slot) = Node.init;
        freeSlots.add(slot);
        nodes.note(slot, 1);
        states.note(slot, 1);
        chunks.blocks.note(slot, 1);
        structures.nodes.note(slot, 1);
        horospheres.nodes.note(slot, 1);
        horospheres.rises.note(slot, 1);
        liveCount -= 1;
    }

    void discardFreed() {
        uint calls = DISCARDS_PER_FRAME;
        chunks.discardFreed(calls);
        nodes.discardNoted(freeSlots, slotCount, 1, calls);
        states.discardNoted(freeSlots, slotCount, 1, calls);
        chunks.blocks.discardNoted(freeSlots, slotCount, 1, calls);
        structures.nodes.discardNoted(freeSlots, slotCount, 1, calls);
        horospheres.nodes.discardNoted(freeSlots, slotCount, 1, calls);
        horospheres.rises.discardNoted(freeSlots, slotCount, 1, calls);
    }

    uint ensureNeighborSlot(uint slot, Face face) {
        MaybeIndex!uint existing = neighborSlot(slot, face);
        if (existing.exists) {
            return existing.value;
        } else {
            return addChild(slot, face);
        }
    }

    uint addChild(uint slot, Face face) {
        ushort parentFaces = childParentFaces(nodeAt(slot).parentFaces, face);
        ParentList list;
        uint remaining = parentFaces;
        while (remaining != 0) {
            Face through = cast(Face) bsf(remaining);
            remaining &= remaining - 1;
            uint parent = slot;
            if (through != face) {
                parent = ensureNeighborSlot(neighborSlot(slot, through).value, face);
            }
            list.links[list.count] = ParentEntry(parent, through);
            list.count += 1;
        }
        NodeId id = childId(idAt(list.links[0].slot), list.links[0].side);
        assert(!slotOf(id).exists);
        uint child = addNode(id, depthOf(slot) + 1, parentFaces);
        foreach (link; list.links[0 .. list.count]) {
            nodeAt(link.slot).neighbors[link.side] = MaybeIndex!uint.of(child);
            nodeAt(link.slot).liveChildren += 1;
            nodeAt(child).neighbors[link.side] = MaybeIndex!uint.of(link.slot);
        }
        return child;
    }

    void reference(uint slot) {
        nodeAt(slot).references += 1;
    }

    void unreference(uint slot) {
        nodeAt(slot).references -= 1;
    }

    Position normalized(Position start) const {
        uint slot = slotOf(start.node).value;
        Point!float point = start.local * Point!float.origin();
        Maybe!Face face = farthestFaceBeyond(point, linkedFaces(slot));
        while (face.exists) {
            slot = neighborSlot(slot, face.value).value;
            start.local = mirror(face.value) * start.local;
            point = start.local * Point!float.origin();
            face = farthestFaceBeyond(point, linkedFaces(slot));
        }
        return Position(idAt(slot), start.local);
    }

    ushort linkedFaces(uint slot) const {
        ushort linked = 0;
        foreach (index; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            if (nodeAt(slot).neighbors[index].exists) {
                linked |= faceBit(cast(Face) index);
            }
        }
        return linked;
    }

    Position ensureNormalized(Position start) {
        return view.ensureNormalized(start);
    }

    ref const(NodeState) stateAt(uint slot) const {
        assert(nodeAt(slot).hasState);
        return *states.at(slot);
    }

    const(NodeState)* ensureState(uint slot) {
        if (!nodeAt(slot).hasState) {
            *states.at(slot) = NodeState.fromParents(view, slot);
            nodeAt(slot).state = Readiness.ready;
        }
        return states.at(slot);
    }

    void markChanged(ChunkSlot chunk) {
        if (!chunks.at(chunk).isQueued && this.needsMesh(chunk)) {
            chunks.queue(chunk);
        }
    }

    bool isFinished(uint slot) const {
        return structures.at(slot).isFinished;
    }

    bool ensureStructureAt(uint slot) {
        if (!isFinished(slot)) {
            Array!Finishing stack;
            stack.append(Finishing(slot, 0));
            while (stack.length > 0) {
                Finishing* top = &stack.ptr[stack.length - 1];
                ParentList list = parents(top.slot);
                if (top.parent < list.count) {
                    uint parent = list.links[top.parent].slot;
                    top.parent += 1;
                    if (!isFinished(parent)) {
                        stack.append(Finishing(parent, 0));
                    }
                } else {
                    uint done = top.slot;
                    stack.length -= 1;
                    finishStructure(done);
                }
            }
            stack.release();
        }
        return structures.at(slot).needsBuilding();
    }

    void finishStructure(uint slot) {
        growBefore(depthOf(slot));
        if (structures.grower.cover !is null && !structures.at(slot).isCovered) {
            structures.grower.cover(structures.grower.context, this, slot);
        }
        this.finalizeStructure(slot);
        structures.at(slot).marks.set(NodeMark.finished);
    }

    void paintAhead(const(uint)[] candidates, Executor executor) {
        if (structures.grower.paintAhead !is null && candidates.length > 0) {
            structures.grower.paintAhead(structures.grower.context, this, candidates, executor);
        }
    }

    void growBefore(uint depth) {
        uint through = depth + PAINT_REACH;
        if (structures.grower.grow !is null && through >= structures.grownBelow) {
            structures.grownBelow = through + 1;
            structures.grower.grow(structures.grower.context, this, cast(int) through);
        }
    }

    void restoreBrushes(uint slot) {
        if (structures.grower.cover !is null) {
            structures.grower.cover(structures.grower.context, this, slot);
        }
    }

    const(Building)* ensureBuildingAt(uint slot) {
        if (structures.buildingAt(slot) is null) {
            ensureStructureAt(slot);
            BuildingPlan plan = planBuilding(slot);
            structures.storeBuilding(slot, Building.make(plan));
            plan.release();
        }
        return structures.buildingAt(slot);
    }

    BuildingPlan planBuilding(uint slot) {
        restoreBrushes(slot);
        BuildingPlan plan = BuildingPlan.make(this, slot);
        this.unpin(slot);
        return plan;
    }

    void release() {
        structures.release();
        chunks.release();
        edits.release();
        horospheres.release();
        nodes.release();
        states.release();
        slots.release();
        freeSlots.release();
        ownView.release();
        threadViews.release();
        slotCount = 0;
        liveCount = 0;
    }
}

/// file: source/common/inventory.d
module common.inventory;

import common.material : MATERIAL_COUNT;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum uint HOTBAR_SLOTS = 9;
enum uint STARTER_COUNT = 999;

immutable Material[HOTBAR_SLOTS] STARTER_HOTBAR = [
    Material.woodPlanks,
    Material.oakWood,
    Material.oakLeaves,
    Material.greyBrick,
    Material.whiteBrick,
    Material.sandstone,
    Material.bench,
    Material.collector,
    Material.beacon,
];

struct Inventory {
    uint[MATERIAL_COUNT] counts;
    Material[HOTBAR_SLOTS] hotbar;
    uint selected;

    static Inventory starter() {
        Inventory inventory;
        inventory.hotbar = STARTER_HOTBAR;
        foreach (material; STARTER_HOTBAR) {
            inventory.counts[material] = STARTER_COUNT;
        }
        return inventory;
    }

    Material held() const {
        return hotbar[selected];
    }

    bool select(uint slot) {
        bool changed = slot < HOTBAR_SLOTS && slot != selected;
        if (changed) {
            selected = slot;
        }
        return changed;
    }

    void gain(Material material) {
        counts[material] += 1;
        uint slot = 0;
        while (slot < HOTBAR_SLOTS && hotbar[slot] != material) {
            slot += 1;
        }
        if (slot == HOTBAR_SLOTS) {
            uint empty = 0;
            while (empty < HOTBAR_SLOTS && counts[hotbar[empty]] > 0 && hotbar[empty] != Material.none) {
                empty += 1;
            }
            if (empty < HOTBAR_SLOTS) {
                hotbar[empty] = material;
            }
        }
    }

    bool spend(Material material) {
        if (material != Material.none && counts[material] > 0) {
            counts[material] -= 1;
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/common/material.d
module common.material;

import base.maybe : Maybe;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum uint MATERIAL_COUNT = Material.max + 1;
enum uint BITS_PER_WORD = 32;
enum uint MATERIAL_WORDS = (MATERIAL_COUNT + BITS_PER_WORD - 1) / BITS_PER_WORD;

struct ByteColor {
    ubyte red;
    ubyte green;
    ubyte blue;
}

enum HiddenFamily : ubyte {
    mist,
    ember,
    tide,
}

enum uint HIDDEN_FAMILY_COUNT = HiddenFamily.max + 1;

struct MaterialSet {
    uint[MATERIAL_WORDS] words;
}

bool has(MaterialSet set, Material material) {
    return (set.words[material / BITS_PER_WORD] & (1u << (material % BITS_PER_WORD))) != 0;
}

MaterialSet including(MaterialSet set, Material material) {
    MaterialSet made = set;
    made.words[material / BITS_PER_WORD] |= 1u << (material % BITS_PER_WORD);
    return made;
}

MaterialSet joined(MaterialSet set, MaterialSet other) {
    MaterialSet made = set;
    foreach (index; 0 .. MATERIAL_WORDS) {
        made.words[index] |= other.words[index];
    }
    return made;
}

MaterialSet within(MaterialSet set, MaterialSet other) {
    MaterialSet made = set;
    foreach (index; 0 .. MATERIAL_WORDS) {
        made.words[index] &= other.words[index];
    }
    return made;
}

bool isEmpty(MaterialSet set) {
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < MATERIAL_WORDS && set.words[index] == 0) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return index == MATERIAL_WORDS;
}

MaterialSet without(MaterialSet set, MaterialSet other) {
    MaterialSet made = set;
    foreach (index; 0 .. MATERIAL_WORDS) {
        made.words[index] &= ~other.words[index];
    }
    return made;
}

Maybe!HiddenFamily hiddenFamilyOf(Material material) {
    if (material == Material.mistStone || material == Material.mistLight) {
        return Maybe!HiddenFamily.of(HiddenFamily.mist);
    } else if (material == Material.emberStone || material == Material.emberLight) {
        return Maybe!HiddenFamily.of(HiddenFamily.ember);
    } else if (material == Material.tideStone || material == Material.tideLight) {
        return Maybe!HiddenFamily.of(HiddenFamily.tide);
    } else {
        return Maybe!HiddenFamily.init;
    }
}

bool isHidden(Material material) {
    return hiddenFamilyOf(material).exists;
}

bool isSameHiddenFamily(Material material, Material beside) {
    Maybe!HiddenFamily own = hiddenFamilyOf(material);
    Maybe!HiddenFamily other = hiddenFamilyOf(beside);
    return own.exists && other.exists && own.value == other.value;
}

bool isSeeThrough(Material material) {
    return material == Material.none || material == Material.glass || isHidden(material);
}

bool isShownAgainst(Material material, Material beside) {
    return material != Material.none && isSeeThrough(beside) && !(material == Material.glass && beside == Material.glass) && !isSameHiddenFamily(material, beside);
}

bool isOccluding(Material material) {
    return material != Material.none && !isHidden(material);
}

bool isGlowing(Material material) {
    return material == Material.lightPanel || material == Material.sunlight || material == Material.lava || material == Material.mistLight || material == Material.emberLight || material == Material.tideLight || material == Material.beacon;
}

MaterialSet materialsWhere(alias test)() {
    MaterialSet set;
    foreach (index; 0 .. MATERIAL_COUNT) {
        if (test(cast(Material) index)) {
            set = set.including(cast(Material) index);
        }
    }
    return set;
}

bool isPlainSolid(Material material) {
    return material != Material.none && !isHidden(material);
}

MaterialSet[HIDDEN_FAMILY_COUNT] familySets() {
    MaterialSet[HIDDEN_FAMILY_COUNT] sets;
    foreach (index; 0 .. MATERIAL_COUNT) {
        Maybe!HiddenFamily found = hiddenFamilyOf(cast(Material) index);
        if (found.exists) {
            sets[found.value] = sets[found.value].including(cast(Material) index);
        }
    }
    return sets;
}

immutable MaterialSet PLAIN_SOLID = materialsWhere!isPlainSolid();
immutable MaterialSet GLOWING = materialsWhere!isGlowing();
immutable MaterialSet HIDDEN = materialsWhere!isHidden();
immutable MaterialSet[HIDDEN_FAMILY_COUNT] FAMILY_SETS = familySets();
