/// file: source/common/neighbors.d
module common.neighbors;

import base.array : Array;
import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.graph : Graph, NodeId;
import common.material : isOccluding, isSeeThrough, isShownAgainst;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkId, ChunkSlot, ChunkState, Occupancy, cellIndex;
import geometry.cube : AXIS_COUNT, Axis, AxisMap, DIRECTIONS, Direction, Sign, beyondBoundary, boundaryOf;
import geometry.honeycomb : Corner, across, axisMaps, faces;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

struct CellHop {
    Maybe!ChunkSlot chunk;
    Vec3!int cell;
    ChunkState state;

    bool isPopulated() const {
        return state == ChunkState.populated;
    }
}

Maybe!ChunkId chunkNeighborId(ref const Graph graph, ChunkId chunk, Direction direction) {
    if (direction.sign == Sign.plus) {
        return Maybe!ChunkId.of(ChunkId(chunk.node, chunk.corner.across[direction.axis]));
    } else {
        Maybe!NodeId neighbor = graph.neighbor(chunk.node, chunk.corner.faces[direction.axis]);
        if (neighbor.exists) {
            return Maybe!ChunkId.of(ChunkId(neighbor.value, chunk.corner));
        } else {
            return Maybe!ChunkId.init;
        }
    }
}

Maybe!ChunkSlot chunkNeighborSlot(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, Direction direction) {
    if (direction.sign == Sign.plus) {
        return Maybe!ChunkSlot.of(ChunkSlot(chunk.slot, chunk.corner.across[direction.axis]));
    } else {
        MaybeIndex!uint neighbor = graph.neighborSlot(chunk.slot, chunk.corner.faces[direction.axis]);
        if (neighbor.exists) {
            return Maybe!ChunkSlot.of(ChunkSlot(neighbor.value, chunk.corner));
        } else {
            return Maybe!ChunkSlot.init;
        }
    }
}

AxisMap neighborAxisMap(Corner corner, Direction direction) {
    if (direction.sign == Sign.plus) {
        return corner.axisMaps[direction.axis];
    } else {
        return AxisMap.init;
    }
}

Vec3!int acrossBorder(ubyte dimension, Corner corner, Vec3!int cell, Direction direction) {
    Vec3!int moved = cell;
    moved[direction.axis] = boundaryOf(dimension, direction.sign);
    return neighborAxisMap(corner, direction).apply(moved);
}

Direction borderCrossed(Vec3!int cell, size_t axis) {
    if (cell[axis] < 0) {
        return Direction(cast(Axis) axis, Sign.minus);
    } else {
        return Direction(cast(Axis) axis, Sign.plus);
    }
}

bool isOutside(ubyte dimension, int coordinate) {
    return coordinate < 0 || coordinate >= dimension;
}

bool isInside(ubyte dimension, Vec3!int cell) {
    return !isOutside(dimension, cell.x) && !isOutside(dimension, cell.y) && !isOutside(dimension, cell.z);
}

size_t indexIn(ubyte dimension, Vec3!int cell) {
    return cellIndex(dimension, cell.x, cell.y, cell.z);
}

CellHop hopCell(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, Vec3!int cell, size_t axis) {
    ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
    Direction direction = borderCrossed(cell, axis);
    Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(chunk, direction);
    if (neighbor.exists) {
        return CellHop(neighbor, acrossBorder(dimension, chunk.corner, cell, direction), graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).state);
    } else {
        return CellHop(neighbor, cell, ChunkState.fresh);
    }
}

Material materialNear(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, Vec3!int cell) {
    ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
    if (isInside(dimension, cell)) {
        return graph.chunks.at(chunk).voxels.at(indexIn(dimension, cell));
    } else {
        uint axis = 0;
        while (!isOutside(dimension, cell[axis])) {
            axis += 1;
        }
        CellHop hop = graph.hopCell(chunk, cell, axis);
        if (hop.isPopulated) {
            return graph.chunks.at(hop.chunk.value).voxels.at(indexIn(dimension, hop.cell));
        } else {
            return Material.none;
        }
    }
}

bool isOccupiedAcross(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, Vec3!int cell, size_t axis) {
    return isOutside(graph.layout.dimension, cell[axis]) && graph.isHopOccupied(graph.hopCell(chunk, cell, axis));
}

bool isCellOccupied(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, Vec3!int cell) {
    ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
    if (isInside(dimension, cell)) {
        return isOccluding(graph.chunks.at(chunk).voxels.at(indexIn(dimension, cell)));
    } else {
        uint axis = 0;
        while (axis < AXIS_COUNT && !graph.isOccupiedAcross(chunk, cell, axis)) {
            axis += 1;
        }
        return axis < AXIS_COUNT;
    }
}

bool isHopOccupied(ref const Graph graph, CellHop hop) {
    if (hop.isPopulated) {
        return graph.isCellOccupied(hop.chunk.value, hop.cell);
    } else {
        return !hop.chunk.exists || isAssumedOccupied(graph.chunks.at(hop.chunk.value).predicted);
    }
}

bool isAssumedOccupied(Occupancy predicted) {
    return predicted != Occupancy.empty;
}

bool isPredictionContradicted(ref const Chunk chunk) {
    if (chunk.voxels.isUniform()) {
        return !chunk.voxels.isFilledWith(Material.none) != isAssumedOccupied(chunk.predicted);
    } else {
        return true;
    }
}

bool needsMesh(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk) {
    const(Chunk)* own = graph.chunks.at(chunk);
    if (own.state != ChunkState.populated || own.voxels.isOpaqueFill()) {
        return false;
    } else if (!own.voxels.isUniform()) {
        return true;
    } else {
        uint direction = 0;
        while (direction < DIRECTIONS.length && !graph.showsAgainst(chunk, DIRECTIONS[direction], own.voxels.fill)) {
            direction += 1;
        }
        return direction < DIRECTIONS.length;
    }
}

bool showsAgainst(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, Direction direction, Material fill) {
    Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(chunk, direction);
    if (!neighbor.exists || graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).state != ChunkState.populated) {
        return false;
    } else if (graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).voxels.isUniform()) {
        return isShownAgainst(graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).voxels.fill, fill);
    } else {
        return true;
    }
}

bool isBorderingVoid(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk) {
    foreach (direction; DIRECTIONS) {
        Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(chunk, direction);
        if (neighbor.exists && graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value).state == ChunkState.populated && graph.showsVoidAcross(chunk, direction, graph.chunks.at(neighbor.value))) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

bool showsVoidAcross(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, Direction direction, const(Chunk)* other) {
    if (other.voxels.isUniform()) {
        return isSeeThrough(other.voxels.fill);
    } else {
        ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
        size_t u = (direction.axis + 1) % AXIS_COUNT;
        size_t v = (direction.axis + 2) % AXIS_COUNT;
        Vec3!int cell;
        cell[direction.axis] = beyondBoundary(dimension, direction.sign);
        foreach (j; 0 .. dimension) {
            foreach (i; 0 .. dimension) {
                cell[u] = i;
                cell[v] = j;
                if (isSeeThrough(other.voxels.at(indexIn(dimension, acrossBorder(dimension, chunk.corner, cell, direction))))) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

void touchHolders(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, Vec3!int cell, ref Array!ChunkSlot holders) {
    ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
    if (isInside(dimension, cell)) {
        holders.append(chunk);
    } else {
        foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
            if (isOutside(dimension, cell[axis])) {
                CellHop hop = graph.hopCell(chunk, cell, axis);
                if (hop.isPopulated) {
                    graph.touchHolders(hop.chunk.value, hop.cell, holders);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void touchChunksReading(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, Vec3!int cell, ref Array!ChunkSlot holders) {
    ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
    Vec3!int outward;
    uint borderAxes = 0;
    foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
        if (cell[axis] == 0) {
            outward[axis] = beyondBoundary(dimension, Sign.minus);
            borderAxes |= 1u << axis;
        } else if (cell[axis] == dimension - 1) {
            outward[axis] = beyondBoundary(dimension, Sign.plus);
            borderAxes |= 1u << axis;
        }
    }
    foreach (subset; 1 .. 2 ^^ AXIS_COUNT) {
        if ((subset & borderAxes) == subset) {
            Vec3!int pushed = cell;
            foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
                if ((subset & (1u << axis)) != 0) {
                    pushed[axis] = outward[axis];
                }
            }
            graph.touchHolders(chunk, pushed, holders);
        }
    }
}

void touchChunksAround(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, ref Array!ChunkSlot holders) {
    int last = graph.layout.dimension - 1;
    foreach (corner; 0 .. 2 ^^ AXIS_COUNT) {
        Vec3!int cell;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
            if ((corner & (1u << axis)) != 0) {
                cell[axis] = last;
            }
        }
        graph.touchChunksReading(chunk, cell, holders);
    }
}

/// file: source/common/node.d
module common.node;

import core.atomic : atomicLoad, cas;
import core.stdc.math : coshf, floorf, logf, powf;
import core.stdc.stdlib : free, malloc;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.graph : NodeId;
import common.material : MATERIAL_COUNT, isSeeThrough;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, Corner, NODE_RADIUS, cubeScale;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum float DENSITY_EXPONENT = -4.0f / 3.0f;
enum uint FLAG_SHIFT = 56;
enum ulong VOXEL_MASK = (1UL << FLAG_SHIFT) - 1;
enum uint STATE_SHIFT = FLAG_SHIFT;
enum uint PREDICTED_SHIFT = FLAG_SHIFT + 2;
enum ulong FIELD_MASK = 3;
enum ulong DEFERRED_BIT = 1UL << (FLAG_SHIFT + 4);
enum ulong QUEUED_BIT = 1UL << (FLAG_SHIFT + 5);
enum ulong EDITED_BIT = 1UL << (FLAG_SHIFT + 6);

struct ChunkId {
    NodeId node;
    Corner corner;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return node.toHash() + corner;
    }
}

struct ChunkSlot {
    uint slot;
    Corner corner;

    static ChunkSlot fromIndex(size_t index) {
        return ChunkSlot(cast(uint)(index / CORNER_COUNT), cast(Corner)(index % CORNER_COUNT));
    }
}

struct ChunkLayout {
    float kleinToCube;
    float cellRatio;
    float cubeSpan;
    ubyte dimension;

    static ChunkLayout make(ubyte dimension) {
        float cellRatio = powf(coshf(NODE_RADIUS), DENSITY_EXPONENT / dimension);
        return ChunkLayout(1 / cubeScale(), cellRatio, 1.0f - powf(cellRatio, dimension), dimension);
    }

    float gridToCube(float grid) const {
        return (1.0f - powf(cellRatio, grid)) / cubeSpan;
    }

    float cubeToGrid(float cube) const {
        float remaining = 1.0f - cube * cubeSpan;
        if (remaining > 0) {
            return logf(remaining) / logf(cellRatio);
        } else {
            return float.infinity;
        }
    }

    float gridToKlein(float grid) const {
        return gridToCube(grid) / kleinToCube;
    }

    float kleinToGrid(float klein) const {
        return cubeToGrid(klein * kleinToCube);
    }

    Vec3!float cellCenter(Vec3!int cell) const {
        return Vec3!float(cellCenterAlong(cell.x), cellCenterAlong(cell.y), cellCenterAlong(cell.z));
    }

    float cellCenterAlong(int cell) const {
        return gridToCube(cell + 0.5f);
    }

    Maybe!int kleinToCell(float klein) const {
        float grid = floorf(kleinToGrid(klein));
        if (grid >= 0.0f && grid < cast(float) dimension) {
            return Maybe!int.of(cast(int) grid);
        } else {
            return Maybe!int.init;
        }
    }
}

size_t cellCount(ubyte dimension) {
    return cast(size_t) dimension * dimension * dimension;
}

size_t cellIndex(ubyte dimension, uint x, uint y, uint z) {
    return x + dimension * (y + cast(size_t) dimension * z);
}

struct Voxels {
    size_t bits;

    static Voxels filled(Material material) {
        return Voxels(material);
    }

    bool isUniform() const {
        return bits < MATERIAL_COUNT;
    }

    bool isFilledWith(Material material) const {
        return bits == material;
    }

    bool isOpaqueFill() const {
        return isUniform() && !isSeeThrough(cast(Material) bits);
    }

    Material fill() const {
        assert(isUniform());
        return cast(Material) bits;
    }

    Material at(size_t index) const {
        if (isUniform()) {
            return cast(Material) bits;
        } else {
            return (cast(const(Material)*) bits)[index];
        }
    }

    const(Material)[] cells(ubyte dimension) const {
        assert(!isUniform());
        return (cast(const(Material)*) bits)[0 .. cellCount(dimension)];
    }

    Material[] toDense(ubyte dimension) {
        size_t count = cellCount(dimension);
        if (isUniform()) {
            Material* memory = cast(Material*) malloc(count);
            memory[0 .. count] = cast(Material) bits;
            bits = cast(size_t) memory;
        }
        return (cast(Material*) bits)[0 .. count];
    }

    void compress(ubyte dimension) {
        if (!isUniform()) {
            const(Material)[] all = cells(dimension);
            size_t index = 1;
            while (index < all.length && all[index] == all[0]) {
                index += 1;
            }
            if (index == all.length) {
                Material first = all[0];
                release();
                bits = first;
            }
        }
    }

    void release() {
        if (!isUniform()) {
            free(cast(void*) bits);
            bits = Material.none;
        }
    }
}

enum ChunkState : ubyte {
    fresh,
    generating,
    populated,
    dropped,
}

enum Occupancy : ubyte {
    unknown,
    full,
    empty,
}

enum Materials : ubyte {
    resolved,
    deferred,
}

struct Chunk {
    ulong word;

    const(Voxels) voxels() const {
        return Voxels(cast(size_t)(word & VOXEL_MASK));
    }

    void voxels(Voxels value) {
        assert((value.bits & ~VOXEL_MASK) == 0);
        word = (word & ~VOXEL_MASK) | value.bits;
    }

    void releaseVoxels() {
        Voxels held = voxels;
        held.release();
        voxels = held;
    }

    Material[] denseVoxels(ubyte dimension) {
        Voxels held = voxels;
        Material[] cells = held.toDense(dimension);
        voxels = held;
        return cells;
    }

    ChunkState state() const {
        return cast(ChunkState)((word >> STATE_SHIFT) & FIELD_MASK);
    }

    void state(ChunkState value) {
        word = (word & ~(FIELD_MASK << STATE_SHIFT)) | (cast(ulong) value << STATE_SHIFT);
    }

    ChunkState loadState() const {
        return cast(ChunkState)((atomicLoad(*cast(const(shared(ulong))*) &word) >> STATE_SHIFT) & FIELD_MASK);
    }

    bool casState(ChunkState expected, ChunkState wanted) {
        ulong seen = atomicLoad(*cast(shared(ulong)*) &word);
        while (((seen >> STATE_SHIFT) & FIELD_MASK) == expected) {
            ulong changed = (seen & ~(FIELD_MASK << STATE_SHIFT)) | (cast(ulong) wanted << STATE_SHIFT);
            bool won = cas(cast(shared(ulong)*) &word, seen, changed);
            if (won) {
                return true;
            }
            seen = atomicLoad(*cast(shared(ulong)*) &word);
        }
        return false;
    }

    Occupancy predicted() const {
        return cast(Occupancy)((word >> PREDICTED_SHIFT) & FIELD_MASK);
    }

    void predicted(Occupancy value) {
        word = (word & ~(FIELD_MASK << PREDICTED_SHIFT)) | (cast(ulong) value << PREDICTED_SHIFT);
    }

    bool hasDeferredMaterials() const {
        return (word & DEFERRED_BIT) != 0;
    }

    void materials(Materials value) {
        if (value == Materials.deferred) {
            word |= DEFERRED_BIT;
        } else {
            word &= ~DEFERRED_BIT;
        }
    }

    bool isQueued() const {
        return (word & QUEUED_BIT) != 0;
    }

    void markQueued() {
        word |= QUEUED_BIT;
    }

    void unmarkQueued() {
        word &= ~QUEUED_BIT;
    }

    bool claimQueued() {
        ulong seen = atomicLoad(*cast(shared(ulong)*) &word);
        while ((seen & QUEUED_BIT) == 0) {
            bool won = cas(cast(shared(ulong)*) &word, seen, seen | QUEUED_BIT);
            if (won) {
                return true;
            }
            seen = atomicLoad(*cast(shared(ulong)*) &word);
        }
        return false;
    }

    bool isEdited() const {
        return (word & EDITED_BIT) != 0;
    }

    void markEdited() {
        word |= EDITED_BIT;
    }
}

static assert(Chunk.sizeof == 8);

/// file: source/common/perception.d
module common.perception;

import core.stdc.math : expf;
import base.numbers : clamped, higherOf, lowerOf;
import base.units : Angle, Length, Ratio, Time;
import common.color : ColorTurn, TURN_PLANES;
import common.material : FAMILY_SETS, HIDDEN_FAMILY_COUNT, MaterialSet, PLAIN_SOLID, joined, within, without;
import common.settings : CharacterConfig;

enum Length EYE_BACK_PER_LEVEL = Length(1.0f);
enum float MOST_WARP_STRENGTH = 0.15f;
enum Time MOST_AFTERIMAGE_TIME = Time(0.2f);
enum float MOST_BAND_GAIN = 4;
enum uint BAND_COUNT = 4;
enum uint FINE_BANDS = 2;
enum float REVEAL_ON_LEVEL = 0.6f;
enum float REVEAL_OFF_LEVEL = 0.4f;

enum Channel : ubyte {
    walkSpeed,
    gravity,
    jumpHeight,
    fieldOfView,
    fog,
    eyeOffset,
    warp,
    colorTurn0,
    colorTurn1,
    colorTurn2,
    colorTurn3,
    colorTurn4,
    colorTurn5,
    revealMist,
    revealEmber,
    revealTide,
    afterimage,
    fineDetail,
    coarseDetail,
}

static assert(Channel.revealTide - Channel.revealMist + 1 == HIDDEN_FAMILY_COUNT);

static assert(Channel.colorTurn5 - Channel.colorTurn0 + 1 == TURN_PLANES);

enum uint CHANNEL_COUNT = Channel.max + 1;

struct Perception {
    Ratio[CHANNEL_COUNT] level;
}

struct ViewEffects {
    Ratio fieldTangentScale = Ratio(1);
    Ratio fogShare = Ratio(1);
    Length eyeBack;
    Ratio warpStrength;
    Time warpSeconds;
    Time afterimageTime;
    Ratio[BAND_COUNT] bandGains = Ratio(1);
    ColorTurn colorTurn;
    MaterialSet visible = PLAIN_SOLID;
}

struct Reveal {
    MaterialSet revealed;
    MaterialSet touchable;

    void update(ref const Perception perception) {
        foreach (index; 0 .. HIDDEN_FAMILY_COUNT) {
            float level = perception.level[Channel.revealMist + index].value;
            if (level > REVEAL_ON_LEVEL) {
                revealed = revealed.joined(FAMILY_SETS[index]);
            } else if (level < REVEAL_OFF_LEVEL) {
                revealed = revealed.without(FAMILY_SETS[index]);
            }
        }
        touchable = touchable.within(revealed);
    }
}

struct SignalDrive {
    uint signal;
    Channel channel;
    float gain;
}

immutable string[3] SIGNAL_NAMES = ["mist", "sway", "lift"];

immutable SignalDrive[7] SIGNAL_DRIVES = [
    SignalDrive(0, Channel.revealMist, 2.0f),
    SignalDrive(0, Channel.colorTurn0, 1.2f),
    SignalDrive(1, Channel.warp, 0.15f),
    SignalDrive(1, Channel.fieldOfView, 0.6f),
    SignalDrive(1, Channel.afterimage, 1.0f),
    SignalDrive(2, Channel.gravity, -0.8f),
    SignalDrive(2, Channel.jumpHeight, 0.8f),
];

Perception felt(Perception base, const(Ratio)[] signals) {
    Perception made = base;
    foreach (drive; SIGNAL_DRIVES) {
        made.level[drive.channel] = made.level[drive.channel] + signals[drive.signal] * drive.gain;
    }
    return made;
}

Perception leveled(Perception perception, Channel channel, Ratio level) {
    Perception made = perception;
    made.level[channel] = level;
    return made;
}

Ratio scaleOf(ref const Perception perception, Channel channel) {
    return Ratio(expf(perception.level[channel].value));
}

CharacterConfig effectiveFor(ref const CharacterConfig base, ref const Perception perception) {
    CharacterConfig effective = base;
    effective.walkSpeed = base.walkSpeed * perception.scaleOf(Channel.walkSpeed);
    effective.gravity = base.gravity * perception.scaleOf(Channel.gravity);
    effective.jumpHeight = base.jumpHeight * perception.scaleOf(Channel.jumpHeight);
    return effective;
}

ViewEffects viewOf(ref const Perception perception, Time time, MaterialSet revealed, Ratio comfort) {
    return ViewEffects(
        perception.scaleOf(Channel.fieldOfView),
        Ratio(lowerOf(1.0f, 1.0f / perception.scaleOf(Channel.fog).value)),
        EYE_BACK_PER_LEVEL * higherOf(perception.level[Channel.eyeOffset].value, 0.0f),
        Ratio(clamped(perception.level[Channel.warp].value, 0.0f, MOST_WARP_STRENGTH * comfort.value)),
        time,
        MOST_AFTERIMAGE_TIME * (clamped(perception.level[Channel.afterimage].value, 0.0f, 1.0f) * comfort.value),
        perception.bandGainsOf(),
        perception.colorTurnOf(),
        PLAIN_SOLID.joined(revealed),
    );
}

Ratio[BAND_COUNT] bandGainsOf(ref const Perception perception) {
    Ratio[BAND_COUNT] gains;
    foreach (band; 0 .. BAND_COUNT) {
        Channel channel = Channel.coarseDetail;
        if (band < FINE_BANDS) {
            channel = Channel.fineDetail;
        }
        gains[band] = Ratio(lowerOf(perception.scaleOf(channel).value, MOST_BAND_GAIN));
    }
    return gains;
}

ColorTurn colorTurnOf(ref const Perception perception) {
    ColorTurn turn;
    foreach (index; 0 .. TURN_PLANES) {
        turn.angles[index] = Angle(perception.level[Channel.colorTurn0 + index].value);
    }
    return turn;
}

/// file: source/common/raycast/chunk.d
module common.raycast.chunk;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : lowerOf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.material : MaterialSet, has;
import common.node : ChunkLayout, Voxels, cellIndex;
import geometry.cube : AXIS_COUNT, Axis, Cell, Sign;
import geometry.ray : Ray;

enum float PARALLEL_TOLERANCE = 1e-6f;

struct ChunkRayCastHit {
    float tanhDistance;
    Cell voxelCoords;
    Axis faceAxis;
    Sign faceSign;
}

Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit castThroughChunk(const Voxels voxels, ChunkLayout layout, Ray ray, float limit, MaterialSet hits) {
    if (voxels.isUniform() && !hits.has(voxels.fill)) {
        return Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit.init;
    } else {
        GridWalk walk = GridWalk(ray, layout, hits);
        return walk.run(voxels, limit);
    }
}

struct GridWalk {
    float[4] start;
    float[4] heading;
    ChunkLayout layout;
    Vec3!int steps;
    MaterialSet hits;

    this(Ray ray, ChunkLayout chosen, MaterialSet hitting) {
        start = ray.start.v.c;
        heading = ray.heading.v.c;
        layout = chosen;
        hits = hitting;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
            float along = heading[axis] * start[3];
            float drift = start[axis] * heading[3];
            float rate = along - drift;
            if (fabsf(rate) <= PARALLEL_TOLERANCE * (fabsf(along) + fabsf(drift))) {
                steps[axis] = 0;
            } else if (rate > 0) {
                steps[axis] = 1;
            } else {
                steps[axis] = -1;
            }
        }
    }

    Maybe!float crossing(size_t axis, float wall) const {
        float t = (wall * start[3] - start[axis]) / (heading[axis] - wall * heading[3]);
        if (t >= 0 && t < 1) {
            return Maybe!float.of(t);
        } else {
            return Maybe!float.init;
        }
    }

    Maybe!float wallCrossing(size_t axis, int wall) const {
        return crossing(axis, layout.gridToKlein(wall));
    }

    Maybe!float nextWall(size_t axis, int cell, float now) const {
        if (steps[axis] == 0) {
            return Maybe!float.init;
        } else {
            int wall = cell;
            if (steps[axis] > 0) {
                wall += 1;
            }
            Maybe!float t = wallCrossing(axis, wall);
            if (t.exists && t.value >= now) {
                return t;
            } else {
                return Maybe!float.init;
            }
        }
    }

    int cellAlong(size_t axis, float t) const {
        float klein = (start[axis] + t * heading[axis]) / (start[3] + t * heading[3]);
        float grid = layout.kleinToGrid(klein);
        if (grid < 0) {
            return 0;
        } else {
            return lowerOf(cast(int) grid, layout.dimension - 1);
        }
    }

    Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit run(ref const Voxels voxels, float limit) const {
        int dimension = layout.dimension;
        float entry = 0;
        float exit = limit;
        Maybe!uint entryAxis;
        float size = layout.gridToKlein(dimension);
        foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
            float klein = start[axis] / start[3];
            float past = -klein;
            float ahead = klein - size;
            int nearWall = dimension;
            int farWall = 0;
            if (steps[axis] > 0) {
                past = klein - size;
                ahead = -klein;
                nearWall = 0;
                farWall = dimension;
            }
            if (steps[axis] == 0) {
                if (klein < 0 || klein > size) {
                    return Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit.init;
                }
            } else if (past > 0) {
                return Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit.init;
            } else {
                if (ahead > 0) {
                    Maybe!float near = wallCrossing(axis, nearWall);
                    if (!near.exists) {
                        return Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit.init;
                    } else if (near.value > entry) {
                        entry = near.value;
                        entryAxis = Maybe!uint.of(axis);
                    }
                }
                Maybe!float far = wallCrossing(axis, farWall);
                if (far.exists) {
                    exit = lowerOf(far.value, exit);
                }
            }
        }
        if (!(entry < exit)) {
            return Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit.init;
        } else {
            Vec3!int cell;
            foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
                cell[axis] = cellAlong(axis, entry);
            }
            if (entryAxis.exists) {
                if (steps[entryAxis.value] > 0) {
                    cell[entryAxis.value] = 0;
                } else {
                    cell[entryAxis.value] = dimension - 1;
                }
                if (isFilled(voxels, cell)) {
                    return hitAt(entry, cell, entryAxis.value);
                }
            }
            return walkFrom(voxels, cell, entry, exit);
        }
    }

    Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit walkFrom(ref const Voxels voxels, Vec3!int first, float entry, float exit) const {
        Vec3!int cell = first;
        Vec3!(Maybe!float) next;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
            next[axis] = nextWall(axis, cell[axis], entry);
        }
        while (true) {
            Maybe!uint nearest = nearestOf(next);
            if (!nearest.exists) {
                return Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit.init;
            }
            uint axis = nearest.value;
            float t = next[axis].value;
            cell[axis] += steps[axis];
            if (!(t < exit) || cell[axis] < 0 || cell[axis] >= layout.dimension) {
                return Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit.init;
            } else if (isFilled(voxels, cell)) {
                return hitAt(t, cell, axis);
            } else {
                next[axis] = nextWall(axis, cell[axis], t);
            }
        }
    }

    bool isFilled(ref const Voxels voxels, Vec3!int cell) const {
        return hits.has(voxels.at(cellIndex(layout.dimension, cell.x, cell.y, cell.z)));
    }

    Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit hitAt(float t, Vec3!int cell, size_t axis) const {
        Cell coords = cell.as!ubyte();
        Sign face = Sign.plus;
        if (steps[axis] > 0) {
            face = Sign.minus;
        }
        return Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit.of(ChunkRayCastHit(t, coords, cast(Axis) axis, face));
    }
}

Maybe!uint nearestOf(Vec3!(Maybe!float) crossings) {
    Maybe!uint nearest;
    foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
        if (crossings[axis].exists && (!nearest.exists || crossings[axis].value < crossings[nearest.value].value)) {
            nearest = Maybe!uint.of(axis);
        }
    }
    return nearest;
}

/// file: source/common/raycast/graph.d
module common.raycast.graph;

import core.stdc.math : atanhf, coshf;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : lowerOf;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.material : MaterialSet;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkId, ChunkSlot, ChunkState;
import common.position : Position;
import common.raycast.chunk : ChunkRayCastHit, castThroughChunk;
import common.traversal : NodeVisit, VisitQueue;
import geometry.cube : Axis, Cell, Sign;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, CUBE_RADIUS, Corner, NODE_RADIUS, cubeCenter, nodeToCorner;
import geometry.ray : MAX_TANH_DISTANCE, Ray;

enum uint RAY_CAST_MAX_NODES = 512;

struct GraphCastHit {
    ChunkId chunk;
    float tanhDistance;
    Cell voxelCoords;
    Axis faceAxis;
    Sign faceSign;
}

Maybe!GraphCastHit rayCast(ref const Graph graph, Position position, Ray ray, float tanhDistance, MaterialSet hits) {
    Maybe!GraphCastHit hit;
    Ray nodeRay = ray.movedBy(position.local);
    float reach = atanhf(lowerOf(tanhDistance, MAX_TANH_DISTANCE));
    float nodeThreshold = coshf(reach + NODE_RADIUS + CUBE_RADIUS);
    float chunkThreshold = coshf(reach + CUBE_RADIUS);
    VisitQueue!RAY_CAST_MAX_NODES queue = VisitQueue!RAY_CAST_MAX_NODES.fromSlot(graph.slotOf(position.node).value);
    float best = tanhDistance;
    while (queue.hasNext()) {
        NodeVisit visit = queue.current();
        Ray localRay = nodeRay.movedBy(visit.inverse);
        foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
            Corner corner = cast(Corner) index;
            const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot(visit.slot, corner));
            if (chunk.state == ChunkState.populated && !(localRay.start.coshDistance(corner.cubeCenter) > chunkThreshold)) {
                Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit chunkHit = castThroughChunk(chunk.voxels, graph.layout, localRay.movedBy(corner.nodeToCorner), best, hits);
                if (chunkHit.exists) {
                    ChunkRayCastHit found = chunkHit.value;
                    best = found.tanhDistance;
                    hit = Maybe!GraphCastHit.of(GraphCastHit(ChunkId(graph.idAt(visit.slot), corner), found.tanhDistance, found.voxelCoords, found.faceAxis, found.faceSign));
                }
            }
        }
        queue.expand(graph, visit, nodeRay.start.v, nodeThreshold);
    }
    return hit;
}

/// file: source/common/settings.d
module common.settings;

import core.stdc.math : sqrtf;
import base.units : Acceleration, AngularSpeed, Blocks, Length, Rate, Ratio, Speed;
import common.material : MaterialSet, PLAIN_SOLID;

enum ubyte CHUNK_DIMENSION = 12;

struct CharacterConfig {
    MaterialSet solid = PLAIN_SOLID;
    Speed noclipSpeed = Speed(0.6f);
    Speed flySpeed = Speed(0.4f);
    Speed walkSpeed = Speed(0.225f);
    Rate walkResponse = Rate(12.1f);
    Acceleration steering = Acceleration(0.4f);
    Acceleration gravity = Acceleration(1.6f);
    AngularSpeed upTurnRate = AngularSpeed(4.0f);
    Ratio leastTurningGravity = Ratio(0.1f);
    Length jumpHeight = Length(0.085f);
    Blocks stepHeight = Blocks(1);
    Ratio footFriction = Ratio(1.75f);
    Length skin = Length(0.0005f);
    Length radius = Length(0.0125f);
    Length height = Length(0.09f);
    Length eyeHeight = Length(0.075f);

    Speed jumpSpeed() const {
        return Speed(sqrtf((gravity * jumpHeight * 2.0f).value));
    }

    float minSupportCosine() const {
        return 1.0f / sqrtf(1.0f + (footFriction * footFriction).value);
    }

    Length halfHeight() const {
        return height / 2.0f;
    }

    Length eyeOffset() const {
        return eyeHeight - halfHeight;
    }
}

/// file: source/common/traversal.d
module common.traversal;

import core.atomic : atomicExchange;
import core.stdc.math : acoshf, coshf, fabs;
import base.array : Array;
import base.clock : Deadline, nowMilliseconds;
import base.flags : Bits;
import base.maybe : MaybeIndex;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;
import base.parallel : Executor, ParallelJob;
import common.graph : Graph, NodeContent;
import common.position : Position;
import common.worldgen.horospheres : probeMayHoldContent;
import geometry.honeycomb : FACE_COUNT, FACE_DISTANCE, Face, NODE_RADIUS, mirror;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Point, Vec4;

enum size_t EXPAND_BATCH = 256;
version (WebAssembly) {
    enum size_t PAINT_BATCH = 16;
} else {
    enum size_t PAINT_BATCH = 256;
}
enum size_t DERIVE_BATCH = 64;
enum double SHELL_FLOOR = 0.01;
enum double SHELL_ROUNDING = 64 * float.epsilon;
enum size_t KEEP_BLOCK = 4096;

enum KeepKind : ubyte {
    dropped,
    kept,
    frontier,
}

struct NodeVisit {
    uint slot;
    Motion!float inverse;
}

bool isListed(T)(const(T)[] list, T value) {
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < list.length && list[index] != value) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return index < list.length;
}

bool isVisited(const(NodeVisit)[] visits, uint slot) {
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < visits.length && visits[index].slot != slot) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return index < visits.length;
}

struct VisitQueue(uint capacity) {
    NodeVisit[capacity] visits = void;
    uint count;
    uint front;

    static VisitQueue fromSlot(uint slot) {
        VisitQueue queue;
        queue.visits[0] = NodeVisit(slot, Motion!float.identity());
        queue.count = 1;
        return queue;
    }

    bool hasNext() const {
        return front < count;
    }

    NodeVisit current() const {
        return visits[front];
    }

    bool isVisited(uint slot) const {
        return visits[0 .. count].isVisited(slot);
    }

    bool isUnvisitedWithin(ref const Graph graph, NodeVisit visit, Face side, Vec4!float point, float nodeThreshold) const {
        MaybeIndex!uint neighbor = graph.neighborSlot(visit.slot, side);
        return neighbor.exists && !isVisited(neighbor.value) && !((side.mirror * visit.inverse * point).c[3] > nodeThreshold);
    }

    void expand(ref const Graph graph, NodeVisit visit, Vec4!float point, float nodeThreshold) {
        foreach (sideIndex; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            Face side = cast(Face) sideIndex;
            if (count < capacity && isUnvisitedWithin(graph, visit, side, point, nodeThreshold)) {
                visits[count] = NodeVisit(graph.neighborSlot(visit.slot, side).value, side.mirror * visit.inverse);
                count += 1;
            }
        }
        front += 1;
    }
}

struct NearbyNode {
    Motion!float transform;
    uint slot;
}

struct MissingSide {
    uint index;
    Face side;
}

struct ExpandOutput {
    Array!NearbyNode found;
    Array!uint unknown;
    Array!MissingSide missing;

    void clear() {
        found.clear();
        unknown.clear();
        missing.clear();
    }

    void release() {
        found.release();
        unknown.release();
        missing.release();
    }
}

struct ExpandJob {
    NearbyScratch* scratch;
    const(Graph)* graph;
    size_t front;
    size_t end;
}

void expandBatch(void* context, size_t index, uint worker) {
    ExpandJob* job = cast(ExpandJob*) context;
    NearbyScratch* scratch = job.scratch;
    ExpandOutput* output = &scratch.outputs.ptr[worker];
    size_t first = job.front + index * EXPAND_BATCH;
    size_t last = lowerOf(first + EXPAND_BATCH, job.end);
    foreach (position; first .. last) {
        NearbyNode current = scratch.nodes.ptr[position];
        NodeContent content = job.graph.nodeAt(current.slot).content;
        if (scratch.isInner(current) || content == NodeContent.holding) {
            scratch.expandKnown(*job.graph, current, cast(uint) position, *output);
        } else if (content == NodeContent.unknown && scratch.hasOpenSide(*job.graph, current)) {
            output.unknown.append(cast(uint) position);
        }
    }
}

struct BlockCounts {
    uint kept;
    uint frontier;
}

enum KeepPass : ubyte {
    none,
    sorting,
    copying,
}

enum Drain : ubyte {
    flowing,
    stalled,
}

struct KeepJob {
    const(NearbyNode)* from;
    size_t count;
    size_t base;
    NearbyScratch* scratch;
    BlockCounts* blocks;
    Point!float camera;
    Point!float previous;
    float coshReach;
    float coshPreviousReach;
    float coshFrontier;
    float coshInner;
    uint keptTotal;

    size_t end(size_t block) const {
        return lowerOf((block + 1) * KEEP_BLOCK, count);
    }

    bool hasNeighborNewlyInReach(Motion!float transform) const {
        Vec4!float toCamera;
        Vec4!float toPrevious;
        foreach (column; 0 .. 4) {
            toCamera.c[column] = -camera.minkowski(transform.m.column(column));
            toPrevious.c[column] = -previous.minkowski(transform.m.column(column));
        }
        uint face = 0;
        while (face < FACE_COUNT && !isNewlyInReach(dot(toCamera, MIRRORED_ORIGINS[face]), dot(toPrevious, MIRRORED_ORIGINS[face]))) {
            face += 1;
        }
        return face < FACE_COUNT;
    }

    bool isNewlyInReach(float coshToCamera, float coshToPrevious) const {
        return !(coshToCamera > coshReach) && coshToPrevious > coshPreviousReach;
    }
}

bool isOffHyperboloid(Vec4!float center) {
    Vec4!double exact = center.as!double();
    return fabs(-exact.minkowski(exact) - 1) > SHELL_FLOOR + SHELL_ROUNDING * exact.c[3] * exact.c[3];
}

float dot(Vec4!float a, Vec4!float b) {
    return a.c[0] * b.c[0] + a.c[1] * b.c[1] + a.c[2] * b.c[2] + a.c[3] * b.c[3];
}

immutable Vec4!float[FACE_COUNT] MIRRORED_ORIGINS = mirroredOrigins();

Vec4!float[FACE_COUNT] mirroredOrigins() {
    Vec4!float[FACE_COUNT] origins;
    foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        origins[face] = mirror(cast(Face) face).m.column(3);
    }
    return origins;
}

struct RebaseJob {
    NearbyNode* nodes;
    const(Bits)* rederived;
    size_t count;
    Motion!float toFrame;
}

void rebaseBlock(void* context, size_t block, uint worker) {
    RebaseJob* job = cast(RebaseJob*) context;
    size_t end = lowerOf((block + 1) * KEEP_BLOCK, job.count);
    foreach (index; block * KEEP_BLOCK .. end) {
        if (!job.rederived.has(index)) {
            job.nodes[index].transform = job.toFrame * job.nodes[index].transform;
        }
    }
}

void sortKept(void* context, size_t item, uint worker) {
    KeepJob* job = cast(KeepJob*) context;
    size_t block = job.base + item;
    BlockCounts counts;
    foreach (index; block * KEEP_BLOCK .. job.end(block)) {
        Motion!float transform = job.from[index].transform;
        Vec4!float center = transform * Vec4!float.origin();
        float product = -job.camera.minkowski(center);
        KeepKind kind = KeepKind.kept;
        if (product > job.coshReach || isOffHyperboloid(center)) {
            kind = KeepKind.dropped;
        } else if ((!(product > job.coshInner) && -job.previous.minkowski(center) > job.coshInner) || (product > job.coshFrontier && job.hasNeighborNewlyInReach(transform))) {
            kind = KeepKind.frontier;
            counts.frontier += 1;
        } else {
            counts.kept += 1;
        }
        job.scratch.kinds.ptr[index] = kind;
    }
    job.blocks[block] = counts;
}

void copyKept(void* context, size_t item, uint worker) {
    KeepJob* job = cast(KeepJob*) context;
    size_t block = job.base + item;
    NearbyScratch* scratch = job.scratch;
    uint kept = job.blocks[block].kept;
    uint frontier = job.keptTotal + job.blocks[block].frontier;
    foreach (index; block * KEEP_BLOCK .. job.end(block)) {
        KeepKind kind = scratch.kinds.ptr[index];
        if (kind != KeepKind.dropped) {
            uint at;
            if (kind == KeepKind.kept) {
                at = kept;
                kept += 1;
            } else {
                at = frontier;
                frontier += 1;
            }
            NearbyNode node = job.from[index];
            scratch.nodes.ptr[at] = node;
            scratch.collected.ptr[node.slot] = Collected(scratch.generation, at);
        }
    }
}

struct DeriveStep {
    uint index;
    uint from;
    Face side;
}

struct DeriveJob {
    NearbyScratch* scratch;
    const(Graph)* graph;
    Point!float center;
    float coshRadius;
    size_t first;
    size_t end;
}

void findDerived(void* context, size_t batch, uint worker) {
    DeriveJob* job = cast(DeriveJob*) context;
    NearbyScratch* scratch = job.scratch;
    Array!DeriveStep* found = &scratch.derived.ptr[batch];
    found.clear();
    size_t start = job.first + batch * DERIVE_BATCH;
    size_t end = lowerOf(start + DERIVE_BATCH, job.end);
    foreach (position; start .. end) {
        uint from = scratch.chain.ptr[position];
        NearbyNode current = scratch.nodes.ptr[from];
        foreach (sideIndex; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            MaybeIndex!uint neighbor = job.graph.neighborSlot(current.slot, cast(Face) sideIndex);
            MaybeIndex!uint index;
            if (neighbor.exists) {
                index = scratch.indexOf(neighbor.value);
            }
            if (index.exists && !scratch.rederived.has(index.value) && !(-job.center.minkowski(current.transform * MIRRORED_ORIGINS[sideIndex]) > job.coshRadius)) {
                found.append(DeriveStep(index.value, from, cast(Face) sideIndex));
            }
        }
    }
}

void applyDerived(void* context, size_t item, uint worker) {
    NearbyScratch* scratch = (cast(DeriveJob*) context).scratch;
    DeriveStep step = scratch.claimed.ptr[item];
    scratch.nodes.ptr[step.index].transform = scratch.nodes.ptr[step.from].transform * step.side.mirror;
}

struct Collected {
    uint stamp;
    uint position;
}

struct NearbyScratch {
    Array!NearbyNode nodes;
    Array!Collected collected;
    Array!ExpandOutput outputs;
    ExpandOutput serial;
    Array!uint candidates;
    Array!KeepKind kinds;
    Array!BlockCounts blocks;
    Array!uint around;
    Array!uint chain;
    Array!(Array!DeriveStep) derived;
    Array!DeriveStep claimed;
    Bits rederived;
    KeepJob keeping;
    Point!float startPoint;
    size_t front;
    size_t missingHead;
    size_t unknownHead;
    size_t paintedHead;
    size_t keptBlocks;
    size_t keptNodes;
    size_t reexpandedNodes;
    float coshThreshold = 0;
    float coshInner = 0;
    double paintingMs = 0;
    uint generation;
    uint paintsThisAdvance;
    KeepPass keepPass;

    void release() {
        nodes.release();
        collected.release();
        foreach (ref output; outputs.slice()) {
            output.release();
        }
        outputs.release();
        serial.release();
        candidates.release();
        kinds.release();
        blocks.release();
        around.release();
        chain.release();
        foreach (ref batch; derived.slice()) {
            batch.release();
        }
        derived.release();
        claimed.release();
        rederived.release();
    }

    MaybeIndex!uint indexOf(uint slot) const {
        if (slot < collected.length && collected.ptr[slot].stamp == generation) {
            return MaybeIndex!uint.of(collected.ptr[slot].position);
        } else {
            return MaybeIndex!uint.init;
        }
    }

    void paintUnknownAhead(ref Graph graph, Executor executor) {
        candidates.clear();
        size_t index = unknownHead;
        while (index < serial.unknown.length && candidates.length < PAINT_BATCH) {
            if (!isUnknownReady(graph, index)) {
                candidates.append(nodes.ptr[serial.unknown.ptr[index]].slot);
            }
            index += 1;
        }
        graph.paintAhead(candidates.slice(), executor);
        paintedHead = unknownHead + 1;
        while (paintedHead < index && isUnknownReady(graph, paintedHead)) {
            paintedHead += 1;
        }
    }

    bool isUnknownReady(ref const Graph graph, size_t index) const {
        uint slot = nodes.ptr[serial.unknown.ptr[index]].slot;
        return graph.isFinished(slot) || graph.structures.at(slot).isCovered;
    }

    bool hasSerialWork() const {
        return missingHead < serial.missing.length || unknownHead < serial.unknown.length;
    }

    bool isBuilding() const {
        return isKeeping() || front < nodes.length || hasSerialWork();
    }

    bool isKeeping() const {
        return keepPass != KeepPass.none;
    }

    void begin(ref Graph graph, Position start, float distance, float inner) {
        coshThreshold = coshf(distance + NODE_RADIUS);
        coshInner = coshf(inner);
        keepPass = KeepPass.none;
        nodes.clear();
        serial.clear();
        front = 0;
        missingHead = 0;
        unknownHead = 0;
        paintedHead = 0;
        generation += 1;
        startPoint = start.local * Point!float.origin();
        collect(graph, NearbyNode(Motion!float.identity(), graph.slotOf(start.node).value));
    }

    void reserveStamps(ref const Graph graph) {
        if (collected.length < graph.slotCount) {
            collected.resize(graph.slotCount);
        }
    }

    void collect(ref Graph graph, NearbyNode node) {
        reserveStamps(graph);
        collected.ptr[node.slot] = Collected(generation, cast(uint) nodes.length);
        nodes.append(node);
    }

    bool claim(uint slot) {
        uint before = atomicExchange(cast(shared(uint)*) &collected.ptr[slot].stamp, generation);
        return before != generation;
    }

    bool collectAround(ref Graph graph, uint cameraSlot, Point!float camera, float reach) {
        MaybeIndex!uint first = indexOf(cameraSlot);
        if (!first.exists) {
            return false;
        } else {
            bool wasBuilding = isBuilding();
            walkAround(graph, first.value, camera, coshf(reach));
            if (!wasBuilding) {
                front = nodes.length;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    void walkAround(ref Graph graph, uint first, Point!float camera, float coshReach) {
        around.clear();
        around.append(first);
        size_t head = 0;
        while (head < around.length) {
            NearbyNode current = nodes.ptr[around.ptr[head]];
            foreach (index; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                Face face = cast(Face) index;
                Motion!float transform = current.transform * face.mirror;
                if (head == 0 || !(-camera.minkowski(transform * Vec4!float.origin()) > coshReach)) {
                    uint neighbor = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(current.slot, face);
                    MaybeIndex!uint found = indexOf(neighbor);
                    uint position = cast(uint) nodes.length;
                    if (found.exists) {
                        position = found.value;
                    } else {
                        collect(graph, NearbyNode(transform, neighbor));
                    }
                    if (!isListed(around.slice(), position)) {
                        around.append(position);
                    }
                }
            }
            head += 1;
        }
    }

    void advance(ref Graph graph, Deadline deadline, Executor executor) {
        while (outputs.length < executor.workers) {
            outputs.append(ExpandOutput.init);
        }
        paintsThisAdvance = 0;
        while (!isKeeping() && isBuilding()) {
            if (hasSerialWork()) {
                Drain drained = drainSerial(graph, deadline, executor);
                if (drained == Drain.stalled) {
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                reserveStamps(graph);
                ExpandJob expansion = ExpandJob(&this, &graph, front, nodes.length);
                ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(&expandBatch, &expansion, deadline, (expansion.end - front + EXPAND_BATCH - 1) / EXPAND_BATCH);
                executor.run(&job);
                front = lowerOf(front + job.count * EXPAND_BATCH, expansion.end);
                gather();
            }
            double now = nowMilliseconds();
            if (deadline.hasPassed(now)) {
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void gather() {
        foreach (ref output; outputs.slice()) {
            foreach (found; output.found.slice()) {
                collected.ptr[found.slot].position = cast(uint) nodes.length;
                nodes.append(found);
            }
            serial.missing.appendAll(output.missing.slice());
            serial.unknown.appendAll(output.unknown.slice());
            output.clear();
        }
    }

    Drain drainSerial(ref Graph graph, Deadline deadline, Executor executor) {
        double now = nowMilliseconds();
        while (hasSerialWork() && !deadline.hasPassed(now)) {
            if (missingHead < serial.missing.length) {
                MissingSide missing = serial.missing.ptr[missingHead];
                missingHead += 1;
                NearbyNode current = nodes.ptr[missing.index];
                uint neighbor = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(current.slot, missing.side);
                if (!indexOf(neighbor).exists) {
                    collect(graph, NearbyNode(current.transform * missing.side.mirror, neighbor));
                }
            } else if (unknownHead >= paintedHead && paintsThisAdvance > 0 && deadline.hasPassed(now + paintingMs)) {
                return Drain.stalled;
            } else if (unknownHead >= paintedHead) {
                double start = nowMilliseconds();
                paintUnknownAhead(graph, executor);
                paintingMs = nowMilliseconds() - start;
                paintsThisAdvance += 1;
            } else {
                NearbyNode current = nodes.ptr[serial.unknown.ptr[unknownHead]];
                unknownHead += 1;
                NodeContent content = graph.ensureContentAt(current.slot);
                if (content == NodeContent.holding) {
                    expandAll(graph, current);
                }
            }
            now = nowMilliseconds();
        }
        if (!hasSerialWork()) {
            serial.clear();
            missingHead = 0;
            unknownHead = 0;
            paintedHead = 0;
        }
        return Drain.flowing;
    }

    bool isWithinReach(NearbyNode current, Face side) const {
        Vec4!float mirroredOrigin = side.mirror.m.column(3);
        return !(-startPoint.minkowski(current.transform * mirroredOrigin) > coshThreshold);
    }

    bool isInner(NearbyNode current) const {
        return !(-startPoint.minkowski(current.transform * Vec4!float.origin()) > coshInner);
    }

    bool isOpenSide(ref const Graph graph, NearbyNode current, Face side) const {
        MaybeIndex!uint existing = graph.neighborSlot(current.slot, side);
        return (!existing.exists || collected.ptr[existing.value].stamp != generation) && isWithinReach(current, side);
    }

    bool hasOpenSide(ref const Graph graph, NearbyNode current) const {
        uint side = 0;
        while (side < FACE_COUNT && !isOpenSide(graph, current, cast(Face) side)) {
            side += 1;
        }
        return side < FACE_COUNT;
    }

    void narrow(float distance) {
        coshThreshold = coshf(distance + NODE_RADIUS);
    }

    void expandKnown(ref const Graph graph, NearbyNode current, uint index, ref ExpandOutput output) {
        foreach (sideIndex; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            Face side = cast(Face) sideIndex;
            if (isOpenSide(graph, current, side)) {
                MaybeIndex!uint existing = graph.neighborSlot(current.slot, side);
                if (existing.exists) {
                    bool claimed = claim(existing.value);
                    if (claimed) {
                        output.found.append(NearbyNode(current.transform * side.mirror, existing.value));
                    }
                } else {
                    output.missing.append(MissingSide(index, side));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void expandAll(ref Graph graph, NearbyNode current) {
        foreach (sideIndex; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            Face side = cast(Face) sideIndex;
            MaybeIndex!uint existing = graph.neighborSlot(current.slot, side);
            if ((!existing.exists || !indexOf(existing.value).exists) && isWithinReach(current, side)) {
                uint neighbor = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(current.slot, side);
                if (!indexOf(neighbor).exists) {
                    collect(graph, NearbyNode(current.transform * side.mirror, neighbor));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void beginFrom(ref const NearbyScratch finished, ref Graph graph, Point!float camera, float distance, float inner) {
        float moved = camera.distance(finished.startPoint);
        float frontier = acoshf(finished.coshThreshold) - 2 * FACE_DISTANCE - moved;
        float coshFrontier = coshf(higherOf(frontier, 0.0f));
        kinds.resize(finished.nodes.length);
        blocks.resize((finished.nodes.length + KEEP_BLOCK - 1) / KEEP_BLOCK);
        nodes.clear();
        serial.clear();
        front = 0;
        missingHead = 0;
        unknownHead = 0;
        paintedHead = 0;
        generation += 1;
        reserveStamps(graph);
        keeping = KeepJob.init;
        keeping.count = finished.nodes.length;
        keeping.camera = camera;
        keeping.previous = finished.startPoint;
        keeping.coshReach = coshf(distance + NODE_RADIUS);
        keeping.coshPreviousReach = finished.coshThreshold;
        keeping.coshFrontier = coshFrontier;
        keeping.coshInner = coshf(inner);
        keepPass = KeepPass.sorting;
        keptBlocks = 0;
    }

    void continueKeeping(ref const NearbyScratch finished, Deadline deadline, Executor executor) {
        while (isKeeping()) {
            keeping.from = finished.nodes.ptr;
            keeping.scratch = &this;
            keeping.blocks = blocks.ptr;
            keeping.base = keptBlocks;
            ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(&sortKept, &keeping, deadline, blocks.length - keptBlocks);
            if (keepPass == KeepPass.copying) {
                job.run = &copyKept;
            }
            executor.run(&job);
            keptBlocks += job.count;
            if (keptBlocks == blocks.length) {
                finishPass();
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    void finishPass() {
        if (keepPass == KeepPass.sorting) {
            BlockCounts total;
            foreach (ref counts; blocks.slice()) {
                BlockCounts own = counts;
                counts = total;
                total.kept += own.kept;
                total.frontier += own.frontier;
            }
            keeping.keptTotal = total.kept;
            nodes.reserve(total.kept + total.frontier);
            nodes.length = total.kept + total.frontier;
            keepPass = KeepPass.copying;
            keptBlocks = 0;
        } else {
            coshThreshold = keeping.coshReach;
            coshInner = keeping.coshInner;
            startPoint = keeping.camera;
            front = keeping.keptTotal;
            keptNodes += front;
            reexpandedNodes += nodes.length - front;
            keepPass = KeepPass.none;
        }
    }

    void rederive(ref const Graph graph, uint firstSlot, Point!float center, float radius, Executor executor) {
        uint first = indexOf(firstSlot).value;
        rederived.cover(nodes.length);
        rederived.clearAll();
        chain.clear();
        chain.append(first);
        rederived.set(first);
        size_t levelStart = 0;
        while (levelStart < chain.length) {
            DeriveJob job = DeriveJob(&this, &graph, center, coshf(radius), levelStart, chain.length);
            size_t batches = (job.end - job.first + DERIVE_BATCH - 1) / DERIVE_BATCH;
            while (derived.length < batches) {
                derived.append(Array!DeriveStep.init);
            }
            ParallelJob finding = ParallelJob(&findDerived, &job, Deadline.init, batches);
            executor.run(&finding);
            claimed.clear();
            foreach (batch; derived.slice()[0 .. batches]) {
                foreach (step; batch.slice()) {
                    if (!rederived.has(step.index)) {
                        rederived.set(step.index);
                        chain.append(step.index);
                        claimed.append(step);
                    }
                }
            }
            ParallelJob applying = ParallelJob(&applyDerived, &job, Deadline.init, claimed.length);
            executor.run(&applying);
            levelStart = job.end;
        }
    }

    void rebase(ref const Graph graph, uint cameraSlot, Motion!float toFrame, float radius, Executor executor) {
        nodes.ptr[indexOf(cameraSlot).value].transform = Motion!float.identity();
        rederive(graph, cameraSlot, Point!float.origin(), radius, executor);
        RebaseJob job = RebaseJob(nodes.ptr, &rederived, nodes.length, toFrame);
        ParallelJob rebasing = ParallelJob(&rebaseBlock, &job, Deadline.init, (nodes.length + KEEP_BLOCK - 1) / KEEP_BLOCK);
        executor.run(&rebasing);
        startPoint = toFrame * startPoint;
    }

    NearbyNode[] collectAll(ref Graph graph, Position start, float distance) {
        begin(graph, start, distance, distance + NODE_RADIUS);
        advance(graph, Deadline.init, Executor.init);
        return nodes.slice();
    }
}

NodeContent ensureContentAt(ref Graph graph, uint slot) {
    if (graph.nodeAt(slot).content == NodeContent.unknown) {
        bool holding = graph.probeMayHoldContent(slot);
        if (holding) {
            graph.nodeAt(slot).content = NodeContent.holding;
        } else {
            graph.nodeAt(slot).content = NodeContent.empty;
        }
    }
    return graph.nodeAt(slot).content;
}

/// file: source/common/view.d
module common.view;

import core.bitop : bsf;
import base.array : Array;
import base.flags : Readiness;
import base.hashmap : HashMap;
import base.maybe : Maybe, MaybeIndex;
import common.graph : ALL_FACES, Graph, NodeId, ParentEntry, ParentList, childId, childParentFaces, farthestFaceBeyond;
import common.node : ChunkLayout;
import common.position : Position;
import common.worldgen.blueprint : Blueprint;
import common.worldgen.building : Building;
import common.worldgen.generation : ChunkStructure, NodeState, Worldgen;
import common.worldgen.horospheres : CornerKey, GroundKey, HorosphereId, HorosphereRef, Horospheres, Rise, RisingList, applyDiscoveries, makeHorosphere, makeWantedHorospheres;
import common.worldgen.store : NodeStructure, Standing;
import common.worldgen.structure : ClaimKey;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, Corner, FACE_COUNT, Face, faceBit, mirror;
import geometry.lorentz : Point;

enum uint VIRTUAL = 1u << 31;

struct ViewNode {
    ParentList parents;
    MaybeIndex!uint[FACE_COUNT] children;
    NodeId id;
    NodeState state;
    uint depth;
    ushort parentFaces;
    Readiness stateReadiness;
}

struct SideKey {
    uint node;
    Face side;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return cast(size_t) node * FACE_COUNT + side;
    }
}

struct SlotKey {
    uint slot;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return slot;
    }
}

struct SlotCorner {
    uint slot;
    Corner corner;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return cast(size_t) slot * CORNER_COUNT + corner;
    }
}

struct RefRange {
    uint start;
    uint count;
}

struct WantedHorosphere {
    uint start;
    uint pathStart;
    uint pathLength;
    HorosphereId parent;
    Corner corner;
}

struct GraphView {
    const(Graph)* graph;
    Graph* owner;
    Array!ViewNode nodes;
    Array!WantedHorosphere wanted;
    Array!Face wantedPaths;
    HashMap!(NodeId, uint) virtualIds;
    HashMap!(SideKey, uint) missingChildren;
    HashMap!(SlotKey, NodeState) statesOfSlots;
    Array!uint statedSlots;
    Array!HorosphereRef refs;
    HashMap!(SlotKey, RefRange) refsOfNodes;
    Array!HorosphereId risingFound;
    HashMap!(GroundKey, RisingList) rising;
    HashMap!(SlotCorner, Rise) choices;
    Array!uint storedSlots;
    Array!GroundKey risingKeys;
    Array!SlotCorner choiceKeys;
    size_t settledWanted;

    bool isBlocked() const {
        return wanted.length > settledWanted;
    }

    static GraphView over(ref const Graph graph) {
        GraphView view;
        view.graph = &graph;
        return view;
    }

    void forget() {
        nodes.clear();
        virtualIds.clear();
        missingChildren.clear();
        statesOfSlots.clear();
        statedSlots.clear();
        refs.clear();
        refsOfNodes.clear();
        risingFound.clear();
        rising.clear();
        choices.clear();
        storedSlots.clear();
        risingKeys.clear();
        choiceKeys.clear();
        settledWanted = wanted.length;
    }

    void release() {
        nodes.release();
        wanted.release();
        wantedPaths.release();
        virtualIds.release();
        missingChildren.release();
        statesOfSlots.release();
        statedSlots.release();
        refs.release();
        refsOfNodes.release();
        risingFound.release();
        rising.release();
        choices.release();
        storedSlots.release();
        risingKeys.release();
        choiceKeys.release();
    }

    ref const(ChunkLayout) layout() const {
        return graph.layout;
    }

    ref const(Worldgen) worldgen() const {
        return graph.worldgen;
    }

    ref const(Horospheres) horospheres() const {
        return graph.horospheres;
    }

    ref const(Blueprint) blueprint() const {
        return graph.structures.blueprint;
    }

    static bool isVirtual(uint node) {
        return (node & VIRTUAL) != 0;
    }

    ref inout(ViewNode) virtualAt(uint node) inout {
        return nodes.ptr[node & ~VIRTUAL];
    }

    NodeId idAt(uint node) const {
        if (isVirtual(node)) {
            return virtualAt(node).id;
        } else {
            return graph.idAt(node);
        }
    }

    uint depthOf(uint node) const {
        if (isVirtual(node)) {
            return virtualAt(node).depth;
        } else {
            return graph.depthOf(node);
        }
    }

    ushort parentFacesOf(uint node) const {
        if (isVirtual(node)) {
            return virtualAt(node).parentFaces;
        } else {
            return graph.nodeAt(node).parentFaces;
        }
    }

    ParentList parents(uint node) const {
        if (isVirtual(node)) {
            return virtualAt(node).parents;
        } else {
            return graph.parents(node);
        }
    }

    MaybeIndex!uint slotOf(NodeId id) const {
        MaybeIndex!uint slot = graph.slotOf(id);
        if (slot.exists) {
            return slot;
        } else {
            const(uint)* known = virtualIds.find(id);
            if (known is null) {
                return MaybeIndex!uint.init;
            } else {
                return MaybeIndex!uint.of(*known);
            }
        }
    }

    MaybeIndex!uint neighborSlot(uint node, Face face) const {
        if (!isVirtual(node)) {
            return graph.neighborSlot(node, face);
        } else if ((virtualAt(node).parentFaces & faceBit(face)) != 0) {
            ParentList list = virtualAt(node).parents;
            uint index = 0;
            while (list.links[index].side != face) {
                index += 1;
            }
            return MaybeIndex!uint.of(list.links[index].slot);
        } else {
            return virtualAt(node).children[face];
        }
    }

    uint ensureNeighborSlot(uint node, Face face) {
        MaybeIndex!uint existing = neighborSlot(node, face);
        if (existing.exists) {
            return existing.value;
        } else if (owner !is null) {
            return owner.addChild(node, face);
        } else if (isVirtual(node)) {
            uint child = virtualChild(node, face);
            virtualAt(node).children[face] = MaybeIndex!uint.of(child);
            return child;
        } else {
            const(uint)* known = missingChildren.find(SideKey(node, face));
            if (known !is null) {
                return *known;
            } else {
                uint child = virtualChild(node, face);
                missingChildren.insert(SideKey(node, face), child);
                return child;
            }
        }
    }

    uint virtualChild(uint node, Face face) {
        ushort parentFaces = childParentFaces(parentFacesOf(node), face);
        ParentList list;
        uint remaining = parentFaces;
        while (remaining != 0) {
            Face through = cast(Face) bsf(remaining);
            remaining &= remaining - 1;
            uint parent = node;
            if (through != face) {
                parent = ensureNeighborSlot(neighborSlot(node, through).value, face);
            }
            list.links[list.count] = ParentEntry(parent, through);
            list.count += 1;
        }
        NodeId id = childId(idAt(list.links[0].slot), list.links[0].side);
        const(uint)* known = virtualIds.find(id);
        if (known !is null) {
            return *known;
        } else {
            ViewNode made;
            made.parents = list;
            made.id = id;
            made.depth = depthOf(node) + 1;
            made.parentFaces = parentFaces;
            nodes.append(made);
            uint handle = cast(uint)(nodes.length - 1) | VIRTUAL;
            virtualIds.insert(id, handle);
            return handle;
        }
    }

    Position ensureNormalized(Position start) {
        uint node = slotOf(start.node).value;
        Maybe!Face face = farthestFaceBeyond(start.local * Point!float.origin(), ALL_FACES);
        while (face.exists) {
            node = ensureNeighborSlot(node, face.value);
            start.local = mirror(face.value) * start.local;
            face = farthestFaceBeyond(start.local * Point!float.origin(), ALL_FACES);
        }
        return Position(idAt(node), start.local);
    }

    uint pathTo(uint node, ref Array!Face sides) const {
        if (!isVirtual(node)) {
            return node;
        } else {
            ParentEntry parent = virtualAt(node).parents.links[0];
            uint start = pathTo(parent.slot, sides);
            sides.append(parent.side);
            return start;
        }
    }

    NodeState ensureState(uint node) {
        if (owner !is null) {
            return *owner.ensureState(node);
        } else if (isVirtual(node)) {
            if (virtualAt(node).stateReadiness == Readiness.pending) {
                virtualAt(node).state = NodeState.fromParents(this, node);
                virtualAt(node).stateReadiness = Readiness.ready;
            }
            return virtualAt(node).state;
        } else if (graph.nodeAt(node).hasState) {
            return graph.stateAt(node);
        } else {
            const(NodeState)* known = statesOfSlots.find(SlotKey(node));
            if (known !is null) {
                return *known;
            } else {
                NodeState state = NodeState.fromParents(this, node);
                statesOfSlots.insert(SlotKey(node), state);
                statedSlots.append(node);
                return state;
            }
        }
    }

    bool hasStructureAt(uint node) const {
        return !isVirtual(node) && graph.isFinished(node);
    }

    ChunkStructure ensureChunkStructure(uint slot) {
        if (owner !is null) {
            bool needsBuilding = owner.ensureStructureAt(slot);
            if (needsBuilding) {
                return ChunkStructure(owner.ensureBuildingAt(slot), owner.structures.at(slot).standing);
            } else {
                return ChunkStructure(null, Standing.outside);
            }
        } else {
            const(NodeStructure)* node = &graph.structures.at(slot);
            const(Building)* building = graph.structures.buildingAt(slot);
            if (!node.isFinished || (node.needsBuilding() && building is null)) {
                return ChunkStructure(null, Standing.unknown);
            } else {
                return ChunkStructure(building, node.standing);
            }
        }
    }

    bool hasHorospheresAt(uint node) const {
        return (!isVirtual(node) && graph.horospheres.hasHorospheresAt(node)) || refsOfNodes.find(SlotKey(node)) !is null;
    }

    const(HorosphereRef)[] horospheresAt(uint node) const {
        if (!isVirtual(node) && graph.horospheres.hasHorospheresAt(node)) {
            return graph.horospheres.horospheresAt(node);
        } else {
            const(RefRange)* range = refsOfNodes.find(SlotKey(node));
            if (range is null || range.count == 0) {
                return null;
            } else {
                return refs.ptr[range.start .. range.start + range.count];
            }
        }
    }

    void storeHorospheres(uint node, const(HorosphereRef)[] found) {
        if (owner !is null) {
            owner.horospheres.storeHorospheres(node, found);
        } else {
            refsOfNodes.insert(SlotKey(node), RefRange(cast(uint) refs.length, cast(uint) found.length));
            refs.appendAll(found);
            if (!isVirtual(node)) {
                storedSlots.append(node);
            }
        }
    }

    Maybe!(const(HorosphereId)[]) knownRising(GroundKey key) const {
        Maybe!(const(HorosphereId)[]) global = graph.horospheres.knownRising(key);
        const(RisingList)* local = rising.find(key);
        if (global.exists || local is null) {
            return global;
        } else {
            return Maybe!(const(HorosphereId)[]).of(risingFound.ptr[local.start .. local.start + local.count]);
        }
    }

    const(HorosphereId)[] storeRising(GroundKey key, const(HorosphereId)[] found) {
        if (owner !is null) {
            return owner.horospheres.storeRising(key, found);
        } else {
            RisingList list = RisingList(cast(uint) risingFound.length, cast(uint) found.length);
            risingFound.appendAll(found);
            rising.insert(key, list);
            risingKeys.append(key);
            return risingFound.ptr[list.start .. list.start + list.count];
        }
    }

    bool hasChoice(SlotCorner at) const {
        return (!isVirtual(at.slot) && graph.horospheres.hasRise(at.slot, at.corner)) || choices.find(at) !is null;
    }

    Rise choiceAt(SlotCorner at) const {
        if (!isVirtual(at.slot) && graph.horospheres.hasRise(at.slot, at.corner)) {
            return graph.horospheres.riseAt(at.slot, at.corner);
        } else {
            return *choices.find(at);
        }
    }

    void storeChoice(SlotCorner at, Rise rise) {
        if (owner !is null) {
            owner.horospheres.storeRise(at.slot, at.corner, rise);
        } else {
            choices.insert(at, rise);
            if (!isVirtual(at.slot)) {
                choiceKeys.append(at);
            }
        }
    }

    CornerKey cornerKeyOf(ClaimKey key) const {
        return CornerKey(idAt(key.slot), cast(Corner) key.feature);
    }

    Maybe!HorosphereId ensureHorosphere(ClaimKey rooted, uint face, Corner corner, HorosphereId parent, Rise rise) {
        const(HorosphereId)* known = graph.horospheres.horosphereOf.find(cornerKeyOf(rooted));
        if (known !is null) {
            return Maybe!HorosphereId.of(*known);
        } else if (owner !is null) {
            return Maybe!HorosphereId.of((*owner).makeHorosphere(rooted, face, corner, parent, rise));
        } else {
            uint pathStart = cast(uint) wantedPaths.length;
            uint start = pathTo(face, wantedPaths);
            wanted.append(WantedHorosphere(start, pathStart, cast(uint) wantedPaths.length - pathStart, parent, corner));
            return Maybe!HorosphereId.init;
        }
    }

    void clearWanted() {
        wanted.clear();
        wantedPaths.clear();
        settledWanted = 0;
    }
}

void applyStates(ref Graph target, ref const GraphView view) {
    foreach (slot; view.statedSlots.slice()) {
        if (!target.nodeAt(slot).hasState) {
            *target.states.at(slot) = *view.statesOfSlots.find(SlotKey(slot));
            target.nodeAt(slot).state = Readiness.ready;
        }
    }
}

struct ThreadViews {
    Array!GraphView views;

    void begin(ref const Graph graph, uint threads) {
        while (views.length < threads) {
            views.append(GraphView.init);
        }
        foreach (ref view; views.slice()) {
            view.graph = &graph;
            view.forget();
        }
    }

    ref GraphView opIndex(uint worker) return {
        return views.ptr[worker];
    }

    size_t finish(ref Graph graph) {
        size_t made = 0;
        foreach (ref view; views.slice()) {
            graph.applyStates(view);
            graph.applyDiscoveries(view);
            made += graph.makeWantedHorospheres(view);
        }
        return made;
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (ref view; views.slice()) {
            view.release();
        }
        views.release();
    }
}

module common.worldgen.blueprint;

import common.worldgen.structure : AxisOrder, CanonicalSite, ClaimKey, ColumnSpot, EDGE_NODES, LineTransform, PAINT_REACH, SiteFrame, SlotTouch, addPendingTouch, canonicalOf, edgeCells, ensureAroundEdge, isEndless, seedTouch, walkTouch;

enum ulong PLACED_RANK = 0;
enum ulong TILE_RANK_BIT = 1;

enum Cover : ubyte {
    over,
    intoAir,
}

struct Paint {
    MaybeIndex!ubyte material;
    Cover cover;
}

struct PaintOwner {
    MaybeIndex!uint tile;

    static PaintOwner ofTile(uint index) {
        return PaintOwner(MaybeIndex!uint.of(index));
    }
}

struct CellBox {
    Vec3!int low;
    Vec3!int high;
    Extent extent;

    static CellBox make(int xLow, int xHigh, int yLow, int yHigh, int zLow, int zHigh) {
        return CellBox(Vec3!int(xLow, yLow, zLow), Vec3!int(xHigh, yHigh, zHigh));
    }

    static CellBox alongLine(int xLow, int xHigh, int yLow, int yHigh) {
        return CellBox(Vec3!int(xLow, yLow, 0), Vec3!int(xHigh, yHigh, 0), Extent.endless);
    }

    bool isEndless() const {
        return extent == Extent.endless;
    }

    bool contains(Vec3!int cell) const {
        return cell.x >= low.x && cell.x <= high.x && cell.y >= low.y && cell.y <= high.y && (isEndless || (cell.z >= low.z && cell.z <= high.z));
    }

    bool overlaps(ref const CellBox other) const {
        return low.x <= other.high.x && other.low.x <= high.x && low.y <= other.high.y && other.low.y <= high.y && (isEndless || other.isEndless || (low.z <= other.high.z && other.low.z <= high.z));
    }

    bool reachesEdge(int level, ubyte dimension) const {
        return isEndless || (edgeOf(low.z, dimension) <= level && edgeOf(high.z, dimension) >= level);
    }
}

struct Rhythm {
    int period;
    int phase;
    int span;
    Repeat repeat;

    bool includes(int height) const {
        final switch (repeat) {
            case Repeat.always:
                return true;
            case Repeat.rhythmic:
                int offset = (height - phase) % period;
                if (offset < 0) {
                    offset += period;
                }
                return offset < span;
        }
    }
}

enum Rhythm EVERY_HEIGHT = Rhythm(0, 0, 0, Repeat.always);

struct BrushRank {
    ulong tile;
    uint index;

    bool isBefore(BrushRank other) const {
        return tile < other.tile || (tile == other.tile && index < other.index);
    }
}

struct Brush {
    CellBox box;
    Rhythm rhythm;
    uint order;
    Paint paint;

    bool covers(Vec3!int column) const {
        return box.contains(column) && rhythm.includes(column.z);
    }
}

struct LineSpec {
    LevelRange edges;
    MaybeIndex!uint node;
    Corner lower;
    Face xSide;
    Face ySide;
    Extent extent;
}

struct LineKey {
    NodeId node;
    Corner lower;
    Face xSide;
    Face ySide;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return node.toHash() ^ ((cast(size_t) lower * FACE_COUNT + xSide) * FACE_COUNT + ySide);
    }
}

struct LineEdge {
    uint line;
    int level;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return cast(size_t)(line * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER) ^ cast(uint) level;
    }
}

struct RouteStop {

    ColumnSpot spot;
}

    uint count;
}

struct Painted {
    Array!Brush brushes;
    Array!LineRun runs;
    Array!Stroke strokes;
    Array!StrokeRun strokeRuns;
    Array!NodeId reached;

    void release() {
        brushes.release();
        runs.release();
        strokes.release();
        strokeRuns.release();
        reached.release();
    }
}

struct RunRef {
    PaintOwner owner;
    uint run;
    int lowEdge;
    int highEdge;
    Extent extent;

    bool reachesEdge(int level) const {
        return extent == Extent.endless || (lowEdge <= level && highEdge >= level);
    }
}

enum TileState : ubyte {
    live,
    dropped,
    free,
}

struct TileEdge {

    NodeId[EDGE_NODES] nodes;
}

    Array!TileEdge edges;
    NodeId face;
    HorosphereId horosphere;
    uint listIndex;
    ubyte feature;
    TileState state;

    bool isDropped() const {
        return state == TileState.dropped;
    }
}

struct EdgeRecord {
    NodeId[EDGE_NODES] nodes;
    uint users;
    LineLife life;
}

    uint used;
    uint unused;
}

    uint edges;
