    LevelRange touched;
}

enum Coverage : ubyte {
    empty,
    covered,
}

struct LevelRange {
    int low;
    int high;
    Coverage coverage;

    bool contains(int first, int last) const {
        return coverage == Coverage.covered && first >= low && last <= high;
    }

    void include(int first, int last) {
        if (coverage == Coverage.covered && first <= high + 1L && last >= low - 1L) {
            low = lowerOf(low, first);
            high = higherOf(high, last);
        } else {
            low = first;
            high = last;
            coverage = Coverage.covered;
        }
    }

    void widen(int first, int last) {
        if (coverage == Coverage.covered) {
            low = lowerOf(low, first);
            high = higherOf(high, last);
        } else {
            low = first;
            high = last;
            coverage = Coverage.covered;
        }
    }

    void widen(ref const LevelRange other) {
        if (other.coverage == Coverage.covered) {
            widen(other.low, other.high);
        }
    }
}

enum PaintResult : ubyte {
    painted,
    endless,
    behind,
}

enum LineLife : ubyte {
    loose,
    kept,
}

enum BuilderPhase : ubyte {
    placing,
    growing,
}

struct Blueprint {
    Array!LineSpec lines;
    Array!LineState lineStates;
    Array!uint freeLines;
    Array!(Array!RunRef) runsOn;
    Array!uint linePins;
    Painted placed;
    Array!TileRecord tiles;
    Array!uint liveTiles;
    Array!uint liveUses;
    Array!uint droppedTiles;
    Array!uint freeTiles;
    Array!RouteStop route;
    Array!SiteFrame flats;
    Array!Material materials;
    MaybeIndex!ubyte[MATERIAL_COUNT] paints;
    HashMap!(LineKey, uint) lineIndex;
    HashMap!(LineEdge, EdgeRecord) touchedEdges;
    HashMap!(ClaimKey, Present) claims;
    Maybe!RouteStop entrance;
    Look look;
    Maybe!float fog;
    uint sweep;
    uint madeLive;
    uint brushCount;
    uint claimCount;
    uint restoredTiles;
    ubyte dimension;

    static Blueprint make(ubyte chunkDimension) {
        Blueprint blueprint;
        blueprint.dimension = chunkDimension;
        return blueprint;
    }

    uint ensureLine(LineSpec spec, NodeId node) {
        LineKey key = LineKey(node, spec.lower, spec.xSide, spec.ySide);
        const(uint)* found = lineIndex.find(key);
        if (found !is null) {
            lines.ptr[*found].node = spec.node;
            return *found;
        } else if (freeLines.length > 0) {
            freeLines.length -= 1;
            uint index = freeLines.ptr[freeLines.length];
            lines.ptr[index] = spec;
            lineStates.ptr[index] = LineState(node);
            lineIndex.insert(key, index);
            return index;
        } else {
            uint index = cast(uint) lines.length;
            lines.append(spec);
            lineStates.append(LineState(node));
            runsOn.append(Array!RunRef.init);
            linePins.append(0);
            lineIndex.insert(key, index);
            return index;
        }
    }

    void keepLine(uint line) {
        lineStates.ptr[line].life = LineLife.kept;
    }

    void forgetLineIfUnused(uint line) {
        LineState* state = &lineStates.ptr[line];
        if (state.life == LineLife.loose && state.edges == 0 && state.touchers == 0 && linePins.ptr[line] == 0 && runsOn.ptr[line].length == 0) {
            LineSpec spec = lines.ptr[line];
            lineIndex.remove(LineKey(state.node, spec.lower, spec.xSide, spec.ySide));
            runsOn.ptr[line].release();
            lines.ptr[line] = LineSpec.init;
            *state = LineState.init;
            freeLines.append(line);
        }
    }

    bool isEdgeTouched(LineEdge edge) const {
        return touchedEdges.find(edge) !is null;
    }

    void touchEdge(LineEdge edge, NodeId[EDGE_NODES] nodes) {
        touchedEdges.insert(edge, EdgeRecord(nodes));
        lineStates.ptr[edge.line].edges += 1;
    }

    NodeId[EDGE_NODES] useEdge(LineEdge edge) {
        EdgeRecord* found = touchedEdges.find(edge);
        found.users += 1;
        return found.nodes;
    }

    void keepEdge(LineEdge edge) {
        touchedEdges.find(edge).life = LineLife.kept;
    }

    bool releaseEdge(LineEdge edge) {
        EdgeRecord* found = touchedEdges.find(edge);
        found.users -= 1;
        return found.life == LineLife.loose && found.users == 0;
    }

    EdgeUses edgeUses() const {
        EdgeUses uses;
        foreach (ref const edge, ref const record; touchedEdges) {
            if (record.life == LineLife.kept) {
                uses.kept += 1;
            } else if (record.users > 0) {
                uses.used += 1;
            } else {
                uses.unused += 1;
            }
        }
        return uses;
    }

    size_t edgeCount() const {
        size_t count = 0;
        foreach (state; lineStates.slice()) {
            count += state.edges;
        }
        return count;
    }

    void forgetEdge(LineEdge edge) {
        touchedEdges.remove(edge);
        lineStates.ptr[edge.line].edges -= 1;
        forgetLineIfUnused(edge.line);
    }

    uint addTile(NodeId face, ubyte feature, HorosphereId horosphere) {
        TileRecord made;
        made.face = face;
        made.horosphere = horosphere;
        made.feature = feature;
        made.state = TileState.live;
        uint tile = cast(uint) tiles.length;
        if (freeTiles.length > 0) {
            freeTiles.length -= 1;
            tile = freeTiles.ptr[freeTiles.length];
            tiles.ptr[tile] = made;
        } else {
            tiles.append(made);
        }
        addLive(tile);
        return tile;
    }

    void reviveTile(uint tile) {
        TileRecord* record = &tiles.ptr[tile];
        if (record.isDropped) {
            unlist(droppedTiles, tile);
            record.state = TileState.live;
            addLive(tile);
        }
    }

    void useTile(uint tile) {
        if (tiles.ptr[tile].state == TileState.live) {
            liveUses.ptr[tiles.ptr[tile].listIndex] = sweep;
        }
    }

    void addLive(uint tile) {
        enlist(liveTiles, tile);
        liveUses.append(sweep);
        madeLive += 1;
    }

    void removeLive(uint tile) {
        uint at = tiles.ptr[tile].listIndex;
        liveUses.ptr[at] = liveUses.ptr[liveUses.length - 1];
        liveUses.length -= 1;
        unlist(liveTiles, tile);
    }

    void freeTile(uint tile) {
        unlist(droppedTiles, tile);
        tiles.ptr[tile].edges.release();
        tiles.ptr[tile] = TileRecord.init;
        tiles.ptr[tile].state = TileState.free;
        freeTiles.append(tile);
    }

    void enlist(ref Array!uint list, uint tile) {
        tiles.ptr[tile].listIndex = cast(uint) list.length;
        list.append(tile);
    }

    void unlist(ref Array!uint list, uint tile) {
        uint at = tiles.ptr[tile].listIndex;
        uint last = list.ptr[list.length - 1];
        list.ptr[at] = last;
        tiles.ptr[last].listIndex = at;
        list.length -= 1;
    }

    ref inout(Painted) paintedBy(PaintOwner owner) inout return {
        if (owner.tile.exists) {
            return tiles.ptr[owner.tile.value].painted;
        } else {
            return placed;
        }
    }

    uint takeOrders(uint count) {
        uint first = brushCount;
        brushCount += count;
        return first;
    }

    uint addStroke(PaintOwner owner, NodeId node, Stroke stroke) {
        Painted* painted = &paintedBy(owner);
        if (painted.strokeRuns.length == 0 || painted.strokeRuns.ptr[painted.strokeRuns.length - 1].node != node) {
            painted.strokeRuns.append(StrokeRun(node, cast(uint) painted.strokes.length, 0));
        }
        painted.strokeRuns.ptr[painted.strokeRuns.length - 1].count += 1;
        painted.strokes.append(stroke);
        return cast(uint)(painted.strokeRuns.length - 1);
    }

    void addBrush(PaintOwner owner, uint line, Brush brush) {
        Painted* painted = &paintedBy(owner);
        int lowEdge = edgeOf(brush.box.low.z, dimension);
        int highEdge = edgeOf(brush.box.high.z, dimension);
        uint run = cast(uint) painted.runs.length - 1;
        if (painted.runs.length == 0 || painted.runs.ptr[run].line != line) {
            painted.runs.append(LineRun(line, cast(uint) painted.brushes.length, 0));
            run = cast(uint) painted.runs.length - 1;
            runsOn.ptr[line].append(RunRef(owner, run, lowEdge, highEdge, brush.box.extent));
        } else {
            Array!RunRef* listed = &runsOn.ptr[line];
            size_t at = listed.length - 1;
            while (listed.ptr[at].owner != owner || listed.ptr[at].run != run) {
                at -= 1;
            }
            listed.ptr[at].lowEdge = lowerOf(listed.ptr[at].lowEdge, lowEdge);
            listed.ptr[at].highEdge = higherOf(listed.ptr[at].highEdge, highEdge);
            if (brush.box.isEndless) {
                listed.ptr[at].extent = Extent.endless;
            }
        }
        painted.runs.ptr[run].count += 1;
        painted.brushes.append(brush);
    }

    void dropTile(uint tile) {
        TileRecord* record = &tiles.ptr[tile];
        foreach (index, run; record.painted.runs.slice()) {
            Array!RunRef* listed = &runsOn.ptr[run.line];
            size_t at = 0;
            while (listed.ptr[at].owner != PaintOwner.ofTile(tile) || listed.ptr[at].run != index) {
                at += 1;
            }
            listed.length -= 1;
            listed.ptr[at] = listed.ptr[listed.length];
        }
        record.painted.release();
        removeLive(tile);
        record.state = TileState.dropped;
        enlist(droppedTiles, tile);
    }

    void collectBrushes(uint line, int level, ref Array!Brush into, ref Array!BrushRank ranks) const {
        foreach (listed; runsOn.ptr[line].slice()) {
            if (listed.reachesEdge(level)) {
                const(Painted)* painted = &paintedBy(listed.owner);
                LineRun run = painted.runs.ptr[listed.run];
                ulong tile = tileRank(listed.owner);
                foreach (brush; painted.brushes.ptr[run.first .. run.first + run.count]) {
                    if (brush.box.reachesEdge(level, dimension)) {
                        into.append(brush);
                        ranks.append(BrushRank(tile, brush.order));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    ulong tileRank(PaintOwner owner) const {
        if (owner.tile.exists) {
            const(TileRecord)* tile = &tiles.ptr[owner.tile.value];
            return SplitMix(tile.face.spice() ^ (tile.feature * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER)).next() | TILE_RANK_BIT;
        } else {
            return PLACED_RANK;
        }
    }

    size_t brushTotal() const {
        size_t total = placed.brushes.length;
        foreach (ref tile; tiles.slice()) {
            total += tile.painted.brushes.length;
        }
        return total;
    }

    MaybeIndex!ubyte ensurePaint(Material material) {
        if (!paints[material].exists) {
            paints[material] = MaybeIndex!ubyte.of(cast(ubyte) materials.length);
            materials.append(material);
        }
        return paints[material];
    }

    bool isClaimed(ClaimKey key) const {
        return claims.find(key) !is null;
    }

    bool claim(ClaimKey key) {
        if (isClaimed(key)) {
            return false;
        } else {
            claims.insert(key, Present.init);
            claimCount += 1;
            return true;
        }
    }

    void release() {
        foreach (ref tile; tiles.slice()) {
            tile.painted.release();
            tile.edges.release();
        }
        foreach (ref listed; runsOn.slice()) {
            listed.release();
        }
        lines.release();
        lineStates.release();
        freeLines.release();
        runsOn.release();
        linePins.release();
        placed.release();
        tiles.release();
        liveTiles.release();
        liveUses.release();
        droppedTiles.release();
        freeTiles.release();
        route.release();
        flats.release();
        materials.release();
        lineIndex.release();
        touchedEdges.release();
        claims.release();
    }
}

struct BlueprintBuilder {
    Array!SiteLine known;
    Graph* graph;
    int paintLimit;
    BuilderPhase phase;

    static BlueprintBuilder make(ref Graph target) {
        return BlueprintBuilder(Array!SiteLine.init, &target, 0, BuilderPhase.placing);
    }

    bool isGrowing() const {
        return phase == BuilderPhase.growing;
    }

    void growFrom(uint key) {
        known.clear();
        paintLimit = cast(int) key - PAINT_REACH;
        phase = BuilderPhase.growing;
    }

    ref Blueprint blueprint() {
        return graph.structures.blueprint;
    }

    bool isOpen(uint slot) const {
        return cast(int) graph.depthOf(slot) >= paintLimit;
    }

    SiteLine* ensureLine(SiteFrame site) {
        uint index = 0;
        while (index < known.length && known.ptr[index].site != site) {
            index += 1;
        }
        if (index == known.length) {
            CanonicalSite canonical = graph.view.canonicalOf(site);
            known.append(SiteLine(site, canonical.transform, blueprint.ensureLine(canonical.line, graph.idAt(canonical.line.node.value))));
        }
        return &known.ptr[index];
    }

    PaintResult paint(SiteFrame site, CellBox box, Rhythm rhythm, Material material, Cover cover) {
        SiteLine* found = ensureLine(site);
        ubyte dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
        CellBox canonical = canonicalBox(box, found.transform, dimension);
        int lowEdge = edgeOf(canonical.low.z, dimension);
        int highEdge = edgeOf(canonical.high.z, dimension);
        if (isGrowing && canonical.isEndless) {
            return PaintResult.endless;
        } else {
            bool ahead = true;
            if (isGrowing) {
                bool isClosed(uint slot) {
                    return !isOpen(slot);
                }
                ahead = probeLineAhead!isClosed(graph.view, *found, blueprint.lines.ptr[found.line], lowEdge, highEdge);
            }
            if (!ahead) {
                return PaintResult.behind;
            } else {
                if (canonical.isEndless) {
                    recordEndless(found.line);
                } else {
                    record(*found, lowEdge, highEdge);
                }
                blueprint.keepLine(found.line);
                blueprint.addBrush(PaintOwner.init, found.line, Brush(canonical, canonicalRhythm(rhythm, found.transform, dimension), blueprint.takeOrders(1), Paint(blueprint.ensurePaint(material), cover)));
                return PaintResult.painted;
            }
        }
    }

    void recordEndless(uint line) {
        LineSpec spec = blueprint.lines.ptr[line];
        if (!spec.isEndless()) {
            SlotTouch seed = seedTouch(spec, line);
            (*graph).addPendingTouch(seed.slot, seed.touch);
        }
        blueprint.lines.ptr[line].extent = Extent.endless;
    }

    void record(ref SiteLine found, int lowEdge, int highEdge) {
        uint line = found.line;
        LineSpec spec = blueprint.lines.ptr[line];
        if (!spec.isEndless() && !found.touched.contains(lowEdge, highEdge)) {
            touchEdges(line, spec, lowEdge, highEdge);
            found.touched.include(lowEdge, highEdge);
        }
        blueprint.lines.ptr[line].edges.widen(lowEdge, highEdge);
    }

    void touchEdges(uint line, ref const LineSpec spec, int lowEdge, int highEdge) {
        SlotTouch edge = seedTouch(spec, line);
        foreach (level; lowEdge .. highEdge + 1) {
            LineEdge key = LineEdge(line, level);
            if (!blueprint.isEdgeTouched(key)) {
                edge = graph.view.walkTouch(edge, spec, level);
                NodeId[EDGE_NODES] nodes = void;
                foreach (index, around; graph.view.ensureAroundEdge(edge, spec)) {
                    nodes[index] = graph.idAt(around.slot);
                    (*graph).addPendingTouch(around.slot, around.touch);
                }
                blueprint.touchEdge(key, nodes);
            }
            blueprint.keepEdge(key);
        }
    }

    void stop(SiteFrame site, ColumnSpot spot) {
        blueprint.route.append(RouteStop(site, spot));
        graph.reference(site.node);
    }

    void enter(SiteFrame site, ColumnSpot spot) {
        if (!blueprint.entrance.exists) {
            blueprint.entrance = Maybe!RouteStop.of(RouteStop(site, spot));
            graph.reference(site.node);
        }
    }

    bool claim(ClaimKey key) {
        bool claimed = blueprint.claim(key);
        if (claimed) {
            graph.reference(key.slot);
        }
        return claimed;
    }

    void release() {
        known.release();
    }
}

bool probeLineAhead(alias isClosed)(ref GraphView view, ref SiteLine found, LineSpec spec, int lowEdge, int highEdge) {
    if (found.open.contains(lowEdge, highEdge)) {
        return true;
    } else {
        SlotTouch edge = seedTouch(spec, found.line);
        int level = lowEdge;
        while (level <= highEdge) {
            edge = view.walkTouch(edge, spec, level);
            foreach (around; view.ensureAroundEdge(edge, spec)) {
                if (isClosed(around.slot)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            level += 1;
        }
        found.open.include(lowEdge, highEdge);
        return true;
    }
}

CellBox canonicalBox(CellBox local, LineTransform transform, ubyte dimension) {
    Span x = signedRange(local.low.x, local.high.x, transform.xSign);
    Span y = signedRange(local.low.y, local.high.y, transform.ySign);
    Span z = heightRange(local.low.z, local.high.z, transform, dimension);
    if (transform.order == AxisOrder.swapped) {
        return CellBox(Vec3!int(y.low, x.low, z.low), Vec3!int(y.high, x.high, z.high), local.extent);
    } else {
        return CellBox(Vec3!int(x.low, y.low, z.low), Vec3!int(x.high, y.high, z.high), local.extent);
    }
}

Span signedRange(int low, int high, int sign) {
    if (sign > 0) {
        return Span(low, high);
    } else {
        return Span(-1 - high, -1 - low);
    }
}

Span heightRange(int low, int high, LineTransform transform, ubyte dimension) {
    int offset = transform.offsetLevels * edgeCells(dimension);
    if (transform.zSign > 0) {
        return Span(low + offset, high + offset);
    } else {
        return Span(offset - 1 - high, offset - 1 - low);
    }
}

Rhythm canonicalRhythm(Rhythm local, LineTransform transform, ubyte dimension) {
    int offset = transform.offsetLevels * edgeCells(dimension);
    if (local.repeat == Repeat.always) {
        return local;
    } else if (transform.zSign > 0) {
        return Rhythm(local.period, local.phase + offset, local.span);
    } else {
        return Rhythm(local.period, offset - local.phase - local.span, local.span);
    }
}

int edgeOf(int height, ubyte dimension) {
    return floorDivision(height, edgeCells(dimension));
}

int floorDivision(int value, int divisor) {
    int quotient = value / divisor;
    if (value % divisor != 0 && value < 0) {
        quotient -= 1;
    }
    return quotient;
}

/// file: source/common/worldgen/building.d
module common.worldgen.building;

import core.stdc.stdlib : calloc, free, malloc;
import base.array : Array;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.worldgen.blueprint : Brush, BrushRank, CellBox, Cover, LineSpec, Paint, Painted;
import common.worldgen.strokes : Stroke, StrokeReach, StrokeRun;
import common.worldgen.structure : ColumnChunk, LineTouch, isOnTouch, isTouchInRange;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, Corner, NODE_RADIUS;
import geometry.lorentz : Vec4;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum uint MAX_LINES_AT_CORNER = 3;

struct NodeCells {
    ubyte dimension;

    int cellsPerChunk() const {
        return dimension * dimension * dimension;
    }

    int cellIndex(Vec3!int cell) const {
        return (cell.x * dimension + cell.y) * dimension + cell.z;
    }
}

struct PlanLine {
    LineSpec spec;
    LineTouch touch;
    uint first;
    uint count;
}

struct BuildingPlan {
    Array!PlanLine lines;
    Array!Brush brushes;
    Array!BrushRank ranks;
    Array!Material materials;
    Array!Stroke strokes;
    ubyte dimension;

    static BuildingPlan make(ref const Graph graph, uint slot) {
        BuildingPlan plan;
        plan.dimension = graph.layout.dimension;
        foreach (touch; graph.structures.touchesAt(slot)) {
            LineSpec spec = graph.structures.blueprint.lines.ptr[touch.line];
            if (isTouchInRange(touch, spec)) {
                uint first = cast(uint) plan.brushes.length;
                graph.structures.blueprint.collectBrushes(touch.line, touch.level, plan.brushes, plan.ranks);
                plan.lines.append(PlanLine(spec, touch, first, cast(uint) plan.brushes.length - first));
            }
        }
        plan.materials.appendAll(graph.structures.blueprint.materials.slice());
        graph.collectStrokes(slot, plan.strokes);
        return plan;
    }

    void release() {
        lines.release();
        brushes.release();
        ranks.release();
        materials.release();
        strokes.release();
    }
}

void collectStrokes(ref const Graph graph, uint slot, ref Array!Stroke into) {
    const(StrokeReach)[] reaches = graph.structures.strokes.reachesAt(graph.idAt(slot));
    Array!BrushRank ranks;
    Array!uint order;
    foreach (index, reach; reaches) {
        ranks.append(BrushRank(graph.structures.blueprint.tileRank(reach.owner), reach.run));
        size_t at = order.length;
        order.append(cast(uint) index);
        while (at > 0 && ranks.ptr[index].isBefore(ranks.ptr[order.ptr[at - 1]])) {
            order.ptr[at] = order.ptr[at - 1];
            at -= 1;
        }
        order.ptr[at] = cast(uint) index;
    }
    foreach (index; order.slice()) {
        StrokeReach reach = reaches[index];
        const(Painted)* painted = &graph.structures.blueprint.paintedBy(reach.owner);
        StrokeRun run = painted.strokeRuns.ptr[reach.run];
        Vec4!float center = (reach.motion.inverse() * Vec4!double.origin()).as!float();
        foreach (stroke; painted.strokes.ptr[run.first .. run.first + run.count]) {
            if (stroke.mayBeWithin(center, NODE_RADIUS)) {
                Stroke moved = stroke.moved(reach.motion);
                if (moved.isWithin(Vec4!float.origin(), NODE_RADIUS)) {
                    into.append(moved);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ranks.release();
    order.release();
}

struct ChunkLines {
    ColumnChunk[MAX_LINES_AT_CORNER] columns;
    CellBox[MAX_LINES_AT_CORNER] bounds;
    uint[MAX_LINES_AT_CORNER] lines;
    uint count;

    static ChunkLines make(ref const BuildingPlan plan, Corner corner) {
        ChunkLines found;
        foreach (index, line; plan.lines.slice()) {
            if (isOnTouch(line.touch, line.spec, corner)) {
                assert(found.count < MAX_LINES_AT_CORNER);
                ColumnChunk column = ColumnChunk.fromTouch(line.touch, line.spec, corner, plan.dimension);
                found.columns[found.count] = column;
                found.bounds[found.count] = boundsOf(column, plan.dimension);
                found.lines[found.count] = cast(uint) index;
                found.count += 1;
            }
        }
        return found;
    }
}

struct BrushUse {
    uint brush;
    uint chunk;
}

struct Building {
    Paint** chunkPaints;
    Array!Material materials;
    Array!Stroke strokes;
    NodeCells cells;

    static Building make(ref const BuildingPlan plan) {
        Building building;
        building.cells = NodeCells(plan.dimension);
        building.materials.appendAll(plan.materials.slice());
        building.strokes.appendAll(plan.strokes.slice());
        building.stamp(plan);
        return building;
    }

    void stamp(ref const BuildingPlan plan) {
        Array!BrushUse uses;
        foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
            Corner corner = cast(Corner) index;
            ChunkLines found = ChunkLines.make(plan, corner);
            uses.clear();
            foreach (chunk; 0 .. found.count) {
                PlanLine line = plan.lines.ptr[found.lines[chunk]];
                foreach (brush; line.first .. line.first + line.count) {
                    if (plan.brushes.ptr[brush].box.overlaps(found.bounds[chunk])) {
                        uses.append(BrushUse(brush, chunk));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (uses.length > 0) {
                sortByRank(uses.slice(), plan.ranks.slice());
                stampChunk(corner, found, uses.slice(), plan.brushes.slice());
            }
        }
        uses.release();
    }

    void stampChunk(Corner corner, ref const ChunkLines found, const(BrushUse)[] uses, const(Brush)[] brushes) {
        if (chunkPaints is null) {
            chunkPaints = cast(Paint**) calloc(CORNER_COUNT, (Paint*).sizeof);
        }
        Paint* paints = cast(Paint*) malloc(cells.cellsPerChunk() * Paint.sizeof);
        chunkPaints[corner] = paints;
        Vec3!int[MAX_LINES_AT_CORNER] columns = void;
        foreach (x; 0 .. cells.dimension) {
            foreach (y; 0 .. cells.dimension) {
                foreach (z; 0 .. cells.dimension) {
                    Vec3!int cell = Vec3!int(x, y, z);
                    foreach (chunk; 0 .. found.count) {
                        columns[chunk] = found.columns[chunk].columnOf(cell);
                    }
                    Paint paint = Paint.init;
                    foreach (use; uses) {
                        if (brushes[use.brush].covers(columns[use.chunk])) {
                            paint = brushes[use.brush].paint;
                        }
                    }
                    paints[cells.cellIndex(cell)] = paint;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    size_t paintBytes() const {
        size_t bytes = 0;
        if (chunkPaints !is null) {
            foreach (paints; chunkPaints[0 .. CORNER_COUNT]) {
                if (paints !is null) {
                    bytes += cells.cellsPerChunk() * Paint.sizeof;
                }
            }
        }
        return bytes;
    }

    void release() {
        if (chunkPaints !is null) {
            foreach (paints; chunkPaints[0 .. CORNER_COUNT]) {
                free(paints);
            }
            free(chunkPaints);
            chunkPaints = null;
        }
        materials.release();
        strokes.release();
    }

    Material materialAt(Corner corner, Vec3!int cell, Material existing) const {
        Paint paint = Paint.init;
        if (chunkPaints !is null && chunkPaints[corner] !is null) {
            paint = chunkPaints[corner][cells.cellIndex(cell)];
        }
        if (!paint.material.exists || (paint.cover == Cover.intoAir && existing != Material.none)) {
            return existing;
        } else {
            return materials.ptr[paint.material.value];
        }
    }
}

void sortByRank(BrushUse[] uses, const(BrushRank)[] ranks) {
    foreach (index; 1 .. uses.length) {
        BrushUse held = uses[index];
        size_t slot = index;
        while (slot > 0 && ranks[held.brush].isBefore(ranks[uses[slot - 1].brush])) {
            uses[slot] = uses[slot - 1];
            slot -= 1;
        }
        uses[slot] = held;
    }
}

CellBox boundsOf(ref const ColumnChunk column, ubyte dimension) {
    Vec3!int first = column.columnOf(Vec3!int(0, 0, 0));
    Vec3!int last = column.columnOf(Vec3!int(dimension - 1, dimension - 1, dimension - 1));
    CellBox bounds;
    foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
        bounds.low[axis] = lowerOf(first[axis], last[axis]);
        bounds.high[axis] = higherOf(first[axis], last[axis]);
    }
    return bounds;
}

/// file: source/common/worldgen/climate.d
module common.worldgen.climate;

import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;
import base.splitmix : SplitMix;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.view : GraphView;
import geometry.honeycomb : Corner, Face, faces;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum float RUGGED_THRESHOLD = 0.4f;
enum float MOUNTAIN_HEIGHT = 2.5f;
enum float LAPSE_RATE = 0.3f;
enum float COVER_DEPTH = 0.06f;
enum float SOIL_DEPTH = 0.4f;
enum float SNOW_WARMTH = -0.45f;
enum float WATER_LEVEL = -0.6f;
enum float BEACH_HEIGHT = 0.08f;
enum float DEEP_WATER = 0.5f;
enum float ROCKY_RELIEF = 2.2f;
enum float WARMTH_CLASS_LIMIT = 0.35f;

struct Process {
    float keep;
    float spread;
    ulong salt;
}

immutable Process BROAD_RELIEF = Process(0.92f, 0.25f, 0x51ED2701);
immutable Process LOCAL_RELIEF = Process(0.5f, 0.25f, 0x7A3D9C11);
immutable Process HEAT = Process(0.94f, 0.3f, 0x2B992DD3);
immutable Process WETNESS = Process(0.94f, 0.3f, 0x6C8E9CF5);
immutable Process STRATA = Process(0.8f, 0.25f, 0x3C6EF372);
immutable Process RUGGEDNESS = Process(0.9f, 0.2f, 0x1F83D9AB);
immutable float[3] ROCK_BAND_DEPTHS = [1.2f, 2.6f, 4.5f];
immutable float[2] WETNESS_CLASS_LIMITS = [-0.2f, 0.3f];

immutable Material[2][3][4] ROCKS = [
    [[Material.sandstone, Material.redSandstone], [Material.shale, Material.shale], [Material.limestone, Material.limestone]],
    [[Material.slate, Material.slate], [Material.dolomite, Material.marble], [Material.marble, Material.marble]],
    [[Material.granite, Material.granite], [Material.diorite, Material.diorite], [Material.andesite, Material.andesite]],
    [[Material.gabbro, Material.olivine], [Material.basalt, Material.basalt], [Material.gabbro, Material.gabbro]],
];

float boundOf(Process process) {
    return process.spread / (1 - process.keep);
}

float mountainOf(float ruggedness) {
    return MOUNTAIN_HEIGHT * higherOf(0, ruggedness - RUGGED_THRESHOLD);
}

enum float RELIEF_BOUND = boundOf(BROAD_RELIEF) + boundOf(LOCAL_RELIEF) + MOUNTAIN_HEIGHT * (boundOf(RUGGEDNESS) - RUGGED_THRESHOLD);
enum float RELIEF_SLACK = 4 * (BROAD_RELIEF.spread + LOCAL_RELIEF.spread + MOUNTAIN_HEIGHT * RUGGEDNESS.spread);

struct NodeClimate {
    float broad = 0;
    float local = 0;
    float heat = 0;
    float wetness = 0;
    float strata = 0;
    float ruggedness = 0;
    float calm = 1;

    static NodeClimate fromParents(const(NodeClimate)[] parents, ulong spice) {
        NodeClimate mean;
        foreach (parent; parents) {
            mean.broad += parent.broad / parents.length;
            mean.local += parent.local / parents.length;
            mean.heat += parent.heat / parents.length;
            mean.wetness += parent.wetness / parents.length;
            mean.strata += parent.strata / parents.length;
            mean.ruggedness += parent.ruggedness / parents.length;
        }
        return NodeClimate(stepped(mean.broad, BROAD_RELIEF, spice), stepped(mean.local, LOCAL_RELIEF, spice), stepped(mean.heat, HEAT, spice), stepped(mean.wetness, WETNESS, spice), stepped(mean.strata, STRATA, spice), stepped(mean.ruggedness, RUGGEDNESS, spice));
    }

    Climate climate() const {
        return Climate(calm * (broad + local + mountainOf(ruggedness)), heat, wetness, strata);
    }
}

float stepped(float mean, Process process, ulong spice) {
    return process.keep * mean + process.spread * noiseOf(spice ^ process.salt);
}

float noiseOf(ulong seed) {
    return SplitMix(seed).roll() * 2 - 1;
}

struct Climate {
    float relief = 0;
    float heat = 0;
    float wetness = 0;
    float strata = 0;

    static Climate lerp(Climate a, Climate b, float t) {
        return Climate(a.relief + (b.relief - a.relief) * t, a.heat + (b.heat - a.heat) * t, a.wetness + (b.wetness - a.wetness) * t, a.strata + (b.strata - a.strata) * t);
    }

    static Climate mean(const(Climate)[] values) {
        Climate sum;
        foreach (value; values) {
            sum = Climate(sum.relief + value.relief / values.length, sum.heat + value.heat / values.length, sum.wetness + value.wetness / values.length, sum.strata + value.strata / values.length);
        }
        return sum;
    }

    float warmth() const {
        return heat - LAPSE_RATE * relief;
    }
}

struct CubeClimate {
    Climate[8] corners;
    Climate lowest;
    Climate highest;

    static CubeClimate fromAround(ref const NodeClimate[8] around) {
        CubeClimate cube;
        foreach (index; 0 .. 8) {
            uint onFaces = ~index & 7;
            Climate[8] sharing;
            uint count = 0;
            foreach (crossed; 0 .. 8) {
                if ((crossed & ~onFaces) == 0) {
                    sharing[count] = around[crossed].climate();
                    count += 1;
                }
            }
            cube.corners[index] = Climate.mean(sharing[0 .. count]);
        }
        cube.lowest = cube.corners[0];
        cube.highest = cube.corners[0];
        foreach (corner; cube.corners[1 .. $]) {
            cube.lowest = Climate(lowerOf(cube.lowest.relief, corner.relief), lowerOf(cube.lowest.heat, corner.heat), lowerOf(cube.lowest.wetness, corner.wetness), lowerOf(cube.lowest.strata, corner.strata));
            cube.highest = Climate(higherOf(cube.highest.relief, corner.relief), higherOf(cube.highest.heat, corner.heat), higherOf(cube.highest.wetness, corner.wetness), higherOf(cube.highest.strata, corner.strata));
        }
        return cube;
    }

    static CubeClimate ensureAround(ref GraphView view, uint slot, Corner chunk) {
        Face[3] sides = chunk.faces;
        NodeClimate[8] around;
        foreach (crossed; 0 .. 8) {
            uint node = slot;
            foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
                if ((crossed & (1u << axis)) != 0) {
                    node = view.ensureNeighborSlot(node, sides[axis]);
                }
            }
            around[crossed] = view.ensureState(node).climate;
        }
        return fromAround(around);
    }

    Climate at(Vec3!float cube) const {
        Climate[4] alongX;
        foreach (index; 0 .. 4) {
            alongX[index] = Climate.lerp(corners[2 * index], corners[2 * index + 1], cube.x);
        }
        Climate low = Climate.lerp(alongX[0], alongX[1], cube.y);
        Climate high = Climate.lerp(alongX[2], alongX[3], cube.y);
        return Climate.lerp(low, high, cube.z);
    }

    Climate mean() const {
        return Climate.mean(corners[]);
    }

    CubeClimate reachingFlat() const {
        CubeClimate reaching = this;
        reaching.lowest.relief = lowerOf(lowest.relief, 0.0f);
        reaching.highest.relief = higherOf(highest.relief, 0.0f);
        return reaching;
    }
}

Material groundAt(float depth, float riser, Climate climate) {
    float warmth = climate.warmth();
    if (depth < higherOf(COVER_DEPTH, lowerOf(riser, SOIL_DEPTH))) {
        return coverOf(warmth, climate.wetness, climate.relief);
    } else if (depth < SOIL_DEPTH) {
        return soilOf(warmth, climate.wetness, climate.relief);
    } else {
        return ROCKS[rockBand(depth + climate.strata)][wetnessClass(climate.wetness)][warmthClass(warmth)];
    }
}

Material openAt(float altitude, Climate climate) {
    if (altitude >= WATER_LEVEL) {
        return Material.none;
    } else if (climate.warmth() < SNOW_WARMTH) {
        return Material.ice;
    } else {
        return Material.water;
    }
}

bool isDesert(float warmth, float wetness) {
    return warmth > 0.45f && wetness < -0.35f;
}

bool isRedDesert(float warmth, float wetness) {
    return isDesert(warmth, wetness) && wetness < -0.65f;
}

bool isShore(float relief) {
    return relief < WATER_LEVEL + BEACH_HEIGHT;
}

Material coverOf(float warmth, float wetness, float relief) {
    if (warmth < SNOW_WARMTH) {
        return Material.snow;
    } else if (relief > ROCKY_RELIEF) {
        return Material.andesite;
    } else if (relief < WATER_LEVEL - DEEP_WATER) {
        return Material.gravel;
    } else if (isShore(relief)) {
        return Material.sand;
    } else if (warmth < -0.15f && wetness < -0.2f) {
        return Material.gravel;
    } else if (warmth < -0.15f) {
        return Material.coarseGrass;
    } else if (isRedDesert(warmth, wetness)) {
        return Material.redSand;
    } else if (isDesert(warmth, wetness)) {
        return Material.sand;
    } else if (wetness > 0.75f && warmth > 0.1f) {
        return Material.mud;
    } else if (wetness > 0.45f && warmth > 0.1f) {
        return Material.lushGrass;
    } else if (wetness > 0.45f) {
        return Material.mudGrass;
    } else if (warmth > 0.25f && wetness < -0.05f) {
        return Material.tanGrass;
    } else {
        return Material.grass;
    }
}

Material soilOf(float warmth, float wetness, float relief) {
    if (relief > ROCKY_RELIEF) {
        return Material.andesite;
    } else if (isShore(relief)) {
        return Material.sand;
    } else if (isRedDesert(warmth, wetness)) {
        return Material.redSand;
    } else if (isDesert(warmth, wetness)) {
        return Material.sand;
    } else if (wetness > 0.5f) {
        return Material.clay;
    } else if (wetness > 0.2f) {
        return Material.clayLoam;
    } else if (wetness > -0.1f) {
        return Material.dirt;
    } else {
        return Material.sandyLoam;
    }
}

uint rockBand(float depth) {
    uint band = 0;
    while (band < ROCK_BAND_DEPTHS.length && depth >= ROCK_BAND_DEPTHS[band]) {
        band += 1;
    }
    return band;
}

uint wetnessClass(float wetness) {
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < WETNESS_CLASS_LIMITS.length && wetness >= WETNESS_CLASS_LIMITS[index]) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return index;
}

uint warmthClass(float warmth) {
    if (warmth >= WARMTH_CLASS_LIMIT) {
        return 1;
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}

Maybe!Material uniformRock(float shallowest, float deepest, Climate lowest, Climate highest) {
    float coldest = lowest.heat - LAPSE_RATE * highest.relief;
    float warmest = highest.heat - LAPSE_RATE * lowest.relief;
    if (shallowest >= SOIL_DEPTH && rockBand(shallowest + lowest.strata) == rockBand(deepest + highest.strata) && wetnessClass(lowest.wetness) == wetnessClass(highest.wetness) && warmthClass(coldest) == warmthClass(warmest)) {
        return Maybe!Material.of(ROCKS[rockBand(shallowest + lowest.strata)][wetnessClass(lowest.wetness)][warmthClass(coldest)]);
    } else {
        return Maybe!Material.init;
    }
}

struct PlaneWorld {
    float tiltRadians;
}

struct StructureWorld {
    char[STRUCTURE_NAME_CAPACITY] text;
    size_t length;

    static StructureWorld fromName(const(char)[] name) {
        assert(name.length <= STRUCTURE_NAME_CAPACITY);
        StructureWorld world = StructureWorld(' ', name.length);
        memcpy(world.text.ptr, name.ptr, name.length);
        return world;
    }

    const(char)[] name() const return {
        return text[0 .. length];
    }
}

struct Worldgen {
    union {
        PlaneWorld plane;
        StructureWorld structure;
    }
    WorldgenKind kind;

    static Worldgen makeTerrain() {
        return Worldgen.init;
    }

    static Worldgen fromPlane(PlaneWorld plane) {
        Worldgen worldgen;
        worldgen.plane = plane;
        worldgen.kind = WorldgenKind.plane;
        return worldgen;
    }

    static Worldgen fromStructure(StructureWorld structure) {
        Worldgen worldgen;
        worldgen.structure = structure;
        worldgen.kind = WorldgenKind.structure;
        return worldgen;
    }

    bool hasPlaneGround() const {
        return kind != WorldgenKind.terrain;
    }

    bool hasStructure() const {
        return kind != WorldgenKind.plane;
    }

    const(char)[] structureName() const return {
        if (kind == WorldgenKind.structure) {
            return structure.name();
        } else {
            return TERRAIN_STRUCTURE;
        }
    }

    float groundTiltRadians() const {
        float tilt = 0;
        final switch (kind) {
            case WorldgenKind.terrain:
            case WorldgenKind.structure:
                break;
            case WorldgenKind.plane:
                tilt = plane.tiltRadians;
                break;
        }
        return tilt;
    }
}

float degreesToRadians(float degrees) {
    return cast(float)(degrees * RADIANS_PER_DEGREE);
}

struct NodeState {
    Plane surface;
    Plane reference;
    NodeClimate climate;
    WildGenes wild;

    static NodeState fromParents(ref GraphView view, uint slot) {
        NodeState state = NodeState.uncalmed(view, slot);
        state.climate.calm = view.calmAt(slot);
        return state;
    }

    static NodeState uncalmed(ref GraphView view, uint slot) {
        ParentList parents = view.parents(slot);
        if (parents.count == 0) {
            const(char)[] name = view.worldgen.structureName();
            return NodeState(Plane.ofFace(Face.first), Plane.ofFace(firstSideAmong(ringFaces(Face.first))), NodeClimate.init, WildGenes.ofRoot(murmurHash3(cast(const(ubyte)[]) name).first));
        } else {
            NodeClimate[MAX_PARENTS] climates;
            WildGenes[MAX_PARENTS] wilds;
            foreach (index, link; parents.links[0 .. parents.count]) {
                NodeState parent = view.ensureState(link.slot);
                climates[index] = parent.climate;
                wilds[index] = parent.wild;
            }
            NodeState first = view.ensureState(parents.links[0].slot);
            Face side = parents.links[0].side;
            Plane surface = first.surface.reflectAcross(side).snappedToFaces();
            Plane reference = first.reference.reflectAcross(side).snappedToFaces();
            ulong spice = view.idAt(slot).spice();
            return NodeState(surface, reference, NodeClimate.fromParents(climates[0 .. parents.count], spice), inheritedGenes(wilds[0 .. parents.count], spice));
        }
    }
}

struct ValueRange {
    float low;
    float high;
}

struct ChunkStructure {
    const(Building)* building;
    Standing standing;

    bool isKnown() const {
        return standing != Standing.unknown;
    }
}

enum MaterialPass : ubyte {
    deferring,
    resolving,
}

struct ChunkParams {
    const(Building)* building;
    const(Stroke)[] strokes;
    ulong nodeSpice;
    Grounds grounds;
    FlatLines flats;
    CubeClimate climate;
    Plane reference;
    float slopeTangent;
    float slopeSecant;
    ChunkLayout layout;
    Corner chunk;
    Standing standing;
    MaterialPass materials;

    bool hasStructure() const {
        return standing == Standing.inside;
    }

    static ChunkParams make(ref GraphView view, uint slot, Corner chunk) {
        ChunkStructure structure = view.ensureChunkStructure(slot);
        assert(structure.isKnown);
        NodeState state = view.ensureState(slot);
        FlatLines flats = flatLinesNear(view.horospheres, view.ensureHorospheresAt(slot), cubeCenter(chunk));
        CubeClimate climate = CubeClimate.ensureAround(view, slot, chunk);
        if (flats.count > 0) {
            climate = climate.reachingFlat();
        }
        return ChunkParams(
            structure.building,
            strokesNear(strokesIn(structure.building), chunk),
            view.idAt(slot).spice(),
            view.ensureGrounds(slot),
            flats,
            climate,
            state.reference,
            tanf(view.worldgen.groundTiltRadians()),
            1.0f / cosf(view.worldgen.groundTiltRadians()),
            view.layout,
            chunk,
            structure.standing,
            MaterialPass.deferring,
        );
    }

    ubyte dimension() const {
        return layout.dimension;
    }

    ref const(Ground) ground(uint index) const return {
        return grounds.items[index];
    }

    ValueRange altitudes(uint index) const {
        float center = ground(index).surface.distanceToChunk(chunk, Vec3!float(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f));
        return ValueRange(center - CUBE_GRID_RADIUS, center + CUBE_GRID_RADIUS);
    }

    bool isTilted(uint index) const {
        return index == BASE_GROUND && slopeTangent != 0;
    }

    uint rivalsOf(uint index) const {
        float highest = altitudes(index).high;
        uint rivals = 0;
        foreach (other; 0 .. grounds.count) {
            if (other != index && !(altitudes(other).low >= highest)) {
                rivals += 1;
            }
        }
        return rivals;
    }

    float levelFrom(uint index, float height, Point!float point) const {
        if (!isTilted(index)) {
            return height;
        } else {
            float across = asinhf(sinhf(reference.distanceTo(point)) / coshf(height));
            return atanf(sinhf(height)) + slopeTangent * across;
        }
    }

    ValueRange groundRange(uint index) const {
        Point!float middle = chunkPoint(chunk, Vec3!float(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f));
        float center = levelFrom(index, ground(index).surface.distanceTo(middle), middle);
        float radius = CUBE_GRID_RADIUS;
        if (isTilted(index)) {
            radius = radius * slopeSecant;
        }
        return ValueRange(center - radius, center + radius);
    }

    float terrainCeiling(uint index) const {
        if (ground(index).fill == Fill.flat) {
            return 0;
        } else if (climate.lowest.relief < WATER_LEVEL) {
            return higherOf(climate.highest.relief, WATER_LEVEL);
        } else {
            return climate.highest.relief;
        }
    }

    bool isClearOf(uint index) const {
        return ground(index).fill == Fill.none || groundRange(index).low > terrainCeiling(index);
    }

    bool isFullOf(uint index) const {
        float highest = groundRange(index).high;
        final switch (ground(index).fill) {
            case Fill.none:
                return false;
            case Fill.flat:
                return highest < 0;
            case Fill.terrain:
                return isProvenBelowTerrain(highest) && rivalsOf(index) == 0;
        }
    }

    bool isClearOfAll() const {
        uint index = 0;
        while (index < grounds.count && isClearOf(index)) {
            index += 1;
        }
        return index == grounds.count;
    }

    bool isFullOfAny() const {
        uint index = 0;
        while (index < grounds.count && !isFullOf(index)) {
            index += 1;
        }
        return index < grounds.count;
    }

    bool isProvenClear() const {
        return !hasStructure && strokes.length == 0 && isClearOfAll();
    }

    bool isProvenBelowTerrain(float highest) const {
        return climate.lowest.relief > highest;
    }

    Occupancy predictOccupancy() const {
        Occupancy predicted = Occupancy.unknown;
        if (!hasStructure && strokes.length == 0) {
            if (isClearOfAll()) {
                predicted = Occupancy.empty;
            } else if (isFullOfAny()) {
                predicted = Occupancy.full;
            }
        }
        return predicted;
    }

    bool isUniformlyFilled(Occupancy predicted) const {
        return predicted == Occupancy.empty || (predicted == Occupancy.full && grounds.count == 1);
    }

    Maybe!Material provenUniformRock(ValueRange altitudes) const {
        return uniformRock(climate.lowest.relief - altitudes.high, climate.highest.relief - altitudes.low, climate.lowest, climate.highest);
    }

    GeneratedVoxels generateVoxels(Yield yield = Yield.init) const {
        TerrainGenerator generator = TerrainGenerator(Voxels.filled(Material.none), this, SplitMix(nodeSpice ^ chunk), yield);
        foreach (index; 0 .. grounds.count) {
            final switch (ground(index).fill) {
                case Fill.none:
                    break;
                case Fill.flat:
                    generator.generateFlat(index);
                    break;
                case Fill.terrain:
                    generator.generateTerrain(index);
                    generator.generateVeins();
                    generator.generateTrees(index);
                    generator.generatePlants(index);
                    break;
            }
        }
        generator.generateStrokes();
        generator.generateStructure();
        generator.voxels.compress(dimension);
        return GeneratedVoxels(generator.voxels, generator.materials);
    }
}

const(Stroke)[] strokesIn(const(Building)* building) {
    if (building is null) {
        return null;
    } else {
        return building.strokes.slice();
    }
}

const(Stroke)[] strokesNear(const(Stroke)[] strokes, Corner chunk) {
    Vec4!float center = cubeCenter(chunk).v;
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < strokes.length && !strokes[index].isWithin(center, CUBE_RADIUS)) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index < strokes.length) {
        return strokes;
    } else {
        return null;
    }
}

struct GeneratedVoxels {
    Voxels voxels;
    Materials materials;
}

struct Yield {
    void function(void* context) call;
    void* context;

    void now() {
        if (call !is null) {
            call(context);
        }
    }
}

struct TerrainGenerator {
    Voxels voxels;
    ChunkParams params;
    SplitMix rng;
    Yield yield;
    Materials materials;
    Readiness cells;
    Mat4!float toNode;
    PlaneMeasure[MAX_GROUNDS] surfaces;
    float[ubyte.max] centers;

    void prepareCells() {
        if (cells == Readiness.pending) {
            toNode = params.chunk.cubeToNode;
            foreach (index; 0 .. params.grounds.count) {
                surfaces[index] = params.ground(index).surface.measure();
            }
            foreach (cell; 0 .. params.dimension) {
                centers[cell] = params.layout.cellCenterAlong(cell);
            }
            cells = Readiness.ready;
        }
    }

    Vec3!float centerOf(uint x, uint y, uint z) const {
        return Vec3!float(centers[x], centers[y], centers[z]);
    }

    bool isNearest(uint ground, float own, Point!float point) const {
        uint other = 0;
        while (other < params.grounds.count && (other == ground || surfaces[other].distanceTo(point) >= own)) {
            other += 1;
        }
        return other == params.grounds.count;
    }

    void generateTerrain(uint ground) {
        ubyte dimension = params.dimension;
        ValueRange altitudes = params.altitudes(ground);
        if (altitudes.low <= params.terrainCeiling(ground)) {
            Maybe!Material rock = params.provenUniformRock(altitudes);
            uint rivals = params.rivalsOf(ground);
            if (rock.exists && rivals == 0) {
                fillEmpty(rock.value);
            } else if (params.materials == MaterialPass.deferring && !params.hasStructure && params.strokes.length == 0 && rivals == 0 && params.isProvenBelowTerrain(altitudes.high)) {
                voxels = Voxels.filled(DEFERRED_STAND_IN_MATERIAL);
                materials = Materials.deferred;
            } else {
                prepareCells();
                double sinhClear = sinh(higherOf(params.climate.highest.relief, WATER_LEVEL) + CLEAR_MARGIN);
                foreach (x; 0 .. dimension) {
                    foreach (y; 0 .. dimension) {
                        foreach (z; 0 .. dimension) {
                            size_t index = cellIndex(dimension, x, y, z);
                            if (voxels.at(index) == Material.none) {
                                Point!float point = cubePoint(toNode, centerOf(x, y, z));
                                if (!(surfaces[ground].sinhDistanceTo(point) > sinhClear)) {
                                    float altitude = surfaces[ground].distanceTo(point);
                                    if (rivals == 0 || isNearest(ground, altitude, point)) {
                                        generateTerrainVoxel(ground, Vec3!uint(x, y, z), altitude, index);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    yield.now();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void generateVeins() {
        if (materials != Materials.deferred && !voxels.isFilledWith(Material.none)) {
            SplitMix veins = SplitMix(params.nodeSpice ^ (cast(ulong) params.chunk << CHUNK_ROLL_SHIFT) ^ VEIN_SALT);
            if (veins.roll() < VEIN_ODDS) {
                ubyte dimension = params.dimension;
                Vec3!int center = Vec3!int(cast(int)(veins.next() % dimension), cast(int)(veins.next() % dimension), cast(int)(veins.next() % dimension));
                Material rock = voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, center.x, center.y, center.z));
                Material ore = oreFor(rock);
                if (ore != Material.none) {
                    foreach (x; higherOf(center.x - VEIN_RADIUS, 0) .. lowerOf(center.x + VEIN_RADIUS + 1, cast(int) dimension)) {
                        foreach (y; higherOf(center.y - VEIN_RADIUS, 0) .. lowerOf(center.y + VEIN_RADIUS + 1, cast(int) dimension)) {
                            foreach (z; higherOf(center.z - VEIN_RADIUS, 0) .. lowerOf(center.z + VEIN_RADIUS + 1, cast(int) dimension)) {
                                size_t index = cellIndex(dimension, x, y, z);
                                int dx = x - center.x;
                                int dy = y - center.y;
                                int dz = z - center.z;
                                if (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= VEIN_RADIUS * VEIN_RADIUS && voxels.at(index) == rock && SplitMix(params.nodeSpice ^ VEIN_SALT ^ (cast(ulong) params.chunk << CHUNK_ROLL_SHIFT) ^ index).roll() < VEIN_FILL) {
                                    voxels.toDense(dimension)[index] = ore;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void fillEmpty(Material material) {
        if (voxels.isFilledWith(Material.none)) {
            voxels = Voxels.filled(material);
        } else if (!voxels.isUniform()) {
            ubyte dimension = params.dimension;
            foreach (x; 0 .. dimension) {
                foreach (y; 0 .. dimension) {
                    foreach (z; 0 .. dimension) {
                        setIfEmpty(Vec3!int(x, y, z), material);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void generateFlat(uint ground) {
        ubyte dimension = params.dimension;
        ValueRange range = params.groundRange(ground);
        if (range.high < 0) {
            fillEmpty(Material.dirt);
        } else if (range.low <= 0) {
            prepareCells();
            foreach (x; 0 .. dimension) {
                foreach (y; 0 .. dimension) {
                    foreach (z; 0 .. dimension) {
                        Point!float point = cubePoint(toNode, centerOf(x, y, z));
                        if (params.levelFrom(ground, surfaces[ground].distanceTo(point), point) < 0) {
                            setIfEmpty(Vec3!int(x, y, z), Material.dirt);
                        }
                    }
                }
                yield.now();
            }
        }
    }

    void generateStructure() {
        if (params.hasStructure) {
            ubyte dimension = params.dimension;
            foreach (x; 0 .. dimension) {
                foreach (y; 0 .. dimension) {
                    foreach (z; 0 .. dimension) {
                        size_t index = cellIndex(dimension, x, y, z);
                        Material existing = voxels.at(index);
                        Material material = params.building.materialAt(params.chunk, Vec3!int(x, y, z), existing);
                        if (material != existing) {
                            voxels.toDense(dimension)[index] = material;
                        }
                    }
                }
                yield.now();
            }
        }
    }

    void generateStrokes() {
        if (params.strokes.length > 0) {
            ubyte dimension = params.dimension;
            Array!Stroke near;
            Vec4!float center = cubeCenter(params.chunk).v;
            foreach (stroke; params.strokes) {
                if (stroke.isWithin(center, CUBE_RADIUS)) {
                    near.append(stroke);
                }
            }
            prepareCells();
            foreach (x; 0 .. dimension) {
                foreach (y; 0 .. dimension) {
                    foreach (z; 0 .. dimension) {
                        Vec4!float point = cubePoint(toNode, centerOf(x, y, z)).v;
                        size_t index = cellIndex(dimension, x, y, z);
                        Material existing = voxels.at(index);
                        Material material = existing;
                        float roll = cellRoll(index);
                        foreach (ref stroke; near.slice()) {
                            if ((stroke.form == StrokeForm.solid || material == Material.none) && stroke.holds(point, roll)) {
                                material = stroke.material;
                            }
                        }
                        if (material != existing) {
                            voxels.toDense(dimension)[index] = material;
                        }
                    }
                }
                yield.now();
            }
            near.release();
        }
    }

    float cellRoll(size_t index) const {
        return SplitMix(params.nodeSpice ^ (cast(ulong) params.chunk << CHUNK_ROLL_SHIFT) ^ index).roll();
    }

    Climate climateOfCell(Vec3!uint cell) const {
        Vec3!float center = centerOf(cell.x, cell.y, cell.z);
        Climate here = params.climate.at(center);
        here.relief = here.relief * params.flats.reliefShareAt(cubePoint(toNode, center));
        return here;
    }

    float depthAt(uint ground, Vec3!uint cell) const {
        return climateOfCell(cell).relief - surfaces[ground].distanceTo(cubePoint(toNode, centerOf(cell.x, cell.y, cell.z)));
    }

    float riserAt(uint ground, Vec3!uint cell, float depth) const {
        float most = 0;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
            Vec3!uint beside = cell;
            if (cell[axis] + 1 < params.dimension) {
                beside[axis] += 1;
            } else {
                beside[axis] -= 1;
            }
            most = higherOf(most, fabsf(depthAt(ground, beside) - depth));
        }
        return RISER_MARGIN * most;
    }

    void generateTerrainVoxel(uint ground, Vec3!uint cell, float altitude, size_t index) {
        Climate here = climateOfCell(cell);
        float depth = here.relief - altitude;
        Material material;
        if (depth >= COVER_DEPTH && depth < SOIL_DEPTH) {
            material = groundAt(depth, riserAt(ground, cell, depth), here);
        } else if (depth >= 0.0f) {
            material = groundAt(depth, 0, here);
        } else {
            material = openAt(altitude, here);
        }
        if (material != Material.none) {
            voxels.toDense(params.dimension)[index] = material;
        }
    }

    void generateTrees(uint ground) {
        ubyte dimension = params.dimension;
        if (!voxels.isUniform() && dimension > MIN_TREE_DIMENSION) {
            Climate mean = params.climate.mean();
            float density = clamped(BASE_TREE_DENSITY + mean.wetness / WETNESS_PER_TREE_DENSITY, MIN_TREE_DENSITY, MAX_TREE_DENSITY);
            uint interior = dimension - 2;
            uint candidateCount = cast(uint)(cast(float)(interior * interior * interior) * density);
            foreach (_; 0 .. candidateCount) {
                int x = cast(int)(1 + (rng.next() % interior));
                int y = cast(int)(1 + (rng.next() % interior));
                int z = cast(int)(1 + (rng.next() % interior));
                ulong roll = rng.next();
                placeTree(ground, Vec3!int(x, y, z), treeKind(mean.warmth(), mean.wetness, roll));
            }
        }
    }

    void generatePlants(uint ground) {
        ubyte dimension = params.dimension;
        if (!voxels.isUniform() && dimension > MIN_TREE_DIMENSION) {
            Climate mean = params.climate.mean();
            Material plant = plantFor(mean.warmth(), mean.wetness);
            uint interior = dimension - 2;
            uint candidateCount = cast(uint)(cast(float)(interior * interior * interior) * PLANT_DENSITY);
            SplitMix plants = SplitMix(params.nodeSpice ^ (cast(ulong) params.chunk << CHUNK_ROLL_SHIFT) ^ PLANT_SALT);
            prepareCells();
            foreach (_; 0 .. candidateCount) {
                Vec3!int base = Vec3!int(cast(int)(1 + plants.next() % interior), cast(int)(1 + plants.next() % interior), cast(int)(1 + plants.next() % interior));
                if (voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, base.x, base.y, base.z)) == Material.none && params.flats.reliefShareAt(cubePoint(toNode, centerOf(base.x, base.y, base.z))) > 0) {
                    Vec3!int up = CELL_STEPS[params.ground(ground).surface.risingNeighbor(params.chunk, params.layout, base)];
                    Material below = voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, base.x - up.x, base.y - up.y, base.z - up.z));
                    if (voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, base.x + up.x, base.y + up.y, base.z + up.z)) == Material.none && isGroundForPlant(plant, below)) {
                        voxels.toDense(dimension)[cellIndex(dimension, base.x, base.y, base.z)] = plant;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void placeTree(uint ground, Vec3!int base, TreeKind kind) {
        ubyte dimension = params.dimension;
        prepareCells();
        if (voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, base.x, base.y, base.z)) == Material.none && params.flats.reliefShareAt(cubePoint(toNode, centerOf(base.x, base.y, base.z))) > 0) {
            int upDirection = params.ground(ground).surface.risingNeighbor(params.chunk, params.layout, base);
            Vec3!int up = CELL_STEPS[upDirection];
            if (voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, base.x + up.x, base.y + up.y, base.z + up.z)) == Material.none && isGroundFor(kind, voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, base.x - up.x, base.y - up.y, base.z - up.z)))) {
                TreeSpecies species = TREE_SPECIES[kind];
                ulong roll = rng.next();
                TreeFrame frame = TreeFrame.fromUp(base, upDirection, cast(int)(species.minTrunk + roll % species.trunkChoices), species.shape, species.reach);
                if (frame.fitsWithin(dimension)) {
                    growTree(frame, species);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void growTree(TreeFrame frame, TreeSpecies species) {
        int reach = frame.reach;
        foreach (level; 0 .. frame.top + 1) {
            foreach (i; -reach .. reach + 1) {
                foreach (j; -reach .. reach + 1) {
                    if (isWood(species.shape, frame.trunk, level, i, j)) {
                        setIfEmpty(frame.cell(level, i, j), species.wood);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        foreach (level; 0 .. frame.top + 1) {
            foreach (i; -reach .. reach + 1) {
                foreach (j; -reach .. reach + 1) {
                    if (species.leaves != Material.none && isLeaf(species.shape, frame.trunk, level, i, j)) {
                        setIfEmpty(frame.cell(level, i, j), species.leaves);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void setIfEmpty(Vec3!int cell, Material material) {
        size_t index = cellIndex(params.dimension, cell.x, cell.y, cell.z);
        if (voxels.at(index) == Material.none) {
            voxels.toDense(params.dimension)[index] = material;
        }
    }
}

struct TreeFrame {
    Vec3!int base;
    Vec3!int up;
    size_t across;
    size_t along;
    int trunk;
    int top;
    int reach;

    static TreeFrame fromUp(Vec3!int base, int upDirection, int trunk, TreeShape shape, int reach) {
        size_t axis = upDirection / 2;
        return TreeFrame(base, CELL_STEPS[upDirection], (axis + 1) % 3, (axis + 2) % 3, trunk, trunk + aboveTrunk(shape), reach);
    }

    Vec3!int cell(int level, int i, int j) const {
        Vec3!int result = Vec3!int(base.x + up.x * level, base.y + up.y * level, base.z + up.z * level);
        result[across] += i;
        result[along] += j;
        return result;
    }

    bool fitsWithin(ubyte dimension) const {
        return isInside(dimension, cell(0, -reach, -reach)) && isInside(dimension, cell(top, reach, reach));
    }
}

int aboveTrunk(TreeShape shape) {
    final switch (shape) {
        case TreeShape.round:
        case TreeShape.broad:
        case TreeShape.flat:
        case TreeShape.bush:
            return 1;
        case TreeShape.cone:
        case TreeShape.weeping:
        case TreeShape.tall:
        case TreeShape.bare:
            return 0;
        case TreeShape.column:
            return -1;
    }
}

TreeKind treeKind(float warmth, float wetness, ulong roll) {
    ulong choice = roll >> CHOICE_SHIFT;
    if (isDesert(warmth, wetness)) {
        return TreeKind.cactus;
    } else if (warmth < SNOW_WARMTH && choice % 3 == 0) {
        return TreeKind.snag;
    } else if (warmth < SNOW_WARMTH) {
        return TreeKind.spruce;
    } else if (warmth < SPRUCE_WARMTH && choice % 6 == 0) {
        return TreeKind.birch;
    } else if (warmth < SPRUCE_WARMTH) {
        return TreeKind.spruce;
    } else if (roll % SHRUB_ODDS == 0) {
        return TreeKind.shrub;
    } else if (warmth > TROPICAL_WARMTH && wetness > WET && choice % 3 == 0) {
        return TreeKind.bigOak;
    } else if (warmth > TROPICAL_WARMTH && wetness > WET) {
        return TreeKind.jungle;
    } else if (warmth > TROPICAL_WARMTH && wetness < DRY) {
        return TreeKind.acacia;
    } else if (wetness > WET) {
        return WET_TREES[choice % WET_TREES.length];
    } else if (warmth < MAPLE_WARMTH) {
        return COOL_TREES[choice % COOL_TREES.length];
    } else {
        return MILD_TREES[choice % MILD_TREES.length];
    }
}

bool isInTrunk(int trunk, int level, int i, int j) {
    return i == 0 && j == 0 && level < trunk;
}

bool isWood(TreeShape shape, int trunk, int level, int i, int j) {
    final switch (shape) {
        case TreeShape.round:
        case TreeShape.cone:
        case TreeShape.broad:
        case TreeShape.weeping:
        case TreeShape.tall:
        case TreeShape.bush:
            return isInTrunk(trunk, level, i, j);
        case TreeShape.flat:
            return isInTrunk(trunk, level, i, j) || (level == trunk - 1 && i == 1 && j == 0) || (level == trunk && i == 1 && j == 1);
        case TreeShape.bare:
            return isInTrunk(trunk, level, i, j) || (level == trunk - 2 && i == 0 && j == 1) || (level == trunk - 1 && i == -1 && j == 0) || (level == trunk && i == 1 && j == 0);
        case TreeShape.column:
            return isInTrunk(trunk, level, i, j) || (i == 1 && j == 0 && level >= 1 && level <= 2 && level < trunk - 1) || (i == -1 && j == 0 && level >= 2 && level <= 3 && level < trunk - 1);
    }
}

bool isInCanopy(int spread, int span) {
    return spread <= CANOPY_RADIUS && span <= CANOPY_CORNER_SPAN;
}

bool isLeaf(TreeShape shape, int trunk, int level, int i, int j) {
    int spread = chebyshevLength(i, j);
    int span = abs(i) + abs(j);
    int squared = i * i + j * j;
    final switch (shape) {
        case TreeShape.round:
            return roundLeaf(trunk, level, spread, span);
        case TreeShape.cone:
            return spruceLeaf(trunk, level, spread, span);
        case TreeShape.broad:
            return broadLeaf(trunk, level, squared);
        case TreeShape.weeping:
            return weepingLeaf(trunk, level, spread, squared, i + j);
        case TreeShape.tall:
            return tallLeaf(trunk, level, squared);
        case TreeShape.flat:
            return (level == trunk && squared <= 10) || (level == trunk + 1 && squared <= 4);
        case TreeShape.bush:
            return (level == 0 && span <= 1) || (level == 1 && squared <= 2);
        case TreeShape.bare:
        case TreeShape.column:
            return false;
    }
}

bool roundLeaf(int trunk, int level, int spread, int span) {
    if (level == trunk - 2 || level == trunk - 1) {
        return isInCanopy(spread, span);
    } else if (level == trunk) {
        return spread <= 1;
    } else if (level == trunk + 1) {
        return span <= 1;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}

bool broadLeaf(int trunk, int level, int squared) {
    if (level == trunk - 3 || level == trunk) {
        return squared <= 5;
    } else if (level == trunk - 2 || level == trunk - 1) {
        return squared <= 10;
    } else if (level == trunk + 1) {
        return squared <= 2;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}

bool weepingLeaf(int trunk, int level, int spread, int squared, int parity) {
    if (level == trunk - 1 || level == trunk) {
        return squared <= 5 - (level - trunk + 1) * 3;
    } else {
        return level >= 1 && level < trunk - 1 && spread == CANOPY_RADIUS && (parity & 1) == 0;
    }
}

bool tallLeaf(int trunk, int level, int squared) {
    if (level == trunk - 2 || level == trunk - 1) {
        return squared <= 5;
    } else if (level == trunk) {
        return squared <= 2;
    } else {
        return level == trunk / 2 && squared == 1;
    }
}

bool spruceLeaf(int trunk, int level, int spread, int span) {
    if (level == trunk) {
        return span == 0;
    } else if (level > trunk || level < SPRUCE_LOWEST_LEAVES) {
        return false;
    } else if ((trunk - level) % 2 == 0) {
        return isInCanopy(spread, span);
    } else {
        return span <= 1;
    }
}

int chebyshevLength(int i, int j) {
    return higherOf(abs(i), abs(j));
}

bool isGroundMaterial(Material material) {
    return material == Material.dirt || material == Material.grass || material == Material.mudGrass || material == Material.lushGrass || material == Material.tanGrass || material == Material.coarseGrass;
}

Material plantFor(float warmth, float wetness) {
    if (isDesert(warmth, wetness)) {
        return Material.thornbush;
    } else if (warmth < SNOW_WARMTH) {
        return Material.moss;
    } else if (wetness > WET) {
        return Material.fern;
    } else {
        return Material.flower;
    }
}

bool isGroundForPlant(Material plant, Material material) {
    if (plant == Material.thornbush) {
        return material == Material.sand || material == Material.redSand || isGroundMaterial(material);
    } else if (plant == Material.moss) {
        return isGroundMaterial(material) || material == Material.snow || material == Material.gravel;
    } else {
        return isGroundMaterial(material);
    }
}

bool isGroundFor(TreeKind kind, Material material) {
    if (kind == TreeKind.cactus) {
        return material == Material.sand || material == Material.redSand;
    } else if (kind == TreeKind.willow || kind == TreeKind.shrub) {
        return isGroundMaterial(material) || material == Material.mud;
    } else if (kind == TreeKind.snag) {
        return isGroundMaterial(material) || material == Material.snow || material == Material.gravel;
    } else {
        return isGroundMaterial(material);
    }
}

struct HorosphereId {
    uint bits;

    static HorosphereId ofIndex(size_t index) {
        return HorosphereId(cast(uint) index + 1);
    }

    size_t index() const {
        assert(bits != 0);
        return bits - 1;
    }
}

struct EdgeLine {
    Plane first;
    Plane second;

    EdgeLine carriedAlong(const(Face)[] path) const {
        return EdgeLine(first.carriedAlong(path), second.carriedAlong(path));
    }
}

struct Horosphere {
    Plane plane;
    EdgeLine column;
    SiteFrame foot;
    CornerKey key;
    uint keySlot;
    HorosphereId parent;
    uint footNode;
    uint users;
    uint tiles;
    int ground;
    int balance;

    ubyte kind;
    ubyte edges;

        return stage == HorosphereStage.measured;
    }
}

struct HorosphereRef {
    Plane plane;
    EdgeLine column;
    HorosphereId horosphere;

    HorosphereRef across(Face side) const {
        Face[1] path = [side];
        return HorosphereRef(plane.carriedAlong(path[]), column.carriedAlong(path[]), horosphere);
    }
}

bool contains(ref const Array!HorosphereRef found, HorosphereId horosphere) {
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < found.length && found.ptr[index].horosphere != horosphere) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return index < found.length;
}

float lineDistanceOf(ref const EdgeLine line, Point!float point) {
    float first = sinhf(line.first.distanceTo(point));
    float second = sinhf(line.second.distanceTo(point));
    return acoshf(sqrtf(1 + first * first + second * second));
}

float columnDistanceOf(ref const HorosphereRef near, Point!float point) {
    return lineDistanceOf(near.column, point);
}

float smoothRamp(float value, float low, float high) {
    float share = clamped((value - low) / (high - low), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    return share * share * (3 - 2 * share);
}

float reliefShareAway(float distance) {
    return smoothRamp(distance, FLAT_CORE, FLAT_EDGE);
}

struct FlatLines {
    EdgeLine[MOST_FLAT_LINES] lines;
    uint count;

    float reliefShareAt(Point!float point) const {
        float share = 1;
        foreach (ref line; lines[0 .. count]) {
            share = lowerOf(share, reliefShareAway(lineDistanceOf(line, point)));
        }
        return share;
    }
}

FlatLines flatLinesNear(ref const Horospheres horospheres, const(HorosphereRef)[] near, Point!float center) {
    FlatLines found;
    foreach (ref line; near) {
        if (found.count < MOST_FLAT_LINES && !horospheres.isUpright(line.horosphere) && columnDistanceOf(line, center) <= FLAT_EDGE + CUBE_RADIUS) {
            found.lines[found.count] = line.column;
            found.count += 1;
        }
    }
    return found;
}

float reliefShareAmong(ref const Horospheres horospheres, const(HorosphereRef)[] near, Point!float point) {
    float share = 1;
    foreach (ref line; near) {
        if (!horospheres.isUpright(line.horosphere)) {
            share = lowerOf(share, reliefShareAway(columnDistanceOf(line, point)));
        }
    }
    return share;
}

struct Grounds {
    Ground[MAX_GROUNDS] items;
    uint count;

    uint farthestRisen() const {
        uint farthest = 1;
        foreach (index; 2 .. count) {
            if (items[index].surface.distanceTo(Point!float.origin()) > items[farthest].surface.distanceTo(Point!float.origin())) {
                farthest = index;
            }
        }
        return farthest;
    }
}
