struct RootedCorner {
    ClaimKey key;
    uint depth;
}

bool isEndless(ref const LineSpec spec) {
    return spec.extent == Extent.endless;
}

bool isTouchInRange(ref const LineTouch touch, ref const LineSpec spec) {
    return isLevelInRange(spec, touch.level);
}

bool isLevelInRange(ref const LineSpec spec, int level) {
    return spec.isEndless() || spec.edges.contains(level, level);
}

bool isOnTouch(ref const LineTouch touch, ref const LineSpec spec, Corner corner) {
    return (corner == touch.lower || corner == upperOf(touch.lower, spec)) && isTouchInRange(touch, spec);
}

Maybe!LineTouch crossed(LineTouch touch, ref const LineSpec spec, Face side) {
    Corner upper = upperOf(touch.lower, spec);
    if (side == spec.xSide) {
        return Maybe!LineTouch.of(LineTouch(touch.level, touch.line, touch.lower, cast(byte) -touch.xSign, touch.ySign));
    } else if (side == spec.ySide) {
        return Maybe!LineTouch.of(LineTouch(touch.level, touch.line, touch.lower, touch.xSign, cast(byte) -touch.ySign));
    } else if (side == crossingSide(touch.lower, spec)) {
        return Maybe!LineTouch.of(LineTouch(touch.level - 1, touch.line, upper, touch.xSign, touch.ySign));
    } else if (side == crossingSide(upper, spec)) {
        return Maybe!LineTouch.of(LineTouch(touch.level + 1, touch.line, upper, touch.xSign, touch.ySign));
    } else {
        return Maybe!LineTouch.init;
    }
}

Corner upperOf(Corner lower, ref const LineSpec spec) {
    return lower.across[crossingAxis(lower, spec)];
}

size_t crossingAxis(Corner corner, ref const LineSpec spec) {
    return 3 - sideAxis(corner, spec.xSide) - sideAxis(corner, spec.ySide);
}

Face crossingSide(Corner corner, ref const LineSpec spec) {
    return corner.faces[crossingAxis(corner, spec)];
}

void finalizeStructure(ref Graph graph, uint slot) {
    Array!LineTouch* found = &graph.structures.scratch;
    found.clear();
    foreach_reverse (touch; graph.structures.pendingAt(graph.idAt(slot))) {
        (*found).addUnique(touch);
    }
    ParentList parents = graph.parents(slot);
    foreach (link; parents.links[0 .. parents.count]) {
        foreach (touch; graph.structures.touchesAt(link.slot)) {
            LineSpec spec = graph.structures.blueprint.lines.ptr[touch.line];
            if (spec.isEndless()) {
                Maybe!LineTouch crossing = crossed(touch, spec, link.side);
                if (crossing.exists) {
                    (*found).addUnique(crossing.value);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    graph.structures.setTouches(slot, found.slice());
    graph.structures.at(slot).marks.put(NodeMark.inStructure, graph.hasTouchInRange(found.slice()));
    graph.structures.at(slot).marks.put(NodeMark.strokes, graph.structures.strokes.reachesAt(graph.idAt(slot)).length > 0);
    if (graph.structures.at(slot).needsBuilding()) {
        graph.pin(slot);
    }
}

bool hasTouchInRange(ref const Graph graph, const(LineTouch)[] touches) {
    foreach (touch; touches) {
        if (isTouchInRange(touch, graph.structures.blueprint.lines.ptr[touch.line])) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void addUnique(ref Array!LineTouch touches, LineTouch touch) {
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < touches.length && touches.ptr[index].line < touch.line) {
        index += 1;
    }
    if (index == touches.length || touches.ptr[index].line != touch.line) {
        touches.append(touch);
        foreach_reverse (moved; index .. touches.length - 1) {
            touches.ptr[moved + 1] = touches.ptr[moved];
        }
        touches.ptr[index] = touch;
    }
}

void addPendingTouch(ref Graph graph, uint slot, LineTouch touch) {
    graph.addPendingTouch(graph.idAt(slot), touch);
}

void addPendingTouch(ref Graph graph, NodeId id, LineTouch touch) {
    assert(!graph.slotOf(id).exists || !graph.isFinished(graph.slotOf(id).value));
    graph.structures.addPending(id, touch);
}

SlotTouch seedTouch(ref const LineSpec spec, uint line) {
    return SlotTouch(LineTouch(0, line, spec.lower, 1, 1), spec.node.value);
}

LineTouch crossedOnLine(LineTouch touch, ref const LineSpec spec, Face side) {
    Maybe!LineTouch crossing = crossed(touch, spec, side);
    assert(crossing.exists);
    return crossing.value;
}

SlotTouch walkTouch(ref GraphView view, SlotTouch from, ref const LineSpec spec, int edge) {
    SlotTouch current = from;
    while (current.touch.level != edge) {
        Face side = crossingSide(current.touch.lower, spec);
        if (edge > current.touch.level) {
            side = crossingSide(upperOf(current.touch.lower, spec), spec);
        }
        current = SlotTouch(crossedOnLine(current.touch, spec, side), view.ensureNeighborSlot(current.slot, side));
    }
    return current;
}

SlotTouch[EDGE_NODES] ensureAroundEdge(ref GraphView view, SlotTouch edge, ref const LineSpec spec) {
    SlotTouch x = SlotTouch(crossedOnLine(edge.touch, spec, spec.xSide), view.ensureNeighborSlot(edge.slot, spec.xSide));
    SlotTouch y = SlotTouch(crossedOnLine(edge.touch, spec, spec.ySide), view.ensureNeighborSlot(edge.slot, spec.ySide));
    SlotTouch both = SlotTouch(crossedOnLine(y.touch, spec, spec.xSide), view.ensureNeighborSlot(y.slot, spec.xSide));
    return [edge, x, y, both];
}

SiteFrame rootSite(uint anchor) {
    return faceSite(anchor, Face.first);
}

SiteFrame faceSite(uint node, Face label) {
    return groundSite(node, firstCornerOn(label), label);
}

SiteFrame groundSite(uint node, Corner corner, Face label) {
    size_t up = sideAxis(corner, label);
    return SiteFrame(0, node, corner, corner.faces[(up + 1) % 3], label, 1, 1, 1);
}

SiteFrame forwarded(SiteFrame site, int edges) {
    return SiteFrame(site.level - edges, site.node, site.corner, site.xSide, site.ySide, site.xSign, site.ySign, site.zSign);
}

SiteFrame moveToLevel(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site, int level) {
    int rise = 1;
    if (level < site.level) {
        rise = -1;
    }
    SiteFrame result = site;
    while (result.level != level) {
        result = view.stepSite(result, rise);
    }
    return result;
}

SiteFrame stepSite(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site, int rise) {
    if (site.zSign * rise > 0) {
        return SiteFrame(site.level + rise, site.node, site.nextCorner(), site.xSide, site.ySide, site.xSign, site.ySign, cast(byte) -site.zSign);
    } else {
        uint across = view.ensureNeighborSlot(site.node, site.zSide());
        return SiteFrame(site.level, across, site.corner, site.xSide, site.ySide, site.xSign, site.ySign, cast(byte) -site.zSign);
    }
}

SiteFrame turnSite(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site, Turn turn) {
    SiteFrame at = view.moveToLevel(site, 0);
    Axis x = at.x();
    Axis y = at.y();
    Axis z = at.z();
    Axis[3] axes = void;
    final switch (turn) {
        case Turn.left:
            axes = [z, y, -x];
            break;
        case Turn.right:
            axes = [-z, y, x];
            break;
        case Turn.pitchUp:
            axes = [x, -z, y];
            break;
        case Turn.pitchDown:
            axes = [x, z, -y];
            break;
        case Turn.rollLeft:
            axes = [y, -x, z];
            break;
        case Turn.rollRight:
            axes = [-y, x, z];
            break;
    }
    return SiteFrame.fromAxes(0, at.node, at.corner, axes[0], axes[1], axes[2]);
}

Maybe!ParentEntry parentOnCorner(ParentList parents, Corner corner) {
    foreach (link; parents.links[0 .. parents.count]) {
        if (sideAxis(corner, link.side) != 3) {
            return Maybe!ParentEntry.of(link);
        }
    }
    return Maybe!ParentEntry.init;
}

Maybe!ParentEntry parentThrough(ParentList parents, Face first, Face second) {
    foreach (link; parents.links[0 .. parents.count]) {
        if (link.side == first || link.side == second) {
            return Maybe!ParentEntry.of(link);
        }
    }
    return Maybe!ParentEntry.init;
}

RootedCorner rootedCorner(ref const GraphView view, uint node, Corner corner) {
    uint slot = node;
    Maybe!ParentEntry lower = parentOnCorner(view.parents(slot), corner);
    while (lower.exists) {
        slot = lower.value.slot;
        lower = parentOnCorner(view.parents(slot), corner);
    }
    return RootedCorner(ClaimKey(slot, corner, SitePart.vertex), view.depthOf(slot));
}

SiteFrame edgeSite(ref const GraphView view, uint node, Corner corner, size_t axis) {
    Face first = corner.faces[(axis + 1) % 3];
    Face second = corner.faces[(axis + 2) % 3];
    uint slot = node;
    Maybe!ParentEntry lower = parentThrough(view.parents(slot), first, second);
    while (lower.exists) {
        slot = lower.value.slot;
        lower = parentThrough(view.parents(slot), first, second);
    }
    return SiteFrame(0, slot, lowerOf(corner, corner.across[axis]), lowerOf(first, second), higherOf(first, second), 1, 1, 1);
}

SiteFrame[NODE_EDGES] edgeSitesOf(ref const GraphView view, uint node) {
    SiteFrame[NODE_EDGES] sites = void;
    uint count = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
        Corner corner = cast(Corner) index;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
            if (corner < corner.across[axis]) {
                sites[count] = view.edgeSite(node, corner, axis);
                count += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    assert(count == NODE_EDGES);
    return sites;
}

RootedCorner ensureSiteOrigin(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site) {
    SiteFrame origin = view.moveToLevel(site, 0);
    return view.rootedCorner(origin.node, origin.corner);
}

ClaimKey ensureSiteFace(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site) {
    SiteFrame at = view.moveToLevel(site, 0);
    uint node = at.node;
    if (at.xSign < 0) {
        node = view.ensureNeighborSlot(node, at.xSide);
    }
    if (at.zSign < 0) {
        node = view.ensureNeighborSlot(node, at.zSide());
    }
    uint across = view.ensureNeighborSlot(node, at.ySide);
    if (view.depthOf(across) < view.depthOf(node)) {
        node = across;
    }
    return ClaimKey(node, at.ySide, SitePart.face);
}

ClaimKey ensureClaimKey(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site, SitePart part) {
    assert(part != SitePart.edge);
    if (part == SitePart.vertex) {
        return view.ensureSiteOrigin(site).key;
    } else {
        return view.ensureSiteFace(site);
    }
}

ulong ensureSiteHash(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site, SitePart part) {
    ulong seed = void;
    final switch (part) {
        case SitePart.vertex:
        case SitePart.face:
            ClaimKey key = view.ensureClaimKey(site, part);
            seed = mixedSeed(view.idAt(key.slot).spice(), key.feature, part);
            break;
        case SitePart.edge:
            seed = view.ensureEdgeSeed(site);
            break;
    }
    return SplitMix(seed).next();
}

ulong mixedSeed(ulong spice, uint feature, SitePart part) {
    return spice ^ ((cast(ulong) feature * (SitePart.max + 1) + part + 1) * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER);
}

ulong ensureEdgeSeed(ref GraphView view, SiteFrame site) {
    CanonicalSite canonical = view.canonicalOf(site);
    ubyte dimension = view.layout.dimension;
    int cells = edgeCells(dimension);
    CellBox edge = canonicalBox(CellBox.make(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, cells - 1), canonical.transform, dimension);
    ulong level = cast(uint) floorDivision(edge.low.z, cells);
    LineSpec line = canonical.line;
    uint feature = (line.lower * FACE_COUNT + line.xSide) * FACE_COUNT + line.ySide;
    return mixedSeed(view.idAt(line.node.value).spice() ^ (level * LEVEL_MULTIPLIER), feature, SitePart.edge);
}

uint[GROUND_RING] ensureGroundRing(ref GraphView view, uint sky, Face label) {
    uint[GROUND_RING] ring = void;
    uint count = 0;
    ring[count] = sky;
    count += 1;
    ushort faces = ringFaces(label);
    foreach (index; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        Face side = cast(Face) index;
        if ((faces & faceBit(side)) != 0) {
            uint beside = view.ensureNeighborSlot(sky, side);
            ring[count] = beside;
            count += 1;
            foreach (otherIndex; index + 1 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                Face other = cast(Face) otherIndex;
                if ((faces & faceBit(other)) != 0 && side.isAdjacentTo(other)) {
                    ring[count] = view.ensureNeighborSlot(beside, other);
                    count += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    assert(count == GROUND_RING);
    return ring;
}

Maybe!SiteFrame crossedFrame(SiteFrame site, Face side, uint node) {
    Corner next = site.nextCorner();
    Face far = next.faces[3 - sideAxis(next, site.xSide) - sideAxis(next, site.ySide)];
    if (side == site.xSide) {
        return Maybe!SiteFrame.of(SiteFrame(site.level, node, site.corner, site.xSide, site.ySide, cast(byte) -site.xSign, site.ySign, site.zSign));
    } else if (side == site.ySide) {
        return Maybe!SiteFrame.of(SiteFrame(site.level, node, site.corner, site.xSide, site.ySide, site.xSign, cast(byte) -site.ySign, site.zSign));
    } else if (side == site.zSide()) {
        return Maybe!SiteFrame.of(SiteFrame(site.level, node, site.corner, site.xSide, site.ySide, site.xSign, site.ySign, cast(byte) -site.zSign));
    } else if (side == far) {
        return Maybe!SiteFrame.of(SiteFrame(site.level + site.zSign, node, next, site.xSide, site.ySide, site.xSign, site.ySign, site.zSign));
    } else {
        return Maybe!SiteFrame.init;
    }
}

SiteFrame lowerFrame(ref const GraphView view, SiteFrame site) {
    ParentList parents = view.parents(site.node);
    foreach (link; parents.links[0 .. parents.count]) {
        Maybe!SiteFrame crossing = crossedFrame(site, link.side, link.slot);
        if (crossing.exists) {
            return crossing.value;
        }
    }
    return site;
}

CanonicalSite canonicalOf(ref const GraphView view, SiteFrame site) {
    SiteFrame entry = site;
    SiteFrame below = view.lowerFrame(entry);
    while (below.node != entry.node) {
        entry = below;
        below = view.lowerFrame(entry);
    }
    Corner lower = lowerOf(entry.nextCorner(), entry.corner);
    Face first = entry.xSide;
    Face second = entry.ySide;
    AxisOrder order = AxisOrder.straight;
    if (second < first) {
        first = entry.ySide;
        second = entry.xSide;
        order = AxisOrder.swapped;
    }
    byte zSign = entry.zSign;
    int cornerLevel = 0;
    if (entry.corner != lower) {
        zSign = cast(byte) -entry.zSign;
        cornerLevel = 1;
    }
    LineSpec line = LineSpec(LevelRange.init, MaybeIndex!uint.of(entry.node), lower, first, second);
    return CanonicalSite(line, LineTransform(cornerLevel - zSign * entry.level, entry.xSign, entry.ySign, zSign, order));
}

struct ColumnChunk {
    size_t zAxis;
    size_t xAxis;
    size_t yAxis;
    int xSign;
    int ySign;
    int zSign;
    int bottom;

    static ColumnChunk fromTouch(ref const LineTouch touch, ref const LineSpec spec, Corner corner, ubyte dimension) {
        size_t xAxis = sideAxis(corner, spec.xSide);
        size_t yAxis = sideAxis(corner, spec.ySide);
        if (corner == touch.lower) {
            return ColumnChunk(3 - xAxis - yAxis, xAxis, yAxis, touch.xSign, touch.ySign, 1, touch.level * edgeCells(dimension));
        } else {
            return ColumnChunk(3 - xAxis - yAxis, xAxis, yAxis, touch.xSign, touch.ySign, -1, (touch.level + 1) * edgeCells(dimension));
        }
    }

    Vec3!int columnOf(Vec3!int cell) const {
        return Vec3!int(signedIndex(cell[xAxis], xSign), signedIndex(cell[yAxis], ySign), bottom + signedIndex(cell[zAxis], zSign));
    }
}

struct ColumnSpot {
    float x = 0;
    float y = 0;
    float z = 0;
}

int signedIndex(int cell, int sign) {
    if (sign > 0) {
        return cell;
    } else {
        return -1 - cell;
    }
}

float signedKlein(ref const ChunkLayout layout, float grid) {
    if (grid < 0) {
        return -layout.gridToKlein(-grid);
    } else {
        return layout.gridToKlein(grid);
    }
}

Length edgeLength(ref const ChunkLayout layout) {
    return Length(2.0f * atanhf(layout.gridToKlein(layout.dimension)));
}

int edgeCells(ubyte dimension) {
    return 2 * dimension;
}

Point!float columnPoint(ref const ChunkLayout layout, ColumnSpot spot) {
    float segmentCells = edgeCells(layout.dimension);
    float segment = floorf(spot.z / segmentCells);
    float local = spot.z - segment * segmentCells;
    float rise = layout.gridToKlein(local);
    float level = segment;
    if (local > layout.dimension) {
        rise = -layout.gridToKlein(segmentCells - local);
        level = segment + 1;
    }
    Point!float inCornerFrame = Vec4!float([signedKlein(layout, spot.x), signedKlein(layout, spot.y), rise, 1.0f]).toPoint();
    return Motion!float.shift(Vec3!float(0, 0, level * edgeLength(layout).value)) * inCornerFrame;
}

Point!float spawnBefore(ref const ChunkLayout layout, ColumnSpot door) {
    return Motion!float.shiftTo(columnPoint(layout, door)) * Motion!float.shift(Vec3!float(-SPAWN_DISTANCE.value, 0, 0)) * Point!float.origin();
}

Motion!float sitePlacement(ref const SiteFrame site, ref const ChunkLayout layout) {
    Mat4!float axes;
    axes.c[0][sideAxis(site.corner, site.xSide)] = site.xSign;
    axes.c[1][sideAxis(site.corner, site.ySide)] = site.ySign;
    axes.c[2][sideAxis(site.corner, site.zSide())] = site.zSign;
    axes.c[3][3] = 1;
    return site.corner.cornerToNode * Motion!float(axes) * Motion!float.shift(Vec3!float(0, 0, -site.level * edgeLength(layout).value));
}

SiteFrame lineSite(ref const LineSpec spec) {
    return SiteFrame(0, spec.node.value, spec.lower, spec.xSide, spec.ySide, 1, 1, 1);
}

Motion!float siteToNode(ref const GraphView view, ref const SiteFrame site, uint slot) {
    return view.nodeToNode(site.node, slot) * sitePlacement(site, view.layout);
}

Motion!float lineToNode(ref const GraphView view, uint line, uint slot) {
    SiteFrame site = lineSite(view.blueprint.lines.ptr[line]);
    return view.siteToNode(site, slot);
}

Motion!float nodeToNode(ref const GraphView view, uint from, uint to) {
    Array!Face path = view.pathBetween(from, to);
    Motion!double transform = Motion!double.identity();
    foreach (side; path.slice()) {
        transform = transform * side.mirror.as!double();
    }
    path.release();
    return transform.as!float();
}

Array!Face pathBetween(ref const GraphView view, uint from, uint to) {
    Array!Face toPath;
    Array!Face fromPath;
    uint toward = to;
    uint away = from;
    while (toward != away) {
        if (view.depthOf(toward) >= view.depthOf(away)) {
            ParentEntry parent = view.parents(toward).links[0];
            toPath.append(parent.side);
            toward = parent.slot;
        } else {
            ParentEntry parent = view.parents(away).links[0];
            fromPath.append(parent.side);
            away = parent.slot;
        }
    }
    Array!Face path;
    foreach (side; toPath.slice()) {
        path.appendReduced(side);
    }
    foreach_reverse (side; fromPath.slice()) {
        path.appendReduced(side);
    }
    toPath.release();
    fromPath.release();
    return path;
}

void appendReduced(ref Array!Face path, Face side) {
    size_t index = path.length;
    while (index > 0 && path.ptr[index - 1] != side && path.ptr[index - 1].isAdjacentTo(side)) {
        index -= 1;
    }
    if (index > 0 && path.ptr[index - 1] == side) {
        foreach (moved; index .. path.length) {
            path.ptr[moved - 1] = path.ptr[moved];
        }
        path.length -= 1;
    } else {
        path.append(side);
    }
}

size_t sideAxis(Corner corner, Face side) {
    size_t axis = 0;
    while (axis < 3 && corner.faces[axis] != side) {
        axis += 1;
    }
    return axis;
}

Corner firstCornerOn(Face side) {
    uint corner = 0;
    while (corner < CORNER_COUNT && sideAxis(cast(Corner) corner, side) == 3) {
        corner += 1;
    }
    return cast(Corner) corner;
}

ushort ringFaces(Face straight) {
    ushort ring = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        if ((cast(Face) index).isAdjacentTo(straight)) {
            ring |= faceBit(cast(Face) index);
        }
    }
    return ring;
}

Face firstSideAmong(ushort faces) {
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < FACE_COUNT && (faces & faceBit(cast(Face) index)) == 0) {
        index += 1;
    }
    assert(index < FACE_COUNT);
    return cast(Face) index;
}

uint ensureAnchorSlot(ref Graph graph) {
    uint sky = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(graph.slotOf(ROOT_NODE).value, Face.first);
    return graph.ensureNeighborSlot(sky, firstSideAmong(ringFaces(Face.first)));
}

ulong anchorBits(ref const Graph graph, uint slot) {
    return SplitMix(graph.idAt(slot).spice()).next();
}

float calmAt(ref const GraphView view, uint node) {
    float calm = 1;
    foreach (ref flat; view.blueprint.flats.slice()) {
        uint here = view.depthOf(node);
        uint there = view.depthOf(flat.node);
        if (here <= there + FLAT_DEPTH_SPAN && there <= here + FLAT_DEPTH_SPAN) {
            float away = (view.siteToNode(flat, node) * Point!float.origin()).distance(Point!float.origin());
            float share = clamped((away - FLAT_RADIUS) / FLAT_BLEND, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            calm = lowerOf(calm, share * share * (3 - 2 * share));
        }
    }
    return calm;
}

float altitude(ref const NodeState state) {
    return state.surface.height;
}

/// file: source/geometry/cube.d
module geometry.cube;

import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import geometry.honeycomb : Face;

enum Axis : ubyte {
    x,
    y,
    z,
}

enum uint AXIS_COUNT = 3;

enum Sign : byte {
    plus = 1,
    minus = -1,
}

struct Direction {
    Axis axis;
    Sign sign;
}

immutable Direction[6] DIRECTIONS = [
    Direction(Axis.x, Sign.plus),
    Direction(Axis.y, Sign.plus),
    Direction(Axis.z, Sign.plus),
    Direction(Axis.x, Sign.minus),
    Direction(Axis.y, Sign.minus),
    Direction(Axis.z, Sign.minus),
];

immutable Vec3!int[6] CELL_STEPS = [
    Vec3!int(-1, 0, 0),
    Vec3!int(1, 0, 0),
    Vec3!int(0, -1, 0),
    Vec3!int(0, 1, 0),
    Vec3!int(0, 0, -1),
    Vec3!int(0, 0, 1),
];

size_t directionIndex(Direction direction) {
    if (direction.sign == Sign.plus) {
        return direction.axis;
    } else {
        return direction.axis + AXIS_COUNT;
    }
}

alias Cell = Vec3!ubyte;

ubyte boundaryOf(ubyte dimension, Sign sign) {
    if (sign == Sign.plus) {
        return cast(ubyte)(dimension - 1);
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}

int beyondBoundary(ubyte dimension, Sign sign) {
    if (sign == Sign.plus) {
        return dimension;
    } else {
        return -1;
    }
}

struct AxisMap {
    Axis[3] to = [Axis.x, Axis.y, Axis.z];

    static AxisMap between(Face[3] from, Face[3] onto) {
        AxisMap map;
        foreach (i; 0 .. 3) {
            foreach (j; 0 .. 3) {
                if (from[i] == onto[j]) {
                    map.to[i] = cast(Axis) j;
                }
            }
        }
        return map;
    }

    Vec3!T apply(T)(Vec3!T cell) const {
        Vec3!T result;
        foreach (i; 0 .. 3) {
            result[to[i]] = cell[i];
        }
        return result;
    }
}

/// file: source/geometry/honeycomb.d
module geometry.honeycomb;

import core.math : sqrt;
import base.numbers : acoshAtCompileTime, asinhAtCompileTime, higherOf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import geometry.cube : AxisMap;
import geometry.lorentz : Mat4, Motion, Normal, Point, Vec4;

enum uint FACE_COUNT = 12;
enum uint CORNER_COUNT = 20;

enum Face : ubyte {
    first,
    last = FACE_COUNT - 1,
}

enum Corner : ubyte {
    first,
    last = CORNER_COUNT - 1,
}

enum double ORTHOGONAL_TOLERANCE = 1e-12;
enum double GOLDEN = 1.6180339887498948482;
enum float BEYOND_TOLERANCE = 1e-6f;

struct Honeycomb {
    Normal!float[FACE_COUNT] normals;
    Motion!float[FACE_COUNT] mirrors;
    Vec3!float[FACE_COUNT] directions;
    Vec3!float[FACE_COUNT] references;
    Face[FACE_COUNT] opposites;
    ushort[FACE_COUNT] adjacent;
    Face[3][CORNER_COUNT] cornerFaces;
    Corner[3][CORNER_COUNT] across;
    AxisMap[3][CORNER_COUNT] axisMaps;
    Motion!float[CORNER_COUNT] cornerToNode;
    Motion!float[CORNER_COUNT] nodeToCorner;
    Point!float[CORNER_COUNT] cubeCenters;
    float cubeScale;
    float coshNodeRadius;
    float coshCubeRadius;
    float coshCubeGridRadius;
    float sinhFaceDistance;

    static Honeycomb make() {
        Honeycomb h;
        Normal!double[FACE_COUNT] normals = faceNormals();
        foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            h.normals[face] = normals[face].as!float();
            h.mirrors[face] = Motion!double.reflection(normals[face]).as!float();
            Vec3!double spatial = normals[face].v.spatial();
            double length = sqrt(spatial.x * spatial.x + spatial.y * spatial.y + spatial.z * spatial.z);
            h.directions[face] = Vec3!float(cast(float)(spatial.x / length), cast(float)(spatial.y / length), cast(float)(spatial.z / length));
            h.sinhFaceDistance = cast(float)(normals[face].v.c[3]);
            foreach (other; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                double product = normals[face].minkowski(normals[other].v);
                if (product * product < ORTHOGONAL_TOLERANCE) {
                    h.adjacent[face] |= cast(ushort)(1u << other);
                }
            }
            h.opposites[face] = mostAntiparallel(normals, face);
        }
        uint corners = 0;
        foreach (a; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            foreach (b; a + 1 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                foreach (c; b + 1 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                    if (h.isAdjacent(a, b) && h.isAdjacent(b, c) && h.isAdjacent(a, c)) {
                        h.cornerFaces[corners] = [cast(Face) a, cast(Face) b, cast(Face) c];
                        corners += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        assert(corners == CORNER_COUNT);
        Point!double[CORNER_COUNT] cornerPoints;
        Motion!double[CORNER_COUNT] frames;
        foreach (corner; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
            Face[3] faces = h.cornerFaces[corner];
            frames[corner] = cornerFrame(normals[faces[0]], normals[faces[1]], normals[faces[2]]);
            cornerPoints[corner] = frames[corner] * Point!double.origin();
            h.cornerToNode[corner] = frames[corner].as!float();
            h.nodeToCorner[corner] = frames[corner].inverse().as!float();
            h.cubeCenters[corner] = cornerPoints[corner].midpoint(Point!double.origin()).as!float();
            foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
                h.across[corner][axis] = h.cornerAcross(faces, axis);
                h.axisMaps[corner][axis] = AxisMap.between(h.acrossFaces(faces, axis), h.cornerFaces[h.across[corner][axis]]);
            }
        }
        foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            h.references[face] = referenceIn(h.directions[face], cornerPoints[h.firstCornerOn(cast(Face) face)]);
        }
        Vec4!double centerInCorner = frames[0].inverse() * Vec4!double.origin();
        double toCube = centerInCorner.c[0] / centerInCorner.c[3];
        h.cubeScale = cast(float) toCube;
        h.coshNodeRadius = cast(float) -cornerPoints[0].minkowski(Vec4!double.origin());
        Point!double center = cornerPoints[0].midpoint(Point!double.origin());
        Point!double gridCenter = (frames[0] * Vec4!double([0.5 * toCube, 0.5 * toCube, 0.5 * toCube, 1])).toPoint();
        double farthest = 1;
        double farthestFromGrid = 1;
        foreach (cubeCorner; 0 .. 8) {
            Point!double point = (frames[0] * Vec4!double([(cubeCorner & 1) * toCube, ((cubeCorner >> 1) & 1) * toCube, ((cubeCorner >> 2) & 1) * toCube, 1])).toPoint();
            farthest = higherOf(farthest, center.coshDistance(point));
            farthestFromGrid = higherOf(farthestFromGrid, gridCenter.coshDistance(point));
        }
        h.coshCubeRadius = cast(float) farthest;
        h.coshCubeGridRadius = cast(float) farthestFromGrid;
        return h;
    }

    bool isAdjacent(size_t a, size_t b) const {
        return (adjacent[a] & (1u << b)) != 0;
    }

    Corner cornerAcross(Face[3] faces, size_t axis) const {
        Face[3] swapped = acrossFaces(faces, axis);
        uint corner = 0;
        while (corner < CORNER_COUNT && !isSameFaceSet(cornerFaces[corner], swapped)) {
            corner += 1;
        }
        assert(corner < CORNER_COUNT);
        return cast(Corner) corner;
    }

    Face[3] acrossFaces(Face[3] faces, size_t axis) const {
        uint candidate = 0;
        while (candidate < FACE_COUNT && !(candidate != faces[axis] && isAdjacent(candidate, faces[(axis + 1) % 3]) && isAdjacent(candidate, faces[(axis + 2) % 3]))) {
            candidate += 1;
        }
        assert(candidate < FACE_COUNT);
        Face[3] swapped = [faces[0], faces[1], faces[2]];
        swapped[axis] = cast(Face) candidate;
        return swapped;
    }

    uint firstCornerOn(Face face) const {
        uint corner = 0;
        while (cornerFaces[corner][0] != face && cornerFaces[corner][1] != face && cornerFaces[corner][2] != face) {
            corner += 1;
        }
        return corner;
    }
}

Normal!double[FACE_COUNT] faceNormals() {
    double rootFive = sqrt(5.0);
    double a = sqrt(1 / (1 - 1 / rootFive));
    double b = a / sqrt(rootFive);
    double length = sqrt(1 + GOLDEN * GOLDEN);
    Normal!double[FACE_COUNT] normals;
    foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        size_t placement = (5 - face % 3) % 3;
        size_t signs = face / 3;
        double first = 1;
        if ((signs & 1) != 0) {
            first = -1;
        }
        double second = GOLDEN;
        if ((signs & 2) != 0) {
            second = -GOLDEN;
        }
        Vec3!double direction = Vec3!double(0, 0, 0);
        direction[(placement + 1) % 3] = first / length;
        direction[(placement + 2) % 3] = second / length;
        normals[face] = Normal!double(Vec4!double([a * direction.x, a * direction.y, a * direction.z, b]));
    }
    return normals;
}

Face mostAntiparallel(ref const Normal!double[FACE_COUNT] normals, size_t face) {
    size_t opposite = face;
    double lowest = 0;
    foreach (other; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        double product = normals[face].minkowski(normals[other].v);
        if (product < lowest) {
            lowest = product;
            opposite = other;
        }
    }
    return cast(Face) opposite;
}

Motion!double cornerFrame(Normal!double a, Normal!double b, Normal!double c) {
    double distance = a.v.c[3];
    Point!double corner = (Vec4!double.origin() + (a.v + b.v + c.v) * distance).toPoint();
    return Motion!double.fromFrame([-a, -b, -c], corner);
}

Vec3!float referenceIn(Vec3!float direction, Point!double corner) {
    Vec3!double point = corner.v.spatial();
    double along = point.x * direction.x + point.y * direction.y + point.z * direction.z;
    Vec3!double reference = Vec3!double(point.x - along * direction.x, point.y - along * direction.y, point.z - along * direction.z);
    double length = sqrt(reference.x * reference.x + reference.y * reference.y + reference.z * reference.z);
    return Vec3!float(cast(float)(reference.x / length), cast(float)(reference.y / length), cast(float)(reference.z / length));
}

bool isSameFaceSet(Face[3] a, Face[3] b) {
    uint matched = 0;
    foreach (face; a) {
        if (face == b[0] || face == b[1] || face == b[2]) {
            matched += 1;
        }
    }
    return matched == 3;
}

immutable Honeycomb HONEYCOMB = Honeycomb.make();

enum float NODE_RADIUS = cast(float) acoshAtCompileTime(HONEYCOMB.coshNodeRadius);
enum float CUBE_RADIUS = cast(float) acoshAtCompileTime(HONEYCOMB.coshCubeRadius);
enum float CUBE_GRID_RADIUS = cast(float) acoshAtCompileTime(HONEYCOMB.coshCubeGridRadius);
enum float FACE_DISTANCE = cast(float) asinhAtCompileTime(HONEYCOMB.sinhFaceDistance);

ushort adjacentFaces(Face face) {

Vec3!float direction(Face face) {

bool isBeyond(Face face, Point!float point) {

/// file: source/geometry/lorentz.d
module geometry.lorentz;

import core.math : sqrt;
import core.stdc.math : acosh, cosh, sinh;
import base.numbers : higherOf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;

struct Vec4(T) {
    T[4] c = [0, 0, 0, 0];

    static Vec4 origin() {
        return Vec4([0, 0, 0, 1]);
    }

    T minkowski(Vec4 other) const {
        return c[0] * other.c[0] + c[1] * other.c[1] + c[2] * other.c[2] - c[3] * other.c[3];
    }

    Point!T toPoint() const {
        T scale = 1 / sqrt(-minkowski(this));
        if (c[3] < 0) {
            scale = -scale;
        }
        return Point!T(this * scale);
    }

    Normal!T toNormal() const {
        return Normal!T(this * (1 / sqrt(minkowski(this))));
    }

    Vec3!T spatial() const {
        return Vec3!T(c[0], c[1], c[2]);
    }

    Vec4 opBinary(string op)(Vec4 rhs) const if (op == "+" || op == "-") {
        Vec4 result;
        foreach (i; 0 .. 4) {
            result.c[i] = mixin("c[i] " ~ op ~ " rhs.c[i]");
        }
        return result;
    }

    Vec4 opBinary(string op)(T rhs) const if (op == "*" || op == "/") {
        Vec4 result;
        foreach (i; 0 .. 4) {
            result.c[i] = mixin("c[i] " ~ op ~ " rhs");
        }
        return result;
    }

    Vec4 opUnary(string op)() const if (op == "-") {
        return this * -1;
    }

    Vec4!U as(U)() const {
        return Vec4!U([cast(U) c[0], cast(U) c[1], cast(U) c[2], cast(U) c[3]]);
    }
}

struct Point(T) {
    Vec4!T v;

    static Point origin() {
        return Point(Vec4!T.origin());
    }

    T minkowski(Vec4!T other) const {
        return v.minkowski(other);
    }

    T coshDistance(Point other) const {
        return higherOf(T(1), -v.minkowski(other.v));
    }

    T distance(Point other) const {
        return cast(T) acosh(coshDistance(other));
    }

    Point midpoint(Point other) const {
        return (v + other.v).toPoint();
    }

    Point!U as(U)() const {
        return Point!U(v.as!U());
    }
}

struct Normal(T) {
    Vec4!T v;

    T minkowski(Vec4!T other) const {
        return v.minkowski(other);
    }

    Normal opUnary(string op)() const if (op == "-") {
        return Normal(-v);
    }

    Normal!U as(U)() const {
        return Normal!U(v.as!U());
    }
}

struct Mat4(T) {
    T[4][4] c = 0;

    static Mat4 identity() {
        Mat4 result;
        foreach (i; 0 .. 4) {
            result.c[i][i] = 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static Mat4 scaling(T factor) {
        Mat4 result;
        foreach (i; 0 .. 3) {
            result.c[i][i] = factor;
        }
        result.c[3][3] = 1;
        return result;
    }

    Vec4!T opBinary(string op)(Vec4!T v) const if (op == "*") {
        Vec4!T result;
        foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
            result.c[row] = c[0][row] * v.c[0] + c[1][row] * v.c[1] + c[2][row] * v.c[2] + c[3][row] * v.c[3];
        }
        return result;
    }

    Mat4 opBinary(string op)(Mat4 rhs) const if (op == "*") {
        Mat4 result;
        foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
            foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
                result.c[col][row] = c[0][row] * rhs.c[col][0] + c[1][row] * rhs.c[col][1] + c[2][row] * rhs.c[col][2] + c[3][row] * rhs.c[col][3];
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    Vec4!T column(size_t index) const {
        return Vec4!T(c[index]);
    }

    T determinant() const {
        T result = 0;
        foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
            if (col % 2 == 0) {
                result += c[col][0] * minor(col);
            } else {
                result -= c[col][0] * minor(col);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    T minor(size_t skipped) const {
        size_t[3] cols;
        size_t count = 0;
        foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
            if (col != skipped) {
                cols[count] = col;
                count += 1;
            }
        }
        T a(size_t col, size_t row) {
            return c[cols[col]][row + 1];
        }
        return a(0, 0) * (a(1, 1) * a(2, 2) - a(2, 1) * a(1, 2)) - a(1, 0) * (a(0, 1) * a(2, 2) - a(2, 1) * a(0, 2)) + a(2, 0) * (a(0, 1) * a(1, 2) - a(1, 1) * a(0, 2));
    }

    T[4] row(size_t index) const {
        return [c[0][index], c[1][index], c[2][index], c[3][index]];
    }
}

struct Motion(T) {
    Mat4!T m;

    static Motion identity() {
        return Motion(Mat4!T.identity());
    }

    static Motion reflection(Normal!T normal) {
        Vec4!T n = normal.v;
        Motion result = identity();
        foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
            T lowered = n.c[col];
            if (col == 3) {
                lowered = -lowered;
            }
            foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
                result.m.c[col][row] -= 2 * n.c[row] * lowered;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static Motion shift(Vec3!T v) {
        T length = sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z);
        if (length == 0) {
            return identity();
        } else {
            Vec3!T u = Vec3!T(v.x / length, v.y / length, v.z / length);
            T coshLength = cast(T) cosh(length);
            T sinhLength = cast(T) sinh(length);
            Motion result = identity();
            foreach (col; 0 .. 3) {
                foreach (row; 0 .. 3) {
                    result.m.c[col][row] += (coshLength - 1) * u[row] * u[col];
                }
                result.m.c[col][3] = sinhLength * u[col];
                result.m.c[3][col] = sinhLength * u[col];
            }
            result.m.c[3][3] = coshLength;
            return result;
        }
    }

    static Motion carrying(Point!T from, Point!T to) {
        return shiftTo(to) * shiftTo(from).inverse();
    }

    static Motion shiftTo(Point!T target) {
        Vec3!T spatial = target.v.spatial();
        T length = sqrt(spatial.x * spatial.x + spatial.y * spatial.y + spatial.z * spatial.z);
        if (length == 0) {
            return identity();
        } else {
            T distance = target.distance(Point!T.origin());
            T scale = distance / length;
            return shift(Vec3!T(spatial.x * scale, spatial.y * scale, spatial.z * scale));
        }
    }

    static Motion fromFrame(Normal!T[3] axes, Point!T origin) {
        Motion result;
        foreach (col; 0 .. 3) {
            result.m.c[col] = axes[col].v.c;
        }
        result.m.c[3] = origin.v.c;
        return result;
    }

    Motion inverse() const {
        Motion result;
        foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
            foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
                result.m.c[col][row] = m.c[row][col];
                if ((col == 3) != (row == 3)) {
                    result.m.c[col][row] = -result.m.c[col][row];
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    Motion orthonormalized() const {
        Vec4!T[4] columns = [m.column(0), m.column(1), m.column(2), m.column(3)];
        columns[3] = columns[3].toPoint().v;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
            Vec4!T v = columns[axis] + columns[3] * columns[axis].minkowski(columns[3]);
            foreach (previous; 0 .. axis) {
                v = v - columns[previous] * v.minkowski(columns[previous]);
            }
            columns[axis] = v.toNormal().v;
        }
        Motion result;
        foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
            result.m.c[col] = columns[col].c;
        }
        return result;
    }

    bool isMirroring() const {
        return m.determinant() < 0;
    }

    Vec4!T opBinary(string op)(Vec4!T v) const if (op == "*") {
        return m * v;
    }

    Point!T opBinary(string op)(Point!T p) const if (op == "*") {
        return Point!T(m * p.v);
    }

    Normal!T opBinary(string op)(Normal!T n) const if (op == "*") {
        return Normal!T(m * n.v);
    }

    Motion opBinary(string op)(Motion rhs) const if (op == "*") {
        return Motion(m * rhs.m);
    }

    Motion!U as(U)() const {
        Motion!U result;
        foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
            foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
                result.m.c[col][row] = cast(U) m.c[col][row];
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
}

/// file: source/geometry/ray.d
module geometry.ray;

import base.maybe : Maybe;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Normal, Point, Vec4;

enum float MAX_TANH_DISTANCE = 0.999f;

struct Ray {
    Point!float start;
    Normal!float heading;

    Vec4!float at(float tanhDistance) const {
        return start.v + heading.v * tanhDistance;
    }

    Ray movedBy(Motion!float motion) const {
        return Ray(motion * start, motion * heading);
    }

    Maybe!float crossing(Normal!float plane) const {
        float t = -plane.minkowski(start.v) / plane.minkowski(heading.v);
        if (t > 0.0f && t <= float.max) {
            return Maybe!float.of(t);
        } else {
            return Maybe!float.init;
        }
    }
}

struct HeadlessArguments {
    Array!(const(char)*) prefixes;
    StartupError error;
    const(char)* outputPath;
    Worldgen worldgen;
    Maybe!float radius;
    Maybe!float iterations;
    Maybe!float height;
    Maybe!Command command;
    RunKind kind;

    static HeadlessArguments fromArgv(int argc, char** argv) {
        HeadlessArguments arguments;
        arguments.parseOptions!Option(OPTIONS[], argc, argv);
        return arguments;
    }

    void apply(Option option, ref ArgumentCursor cursor) {
        final switch (option) {
            case Option.worldgen:
                parseWorldgen(cursor);
                break;
            case Option.output:
                outputPath = cursor.next();
                break;
            case Option.radius:
                radius = number(option, cursor.next());
                break;
            case Option.iterations:
                iterations = number(option, cursor.next());
                break;
            case Option.height:
                height = number(option, cursor.next());
                break;
            case Option.help:
                kind = RunKind.help;
                cursor.stop();
                break;
            case Option.showVersion:
                kind = RunKind.showVersion;
                cursor.stop();
                break;
        }
    }

    void applyPositional(const(char)* argument) {
        if (argument[0] == '-') {
            error = StartupError(null, UNKNOWN_OPTION, argument);
        } else if (!command.exists) {
            command = optionNamed!Command(COMMANDS[], sliceOf(argument));
            if (!command.exists) {
                error = StartupError(null, "unknown command", argument);
            }
        } else if (takesPrefixes()) {
            prefixes.append(argument);
        } else {
            error = StartupError(null, "unexpected", argument);
        }
    }

    void parseWorldgen(ref ArgumentCursor cursor) {
        WorldgenArgument parsed = WorldgenArgument.from(cursor);
        worldgen = parsed.worldgen;
        error = parsed.error;
    }

    Maybe!float number(Option option, const(char)* text) {
        Maybe!float parsed = numberIn(text);
        if (!parsed.exists) {
            error = StartupError(null, NOT_A_NUMBER, text, OPTIONS[option].name);
        }
        return parsed;
    }

    bool takesPrefixes() const {
        return command.value == Command.tests || command.value == Command.views || command.value == Command.films;
    }

    bool needsStructure() const {
        return command.value == Command.dumpStructure || command.value == Command.slice || command.value == Command.checkRepaint || command.value == Command.checkForget;
    }

    StartupError usageError() const {
        if (kind != RunKind.command) {
            return StartupError.init;
        } else if (!command.exists) {
            return StartupError(null, "nothing to do: give a command");
        } else if (needsStructure() && worldgen.kind != WorldgenKind.structure) {
            return StartupError(registry().allNames(), "needs a structure world", null, COMMANDS[command.value].name);
        } else {
            return StartupError.init;
        }
    }

    float commandRadius() const {
        if (radius.exists) {
            return radius.value;
        } else if (command.value == Command.dumpWorld || command.value == Command.worldDigest || command.value == Command.materialCensus || command.value == Command.surfaceCensus) {
            return DEFAULT_DUMP_RADIUS;
        } else if (command.value == Command.benchNearby) {
            return DEFAULT_NEARBY_RADIUS;
        } else {
            return DEFAULT_GEN_RADIUS;
        }
    }

    int sliceHeight() const {
        if (height.exists) {
            return cast(int) height.value;
        } else {
            return DEFAULT_SLICE_HEIGHT;
        }
    }

    uint iterationCount() const {
        if (iterations.exists) {
            return cast(uint) iterations.value;
        } else {
            return DEFAULT_NEARBY_ITERATIONS;
        }
    }
}

bool isChosen(ref const HeadlessArguments arguments, string name) {
    size_t index = 0;
    while (index < arguments.prefixes.length && !isPrefixOf(sliceOf(arguments.prefixes.ptr[index]), name)) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return arguments.prefixes.length == 0 || index < arguments.prefixes.length;
}

bool isPrefixOf(const(char)[] prefix, string name) {
    return prefix.length <= name.length && name[0 .. prefix.length] == prefix;
}

ExitStatus runTest(ref const NamedScript test, Worldgen worldgen, FILE* report) {
    double start = nowSeconds();
    fprintf(report, "== %.*s\n", cast(int) test.name.length, test.name.ptr);
    fflush(report);
    reportHangAfter(TEST_HANG_SECONDS);
    ClientConfig config;
    Game game = Game.make(worldgen, config.reach);
    game.supply = ChunkSupply.onDemand;
    StructureProblem problem = game.placeStructure();
    ExitStatus status = ExitStatus.failed;
    if (problem.isPresent) {
        fprintf(report, "%s\n", problem.text.ptr);
    } else {
        Script script = Script.make(&game, report);
        status = script.run(test.run);
        fprintf(report, "session: steps=%u time=%.2f traveled=%.2f wall=%.1fs%s\n", script.steps, cast(double) game.time.value, cast(double) game.traveled.value, nowSeconds() - start, sessionSuffix(status));
    }
    fflush(report);
    game.release();
    return status;
}

immutable(char)* sessionSuffix(ExitStatus status) {
    if (status == ExitStatus.ok) {
        return "";
    } else {
        return " error";
    }
}

ExitStatus runFilms(ref const HeadlessArguments arguments, FILE* report) {
    ExitStatus status = ExitStatus.ok;
    foreach (ref film; FILMS) {
        ExitStatus ran = runScripts(arguments, film.shots, report);
        if (ran != ExitStatus.ok) {
            status = ExitStatus.failed;
        }
    }
    return status;
}

ExitStatus runScripts(ref const HeadlessArguments arguments, const(NamedScript)[] scripts, FILE* report) {
    uint passed = 0;
    uint failed = 0;
    foreach (ref test; scripts) {
        if (arguments.isChosen(test.name)) {
            ExitStatus ran = runTest(test, arguments.worldgen, report);
            if (ran == ExitStatus.ok) {
                passed += 1;
            } else {
                failed += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    fprintf(report, "%u passed, %u failed\n", passed, failed);
    return exitStatus(failed == 0);
}

ExitStatus runCommand(ref const HeadlessArguments arguments, FILE* output) {
    float radius = arguments.commandRadius();
    ExitStatus status = ExitStatus.ok;
    final switch (arguments.command.value) {
        case Command.tests:
            status = runScripts(arguments, TESTS, output);
            break;
        case Command.views:
            status = runScripts(arguments, VIEWS, output);
            break;
        case Command.films:
            status = runFilms(arguments, output);
            break;
        case Command.worldDigest:
            status = printWorldDigest(output, radius, CHUNK_DIMENSION);
            break;
        case Command.dumpWorld:
            status = dumpWorld(output, radius, CHUNK_DIMENSION);
            break;
        case Command.materialCensus:
            status = printMaterialCensus(output, radius, CHUNK_DIMENSION);
            break;
        case Command.surfaceCensus:
            status = printSurfaceCensus(output, radius, CHUNK_DIMENSION);
            break;
        case Command.dumpStructure:
            status = dumpStructure(output, CHUNK_DIMENSION, arguments.worldgen);
            break;
        case Command.slice:
            status = printSlices(output, CHUNK_DIMENSION, arguments.worldgen, arguments.sliceHeight());
            break;
        case Command.checkRepaint:
            status = checkRepaint(output, CHUNK_DIMENSION, arguments.worldgen);
            break;
        case Command.checkForget:
            status = checkForget(output, CHUNK_DIMENSION, arguments.worldgen);
            break;
        case Command.benchGen:
            benchGen(output, radius, CHUNK_DIMENSION);
            break;
        case Command.benchMesh:
            benchMesh(output, radius, CHUNK_DIMENSION);
            break;
        case Command.benchDrive:
            benchDrive(output, radius, CHUNK_DIMENSION);
            break;
        case Command.benchNearby:
            benchNearby(output, radius, arguments.iterationCount(), CHUNK_DIMENSION);
            break;
        case Command.benchHashMap:
            benchHashMap(output);
            break;
        case Command.biologyTables:
            printBiologyTables(output);
            break;
        case Command.wildCensus:
            printWildCensus(output);
            break;
    }
    return status;
}

void printWildCensus(FILE* output) {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(CHUNK_DIMENSION, Worldgen.fromPlane(PlaneWorld(0)));
    graph.bindView();
    uint root = graph.slotOf(ROOT_NODE).value;
    WildGenes rootGenes = graph.ensureState(root).wild;
    Array!uint frontier;
    Array!uint next;
    frontier.append(root);
    fprintf(output, "depth nodes mean_genes_differing_from_root\n");
    foreach (depth; 1 .. CENSUS_DEPTH + 1) {
        next.clear();
        foreach (slot; frontier.slice()) {
            foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                if (next.length < CENSUS_WIDTH && !graph.isParentFace(slot, cast(Face) face)) {
                    uint child = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(slot, cast(Face) face);
                    if (graph.depthOf(child) == depth) {
                        next.append(child);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        float differing = 0;
        foreach (slot; next.slice()) {
            differing += differingGenes(graph.ensureState(slot).wild, rootGenes);
        }
        fprintf(output, "%5u %5zu %.3f\n", cast(uint) depth, next.length, cast(double)(differing / next.length));
        Array!uint swapped = frontier;
        frontier = next;
        next = swapped;
    }
    frontier.release();
    next.release();
    graph.release();
}

void printBiologyTables(FILE* output) {
    Organism organism = Organism.make(starterGenome());
    foreach (index, ref given; STARTER_DOSES) {
        fprintf(output, "dose %zu, %s\n  concentration:", index + 1, ENUM_NAMES!Route[given.route].ptr);
        foreach (receptor; organism.receptors.slice()) {
            fprintf(output, " %c%c", cast(char)('A' + receptor.firstHalf), cast(char)('A' + receptor.secondHalf));
        }
        fprintf(output, "\n");
        float concentration = LEAST_TABLE_CONCENTRATION;
        while (concentration <= MOST_TABLE_CONCENTRATION) {
            fprintf(output, "  %10.4f:", cast(double) concentration);
            foreach (ref receptor; organism.receptors.slice()) {
                Binding binding = organism.cache.bindingOf(receptor.pocket, given.molecule);
                Ratio[1] concentrations = [Ratio(concentration)];
                Ratio[1] affinities = [binding.affinity];
                Ratio[1] occupied;
                occupanciesOf(concentrations[], affinities[], occupied[]);
                fprintf(output, " %.2f", cast(double) occupied[0].value);
            }
            fprintf(output, "\n");
            concentration *= TABLE_CONCENTRATION_STEP;
        }
        Organism dosed = Organism.make(starterGenome());
        dosed.dose(given);
        fprintf(output, "  seconds: blood, then signals\n");
        foreach (row; 0 .. TABLE_ROWS) {
            fprintf(output, "  %7.1f: %.4f", cast(double)(row * TABLE_ROW_SECONDS.value), cast(double) dosed.body.bloodOf(given.molecule).value);
            foreach (signal; dosed.signaling.signals()) {
                fprintf(output, " %+.3f", cast(double) signal.value);
            }
            fprintf(output, "\n");
            dosed.advance(TABLE_ROW_SECONDS);
        }
        dosed.release();
    }
    organism.release();
}

ExitStatus runWithOutput(ref const HeadlessArguments arguments, const(char)* program) {
    FILE* output = openReport(arguments.outputPath);
    if (output is null) {
        StartupError(null, REPORT_UNOPENED, arguments.outputPath).report(program);
        return ExitStatus.failed;
    } else {
        ExitStatus status = runCommand(arguments, output);
        closeReport(output);
        return status;
    }
}

ExitStatus startCommand(ref const HeadlessArguments arguments, const(char)* program) {
    if (arguments.error.isPresent()) {
        arguments.error.report(program);
        return ExitStatus.usage;
    } else if (arguments.kind == RunKind.help) {
        printf("%.*s", cast(int) USAGE.length, USAGE.ptr);
        return ExitStatus.ok;
    } else if (arguments.kind == RunKind.showVersion) {
        printf("%s", VERSION_TEXT.ptr);
        return ExitStatus.ok;
    } else {
        return runWithOutput(arguments, program);
    }
}

extern (C) int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    reportCrashes();
    gatherWorlds();
    HeadlessArguments arguments = HeadlessArguments.fromArgv(argc, argv);
    ExitStatus status = startCommand(arguments, argv[0]);
    arguments.prefixes.release();
    return status;
}

        ulong virtualSize;
        ulong residentSize;
        ulong residentSizeMax;

    }

    MachTaskBasicInfo taskInfo() {
        MachTaskBasicInfo info;
        uint count = MachTaskBasicInfo.sizeof / int.sizeof;
        task_info(mach_task_self_, MACH_TASK_BASIC_INFO, cast(int*) &info, &count);

    }

        size_t sizeInUse;

        size_t sizeAllocated;
    }

    HeapBytes heapBytes() {
        MallocStatistics statistics;
        malloc_zone_statistics(null, &statistics);
        return HeapBytes(statistics.sizeInUse, statistics.sizeAllocated - statistics.sizeInUse);

    enum string STATM_PATH = "/proc/self/statm";
    enum string DELETE_WINDOW_ATOM = "WM_DELETE_WINDOW";
    enum string XINPUT_EXTENSION = "XInputExtension";
    enum size_t BYTES_PER_KILOBYTE = 1024;
    enum uint KEYCODE_COUNT = 256;
    enum uint CURSOR_BITMAP_SIZE = 8;
    enum long INPUT_EVENT_MASK = KEY_PRESS_EVENTS | KEY_RELEASE_EVENTS | BUTTON_PRESS_EVENTS | STRUCTURE_EVENTS | FOCUS_EVENTS;
    enum uint POINTER_GRAB_MASK = BUTTON_PRESS_EVENTS;
    enum int XI_REQUIRED_MAJOR = 2;
    enum int XI_REQUIRED_MINOR = 1;
    enum size_t XI_MASK_BYTES = (XI_RawMotion >> 3) + 1;
    enum uint POINTER_AXES = 2;
    enum uint BITS_PER_BYTE = 8;

    enum AxisMode : ubyte {
        relative,
        absolute,
    }

    struct PointerAxis {
        double countsPerValue = 1;
        Maybe!double last;
        AxisMode mode;

        double delta(double value) {
            if (mode == AxisMode.absolute) {
                Maybe!double previous = last;
                last = Maybe!double.of(value);
                if (previous.exists) {
                    return (value - previous.value) * countsPerValue;
                } else {
                    return 0;
                }
            } else {
                return value * countsPerValue;
            }
        }
    }

    struct RawPointer {
        PointerAxis[POINTER_AXES] axes;
        int opcode;
        Maybe!int deviceId;
    }

    bool isXInputVersionSufficient(int major, int minor) {
        return major > XI_REQUIRED_MAJOR || (major == XI_REQUIRED_MAJOR && minor >= XI_REQUIRED_MINOR);
    }

    void setEventBit(ubyte[] mask, int event) {
        mask[event / BITS_PER_BYTE] |= cast(ubyte)(1 << (event % BITS_PER_BYTE));
    }

    bool isEventBitSet(const(ubyte)* mask, int event) {
        return (mask[event / BITS_PER_BYTE] & (1 << (event % BITS_PER_BYTE))) != 0;
    }

    size_t residentBytes() {
        FILE* statm = fopen(STATM_PATH, "r");
        size_t total = 0;
        size_t resident = 0;
        if (statm !is null) {
            fscanf(statm, "%zu %zu", &total, &resident);
            fclose(statm);
        }
        return resident * pageSize();
    }

    size_t peakResidentBytes() {
        rusage usage;
        getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF, &usage);
        return cast(size_t) usage.ru_maxrss * BYTES_PER_KILOBYTE;
    }

    HeapBytes heapBytes() {
        auto info = mallinfo2();
        return HeapBytes(info.uordblks + info.hblkhd, info.fordblks);
    }
}
