/// file: source/shaders/face.h
#if !defined(FACE_H)
#define FACE_H

const uint COORD_BITS = 8u;
const uint COORD_MASK = (1u << COORD_BITS) - 1u;
const uint AXIS_SHIFT = 3u * COORD_BITS;
const uint AXIS_MASK = 3u;
const uint REVERSED_BIT = 1u << 2u;
const uint FLIPPED_BIT = 1u << 3u;
const uint MATERIAL_MASK = 0xFFFFu;
const uint WINDOW_SHIFT = 16u;
const uint WINDOW_MASK = 0xFFu;
const uint OCCLUSION_SHIFT = 24u;
const uint OCCLUSION_BITS = 2u;
const uint OCCLUSION_MASK = (1u << OCCLUSION_BITS) - 1u;
const uint OCCLUSION_LEVELS = OCCLUSION_MASK;
const float OCCLUSION_DARKEST = 0.05;

struct Face {
    uint pos_axis;
    uint occlusion_material;
};

uvec3 face_position(Face face) {
    return uvec3(face.pos_axis & COORD_MASK, (face.pos_axis >> COORD_BITS) & COORD_MASK, (face.pos_axis >> (2u * COORD_BITS)) & COORD_MASK);
}

uint face_code(Face face) {
    return face.pos_axis >> AXIS_SHIFT;
}

uint face_material(Face face) {
    return face.occlusion_material & MATERIAL_MASK;
}

uint face_window(Face face) {
    return (face.occlusion_material >> WINDOW_SHIFT) & WINDOW_MASK;
}

float face_occlusion(Face face, uvec2 corner) {
    uint index = corner.x | corner.y << 1u;
    uint level = (face.occlusion_material >> (OCCLUSION_SHIFT + OCCLUSION_BITS * index)) & OCCLUSION_MASK;
    return mix(OCCLUSION_DARKEST, 1.0, float(level) / float(OCCLUSION_LEVELS));
}

#endif

/// file: source/shaders/fog.frag
#version 450

#include "target.h"
#include "common.h"

STAGE_LINK(0) in vec2 screen;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 fog;

#if defined(GL_ES)
    uniform sampler2D depth_input;
    uniform sampler2D glow_input;
    #define LOAD_INPUT(name) texelFetch(name, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0)
#else
    layout(input_attachment_index = 0, set = 0, binding = 1) uniform subpassInput depth_input;
    layout(input_attachment_index = 1, set = 0, binding = 2) uniform subpassInput glow_input;
    #define LOAD_INPUT(name) subpassLoad(name)
#endif

void main() {
    vec2 slope = (screen * 2.0 - 1.0) * half_tangents;
    float klein_depth = depth_scale / (LOAD_INPUT(depth_input).x + depth_scale);
    float radius = klein_depth * sqrt(1.0 + dot(slope, slope));
    float kept = 0.0;
    if (radius < 1.0) {
        kept = exp(-pow(atanh(radius) / fog_reach, fog_sharpness));
    }
    fog = vec4(fog_color.rgb, mix(kept, 1.0, LOAD_INPUT(glow_input).x));
}

}

/// file: source/shaders/highlight.frag
#version 450

#include "target.h"
#include "depth.h"

const float EDGE_SRGB = 0.05;
const float SRGB_OFFSET = 0.055;
const float SRGB_GAMMA = 2.4;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 color;
layout(location = 1) out float glow;

void main() {
    float edge = pow((EDGE_SRGB + SRGB_OFFSET) / (1.0 + SRGB_OFFSET), SRGB_GAMMA);
    color = vec4(edge, edge, edge, 1.0);
    glow = 0.0;
    write_depth();
}

/// file: source/shaders/highlight.vert
#version 450

#include "target.h"
#include "common.h"
#include "clip.h"
#include "warp.h"

const vec3 CORNERS[8] = vec3[](
    vec3(0, 0, 0), vec3(1, 0, 0), vec3(0, 1, 0), vec3(1, 1, 0),
    vec3(0, 0, 1), vec3(1, 0, 1), vec3(0, 1, 1), vec3(1, 1, 1)
);

const int EDGES[24] = int[](
    0, 1, 1, 3, 3, 2, 2, 0,
    4, 5, 5, 7, 7, 6, 6, 4,
    0, 4, 1, 5, 3, 7, 2, 6
);

const vec3 VOXEL_CENTER = vec3(0.5);
const float OUTLINE_SCALE = 1.01;

PUSH_BEGIN
    PUSHED mat4 model;
    PUSHED vec4 low;
    PUSHED vec4 high;
PUSH_END

void main() {
    vec3 c = VOXEL_CENTER + (CORNERS[EDGES[VERTEX_INDEX]] - VOXEL_CENTER) * OUTLINE_SCALE;
    place_clip(projection * warped(camera_inverse * model * vec4(mix(low.xyz, high.xyz, c), 1.0)));
}

/// file: source/shaders/hud.vert
#version 450

#include "target.h"

const float SRGB_POWER = 2.2;
const uint TEXEL_MASK = 0xFFFFu;
const uint TEXEL_Y_SHIFT = 16u;

STAGE_LINK(0) out vec4 shade;
STAGE_LINK(1) out vec2 texel;

#if defined(GL_ES)
    layout(location = 0) in vec2 vertex_at;
    layout(location = 1) in vec4 vertex_written;
    layout(location = 2) in vec2 vertex_texel;

    vec2 position_of_vertex() {
        return vertex_at;
    }

    vec4 written_of_vertex() {
        return vertex_written;
    }

    vec2 texel_of_vertex() {
        return vertex_texel;
    }
#else
    struct Vertex {
        vec2 at;
        uint color;
        uint texel;
    };

    BOUND(0, 0) readonly restrict buffer Vertices {
        Vertex vertices[];
    };

    vec2 position_of_vertex() {
        return vertices[VERTEX_INDEX].at;
    }

    vec4 written_of_vertex() {
        return unpackUnorm4x8(vertices[VERTEX_INDEX].color);
    }

    vec2 texel_of_vertex() {
        uint packed = vertices[VERTEX_INDEX].texel;
        return vec2(float(packed & TEXEL_MASK), float(packed >> TEXEL_Y_SHIFT));
    }
#endif

void main() {
    vec2 at = position_of_vertex();
    vec4 written = written_of_vertex();
    shade = vec4(pow(written.rgb, vec3(SRGB_POWER)), written.a);
    texel = texel_of_vertex();
    gl_Position = vec4(at.x, SCREEN_Y(at.y), 0.0, 1.0);
}

/// file: source/shaders/marker.vert
#version 450

#include "target.h"
#include "common.h"
#include "clip.h"
#include "warp.h"

const float SRGB_POWER = 2.2;

const vec3 CORNERS[8] = vec3[](
    vec3(-1, -1, -1), vec3(1, -1, -1), vec3(-1, 1, -1), vec3(1, 1, -1),
    vec3(-1, -1, 1), vec3(1, -1, 1), vec3(-1, 1, 1), vec3(1, 1, 1)
);

const int TRIANGLES[36] = int[](
    0, 1, 3, 3, 2, 0,
    4, 6, 7, 7, 5, 4,
    0, 4, 5, 5, 1, 0,
    2, 3, 7, 7, 6, 2,
    0, 2, 6, 6, 4, 0,
    1, 5, 7, 7, 3, 1
);

STAGE_LINK(0) out vec3 shade;

PUSH_BEGIN
    PUSHED mat4 model;
    PUSHED float half_side;
    PUSHED uint marker_color;
PUSH_END

#if defined(GL_ES)
    const float CHANNEL_MOST = 255.0;

    vec3 written_color() {
        return vec3(float(marker_color & 255u), float((marker_color >> 8u) & 255u), float((marker_color >> 16u) & 255u)) / CHANNEL_MOST;
    }
#else
    vec3 written_color() {
        return unpackUnorm4x8(marker_color).rgb;
    }
#endif

void main() {
    shade = pow(written_color(), vec3(SRGB_POWER));
    place_clip(projection * warped(camera_inverse * model * vec4(CORNERS[TRIANGLES[VERTEX_INDEX]] * half_side, 1.0)));
}

/// file: source/shaders/post.frag
#version 450

#include "target.h"

layout(location = 0) out vec4 color;
layout(location = 1) out vec4 kept;

BOUND(0, 0) uniform sampler2D scene;
BOUND(0, 1) uniform sampler2D previous;
BOUND(0, 2) uniform sampler2D level1;
BOUND(0, 3) uniform sampler2D level2;
BOUND(0, 4) uniform sampler2D level3;
BOUND(0, 5) uniform sampler2D level4;

PUSH_BEGIN
    PUSHED vec4 band_gains;
    PUSHED float afterimage;
PUSH_END

void main() {
    ivec2 pixel = ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy);
    vec2 place = gl_FragCoord.xy / vec2(textureSize(scene, 0));
    vec3 finest = texelFetch(scene, pixel, 0).rgb;
    vec3 first = texture(level1, place).rgb;
    vec3 second = texture(level2, place).rgb;
    vec3 third = texture(level3, place).rgb;
    vec3 fourth = texture(level4, place).rgb;
    vec3 banded = fourth + band_gains.x * (finest - first) + band_gains.y * (first - second) + band_gains.z * (second - third) + band_gains.w * (third - fourth);
    vec3 seen = mix(max(banded, vec3(0.0)), texelFetch(previous, pixel, 0).rgb, afterimage);
    color = vec4(seen, 1.0);
    kept = color;
}

/// file: source/shaders/present.frag
#version 450

#include "target.h"

const float SRGB_LINEAR_LIMIT = 0.0031308;
const float SRGB_LINEAR_SLOPE = 12.92;
const float SRGB_OFFSET = 0.055;
const float SRGB_GAMMA = 2.4;

STAGE_LINK(0) in vec2 screen;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 color;

uniform sampler2D image;

vec3 encoded(vec3 linear) {
    vec3 low = linear * SRGB_LINEAR_SLOPE;
    vec3 high = (1.0 + SRGB_OFFSET) * pow(linear, vec3(1.0 / SRGB_GAMMA)) - SRGB_OFFSET;
    return mix(high, low, vec3(lessThanEqual(linear, vec3(SRGB_LINEAR_LIMIT))));
}

void main() {
    color = vec4(encoded(texelFetch(image, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0).rgb), 1.0);
}

/// file: source/shaders/reduce.frag
#version 450

#include "target.h"

layout(location = 0) out vec4 color;

BOUND(0, 0) uniform sampler2D finer;

void main() {
    vec2 texel = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(finer, 0));
    vec2 center = gl_FragCoord.xy * 2.0 * texel;
    vec3 sum = texture(finer, center + vec2(-texel.x, -texel.y)).rgb;
    sum += texture(finer, center + vec2(texel.x, -texel.y)).rgb;
    sum += texture(finer, center + vec2(-texel.x, texel.y)).rgb;
    sum += texture(finer, center + vec2(texel.x, texel.y)).rgb;
    color = vec4(sum * 0.25, 1.0);
}

/// file: source/shaders/voxels.frag
#version 450

#include "target.h"
#include "depth.h"

const float CLEAR_ALPHA = 0.5;

STAGE_LINK(0) in vec3 texcoords;
STAGE_LINK(1) in float brightness;
STAGE_LINK(2) flat in float glowing;
STAGE_LINK(3) flat in vec3 tint;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 color;
layout(location = 1) out float glow;

BOUND(1, 1) uniform sampler2DArray textures;

void main() {
    vec4 texel = texture(textures, texcoords);
    if (texel.a < CLEAR_ALPHA) {
        discard;
    }
    color = vec4(texel.rgb * tint * mix(brightness, 1.0, glowing), 1.0);
    glow = glowing;
    write_depth();
}

/// file: source/shaders/voxels.vert
#version 450

#include "target.h"
#include "common.h"
#include "draw.h"
#include "face.h"
#include "clip.h"
#include "warp.h"

const uint VERTICES_PER_FACE = 6u;
const uint FIRST_SOLID_MATERIAL = 1u;
const uint BITS_PER_WORD = 32u;
const uint WINDOWS_PER_SIDE = 16u;
const float SHADE_FACING_SUN = 1.0;
const float SHADE_AWAY = 0.5;

STAGE_LINK(0) out vec3 texcoords;
STAGE_LINK(1) out float brightness;
STAGE_LINK(2) flat out float glowing;
STAGE_LINK(3) flat out vec3 tint;

#if defined(GL_ES)
    const uint FACE_ROW_SHIFT = 12u;
    const uint FACE_COLUMN_MASK = 4095u;

    uniform usampler2D face_texture;
    uniform DrawTransform current_draw;

    Face load_face(uint index) {
        uvec2 words = texelFetch(face_texture, ivec2(index & FACE_COLUMN_MASK, index >> FACE_ROW_SHIFT), 0).rg;
        return Face(words.x, words.y);
    }

    DrawTransform load_draw() {
        return current_draw;
    }
#else
    BOUND(1, 0) readonly restrict buffer Faces {
        Face faces[];
    };

    BOUND(1, 2) readonly restrict buffer Transforms {
        DrawTransform draws[];
    };

    Face load_face(uint index) {
        return faces[index];
    }

    DrawTransform load_draw() {
        return draws[gl_InstanceIndex];
    }
#endif

PUSH_BEGIN
    PUSHED uint dimension;
    PUSHED float cell_ratio;
    PUSHED uint glowing_materials[3];
    PUSHED uint unseen_materials[3];
    PUSHED uint framed_material;
PUSH_END

const vec4 UNSEEN_CLIP = vec4(2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.0);

uvec2 face_corner(uint vertex_index, bool is_reversed, bool is_flipped) {
    uint step_index = vertex_index;
    if (vertex_index >= 3u) {
        step_index = (vertex_index - 1u) % 4u;
    }
    uvec2 corner = uvec2(step_index >> 1u, ((step_index + 1u) >> 1u) & 1u);
    if (is_reversed != is_flipped) {
        corner = corner.yx;
    }
    if (is_flipped) {
        corner.y = 1u - corner.y;
    }
    return corner;
}

vec4 cross4(vec4 a, vec4 b, vec4 c) {
    return vec4(
        dot(a.yzw, cross(b.yzw, c.yzw)),
        -dot(a.xzw, cross(b.xzw, c.xzw)),
        dot(a.xyw, cross(b.xyw, c.xyw)),
        -dot(a.xyz, cross(b.xyz, c.xyz))
    );
}

float minkowski(vec4 a, vec4 b) {
    return dot(a.xyz, b.xyz) - a.w * b.w;
}

float facing_sun(vec4 point, vec4 along, vec4 across) {
    vec4 plane = cross4(point, along, across);
    if (dot(plane, eye) < 0.0) {
        plane = -plane;
    }
    float plane_norm = dot(plane.xyz, plane.xyz) - plane.w * plane.w;
    float point_norm = -minkowski(point, point);
    float toward = -minkowski(sun, point);
    if (plane_norm <= 0.0 || point_norm <= 0.0 || toward <= 0.0) {
        return 0.0;
    }
    return clamp(dot(plane, sun) * sqrt(point_norm / plane_norm) / toward, -1.0, 1.0);
}

void main() {
    uint vertex_index = uint(VERTEX_INDEX);
    Face face = load_face(vertex_index / VERTICES_PER_FACE);
    DrawTransform draw = load_draw();
    uint code = face_code(face);
    uint axis = code & AXIS_MASK;
    uvec2 corner = face_corner(vertex_index % VERTICES_PER_FACE, ((code & REVERSED_BIT) != 0u) != (draw.reversed.x != 0.0), (code & FLIPPED_BIT) != 0u);
    uint material = face_material(face);
    vec2 on_layer = vec2(corner);
    if (material != framed_material) {
        uint window = face_window(face);
        on_layer = (on_layer + vec2(window % WINDOWS_PER_SIDE, window / WINDOWS_PER_SIDE)) / float(WINDOWS_PER_SIDE);
    }
    texcoords = vec3(on_layer, float(material - FIRST_SOLID_MATERIAL));
    tint = material_tints[material].rgb;
    uvec3 grid = face_position(face);
    grid[(axis + 1u) % 3u] += corner.x;
    grid[(axis + 2u) % 3u] += corner.y;
    vec3 cube = vec3(grid) / float(dimension);
    if (cell_ratio != 1.0) {
        cube = (1.0 - pow(vec3(cell_ratio), vec3(grid))) / (1.0 - pow(cell_ratio, float(dimension)));
    }
    vec4 point = draw.transform * vec4(cube, 1.0);
    float shade = mix(SHADE_AWAY, SHADE_FACING_SUN, 0.5 + 0.5 * facing_sun(point, draw.transform[(axis + 1u) % 3u], draw.transform[(axis + 2u) % 3u]));
    brightness = face_occlusion(face, corner) * shade;
    glowing = float((glowing_materials[material / BITS_PER_WORD] >> (material % BITS_PER_WORD)) & 1u);
    if (((unseen_materials[material / BITS_PER_WORD] >> (material % BITS_PER_WORD)) & 1u) != 0u) {
        place_clip(UNSEEN_CLIP);
    } else {
        place_clip(projection * warped(camera_inverse * point));
    }
}

/// file: source/shaders/warp.h
#if !defined(WARP_H)
#define WARP_H

#include "common.h"

const float WARP_FREQUENCY = 6.0;
const float WARP_RATE = 1.3;
const float WARP_RATE_ACROSS = 0.9;

vec4 warped(vec4 camera_point) {
    float reach = length(camera_point.xyz);
    if (warp_strength == 0.0 || reach == 0.0) {
        return camera_point;
    }
    vec3 direction = camera_point.xyz / reach;
    float off_axis = length(direction.xy);
    vec2 sway = vec2(sin(WARP_FREQUENCY * direction.y + warp_seconds * WARP_RATE), sin(WARP_FREQUENCY * direction.x - warp_seconds * WARP_RATE_ACROSS));
    vec3 moved = normalize(direction + vec3(sway * (warp_strength * off_axis), 0.0));
    return vec4(moved * reach, camera_point.w);
}

#endif

/// file: source/unit/allocator.d
module unit.allocator;

import base.allocator : RangeAllocator;
import base.maybe : Maybe;

enum uint CAPACITY = 100;

unittest {
    RangeAllocator allocator;
    allocator.grow(CAPACITY);
    Maybe!uint a = allocator.allocate(30);
    Maybe!uint b = allocator.allocate(30);
    Maybe!uint c = allocator.allocate(30);
    assert(a == Maybe!uint.of(0) && b == Maybe!uint.of(30) && c == Maybe!uint.of(60));
    Maybe!uint tooMuch = allocator.allocate(30);
    assert(!tooMuch.exists);
    allocator.release(b.value, 30);
    Maybe!uint reused = allocator.allocate(20);
    assert(reused == Maybe!uint.of(30));
    allocator.release(a.value, 30);
    allocator.release(30, 20);
    assert(allocator.used() == 30);
    Maybe!uint merged = allocator.allocate(60);
    assert(merged == Maybe!uint.of(0));
    allocator.grow(2 * CAPACITY);
    Maybe!uint grown = allocator.allocate(110);
    assert(grown == Maybe!uint.of(90));
    assert(allocator.used() == 2 * CAPACITY);
    allocator.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/arrivals.d
module unit.arrivals;

import base.hashmap : FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.parallel : Executor;
import client.arrivals : Integrator;
import client.tasks : GenKind, GenResult;
import common.graph : Graph, ROOT_NODE;
import common.neighbors : chunkNeighborSlot, needsMesh;
import common.node : Chunk, ChunkSlot, ChunkState, Materials, Voxels, cellCount;
import common.worldgen.generation : GeneratedVoxels, Worldgen;
import geometry.cube : DIRECTIONS;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, FACE_COUNT, Face;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum ubyte DIMENSION = 4;
enum ulong MIX = 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9;
enum size_t KINDS = 4;
enum size_t VOID_ODDS = 3;
enum size_t BATCH_STRIDE = 3;

GeneratedVoxels madeVoxels(size_t chunk) {
    if (chunk % KINDS == 0) {
        return GeneratedVoxels(Voxels.filled(Material.granite), Materials.resolved);
    } else if (chunk % KINDS == 1) {
        return GeneratedVoxels(Voxels.filled(Material.none), Materials.resolved);
    } else {
        Voxels voxels = Voxels.filled(Material.granite);
        Material[] cells = voxels.toDense(DIMENSION);
        foreach (cell; 0 .. cellCount(DIMENSION)) {
            if (((chunk * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER + cell) * MIX >> 32) % VOID_ODDS == 0) {
                cells[cell] = Material.none;
            }
        }
        return GeneratedVoxels(voxels, Materials.resolved);
    }
}

bool isArrivedIn(ChunkSlot chunk, size_t batch) {
    return (cast(size_t) chunk.slot * CORNER_COUNT + chunk.corner) / BATCH_STRIDE % 2 == batch;
}

bool isBesideArrivalIn(ref const Graph graph, ChunkSlot chunk, size_t batch) {
    foreach (direction; DIRECTIONS) {
        Maybe!ChunkSlot neighbor = graph.chunkNeighborSlot(chunk, direction);
        if (neighbor.exists && isArrivedIn(neighbor.value, batch)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(DIMENSION, Worldgen.makeTerrain());
    uint root = graph.slotOf(ROOT_NODE).value;
    foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        graph.ensureNeighborSlot(root, cast(Face) face);
    }
    size_t chunkCount = cast(size_t) graph.slotCount * CORNER_COUNT;
    size_t first = 0;
    while (!isArrivedIn(ChunkSlot.fromIndex(first), 0) || !graph.isBesideArrivalIn(ChunkSlot.fromIndex(first), 1)) {
        first += 1;
    }
    ChunkSlot dropped = ChunkSlot.fromIndex(first);
    Integrator integrator = Integrator.make(1);
    foreach (batch; 0 .. 2) {
        foreach (index; 0 .. chunkCount) {
            ChunkSlot chunk = ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index);
            if (isArrivedIn(chunk, batch)) {
                graph.chunks.writable(chunk).state = ChunkState.generating;
                integrator.arrivals.append(GenResult(madeVoxels(index), chunk, GenKind.fresh));
            }
        }
        integrator.run(graph, Executor(null));
        if (batch == 0) {
            Chunk* chunk = graph.chunks.existing(dropped);
            chunk.releaseVoxels();
            chunk.state = ChunkState.dropped;
        }
    }
    foreach (index; 0 .. chunkCount) {
        ChunkSlot chunk = ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index);
        assert(!graph.needsMesh(chunk) || graph.chunks.at(chunk).isQueued);
    }
    assert(graph.chunks.at(dropped).state == ChunkState.generating && graph.chunks.restores.length == 1);
    integrator.release();
    graph.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/blueprint.d
module unit.blueprint;

import common.worldgen.blueprint : Rhythm, canonicalRhythm, edgeOf;
import common.worldgen.structure : AxisOrder, LineTransform, edgeCells;

enum ubyte DIMENSION = 12;

unittest {
    int edge = edgeCells(DIMENSION);
    assert(edgeOf(-3, DIMENSION) == -1 && edgeOf(0, DIMENSION) == 0);
    assert(edgeOf(edge - 1, DIMENSION) == 0 && edgeOf(edge, DIMENSION) == 1);
    assert(edgeOf(-edge, DIMENSION) == -1 && edgeOf(-edge - 1, DIMENSION) == -2);
    LineTransform mirrored = LineTransform(2, 1, 1, -1, AxisOrder.straight);
    Rhythm local = Rhythm(8, 1, 3);
    Rhythm moved = canonicalRhythm(local, mirrored, DIMENSION);
    foreach (height; -20 .. 20) {
        assert(local.includes(height) == moved.includes(mirrored.offsetLevels * edge - 1 - height));
    }
}

/// file: source/unit/breeding.d
module unit.breeding;

import common.biology.breeding : crossed, expressionIn;
import common.biology.wild : WILD_GENES, WildGenes;
import common.worldgen.climate : Climate;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum ulong SALT = 0x1234;

unittest {
    WildGenes first = WildGenes([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    WildGenes second = WildGenes([10, 20, 30, 40]);
    WildGenes child = crossed(first, second, SALT, 0);
    foreach (index; 0 .. WILD_GENES) {
        assert(child.seeds[index] == first.seeds[index] || child.seeds[index] == second.seeds[index]);
    }
    WildGenes wild = crossed(first, second, SALT, 1);
    uint unchanged = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. WILD_GENES) {
        if (wild.seeds[index] == first.seeds[index] || wild.seeds[index] == second.seeds[index]) {
            unchanged += 1;
        }
    }
    assert(unchanged == 0);
}

unittest {
    Climate wet = Climate(0, 0.2f, 0.9f, 0);
    Climate dry = Climate(0, 0.2f, -0.9f, 0);
    assert(expressionIn(Material.fern, wet) > expressionIn(Material.fern, dry));
    assert(expressionIn(Material.thornbush, dry) > expressionIn(Material.thornbush, wet));
    assert(expressionIn(Material.flower, wet) > 0 && expressionIn(Material.flower, wet) < 1);
}

/// file: source/unit/camera.d
module unit.camera;

import core.math : cos;
import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.numbers : PI;
import base.units : Angle, Length;
import base.vector3 : Vec3, dot, magnitude, scaled;
import client.camera : CAMERA_FORWARD, Camera, PITCH_LIMIT;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion;

enum Angle ANGLE_TOLERANCE = Angle(1e-3f);

unittest {
    Camera camera = Camera.make(Length(0));
    camera.turn(Angle(0), Angle(PI));
    assert(camera.elevation() <= PITCH_LIMIT + ANGLE_TOLERANCE);
    camera.turn(Angle(0), Angle(-2 * PI));
    assert(camera.elevation() >= -PITCH_LIMIT - ANGLE_TOLERANCE);
    Angle before = camera.elevation();
    camera.turn(Angle(PI / 2), Angle(0));
    assert(fabsf((camera.elevation() - before).value) < ANGLE_TOLERANCE.value);
}

unittest {
    Camera camera = Camera.make(Length(0));
    camera.turn(Angle(0), Angle(0.3f));
    camera.follow(camera.position, Motion!float.identity(), Vec3!float(0.6f, 0.8f, 0));
    Vec3!float up = camera.heading.rotate(Vec3!float(0, 1, 0));
    assert(fabsf(up.x - 0.6f) + fabsf(up.y - 0.8f) + fabsf(up.z) < ANGLE_TOLERANCE.value);
    assert(fabsf(camera.elevation().value - 0.3f) < ANGLE_TOLERANCE.value);
}

unittest {
    Camera camera = Camera.make(Length(0));
    camera.turn(Angle(0), -PITCH_LIMIT);
    Vec3!float before = camera.heading.rotate(CAMERA_FORWARD);
    foreach (step; 0 .. 100) {
        float wobble = 1e-3f;
        if (step % 2 != 0) {
            wobble = -wobble;
        }
        Vec3!float up = Vec3!float(wobble, 1, wobble * 0.5f);
        camera.follow(camera.position, Motion!float.identity(), up.scaled(1 / up.magnitude));
    }
    Vec3!float after = camera.heading.rotate(CAMERA_FORWARD);
    assert(before.dot(after) > cos(ANGLE_TOLERANCE.value * 10));
}

module unit.climate;

import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.worldgen.climate : BROAD_RELIEF, Climate, CubeClimate, HEAT, NodeClimate, SOIL_DEPTH, boundOf, groundAt, uniformRock;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum uint SAMPLES = 50;
enum uint GENERATIONS = 2000;
enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-4f;

unittest {
    NodeClimate[8] around;
    foreach (index; 0 .. 8) {
        around[index] = NodeClimate.fromParents(around[0 .. index], index * 977);
    }
    CubeClimate cube = CubeClimate.fromAround(around);
    assert(cube.corners[7].relief == around[0].climate().relief);
    foreach (sample; 0 .. SAMPLES) {

        Climate inside = cube.at(Vec3!float(t, 1 - t, t * t));

    }
    NodeClimate walked;
    foreach (generation; 0 .. GENERATIONS) {
        NodeClimate[1] parent = [walked];
        walked = NodeClimate.fromParents(parent[], generation * 0x9E37);
        assert(walked.broad <= boundOf(BROAD_RELIEF) && walked.broad >= -boundOf(BROAD_RELIEF));
        assert(walked.heat <= boundOf(HEAT) && walked.heat >= -boundOf(HEAT));
    }
}

/// file: source/unit/clock.d
module unit.clock;

import base.clock : FrameClock, SMOOTHED_FRAMES;

immutable double[2] UNEVEN_FRAMES = [0.012, 0.021];
enum double MOST_FRAME = 0.1;
enum double FRAME_TOLERANCE = 1e-9;

unittest {
    FrameClock clock = FrameClock.startingAt(0);
    double now = 0;
    double smoothed = 0;
    foreach (frame; 0 .. 4 * SMOOTHED_FRAMES) {
        now += UNEVEN_FRAMES[frame % UNEVEN_FRAMES.length];
        smoothed = clock.tick(now, MOST_FRAME);
    }
    double mean = (UNEVEN_FRAMES[0] + UNEVEN_FRAMES[1]) / 2;
    assert(smoothed > mean - FRAME_TOLERANCE && smoothed < mean + FRAME_TOLERANCE);
    assert(clock.worst > UNEVEN_FRAMES[1] - FRAME_TOLERANCE && clock.worst < UNEVEN_FRAMES[1] + FRAME_TOLERANCE);
    smoothed = clock.tick(now + 1, MOST_FRAME);
    assert(smoothed < mean + MOST_FRAME / SMOOTHED_FRAMES + FRAME_TOLERANCE);
}

/// file: source/unit/color.d
module unit.color;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.numbers : PI;
import base.units : Angle;
import common.color : CHROMA_AXES, CHROMA_BASIS, COLOR_CHANNELS, ColorTurn, Seen, Spectrum, TURN_PLANES, dotOf, grayOf, seenOf, spectrumOf, turned;

enum float COLOR_TOLERANCE = 1e-5f;
immutable Seen SAMPLE = [0.6f, 0.2f, 0.05f];

ColorTurn turnOf(float radians) {
    ColorTurn turn;
    foreach (index; 0 .. TURN_PLANES) {
        turn.angles[index] = Angle(radians * (index + 1));
    }
    return turn;
}

bool isNear(float a, float b) {
    return fabsf(a - b) <= COLOR_TOLERANCE;
}

unittest {
    foreach (axis; 0 .. CHROMA_AXES) {
        float sum = 0;
        foreach (channel; CHROMA_BASIS[axis]) {
            sum += channel;
        }
        assert(isNear(sum, 0));
        foreach (other; 0 .. CHROMA_AXES) {
            float expected = 0;
            if (other == axis) {
                expected = 1;
            }
            assert(isNear(dotOf(CHROMA_BASIS[axis], CHROMA_BASIS[other]), expected));
        }
    }
}

unittest {
    Spectrum color = spectrumOf(SAMPLE);
    ColorTurn still;
    Seen same = seenOf(turned(color, still));
    foreach (channel; 0 .. 3) {
        assert(isNear(same[channel], SAMPLE[channel]));
    }
    ColorTurn whole;
    foreach (index; 0 .. TURN_PLANES) {
        whole.angles[index] = Angle(2 * PI);
    }
    Spectrum around = turned(color, whole);
    foreach (channel; 0 .. COLOR_CHANNELS) {
        assert(isNear(around[channel], color[channel]));
    }
}

unittest {
    Spectrum gray = 0.4f;
    Spectrum moved = turned(gray, turnOf(0.7f));
    foreach (channel; moved) {
        assert(isNear(channel, 0.4f));
    }
    Spectrum color = spectrumOf(SAMPLE);
    Spectrum other = turned(color, turnOf(1.3f));
    assert(isNear(grayOf(other), grayOf(color)));
    float before = 0;
    float after = 0;
    foreach (channel; 0 .. COLOR_CHANNELS) {
        before += (color[channel] - grayOf(color)) * (color[channel] - grayOf(color));
        after += (other[channel] - grayOf(other)) * (other[channel] - grayOf(other));
    }
    assert(isNear(before, after));
    foreach (step; 0 .. 32) {
        Seen seen = seenOf(turned(color, turnOf(step * 0.2f)));
        foreach (channel; seen) {
            assert(channel >= -COLOR_TOLERANCE);
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/unit/controller.d
module unit.controller;

import base.vector3 : Vec3, dot, magnitude;
import common.character.controller : PlaneSet, SkinRule, alongGround, clipToPlanes;
import common.character.sweep : ContactPlane;

enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-5f;

unittest {
    Vec3!float floorNormal = Vec3!float(0, 1, 0);
    Vec3!float wallNormal = Vec3!float(-1, 0, 0);
    ContactPlane[2] planes = [
        ContactPlane(floorNormal, 0),
        ContactPlane(wallNormal, 0),
    ];
    Vec3!float intoCorner = Vec3!float(1, -0.5f, 1);
    Vec3!float clipped = clipToPlanes(planes, intoCorner, SkinRule.restore);
    assert(clipped.x > -TOLERANCE && clipped.x < TOLERANCE);
    assert(clipped.y > -TOLERANCE && clipped.y < TOLERANCE);
    assert(clipped.z > 1 - TOLERANCE);
    assert(clipped.magnitude <= intoCorner.magnitude);
}

unittest {
    Vec3!float slopeNormal = Vec3!float(-0.5f, 0.8660254f, 0);
    Vec3!float uphill = Vec3!float(1, 0, 0);
    Vec3!float downhill = Vec3!float(-1, 0, 0);
    Vec3!float across = Vec3!float(0, 0, 1);
    float cosine = slopeNormal.y;
    assert(alongGround(uphill, slopeNormal).magnitude > cosine - TOLERANCE && alongGround(uphill, slopeNormal).magnitude < cosine + TOLERANCE);
    assert(alongGround(uphill, slopeNormal).y > 0);
    assert(alongGround(downhill, slopeNormal).magnitude > cosine - TOLERANCE && alongGround(downhill, slopeNormal).magnitude < cosine + TOLERANCE);
    assert(alongGround(downhill, slopeNormal).y < 0);
    assert(alongGround(across, slopeNormal).magnitude > 1 - TOLERANCE);
}

unittest {
    Vec3!float wallNormal = Vec3!float(-1, 0, 0);
    float skinDeficit = 0.25f;
    ContactPlane[1] touching = [ContactPlane(wallNormal, skinDeficit)];
    Vec3!float along = Vec3!float(0, 0, 1);
    Vec3!float restored = clipToPlanes(touching, along, SkinRule.restore);
    assert(restored.dot(wallNormal) >= skinDeficit);
    Vec3!float clippedVelocity = clipToPlanes(touching, along, SkinRule.ignore);
    assert(clippedVelocity == along);
}

unittest {
    Vec3!float a = Vec3!float(-1, 0, 0);
    Vec3!float b = Vec3!float(0, 0, -1);
    Vec3!float c = Vec3!float(0, -1, 0);
    ContactPlane[3] boxed = [
        ContactPlane(a, 0),
        ContactPlane(b, 0),
        ContactPlane(c, 0),
    ];
    Vec3!float intoAll = Vec3!float(1, 1, 1);
    assert(clipToPlanes(boxed, intoAll, SkinRule.restore).magnitude == 0);
}

unittest {
    Vec3!float floorNormal = Vec3!float(0, 1, 0);
    Vec3!float ceilingNormal = Vec3!float(0, -1, 0);
    ContactPlane[2] squeezed = [
        ContactPlane(floorNormal, 0.01f),
        ContactPlane(ceilingNormal, 0.02f),
    ];
    Vec3!float alongSlot = Vec3!float(1, -0.1f, 0);
    Vec3!float clipped = clipToPlanes(squeezed, alongSlot, SkinRule.restore);
    assert(clipped.x > 1 - TOLERANCE);
    assert(clipped.y > -TOLERANCE && clipped.y < TOLERANCE);
}

unittest {
    Vec3!float first = Vec3!float(-1, 0, 0);
    Vec3!float nearlySame = Vec3!float(-1, 1e-5f, 0);
    PlaneSet set;
    set.add(ContactPlane(first, 0.5f));
    set.add(ContactPlane(nearlySame, 0.1f));
    assert(set.count == 1);
    assert(set.planes[0].separation == 0.5f);
}

module unit.features;

import core.math : sqrt;
import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.character.features : CELL_CORNERS, Hexahedron, Quad;

enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-5f;

unittest {
    Hexahedron cube;
    foreach (corner; 0 .. CELL_CORNERS) {
        cube.corners[corner] = Vec3!float(cast(float)(corner & 1), cast(float)((corner >> 1) & 1), cast(float)((corner >> 2) & 1));
    }
    Quad top = cube.face(1, 1);
    assert(top.normal.y > 1 - TOLERANCE);
    Vec3!float above = Vec3!float(0.5f, 2.0f, 0.5f);
    assert(top.isAbove(above));
    Vec3!float aside = Vec3!float(1.5f, 2.0f, 0.5f);
    assert(!top.isAbove(aside));
    Quad bottom = cube.face(1, -1);
    assert(bottom.normal.y < -1 + TOLERANCE);
    Vec3!float inside = Vec3!float(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f);
    assert(cube.distanceTo(inside) == 0);
    assert(fabsf(cube.distanceTo(above) - 1) < TOLERANCE);
    Vec3!float diagonal = Vec3!float(2.0f, 2.0f, 0.5f);
    assert(fabsf(cube.distanceTo(diagonal) - sqrt(2.0f)) < TOLERANCE);
}

/// file: source/unit/font.d
module unit.font;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.array : Array;
import client.font : Font, Outline, PLEX_MONO, PixelBox, PixelFrame, Raster, Segment, Transform, addGlyph, boundsOf, flatten, glyphOf, pixelBoxOf;

enum uint TEST_EM_PIXELS = 64;
enum float AREA_TOLERANCE = 0.01f;
enum float FULL_TEXEL = 255;
immutable string AREA_GLYPHS = "HOegM8";

unittest {
    Font font = Font.make(PLEX_MONO);
    float scale = cast(float) TEST_EM_PIXELS / font.unitsPerEm;
    assert(font.glyphOf('A') != 0);
    assert(!font.boundsOf(font.glyphOf(' ')).exists);
    Outline outline;
    Array!Segment segments;
    Raster raster;
    Array!ubyte coverage;
    foreach (character; AREA_GLYPHS) {
        ushort glyph = font.glyphOf(character);
        PixelBox box = pixelBoxOf(font.boundsOf(glyph).value, scale);
        outline.clear();
        font.addGlyph(glyph, Transform.init, outline);
        segments.clear();
        flatten(outline, PixelFrame(scale, box.left, box.top), segments);
        float enclosed = 0;
        foreach (segment; segments.slice()) {
            enclosed += (segment.from.x * segment.to.y - segment.to.x * segment.from.y) / 2;
        }
        raster.begin(box.width, box.height);
        raster.fill(segments.slice());
        coverage.resize(cast(size_t) box.width * box.height);
        raster.writeCoverage(box.width, coverage.slice(), box.width, 0);
        float covered = 0;
        foreach (texel; coverage.slice()) {
            covered += texel / FULL_TEXEL;
        }
        assert(fabsf(covered - fabsf(enclosed)) <= AREA_TOLERANCE * fabsf(enclosed));
    }
    outline.release();
    segments.release();
    raster.release();
    coverage.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/frames.d
module unit.frames;

import core.math : cos, sin, sqrt;
import core.stdc.math : fabs, round;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import client.frames : CameraStep, MouseCounts, MouseMotion, stepBetween;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion;

enum uint STEPS = 7;
enum MouseCounts COUNTS = MouseCounts(100, -23);
immutable Vec3!double START = Vec3!double(0.3, -0.1, 0.2);
immutable Vec3!double SHIFT = Vec3!double(0.004, 0.0, -0.01);
enum double TURN = 0.3;
enum double TOLERANCE = 1e-4;

unittest {
    MouseMotion motion = MouseMotion(COUNTS, MouseCounts.init, STEPS, 0);
    MouseCounts sum;
    while (motion.isActive()) {
        MouseCounts share = motion.next();
        assert(share.dx == round(share.dx) && share.dy == round(share.dy));
        sum.dx += share.dx;
        sum.dy += share.dy;
    }
    assert(sum == COUNTS);
    Motion!double start = Motion!double.shift(START);
    Motion!double turn = Motion!double.identity();
    turn.m.c[0][0] = cos(TURN);
    turn.m.c[0][2] = -sin(TURN);
    turn.m.c[2][0] = sin(TURN);
    turn.m.c[2][2] = cos(TURN);
    CameraStep step = stepBetween(start, start * turn * Motion!double.shift(SHIFT));
    double length = sqrt(SHIFT.x * SHIFT.x + SHIFT.y * SHIFT.y + SHIFT.z * SHIFT.z);
    assert(fabs(step.moved - length) < TOLERANCE && fabs(step.turned - TURN) < TOLERANCE);
}

/// file: source/unit/generation.d
module unit.generation;

import base.array : Array;
import common.graph : Graph, NodeId;
import common.view : GraphView;
import common.worldgen.generation : NodeState, Worldgen;
import common.worldgen.plane : Plane;
import geometry.honeycomb : FACE_COUNT, Face;

enum ubyte DIMENSION = 12;

bool isSamePlane(Plane a, Plane b) {
    return a.up == b.up && a.height == b.height;
}

bool isSameState(NodeState a, NodeState b) {
    return isSamePlane(a.surface, b.surface) && isSamePlane(a.reference, b.reference) && a.climate.broad == b.climate.broad && a.climate.local == b.climate.local && a.climate.heat == b.climate.heat && a.climate.wetness == b.climate.wetness && a.climate.strata == b.climate.strata && a.climate.ruggedness == b.climate.ruggedness;
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(DIMENSION, Worldgen.makeTerrain());
    foreach (side; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        uint neighbor = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(graph.anchorSlot, cast(Face) side);
        foreach (outer; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            graph.ensureNeighborSlot(neighbor, cast(Face) outer);
        }
    }
    uint region = graph.slotCount;
    GraphView view = GraphView.over(graph);
    Array!NodeState worked;
    Array!NodeId ids;
    foreach (slot; 0 .. region) {
        foreach (side; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            foreach (outer; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                uint far = view.ensureNeighborSlot(view.ensureNeighborSlot(slot, cast(Face) side), cast(Face) outer);
                worked.append(view.ensureState(far));
                ids.append(view.idAt(far));
            }
        }
    }
    assert(graph.slotCount == region && view.nodes.length > 0);
    size_t index = 0;
    foreach (slot; 0 .. region) {
        foreach (side; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            foreach (outer; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
                uint far = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(graph.ensureNeighborSlot(slot, cast(Face) side), cast(Face) outer);
                const(NodeState)* state = graph.ensureState(far);
                assert(graph.idAt(far) == ids.ptr[index] && isSameState(*state, worked.ptr[index]));
                index += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    view.release();
    worked.release();
    ids.release();
    graph.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/genome.d
module unit.genome;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.array : Array;
import base.units : Ratio;
import common.biology.genome : Gene, Genome, Receptor, assembleReceptors, enzymeGene, enzymeOf, halfOf, receptorGene;
import common.biology.metabolism : Enzyme, MOTIF_CELLS, MotifCell, Operation, Presence;
import common.biology.molecule : Fragment;
import common.biology.pocket : HALF_CELLS, HalfPocket, PocketCell, PocketKind;

enum float AMOUNT_TOLERANCE = 1e-5f;

HalfPocket halfFrom(uint salt) {
    HalfPocket half;
    foreach (index; 0 .. HALF_CELLS) {
        half.cells[index] = PocketCell(cast(PocketKind)((index + salt) % 4), cast(ubyte)((index * 3 + salt) % 8), cast(ubyte)((index + 2 * salt) % 8), cast(ubyte)((index + salt) % 2));
    }
    return half;
}

unittest {
    HalfPocket half = halfFrom(5);
    Gene receptor = receptorGene(half, Ratio(1));
    assert(halfOf(receptor) == half);
    Enzyme enzyme;
    enzyme.operation = Operation.attach;
    enzyme.attached = Fragment.of(0b011);
    foreach (index; 0 .. MOTIF_CELLS) {
        enzyme.motif[index] = MotifCell(cast(ubyte)(index % 8), cast(ubyte)((index * 5) % 8), cast(Presence)(index % 3));
    }
    Gene encoded = enzymeGene(enzyme, Ratio(1));
    assert(enzymeOf(encoded) == enzyme);
}

unittest {
    Genome genome;
    genome.add(receptorGene(halfFrom(1), Ratio(1)));
    genome.add(receptorGene(halfFrom(2), Ratio(1)));
    Array!Receptor receptors;
    assembleReceptors(genome, receptors);
    assert(receptors.length == 3);
    assert(fabsf(receptors.ptr[0].amount.value - 0.5f) <= AMOUNT_TOLERANCE);
    assert(fabsf(receptors.ptr[1].amount.value - 1.0f) <= AMOUNT_TOLERANCE);
    assert(fabsf(receptors.ptr[2].amount.value - 0.5f) <= AMOUNT_TOLERANCE);
    receptors.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/hashmap.d
module unit.hashmap;

import base.flags : Bits;
import base.hashmap : FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER, HashMap;

enum size_t KEYS = 100000;
enum size_t KEPT = 3;
enum size_t RANGE = 4096;
enum size_t STEPS = 2_000_000;
enum size_t SWING = 200_000;
enum size_t VISIT_STEPS = 1009;
enum size_t BIG_RANGE = 1 << 18;
enum size_t BIG_STEPS = 1_500_000;
enum size_t BIG_SWING = 500_000;
enum size_t BIG_VISIT_STEPS = 4999;
enum ulong STATE_MULTIPLIER = 6364136223846793005UL;
enum ulong STATE_INCREMENT = 1442695040888963407UL;

struct Key {
    size_t value;

    size_t toHash() const {
        return value;
    }
}

unittest {
    HashMap!(Key, size_t) map;
    foreach (i; 0 .. KEYS) {
        map.insert(Key(i), i * 2);
        assert(*map.find(Key(i / 2)) == (i / 2) * 2);
    }
    foreach (i; 0 .. KEYS) {
        assert(*map.find(Key(i)) == i * 2);
    }
    assert(map.find(Key(KEYS)) is null);
    map.insert(Key(3), 7);
    assert(*map.find(Key(3)) == 7);
    size_t capacity = map.current.capacity;
    map.clear();
    assert(map.find(Key(3)) is null && map.current.capacity == capacity);
    map.insert(Key(3), 1);
    assert(*map.find(Key(3)) == 1);
    map.release();
    HashMap!(Key, size_t) churn;
    foreach (i; 0 .. KEYS) {
        churn.insert(Key(i), i);
        if (i >= KEPT) {
            churn.remove(Key(i - KEPT));
            assert(churn.find(Key(i - KEPT)) is null);
        }
        assert(*churn.find(Key(i)) == i);
    }
    assert(churn.current.capacity < KEYS);
    churn.remove(Key(KEYS - 1));
    churn.insert(Key(KEYS - 1), 1);
    assert(*churn.find(Key(KEYS - 1)) == 1);
    churn.release();
    HashMap!(Key, size_t) emptied;
    foreach (i; 0 .. KEYS) {
        emptied.insert(Key(i * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER), i);
    }
    foreach (i; KEPT .. KEYS) {
        emptied.remove(Key(i * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER));
    }
    foreach (i; 0 .. KEYS) {
        size_t* found = emptied.find(Key(i * FIBONACCI_MULTIPLIER));
        if (i < KEPT) {
            assert(found !is null && *found == i);
        } else {
            assert(found is null);
        }
    }
    emptied.release();
}

unittest {
    HashMap!(Key, size_t) map;
    Bits held;
    held.cover(RANGE);
    ulong state = 1;
    foreach (step; 0 .. STEPS) {
        state = state * STATE_MULTIPLIER + STATE_INCREMENT;
        size_t key = (state >> 33) % RANGE;
        if (((step / SWING) % 2 == 0) != ((state >> 20) % 4 == 0)) {
            map.insert(Key(key), key);
            held.set(key);
        } else {
            map.remove(Key(key));
            held.clear(key);
        }
        size_t probed = (state >> 40) % RANGE;
        size_t* found = map.find(Key(probed));
        if (held.has(probed)) {
            assert(found !is null && *found == probed);
        } else {
            assert(found is null);
        }
        if (step % VISIT_STEPS == 0) {
            size_t visited = 0;
            foreach (ref const visitedKey, ref value; map) {
                assert(held.has(visitedKey.value) && value == visitedKey.value);
                visited += 1;
            }
            size_t present = 0;
            foreach (cell; 0 .. RANGE) {
                if (held.has(cell)) {
                    present += 1;
                }
            }
            assert(visited == present);
        }
    }
    foreach (key; 0 .. RANGE) {
        assert((map.find(Key(key)) !is null) == held.has(key));
    }
    held.release();
    map.release();
}

unittest {
    HashMap!(Key, size_t) map;
    Bits held;
    held.cover(BIG_RANGE);
    size_t present = 0;
    ulong state = 1;
    foreach (step; 0 .. BIG_STEPS) {
        state = state * STATE_MULTIPLIER + STATE_INCREMENT;
        size_t key = (state >> 30) % BIG_RANGE;
        if (((step / BIG_SWING) % 2 == 0) != ((state >> 20) % 4 == 0)) {
            if (!held.has(key)) {
                map.insert(Key(key), key);
                held.set(key);
                present += 1;
            }
        } else if (held.has(key)) {
            map.remove(Key(key));
            held.clear(key);
            present -= 1;
        }
        size_t probed = (state >> 40) % BIG_RANGE;
        assert((map.find(Key(probed)) !is null) == held.has(probed));
        if (step % BIG_VISIT_STEPS == 0) {
            size_t visited = 0;
            foreach (ref const visitedKey, ref value; map) {
                assert(held.has(visitedKey.value) && value == visitedKey.value);
                visited += 1;
            }
            assert(visited == present);
        }
    }
    held.release();
    map.release();
}

unittest {
    HashMap!(Key, size_t) map;
    size_t count = 0;
    while (map.previous.capacity == 0) {
        map.insert(Key(count), count);
        count += 1;
    }
    assert(map.migrated > 0);
    size_t visited = 0;
    foreach (ref const key, ref value; map) {
        assert(key.value == value && value < count);
        visited += 1;
    }
    assert(visited == count);
    map.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/honeycomb.d
module unit.honeycomb;

import core.stdc.math : acosh;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, CUBE_RADIUS, Corner, FACE_COUNT, FACE_DISTANCE, Face, NODE_RADIUS, across, axisMaps, cornerToNode, cubeCenter, cubeScale, cubeToNode, faces, isAdjacentTo, isBeyond, mirror, nodeToCorner, normal, opposite;
import geometry.lorentz : Point, Vec4;

enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-5f;

unittest {
    foreach (index; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        Face face = cast(Face) index;
        assert(face.opposite != face && !face.isAdjacentTo(face.opposite) && face.opposite.opposite == face);
        uint neighbors = 0;
        foreach (other; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            if (face.isAdjacentTo(cast(Face) other)) {
                neighbors += 1;
            }
        }
        assert(neighbors == 5);
        Point!float mirrored = face.mirror * Point!float.origin();
        assert(face.isBeyond(mirrored) && !face.isBeyond(Point!float.origin()));
        assert(acosh(mirrored.coshDistance(Point!float.origin())) - 2 * FACE_DISTANCE < TOLERANCE);
    }
    foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
        Corner corner = cast(Corner) index;
        Point!float point = corner.cornerToNode * Point!float.origin();
        assert(point.distance(Point!float.origin()) - NODE_RADIUS < TOLERANCE);
        foreach (face; corner.faces) {
            assert(face.normal.minkowski(point.v) * face.normal.minkowski(point.v) < TOLERANCE);
        }
        Vec4!float center = corner.nodeToCorner * Vec4!float.origin();
        foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
            assert(center.c[axis] / center.c[3] / cubeScale() - 1 < TOLERANCE);
            Corner next = corner.across[axis];
            assert(next != corner && next.across[corner.axisMaps[axis].to[axis]] == corner);
        }
        foreach (cubeCorner; 0 .. 8) {
            Vec4!float at = Vec4!float([cubeCorner & 1, (cubeCorner >> 1) & 1, (cubeCorner >> 2) & 1, 1]);
            Point!float cornerOfCube = (corner.cubeToNode * at).toPoint();
            assert(corner.cubeCenter.distance(cornerOfCube) < CUBE_RADIUS + TOLERANCE);
        }
    }
}

Graph structureGraph() {
    return Graph.make(DIMENSION, Worldgen.fromStructure(StructureWorld.fromName("test")));
}

Rise firstKindRise(ubyte edges) {
    return Rise(MaybeIndex!ubyte.of(0), edges);
}

void openAt(ref Graph graph, SiteFrame site, ubyte edges) {
    bool opened = graph.openHorosphere(site, firstKindRise(edges));
    assert(opened);
}

HorosphereId risenOver(ref Graph graph, uint face, Corner corner, HorosphereId over) {
    Maybe!HorosphereId made = graph.view.ensureHorosphereOver(face, corner, over);
    assert(made.exists);
    return made.value;
}

size_t airIn(ref Graph graph, uint slot) {
    size_t air = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
        GeneratedVoxels generated = ChunkParams.make(graph.view, slot, cast(Corner) index).generateVoxels();
        foreach (cell; 0 .. cast(size_t) DIMENSION * DIMENSION * DIMENSION) {
            if (generated.voxels.at(cell) == Material.none) {
                air += 1;
            }
        }
        generated.voxels.release();
    }
    return air;
}

Vec3!float ensurePullAt(ref Graph graph, Position at) {
    graph.view.ensureClimate(graph.slotOf(at.node).value, at.local * Point!float.origin());
    Gravity gravity = graph.ensureGravityAt(at);
    return gravity.up.scaled(gravity.strength);
}

float largestPullChange(ref Graph graph, Position start, Vec3!float heading, uint steps) {
    Position at = start;
    Vec3!float last = graph.ensurePullAt(at);
    float largest = 0;
    Motion!float step = Motion!float.shift(heading.scaled(PULL_STEP));
    foreach (_; 0 .. steps) {
        at = graph.ensureNormalized(Position(at.node, (at.local * step).orthonormalized()));
        Vec3!float pull = graph.ensurePullAt(at);
        largest = higherOf(largest, pull.minus(last).magnitude);
        last = pull;
    }
    return largest;
}

float largestPullChangeAround(ref Graph graph, SiteFrame tower, int bottom, int top) {
    float largest = 0;
    int cell = bottom;
    while (cell <= top) {
        Point!float center = sitePlacement(tower, graph.layout) * columnPoint(graph.layout, ColumnSpot(0.5f, 0.5f, cell + 0.5f));
        Position start = graph.ensureNormalized(Position(graph.idAt(tower.node), Motion!float.shiftTo(center)));
        foreach (heading; PULL_HEADINGS) {
            largest = higherOf(largest, graph.largestPullChange(start, heading, PULL_STEPS));
        }
        cell += PULL_CELL_STRIDE;
    }
    return largest;
}

void checkBuriedBeyond(ref Graph graph, HorosphereId risen) {
    Horosphere made = graph.horospheres.horosphere(risen);
    uint node = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(made.footNode, made.label);
    Face side = made.label.opposite;
    float altitude = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(risen, node).distanceTo(Point!float.origin());
    foreach (_; 0 .. DEEP_STEPS) {
        node = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(node, side);
        side = side.opposite;
        float deeper = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(risen, node).distanceTo(Point!float.origin());
        assert(deeper < altitude);
        altitude = deeper;
        size_t air = graph.airIn(node);
        assert(air == 0);
    }
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = structureGraph();
    graph.horospheres.kinds.append(HorosphereKind(0, HorosphereForm.bare, 0));
    SiteFrame root = rootSite(graph.anchorSlot);
    graph.openAt(root, LOWEST_RISE_EDGES);
    bool beside = graph.openHorosphere(forwarded(root, 1), firstKindRise(LOWEST_RISE_EDGES));
    assert(!beside);
    HorosphereId risen = graph.risenOver(graph.anchorSlot, root.corner, ROOT);
    NearbyScratch scratch;
    NearbyNode[] nearby = scratch.collectAll(graph, Position(graph.idAt(graph.horospheres.horosphere(risen).footNode), Motion!float.identity()), RADIUS);
    foreach (node; nearby) {
        const(HorosphereRef)[] found = graph.view.ensureHorospheresAt(node.slot);
        foreach (near; found) {
            Plane carried = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(near.horosphere, node.slot);
            assert(fabsf(carried.distanceTo(Point!float.origin()) - near.plane.distanceTo(Point!float.origin())) < PLANE_TOLERANCE);
        }
    }
    GraphView view = GraphView.over(graph);
    RiseMeasure viewed = view.ensureMeasure(risen);
    RiseMeasure measured = graph.view.ensureMeasure(risen);
    assert(!view.isBlocked && viewed == measured);
    view.release();
    Horosphere made = graph.horospheres.horosphere(risen);
    float footAltitude = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(risen, made.footNode).distanceTo(Point!float.origin());
    float anchorAltitude = graph.ensureState(graph.anchorSlot).surface.distanceTo(Point!float.origin());
    assert(fabsf(footAltitude - anchorAltitude) < PLANE_TOLERANCE);
    uint[GROUND_RING] ring = graph.view.ensureGroundRing(graph.anchorSlot, Face.first);
    SiteFrame high = graph.view.moveToLevel(forwarded(graph.view.turnSite(root, Turn.pitchUp), RISE_EDGES), 0);
    uint below = graph.view.ensureGroundNode(high.node, ROOT);
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < GROUND_RING && ring[index] != below) {
        index += 1;
    }
    assert(index < GROUND_RING);
    uint footGround = graph.view.ensureGroundNode(made.footNode, risen);
    assert(footGround == made.footNode);
    foreach (node; nearby) {
        HorosphereId[2] both = [ROOT, risen];
        foreach (over; both) {
            float ground = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(over, graph.view.ensureGroundNode(node.slot, over)).distanceTo(Point!float.origin());
            assert(fabsf(ground - FACE_DISTANCE) < PLANE_TOLERANCE);
        }
    }
    assert(graph.view.isOnFootLine(made.footNode, risen));
    SiteFrame farAlong = graph.view.moveToLevel(forwarded(made.foot, FAR_EDGES), 0);
    assert(!graph.view.isOnFootLine(farAlong.node, risen));
    SiteFrame quarter = made.foot;
    foreach (_; 0 .. GROUND_EDGES) {
        SiteFrame tower = graph.view.turnSite(graph.view.turnSite(quarter, Turn.pitchUp), Turn.rollRight);
        bool towerMatches = graph.isCanonicalMatch(tower);
        assert(towerMatches);
        SiteFrame across = graph.view.turnSite(graph.view.turnSite(graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(tower, LOWEST_RISE_EDGES), Turn.pitchUp), Turn.pitchUp), Turn.rollRight);
        bool acrossMatches = graph.isCanonicalMatch(across);
        assert(acrossMatches);
        quarter = graph.view.turnSite(quarter, Turn.right);
    }
    SiteFrame risenTower = graph.view.turnSite(graph.view.turnSite(made.foot, Turn.pitchUp), Turn.rollRight);
    SiteFrame rootTower = graph.view.turnSite(graph.view.turnSite(graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(risenTower, LOWEST_RISE_EDGES), Turn.pitchUp), Turn.pitchUp), Turn.rollRight);
    float length = LOWEST_RISE_EDGES * edgeCells(graph.layout.dimension);
    foreach (cell; PAINTED_CELLS) {
        Point!float fromRisen = graph.view.siteToNode(risenTower, risenTower.node) * columnPoint(graph.layout, ColumnSpot(cell.x + 0.5f, cell.y + 0.5f, cell.z + 0.5f));
        Point!float fromRoot = graph.view.siteToNode(rootTower, risenTower.node) * columnPoint(graph.layout, ColumnSpot(cell.y + 0.5f, cell.x + 0.5f, length - cell.z - 0.5f));
        assert(isSamePoint(fromRisen, fromRoot));
    }
    BlueprintBuilder builder = BlueprintBuilder.make(graph);
    foreach (cell; PAINTED_CELLS) {
        PaintResult result = builder.paint(risenTower, CellBox.make(cell.x, cell.x, cell.y, cell.y, cell.z, cell.z), EVERY_HEIGHT, Material.granite, Cover.over);
        assert(result == PaintResult.painted);
    }
    foreach (cell; PAINTED_CELLS) {
        Point!float center = sitePlacement(risenTower, graph.layout) * columnPoint(graph.layout, ColumnSpot(cell.x + 0.5f, cell.y + 0.5f, cell.z + 0.5f));
        Position at = graph.ensureNormalized(Position(graph.idAt(risenTower.node), Motion!float.shiftTo(center)));
        ChunkPoint inChunk = chunkPointOf(at.local * Point!float.origin());
        Vec3!int voxel = void;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
            voxel[axis] = cast(int) floorf(graph.layout.cubeToGrid(inChunk.coords[axis]));
        }
        const(Building)* building = graph.ensureBuildingAt(graph.slotOf(at.node).value);
        assert(building.materialAt(inChunk.corner, voxel, Material.none) == Material.granite);
    }
    builder.release();
    Plane over = risenPlaneOver(root.corner, Face.first, LOWEST_RISE_EDGES, graph.view.edgeOf());
    Plane stored = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(risen, graph.anchorSlot);
    assert(fabsf(over.distanceTo(Point!float.origin()) - stored.distanceTo(Point!float.origin())) < PLANE_TOLERANCE);
    Vec3!float down = Vec3!float(0, -1, 0);
    Vec3!float up = Vec3!float(0, 1, 0);
    float[2] equal = [0.5f, 0.5f];
    float[2] whole = [1, 1];
    Vec3!float[2] opposed = [up, down];
    assert(blendedGravity(equal[], whole[], opposed[]).strength < PLANE_TOLERANCE);
    float[1] alone = [0.5f];
    float[1] all = [1];
    Vec3!float[1] single = [up];
    assert(blendedGravity(alone[], all[], single[]).strength == 1.0f);
    float[2] nearFaded = [-1, 0];
    float[2] faded = [0, 1];
    assert(blendedGravity(nearFaded[], faded[], opposed[]).up.y == down.y);
    scratch.release();
    graph.release();
}

    graph.openAt(along, LOWEST_RISE_EDGES);
    HorosphereId second = graph.risenOver(along.node, along.corner, first);
    assert(graph.horospheres.horosphere(second).parent == first);
    uint foot = graph.horospheres.horosphere(second).footNode;
    float separation = CLEARANCE_EDGES * graph.view.edgeOf();
    Plane secondPlane = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(second, foot);
    Plane rootPlane = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(ROOT, foot);
    assert(isApart(secondPlane, rootPlane, separation));
    uint found = 0;
    foreach (near; graph.view.ensureHorospheresAt(foot)) {
        if (near.horosphere == second) {
            found += 1;
        }
    }
    assert(found > 0);
    graph.release();
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = structureGraph();
    graph.horospheres.kinds.append(HorosphereKind(1, HorosphereForm.bare, 0));
    SiteFrame root = rootSite(graph.anchorSlot);
    graph.openAt(root, LOWEST_RISE_EDGES);
    HorosphereId first = graph.risenOver(graph.anchorSlot, root.corner, ROOT);
    float separation = CLEARANCE_EDGES * graph.view.edgeOf();
    uint risen = 0;
    foreach (edges; ALONG_EDGES .. FARTHEST_EDGES + 1) {
        SiteFrame along = graph.view.moveToLevel(forwarded(graph.horospheres.horosphere(first).foot, edges), 0);
        foreach (made; graph.view.ensureRising(graph.view.ensureGroundNode(along.node, first), first)) {
            uint foot = graph.horospheres.horosphere(made).footNode;
            assert(graph.horospheres.horosphere(made).parent == first);
            Plane madePlane = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(made, foot);
            Plane rootPlane = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(ROOT, foot);
            assert(isApart(madePlane, rootPlane, separation));
            risen += 1;
        }
    }
    assert(risen > 0);
    graph.release();
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = structureGraph();
    graph.horospheres.kinds.append(HorosphereKind(0, HorosphereForm.bare, 0));
    graph.horospheres.kinds.append(HorosphereKind(1, HorosphereForm.upright, 1));
    SiteFrame root = rootSite(graph.anchorSlot);
    graph.openAt(root, LOWEST_RISE_EDGES);
    HorosphereId first = graph.risenOver(graph.anchorSlot, root.corner, ROOT);
    float edge = graph.view.edgeOf();
    uint trees = 0;
    foreach (edges; 0 .. FARTHEST_EDGES + 1) {
        SiteFrame along = graph.view.moveToLevel(forwarded(graph.horospheres.horosphere(first).foot, edges), 0);
        foreach (made; graph.view.ensureRising(graph.view.ensureGroundNode(along.node, first), first)) {
            const(Horosphere)* tree = &graph.horospheres.horosphere(made);
            assert(graph.horospheres.isUpright(made) && tree.parent == first);
            RiseLine line = riseLineOver(tree.foot.corner, tree.label, edge);
            Plane ground = graph.view.ensurePlaneIn(ROOT, tree.footNode);
            assert(isRayApart(line.base, line.along, ground, CLEARANCE_EDGES * edge));
            trees += 1;
        }
    }
    assert(trees > 0);
    graph.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/kinetics.d
module unit.kinetics;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.numbers : LN_TWO;
import base.units : Ratio, Time;
import common.biology.kinetics : Body, Route, clearanceOf;
import common.biology.molecule : CENTER_CELL, Fragment, Molecule, withFragment;

enum float LEVEL_TOLERANCE = 1e-4f;
enum Ratio DOSE = Ratio(1);
enum ubyte POLAR = 0b100;
enum uint SHORT_STEPS = 400;
enum Time LONG_STEP = Time(8);

unittest {
    Molecule molecule = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(POLAR));
    Body body;
    body.dose(molecule, DOSE, Route.injected);
    body.advance(Time(cast(float)(LN_TWO / clearanceOf(molecule).value)));
    assert(fabsf(body.bloodOf(molecule).value - DOSE.value / 2) <= LEVEL_TOLERANCE);
}

unittest {
    Molecule molecule = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(0));
    Body once;
    once.dose(molecule, DOSE, Route.ingested);
    once.dose(molecule, DOSE, Route.inhaled);
    once.advance(LONG_STEP);
    Body often;
    often.dose(molecule, DOSE, Route.ingested);
    often.dose(molecule, DOSE, Route.inhaled);
    foreach (_; 0 .. SHORT_STEPS) {
        often.advance(LONG_STEP / SHORT_STEPS);
    }
    assert(fabsf(once.bloodOf(molecule).value - often.bloodOf(molecule).value) <= LEVEL_TOLERANCE);
    assert(once.bloodOf(molecule).value > 0);
}

/// file: source/unit/lorentz.d
module unit.lorentz;

import core.math : sqrt;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import geometry.lorentz : Mat4, Motion, Normal, Point, Vec4;

enum double TOLERANCE = 1e-9;

bool isNear(double a, double b) {
    double difference = a - b;
    return difference < TOLERANCE && difference > -TOLERANCE;
}

unittest {
    Motion!double moved = Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(0.3, -1.2, 0.7));
    Point!double there = moved * Point!double.origin();
    assert(isNear(there.distance(Point!double.origin()), sqrt(0.09 + 1.44 + 0.49)));
    Motion!double back = moved.inverse() * moved;
    foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
        foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
            assert(isNear(back.m.c[col][row], Mat4!double.identity().c[col][row]));
        }
    }
    Point!double start = Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(1, 0, 0.5)) * Point!double.origin();
    Point!double end = Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(-0.4, 2, 0)) * Point!double.origin();
    assert(isNear((Motion!double.carrying(start, end) * start).coshDistance(end), 1));
    Normal!double plane = Vec4!double([1, 0.5, 0, 0.25]).toNormal();
    Motion!double mirror = Motion!double.reflection(plane);
    Point!double mirrored = mirror * start;
    assert(isNear(start.coshDistance(mirror * mirrored), 1));
    assert(isNear(plane.minkowski(start.v), -plane.minkowski(mirrored.v)));
    assert(mirror.isMirroring() && !moved.isMirroring());
    Motion!double drifted = moved;
    drifted.m.c[0][1] += 1e-4;
    drifted.m.c[3][2] -= 1e-4;
    Motion!double repaired = drifted.orthonormalized();
    foreach (col; 0 .. 4) {
        foreach (other; 0 .. 4) {
            double expected = 0;
            if (col == other && col == 3) {
                expected = -1;
            } else if (col == other) {
                expected = 1;
            }
            assert(isNear(repaired.m.column(col).minkowski(repaired.m.column(other)), expected));
        }
    }
}

/// file: source/unit/meshing.d
module unit.meshing;

import core.stdc.stdlib : free, malloc;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import client.meshing : CORNERS_PER_FACE, ChunkCells, Facing, OCCLUSION_LEVELS, Quad, WINDOW_BITS, WINDOW_SHIFT, maxQuads, paddedCellCount, paddedIndex;
import common.node : ChunkSlot;
import geometry.cube : AXIS_COUNT;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum ubyte DIMENSION = 4;
enum ubyte CELL = 2;

unittest {
    Material[] padded = (cast(Material*) malloc(paddedCellCount(DIMENSION)))[0 .. paddedCellCount(DIMENSION)];
    padded[] = Material.none;
    Vec3!int center = Vec3!int(CELL, CELL, CELL);
    ChunkCells cells = ChunkCells(padded.ptr, null, ChunkSlot.init, DIMENSION, 1);
    padded[paddedIndex(DIMENSION, center)] = Material.granite;
    assert(cells.isOccupied(center));
    Quad* quads = cast(Quad*) malloc(maxQuads(DIMENSION) * Quad.sizeof);
    uint count = cells.extractQuads(quads);
    assert(count == 2 * AXIS_COUNT);
    uint[CORNERS_PER_FACE] unoccluded = OCCLUSION_LEVELS;
    foreach (quad; quads[0 .. count]) {
        uint window = (quad.occlusionMaterial >> WINDOW_SHIFT) & ((1u << WINDOW_BITS) - 1);
        assert(quad.occlusionMaterial == Quad.fromVoxel(center, 0, Facing.outward, Material.granite, unoccluded, window).occlusionMaterial);
    }
    padded[paddedIndex(DIMENSION, Vec3!int(CELL - 1, CELL, CELL))] = Material.glass;
    uint glassCount = cells.extractQuads(quads);
    uint glassQuads = 0;
    foreach (quad; quads[0 .. glassCount]) {
        if ((quad.occlusionMaterial & ((1u << WINDOW_SHIFT) - 1)) == Material.glass) {
            glassQuads += 1;
        }
    }
    assert(glassCount == 2 * AXIS_COUNT + 2 * AXIS_COUNT - 1);
    assert(glassQuads == 2 * AXIS_COUNT - 1);
    free(quads);
    free(padded.ptr);
}

/// file: source/unit/metabolism.d
module unit.metabolism;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.units : Ratio, Time;
import common.biology.kinetics : Body, Route, clearanceOf;
import common.biology.metabolism : Enzyme, MotifCell, Operation, Presence, SITE_CELL, metabolize, productOf;
import common.biology.molecule : CENTER_CELL, Fragment, GRID_CELLS, GridPoint, Molecule, Property, cellOf, fragmentAt, fragmentCount, isConjugated, propertyBit, withFragment;

enum float AMOUNT_TOLERANCE = 1e-5f;
enum Ratio DOSE = Ratio(1);
enum Time TICK = Time(0.5f);

Enzyme enzymeAtFilled(Operation operation, ubyte wanted, ubyte cares) {
    Enzyme enzyme;
    enzyme.operation = operation;
    enzyme.motif[SITE_CELL] = MotifCell(wanted, cares, Presence.filled);
    return enzyme;
}

uint countWith(Molecule molecule, Property property) {
    uint count = 0;
    foreach (cell; 0 .. GRID_CELLS) {
        if (molecule.fragmentAt(cell).isPresent && molecule.fragmentAt(cell).has(property)) {
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

unittest {
    Molecule plain = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(0)).withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(1, 0, 0)), Fragment.of(propertyBit(Property.bulky)));
    Maybe!Molecule oxidized = enzymeAtFilled(Operation.oxidize, 0, propertyBit(Property.bulky)).productOf(plain);
    assert(oxidized.exists && oxidized.value.fragmentCount == 2 && countWith(oxidized.value, Property.polar) == 1 && countWith(oxidized.value, Property.bulky) == 1);
    Maybe!Molecule cleaved = enzymeAtFilled(Operation.cleave, propertyBit(Property.bulky), propertyBit(Property.bulky)).productOf(plain);
    assert(cleaved.exists && cleaved.value.fragmentCount == 1 && countWith(cleaved.value, Property.bulky) == 0);
    assert(!enzymeAtFilled(Operation.cleave, propertyBit(Property.charged), propertyBit(Property.charged)).productOf(plain).exists);
    Maybe!Molecule marked = enzymeAtFilled(Operation.conjugate, 0, 0).productOf(plain);
    assert(marked.exists && marked.value.isConjugated && clearanceOf(marked.value).value > clearanceOf(plain).value);
}

unittest {
    Molecule plain = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(0));
    Enzyme[1] enzymes = [enzymeAtFilled(Operation.oxidize, 0, propertyBit(Property.polar))];
    Body body;
    body.dose(plain, DOSE, Route.ingested);
    body.dose(plain, DOSE, Route.injected);
    float before = body.species[0].gut.value + body.species[0].blood.value;
    metabolize(body, enzymes[], TICK);
    assert(body.count == 2);
    float after = 0;
    foreach (ref held; body.species[0 .. body.count]) {
        after += held.gut.value + held.blood.value;
    }
    assert(fabsf(after - before) <= AMOUNT_TOLERANCE);
    assert(body.species[1].blood.value > 0 && body.species[1].gut.value > 0);
}
