/// file: source/unit/neighbors.d
module unit.neighbors;

import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.graph : Graph, ROOT_NODE;
import common.neighbors : CellHop, hopCell, isOutside, neighborAxisMap;
import common.node : ChunkSlot;
import common.worldgen.generation : Worldgen;
import geometry.cube : AXIS_COUNT, Axis, DIRECTIONS, beyondBoundary, boundaryOf;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, Corner, FACE_COUNT, Face;

enum ubyte DIMENSION = 4;
enum int EDGE_CELL = 2;

CellHop hopRemaining(ref const Graph graph, CellHop hop) {
    uint axis = AXIS_COUNT;
    while (axis > 0 && !isOutside(graph.layout.dimension, hop.cell[axis - 1])) {
        axis -= 1;
    }
    if (axis == 0) {
        return hop;
    } else {
        return graph.hopCell(hop.chunk.value, hop.cell, axis - 1);
    }
}

bool isSameCell(CellHop a, CellHop b) {
    return a.chunk == b.chunk && a.cell == b.cell;
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(DIMENSION, Worldgen.makeTerrain());
    uint root = graph.slotOf(ROOT_NODE).value;
    foreach (face; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        uint neighbor = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(root, cast(Face) face);
        foreach (outer; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
            graph.ensureNeighborSlot(neighbor, cast(Face) outer);
        }
    }
    uint valenceFourEdges = 0;
    uint valenceFiveEdges = 0;
    foreach (cornerIndex; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
        ChunkSlot chunk = ChunkSlot(root, cast(Corner) cornerIndex);
        foreach (a; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
            foreach (b; a + 1 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
                foreach (signs; 0 .. 4u) {
                    Vec3!int edge = Vec3!int(EDGE_CELL, EDGE_CELL, EDGE_CELL);
                    edge[a] = -1;
                    if ((signs & 1) != 0) {
                        edge[a] = DIMENSION;
                    }
                    edge[b] = -1;
                    if ((signs & 2) != 0) {
                        edge[b] = DIMENSION;
                    }
                    CellHop viaA = graph.hopRemaining(graph.hopCell(chunk, edge, a));
                    CellHop viaB = graph.hopRemaining(graph.hopCell(chunk, edge, b));
                    if (signs == 3) {
                        assert(!isSameCell(viaA, viaB));
                        valenceFiveEdges += 1;
                    } else {
                        assert(isSameCell(viaA, viaB));
                        valenceFourEdges += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        foreach (direction; DIRECTIONS) {
            Vec3!int past = Vec3!int(EDGE_CELL, 1, 0);
            past[direction.axis] = beyondBoundary(DIMENSION, direction.sign);
            CellHop there = graph.hopCell(chunk, past, direction.axis);
            Axis back = neighborAxisMap(chunk.corner, direction).to[direction.axis];
            Vec3!int stepped = there.cell;
            stepped[back] = beyondBoundary(DIMENSION, direction.sign);
            CellHop home = graph.hopCell(there.chunk.value, stepped, back);
            Vec3!int expected = past;
            expected[direction.axis] = boundaryOf(DIMENSION, direction.sign);
            assert(home.chunk.value == chunk && home.cell == expected);
        }
    }
    assert(valenceFourEdges == CORNER_COUNT * AXIS_COUNT * 3);
    assert(valenceFiveEdges == CORNER_COUNT * AXIS_COUNT);
    graph.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/node.d
module unit.node;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.numbers : higherOf, lowerOf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.node : ChunkLayout, Voxels, cellCount, cellIndex;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum ubyte LAYOUT_DIMENSION = 12;
enum ubyte VOXEL_DIMENSION = 4;
enum float NODE_VOLUME = 4.3062076f;
enum float MOST_VOLUME_SPREAD = 2.0f;
enum float GRID_TOLERANCE = 1e-3f;
enum float VOLUME_TOLERANCE = 1e-3f;
immutable float[3] GAUSS_POINTS = [-0.7745967f, 0.0f, 0.7745967f];
immutable float[3] GAUSS_WEIGHTS = [5.0f / 9.0f, 8.0f / 9.0f, 5.0f / 9.0f];

float kleinBoxVolume(Vec3!float low, Vec3!float high) {
    Vec3!float middle = Vec3!float((low.x + high.x) / 2, (low.y + high.y) / 2, (low.z + high.z) / 2);
    Vec3!float half = Vec3!float((high.x - low.x) / 2, (high.y - low.y) / 2, (high.z - low.z) / 2);
    float total = 0;
    foreach (i; 0 .. GAUSS_POINTS.length) {
        foreach (j; 0 .. GAUSS_POINTS.length) {
            foreach (k; 0 .. GAUSS_POINTS.length) {
                float x = middle.x + half.x * GAUSS_POINTS[i];
                float y = middle.y + half.y * GAUSS_POINTS[j];
                float z = middle.z + half.z * GAUSS_POINTS[k];
                float inside = 1.0f - x * x - y * y - z * z;
                total += GAUSS_WEIGHTS[i] * GAUSS_WEIGHTS[j] * GAUSS_WEIGHTS[k] / (inside * inside);
            }
        }
    }
    return total * half.x * half.y * half.z;
}

unittest {
    ChunkLayout layout = ChunkLayout.make(LAYOUT_DIMENSION);
    float smallest = 0;
    float largest = 0;
    float total = 0;
    foreach (x; 0 .. LAYOUT_DIMENSION) {
        foreach (y; 0 .. LAYOUT_DIMENSION) {
            foreach (z; 0 .. LAYOUT_DIMENSION) {
                assert(fabsf(layout.cubeToGrid(layout.gridToCube(x)) - x) < GRID_TOLERANCE);
                float volume = kleinBoxVolume(Vec3!float(layout.gridToKlein(x), layout.gridToKlein(y), layout.gridToKlein(z)), Vec3!float(layout.gridToKlein(x + 1), layout.gridToKlein(y + 1), layout.gridToKlein(z + 1)));
                if (x == 0 && y == 0 && z == 0) {
                    smallest = volume;
                }
                smallest = lowerOf(smallest, volume);
                largest = higherOf(largest, volume);
                total += volume;
            }
        }
    }
    assert(largest / smallest < MOST_VOLUME_SPREAD);
    assert(fabsf(total * CORNER_COUNT / NODE_VOLUME - 1) < VOLUME_TOLERANCE);
}

unittest {
    Voxels stone = Voxels.filled(Material.granite);
    assert(stone.isUniform() && stone.isOpaqueFill() && stone.at(5) == Material.granite);
    Material[] cells = stone.toDense(VOXEL_DIMENSION);
    assert(!stone.isUniform() && cells.length == cellCount(VOXEL_DIMENSION) && stone.at(5) == Material.granite);
    stone.compress(VOXEL_DIMENSION);
    assert(stone.isFilledWith(Material.granite));
    stone.toDense(VOXEL_DIMENSION)[cellIndex(VOXEL_DIMENSION, 1, 2, 3)] = Material.glass;
    stone.compress(VOXEL_DIMENSION);
    assert(!stone.isUniform() && stone.at(cellIndex(VOXEL_DIMENSION, 1, 2, 3)) == Material.glass);
    stone.release();
    assert(!Voxels.filled(Material.none).isOpaqueFill() && !Voxels.filled(Material.glass).isOpaqueFill());
}

/// file: source/unit/occupancy.d
module unit.occupancy;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.units : Ratio;
import common.biology.occupancy : occupanciesOf;

enum float OCCUPANCY_TOLERANCE = 1e-5f;
enum Ratio AGONIST_AFFINITY = Ratio(0.3f);
enum Ratio COMPETITOR_AFFINITY = Ratio(0.05f);
enum Ratio COMPETITOR_LEVEL = Ratio(0.2f);

unittest {
    Ratio[1] concentrations = [AGONIST_AFFINITY];
    Ratio[1] affinities = [AGONIST_AFFINITY];
    Ratio[1] occupancy;
    occupanciesOf(concentrations[], affinities[], occupancy[]);
    assert(fabsf(occupancy[0].value - 0.5f) <= OCCUPANCY_TOLERANCE);
}

unittest {
    float shift = 1 + COMPETITOR_LEVEL.value / COMPETITOR_AFFINITY.value;
    Ratio[2] concentrations = [AGONIST_AFFINITY * shift, COMPETITOR_LEVEL];
    Ratio[2] affinities = [AGONIST_AFFINITY, COMPETITOR_AFFINITY];
    Ratio[2] occupancy;
    occupanciesOf(concentrations[], affinities[], occupancy[]);
    assert(fabsf(occupancy[0].value - 0.5f) <= OCCUPANCY_TOLERANCE);
}

/// file: source/unit/parallel.d
module unit.parallel;

import core.atomic : atomicLoad, atomicOp;
import core.stdc.stdlib : calloc, free;
import base.clock : Deadline;
import base.parallel : ConcurrentQueue, ParallelJob, TaskSource, WorkerPool;

enum uint WORKERS = 3;
enum size_t ITEMS = 10000;
enum uint ROUNDS = 50;

struct Counts {
    shared uint[ITEMS] seen;
}

void countItem(void* context, size_t index, uint worker) {
    atomicOp!"+="((cast(Counts*) context).seen[index], 1);
}

bool takeNothing(void* context, uint worker) {
    return false;
}

unittest {
    WorkerPool* pool = WorkerPool.make(WORKERS, TaskSource(&takeNothing, null));
    Counts* counts = cast(Counts*) calloc(1, Counts.sizeof);
    foreach (round; 0 .. ROUNDS) {
        ParallelJob job = ParallelJob(&countItem, counts, Deadline.init, ITEMS);
        pool.run(&job);
        assert(job.count == ITEMS);
    }
    foreach (index; 0 .. ITEMS) {
        assert(atomicLoad(counts.seen[index]) == ROUNDS);
    }
    ParallelJob late = ParallelJob(&countItem, counts, Deadline.at(0), ITEMS);
    pool.run(&late);
    assert(late.count >= 1 && late.count < ITEMS);
    foreach (index; 0 .. ITEMS) {
        uint expected = ROUNDS;
        if (index < late.count) {
            expected += 1;
        }
        assert(atomicLoad(counts.seen[index]) == expected);
    }
    free(counts);
    pool.release();
    free(pool);
}

unittest {
    ConcurrentQueue!uint queue = ConcurrentQueue!uint.make(4);
    foreach (value; 0 .. 4) {
        bool pushed = queue.push(value);
        assert(pushed);
    }
    bool overfull = queue.push(4);
    assert(!overfull);
    uint popped;
    bool took = queue.pop(popped);
    assert(took && popped == 0);
    bool refilled = queue.push(4);
    assert(refilled);
    foreach (expected; 1 .. 5) {
        took = queue.pop(popped);
        assert(took && popped == expected);
    }
    took = queue.pop(popped);
    assert(!took);
    queue.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/plane.d
module unit.plane;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.worldgen.plane : Plane;
import geometry.honeycomb : FACE_DISTANCE, Face, opposite;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Point, Vec4;

enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-3f;
enum uint STEPS = 8;

Face alternatingFace(uint step) {
    if (step % 2 == 0) {
        return Face.first;
    } else {
        return Face.first.opposite;
    }
}

unittest {
    Plane ground = Plane.ofFace(Face.first);
    assert(fabsf(ground.distanceTo(Point!float.origin()) + FACE_DISTANCE) < TOLERANCE);
    Plane across = ground.reflectAcross(Face.first);
    assert(fabsf(across.distanceTo(Point!float.origin()) - FACE_DISTANCE) < TOLERANCE);
    Point!float point = Motion!float.shift(Vec3!float(0.3f, -0.2f, 0.4f)) * Point!float.origin();
    Plane far = ground;
    foreach (step; 0 .. STEPS) {
        far = far.reflectAcross(alternatingFace(step));
    }
    assert(far.height > STEPS / 2);
    Plane back = far;
    foreach_reverse (step; 0 .. STEPS) {
        back = back.reflectAcross(alternatingFace(step));
    }
    assert(fabsf(back.distanceTo(point) - ground.distanceTo(point)) < TOLERANCE);
    Plane nudged = Plane(Vec3!float(ground.up.x + 1e-3f, ground.up.y, ground.up.z), ground.height + 1e-3f);
    Plane snapped = nudged.snappedToFaces();
    assert(snapped.height == ground.height && snapped.up == ground.up);
    assert((-nudged).snappedToFaces().height == -ground.height);
    Plane fromItsNormal = Plane.fromNormal(Vec4!float([ground.up.x * 1.2f, ground.up.y * 1.2f, ground.up.z * 1.2f, 0.0f]).toNormal().v);
    assert(fabsf(fromItsNormal.height) < TOLERANCE);
}

/// file: source/unit/png.d
module unit.png;

import core.stdc.stdlib : free;
import client.png : PngImage, RGBA_BYTES, RGB_BYTES, adler32, crc32, decodePng, encodePng;

enum uint CRC_OF_IEND = 0xAE426082;
enum uint ADLER_OF_WIKIPEDIA = 0x11E60398;
enum uint WIDTH = 300;
enum uint HEIGHT = 250;
enum size_t PIXEL_MIX = 2654435761;

unittest {
    assert(crc32(cast(const(ubyte)[]) "IEND") == CRC_OF_IEND);
    assert(adler32(cast(const(ubyte)[]) "Wikipedia") == ADLER_OF_WIKIPEDIA);
    ubyte[WIDTH * HEIGHT * RGBA_BYTES] rgba;
    foreach (index, ref value; rgba) {
        value = cast(ubyte)(index * PIXEL_MIX);
    }
    ubyte[] encoded = encodePng(WIDTH, HEIGHT, rgba[]);
    PngImage decoded = decodePng(encoded);
    assert(decoded.isRead() && decoded.width == WIDTH && decoded.height == HEIGHT);
    foreach (pixel; 0 .. WIDTH * HEIGHT) {
        assert(decoded.pixels()[pixel * RGB_BYTES .. (pixel + 1) * RGB_BYTES] == rgba[pixel * RGBA_BYTES .. pixel * RGBA_BYTES + RGB_BYTES]);
    }
    encoded[encoded.length / 2] ^= 1;
    PngImage corrupted = decodePng(encoded);
    assert(!corrupted.isRead());
    decoded.release();
    free(encoded.ptr);
}

/// file: source/unit/pocket.d
module unit.pocket;

import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import common.biology.molecule : CENTER_CELL, Fragment, GRID_CELLS, GridPoint, Molecule, ROTATION_COUNT, cellOf, inverted, pointOf, rotated, withFragment;
import common.biology.pocket : Binding, HALF_CELLS, HalfPocket, Pocket, PocketCell, PocketKind, bindingOf, joined;

enum float SCORE_TOLERANCE = 1e-5f;
enum ubyte POLAR = 0b100;
enum ubyte BULKY = 0b001;

HalfPocket sampleHalf(ubyte salt) {
    HalfPocket half;
    foreach (index; 0 .. HALF_CELLS) {
        uint kind = (index * 7 + salt) % 4;
        half.cells[index] = PocketCell(cast(PocketKind) kind, cast(ubyte)((index + salt) % 8), cast(ubyte)((index * 3 + salt) % 8), cast(ubyte)(index % 2));
    }
    return half;
}

unittest {
    Pocket homomer = joined(sampleHalf(1), sampleHalf(1));
    foreach (cell; 0 .. GRID_CELLS) {
        assert(homomer.cells[cell] == homomer.cells[cellOf(inverted(pointOf(cell)))]);
    }
    Pocket heteromer = joined(sampleHalf(1), sampleHalf(2));
    uint different = 0;
    foreach (cell; 0 .. GRID_CELLS) {
        if (heteromer.cells[cell] != heteromer.cells[cellOf(inverted(pointOf(cell)))]) {
            different += 1;
        }
    }
    assert(different > 0);
}

unittest {
    Pocket pocket = joined(sampleHalf(3), sampleHalf(5));
    Molecule molecule = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(POLAR)).withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(1, 0, 0)), Fragment.of(BULKY)).withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(0, 1, -1)), Fragment.of(POLAR | BULKY));
    Binding plain = bindingOf(pocket, molecule);
    foreach (rotation; 0 .. ROTATION_COUNT) {
        assert(fabsf(bindingOf(pocket, molecule.rotated(rotation)).score - plain.score) <= SCORE_TOLERANCE);
    }
}

unittest {
    Pocket pocket;
    foreach (cell; 0 .. GRID_CELLS) {
        pocket.cells[cell] = PocketCell(PocketKind.wall, 0, 0, 0);
    }
    uint trigger = cellOf(GridPoint(1, 0, 0));
    uint brake = cellOf(GridPoint(-1, 0, 0));
    pocket.cells[CENTER_CELL] = PocketCell(PocketKind.open, POLAR, POLAR, 0);
    pocket.cells[trigger] = PocketCell(PocketKind.trigger, 0, 0, 0);
    pocket.cells[brake] = PocketCell(PocketKind.brake, 0, 0, 0);
    Molecule agonist = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(POLAR)).withFragment(trigger, Fragment.of(0));
    Molecule antagonist = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(POLAR));
    Molecule inverse = Molecule.init.withFragment(CENTER_CELL, Fragment.of(POLAR)).withFragment(brake, Fragment.of(0));
    Binding agonistBinding = bindingOf(pocket, agonist);
    Binding antagonistBinding = bindingOf(pocket, antagonist);
    assert(agonistBinding.efficacy[0].value > 0);
    assert(antagonistBinding.efficacy[0].value == 0);
    Binding inverseBinding = bindingOf(pocket, inverse);
    assert(inverseBinding.efficacy[0].value <= 0);
    Molecule clashing = antagonist.withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(0, 1, 0)), Fragment.of(0)).withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(0, -1, 0)), Fragment.of(0)).withFragment(cellOf(GridPoint(0, 0, 1)), Fragment.of(0));
    assert(bindingOf(pocket, clashing).affinity.value > antagonistBinding.affinity.value);
}

/// file: source/unit/raycast.d
module unit.raycast;

import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.material : PLAIN_SOLID, including;
import common.node : ChunkLayout, Voxels, cellIndex;
import common.raycast.chunk : ChunkRayCastHit, castThroughChunk;
import geometry.cube : AXIS_COUNT, Axis, Sign;
import geometry.lorentz : Point, Vec4;
import geometry.ray : Ray;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum ubyte DIMENSION = 4;
immutable Vec3!int TARGET = Vec3!int(1, 2, 3);
enum float START_KLEIN = -0.2f;
enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-4f;
enum uint RAYS = 200;
enum uint MARCH_STEPS = 20000;
enum ulong SEED = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1D;

unittest {
    ChunkLayout layout = ChunkLayout.make(DIMENSION);
    Voxels voxels = Voxels.filled(Material.none);
    voxels.toDense(DIMENSION)[cellIndex(DIMENSION, TARGET.x, TARGET.y, TARGET.z)] = Material.granite;
    Vec3!float center = Vec3!float(layout.gridToKlein(TARGET.x + 0.5f), layout.gridToKlein(TARGET.y + 0.5f), layout.gridToKlein(TARGET.z + 0.5f));
    Point!float from = Vec4!float([START_KLEIN, center.y, center.z, 1]).toPoint();
    Point!float to = Vec4!float([center.x, center.y, center.z, 1]).toPoint();
    Ray ray = Ray(from, (to.v + from.v * from.minkowski(to.v)).toNormal());
    Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit hit = castThroughChunk(voxels, layout, ray, 1, PLAIN_SOLID);
    assert(hit.exists && hit.value.voxelCoords == TARGET.as!ubyte() && hit.value.faceAxis == Axis.x && hit.value.faceSign == Sign.minus);
    Vec4!float reached = ray.at(hit.value.tanhDistance);
    float wall = layout.gridToKlein(TARGET.x);
    assert(reached.c[0] / reached.c[3] - wall < TOLERANCE && wall - reached.c[0] / reached.c[3] < TOLERANCE);
    Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit stoppedShort = castThroughChunk(voxels, layout, ray, hit.value.tanhDistance, PLAIN_SOLID);
    assert(!stoppedShort.exists);
    voxels.toDense(DIMENSION)[cellIndex(DIMENSION, TARGET.x, TARGET.y, TARGET.z)] = Material.mistStone;
    assert(!castThroughChunk(voxels, layout, ray, 1, PLAIN_SOLID).exists);
    assert(castThroughChunk(voxels, layout, ray, 1, PLAIN_SOLID.including(Material.mistStone)).exists);
    voxels.release();
}

Maybe!(Vec3!int) cellOn(ChunkLayout layout, Ray ray, float t) {
    Vec4!float at = ray.at(t);
    Vec3!int cell;
    foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
        Maybe!int along = layout.kleinToCell(at.c[axis] / at.c[3]);
        if (!along.exists) {
            return Maybe!(Vec3!int).init;
        }
        cell[axis] = along.value;
    }
    return Maybe!(Vec3!int).of(cell);
}

Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit marched(ref const Voxels voxels, ChunkLayout layout, Ray ray, float limit) {
    Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit hit;
    Maybe!(Vec3!int) first = cellOn(layout, ray, 0);
    uint step = 1;
    while (step < MARCH_STEPS && !hit.exists) {
        float t = limit * step / MARCH_STEPS;
        Maybe!(Vec3!int) found = cellOn(layout, ray, t);
        if (found.exists && found != first) {
            Vec3!int cell = found.value;
            if (voxels.at(cellIndex(layout.dimension, cell.x, cell.y, cell.z)) != Material.none) {
                hit = Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit.of(ChunkRayCastHit(t, cell.as!ubyte()));
            }
        }
        step += 1;
    }
    return hit;
}

float shuffled(ref ulong state) {
    state ^= state << 13;
    state ^= state >> 7;
    state ^= state << 17;
    return (state >> 40) / cast(float)(1 << 24);
}

unittest {
    ChunkLayout layout = ChunkLayout.make(DIMENSION);
    float size = layout.gridToKlein(DIMENSION);
    Voxels voxels = Voxels.filled(Material.none);
    Material[] cells = voxels.toDense(DIMENSION);
    ulong state = SEED;
    foreach (index; 0 .. cells.length) {
        cells[index] = Material.none;
        if (shuffled(state) < 0.15f) {
            cells[index] = Material.granite;
        }
    }
    uint hits = 0;
    foreach (_; 0 .. RAYS) {
        Vec3!float from;
        Vec3!float to;
        foreach (axis; 0 .. AXIS_COUNT) {
            from[axis] = (shuffled(state) * 1.6f - 0.3f) * size;
            to[axis] = shuffled(state) * size;
        }
        Point!float start = Vec4!float([from.x, from.y, from.z, 1]).toPoint();
        Point!float aim = Vec4!float([to.x, to.y, to.z, 1]).toPoint();
        Ray ray = Ray(start, (aim.v + start.v * start.minkowski(aim.v)).toNormal());
        Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit walked = castThroughChunk(voxels, layout, ray, 0.9f, PLAIN_SOLID);
        Maybe!ChunkRayCastHit expected = marched(voxels, layout, ray, 0.9f);
        assert(walked.exists == expected.exists);
        if (walked.exists) {
            hits += 1;
            assert(walked.value.voxelCoords == expected.value.voxelCoords);
            assert(walked.value.tanhDistance <= expected.value.tanhDistance + 0.9f / MARCH_STEPS);
        }
    }
    assert(hits > RAYS / 4);
    voxels.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/signaling.d
module unit.signaling;

import base.units : Ratio, Time;
import common.biology.pocket : TRANSDUCER_COUNT;
import common.biology.signaling : Signaling;

enum Time TICK = Time(0.05f);
enum uint DOSED_TICKS = 20000;
enum uint WITHDRAWN_TICKS = 60;
enum uint BASELINE_TICKS = 2000;
enum float REBOUND_SHARE = 0.9f;

unittest {
    Ratio[TRANSDUCER_COUNT] resting;
    Ratio[TRANSDUCER_COUNT] driven = [Ratio(1), Ratio(0)];
    Signaling baseline;
    foreach (_; 0 .. BASELINE_TICKS) {
        baseline.advance(resting, TICK);
    }
    float rawOff = baseline.rawSignal(0);
    Signaling dosed = baseline;
    foreach (_; 0 .. DOSED_TICKS) {
        dosed.advance(driven, TICK);
    }
    float rawOn = dosed.rawSignal(0);
    assert(rawOn > rawOff);
    foreach (_; 0 .. WITHDRAWN_TICKS) {
        dosed.advance(resting, TICK);
    }
    assert(dosed.signalOf(0).value <= -REBOUND_SHARE * (rawOn - rawOff));
}

/// file: source/unit/slab.d
module unit.slab;

import base.array : Array;
import base.pages : pageSize;
import base.slab : DiscardPass, FreeIndices, NOTED_PAGES_PER_DISCARD, Run, RunPool, SLAB_SHIFT, SLAB_SIZE, Slab;

enum uint RUNS = 3000;
enum uint INDICES = 10000;
enum uint INDEX_STRIDE = 7;

struct Record {
    uint[3] values;
}

unittest {
    Slab!uint slab;
    slab.ensure(SLAB_SIZE + 1);
    uint* first = slab.at(0);
    *slab.at(SLAB_SIZE) = SLAB_SIZE;
    slab.ensure(SLAB_SIZE * 3);
    assert(slab.at(0) is first);
    assert(*slab.at(SLAB_SIZE) == SLAB_SIZE);
    assert(*slab.at(SLAB_SIZE * 3 - 1) == 0);
    slab.release();
    Slab!uint sparse;
    *sparse.touch(SLAB_SIZE * 5) = 7;
    assert(sparse.blocks.ptr[0] is null);
    uint* touched = sparse.touch(SLAB_SIZE * 5);
    assert(*touched == 7);
    sparse.release();
}

unittest {
    Slab!Record slab;
    FreeIndices free;
    size_t count = (NOTED_PAGES_PER_DISCARD + 2) * pageSize() / Record.sizeof;
    size_t straddling = pageSize() / Record.sizeof;
    size_t inside = count / 2;
    slab.ensure(count);
    foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
        slab.at(index).values[0] = cast(uint) index + 1;
    }
    foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
        if (index != straddling && index != inside) {
            *slab.at(index) = Record.init;
            free.add(cast(uint) index);
            slab.note(index, 1);
        }
    }
    do {
        uint calls = 1;
        slab.discardNoted(free, count, 1, calls);
    } while (slab.pass == DiscardPass.sweeping);
    assert(slab.notedCount == 0);
    assert(slab.at(straddling).values[0] == straddling + 1 && slab.at(inside).values[0] == inside + 1);
    foreach (index; 0 .. count) {
        assert(index == straddling || index == inside || slab.at(index).values[0] == 0);
    }
    slab.release();
    free.release();
}

unittest {
    RunPool!uint pool;
    Array!Run runs;
    foreach (index; 0 .. RUNS) {
        Run run = pool.reserve(index % 37 + 1);
        assert(run.start >> SLAB_SHIFT == (run.start + run.length - 1) >> SLAB_SHIFT);
        foreach (ref item; pool.slice(run)) {
            item = index;
        }
        runs.append(run);
    }
    foreach (index, run; runs.slice()) {
        foreach (item; pool.slice(run)) {
            assert(item == index);
        }
    }
    uint end = pool.end;
    foreach (run; runs.slice()) {
        pool.release(run);
    }
    foreach (run; runs.slice()) {
        pool.reserve(run.length);
    }
    assert(pool.end == end);
    runs.release();
    pool.release();
}

unittest {
    FreeIndices free;
    foreach (step; 0 .. INDICES) {
        free.add(step * INDEX_STRIDE % INDICES);
    }
    foreach (expected; 0 .. INDICES / 2) {
        uint lowest = free.takeLowest();
        assert(lowest == expected);
    }
    free.add(INDEX_STRIDE);
    assert(free.contains(INDEX_STRIDE) && !free.contains(INDEX_STRIDE + 1));
    assert(free.containsAll(INDICES / 2, INDICES) && !free.containsAll(INDICES / 2 - 1, INDICES));
    assert(free.containsAll(INDEX_STRIDE, INDEX_STRIDE + 1) && !free.containsAll(0, INDEX_STRIDE + 1));
    uint added = free.takeLowest();
    assert(added == INDEX_STRIDE);
    free.drop(INDICES / 2);
    uint afterDropped = free.takeLowest();
    assert(afterDropped == INDICES / 2 + 1);
    assert(free.count == INDICES / 2 - 2);
    free.release();
}

module unit.strokes;

import core.stdc.math : acoshf, fabsf;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.worldgen.strokes : Nearest, Stroke, StrokeForm;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Point, Vec4;
import plugins.api.api : Material;

enum double LENGTH = 0.8;
enum double SIDE = 0.3;
enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-4f;

unittest {
    Motion!double start = Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(0.2, -0.1, 0.3));
    Stroke stroke = Stroke.make(start, LENGTH, 0.1f, 0.05f, Material.oakWood, StrokeForm.solid);
    Vec4!float beside = (start * Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(0, 0, LENGTH / 2)) * Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(SIDE, 0, 0)) * Point!double.origin()).v.as!float();
    Nearest middle = stroke.nearest(beside);
    assert(fabsf(acoshf(middle.coshDistance) - SIDE) < TOLERANCE && fabsf(middle.along - LENGTH / 2) < TOLERANCE);
    Vec4!float past = (start * Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(0, 0, LENGTH + SIDE)) * Point!double.origin()).v.as!float();
    Nearest end = stroke.nearest(past);
    assert(fabsf(acoshf(end.coshDistance) - SIDE) < TOLERANCE && end.along == stroke.length);
    Vec4!float behind = (start * Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(0, 0, -SIDE)) * Point!double.origin()).v.as!float();
    assert(fabsf(acoshf(stroke.nearest(behind).coshDistance) - SIDE) < TOLERANCE);
    assert(stroke.holds((start * Motion!double.shift(Vec3!double(0.05, 0, 0.1)) * Point!double.origin()).v.as!float(), 0));
    assert(!stroke.holds(beside, 0));
}

/// file: source/unit/structure.d
module unit.structure;

import core.math : sqrt;
import core.stdc.math : atanhf, coshf, fabsf, floorf;
import base.units : Length;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.position : Position;
import common.traversal : NearbyNode, NearbyScratch;
import common.worldgen.blueprint : BlueprintBuilder, CellBox, Cover, EVERY_HEIGHT, LineSpec, PaintResult, canonicalBox;
import common.worldgen.generation : StructureWorld, Worldgen;
import common.worldgen.structure : CanonicalSite, ClaimKey, ColumnChunk, ColumnSpot, GROUND_RING, LineTouch, NODE_EDGES, RootedCorner, SiteFrame, altitude, canonicalOf, columnPoint, edgeCells, edgeLength, edgeSite, edgeSitesOf, ensureGroundRing, ensureSiteFace, ensureSiteHash, ensureSiteOrigin, forwarded, groundSite, isLevelInRange, isOnTouch, lineSite, lineToNode, moveToLevel, nodeToNode, rootSite, sideAxis, siteToNode, turnSite;
import geometry.honeycomb : CORNER_COUNT, Corner, FACE_COUNT, FACE_DISTANCE, Face, across, cornerToNode, cubeToNode, faces, isAdjacentTo, mirror;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Point, Vec4;
import plugins.api.api : Material, SitePart, Turn;

enum uint FACE_CORNERS = 5;
enum ubyte DIMENSION = 12;
enum float RADIUS = 3.0f;
enum Length TOLERANCE = Length(0.01f);
enum Length ON_LINE = Length(1e-3f);
enum int BEHIND_EDGES = 10;
enum int RISE_EDGES = 3;
enum uint DEEP_STEPS = 40;
enum uint SIDE_STRIDE = 5;
immutable Face[3] EDGE_WALK = [cast(Face) 3, cast(Face) 7, cast(Face) 1];
immutable Vec3!int[4] CELLS = [
    Vec3!int(0, 0, 0),
    Vec3!int(3, 1, 2),
    Vec3!int(11, 5, 0),
    Vec3!int(2, 11, 9),
];

bool isOnLineInFrame(ref const LineSpec spec, Point!float corner, Point!float center, ref const typeof(Graph.layout) layout) {
    Vec4!float q = corner.v;
    Vec4!float c = center.v;
    int level = cast(int) floorf(atanhf(c.c[2] / c.c[3]) / edgeLength(layout).value);
    return Length(sqrt(q.c[0] * q.c[0] + q.c[1] * q.c[1])) < ON_LINE && isLevelInRange(spec, level);
}

bool hasTouchAt(ref const Graph graph, uint slot, uint line, Corner corner) {
    const(LineTouch)[] touches = graph.structures.touchesAt(slot);
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < touches.length && !(touches[index].line == line && isOnTouch(touches[index], graph.structures.blueprint.lines.ptr[line], corner))) {
        index += 1;
    }
    return index < touches.length;
}

LineTouch touchOf(ref const Graph graph, uint slot, uint line) {
    const(LineTouch)[] touches = graph.structures.touchesAt(slot);
    uint index = 0;
    while (index < touches.length && touches[index].line != line) {
        index += 1;
    }
    assert(index < touches.length);
    return touches[index];
}

bool isSamePoint(Point!float a, Point!float b) {
    return -a.v.toPoint().minkowski(b.v.toPoint().v) < coshf(TOLERANCE.value);
}

Graph testGraph() {
    return Graph.make(DIMENSION, Worldgen.fromStructure(StructureWorld.fromName("test")));
}

SiteFrame[FACE_CORNERS] faceWalk(ref Graph graph, SiteFrame start) {
    SiteFrame[FACE_CORNERS] corners = void;
    corners[0] = start;
    foreach (index; 1 .. FACE_CORNERS) {
        corners[index] = graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(corners[index - 1], 1), Turn.right);
    }
    return corners;
}

SiteFrame[8] testSites(ref Graph graph) {
    SiteFrame ground = rootSite(graph.anchorSlot);
    SiteFrame tower = graph.view.turnSite(ground, Turn.pitchUp);
    SiteFrame bridge = graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(tower, 1), Turn.pitchDown);
    SiteFrame corner = graph.faceWalk(ground)[2];
    return [
        tower,
        bridge,
        graph.view.turnSite(bridge, Turn.right),
        graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(bridge, 1), Turn.pitchDown),
        ground,
        graph.view.turnSite(corner, Turn.rollLeft),
        forwarded(graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(corner, 2), Turn.pitchUp), -1),
        graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(graph.view.turnSite(corner, Turn.left), -2), Turn.pitchUp),
    ];
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = testGraph();
    BlueprintBuilder builder = BlueprintBuilder.make(graph);
    SiteFrame[8] sites = graph.testSites();
    CellBox pillar = CellBox.make(-2, 1, -3, 0, -12, 30);
    foreach (site; sites[0 .. 4]) {
        PaintResult result = builder.paint(site, pillar, EVERY_HEIGHT, Material.granite, Cover.over);
        assert(result == PaintResult.painted);
    }
    PaintResult endlessResult = builder.paint(sites[4], CellBox.alongLine(-6, 5, 0, 1), EVERY_HEIGHT, Material.granite, Cover.over);
    assert(endlessResult == PaintResult.painted);
    foreach (site; sites[5 .. $]) {
        PaintResult result = builder.paint(site, pillar, EVERY_HEIGHT, Material.granite, Cover.over);
        assert(result == PaintResult.painted);
    }
    NearbyScratch scratch;
    NearbyNode[] nearby = scratch.collectAll(graph, Position(graph.idAt(graph.anchorSlot), Motion!float.identity()), RADIUS);
    uint touchedChunks = 0;
    foreach (node; nearby) {
        graph.ensureStructureAt(node.slot);
        foreach (line, spec; graph.structures.blueprint.lines.slice()) {
            Motion!float lineFromNode = graph.view.lineToNode(cast(uint) line, node.slot).inverse();
            Point!float center = lineFromNode * Point!float.origin();
            foreach (index; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
                Corner corner = cast(Corner) index;
                Point!float cornerInLine = lineFromNode * corner.cornerToNode * Point!float.origin();
                assert(isOnLineInFrame(spec, cornerInLine, center, graph.layout) == graph.hasTouchAt(node.slot, cast(uint) line, corner));
                if (isOnLineInFrame(spec, cornerInLine, center, graph.layout)) {
                    touchedChunks += 1;
                    LineTouch touch = graph.touchOf(node.slot, cast(uint) line);
                    ColumnChunk chunk = ColumnChunk.fromTouch(touch, spec, corner, DIMENSION);
                    foreach (cell; CELLS) {
                        Vec3!int column = chunk.columnOf(cell);
                        Vec3!float cellCenter = graph.layout.cellCenter(cell);
                        Point!float actual = Point!float(corner.cubeToNode * Vec4!float([cellCenter.x, cellCenter.y, cellCenter.z, 1.0f]));
                        Point!float expected = lineFromNode.inverse() * columnPoint(graph.layout, ColumnSpot(column.x + 0.5f, column.y + 0.5f, column.z + 0.5f));
                        assert(isSamePoint(actual, expected));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    assert(touchedChunks >= 8 * graph.structures.blueprint.lines.length);
    builder.release();
    scratch.release();
    graph.release();
}

bool isCanonicalMatch(ref Graph graph, SiteFrame site) {
    CanonicalSite canonical = graph.view.canonicalOf(site);
    SiteFrame line = lineSite(canonical.line);
    foreach (cell; CELLS) {
        Vec3!int local = Vec3!int(cell.x - 6, cell.y - 6, cell.z - 20);
        CellBox moved = canonicalBox(CellBox(local, local), canonical.transform, DIMENSION);
        ColumnSpot fromSite = ColumnSpot(local.x + 0.5f, local.y + 0.5f, local.z + 0.5f);
        ColumnSpot fromLine = ColumnSpot(moved.low.x + 0.5f, moved.low.y + 0.5f, moved.low.z + 0.5f);
        if (!isSamePoint(graph.view.siteToNode(site, site.node) * columnPoint(graph.layout, fromSite), graph.view.siteToNode(line, site.node) * columnPoint(graph.layout, fromLine))) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = testGraph();
    SiteFrame[8] sites = graph.testSites();
    foreach (site; sites) {
        bool matches = graph.isCanonicalMatch(site);
        assert(matches);
    }
    graph.release();
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = testGraph();
    SiteFrame start = rootSite(graph.anchorSlot);
    SiteFrame[FACE_CORNERS] corners = graph.faceWalk(start);
    SiteFrame closed = graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(corners[FACE_CORNERS - 1], 1), Turn.right);
    Point!float origin = Point!float.origin();
    assert(isSamePoint(graph.view.siteToNode(closed, start.node) * origin, graph.view.siteToNode(start, start.node) * origin));
    assert(!isSamePoint(graph.view.siteToNode(corners[2], start.node) * origin, graph.view.siteToNode(start, start.node) * origin));
    RootedCorner startOrigin = graph.view.ensureSiteOrigin(start);
    RootedCorner closedOrigin = graph.view.ensureSiteOrigin(closed);
    RootedCorner farOrigin = graph.view.ensureSiteOrigin(corners[2]);
    assert(closedOrigin.key == startOrigin.key);
    assert(farOrigin.key != startOrigin.key);
    ClaimKey block = graph.view.ensureSiteFace(start);
    foreach (corner; corners) {
        ClaimKey cornerBlock = graph.view.ensureSiteFace(corner);
        assert(cornerBlock == block);
    }
    SiteFrame beyond = graph.view.turnSite(corners[1], Turn.right);
    ClaimKey beyondBlock = graph.view.ensureSiteFace(beyond);
    ClaimKey walkedBlock = graph.view.ensureSiteFace(graph.faceWalk(beyond)[3]);
    assert(beyondBlock != block);
    assert(walkedBlock == beyondBlock);
    SiteFrame back = graph.view.turnSite(graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(start, 1), Turn.right), Turn.right);
    ulong edge = graph.view.ensureSiteHash(start, SitePart.edge);
    ulong backEdge = graph.view.ensureSiteHash(back, SitePart.edge);
    ulong rolledEdge = graph.view.ensureSiteHash(graph.view.turnSite(start, Turn.rollLeft), SitePart.edge);
    ulong nextEdge = graph.view.ensureSiteHash(corners[1], SitePart.edge);
    ulong startVertex = graph.view.ensureSiteHash(start, SitePart.vertex);
    ulong closedVertex = graph.view.ensureSiteHash(closed, SitePart.vertex);
    ulong startFace = graph.view.ensureSiteHash(start, SitePart.face);
    ulong laterFace = graph.view.ensureSiteHash(corners[3], SitePart.face);
    assert(backEdge == edge);
    assert(rolledEdge == edge);
    assert(nextEdge != edge);
    assert(closedVertex == startVertex);
    assert(laterFace == startFace);
    assert(startFace != startVertex);
    SiteFrame first = graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(graph.view.turnSite(corners[0], Turn.pitchUp), 1), Turn.pitchDown);
    SiteFrame last = graph.view.turnSite(graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(graph.view.turnSite(corners[1], Turn.pitchUp), 1), Turn.pitchDown), Turn.right);
    Point!float apex = columnPoint(graph.layout, ColumnSpot(-0.5f, 0.5f, edgeCells(DIMENSION) + 0.5f));
    Point!float mirroredApex = columnPoint(graph.layout, ColumnSpot(0.5f, 0.5f, edgeCells(DIMENSION) + 0.5f));
    assert(isSamePoint(graph.view.siteToNode(first, graph.anchorSlot) * apex, graph.view.siteToNode(last, graph.anchorSlot) * mirroredApex));
    foreach (turn; [Turn.left, Turn.pitchUp, Turn.rollRight]) {
        SiteFrame spun = start;
        foreach (_; 0 .. 4) {
            spun = graph.view.turnSite(spun, turn);
        }
        assert(spun == start);
    }
    graph.release();
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = testGraph();
    uint deep = graph.anchorSlot;
    foreach (step; 0 .. DEEP_STEPS) {
        uint index = step * SIDE_STRIDE;
        while (graph.isParentFace(deep, cast(Face)(index % FACE_COUNT))) {
            index += 1;
        }
        deep = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(deep, cast(Face)(index % FACE_COUNT));
    }
    assert(graph.depthOf(deep) > DEEP_STEPS);
    foreach (index; 0 .. FACE_COUNT) {
        Face side = cast(Face) index;
        uint beside = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(deep, side);
        assert(isSamePoint(graph.view.nodeToNode(beside, deep) * Point!float.origin(), side.mirror * Point!float.origin()));
        Face turn = cast(Face)((index + SIDE_STRIDE) % FACE_COUNT);
        uint corner = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(beside, turn);
        assert(isSamePoint(graph.view.nodeToNode(corner, deep) * Point!float.origin(), side.mirror * turn.mirror * Point!float.origin()));
        if (side.isAdjacentTo(turn)) {
            uint otherWay = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(graph.ensureNeighborSlot(deep, turn), side);
            assert(otherWay == corner);
        }
    }
    graph.release();
}

/// file: source/unit/sweep.d
module unit.sweep;

import core.math : sqrt;
import core.stdc.math : fabsf;
import base.maybe : Maybe;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.character.features : Edge, Quad;
import common.character.sweep : Capsule, Contact, Section, SectionRank;

enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-5f;

unittest {
    Capsule capsule = Capsule(Vec3!float(0, 1, 0), 0.4f, 0.9f, 0.01f);
    uint count = capsule.sectionCount();
    assert(capsule.sectionOffset(0, count) == -capsule.capOffset());
    assert(capsule.sectionOffset(count - 1, count) == capsule.capOffset());
    float spacing = capsule.sectionOffset(1, count) - capsule.sectionOffset(0, count);
    float half = spacing / 2;
    assert(capsule.radius - sqrt(capsule.radius * capsule.radius - half * half) <= capsule.skin);
    Capsule sphere = Capsule(Vec3!float(0, 1, 0), 0.4f, 0.4f, 0.01f);
    assert(sphere.sectionCount() == 1);
}

unittest {
    Quad floor = Quad([Vec3!float(0, 1, 0), Vec3!float(0, 1, 1), Vec3!float(1, 1, 1), Vec3!float(1, 1, 0)], Vec3!float(0, 1, 0));
    Section section = Section(null, Vec3!float(0.5f, 2.0f, 0.5f), 0.4f, 0.41f, SectionRank.lowest);
    Vec3!float down = Vec3!float(0, -1, 0);
    Maybe!Contact landing = section.quadContact(floor, down, 2.0f, Maybe!Contact.init);
    assert(landing.exists && fabsf(landing.value.stop - 0.59f) < TOLERANCE);
    Vec3!float along = Vec3!float(1, 0, 0);
    assert(!section.quadContact(floor, along, 2.0f, Maybe!Contact.init).exists);
    Section resting = Section(null, Vec3!float(0.5f, 1.405f, 0.5f), 0.4f, 0.41f, SectionRank.lowest);
    Maybe!Contact touching = resting.quadContact(floor, down, 1.0f, Maybe!Contact.init);
    assert(touching.exists && touching.value.stop == 0 && touching.value.gap > 0.004f && touching.value.gap < 0.006f);
    Edge rim = Edge(Vec3!float(1, 1, 0), Vec3!float(1, 1, 1));
    Section beside = Section(null, Vec3!float(1.6f, 1.2f, 0.5f), 0.4f, 0.41f, SectionRank.lowest);
    Vec3!float toward = Vec3!float(-1, 0, 0);
    Maybe!Contact edgeHit = beside.edgeContact(rim, toward, 1.0f, Maybe!Contact.init);
    assert(edgeHit.exists && edgeHit.value.normal.x > 0 && edgeHit.value.normal.y > 0);
}

/// file: source/unit/traversal.d
module unit.traversal;

import core.stdc.stdlib : free;
import base.array : Array;
import base.parallel : Executor, TaskSource, WorkerPool;
import base.vector3 : Vec3;
import common.graph : Graph;
import common.position : Position;
import common.traversal : NearbyNode, NearbyScratch;
import common.worldgen.generation : Worldgen;
import geometry.honeycomb : FACE_COUNT;
import geometry.lorentz : Motion, Point;

enum ubyte DIMENSION = 4;
enum float SET_RADIUS = 3.0f;
enum float DERIVE_RADIUS = 2.5f;
enum uint WORKERS = 3;
immutable Vec3!float DRIFT = Vec3!float(0.3f, -0.2f, 0.1f);

bool takesNoTask(void* context, uint worker) {
    return false;
}

bool isSameMotion(Motion!float a, Motion!float b) {
    foreach (column; 0 .. 4) {
        foreach (row; 0 .. 4) {
            if (a.m.c[column][row] != b.m.c[column][row]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

unittest {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(DIMENSION, Worldgen.makeTerrain());
    NearbyScratch scratch;
    scratch.collectAll(graph, Position.origin(), SET_RADIUS);
    Motion!float drift = Motion!float.shift(DRIFT);
    foreach (ref node; scratch.nodes.slice()) {
        node.transform = drift * node.transform;
    }
    scratch.nodes.ptr[0].transform = Motion!float.identity();
    Array!NearbyNode drifted;
    drifted.appendAll(scratch.nodes.slice());
    uint first = scratch.nodes.ptr[0].slot;
    scratch.rederive(graph, first, Point!float.origin(), DERIVE_RADIUS, Executor.init);
    Array!NearbyNode alone;
    alone.appendAll(scratch.nodes.slice());
    scratch.nodes.clear();
    scratch.nodes.appendAll(drifted.slice());
    WorkerPool* pool = WorkerPool.make(WORKERS, TaskSource(&takesNoTask, null));
    scratch.rederive(graph, first, Point!float.origin(), DERIVE_RADIUS, Executor(pool));
    pool.release();
    free(pool);
    size_t changed = 0;
    foreach (index, node; scratch.nodes.slice()) {
        assert(isSameMotion(node.transform, alone.ptr[index].transform));
        if (!isSameMotion(node.transform, drifted.ptr[index].transform)) {
            changed += 1;
        }
    }
    assert(changed > FACE_COUNT);
    drifted.release();
    alone.release();
    scratch.release();
    graph.release();
}

module unit.units;

import base.units : Acceleration, Angle, AngularSpeed, Blocks, Length, LocalBlock, Rate, Ratio, Speed, Time;

enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-6f;

unittest {
    static assert(is(typeof(Speed(2) * Time(3)) == Length));
    static assert(is(typeof(Acceleration(2) * Time(3)) == Speed));
    static assert(is(typeof(Length(2) / Time(4)) == Speed));
    static assert(is(typeof(Rate(2) * Time(3)) == Ratio));
    static assert(is(typeof(AngularSpeed(2) * Time(3)) == Angle));
    static assert(!is(typeof(Length(1) + Time(1))));
    Length traveled = Speed(0.5f) * Time(4) - Length(0.5f);
    assert(traveled.value > 1.5f - TOLERANCE && traveled.value < 1.5f + TOLERANCE);
    assert(Length(1) < Length(2));
    assert(LocalBlock(Length(0.05f)).heightOf(Blocks(2)).value > 0.1f - TOLERANCE);
}

/// file: source/unit/vector3.d
module unit.vector3;

import base.vector3 : Vec3, ZERO_VECTOR, cappedTo, cross, dot, magnitude, movedToward, rejectAlong;

enum float TOLERANCE = 1e-4f;

unittest {
    Vec3!float v = Vec3!float(3, 4, 0);
    assert(v.cappedTo(1).magnitude < 1 + TOLERANCE);
    Vec3!float z = Vec3!float(0, 0, 1);
    assert(v.cross(z).dot(v) == 0);
    Vec3!float reached = ZERO_VECTOR.movedToward(v, 10);
    assert(reached.x == 3 && reached.y == 4);
    Vec3!float partial = ZERO_VECTOR.movedToward(v, 1);
    assert(partial.magnitude < 1 + TOLERANCE && partial.magnitude > 1 - TOLERANCE);
    Vec3!float xAxis = Vec3!float(1, 0, 0);
    assert(v.rejectAlong(xAxis).dot(xAxis) == 0);
    assert(v[0] == v.x && v[1] == v.y && v[2] == v.z);
    v[1] = 7;
    assert(v.y == 7);
    assert(v.as!int() == Vec3!int(3, 7, 0));
}

import plugins.api.api : Material, Turn;

enum uint DRIVE_NEARBY_VERSION = 1;
enum uint DRIVE_IDLE_ITERATIONS = 200;
enum double DRIVE_BUDGET_MILLISECONDS = 5.0;
enum size_t HASH_HEADER_BYTES = 2;
enum float STRUCTURE_DUMP_RADIUS = 4.5f;
enum uint SLICE_QUARTERS_AROUND = 4;
enum uint SLICE_QUARTERS_OF_FACE = 5;
enum size_t BENCH_MAP_LIVE = 2_000_000;
enum size_t BENCH_MAP_CHURN = 8_000_000;
enum size_t BENCH_MAP_LOOKUPS = 4_000_000;
enum size_t BENCH_MAP_BATCH = 1024;
enum uint FORGET_STEPS = 16;
enum uint FORGET_SIDE_STRIDE = 5;
enum float FORGET_NEAR_RADIUS = 1.0f;
enum uint FORGET_SWEEPS = 4000;

struct ContentHashes {
    Hash128 materials;
    Hash128 occupancy;

    static ContentHashes fromVoxels(Corner corner, const Voxels voxels, ubyte dimension) {
        size_t cells = cast(size_t) dimension * dimension * dimension;
        ubyte* materialBytes = cast(ubyte*) malloc(HASH_HEADER_BYTES + cells * Material.sizeof);
        ubyte* occupancy = cast(ubyte*) malloc(HASH_HEADER_BYTES + cells);
        Material* materials = cast(Material*)(materialBytes + HASH_HEADER_BYTES);
        materialBytes[0] = corner;
        materialBytes[1] = dimension;
        occupancy[0] = corner;
        occupancy[1] = dimension;
        size_t cell = 0;
        foreach (x; 0 .. dimension) {
            foreach (y; 0 .. dimension) {
                foreach (z; 0 .. dimension) {
                    materials[cell] = voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, x, y, z));
                    occupancy[HASH_HEADER_BYTES + cell] = 0;
                    if (materials[cell] != Material.none) {
                        occupancy[HASH_HEADER_BYTES + cell] = 1;
                    }
                    cell += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        ContentHashes result = ContentHashes(murmurHash3(materialBytes[0 .. HASH_HEADER_BYTES + cells * Material.sizeof]), murmurHash3(occupancy[0 .. HASH_HEADER_BYTES + cells]));
        free(materialBytes);
        free(occupancy);
        return result;
    }
}

struct WorldDigest {
    Hash128 materials;
    Hash128 occupancy;
    size_t populated;

    static WorldDigest fromGraph(ref const Graph graph) {
        WorldDigest digest;
        foreach (index; 0 .. cast(size_t) graph.slotCount * CORNER_COUNT) {
            ChunkSlot slot = ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index);
            const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(slot);
            if (chunk.state == ChunkState.populated) {
                digest.add(ContentHashes.fromVoxels(slot.corner, chunk.voxels, graph.layout.dimension));
            }
        }
        return digest;
    }

    void add(ContentHashes hashes) {
        materials.first += hashes.materials.first;
        materials.second += hashes.materials.second;
        occupancy.first += hashes.occupancy.first;
        occupancy.second += hashes.occupancy.second;
        populated += 1;
    }

    void print(FILE* output) const {
        fprintf(output, "digest populated=%zu materials ", populated);
        printHash(output, materials);
        fprintf(output, " occupancy ");
        printHash(output, occupancy);
        fprintf(output, "\n");
    }
}

struct ChunkPass {
    double paramsMs = 0;
    double voxelsMs = 0;
    double denseMs = 0;
    double populateMs = 0;
    uint generated;
    uint solid;
    uint deferred;

    void generate(ref Graph graph, const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, float radius) {
        float threshold = coshf(radius + CUBE_RADIUS);
        Point!float start = Point!float.origin();
        foreach (nearbyNode; nearby) {
            foreach (cornerIndex; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
                Corner corner = cast(Corner) cornerIndex;
                ChunkSlot slot = ChunkSlot(nearbyNode.slot, corner);
                Point!float chunkCenter = nearbyNode.transform * corner.cubeCenter;
                if (graph.chunks.at(slot).state == ChunkState.fresh && !(start.coshDistance(chunkCenter) > threshold)) {
                    generateChunk(graph, slot);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void generateChunk(ref Graph graph, ChunkSlot slot) {
        double t0 = nowMilliseconds();
        ChunkParams params = ChunkParams.make(graph.view, slot.slot, slot.corner);
        graph.chunks.writable(slot).predicted = params.predictOccupancy();
        double t1 = nowMilliseconds();
        GeneratedVoxels result = params.generateVoxels();
        double t2 = nowMilliseconds();
        graph.populateChunk(slot, result);
        double t3 = nowMilliseconds();
        paramsMs += t1 - t0;
        voxelsMs += t2 - t1;
        populateMs += t3 - t2;
        generated += 1;
        if (result.voxels.isUniform()) {
            solid += 1;
        } else {
            denseMs += t2 - t1;
        }
        if (result.materials == Materials.deferred) {
            deferred += 1;
        }
    }
}

uint countDeferred(ref const Graph graph) {
    uint count = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. cast(size_t) graph.slotCount * CORNER_COUNT) {
        if (graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index)).hasDeferredMaterials) {
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

void resolveAllMaterials(ref Graph graph) {
    foreach (index; 0 .. cast(size_t) graph.slotCount * CORNER_COUNT) {
        if (graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index)).hasDeferredMaterials) {
            graph.resolveMaterials(ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index));
        }
    }
}

void generateWorld(ref Graph graph, float radius) {
    NearbyScratch scratch;
    NearbyNode[] nearby = scratch.collectAll(graph, Position.origin(), radius);
    ChunkPass pass;
    pass.generate(graph, nearby, radius);
    graph.resolveAllMaterials();
    scratch.release();
}

void printHash(FILE* output, Hash128 hash) {
    fprintf(output, "%016llx%016llx", hash.first, hash.second);
}

void printChunkLine(FILE* output, NodeId node, Corner corner, ContentHashes hashes) {
    printHash(output, node.value);
    fprintf(output, " %02u ", cast(uint) corner);
    printHash(output, hashes.materials);
    fprintf(output, " ");
    printHash(output, hashes.occupancy);
    fprintf(output, "\n");
}

ExitStatus finishWorld(FILE* output, ref Graph graph) {
    StructureProblem problem = growthProblem(graph);
    printProblem(output, problem);
    graph.release();
    return exitStatus(!problem.isPresent);
}

ExitStatus dumpWorld(FILE* output, float radius, ubyte dimension) {
    Graph graph = terrainGraph(dimension);
    graph.generateWorld(radius);
    foreach (index; 0 .. cast(size_t) graph.slotCount * CORNER_COUNT) {
        ChunkSlot slot = ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index);
        const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(slot);
        if (chunk.state == ChunkState.populated) {
            printChunkLine(output, graph.idAt(slot.slot), slot.corner, ContentHashes.fromVoxels(slot.corner, chunk.voxels, dimension));
        }
    }
    WorldDigest.fromGraph(graph).print(output);
    return finishWorld(output, graph);
}

ExitStatus printMaterialCensus(FILE* output, float radius, ubyte dimension) {
    Graph graph = terrainGraph(dimension);
    graph.generateWorld(radius);
    size_t[MATERIAL_COUNT] counts;
    foreach (index; 0 .. cast(size_t) graph.slotCount * CORNER_COUNT) {
        const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index));
        if (chunk.state == ChunkState.populated) {
            foreach (cell; 0 .. cast(size_t) dimension * dimension * dimension) {
                counts[chunk.voxels.at(cell)] += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    foreach (material, count; counts) {
        if (count > 0 && material != Material.none) {
            fprintf(output, "%.*s %zu\n", cast(int) ENUM_NAMES!Material[material].length, ENUM_NAMES!Material[material].ptr, count);
        }
    }
    return finishWorld(output, graph);
}

bool touchesAir(const(Chunk)* chunk, ubyte dimension, Vec3!int cell) {
    foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
        foreach (step; [-1, 1]) {
            Vec3!int beside = cell;
            beside[axis] += step;
            if (beside[axis] >= 0 && beside[axis] < dimension && chunk.voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, beside.x, beside.y, beside.z)) == Material.none) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

ExitStatus printSurfaceCensus(FILE* output, float radius, ubyte dimension) {
    Graph graph = terrainGraph(dimension);
    graph.generateWorld(radius);
    size_t[MATERIAL_COUNT] counts;
    foreach (index; 0 .. cast(size_t) graph.slotCount * CORNER_COUNT) {
        const(Chunk)* chunk = graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index));
        if (chunk.state == ChunkState.populated && !chunk.voxels.isUniform()) {
            foreach (x; 0 .. dimension) {
                foreach (y; 0 .. dimension) {
                    foreach (z; 0 .. dimension) {
                        Material material = chunk.voxels.at(cellIndex(dimension, x, y, z));
                        if (material != Material.none && touchesAir(chunk, dimension, Vec3!int(x, y, z))) {
                            counts[material] += 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    foreach (material, count; counts) {
        if (count > 0) {
            fprintf(output, "%.*s %zu\n", cast(int) ENUM_NAMES!Material[material].length, ENUM_NAMES!Material[material].ptr, count);
        }
    }
    return finishWorld(output, graph);
}

void printProblem(FILE* output, ref const StructureProblem problem) {
    if (problem.isPresent) {
        fprintf(output, "%s\n", problem.text.ptr);
    }
}

ExitStatus printWorldDigest(FILE* output, float radius, ubyte dimension) {
    Graph graph = terrainGraph(dimension);
    graph.generateWorld(radius);
    WorldDigest.fromGraph(graph).print(output);
    return finishWorld(output, graph);
}

size_t countFilled(ref Graph graph, uint slot) {
    size_t filled = 0;
    foreach (cornerIndex; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
        GeneratedVoxels generated = ChunkParams.make(graph.view, slot, cast(Corner) cornerIndex).generateVoxels();
        foreach (x; 0 .. graph.layout.dimension) {
            foreach (y; 0 .. graph.layout.dimension) {
                foreach (z; 0 .. graph.layout.dimension) {
                    if (generated.voxels.at(cellIndex(graph.layout.dimension, x, y, z)) != Material.none) {
                        filled += 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        generated.voxels.release();
    }
    return filled;
}

ExitStatus dumpStructure(FILE* output, ubyte dimension, Worldgen worldgen) {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(dimension, worldgen);
    StructureProblem problem = graph.placeWorldStructure();
    if (!problem.isPresent) {
        NearbyScratch scratch;
        NearbyNode[] nearby = scratch.collectAll(graph, Position(graph.idAt(graph.anchorSlot), Motion!float.identity()), STRUCTURE_DUMP_RADIUS);
        foreach (node; nearby) {
            bool needsBuilding = graph.ensureStructureAt(node.slot);
            if (needsBuilding) {
                fprintf(output, "altitude=%.3f filled=%zu\n", cast(double)(*graph.ensureState(node.slot)).altitude(), graph.countFilled(node.slot));
            }
        }
        scratch.release();
        fprintf(output, "lines=%zu brushes=%zu stops=%zu claims=%u edge=%.4f\n", graph.structures.blueprint.lines.length, graph.structures.blueprint.brushTotal(), graph.structures.blueprint.route.length, graph.structures.blueprint.claimCount, cast(double) edgeLength(graph.layout).value);
        problem = growthProblem(graph);
    }
    printProblem(output, problem);
    ExitStatus status = exitStatus(!problem.isPresent);
    graph.release();
    return status;
}

ExitStatus checkRepaint(FILE* output, ubyte dimension, Worldgen worldgen) {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(dimension, worldgen);
    StructureProblem problem = graph.placeWorldStructure();
    uint differing = 0;
    if (!problem.isPresent) {
        NearbyScratch scratch;
        NearbyNode[] nearby = scratch.collectAll(graph, Position(graph.idAt(graph.anchorSlot), Motion!float.identity()), STRUCTURE_DUMP_RADIUS);
        Array!ulong painted;
        foreach (node; nearby) {
            bool needsBuilding = graph.ensureStructureAt(node.slot);
            if (needsBuilding) {
                painted.append(graph.hashGenerated(node.slot));
            }
        }
        size_t tiles = graph.structures.blueprint.tiles.length;
        foreach (tile; 0 .. tiles) {
            if (tile % 2 == 0) {
                graph.dropTile(cast(uint) tile);
            }
        }
        foreach (slot; 0 .. graph.slotCount) {
            graph.structures.releaseBuilding(slot);
        }
        size_t index = 0;
        foreach (node; nearby) {
            bool needsBuilding = graph.ensureStructureAt(node.slot);
            if (needsBuilding) {
                ulong repainted = graph.hashGenerated(node.slot);
                if (repainted != painted.ptr[index]) {
                    differing += 1;
                }
                index += 1;
            }
        }
        fprintf(output, "repaint structured=%zu tiles=%zu painted_again=%u differing=%u\n", painted.length, tiles, graph.structures.blueprint.restoredTiles, differing);
        painted.release();
        scratch.release();
        problem = growthProblem(graph);
    }
    printProblem(output, problem);
    graph.release();
    return exitStatus(!problem.isPresent && differing == 0);
}

struct StructureCounts {
    size_t lines;
    size_t edges;
    size_t pending;
    size_t tiles;

    static StructureCounts of(ref const Graph graph) {
        const(Blueprint)* blueprint = &graph.structures.blueprint;
        size_t pending = 0;
        foreach (ref const id, ref const list; graph.structures.pending) {
            pending += 1;
        }
        return StructureCounts(blueprint.lines.length - blueprint.freeLines.length, blueprint.edgeCount(), pending, blueprint.liveTiles.length + blueprint.droppedTiles.length);
    }
}

void hashStructured(ref Graph graph, const(NearbyNode)[] nearby, ref HashMap!(NodeId, ulong) hashes) {
    foreach (node; nearby) {
        bool needsBuilding = graph.ensureStructureAt(node.slot);
        if (needsBuilding) {
            hashes.insert(graph.idAt(node.slot), graph.hashGenerated(node.slot));
        }
    }
}

ExitStatus checkForget(FILE* output, ubyte dimension, Worldgen worldgen) {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(dimension, worldgen);
    StructureProblem problem = graph.placeWorldStructure();
    uint differing = 0;
    uint forgotten = 0;
    if (!problem.isPresent) {
        NearbyScratch scratch;
        Position anchor = Position(graph.idAt(graph.anchorSlot), Motion!float.identity());
        HashMap!(NodeId, ulong) first;
        graph.hashStructured(scratch.collectAll(graph, anchor, STRUCTURE_DUMP_RADIUS), first);
        StructureCounts painted = StructureCounts.of(graph);
        uint far = graph.anchorSlot;
        foreach (step; 0 .. FORGET_STEPS) {
            uint side = step * FORGET_SIDE_STRIDE;
            while (graph.isParentFace(far, cast(Face)(side % FACE_COUNT))) {
                side += 1;
            }
            far = graph.ensureNeighborSlot(far, cast(Face)(side % FACE_COUNT));
        }
        NearbyScratch away;
        away.collectAll(graph, Position(graph.idAt(far), Motion!float.identity()), FORGET_NEAR_RADIUS);
        Evictor evictor;
        Array!Unloaded unloaded;
        double evicting = nowMilliseconds();
        foreach (_; 0 .. FORGET_SWEEPS) {
            unloaded.clear();
            evictor.sweep(graph, away, null, Point!float.origin(), unloaded, nowMilliseconds());
        }
        evicting = nowMilliseconds() - evicting;
        forgotten = evictor.forgottenTiles;
        StructureCounts left = StructureCounts.of(graph);
        EdgeUses edgeUses = graph.structures.blueprint.edgeUses();
        HashMap!(NodeId, Present) kept;
        size_t structured = 0;
        size_t keptCount = 0;
        foreach (ref const id, ref const hash; first) {
            structured += 1;
            if (graph.slotOf(id).exists) {
                kept.insert(id, Present.init);
                keptCount += 1;
            }
        }
        HashMap!(NodeId, ulong) again;
        graph.hashStructured(scratch.collectAll(graph, anchor, STRUCTURE_DUMP_RADIUS), again);
        uint missing = 0;
        uint keptDiffering = 0;
        foreach (ref const id, ref const hash; first) {
            const(ulong)* repainted = again.find(id);
            if (repainted is null) {
                missing += 1;
            } else if (*repainted != hash) {
                differing += 1;
                if (kept.find(id) !is null) {
                    keptDiffering += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        differing += missing;
        fprintf(output, "forget evicting %u nodes and %u tiles took %.0fms\n", evictor.evicted, evictor.droppedTiles, evicting);
        fprintf(output, "forget structured=%zu (%zu never evicted) forgot=%u of %u dropped tiles,lines %zu->%zu edges %zu->%zu (kept %u, used %u, unused %u) pending %zu->%zu tiles %zu->%zu, differing=%u (%u never evicted, %u missing)\n", structured, keptCount, forgotten, evictor.droppedTiles, painted.lines, left.lines, painted.edges, left.edges, edgeUses.kept, edgeUses.used, edgeUses.unused, painted.pending, left.pending, painted.tiles, left.tiles, differing, keptDiffering, missing);
        kept.release();
        first.release();
        again.release();
        unloaded.release();
        evictor.release();
        away.release();
        scratch.release();
        problem = growthProblem(graph);
    }
    printProblem(output, problem);
    graph.release();
    return exitStatus(!problem.isPresent && differing == 0 && forgotten > 0);
}

ExitStatus printSlices(FILE* output, ubyte dimension, Worldgen worldgen, int height) {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(dimension, worldgen);
    StructureProblem problem = graph.placeWorldStructure();
    if (!problem.isPresent) {
        SiteFrame root = rootSite(graph.anchorSlot);
        SiteFrame[2] vertices = [root, forwarded(root, 1)];
        foreach (vertex, first; vertices) {
            SiteFrame around = first;
            foreach (index; 0 .. SLICE_QUARTERS_AROUND) {
                fprintf(output, "vertex %u quarter %u\n", cast(uint) vertex, cast(uint) index);
                graph.printQuarter(output, around, height);
                around = graph.view.turnSite(around, Turn.right);
            }
        }
        SiteFrame corner = root;
        foreach (index; 0 .. SLICE_QUARTERS_OF_FACE) {
            fprintf(output, "face quarter %u\n", cast(uint) index);
            graph.printQuarter(output, corner, height);
            corner = graph.view.turnSite(forwarded(corner, 1), Turn.right);
        }
        problem = growthProblem(graph);
    }
    printProblem(output, problem);
    ExitStatus status = exitStatus(!problem.isPresent);
    graph.release();
    return status;
}

void printQuarter(ref Graph graph, FILE* output, SiteFrame quarter, int height) {
    SiteFrame tower = graph.view.turnSite(graph.view.turnSite(quarter, Turn.pitchUp), Turn.rollRight);
    int far = graph.layout.dimension - 1;
    foreach_reverse (y; 0 .. far + 1) {
        foreach (x; 0 .. far + 1) {
            char mark = '#';
            Material generated = graph.generateAt(tower, Vec3!int(x, y, height));
            if (generated == Material.none) {
                mark = '.';
            }
            fputc(mark, output);
        }
        fputc('\n', output);
    }
}

Material generateAt(ref Graph graph, SiteFrame tower, Vec3!int cell) {
    Point!float center = sitePlacement(tower, graph.layout) * columnPoint(graph.layout, ColumnSpot(cell.x + 0.5f, cell.y + 0.5f, cell.z + 0.5f));
    Position at = graph.ensureNormalized(Position(graph.idAt(tower.node), Motion!float.shiftTo(center)));
    uint slot = graph.slotOf(at.node).value;
    ChunkPoint inChunk = chunkPointOf(at.local * Point!float.origin());
    Vec3!int voxel = void;
    foreach (axis; 0 .. 3) {
        voxel[axis] = cast(int) floorf(graph.layout.cubeToGrid(inChunk.coords[axis]));
    }
    GeneratedVoxels generated = ChunkParams.make(graph.view, slot, inChunk.corner).generateVoxels();
    Material material = generated.voxels.at(cellIndex(graph.layout.dimension, voxel.x, voxel.y, voxel.z));
    generated.voxels.release();
    return material;
}

ulong hashGenerated(ref Graph graph, uint slot) {
    ulong hash = 0;
    foreach (cornerIndex; 0 .. CORNER_COUNT) {
        GeneratedVoxels generated = ChunkParams.make(graph.view, slot, cast(Corner) cornerIndex).generateVoxels();
        hash += ContentHashes.fromVoxels(cast(Corner) cornerIndex, generated.voxels, graph.layout.dimension).materials.first;
        generated.voxels.release();
    }
    return hash;
}

Graph terrainGraph(ubyte dimension) {
    Graph graph = Graph.make(dimension, Worldgen.makeTerrain());
    StructureProblem problem = graph.placeWorldStructure();
    assert(!problem.isPresent);
    return graph;
}

double averageOf(double total, size_t count) {
    if (count > 0) {
        return total / count;
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}

void benchGen(FILE* output, float radius, ubyte dimension) {
    Graph graph = terrainGraph(dimension);
    NearbyScratch scratch;
    NearbyNode[] nearby = scratch.collectAll(graph, Position.origin(), radius);
    ChunkPass pass;
    pass.generate(graph, nearby, radius);
    uint dense = pass.generated - pass.solid;
    fprintf(output, "bench-gen dim=%u radius=%.2f chunks=%u solid=%u dense=%u deferred=%u resolved_on_exposure=%u\n", cast(uint) dimension, cast(double) radius, pass.generated, pass.solid, dense, pass.deferred, pass.deferred - graph.countDeferred());
    fprintf(output, "params total=%.1fms avg=%.3fms\n", pass.paramsMs, averageOf(pass.paramsMs, pass.generated));
    fprintf(output, "voxels total=%.1fms avg=%.3fms dense_avg=%.3fms\n", pass.voxelsMs, averageOf(pass.voxelsMs, pass.generated), averageOf(pass.denseMs, dense));
    fprintf(output, "populate total=%.1fms avg=%.3fms\n", pass.populateMs, averageOf(pass.populateMs, pass.generated));
    scratch.release();
    graph.release();
}

void benchMesh(FILE* output, float radius, ubyte dimension) {
    Graph graph = terrainGraph(dimension);
    graph.generateWorld(radius);
    Mesher mesher;
    mesher.setup(dimension);
    uint meshed = 0;
    size_t faces = 0;
    size_t mostFaces = 0;
    double totalMs = 0;
    double slowestMs = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. cast(size_t) graph.slotCount * CORNER_COUNT) {
        if (graph.needsMesh(ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index))) {
            double start = nowMilliseconds();
            size_t count = mesher.mesh(graph, ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index)).length;
            double elapsed = nowMilliseconds() - start;
            totalMs += elapsed;
            slowestMs = higherOf(elapsed, slowestMs);
            mostFaces = higherOf(count, mostFaces);
            faces += count;
            meshed += 1;
        }
    }
    fprintf(output, "bench-mesh dim=%u radius=%.2f meshed=%u faces=%zu max_faces=%zu total=%.1fms avg=%.4fms max=%.4fms\n", cast(uint) dimension, cast(double) radius, meshed, faces, mostFaces, totalMs, averageOf(totalMs, meshed), slowestMs);
    mesher.release();
    graph.release();
}

void benchDrive(FILE* output, float radius, ubyte dimension) {
    Graph graph = terrainGraph(dimension);
    NearbyScratch scratch;
    NearbyNode[] nearby = scratch.collectAll(graph, Position.origin(), radius);
    Streamer streamer = Streamer.make();
    uint nodesBefore = graph.slotCount;
    double start = nowMilliseconds();
    double driveMs = 0;
    uint drives = 0;
    do {
        double driveStart = nowMilliseconds();
        streamer.drive(graph, nearby, Position.origin(), Motion!float.identity(), radius, DRIVE_NEARBY_VERSION, Pacing.budgeted, Deadline.at(driveStart + DRIVE_BUDGET_MILLISECONDS));
        driveMs += nowMilliseconds() - driveStart;
        drives += 1;
        if (streamer.inFlight > 0) {
            streamer.integrate(graph, Deadline.init);
        }
    } while (streamer.inFlight > 0 || streamer.scanCursor < nearby.length);
    double totalMs = nowMilliseconds() - start;
    uint populated = 0;
    foreach (index; 0 .. cast(size_t) graph.slotCount * CORNER_COUNT) {
        if (graph.chunks.at(ChunkSlot.fromIndex(index)).state == ChunkState.populated) {
            populated += 1;
        }
    }
    fprintf(output, "bench-drive dim=%u radius=%.2f populated=%u nodes=%u->%u drives=%u total=%.1fms drive=%.1fms integrate_and_wait=%.1fms\n", cast(uint) dimension, cast(double) radius, populated, nodesBefore, graph.slotCount, drives, totalMs, driveMs, totalMs - driveMs);
    double idleStart = nowMilliseconds();
    foreach (_; 0 .. DRIVE_IDLE_ITERATIONS) {
        streamer.drive(graph, nearby, Position.origin(), Motion!float.identity(), radius, DRIVE_NEARBY_VERSION, Pacing.budgeted, Deadline.at(nowMilliseconds() + DRIVE_BUDGET_MILLISECONDS));
    }
    fprintf(output, "bench-drive idle scan=%.3fms/drive nodes=%zu\n", (nowMilliseconds() - idleStart) / DRIVE_IDLE_ITERATIONS, nearby.length);
    streamer.release();
    scratch.release();
    graph.release();
}

void benchNearby(FILE* output, float radius, uint iterations, ubyte dimension) {
    Graph graph = terrainGraph(dimension);
    NearbyScratch scratch;
    double coldStart = nowMilliseconds();
    size_t nodeCount = scratch.collectPruned(graph, radius).length;
    double coldMs = nowMilliseconds() - coldStart;
    double start = nowMilliseconds();
    foreach (_; 0 .. iterations) {
        scratch.collectPruned(graph, radius);
    }
    fprintf(output, "bench-nearby dim=%u radius=%.1f nodes=%zu graph=%u iterations=%u cold=%.1fms collect=%.3fms\n", cast(uint) dimension, cast(double) radius, nodeCount, graph.slotCount, iterations, coldMs, (nowMilliseconds() - start) / iterations);
    scratch.release();
    graph.release();
}

NodeId benchKey(ulong index) {
    return NodeId(Hash128(SplitMix(index).next(), SplitMix(~index).next()));
}

struct WorstBatch {
    double start = 0;
    double worst = 0;

    void after(size_t index) {
        if (index % BENCH_MAP_BATCH == BENCH_MAP_BATCH - 1) {
            double now = nowMilliseconds();
            worst = higherOf(now - start, worst);
            start = now;
        }
    }
}

void benchHashMap(FILE* output) {
    HashMap!(NodeId, uint) map;
    double start = nowMilliseconds();
    WorstBatch batch = WorstBatch(start);
    foreach (index; 0 .. BENCH_MAP_LIVE) {
        map.insert(benchKey(index), cast(uint) index);
        batch.after(index);
    }
    double filled = nowMilliseconds();
    batch.start = filled;
    foreach (index; 0 .. BENCH_MAP_CHURN) {
        map.insert(benchKey(BENCH_MAP_LIVE + index), cast(uint) index);
        map.remove(benchKey(index));
        batch.after(index);
    }
    double churned = nowMilliseconds();
    size_t found = 0;
    SplitMix pick = SplitMix(BENCH_MAP_LIVE);
    foreach (_; 0 .. BENCH_MAP_LOOKUPS) {
        if (map.find(benchKey(BENCH_MAP_CHURN + pick.next() % BENCH_MAP_LIVE)) !is null) {
            found += 1;
        }
    }
    double hit = nowMilliseconds();
    foreach (index; 0 .. BENCH_MAP_LOOKUPS) {
        if (map.find(benchKey(index)) !is null) {
            found += 1;
        }
    }
    double missed = nowMilliseconds();
    size_t capacity = map.current.capacity;
    map.release();
    double released = nowMilliseconds();
    fprintf(output, "bench-hashmap live=%zu: fill %.1fns/insert, churn %.1fns/insert+remove, slowest %zu changes %.2fms, hit %.1fns, miss %.1fns, found %zu of %zu, releasing %zu slots %.1fms\n", BENCH_MAP_LIVE, (filled - start) * NANOSECONDS_PER_MILLISECOND / BENCH_MAP_LIVE, (churned - filled) * NANOSECONDS_PER_MILLISECOND / BENCH_MAP_CHURN, BENCH_MAP_BATCH, batch.worst, (hit - churned) * NANOSECONDS_PER_MILLISECOND / BENCH_MAP_LOOKUPS, (missed - hit) * NANOSECONDS_PER_MILLISECOND / BENCH_MAP_LOOKUPS, found, BENCH_MAP_LOOKUPS, capacity, released - missed);
}

NearbyNode[] collectPruned(ref NearbyScratch scratch, ref Graph graph, float radius) {
    scratch.begin(graph, Position.origin(), radius, FULL_RADIUS);
    scratch.advance(graph, Deadline.init, Executor.init);
    return scratch.nodes.slice();
}
